title: Support Engineer IV, Amazon Robotics
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Robotics IT is at the forefront of designing and deploying AI and Robotics solutions that directly impact some of Amazon's most critical programs — both internally and externally. Our IT teams keep Robotics development, design, deployment, and manufacturing operations running at peak performance, enabling innovation at a global scale.

As a Senior IT Support Engineer, you will serve as a technical leader and escalation point for a team of IT Support Technicians, remote support teams, and Operations stakeholders. You will own the implementation and maintenance of critical infrastructure — with a strong emphasis on networking and Linux systems — while delivering white glove support to senior leadership across multiple business entities.

You will play a hands-on role in supporting the buildout and ongoing operations of robotics lab environments, working directly alongside R&D and engineering teams. You will drive continuous improvement, lead site and cross-functional projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of IT operations for Amazon Robotics.

This role offers significant opportunities to innovate, lead, and make a measurable impact as part of a high-performing, multinational team.

Key job responsibilities
Infrastructure & Operations
• Implement, maintain, and optimize IT infrastructure, with a strong focus on network architecture, Linux systems, audio/video, and end-user devices, ensuring maximum availability and performance
• Configure and troubleshoot network infrastructure including switches, routers, firewalls, VLANs, and wireless systems in alignment with Amazon standards
• Administer and maintain Linux-based systems (Ubuntu, RHEL, or equivalent), including server configuration, patching, scripting, and performance tuning
• Design and maintain lab network segmentation, including isolated VLANs, dedicated lab subnets, and semi-air-gapped environments to support AI/ML development and testing workflows
• Support the physical buildout of robotics lab environments, including rack and stack of high-density compute, GPU clusters, cabling, and associated network infrastructure
• Liaise with global SME teams to facilitate the installation and maintenance of networking and server infrastructure in accordance with Amazon standards
• Perform site audits on technical infrastructure to ensure adherence to Amazon IT and Health & Safety guidelines

Stakeholder Engagement & Escalation
• Serve as the primary IT point of contact and escalation for the business, Operations, R&D and engineering teams, and cross-functional support teams
• Communicate confidently, both verbally and in writing, with senior management and stakeholders at varying levels across multiple business entities
• Act as the interface between IT Support Technicians, remote teams, and Operations on technical issues
• Represent the IT department in site meetings and conference calls
• Manage relationships with contractors and external suppliers, clearly communicating technical requirements and Amazon standards

Project & Change Management
• Lead and manage site and cross-functional IT projects as a single point of contact, keeping stakeholders informed of progress and maintaining project documentation
• Lead lab infrastructure buildout projects, translating AI and engineering team requirements into network and systems design, procurement, and deployment plans
• Create, review, revise, and execute change management requests and project plans
• Interact with suppliers, request quotes, and procure equipment in accordance with policies, budgets, and operational demand

Team Development & Reporting
• Provide direction, mentoring, and training to IT Support Technicians and engineers, with a focus on networking and Linux best practices; act as technical contact for remote support teams
• Manage and audit departmental documentation to ensure accuracy and currency
• Produce weekly reports covering key metrics and work performed
• Contribute to the paid on-call schedule covering your home site and regional node for high-severity incidents
• Support the recruitment of new talent into Amazon Robotics IT through interviews
• Occasional travel required

About the team
Robotics IT Service Management is responsible for the IT support of Robotics manufacturing, design, and innovation on a global scale. We work directly with the teams that are creating some of the leading Robotics and AI technology in the world.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or experience related IT
- Experience with networking technology (TCP/IP, subnetting, DNS and DHCP)
- Experience in Linux systems administration and/or development
- Experience with network hardware: copper and optical fiber cabling, switches, routers
- Experience in managing and troublshooting network, or experience in technical support and experience in Linux and Networking protocols
- Experience using Linux, demonstrating proficiency with associated tools or languages
- Experience in technical support, or experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems and experience in managing and troublshooting network
- Experience managing and coordinating multiple projects simultaneously

Preferred qualifications

- CCNA or equivalent level networking certification, or Bachelor's degree
- Experience in Linux and Networking protocols, or experience in Network protocols like DNS/DHCP/TCP and experience with automation and any version control tools

title: Applied Science Manager, Translation Services
descriptionHtml:
Have you ever wondered how Amazon launches and maintains a consistent customer experience across hundreds of countries and languages it serves its customers? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you!
Translation Services is seeking an Applied Science Manager to own the technical vision and multi-year science roadmap spanning machine translation, multimodal content (image translation, video subtitling), and automated quality evaluation. This leader will manage scientists and MLEs, define research direction for novel problem spaces with limited industry precedent, and bridge science breakthroughs into production-ready systems operating at Amazon scale.

As a leader of the Science team of TS, this person will be responsible for leading their team in designing algorithmic solutions based on data and mathematics for translating billions of words annually across 130+ and expanding set of locales. The goal is to build solutions with minimal human touch involved in any language translation and ensure accurate translated text is available to our worldwide customers in a streamlined and optimized manner.

With access to vast amounts of data, technology, and a diverse community of talented individuals, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the way customers and stakeholders engage with Amazon and our platform worldwide. This role requires strong technical skills, a deep understanding of machine learning approaches, and a solid grasp on NLP and LLM techniques to solve complex language translation challenges. You must have a demonstrated ability for optimizing, developing, launching, and maintaining large-scale production systems.

As a key member of the team, you will oversee all aspects of the software lifecycle: design, experimentation, implementation, and testing. You should be willing to dive deep when needed, move rapidly with a bias for action, and get things done. You should have an entrepreneurial spirit, know how to deliver, and long for the opportunity to build pioneering solutions to challenging problems. This role will demand resourcefulness and willingness to learn on both the technical and business side.


Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will work closely with business partners, applied scientists, software development engineers, and product managers to accelerate building solutions to expand translation capabilities. You will have significant influence on our overall strategy by helping define science and engineering strategy, define product features, drive system architecture, and spearhead the best-practices that enable a quality product. You will also influence the development processes, and develop well-rounded skills such as leadership, and effective project management. Building a strong development team and developing career plans for the scientists and engineers reporting to you will be a key responsibility. Throughout, you should possess creativity, curiosity, and excellent judgment to thrive in an environment of ambiguity.

A day in the life
You will spend your days collaborating with scientists, developers, customers, stakeholders, and converting the business needs into a data-driven solution. You will support a team to design and execute science products. You will dive deep into the data and balance technical execution with longer term strategy. You will grow and develop your team.

About the team
Translation Services is entering a phase where the problems ahead are fundamentally different from the problems we've solved. Our text translation stack is production-grade and serving 30+ language pairs across Retail. But the next frontier — image translation, video subtitle localization, long form text and automated quality evaluation — represents novel research problems at Amazon scale with limited industry precedent.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of scientists or machine learning engineers management experience
- Knowledge of ML, NLP, Information Retrieval and Analytics

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application
- Experience building complex software systems, especially involving deep learning, machine learning and computer vision, that have been successfully delivered to customers

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AWS is looking for a dynamic Commissioning Engineer. It is the responsibility of all Amazonians to have alignment with our leadership principles and demonstrate these at the highest level.

The responsibilities of the ACx Commissioning Engineer (CxE) include, but are not limited to, oversight and coordination of multi-discipline division of work related to design review and commissioning of Amazon critical infrastructure for new construction and special projects. The CxE is responsible for supporting vendors, contractors, and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems including medium and low voltage power systems, Generators, UPS, HVAC, Chilled Water, BMS, and EPMS systems. It is the CxE responsibility to ensure that all commissioning procedures follow the appropriate safety practices and policies. The CxE proactively communicates with the ACx Regional Manager and the ACx team to ensure that the applicable test documents are created and executed in accordance with all commissioning requirements. Key job responsibilities

title: Data Center Engineering Operations Technician
descriptionHtml:
How would you like to be a part of Earth’s most customer-centric company? You would work with teams of front-line responders who support the operations of some of the world’s most powerful data centers. Our Data Center Engineering Operations team maintain and operate our critical infrastructure systems so that they are prepared to stand up against any situation.

AWS has the world’s largest cloud computing portfolio. As an Amazonian you will work in some of the most sophisticated, safe, and secure data centers in the world. Our Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT’s) help keep them that way by working with the brightest minds from around the globe to help test and implement the newest technology and work practices to meet the demands of a changing market.

We have a passion for learning and evolving, it’s how we have helped define ourselves as leaders in the industry. Let’s work hard, have fun, and make history!

Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Work Schedule:
Our Data Centers operate 24/7 and require on-site presence. This position offers two shift schedule options:

Option 1: Weekend Rotation
- Days Worked: Sunday - Tuesday, plus every other Saturday
- Weekly Pattern: Alternates between 3-day and 4-day work weeks
- Shift Hours: 5:30am - 6:00pm (day shift) OR 5:30pm - 6:00am (night shift)

Option 2: Weekday Rotation
- Days Worked: Wednesday - Friday, plus every other Saturday
- Weekly Pattern: Alternates between 3-day and 4-day work weeks
- Shift Hours: 5:30am - 6:00pm (day shift) OR 5:30pm - 6:00am (night shift)

Both schedules follow a rotating pattern where you'll work 3 days one week and 4 days the following week.

Overtime & Pay
- Overtime: Time and a half after 40 hours per week
- Night Shift Differential: 13% additional pay (6:00pm - 6:00am shifts)
- Maximum Hours: 60 hours per week in total (up to 20 hours of overtime)

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration
- 2+ years of practical experience in electrical systems, mechanical systems, HVAC, and/or fire suppression systems
- Can bend or twist the body into unusual positions while working, use hands to manipulate small wires and objects, walk on job sites in uneven terrain, and work at heights and from ladders

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in data center engineering

Amazon Web Services provides a highly reliable, scalable, and low-cost cloud platform that powers thousands of businesses in over 190 countries. AWS’ Infrastructure Supply Chain & Procurement organization works to deliver solutions to source, build and maintain our socially responsible data center supply chains. We are a team of highly-motivated, engaged, and responsive professionals who enable the core sustainable infrastructure of AWS. Come join our team and be a part of history as we deliver results for the largest cloud services company on Earth!

The IPS Procurement Category Management Org is responsible for the procurement of all third party provided services required for the operation of our Data Center infrastructure globally, including Colo and Edge facilities for externally delivered services not provided by the facility owner. The team is responsible for the identification, on boarding and performance management of suppliers as well as developing category strategies, conducting competitive tendering processes, supplier negotiations and the preparation of associated Work Orders.

The team is structured into three regions, each led by a regional manager, with each regional team composed of category managers with responsibility for the management of specific areas of spend within the region and a cohort of procurement specialists who support the category managers. The category management approach facilitates a strategic approach to procurement by facilitating in depth market analysis coupled with a cross functional approach to identify supplier and associated contracting options which are focused on meeting the particular needs of the business. Category management moves beyond traditional transactional based purchasing negotiations to provide a strategic approach to longer term, sustainable cost reductions, reducing risk and increasing resiliency in the supply base and facilitating innovation from within the supply base that the business can leverage.
While cost reduction will always be a key focus of the team, the principle cynosure of the team is the delivery of services that are keenly focused on increasing reliability and supporting enhanced availability through robust relationships which support continuity of operations. As service and quality levels can vary greatly, principally based on the skill set within a supplier local organization, the regional structure facilitates tailoring of category strategies to meet local market considerations and closely monitor supplier performance at the local level.


Key job responsibilities
The ideal candidate thinks long term, drives multiple initiatives, and communicates appropriately and influences customers and suppliers at all levels. You must be collaborative, but also work with significant autonomy. To be successful in this role you must be highly analytical; think strategically and globally; have a sense of urgency to meet customer timelines; exhibit curiosity and learning drive; succeed in a fast-paced environment; engage and influence key stakeholders; and have a high level of customer focus and business judgement. Also, you must have a demonstrated track record of managing multiple projects and driving them to completion to meet business objectives. It will be critical to embrace and model Amazon’s Leadership Principles and have an entrepreneurial spirit with a “get it done” mentality.

•Manage a complex category within the Maintenance, Repair, and Operation (MRO) and Facility Management domains.

•Achieve cost savings through bidding and negotiations, drive collaboration to achieve long term value delivery.

•Obtain market intelligence, analyze category data and metrics to drive Procurement category strategies.

•Understand trends in customers’ needs and concerns, across categories and regions, to influence customers’ priorities.

•Lead supplier selection process across multiple sub-categories, internal teams, and regions, and create longer-term supplier selection strategies for management.

•Ensure you are knowledgeable about the supply market, new innovations and supplier capabilities, technically and geographically.

•Ensure you are knowledgeable about sustainability, diversity, in-country value and have experience developing category strategies to incorporate same.

•Develop mechanisms and metrics to track supplier performance related to delivery, quality, and cost.

•Create supplier scorecards to measure and track supplier performance.

•Lead business reviews to discuss best practices and issues and to ultimately improve supplier performance and strengthen business partnerships.

•Innovate within the procurement space, automating and/or improving tools or processes to better support the Procurement Lifecycle.

•Provide support throughout the contracting process, as well as SRM and management of contracts post-execution.

Travel domestic and international as required.

- 5+ years of relevant strategic sourcing including vendor negotiations, global contract management, process improvement, operational and financial analysis experience

title: Software Development Engineer II, PartyRock
descriptionHtml:
How do you teach millions of people to understand AI, not by lecturing, but by letting them build? That is the challenge we are solving on the PartyRock team in Berlin.

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to help us turn AI literacy into a hands-on experience. You will work on PartyRock (partyrock.aws), an AI-powered application builder that lets non-technical users create interactive web apps using natural language. Your code will directly shape how students, educators, and curious minds around the world learn AI by doing AI.

This is a backend role on a small, fast-moving team where you ship frequently, work across the entire stack, and see your work reach real users within days.

Party Rock is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build features across the full stack, from React frontend to Lambda backend to the database, in a TypeScript-first codebase with end-to-end type safety
- Prototype and ship new AI-powered experiences that make complex AI concepts accessible to non-technical users
- Collaborate with partner organizations and cross-functional teams to bring AI education to classrooms and events worldwide
- Contribute to system reliability through code reviews, operational excellence, and participation in an on-call rotation

A day in the life
You will work in our Berlin office as part of an engineering team with full ownership of the product. One day you might be building a new AI-powered widget, the next you are optimizing streaming performance for thousands of concurrent users, and the day after you are prototyping an idea that came out of a conversation with an educator around the globe.

We ship fast and iterate often. You will work across frontend, backend, infrastructure, and AI integration, with guidance from experienced engineers when you need it.

We are in-office in Berlin and value a sustainable pace. You will participate in an on-call rotation to keep our systems reliable.

About the team
Our mission: we democratize AI literacy by enabling anyone to learn through building. By creating solutions to their real problems, people develop transferable AI skills and insights. Learning AI by doing AI.

We are a Berlin-based team within AWS, building PartyRock (partyrock.aws). Our users range from students in classrooms to employees exploring AI for the first time. We work with education partners all over the world to bring AI literacy to millions of people through events and direct access.

Engineers own features end-to-end, from database schema to production deployment, and we use AI throughout our own development process. If you want to work close to customers, ship often, and see your impact directly, this is the team.

You would work on the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Developer Tools org where we are going to use generative AI and foundation models to re-imagine the experience of all builders on AWS. From the IDE to web based tools and services AI will help engineers to work on large and small applications. In this team we have to explore new technologies and find creative solutions. Curiosity and an explorative mindset can find a place to impact the life of engineers around the world.

Diverse Experiences

title: Manager, Electrical & Controls Engineering , OneMHS - Electrical and Control Engineering, Arch and Design
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Manager, Electrical & Controls Engineering to lead and manage the electrical power systems and controls engineering function within One MHS (One Material Handling Systems). This role will be responsible for overseeing the complete design, development, and implementation of electrical power distribution and control systems for material handling projects — while leading a team of engineers to deliver solutions that prioritize safety, scalability, and operational excellence. As part of OneMHS, you will shape how we design, build, and operate material handling capabilities through strategic leadership in electrical and controls engineering.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in electrical power system design, controls engineering, industrial communication protocols, and automation platforms for complex material handling systems including conveyance and sortation — combined with demonstrated leadership experience managing engineering teams. You will drive cross-functional collaboration with mechanical engineering, software, and project management teams to deliver robust electrical and controls solutions while ensuring compliance with NEC code and industry standards.

This role requires both deep technical expertise spanning electrical power design and controls engineering, and strong people leadership skills — including the ability to build high-performing teams, set strategic direction, manage resources, and drive organizational excellence in project delivery.


Key job responsibilities
Leadership & Team Management

• Lead, mentor, and develop a team of electrical and controls engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement
• Set strategic direction for the electrical and controls engineering function, aligning team objectives with broader OneMHS program goals
• Manage resource allocation, workload balancing, and project assignments to ensure on-time, high-quality delivery across multiple concurrent projects
• Conduct performance reviews, career development planning, and talent acquisition for the electrical and controls engineering team
• Establish and enforce engineering standards, design review processes, and quality gates across the team
• Drive organizational improvements including process optimization, tool adoption, and knowledge management initiatives
• Represent the electrical and controls engineering function in leadership meetings, program reviews, and strategic planning sessions

Power Systems Design & Distribution

• Oversee the design of all power and controls systems related to MH projects, including 3-phase and single-phase power distribution systems
• Direct the development of electrical layouts, schematics, control architectures, and panel standardization for material handling applications
• Ensure modular and scalable power distribution system designs that prioritize reliability, maintainability, and performance
• Establish and maintain best practices for panel placement, grounding, and safety circuit design
• Approve single-line diagrams, power distribution schematics, and panel schedules to support facility and equipment power needs

Controls Engineering & Communication Protocols

• Oversee the design and implementation of industrial communication networks utilizing EtherCAT, Ethernet/IP, and PROFINET protocols
• Direct control system architecture development incorporating IPCs (Industrial PCs), PLCs (Programmable Logic Controllers), and SCADA systems
• Ensure proper specification, configuration, and integration of Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs) and their associated interfaces within material handling systems
• Oversee the selection, specification, and integration of sensors, encoders, safety circuits, and all safety devices in accordance with applicable safety standards
• Ensure the design and implementation of safety systems including light curtains, safety relays, E-stops, and safety PLCs meet all regulatory requirements

In-Field Installation Audits & Compliance

• Establish audit programs and oversee in-field installation audits to verify compliance with design specifications, quality standards, and NEC code requirements
• Review and approve electrical and controls drawings, specifications, and submittals at a program level
• Drive continuous improvement by auditing electrical system designs to identify opportunities and develop superior solutions
• Ensure all designs and installations comply with the National Electrical Code (NEC) / NFPA 70 and other applicable standards
• Stay current with NEC code revisions, NFPA updates, and industry regulatory changes, and communicate impacts to the team

Collaboration & Strategic Engagement

• Partner with cross-functional leadership including mechanical engineering, software, and project management to deliver fully integrated solutions
• Serve as the primary technical authority and escalation point for electrical and controls engineering decisions
• Drive commissioning strategy, troubleshooting protocols, and startup activities across projects
• Develop and maintain electrical and controls design standards, best practices, and organizational playbooks
• Build relationships with vendors, suppliers, and external partners to drive innovation and cost optimization


A day in the life
Lead your team of electrical and controls engineers in delivering world-class solutions for material handling projects with industry-leading performance in reliability, safety, and scalability. Set priorities and allocate resources across multiple concurrent projects while providing technical oversight on power distribution system designs and control architectures. Conduct design reviews, approve specifications for VFDs, sensors, encoders, and safety devices, and ensure optimal system performance across the portfolio.

Guide your team in implementing industrial communication networks using EtherCAT, Ethernet/IP, and PROFINET protocols while developing PLC and SCADA-based control systems. Oversee in-field installation audit programs to verify NEC code compliance and design integrity. Mentor and develop engineers at all levels while driving continuous improvement in design standards, documentation processes, and team capabilities across the OneMHS program. Engage with cross-functional leadership to align on program strategy and remove barriers for your team.

title: Pricing Manager, OTR Strategy, Now LM OTR Strategy
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Now is India's fastest-growing quick commerce platform — and the pricing mechanisms that power our last-mile network are built by this team. If you want to own national-scale OTR pricing strategy while acting as the voice of Delivery Partners across a high-velocity network, this role is for you.

As a Program Manager on the Amazon Now OTR Strategy team, you will design and deploy rider rate cards and incentive structures that shape the economics of millions of deliveries across India. You will ensure Delivery Partners have competitive, reliable earnings — making Amazon the number one destination for delivery work in every city we operate in. Our Delivery Partners are the face of Amazon in front of our customers, and this role exists to make sure they are engaged, fairly compensated, and set up to thrive.


Key job responsibilities
OTR Rate Card Design & Deployment: Own end-to-end design and deployment of OTR rate cards and Delivery Partner incentive structures at national scale. Pricing is the lever that moves everything else.

Voice of Delivery Partners: Track earnings competitiveness, identify reliability gaps, and drive interventions that make Amazon the number one destination for delivery work. Our Delivery Partners are the face of Amazon.

Benchmarking: Lead competitor rate card benchmarking at hyper-local granularity and translate field intelligence into actionable pricing recommendations.

Incentive Programs: Design surge pricing and productivity-linked incentive programs that keep Delivery Partners engaged across peak and off-peak cycles.

Pricing Analytics: Build frameworks in SQL/R and Excel to monitor rate card performance, track cost-per-delivery trends, and measure impact of pricing interventions.

Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with LM Operations, Forecasting, Finance, Product and Capacity Planning teams to ensure pricing decisions are smart, operationally grounded and financially sustainable.

Senior Leadership Reporting: Present data-backed pricing recommendations to senior leadership, distilling complex trade-offs into clear decision points.

A day in the life
Your day typically starts with a quick review of overnight delivery cost metrics and flagging any rate card anomalies across clusters. Mid-morning you might be on a call with a 3P partner discussing IC benchmarking data, or pulling a SQL query to size the earnings gap in a specific city. Afternoons are often cross-functional — aligning with Operations on a surge pricing intervention, walking Finance through CPD impact, or providing pricing inputs for a new product launch. You will spend time in the field periodically, talking to Delivery Partners directly to understand what the data does not always show.

About the team
The Amazon Now OTR Strategy team defines how Delivery Partners are compensated and how pricing mechanisms scale across India's fastest-growing quick commerce network. We are a small, high-ownership team that combines financial rigor with deep operational context — we move fast, learn from data, and hold ourselves accountable to clear outcomes. Our work sits at the intersection of finance, operations, product, and field execution, with direct impact on millions of deliveries every month. If you want ownership, visibility, and the chance to build something at scale — this is the team for you.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of program or project management experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- 2+ years of Quick Commerce experience with 1+ years of QC last mile rate card design experience.

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
- MBA

Work/Life Balance
Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. Most days, our entire team is co-located in the Seattle office, but we’re also flexible when people occasionally need to work remote. We generally keep core in-office hours from 10am to 4pm. About half of us come in earlier and the other half of us stay later.

On-Call Responsibility
This position involves on-call responsibilities, typically for one week every two months. We don’t like getting paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so that we don’t get paged for the same issue twice.

Mentorship & Career Growth
Our team is dedicated to supporting new team members. Our team has a broad mix of experience levels and Amazon tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior engineers truly enjoy mentoring more junior engineers and engineers from non-traditional backgrounds through one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth. We try to assign projects and tasks based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded engineer and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

The role is cross-functional and requires deep collaboration and influencing ability with stakeholders from business and corporate functions

A day in the life
As an SLP Specialist, you will join a team of Security and Loss Prevention professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area. Your daily focus will be on hands-on execution of security operations, including conducting physical security rounds, monitoring CCTV systems, and responding to immediate security concerns. You perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. During your investigations, you collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analysing data reports, and conducting interviews. You execute established procedures to address security incidents and implement approved solutions for identified vulnerabilities. Your findings help to identify vulnerabilities in our processes, for which you contribute to the development of mitigating measures. You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our sites by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems and, jointly with subject matter experts and external suppliers, maintain their functionality. You interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience. You also act as point of contact for multiple internal and external departments (e.g., legal, HR, security service providers, local law enforcement) and subject matter expert in Security and Loss Prevention-related matters. Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams and liaise with various stakeholders on policy and procedure across all management levels.

About the team
Sitting within the Worldwide Operations Security organisation, Security and Loss Prevention supports the accomplishment of Amazon´s business targets and the strengthening of our brand by effectively protecting against relevant threats and by managing security and loss prevention risks that could:
• Put our associates and customers under jeopardy
• Disrupt the continuity of our business operations
• Inflict damage to our assets
• Have adverse impact on our brand reputation
Working in partnership with our stakeholders, we secure the Amazon supply chain end-to-end and promote security during business conversations. We do this by preventing security and loss prevention-related risks and vulnerabilities as early as possible, intervening in unfolding incidents to minimize any negative impact as well as thoroughly investigating security-related incidents to identify and remove root causes, preventing reoccurrence.

descriptionHtml:
Do you want to shape the future of how Alexa enabled devices connect with Alexa Cloud? Do you want to be part of a team that builds services used by millions of customers? If you said yes to any or all of those, come join the Alexa Connected Devices!
We are looking for a passionate engineer to work on the development of Tier-1 Connectivity services for Alexa Cloud that enable connectivity between Alexa enabled devices (Echo, Smart Home etc.) and Alexa.

Key job responsibilities
• Building software to deliver a low latency, low cost, highly reliable, and high scalable connectivity between Alexa enabled devices and Alexa Cloud

About the team
The mission of the Alexa Connectivity teams is to deliver a low latency, low cost, highly reliable, and high scalable connectivity between Alexa enabled devices and Alexa Cloud. The changes we make, improves the speed and reliability experienced by end customers when interacting with Alexa devices, and simplifies experience for developers and rest of Alexa by abstracting the connection management from them. The team handles tens of billions of transactions per day. This is a highly visible role to get in the inception phase, build new features, and operate a tier-1 Cloud Service. title: Asistent/ka personalistiky (FTC)
descriptionHtml:
Vezměte prosím na vědomí, že se jedná o dvouletou smlouvu.

Jedním z mnoha důvodů, proč společnost Amazon zvedá laťku v oblasti spokojenosti zákazníků, je skutečnost, že v útvaru lidských zdrojů dbáme na to, aby za námi stál ten nejlepší tým. Potřebujeme aktivní zaměstnance, kteří mají proaktivní přístup k práci, abychom disponovali správnými talenty ve správném počtu a mohli tak uspokojovat potřeby našich zákazníků. Jako asistent/ka personalistiky budete mít za cíl motivovat naše zaměstnance a tvorbou naplňujícího pracovního prostředí udržovat jejich angažovanost. Jelikož budete pracovat jako součást týmu, budete mít možnost sdílet nápady a učit se od ostatních a rozvíjet tak svou kariéru.

Key job responsibilities
Nejedná se o tradiční kancelářskou práci, protože budete pracovat přímo v provozu a budete v přímém kontaktu s našimi týmy ve skladech. V závislosti na místě svého působení se můžete střídat s kolegy z útvaru lidských zdrojů. To znamená, že někdo z našeho personálního týmu je vždy přítomen, aby si mohl pohovořit se zaměstnanci a odpovídat na případné dotazy.
Role asistenta/asistentky personalistiky je různorodá. Kromě toho, že nám budete pomáhat udržovat přehled o klíčových procesech v oblasti lidských zdrojů, budete také podporovat vedoucí pracovníky ve svém týmu při různých projektech s cílem zajistit angažovanost zaměstnanců. Můžete také zajišťovat získávání zpětné vazby a realizovat činnosti, jejichž účelem je přimět lidi k zapojení do nových plánů. K této roli patří také poskytování podpory při vytváření inkluzivního prostředí, v němž mají zaměstnanci pocit, že mohou vznášet jakékoli dotazy týkající se lidských zdrojů.

descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. Proactive Prevention - Drive injury prevention through advanced data analysis and evidence-based solutions. Wellness Education - Champion a culture of proactive health and injury prevention through innovative training programs and hands-on coaching. Develop and deliver engaging ergonomic education that empowers associates to make informed decisions about their wellbeing. Build trusted partnerships with operations teams to integrate prevention strategies into daily workflows. title: Applied Scientist II, Grocery, Retail & In-Store Experience (GRAISE)
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a talented Applied Scientist to join our team. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy machine learning and computer vision models that solve real-world problems at scale in the Amazon grocery domain. You will work closely with engineering, product, and business teams to turn complex technical challenges into production-ready solutions, and own the model development lifecycle from experimentation through deployment. You will bring scientific rigor to every stage — from data analysis and model design to evaluation and iteration. This is a high-impact role where your models will directly improve the shopping experience for millions of customers in Amazon grocery stores.

Key job responsibilities
Design, train, and evaluate computer vision and machine learning models for complex grocery-domain problems including product identification, shelf perception, and in-store scene understanding — iterating rapidly from prototype to production-quality solutions
Conduct rigorous exploratory data analysis to characterize domain-specific challenges (image variability, catalog gaps, label noise) and translate findings into actionable modeling decisions
Own the model development lifecycle from experimentation through deployment — collaborating with software and ML engineers to ensure models meet latency, throughput, and reliability requirements at production scale
Design and execute offline and online evaluation frameworks — defining metrics that capture both model performance and downstream business impact, and diagnosing failure modes to prioritize improvements
Build and improve data pipelines and annotation workflows that feed model training, including active learning strategies to maximize label efficiency
Communicate technical results, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to engineering, product, and business stakeholders — connecting model behavior to customer experience outcomes
Stay current with state-of-the-art research in computer vision, multimodal learning, and representation learning — evaluating and adapting promising techniques to team-specific problems
Contribute to a culture of scientific rigor through reproducible experimentation, thorough documentation, peer code and design reviews, and raising the quality bar for the team


A day in the life
As an Applied Scientist on the GRAISE team, you'll spend your days analyzing model performance from overnight experiments, collaborating with engineers to deploy computer vision models to production, and prototyping new approaches using multimodal learning with store video and sensor data. You'll present findings to product and business stakeholders, translating technical results into actionable recommendations. Throughout the day, you'll balance rigorous scientific thinking with practical engineering constraints, knowing your work directly improves the shopping experience for millions of customers in Amazon grocery stores.

About the team
The GRAISE team (Grocery, Retail & In-Store Experience) within World Wide Grocery Store Tech (WWGST) builds foundational AI and machine learning systems that power Amazon's in-store grocery technologies. We develop domain-specific models that solve uniquely complex challenges in grocery — from smart shopping carts and inventory intelligence to personalization and store operations. Our mission is to create technology which makes grocery shopping more convenient, economical, personalized, and enjoyable for customers while empowering retailers with operational efficiency

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying computer vision models (object detection, image classification, segmentation, or visual search) on real-world data beyond academic benchmarks
- Demonstrated ability to take a model from research prototype to production deployment — including performance profiling, latency optimization, and working within serving infrastructure constraints
- Practical experience with noisy, imperfect, or sparse training data — including techniques such as semi-supervised learning, active learning, weak supervision, or synthetic data generation
- Experience building or contributing to annotation pipelines and human-in-the-loop workflows that improve data quality and labeling efficiency over time
- Track record of clearly documenting experiments, writing technical design documents, and communicating results to cross-functional partners

descriptionHtml:
Description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a world-class Principal AI Scientist to lead cutting-edge research and development at the intersection of artificial intelligence and telecommunications network infrastructure. In this role, you will pioneer AI-native approaches to network modeling, reasoning, and optimization — shaping how the world’s largest telecommunications operators harness AI to build, operate, and evolve next-generation networks.
You will serve as the technical thought leader for network-domain AI science within AWS’s telecommunications practice — defining strategy, driving research, and delivering production-ready solutions that unlock transformative business value for Tier-1 operators. This includes developing novel network models, ontologies, and AI architectures purpose-built for the telecommunications domain, and translating them into scalable offerings on the AWS platform.
This is a high-visibility role requiring deep hands-on expertise in building, training, and evaluating AI/ML models at scale, combined with mastery of telecommunications network architectures, protocols, and data systems. You will drive AI-Native 6G co-development with customers and represent AWS as a thought leader in global industry forums.



Key job responsibilities

• Lead end-to-end research and development of AI models for telecommunications networks — from architecture design, training methodology, and evaluation through optimization and production deployment on AWS.
• Design and develop network ontologies, knowledge graphs, and semantic representations that enable AI systems to reason over complex, multi-vendor, multi-domain network topologies.
• Develop and apply graph neural networks (GNNs), foundation models, transformer architectures, and other advanced AI techniques to network telemetry, configuration, and operational data.
• Drive AI-Native 6G co-development with Tier-1 telecommunications operators — translating their network AI challenges into research programs, proof-of-concept engagements, and scalable production solutions.
• Represent AWS as a technical thought leader in global industry forums and standards bodies — shaping the direction of AI for networks, publishing research, and positioning AWS as the platform of choice.
• Build deep partnerships with AWS Service Teams to integrate network AI capabilities into the broader AWS AI/ML and infrastructure platform.
• Author and deliver strategic narratives, science papers, and technical documents for AWS leadership and customer executives.
• Design privacy-preserving, distributed model training approaches that enable operators to leverage sensitive network data without centralization.
• Collaborate across a multidisciplinary team to support customer engagements, industry co-innovation programs, and developer scaling initiatives.
• Mentor and influence a community of Solutions Architects, Field Development Engineers, and partner engineers on AI/ML best practices for telecommunications.


A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing results from a model training run on network telemetry data. By mid-morning, you’re whiteboarding a novel architecture with AWS service team engineers. After lunch, you join a call with a Tier-1 operator’s CTO to scope a joint research initiative on autonomous network operations. In the afternoon, you draft a section of a strategic narrative for leadership, translating your research into business impact. You end the day reviewing a paper submission for an industry working group — knowing your science is shaping how the world builds 6G networks.

About the team
This role sits within AWS’s Telecommunications practice, working at the frontier of AI-Native networking with Tier-1 global operators. The team co-develops next-generation network AI solutions in partnership with the world’s leading telecommunications companies and industry bodies, spanning network intelligence, autonomous operations, and 6G research.

title: Cluster Operations Manager, Data Center Operations (DCO)
descriptionHtml:
AWS is investing €33.7 billion in Aragón, Spain — one of the largest infrastructure investments in the region's history. As a DCO Cluster Manager, you'll lead the build-out and operation of our compute operations teams in this rapidly growing region.

This is a senior leadership role where you'll own safety, security, availability, scaling, costs, and efficiency across a 24/7 operation. You'll lead the team responsible for installing, maintaining, and decommissioning network and server equipment — but your primary focus is people. You'll build and grow a high-performing organization of managers and technicians from the ground up, shaping a culture of operational excellence as the region scales.

Previous data center experience is not required. What matters most is proven people leadership — specifically, experience managing managers and developing teams through periods of rapid growth. If you've led large, complex operations and know how to inspire, scale, and develop leaders, this is an exceptional opportunity.

Key job responsibilities
- People Leadership: Build, lead, and develop a team of Data Center Managers and 100+ associates. Recruit talent, grow leaders, and foster a culture of ownership and continuous learning.
- Strategic Vision: Define and execute the operational strategy for the Aragón region, aligning with AWS global standards while adapting to local growth demands.

title: Sr Tech Ops and Strategy Lead, AWS SMGS Ops Sales Ops - Global Sales
descriptionHtml:
AWS Global Sales Operations is the strategic operating function that provides insights, mechanisms, and objective recommendations enabling AWS Global Sales to scale, transform, and deliver long-term customer and business outcomes.
At AWS, we celebrate innovation, calculated risk-taking, and new ideas. We are builders who experiment, learn, simplify, and scale what works. It is still Day 1, and we are looking for curious, analytical, and action-oriented leaders to join our diverse teams of thinkers, problem solvers, and doers.

The Field Tech Operations Lead is the strategic advisor and operating partner to Area Tech Leader. You will translate EMEA Tech strategy and the area business priorities into executable plans, scalable mechanisms, and measurable customer outcomes across Solutions Architecture, Customer Solutions Management, and strategic initiatives. You will help the Area Tech organization operate with greater clarity, speed, and impact by embedding data, AI, and automation into how the business plans, inspects performance, prioritizes resources, and executes. You will build mechanisms that surface risks earlier, reduce manual work, improve decision quality, and ensure technical expertise is deployed where it creates the greatest customer and business value.

You will also own the area’s migration strategy and execution end to end, driving progress from opportunity identification through migration launch, modernization, and consumption realization with a large cross functional team across the Area.

This is a cross-functional, hands-on role that requires strong strategic judgment, analytical rigor, commercial awareness, and operational discipline. The ideal candidate can operate effectively in ambiguity, influence senior stakeholders, communicate across technical and non-technical audiences, and build scalable mechanisms that improve how the business operates.

Success in this role requires an owner mindset, strong bias for action, and the ability to turn complex business and technical priorities into clear operating plans that deliver measurable impact for customers and AWS.

Key job responsibilities
Strategic Partnership: Advise Area Tech Leaders on strategy, organizational performance, risks, priorities, and investment decisions.

Strategy and Planning: Develop and execute the Tech operating plan, translating EMEA Tech strategy and Area business priorities into clear priorities, actions, and outcomes.

Business Performance: Establish KPIs, lead business reviews, and provide decision-oriented insights that improve performance, resource allocation, and execution.

Sales and Tech Alignment: Align technical priorities and capacity with the Area business plan and identify gaps requiring leadership action.

Migration and Modernization: Own the Area’s Migration and Modernization strategy and execution end to end, from opportunity identification and prioritization through migration, modernization, launch, and consumption realization.

Strategic Initiatives: Coordinate GenAI, customer adoption, and other Area Tech priorities, recommending when to scale, redesign, simplify, or stop.

Resource Planning: Provide data-backed recommendations on capacity, coverage, skills, and technical resource allocation.

Customer Adoption: Track customer progression from technical engagement to production adoption and business outcomes, distinguishing activity from measurable impact.

Area and EMEA Alignment: Act as the operational link between Area Tech leadership and EMEA Field Tech Operations, adopt common standards, escalate systemic blockers, and share scalable best practices.

Cross-Functional Leadership: Influence, build alignment, and drive execution across Sales, Business Development, Professional Services, Partners, Finance, technical teams, and Worldwide organizations.

A day in the life
You will lead the Area Tech AI-enabled rhythm of business and work closely with Area Tech leadership to identify where customer outcomes, technical capacity, or execution are off track. You will partner with Sales, Solutions Architects, Business Development, Professional Services, Partners, and other cross-functional teams to prioritize key customers, remove blockers, and agree the actions needed to improve Area performance and accelerate Migration, Modernization, and GenAI adoption.

The role moves regularly between strategic planning and hands-on execution. This may include developing decision-oriented insights for leadership, improving business review mechanisms, shaping resource allocation recommendations, or coordinating cross-functional initiatives across countries and teams.

You will also connect the Area with EMEA and Worldwide stakeholders, share best practices, escalate systemic issues, and ensure common strategies and operating standards translate into effective Area execution. Throughout the day, you will bring clarity to complex problems, align leaders around the right priorities, and turn strategy into actions that deliver measurable customer and business outcomes.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience in strategy and operations, business operations, sales operations, technical operations, program management, consulting, or a related field.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using Salesforce (or other CRM tool) or BI tools
- Experience in cloud computing, enterprise technology, software, technical sales, customer success, or professional services.
- Experience with migration and modernization programs, including customer prioritization, pipeline progression, launch, and consumption realization.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Operations sits at the heart of the Amazon customer experience. We look after everything from the moment a customer clicks buy, to the moment their item is delivered – from desktop to doorstep.

Across the globe we have more than thousand Fulfillment Centers, thousands of Delivery Stations, tens of thousands of machines, and hundreds of thousands of employees, all working together in harmony to make sure the right item gets delivered to the right person, in the right place, at the right time.

We are open, inclusive and welcome individuality and diversity. The culture in our Operation is built on the way teams’ bond and the work ethic that enables our business run like clockwork. Our teams take pride in a job well done, looking out for one another, ensuring the highest safety standards and playing their part in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for around the world.

Join us in the Amazon Maintenance Operation centre team. We maintain and optimize technologies in the Global Amazon Warehouse & Delivery Network.
Purpose of job
We are seeking a seasoned Senior Building Management System (BMS) Specialist to join our current team and support one of the largest BMS portfolios in the world. This role requires a dynamic individual with a strong technical foundation in BMS programming, coupled with good HVAC understanding. The successful candidate will spearhead efforts to maintain, enhance, and optimize our global services, ensuring seamless BMS functionality and delivering unparalleled customer experiences.


Key job responsibilities
• Maintain and optimize BMS technologies, IoT platforms, and data analytics of the BMS.
• Monitor and maintain ticket/work order processes and queues while ensuring customer care and quality meet the high bar.
• Monitor and analyze BMS data to proactively identify and action opportunities for optimization, energy efficiency, and cost savings.
• Design, implement and manage BMS Standard Operating Procedures, Policies and Processes which are scalable across the globe.
• Support the development and execute a comprehensive strategy for maintaining, improving, and expanding our global support services.

• Establish and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and vendors, ensuring a customer-centric approach.
• Provides strategic insights and recommendations to management on BMS trends, improvements, issues, root causes, team skillsets, industry best practices, and emerging technologies.

• Lead training sessions and development programs for internal teams and individuals to continuously enhance the capability, technical skills of field RME teams, and BMS Specialists.

• Willing to work flexible shifts to provide 24/7 BMS support, ensuring global customers receive timely and reliable assistance.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering, engineering technology or equivalent, or 5+ years of professional or military experience

- Ability to remotely troubleshoot BMS communication issues, including fieldbus (BACnet, LON, Modbus via RS485), Network Gateways and IP-based protocols (Niagara Fox, MQTT, BACnet/IP, SNMP).
- Ability to integrate multiple communications protocols such as BACnet, LON, Modbus, SNMP to a single platform with normalized data for standard visualization.
- Experience in BMS programming and commissioning, with a minimum of 3 years in building controls and HVAC or related field.

title: Senior Solutions Architect, AWS Plus Team
descriptionHtml:
What if your customer was Amazon itself? AWS Plus is a specialized account team within AWS that supports Amazon's own business units as strategic cloud customers. As a Senior Solutions Architect on this team, you'll be the primary technical advisor to one or more of Amazon's businesses, working directly with their engineering teams and technology leaders to design, operate, and optimize AWS workloads at a scale few external customers ever reach.

Amazon's businesses run some of the largest and most demanding workloads on AWS, and they expect their Solutions Architect to operate as a true peer to their engineers. You'll go deep on your customer's domain, make prescriptive architecture recommendations, and help them adopt new AWS capabilities, including generative and agentic AI, ahead of the broader market.

Key job responsibilities

title: Mechanical Integration Lead, OMHS
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking a Mechanical Integration Lead to drive the successful installation, integration, and deployment of material handling equipment (MHE) across multiple greenfield and brownfield fulfillment center sites. This role provides hands-on mechanical engineering leadership in complex automation environments, ensuring projects meet Amazon's safety, timeline, cost, and quality standards. The Mechanical Integration Lead will directly manage mechanical installation crews deploying conveyor systems, sortation equipment, and associated structural systems across North America. Reporting to the Site Deployment Manager, you will lead sub-teams responsible for structural steel installation, conveyor prep and placement, mechanical connections and belting, side guide and netting installation, pneumatic systems, and mechanical quality control and commissioning. You will collaborate across engineering, supply chain, and operations to implement scalable solutions, resolve technical issues in the field, and deliver high-impact results across large, multi-site programs.

Key job responsibilities
Mechanical Installation Leadership:
• Directly manage and lead mechanical installation crews deploying MHE across North American facilities
• Oversee structural header steel installation including hanging steel, prebuilding supports, and anchoring to building structure
• Lead conveyor prep and placement operations — rigging, lifting, staging, and setting conveyor sections into final positions on installed supports
• Manage conveyor connections and belting crews — ensuring proper mechanical alignment, bed connections, squaring, leveling, and hardware tightening
• Direct side guide and netting installation ensuring proper alignment and tension
• Oversee belt crew operations including belting and lacing installation on aligned conveyor sections
• Manage pneumatic/air systems installation including air connections to conveyor components, pressure testing, and leak verification
• Coordinate with the logistics and receiving team to ensure materials are inventoried, staged, and distributed to work zones on schedule

Quality Control & Commissioning:
• Lead mechanical QC and commissioning activities including alignment verification, hardware inspections, and match-mark verification
• Oversee conveyor run-in testing, belt tracking verification, and belt tension checks
• Manage mechanical punch list identification and repair
• Verify IOQ checks and ensure all mechanical systems meet specifications before handoff to electrical teams
• Ensure proper match-marking of nuts/bolts to verify tightness across all connections

Technical Leadership & Standards:
• Provide mechanical engineering expertise for automation initiatives across assigned sites
• Implement technical solutions and lead project-level decisions within the mechanical scope
• Follow and help develop mechanical installation standards and best practices
• Create and maintain technical documentation including work instructions, installation SOPs, and QC checklists
• Participate in design reviews and drive mechanical engineering excellence
• Recommend and implement process improvements to increase installation efficiency and quality

Project Execution & Coordination:
• Lead delivery of complex mechanical installation projects with multi-site impact
• Work cross-functionally with engineering, supply chain, and operations teams
• Coordinate with the electrical integration lead to ensure proper sequencing — mechanical work must be complete in each zone before electrical teams
mobilize
• Manage relationships with mechanical vendors and partners
• Provide technical input to leadership for data-driven decision-making
• Drive achievement of safety, timeline, cost, and quality metrics across assigned zones
• Participate in daily business reviews with installation progress updates

A day in the life
As a Mechanical Integration Lead, you start your day with the site coordination meeting, reviewing progress against the installation schedule and identifying any material or sequencing issues with your crews. From there, you're on the construction
floor — walking zones with your structural steel team verifying header hanger loads, checking that the conveyor prep and placement crew has the right sections staged, and ensuring the connections team is properly aligning and torquing hardware. You troubleshoot rigging challenges, coordinate with the Site Operations Leader on material deliveries, and validate that mechanical QC checks are passed before handing zones off to the electrical team. You close out by updating job plans, flagging risks for the daily business review, and planning tomorrow's crew assignments, ratios, and confirming proper routing around obstructions. You oversee wire pulling operations in active zones, ensuring proper cable sizing, bend radius compliance, and pull tension limits are respected. Mid-morning you inspect control panel placements, verifying mounting locations match drawings, checking clearance requirements, and confirming grounding connections. You validate junction box and disconnect installations, review wire terminations for proper torque values and labeling, and address any field conflicts that require engineering clarification. By afternoon, you're tracking installation progress against the schedule, coordinating with the device installation lead on upcoming zone handoffs, and documenting redlines for as-built updates. You close out at the daily business review with progress updates and flag any material or access risks for the next day.

About the team
The OMHS Installation & Deployment team supports the deployment and integration of automation and material handling systems across Amazon's operations network. The team works cross-functionally with engineering, construction, operations, supply chain, vendors, and field execution partners to deliver safe, scalable, and reliable systems.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience in engineering including a supervisory role managing people
- Experience in a fast-paced, automated, industrial, logistics, production or manufacturing environment

Preferred qualifications

- Experience of automated equipment including packaging machinery, sortation and conveyor systems
- Experience in preventative maintenance systems

title: Threat Intelligence Analyst, Special Projects & Investigations - Threat Intelligence
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to own threat intelligence initiatives that protect millions of Amazon sellers worldwide? The Threat Intelligence team within Special Projects & Investigations (SPI) is obsessed with staying ahead of threat actors and defending our Selling Partners across the Asia-Pacific region. We dive deep into dark and clear web intelligence to uncover unknown abuse vectors, potential internal threats, and organized cyber fraud schemes before they impact our customers and platform.
As a Threat Intelligence Analyst based in Singapore, you will be a core member of our APAC intelligence operation, proactively hunting threat actors, running deep investigations into fraud schemes and abuse networks targeting Amazon, and leveraging AI-native tools and automation to scale your investigative reach across the region. This is not a reactive role. We are building a team that finds threats before they find us, with the goal of doing it with the most advanced AI-augmented intelligence workflows in the industry.

Key job responsibilities
• Proactively hunt threat actors and fraud networks operating across Mandarin-language and broader APAC online communities targeting Amazon's seller ecosystem
• Conduct deep investigations into organized abuse schemes including seller fraud, account takeover, counterfeit operations, and platform manipulation, from initial lead to actionable intelligence output
• Build, operate, and continuously improve AI-augmented investigation workflows that scale threat detection and intelligence production, reducing manual toil and expanding coverage velocity
• Produce clear, concise, and actionable finished intelligence that drives decisions by partner teams across enforcement, policy, and legal
• Apply structured analytic frameworks to map threat actor TTPs, build actor profiles, and contribute to the team's threat picture
• Collaborate with global partners SPI TI counterparts to integrate APAC intelligence findings into the worldwide threat picture and inform proactive detection models
• Support partner team requests, bringing investigative depth and regional expertise to complex, high-priority cases

A day in the life
Your morning starts with a sweep of deep, dark web forums, Telegram channels, and Mandarin-language communities, looking for signals before they become incidents. When something surfaces, you investigate: mapping actors, reverse engineering the tactics used, building the picture. Your findings become finished intelligence that enforcement, policy, and legal teams act on. Between investigations, you're refining the automation and workflows that make tomorrow's work faster and wider in reach. No two days are identical, but the focus never shifts, find threats before they land.

About the team
We're a global threat intelligence team with a simple mission: find threats before they find us. We blend rigorous analytic tradecraft with AI-native tools to investigate fraud networks, track threat actors, and protect sellers across Amazon's marketplace. We work closely with enforcement, policy, and legal partners who act on what we produce. We're a small team that writes well, thinks critically, and genuinely geeks out on how threat actors operate. If you want to build the most advanced intelligence operation in e-commerce, and do it alongside people who care about doing it right, you'll fit in here.

descriptionHtml:
Arbeitsschutz und Wohlbefinden unserer Mitarbeitenden haben bei Amazon höchste Priorität. Unsere Safety Specialists spielen dabei eine entscheidende Rolle. In dieser Funktion sorgst Du proaktiv dafür, dass alle Mitarbeitenden an Deinem Standort in einem sicheren und gesunden Umfeld arbeiten. Du hast die Möglichkeit, jeden Tag einen Unterschied für Menschen zu machen. Indem Du proaktiv für ihre Sicherheit sorgst, gibst Du ihnen Zuversicht in ihrer Rolle und motivierst sie zu Höchstleistungen.

- Durchführung von Audits, um die Einhaltung der relevanten Arbeitsschutzgesetze sicherzustellen und Lösungen bei identifizierten Risiken umzusetzen.

Außerdem entwickelst Du Schulungen und andere Programme, damit alle die neuen Sicherheitsprozesse befolgen und neue Standards erreichen.

About the team
Das Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) Team spielt eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Gewährleistung des mentalen und körperlichen Wohlbefindens unserer Mitarbeitenden am Arbeitsplatz. Unser Team arbeitet mit Führungskräften, Mitarbeitenden und lokalen Behörden an allen unseren Standorten zusammen, um die Einhaltung der Amazon-Richtlinien und gesetzlichen Vorschriften sicherzustellen und die Sicherheit unserer Arbeitsumgebungen zu gewährleisten.
