title: System Development Engineer, AWS Manufacturing Infrastructure Services
descriptionHtml:
Have you ever wondered what it would be like to build massively scalable systems that are used by the world's largest cloud infrastructures?
Would you enjoy broad yet equally deep scope that impacts all AWS systems globally?
AWS Manufacturing Infrastructure Services continues to pioneer and our team is architecting, building, and operating scalable services that are at the core of AWS infrastructure.

What do we do?
We own all AWS platforms, services, infrastructure, and tools that ensure the health of AWS hardware by testing every new system across all AWS manufacturing sites and ensure they are healthy when delivered to data centers. Our platform enables service owners such as EC2, EBS, S3, and other to deliver healthy servers for their service. Our team leads a large-scale service that sets the bar for Amazon and the industry in platform level services, effectively enabling the hardware at scale by designing and developing the software that manages the verification and testing of every server and rack in AWS manufacturing sites.

Why it’s high-impact?
We set the bar high to ensure that AWS customers get the capacity they need to run their applications on a healthy hardware server.

What’s the challenge?
There are many ambiguous and difficult challenges in our fast-moving space. Our platform is mission critical and requires deep system and software expertise. You need to have the ability to work within a fast moving and startup-like environment in a large company. You will identify solutions, trying ideas, given space to fail and iterate to produce products that your customers love.

What you will do?
You will be a part of a team to build the next generation of platform level software and systems that enables us to deliver healthy hardware to AWS customers. You design and deliver technology solutions which solve difficult business problems.

Who would succeed in this role?
Deeply technical engineers, who stay close to the customer as well as the systems architecture and design. They think about customer experience and the outcome. A person who works autonomously and dives deep in to a problem to deeply understand how things work, when to make subtle change, and when to disrupt the status quo to achieve the right results.


Key job responsibilities
- Own the reliability of manufacturing networking, systems, and platform infrastructure across AWS manufacturing partner sites globally.
- Develop infrastructure-as-code to stand up and manage distributed manufacturing services at new and existing sites.
- Build monitoring, alerting, and anomaly detection systems that identify infrastructure failures before they impact manufacturing throughput.
- Develop troubleshooting tools and runbooks that enable rapid diagnosis and resolution of site infrastructure issues.
- Consult with ODM/CM IT teams on network design and infrastructure standards, working across organizational boundaries where partners don't report to AWS.
- Drive site expansion readiness, ensuring new manufacturing sites are infrastructure-ready within target onboarding timelines.
- Implement security and operational best practices for manufacturing environments, including credential management, network segmentation, and access controls.
- Contribute to architecture decisions for manufacturing platform evolution.
- Develop and build systems that enables operating manufacturing infrastrcure operation at scale

About the team
We are EC2 Manufacturing Infrastructure Services. We exist to make sure that a working rack delivers to our customers in AWS data centers.

Every server that powers EC2, every rack that runs AI/ML workloads, every piece of capacity that AWS customers depend on passes through our systems before it ships. We own Server Level Testing, Rack Level Testing, Firmware Upgrade services, code deployment into manufacturing sites, network architecture at contract manufacturers, and all infrastructure installed at those sites. When yield drops or a test pipeline breaks, we are the team that responds.

Nothing reaches an AWS data center without passing through us first. If our services go down, manufacturing lines stop. If our infrastructure is unreliable, capacity doesn't ship. The blast radius of what we do is measured in billions of dollars of customer workloads.

We are a small team with enormous scope. You will own real systems on day one. We don't have layers of abstraction between you and the problem. You build it, you ship it, you operate it, you improve it.

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
- 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience in Linux OS and network troubleshooting, or experience in networking administration and troubleshooting and experience managing full application stacks from the OS up through custom applications
- Experience in enterprise scale infrastructure or development-based cloud programs/projects in a related industry
- Experience with automation or working with scripting languages like Python, Java, Perl, PHP, Ruby, Bash, Shell, or equivalent
- 3+ years of systems engineering, network engineering, or SRE experience
- Networking: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, firewalls, network segmentation
- Knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals (networking, storage, operating systems, firewalls).

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in an Agile environment using the Scrum methodology
- Experience in data centers, infrastructure service providers, or related technology companies
- Knowledge of security technology and concepts (Authentication, Authorization, Single sign-on, Cryptography, etc.)
- Experience with AWS services in edge/hybrid environments (EC2, VPC, IAM, Outposts, CloudWatch, S3)
- Experience with on-premise infrastructure (servers, storage, campus networking, firewalls)
- Familiarity with PXE boot, IPMI/BMC, or bare-metal provisioning
- Experience with monitoring and observability platforms (CloudWatch, Prometheus/Grafana, or similar)

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. -Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives

title: Security Engineer, Amazon Photos
descriptionHtml:
In the world of cloud security, there's no such thing as a small vulnerability. Billions of photo uploads, AI processing requests, cross-device shares. Each one has to be perfect. Each one has to be secure. Behind every transaction is a family's memories, and those are worth protecting.

Amazon Photos is hiring a Security Engineer who understands that kind of responsibility. Not just someone who can code, but someone who sees the bigger picture: the architecture, the attack vectors, the human element. Because at the end of the day, we're not just securing data - we're securing trust.

The role demands technical mastery across multiple domains:

- Mobile security: iOS and Android apps that millions of customers depend on daily
- Smart device integration: Fire TV and Echo platforms where families share their memories
- Backend systems: Where AI helps customers rediscover moments they thought were lost
- Automation frameworks: Because at our scale, manual isn't an option

You'll work directly with senior leadership, but this isn't about following orders. It's about taking initiative, seeing the vulnerabilities before they become problems, building the solutions before they become urgent. You'll have the authority to make decisions and the autonomy to execute them.

The threats are real. They evolve daily. And unlike most security roles, the stakes here are personal - these aren't just business transactions we're protecting, they're first steps, graduations, weddings, last goodbyes.

We are seeking someone that understands that security isn't just about writing code - it's about understanding systems, anticipating attacks, and building defenses that scale. Someone who knows that the best security is invisible to users but impenetrable to attackers.

If you're passionate about both technical excellence and making a difference in people's lives, we'd love to talk with you about joining our team.

Key job responsibilities
1. Cross-Platform Security Leadership
- Drive security architecture and design for Amazon Photos services across backend, iOS, Android, Fire TV, and Echo app platforms
- Perform threat modeling and security reviews for new features and existing systems across all supported platforms
- Partner with development teams to implement security controls and best practices in mobile, TV, and voice-activated environments
- Lead security incident response efforts for assigned services and applications

2. Security Engineering & Implementation
- Design and implement security automation solutions to detect and prevent vulnerabilities across all Photos platforms
- Develop secure-by-default frameworks and reusable components for Photos services and apps
- Perform security code reviews and penetration testing of critical services and client applications
- Build and maintain security monitoring and alerting systems for backend services and client apps

3. Risk Management & Compliance
- Assess and document security risks for Photos services, apps, and customer data across all platforms
- Drive remediation of security findings within SLA requirements
- Ensure compliance with Amazon security standards, DigiSec campaigns, and relevant regulations
- Maintain security documentation and technical designs for all Photos platforms

4. Cross-team Collaboration and Communication
- Collaborate with DigiSec to understand and implement relevant security campaigns and initiatives
- Articulate the security state of Amazon Photos to stakeholders, including progress on DigiSec-driven initiatives
- Produce clear, concise reports on security posture and ongoing initiatives for both technical and non-technical audiences
- Participate in cross-team security reviews and provide expertise on Photos-specific security considerations

5. Continuous Improvement and Innovation
- Stay current with emerging security threats and best practices in mobile, TV, and voice-activated app security
- Propose and implement innovative security solutions that enhance user experience without compromising security
- Contribute to the development of long-term security strategy for Amazon Photos, considering evolving threats and technologies

6. Mentorship and Knowledge Sharing
- Provide technical mentorship to junior security engineers and developers on secure coding practices
- Contribute to security-related documentation and internal knowledge bases
- Participate in and potentially lead security training sessions for the broader Photos team

A day in the life
Morning:
- Start your day reviewing security alerts from overnight and sharing news and activity with Amazon Photos development teams
- Join the Photos mobile app team's design review for a new feature enabling secure photo sharing between Echo Show devices
- Conduct a threat modeling session with backend developers for an upcoming service launch
- Collaborate with one of the machine learning teams to validate security controls for a new photo recognition feature

Afternoon:
- Deep dive into analyzing an unusual pattern detected in our subscription activity
- Write and test automation scripts to detect potential privacy issues in photo sharing flows
- Partner with Android developers to implement secure-by-default patterns in their latest feature
- Review pull requests for security-critical changes
- Collaborate with DigiSec on ongoing security campaigns

Evening:
- Forget about work, knowing that we're secure, stable, and safe

About the team
We're a focused, high-impact security team being built from the ground up within Amazon Photos. Reporting directly to senior leadership, with technical direction from a Principal Engineer, team members have unprecedented access to guidance and support while maintaining the autonomy to shape our security future.

As one of our first dedicated security engineers, you'll help establish our team's culture and technical foundations. Our dedicated team is starting small, which means you'll have outsized influence on our direction and substantial ownership of our security landscape.

Our flat structure and direct senior leadership access means quick decision-making and minimal bureaucracy. If you enjoy building things from scratch and want to help define what security looks like for a service trusted by millions, this is your opportunity.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of non-internship background in troubleshooting systems issues, analyzing logs, or automating complex tasks using command line tools experience
- 5+ years of work in identifying security issues and risks, and developing mitigation plans experience
- 4+ years of (non-internship) scripting, programming, and security code review in common programming languages experience
- Knowledge of at least two of the following programming languages: Scala, Java, Python, C/C++, or Go
- Experience (non-internship) in scripting, programming, and security code reviewing in a common programming language
- Experience (non-internship) in troubleshooting systems issues, analyzing logs, or automating complex tasks using command line tools
- Experience working in identifying security issues and risks, and developing mitigation plans
- Experience (non-internship) in industry-based security vulnerabilities identification, attack patterns, and remediation techniques
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- Experience applying threat modeling or other risk identification techniques or equivalent
- Experience with security in service-oriented architectures/microservices and web services

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Autos is building the end-to-end vehicle buying experience on Amazon. Amazon Autos is building the end-to-end vehicle buying experience on Amazon, from research and discovery through purchase, financing, and delivery. title: Senior Program Activation Manager, Twitch Brand Partnership Studio (BPS)
descriptionHtml:
Brand Partnership Studio is Amazon's in-house content and tech team supporting the ideation and execution of custom content, sponsorships, and technology on Twitch.

The mission of the Brand Partnership Studio is to bring Twitch streamers visibility and creativity across Twitch and Amazon through strategic brand partnerships. We enable brands to win in the creator economy by delivering what their target audiences and Twitch viewers want — programs that harness popular culture and community behaviors with compelling content and tech.

Reporting to the Head of EU5, BPS, the Senior Program Activation Manager will be a key player contributing to the Brand Partnership Studio mission within the London office. In this role, you'll oversee multiple creative projects simultaneously, build deep expertise in the Twitch creator ecosystem, and serve as a key point of contact for clients, creators, and vendors across EU5 markets. You're a strategic problem solver who thrives in fast-paced environments, knows how to bring ideas to life across digital platforms, and can leverage data and operational insights to drive smarter decision-making and scalable growth.

Own end-to-end execution, project management, and quality control of custom solutions throughout post-sale lifecycle and ensure timelines, deliverables, budgets, and client expectations are met.

Build relationships with stakeholders across Twitch Partnerships, Amazon Ads Sales (LCS), Creative Strategy, Production, and external brand partners to drive alignment and unlock growth opportunities.

Develop and manage detailed project schedules and budgets across multiple campaigns. Additionally, secure approvals, track action items, and coordinate closely with vendors, talent, sales, and production teams to ensure seamless live execution.

Represent the Brand Partnership Studio in client meetings, providing production recommendations and proactively identifying risks, challenges, and solutions.

Collaborate closely with other teams within the Brand Partnership Studio, including Creative Strategists, Producers, Influencer Relation Managers, and cross-functional teams such as Sales, Account Management, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Marketing.

Lead remote and on set livestream production, live event brand integrations, and branded video content production, to ensure quality control and exceed client expectations (travel up to 10%).

title: Solutions Architect, Frontier AI Startups

descriptionHtml:
The companies defining the future of AI are a small number of startups training, tuning, and operating models at scale. They are run by ambitious founders, who solve the hardest problems across a variety of different industries. They are moving fast, operating at the edge of what technology can do, and defining the possibilities of computing for years to come.

We are looking for technical builders who are passionate about helping startups at the frontier of AI to grow. This role requires someone who is equally comfortable in deep architectural conversations and advisory discussions. For someone who understands that for a startup, the right technical decision and the right business decision are rarely separate.

In this position, you will work directly with a portfolio of frontier AI startups, helping them architect, train, fine-tune, and deploy AI systems at scale. Your conversations will range from low-level discussions about chip types to high-level explorations of advanced prompt engineering.

Your work will extend beyond individual customer relationships. You will serve as a direct feedback channel to product teams, translating patterns you observe across your portfolio into concrete input on what should be built and improved. You will contribute to the broader technical community through written content and conference presentations, sharing knowledge at a scale that one-on-one work alone cannot reach.

Key job responsibilities
- Advise a range of funded AI Startups to adopt the right architecture for them.
- Support startups in architecting scalable, reliable, and secure solutions.
- Support adoption of a broad range of AWS services to deliver business value and accelerate growth.
- Support the evolution and roadmap of the AWS platform and services, connecting our engineering teams with our customers for feedback.
- Establish and build technical relationships within the startup ecosystem, including accelerators, incubators, and VCs.
- Develop startup specific technical content, such as blog posts, sample code, and solutions to assist customers solve technical problems and reduce time-to-market.

A day in the life
A day in the life of a Frontier AI Solutions Architect is rarely the same. Expect to have a variety of different types of technical conversations revolving around applied AI and infrastructure, meetings with VCs and incubators, and opportunities to build and present AI content and projects.

About the team
Frontier AI is a team of builders. We work with our customers, peers, and cross-functional teams to build out what is possible with AI. Learning by doing, collaborating, and scaling knowledge is the culture of the team.

- 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

title: Senior Program Manager, AU Global Store
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history. We are looking for a dynamic, organised self-starter to join as a Senior Program Manager to grow the Amazon Global Store business in Australia, based from our Sydney office.

Amazon Global Store is in integral pillar of the Amazon.com.au proposition that today offers high demand international products, locally to AU customers. We are an innovative business focused on building a leading customer experience around our growing range of relevant international products sourced from Amazon’s global stores. We work with Amazon’s wider global business network, across teams such as search, customer experience, vendor management, engineering, marketing, logistics, finance, legal and compliance to tailor the best that Amazon has to offer globally into a proposition that best suits local customers’ needs.
________________________________________________

There are also a great range of benefits that make Amazon a great place to work, including our popular Dogs At Work program which has been proven to lower stress and boost morale and is now running successfully in our corporate offices around Australia.

Our commuter benefits scheme allows employees to save on the cost of getting to and from work while Amazon also offers subsidized health insurance for employees and their dependents on top of salary continuance (income protection), and life insurance.

Amazon has all kinds of jobs for all kinds of people, and prides itself on hiring individuals with all types of background and experiences and celebrates diversity of leadership and thought as a key component in its mission to create the most customer-centric company in the world.

This position requires full-time in-office presence 5 days per week at our CBD location.

Key job responsibilities
To excel in this role, you will:
- Enjoy a high degree of ownership: Own the Global Store strategy end to end, from defining selection, pricing, promotions, and marketing, to driving execution plans with local and global teams that deliver adoption and sustainable growth.
- Excel at stakeholder management: Drive outcomes through others by building strong relationships and influencing cross-functional teams, including search, engineering, marketing, logistics, finance, and compliance, across multiple geographies. Navigate ambiguity and align diverse stakeholders around shared goals without direct authority.
- Drive commercial performance through data: Go beyond reviewing dashboards. Proactively dive deep into metrics, uncover opportunities, build business cases, and develop actionable recommendations that improve growth, profitability, and customer value.
- Customer Experience Ownership: Think big and invent new ways to improve Global Store CX, locally and internationally.
- Technology and AI Adoption: Embrace AI and new technologies, diving into Amazon's tools and systems quickly and confidently to find faster, smarter ways to operate.
- Thrive in a fast-paced environment: Demonstrate strong organisational skills and effectively prioritise competing demands across multiple workstreams, making sound judgment calls independently when priorities conflict.
- Embrace a growth mindset: Demonstrate resilience, curiosity, and a genuine appetite for continuous learning, including adapting quickly to Amazon's ways of working such as document-led meetings, narrative writing, and a culture of high-velocity decision making.
- Develop Team Capabilities: Act as a subject matter expert, coach colleagues, and contribute to team knowledge development.

A day in the life
In this role, you'll focus on growing the AU Global Store business by working across multiple teams and geographies. You might start your day analysing customer data to identify opportunities for improving the shopping experience, then move into strategy sessions with local and international teams to plan how to expand our product offerings. You'll collaborate with colleagues in search, customer experience, vendor management, engineering, marketing, logistics, finance, legal, and compliance to bring the best of Amazon's global selection to Australian customers. Throughout the day, you'll balance strategic thinking with hands-on problem-solving, whether that's developing execution plans, troubleshooting challenges, or presenting business results to senior leadership.

About the team
We are building an innovative business that serves as a key pillar of Amazon.com.au, bringing international products to customers who want access to a broader selection. Our team works collaboratively across Amazon's global network to understand what Australian customers need and translate that into tailored solutions. We're focused on creating a leading customer experience while driving sustainable business growth. When you join us, you'll be part of a group that values curiosity, analytical thinking, and the ability to influence and collaborate across technical and non-technical teams to solve complex problems together.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred qualifications

- 8+ years of Business strategy or Non-Tech Program Management experience

L'équipe Amazon Alexa International à Toronto recherche un(e) Chef de produit senior pour diriger l'expansion d'Alexa+ au Canada. Key job responsibilities
 Define user needs and identify gaps, features enhancements and opportunities to grow the business
 Define creative, high-quality, simple product roadmaps based on team strategy and vision.
 Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the market landscape, customer needs, and
competitive dynamics in Canada across English and French locales.
 Develop detailed, crisp business requirements and user stories that can be used to create product
specifications and architecture for each product and application.
 Translate strategic vision into actionable plans and lead cross-functional teams to execute on
priority initiatives.

endpoints.
 Track launches through every step—from experience review and packaging approval, to beta
testing, leadership presentations, and customer launch.
 Manage prioritization and trade-offs among customer experience, performance and operational
support load.

build improvement plan.
 Work closely with engineering teams and program management to deliver products to the market.

financial, and technical goals


• Définir les besoins des utilisateurs et identifier les lacunes, les améliorations de fonctionnalités et les opportunités de croissance de l'entreprise.

• Élaborer des exigences commerciales détaillées et précises ainsi que des témoignages utilisateurs pouvant servir à créer les spécifications produit et l'architecture de chaque produit et application.
• Traduire la vision stratégique en plans d'action concrets et diriger des équipes interfonctionnelles pour exécuter les initiatives prioritaires.
• Être responsable de l'expérience client de bout en bout pour Alexa Canada sur Echo, FireTV et les points d'accès supplémentaires.
• Suivre les lancements à chaque étape — de la revue d'expérience et l'approbation de l'emballage, aux tests bêta, présentations à la direction et lancement client.
• Gérer la priorisation et les compromis entre l'expérience client, la performance et la charge de support opérationnel.
• Surveiller en continu la performance de l'expérience client, identifier les lacunes et les axes d'amélioration, et élaborer un plan d'amélioration.
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie et de gestion de programme pour livrer les produits sur le marché.
• Identifier et résoudre de manière proactive les problèmes stratégiques susceptibles de compromettre la capacité de l'équipe à atteindre ses objectifs stratégiques, financiers et techniques.


A day in the life
As a Senior Product Manager, you will have a wide set of responsibilities to ensure our customers are
delighted, including launching new Alexa-powered devices and experiences and making Alexa
continuously smarter. This role is equal parts business strategy, product definition, and program
delivery. You will need to thrive and deliver results in a highly ambiguous, fast-paced, and dynamic
business environment – operating at all levels of the organization. The ideal candidate will use a
combination of outstanding analytical skills, cross-functional understanding, business judgment,
technical expertise, and strategic thinking to define the programs that improve Alexa CA Customer
Experience. You will work closely with many partners such as solution architects, engineering,
marketing, content, business development, and legal to ensure customers have access to a world class
Alexa experience in Canada.


En tant que Chef de produit senior, vous aurez un large éventail de responsabilités pour garantir la satisfaction de nos clients, y compris le lancement de nouveaux appareils et expériences alimentés par Alexa et l'amélioration continue de l'intelligence d'Alexa. Ce rôle combine à parts égales stratégie commerciale, définition de produit et livraison de programme. Vous devrez évoluer et produire des résultats dans un environnement commercial hautement complexe, dynamique et en constante évolution — en opérant à tous les niveaux de l'organisation. Le candidat ou la candidate idéale utilisera une combinaison de compétences analytiques exceptionnelles, de compréhension interfonctionnelle, de jugement commercial, d'expertise technique et de réflexion stratégique pour définir les programmes qui améliorent l'expérience client d'Alexa au Canada. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec de nombreux partenaires tels que les architectes de solutions, l'ingénierie, le marketing, le contenu, le développement commercial et le juridique pour garantir que les clients aient accès à une expérience Alexa de classe mondiale au Canada.

title: Techniker / Elektriker / Mechatroniker
descriptionHtml:
Das Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist für unseren Betrieb von fundamentaler Bedeutung – es sorgt dafür, dass unsere technischen Systeme und Anlagen laufend funktionieren. Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du für die Wartung und Instandhaltung unserer förder- und haustechnischen Anlagen sowie Produktionsanlagen zuständig. Du hilfst, die höchsten Sicherheitsstandards im Arbeitsschutz zu gewährleisten und Maschinenausfallzeiten zu verhindern. Unser technisches Team stellt eine hohe Verfügbarkeit der technischen Anlagen sicher und verbessert die Qualität unserer Geräte.


WIR BIETEN AN:

- Einen unbefristeten Vertrag direkt mit Amazon.
- Ein attraktives Vergütungspaket und Mitarbeiterrabatte auf amazon.de sowie Amazon Extras (z.B. Rabatte in Reisen, Restaurants, Unterhaltung, Elektronik, Heim etc.)
- Hervorragende Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem globalen Unternehmen
- Pendlerleistungen, z.B. Kostenübernahme für das 49 EUR Ticket oder Bike Leasing Angebote
- Leistungen wie z.B. Unterstützung bei der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und eine kostenlose Lebens- und Erwerbsunfähigkeitsversicherung.
- Vermittlungsservices für die Betreuung von Kindern, Senioren und Menschen mit besonderen Bedürfnissen
- Mitarbeiter werben Mitarbeiter - Prämienzahlung von bis zu 2.000 EUR
- Familienbonus (Einmalzahlung für Eltern in Elternzeit).
- Ein kostenloses Mitarbeiterhilfeprogramm (auch für Familienmitglieder) für eine Beratung bei beruflichen oder privaten Angelegenheiten.


Key job responsibilities
- Ausführung präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an einer breiten Vielfalt von Geräten an unseren Standorten
- Durchführung von Reparaturen und Fehlerdiagnosen
- Verwendung neuester Tools zur Maximierung der Geräteeffektivität
- Einhaltung aller Arbeitsschutzrichtlinien und -praktiken
- Unterstützung der Entwicklung und des beruflichen Fortschritts von Auszubildenden am Standort
- Arbeit an Projekten zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Einführung von Best Practices an verschiedenen EU-Standorten

A day in the life
Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren tätig, um schnell auf technische Störungen reagieren zu können. Du führst eine Reihe geplanter präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an Geräten durch, um für ihren sicheren Betrieb zu sorgen. Außerdem reagierst Du als Instandhaltungstechniker:in unverzüglich auf Störungen und Ausfälle. Du untersuchst die Ursachen, findest so schnell wie möglich Lösungen und wendest sie an. Zudem machst Du Vorschläge für langfristige Verbesserungen.
In Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Kolleg:innen nimmst Du tägliche Wartungsaufgaben wahr und kommunizierst mit Dienstleistern, falls Du externe Expertise benötigst. Du arbeitest in rotierenden Schichten, damit wir rund um die Uhr unsere Standorte unterstützen – und dafür sorgen, dass Amazon weiterhin in dem Tempo liefern kann, für das wir bekannt sind.

About the team
Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) sorgt dafür, dass unsere Geräte und Ausstattung jederzeit optimal funktionieren. Wir sind ein Team von Techniker:innen und Ingenieur:innen, das aus hervorragenden Teamplayern besteht und von erfahrenen Führungskräften geleitet wird. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, die Geräte in unserem gesamten globalen Netzwerk von Fulfillment-Centern zu warten, zu reparieren und ihre Fehler zu beheben. Einige unserer Mitarbeiter:innen sind Führungskräfte, die das Team bei der Arbeit an spannender, innovativer Technologie beaufsichtigen – die es teilweise nur bei Amazon gibt.
Von der Installation automatisierter Verpackungssysteme bis hin zur Beaufsichtigung der allgemeinen Wartungsarbeiten eines Standorts sowie der Reparatur von für den Vertrieb wesentlichen Geräten wickelt unser Team einen Großteil der technischen Aufgaben bei Amazon ab. Unter anderem sorgt es auch dafür, dass Gebäude weiterhin den rechtlichen Auflagen entsprechen, damit alle sicher bleiben und unsere Standorte mit maximaler Effizienz betrieben werden. Es gibt zahlreiche Aufstiegschancen im RME-Team selbst ebenso wie im gesamten Amazon-Unternehmen.
Alle unsere Aktivitäten sind darauf ausgerichtet, die Ausfallzeiten an Amazons wichtigsten Betriebsstandorten zu reduzieren, damit Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen rechtzeitig erhalten. descriptionHtml:
Would you like to be part of an organization developing the next generation of leaders in a rapidly growing, highly innovative global business? - Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation

Physical Requirements:

- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field

title: SDE, Responsible AI
descriptionHtml:
AI is transforming every corner of Amazon — and with that transformation comes the responsibility to get it right. The Amazon Responsible AI (RAI) team is building the systems that ensure Amazon's AI is fair, safe, transparent, and compliant with emerging global regulations. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer who wants to work at the frontier of AI governance — building the platform that gives Amazon real-time visibility into the compliance posture of thousands of AI systems across the company.

No one has solved AI governance at this scale before. descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Are you experienced in Critical Infrastructure Commissioning and looking for a fast paced environment to work in? As a Data Center Commissioning Engineer (CxE), you will be part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling fascinating and challenging problems building and supporting the operations of Amazon owned data centers. The Amazon Commissioning team (ACx) understands, evaluates, defines and manages the expectations of construction quality in accordance to engineering designs to meet the customer requirements. The CxE is responsible for supporting vendors, contractors, and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems such as:

-Medium and low voltage power systems
-Generators
-UPS
-HVAC (Air Handlers / Exhaust Fans / VFD)
-Chilled Water Systems
-Building Management systems (BMS)
-Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS)
-Testing and balancing
-Pumps and Hydronic systems

Physical Requirements
Walk job sites in uneven terrain
Work at heights and from ladders
Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl
Lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more
Carry objects weighing up to 49 pounds for short distances
Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration with potential for night and weekends
Perform physical tasks throughout the day without becoming overly tired
Ability to manipulate small wires and objects easily
Work in a noisy environment
Work in environments that are colder or hotter than a normal office environment

Additional Job Requirements
· Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 80% of the year.
· Required to provide personal transportation for meetings and job visits away from the office; reimbursed.
· US Citizenship required

Key job responsibilities
The Commissioning Engineer (CxE) provides testing and validation oversight of AWS data center electrical and mechanical infrastructure. CxEs review design documents, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), and manage third-party commissioning vendors in the performance of onsite pre-functional, functional, and integrated systems testing. They take Ownership of their projects’ successes by Diving Deep to resolve technical issues and having Bias for Action to address everchanging schedule and coordination demands onsite. Additionally, CxEs communicate lessons learned and continuously collaborate on program improvements.

The CxE shall provide multi-discipline input into the scheduling, test script development, designing, and planning of projects. In addition, the CxE will be required to review component submittal packages, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), perform system level and integrated system testing. During commissioning the CxE will continuously audit activities to ensure compliance with environmental, quality, and safety requirements. Additionally, the individual will be responsible for comprehensive weekly reporting of status of all ongoing projects and lessons learned to continually improve the quality of our program. This position will include coverage of multiple inflight projects and tight timelines.

A day in the life
On a typical project, the CxE works across AWS engineering, capacity delivery, operations, and contractor teams to coordinate site activities, prioritize tasks, and ensure each issue has clear path to resolution. The CxE manages the project commissioning vendor whose primary scope is to identify issues, determine criticality, propose solutions, and document their findings. If project turnover is at risk, the CxE escalates to the appropriate stakeholders. Upon project completion, the CxE will communicate lessons learned to help peers on similar projects in flight and participate in initiatives that drive improvement to the commissioning program.

title: Operations Manager, Fulfillment Center
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for a motivated, customer-focused Operations Manager (Outbound) to join our Fulfillment Center in Cajamar, SP. This is a full-time, on-site position, working under 3x2 shift.

In this role, you will lead a team of Area Managers I, Operations Leads, and hourly associates, and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Reporting to the Sr. Operations Manager, you will work to continuously improve the functionality and level of service we provide our customers, driving exceeded productivity goals and delivering against our customer promises.

Key job responsibilities
• Manage your shift directly on the floor – this is a hands-on, tactical role where you are present and leading operations in real time, ensuring the shift runs safely, on time, and at standard

• Own a major process directly or indirectly – becoming a subject matter expert in your area

• Lead and supervise a team of Area Managers, Operations Leads, and hourly associates in a fast-paced, time-critical environment

• Own the overall safety, quality, productivity, attendance, and customer experience during your shift

• Make real-time decisions to resolve bottlenecks, adjust labor allocation, and maintain workflow continuity

• Monitor metrics and KPIs in real time, identify trends, and execute immediate action plans for improvement

• Set and clarify requirements and expectations for Area Managers and Operations Leaders

• Support, mentor, and motivate your workforce; develop and implement career development plans for all direct reports

• Manage and drive staffing plans, schedules, and performance levels to attain the Business Plan

• Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and procedures

• Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts; work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud

A day in the life
You lead a shift in operations. Review the production forecast and allocate resources to achieve it. Monitor production in real time, inspect metrics, and quickly correct deviations. Implement and strengthen a safety culture across your shift — ensuring the team works safely and risks are eliminated.

• 3x2 shift pattern (3 days on / 3 off, 2 days on / 2 off);
• 12-hour shifts (06:00–18:00 or 18:00–05:00);
• Availability to work weekends and holidays

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with Lean/Six Sigma

title: Manager, Electrical Engineering, Avionics
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

We are looking for a technical leader, who has a demonstrated track record of building strong engineering teams and delivering complex solutions, to lead the Electrical Engineering team for the Satellite Avionics Bus.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
• Lead the execution for avionics hardware development for the avionics bus.
• Work with key stakeholders across hardware and software development teams to define subsystem requirements.
• Work within the Electrical & Test engineering team(s) to develop, test, and deliver hardware subsystems for the avionics bus.
• Develop and manage development processes, including architecture reviews, requirement reviews, hardware design reviews, build release reviews, test results reviews, and flight release reviews.
• Partner with cross-functional teams including antenna & RF engineering, propulsion, mechanical engineering, software, test, integration, reliability, compliance/regulatory, manufacturing, program management, etc.
• Hire, lead, and guide the various aspects of the avionics electrical engineering team through architecture, trade studies, technology selection, component selection, circuit design and analysis, schematic capture, design reviews, PCB stack-up design, PCB layout, prototyping, bring-up, testing, characterization, debugging, and productization.
• Contribute to the planning and execution for electrical component and subsystem test plans to ensure robust electrical designs for space applications.

A day in the life
You will lead your team for a variety of tasks for avionics subsystems, from board design, to board bring-up, design validation, and integration. You will work with a cross functional team to perform design validation and qualification testing for your subsystem. As your subsystem continues onto satellite level test and operations, your team will be the subject matter experts that interfaces with the vehicle integration & test and operations teams from test planning through launch and on orbit operations. Your team will be responsible for evaluating hardware health telemetry across test and operations while also developing processes to troubleshoot and to incorporate design improvements for issues discovered.

About the team
Our team designs and delivers the hardware subsystems for the flight computer, propulsion controller, solar array deploy and control, magnetorquer bars, magnetometer, and camera system. We are looking for an Electrical Engineering Manager who has a demonstrated team leadership and will provide deep technical expertise in defining, architecting, implementing, verifying, and deploying to the field highly reliable, power efficient, and low cost electronics that fly the satellite.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or equivalent
- Bachelor's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering, or 3+ years of management/team lead function experience
- 7+ years designing and/or testing complex, multi-layer, high-speed PCBA designs.
- 7+ years in hardware development across the full product life cycle (concept to production) in Consumer Electronics, Power Electronics, Robotics, Aerospace, Automotive, and/or Communications fields or combination thereof.
- Experience with schematic and layout ECAD tools.
- Experience with PCB design and debugging, including microprocessors, FPGAs, power supplies, and sensors.
- Experience with complex board designs, including high-speed interconnects, high-reliability designs, avionics, vehicle control systems, and/or motor & actuator control electronics.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or above in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
- Experience with the project management of technical projects
- Experience with developing scripts and/or software (Python) that aid the development or testing of hardware.
- Experience automating, building, integrating, and testing systems.
- Experience in development and test of satellite bus systems.
- Experience with integration of systems into aerospace/avionics enclosures.
- Experience with operations of aerospace/avionics systems.
- Electronics design/qualification experience with radiation environments or radiation tolerant hardware.
- Experience with low-level firmware development and integration.
- Experience with RF design and test equipment.
- Experience with space hardware qualification (MIL Std 1540 / SMC-S-016).
- Experience in two or more areas: EMI/EMC test, hardware-in-the-loop testing, design verification test, radiation test, reliability test, and vehicle integration & test.
- Experience developing requirements, test plans, and test procedures for design verification, qualification, and/or manufacturing test.
- Experience designing and delivering test systems to support design verification, qualification, reliability, and/or manufacturing testing.
- Experience with setup, control and automation of lab equipment like spectrum analyzers, signal generators, electronic loads, power supplies, network analyzers, high-speed oscilloscopes, etc.
- 7+ years designing and testing with SoCs, DRAMs, FPGAs, multi-gigabit interfaces, power converters, sensors, operational amplifiers, ADCs/DACs, high speed printed circuit boards, and harnessing.

title: Senior Manager, Solutions Architecture, Data, AWS
descriptionHtml:
Are you a technical leader who can set the deep-dive data strategy for a multi-billion-dollar business and build and run the team that executes it? Do you have the technical depth across storage, database, and analytics and the leadership skills to guide a team of Specialist Solutions Architects, sponsor our largest customers, and act as the trusted technical advisor to a GTM leadership team? Do you want to help customers across Asia Pacific, Japan and China get their data estates ready for the AI and agentic era? Join the Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) Data & AI team as a Sr Manager, Solutions Architecture for Data.

This role leads the Specialist SA function across the full APJC data portfolio including storage, database, and analytics services and is the senior technical leader for the APJC data business. You will guide, coach, and develop a geographically distributed team of Specialist SAs spanning six geos (ASEAN, Korea, Japan, ANZ, Taiwan and India), and you will be the executive technical sponsor and top escalation point for our customers, partners, and AWS service teams. Data is the context layer that turns generic AI into personalised, differentiated customer experiences; every AI conversation is a data conversation, and this role owns the technical strategy that makes our customers' data foundations cloud-native, resilient, and AI/agentic-ready. You will dive deep on data strategy, find ways to make the team's impact felt at scale, and operate as the technical advisor the CTO to the CEO of the APJC data business.

Key job responsibilities
• Hire, on-board, train, and develop Specialist Solutions Architects across Storage, Database, and Analytics, building a high-performing distributed team across APJC's six geos and time zones
• Own the technical data strategy for APJC, define reference architectures, best practices, and the technical narrative that gets customers' data estates AI/agentic-ready
• Act as executive technical sponsor and top escalation point on the most strategic and complex customer opportunities
• Serve as the technical advisor ("CTO") to the Head of Data, translating customer signal into strategy
• Act as technical liaison between customers, service teams, and support carrying roadmap feedback and competitive gaps back to product leadership
• Drive impact at scale through mechanisms, reusable assets, and enablement that multiply the team beyond one-to-one engagements

A day in the life
One morning you're coaching an SA through a complex analytics modernisation architecture; midday you're the executive sponsor in a CxO briefing making the technical case to migrate a legacy estate ahead of an AI initiative. The afternoon you're unblocking an escalated deal, reviewing a reusable reference architecture your team built, and feeding APJC customer signal back to a service team to shape the roadmap. You move fluidly between leading the team, diving deep on data strategy, and advising the business, measuring success by the technical health and collective growth of the APJC data business.

About the team

descriptionHtml:

本ポジションは、Amazonの物流施設のマテハン・ストレージ設備の安全性や品質を最大化させるため、Construction Manager（CM）をサポートしながら設備が仕様書や標準の要求事項を満たしているか検査あるいは搬送テストを実行し、抽出した問題点をタイムリーに解決させながら設備の立ち上げを成功させ、日本のお客様へお届けする商品のリードタイム短縮と輸送コスト削減に貢献します。

Key job responsibilities
- 日本のフルフィルメントセンターとソートセンターの計画どおりの立ち上げを成功させる。
- 社内各部署及び国内外の協力会社と連携し、継続的に安全な職場環境をつくり、設備の安全性と品質を向上させる。
- Construction Manager（CM）を補佐し、安全基準と設備仕様などの各種標準に則り設備の検査を行い、検出した問題について解決できるまで管理する。
- 計画された設備の能力が達成できるよう搬送テストを準備・実行する。

A day in the life
一週間に4~5日を工事中のサイトで勤務し、Construction Manager（CM）を実務の面でサポートしながら施工管理と設備の立ち上げに貢献します。具体的には各種仕様書や図面に基づきマテハン機器やストレージ設備の設計や据付後の品質検査を行い、不具合のあるアイテムをSnag Listに登録して解決するまでトラックします。試運転調整後の設備の能力を確認するための各種搬送テストの準備と実行をサポートします。業務を進めるうえで何か迷うことがあれば、CMをはじめとするチームメンバー気軽に相談しながら解決していくことでスキルを高めていくことができます。

チームメンバーは10数名で、年間に新築工事2～4サイトの立ち上げるため、各サイトにつきプロジェクトマネージャー1名と施工管理者3名が着工から稼働までプロジェクトを指揮します。本ポジションは施工管理者を補佐するポジションとなります。チームメンバーは機械・電気工学から建設の分野までさまざまなバックグラウンドを持っていますが、定期的なチームミーティングや現場レビューを通じてオープンなディスカッションを通じてお互いの知識や経験を共有しています。 そうすることで個人のスキルの幅と広げ、かつ専門性を高めながら、チームとしての成長を目指しています。

SCE is a specialized global deal team that engages with commercial and public sector customers on deal strategy, structuring, and negotiations through contractual closure for transformational, strategic, large, complex, and/or highly competitive opportunities such as GenAI. These engagements may also involve Pan-Amazon and AWS go-to-market opportunities involving close partnership between the SCE team and other Amazon and AWS stakeholders.

As a SCE Deal Lead, you will be responsible for managing the end to end Deal Cycle for strategic, large, complex or highly competitive deals. This highly visible role will own engagement with customer C-level executives, IT teams, and multiple lines of business to achieve business outcomes, increase the adoption of AWS services, and to enable private pricing, go-to-market, pan-Amazon, and other strategic relationships. descriptionHtml:
The Language Producer, German (LPGER) is responsible for ensuring Amazon MGM Studios Originals content maintains its creative vision and quality when localized into German, with dubbed and subtitled versions for theatrical and all downstream audiences.

Based in Germany and reporting to the Head of Language Programs & Creative in Los Angeles, the LPGER drives workflow improvements, vendor/talent management, creative program development and stakeholder communication to elevate the Premium German Localization Program.






Key job responsibilities
As a strategic leader, the LPGER researches market trends/developments to support expansion of the Premium German Localization Program. Working with the Culver City team, they drive iterative workflow and process improvements to raise the creative bar and support scalable solutions for all in-territory content. The LPGER will be comfortable discussing German dubbing and subtitling both high level and granularly; maintaining metrics for talent/vendors and providing escalations for internal/external resources. As primary contact for internal LO creative talent/stakeholders, the LPGER will provide localization updates related to their titles.

The LPGER monitors the performance of Creative Supervisors, responsible for creative quality and title-by-title localization of Amazon MGM Studios content. Additionally, the LPGER builds and maintains relationships with dubbing studios & their associated creative teams, to understand potential and available opportunities for programmatic improvements supporting talent development and cultivation. Working independently, the LPGER connects German language localization, the creative community, and Amazon MGM Studios' operational direction. Key responsibilities include maintaining talent databases, enforcing contractual standards, analyzing creative issues, monitoring industry trends, and exploring technological innovations while ensuring operational requirements in post-production and distribution are met.


About the team
Global Localization at Amazon MGM Studios is responsible for creating subtitled and/or dubbed versions of our content for more than 240 countries and territories worldwide. Our team ensures localized content conveys the original creative intent and is adapted with appropriate linguistic and cultural references for our global Customers. The team oversees the human, creative, and technical aspects of localization from greenlight through distribution. Our global Customers should relish the holistic quality of our product, as they enjoy the exclusive experience of material tailored just for them.

- Speak, write, and read fluently in German
- Experience analyzing metrics to implement business improvements. Localization Creative services or global studio/post-production.
- Deep expertise & strong connections in German dubbing markets.
- Experience formulating strategies to streamline systems, translating vision into actionable plans.
- Experience directing freelance workers and developing creative teams.
- Familiarity with local audience localization preferences and regulations.
- Direct experience with global distributed teams.
- Experience with 3P post vendors & episodic/feature content technical workflows.
- Understanding of post-production and international day-and-date delivery. Understanding of, interest in exploring AI/ML technologies to augment in-person work options.

- Advanced written and oral communication skills.
- Professional working knowledge and established relationships with local dubbing studios, translators, adaptors, directors, creative talent, and associations. title: Support Engineer III, AMC, Ad-Tech Solutions
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) is a new secure, privacy-safe, and dedicated cloud-based environment in which advertisers can easily perform analytics across multiple, pseudonymized data sets to generate insights. Inputs can include an advertiser’s own data sets, as well as their Amazon Advertising campaign events, such as impressions, clicks, and conversions. AMC enables advertisers to perform campaign measurement, audience refinement, supply optimization, and more, enabling advertisers to make more informed decisions about their cross-channel marketing investments. Our services ingest billions of behavioral signals every day. Speed, scale, and accuracy are critical to our success.

Are you passionate about driving customer success? Interested in learning new technologies? Do you thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment? AMC is seeking a Sr Support Engineer to provide support to partners and external customers as they build business-critical applications on our platform. You'll also work directly with Amazon Advertising product and engineering teams to ensure that customer issues are resolved as expediently as possible.


Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will independently resolve customer issues and blockers by providing knowledgeable and responsive technical support on AMC. Our customers are large enterprises, direct and agencies.You would often interact with customers’ Data Analysts and other Data focused stakeholders. You would use advanced SQL skills to build confidence and solutions. You will have ownership for issue investigation, identifying root cause and software defects, conceive and provide workarounds if acceptable to customers for continuity. You will gather sufficient information that helps reproduce issues and contribute to building software fixes. This is a complex, and fast-paced environment as you will own the most critical part of the customer experience and delivering on our customers’ most basic need. While we obsess over issue resolution, in this role you will also develop tools to scale our support & service quality, and provide critical input for product prioritization to address root causes of why the customer experienced an issue in the first place. Our advertising customers are likely Amazon customers, and we take seriously maintaining the high customer service bar set by Amazon to be the level at which we need to operate.
A day in the life

* Track, investigate, and resolve customer questions and issues using appropriate communication channel including phone, email, and live as well as asynchronous at various levels of complexity and customer impact.
* Act as an escalation point for the most complex and in-depth issues that potentially span multiple external and internal organizations.
* Communicate directly with internal organizations to complete root cause analyses, issue investigation, workarounds and defect resolution.
* Develop and implement complex repro cases to identify potential software defects, mis-configurations, or issues in customer environments.
* Use case management tools to manage and prioritize issues based on multiple factors including customer impact.
* Build & Contribute to training material and documentation for both internal and customer-facing users.
* Actively seeking solutions to customer needs, communicating trends to leadership, and suggesting innovative solutions on behalf of the customer experience.
* Providing support directly to data analysts who are using Amazon Marketing Cloud.
* Writing queries, code samples, tutorials, and technical articles for the customer community
* Working with customers to understand how they are using our services, and providing feedback to development teams
* Collaborating with internal stakeholders to drive timely customer communication
* Driving internal projects that improve support-related processes and our customer's user experience

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of software development, or 1+ years of technical support experience
- Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

AMC enables advertisers to perform campaign measurement, audience refinement, supply optimization, and more, enabling advertisers to make more informed decisions about their cross-channel marketing investments. Our services ingest billions of behavioral signals every day. Speed, scale, and accuracy are critical to our success.

Are you passionate about driving customer success? Interested in learning new technologies? Do you thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment? AMC is seeking a Sr Support Engineer to provide support to partners and external customers as they build business-critical applications on our platform. You'll also work directly with Amazon Advertising product and engineering teams to ensure that customer issues are resolved as expediently as possible.


Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will independently resolve customer issues and blockers by providing knowledgeable and responsive technical support on AMC. Our customers are large enterprises, direct and agencies.You would often interact with customers’ Data Analysts and other Data focused stakeholders. You would use advanced SQL skills to build confidence and solutions. You will have ownership for issue investigation, identifying root cause and software defects, conceive and provide workarounds if acceptable to customers for continuity. You will gather sufficient information that helps reproduce issues and contribute to building software fixes. This is a complex, and fast-paced environment as you will own the most critical part of the customer experience and delivering on our customers’ most basic need. While we obsess over issue resolution, in this role you will also develop tools to scale our support & service quality, and provide critical input for product prioritization to address root causes of why the customer experienced an issue in the first place. Our advertising customers are likely Amazon customers, and we take seriously maintaining the high customer service bar set by Amazon to be the level at which we need to operate.
A day in the life

* Track, investigate, and resolve customer questions and issues using appropriate communication channel including phone, email, and live as well as asynchronous at various levels of complexity and customer impact.
* Act as an escalation point for the most complex and in-depth issues that potentially span multiple external and internal organizations.
* Communicate directly with internal organizations to complete root cause analyses, issue investigation, workarounds and defect resolution.
* Develop and implement complex repro cases to identify potential software defects, mis-configurations, or issues in customer environments.
* Use case management tools to manage and prioritize issues based on multiple factors including customer impact.
* Build & Contribute to training material and documentation for both internal and customer-facing users.
* Actively seeking solutions to customer needs, communicating trends to leadership, and suggesting innovative solutions on behalf of the customer experience.
* Providing support directly to data analysts who are using Amazon Marketing Cloud.
* Writing queries, code samples, tutorials, and technical articles for the customer community
* Working with customers to understand how they are using our services, and providing feedback to development teams
* Collaborating with internal stakeholders to drive timely customer communication
* Driving internal projects that improve support-related processes and our customer's user experience

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of software development, or 1+ years of technical support experience
- Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

descriptionHtml:

- Experience managing and prioritizing multiple searches, projects and client relationships

title: Software Development Engineer, Agentic WorkSpaces
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Amazon WorkSpaces has protected and empowered enterprise work for over a decade. Now we are reimagining what a workspace is. We are building Agentic WorkSpaces: a platform where the workspace itself is an active partner in how you work not just infrastructure that delivers applications. The Agentic WorkSpaces organization envisions a world where people teams and AI collaborate securely from anywhere to create unprecedented value for every organization. We build lovable products that empower every business to unlock the full potential of human-AI teamwork driving smarter decisions greater creativity more value and faster innovation with confidence.

Come change the way the world sees the cloud! Amazon WorkSpaces is a managed desktop computing service in the cloud that allows customers to easily provision cloud-based desktops enabling end-users to access the documents applications and resources they need with the device of their choice including laptops iPad Kindle Fire Android tablets and zero clients. With a few clicks in the AWS Management Console customers can provision a high-quality cloud desktop experience (for Windows or Linux) for any number of users at a cost that is highly competitive with traditional desktops and half the cost of most virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI) solutions. Now we are taking this further with the agentic WorkSpace: a secure managed environment purpose-built for human-AI collaboration at enterprise scale where people and AI agents work side by side to deliver results neither could achieve alone.

We offer a unique opportunity to solve some of the most interesting problems associated with providing secure reliable fast and highly scalable solutions at the intersection of cloud computing and agentic AI. In the process you will have the opportunity to work on a number of industry-leading AWS services. Our team is innovating in multiple areas to give our customers the best-in-class interactive streaming platform while pioneering the next generation of human-AI collaborative workspaces. We are looking for people who believe in providing world-class application streaming experience for AWS Enterprise and ISV customers and who are energized by the challenge of building the future where every workspace is an intelligent partner that drives smarter decisions greater creativity and faster innovation with confidence.

title: ファシリティエンジニア - DCEO（データセンターエンジニアリング・オペレーションズ）, Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services はすべての AWS グローバルインフラストラクチャの設計、計画、提供、運用を担当しています。私たちは、クラウドを稼働させ続ける人々です。すべての AWS データセンターとお客様がイノベーションに継続的にアクセスできるようにするすべてのサーバー、ストレージ、ネットワーク、電源、冷却設備をサポートしています。私たちはサプライチェーンに影響を与える数千もの要因を考慮しながら、最も困難な課題に取り組んでいます。そして私たちと共に支援したいと考える優秀な人材を探しています。

ソフトウェア、ハードウェア、ネットワークエンジニア、サプライチェーンスペシャリスト、セキュリティエキスパート、オペレーションマネージャー、その他の重要な役割を担う多様なチームに参加していただきます。AWS 全体の人々と協力して、お客様に最低コストで無限の容量を提供しながら、安全性とセキュリティの最高基準を提供できるよう支援していただきます。そして、大胆なアイデアを歓迎し、それを完成まで自分のものとして進める力を与える包括的な文化を体験していただけます。

Data Center Operationsチームは AWS のバックボーンであり、急速に成長する AWS ビジネスとお客様を 24 時間 365 日サポートしています。私たちは AWS の物理インフラストラクチャを維持し、安全性、セキュリティ、可用性、生産性、容量、効率性、コストの分野における運用パフォーマンスの基準を確保することに取り組んでいます。

Key job responsibilities
Facility Engineer - Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) の役割は、大規模で高密度のデータセンターにおいて、施設（電気/機械システム、制御/消火システムなど）の展開、運用、保守、および関連プロジェクトの管理を担当します。
日常業務では、以下の業務に携わります:
- 建物システムの点検と監視、および施設の問題のトラブルシューティング
- 運用効率の改善とエネルギー削減
- ベンダーやパートナーとの定期メンテナンスと修理の計画と実施。これには、ブレーカー操作、機械/電気設備操作などの重要な施設運用が含まれます
- 新規キャパシティ設置前の電気冷却容量の確認
- 新規データセンター建設および既存データセンター拡張の設計レビュー
- プロジェクトチームメンバーと協力して建設とテストをサポート

A day in the life
柔軟な勤務体制:

通常営業日は 9:00〜18:00 の間で実働 8 時間

勤務時間は、その日および週の業務に応じて相談・調整可能

通常勤務時間外のオンコール業務があり、全チームメンバーで週単位でローテーション

*注: ビジネス状況によっては、この役割でシフト勤務が必要になる場合があります。シフト勤務の詳細については、面接時に説明します。

About the team
チームについて

多様な経験

AWS は多様な経験を重視しています。職務内容に記載されているすべての資格やスキルを満たしていなくても、応募することをお勧めします。キャリアが始まったばかりの場合、従来の道を歩んでいない場合、または関連しない経験がある場合でも、応募をためらわないでください。

なぜ AWS なのか?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) は、世界で最も包括的で広く採用されているクラウドプラットフォームです。私たちはクラウドコンピューティングのパイオニアであり、イノベーションを止めることはありません。だからこそ、最も成功しているスタートアップから Global 500 企業まで、幅広いお客様が当社の堅牢な製品・サービスを信頼し、ビジネスを推進しています。

包括的なチーム文化

AWS では、学び、好奇心を持つことが私たちの本質です。従業員主導のアフィニティグループは、私たちが自分たちの違いを誇りに思える包括的な文化を育んでいます。Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) や AmazeCon (ジェンダーダイバーシティ) カンファレンスを含む継続的なイベントや学習体験は、私たちが独自性を受け入れることを決して止めないよう刺激を与えてくれます。

メンターシップとキャリア成長

私たちは、地球上で最高の雇用主になるために、継続的にパフォーマンスバーを引き上げています。だからこそ、ここには、より多角的な専門家に成長するのに役立つ、無限の知識共有、メンターシップ、その他のキャリア向上リソースがあります。

ワークライフバランス

私たちはワークライフハーモニーを重視しています。仕事での成功は、家庭での犠牲を伴うべきではありません。だからこそ、柔軟な勤務時間と勤務体制が私たちの文化の一部となっています。職場と家庭でサポートされていると感じるとき、クラウドで達成できないことは何もありません。

Basic qualifications

- ミッションクリティカルな設備の運用と保守に関する 2 年以上の関連実務経験（例: 24 時間稼働の工場、変電所、病院など）
- メンテナンス、変更管理、インシデント管理、ベンダー管理の経験または基本的な理解、およびポリシー、プロセス、手順を遵守して作業する方法
- 日本語（JLPT N2 相当）および英語（TOEIC 550 相当、または英語で日常業務を処理できるレベル）の両方における口頭および読み書き能力

Preferred qualifications

- データセンターに関連する資格（CDCP、CDCS、CDCE、ASHRAE など）、またはデータセンター管理のための資格（第二種または第三種電気主任技術者、エネルギー管理士、第 4 類危険物取扱者、冷凍機械責任者、第二種電気工事士）
- プロジェクト管理資格（PMP、Prince2、ITILv2、BICSI）
- 電気システムに関する高度な理解力（変電所の電源供給システム、変圧器、スイッチギア、VFI クラス UPS、DRUPS、PDU、ATS、STS、SLA または VRLA バッテリーおよび関連システム、ディーゼル/ガスタービン発電機に関連する燃料システム、サージ制御回路、アクティブ高調波フィルター、バッテリー監視システム、分岐回路監視システム、SCADA システム）
- 機械システムに関する高度な理解力（CRAC/CRAH、AHU、チラー、冷却塔、貯蔵タンク、熱交換器、配管システム、ポンプ、バルブ、ダクトシステム、ファン、ダンパー、火災検知・消火システム、排水システム、ビル監視システム、自動制御システム）
- 英語の流暢さ - TOEIC スコア 800 以上または同等

descriptionHtml:

Unser technisches Team stellt eine hohe Verfügbarkeit der technischen Anlagen sicher und verbessert die Qualität unserer Geräte.


Key job responsibilities
- Ausführung präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an einer breiten Vielfalt von Geräten an unseren Standorten
- Durchführung von Reparaturen und Fehlerdiagnosen
- Verwendung neuester Tools zur Maximierung der Geräteeffektivität
- Einhaltung aller Arbeitsschutzrichtlinien und -praktiken
- Unterstützung der Entwicklung und des beruflichen Fortschritts von Auszubildenden am Standort
- Arbeit an Projekten zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Einführung von Best Practices an verschiedenen EU-Standorten
- Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit

WIR BIETEN:
• Einen unbefristeten Vertrag direkt mit Amazon.
• Spannende Aufgaben in einem expandierenden, innovativen und internationalen Umfeld.
• Gestaltungsfreiräume für Ideen und Wertschätzung von Engagement.
• Hervorragende Perspektiven aufgrund unseres Wachstums.
• Die Mitarbeit in einem kompetenten, hoch motivierten Team.
• Vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und ein attraktives Vergütungspaket mit Unternehmensbeteiligung.
• Das kollektivvertragliche Mindestgrundgehalt beträgt € 39.243€ brutto pro Jahr. Eine Überzahlung ist je nach Qualifikation und Erfahrung möglich.

A day in the life
Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren tätig, um schnell auf technische Störungen reagieren zu können. Du führst eine Reihe geplanter präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an Geräten durch, um für ihren sicheren Betrieb zu sorgen. Außerdem reagierst Du als Instandhaltungstechniker:in unverzüglich auf Störungen und Ausfälle. Du untersuchst die Ursachen, findest so schnell wie möglich Lösungen und wendest sie an. Zudem machst Du Vorschläge für langfristige Verbesserungen.
In Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Kolleg:innen nimmst Du tägliche Wartungsaufgaben wahr und kommunizierst mit Dienstleistern, falls Du externe Expertise benötigst. Du arbeitest in rotierenden Schichten, damit wir rund um die Uhr unsere Standorte unterstützen – und dafür sorgen, dass Amazon weiterhin in dem Tempo liefern kann, für das wir bekannt sind.

About the team
Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) sorgt dafür, dass unsere Geräte und Ausstattung jederzeit optimal funktionieren. Wir sind ein Team von Techniker:innen und Ingenieur:innen, das aus hervorragenden Teamplayern besteht und von erfahrenen Führungskräften geleitet wird. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, die Geräte in unserem gesamten globalen Netzwerk von Fulfillment-Centern zu warten, zu reparieren und ihre Fehler zu beheben. Einige unserer Mitarbeiter:innen sind Führungskräfte, die das Team bei der Arbeit an spannender, innovativer Technologie beaufsichtigen – die es teilweise nur bei Amazon gibt.
Von der Installation automatisierter Verpackungssysteme bis hin zur Beaufsichtigung der allgemeinen Wartungsarbeiten eines Standorts sowie der Reparatur von für den Vertrieb wesentlichen Geräten wickelt unser Team einen Großteil der technischen Aufgaben bei Amazon ab. Unter anderem sorgt es auch dafür, dass Gebäude weiterhin den rechtlichen Auflagen entsprechen, damit alle sicher bleiben und unsere Standorte mit maximaler Effizienz betrieben werden. Es gibt zahlreiche Aufstiegschancen im RME-Team selbst ebenso wie im gesamten Amazon-Unternehmen.
Alle unsere Aktivitäten sind darauf ausgerichtet, die Ausfallzeiten an Amazons wichtigsten Betriebsstandorten zu reduzieren, damit Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen rechtzeitig erhalten. Oft arbeiten wir früh morgens, spät abends oder in der Nachtschicht, um Wartungsarbeiten mit den geringstmöglichen Störungen vorzunehmen. Falls wir eine bessere Möglichkeit finden, eine bestimmte Aufgabe zu erledigen, verfügen wir über die Fertigkeiten und Gelegenheiten, vollständig neue Prozesse oder bahnbrechende Technologie wie Amazon Robotics oder unseren Complex Item Sorter einzuführen.
