title: Installation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Transform network infrastructure by joining our dynamic team! You'll be at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that drive network stability and scalability, using your technical expertise to create automated systems that power global technological advancement.

Infra Delivery Install Technicians will collaborate with cross-functional teams, troubleshoot complex technical scenarios, and implement strategic solutions that keep our network running seamlessly. Expect to engage in hands-on technical work that requires creativity, precision, and a passion for technological innovation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
- Moving and implementing large enterprise equipment
- Installing Fiber and Copper cabling and patching cabling between equipment
- Ensuring proper safety and security standards are maintained during cabling and rack installation,
- Following well established hardware installation procedures and break-fix activities
- Safely using material handling tools and equipment
- Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided

Physical Requirements:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
- Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to participate in primary responder rotation and provide after-hours support as needed
- Working in cramped and/or elevated and/or noisy environments
- Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Computer Hardware Repair, Infrastructure Cabling, Network Deployment, or Data Center Operations experience, or experience in similar technical or vocational roles
- High school diploma or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- industry standard certification (CompTIA, CCENT, or Network+)
- Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
- Knowledge of network cabling, optic types, and test equipment

title: AI Sales Specialist, SSO/GenAI Team
descriptionHtml:
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

Would you like to be part of a team shaping the future of the IT industry through responsible and innovative use of Artificial Intelligence? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is advancing the next evolution of cloud computing with AI technologies. We are seeking a Senior AI Sales Specialist who brings strong technical AI knowledge together with a customer-centric, outcome-focused approach to revenue growth.

This role partners closely with customers to understand their goals, translate complex AI capabilities into clear business value, and support successful AI adoption at scale. If you enjoy collaborating with diverse stakeholders, communicating technical concepts with clarity, and contributing to long-term customer success, we encourage you to apply.

AWS Global Sales supports customers of all sizes across the region to innovate and grow in the cloud. As organizations increasingly adopt foundation models, large language models (LLMs), and agentic AI, we are expanding our team of sales professionals. We are seeking professionals who can help customers identify and prioritize AI use cases to create AWS opportunities, build sustainable pipelines, and guide customers through complex AI adoption journeys.


Key job responsibilities
• Sales & Revenue Contribution:
o Support the achievement of sales targets by developing and maintaining a healthy pipeline and guiding customers through end-to-end sales cycles, from discovery through to agreement;
o Create detailed account plans and territory strategies in partnership with internal teams, while maintaining accurate forecasting using CRM tools;
o Collaborate with customers to identify and qualify high-impact AI use cases aligned to their business priorities and strategic objectives.
• Sales & Solution Advisory
o Act as a trusted advisor on AWS AI services, helping customers understand potential outcomes, value, and return on investment;
o Lead technical discovery sessions and contribute to demonstrations, proofs of concept, and solution design, including model selection, fine-tuning, and deployment approaches;
o Provide guidance on model evaluation, responsible AI practices, governance considerations, and relevant compliance requirements.
• Customer Engagement & Market Development
o Build and maintain strong relationships with decision-makers and executive stakeholders through a consultative, collaborative approach;
o Partner with internal teams to deliver workshops, enablement sessions, and solution reviews that support customer learning and adoption;
o Share customer insights and feedback with AWS AI product teams to help inform product direction and improvements.


About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of direct sales or business development in software, cloud or SaaS markets selling to C-level executives experience
- Experience proactively growing customer relationships within an account while expanding their understanding of the customer's business
- Experience positioning and selling complex technical solution to new customers and new market segments
- Ability to design high-level AI technical architectures and present AI workflows to both business and technical stakeholders
- Proven track record in engaging with C-Suite contacts in customers communicate and present with impact towards agreed project outcomes.

Preferred qualifications

- Demonstrated ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments with a 'roll up your sleeves' approach to problem-solving
- Track record of success driving adoption of new and disruptive technologies within Enterprise accounts.
- Track record of consistent territory growth and sales quota attainment
- Experience working as a Co-Prime Seller in a matrixed team environment
- Experience selling AI solutions, including competitive or complementary products in the market

title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) - Workforce Optimization
descriptionHtml:
Have you ever ordered a product from Amazon and been amazed by how fast it gets to you? Every day, Amazon engineers are working relentlessly to make sure that the time from Click to Deliver is as short as possible for your products. In our mission to get packages to you even faster, Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) is building large scale, fault-tolerant distributed systems for optimizing labor planning in fulfillment operations.

Our team is looking for Software Development Engineers who love listening to our customers, working as a team, and building large scalable systems. This is an opportunity to build and improve systems that will help Fulfillment Centers (FCs i.e. Amazon Warehouses) and other building types around the world to operate efficiently by providing information and insights to FC operators and software services which rely on real time information for planning and staffing. These systems provide aggregate data and help build an end-to-end picture of FC state to help users make key decisions to improve efficiency and staff optimally. These decisions impact delivery of packages to Amazon customers. Your work will directly influence Amazon business and customer promise. As a member of this team, you will get the opportunity to work on highly visible, innovative projects that directly impact the customer experience. You will be involved in all the aspects of the software development cycle including scoping, design, implementation, testing & delivery of your product. The position has great opportunity for growth.

Key job responsibilities
In this position you will partner with product managers, software engineers, user experience designers and other teams. A successful candidate will have an established background with strong technical ability, bar raising engineering skills, great communication skills and motivation to achieve results for your customers. In this role you will both code and mentor junior engineers committing code to the program.

About the team
Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) powers Amazon’s global fulfillment network. We invent and deliver software, hardware, and data science solutions that orchestrate processes, robots, machines, and people. We harmonize the physical and virtual world so Amazon customers can get what they want, when they want it.

Workforce Optimization
AFT’s Workforce Optimization team delivers innovative platforms and products to automate labor management and staffing decisions across processes and functions at Amazon’s global fulfillment network locations.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Manager, Technical Infrastructure Program Management, Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation
descriptionHtml:
Join our Robotics Delivery and Packaging Innovation International team, where we transform complex automation technologies into efficiently deployable solutions on a global scale. Amazon is seeking an experienced Manager to lead a team of Single-Threaded Leaders (STLs) who own end-to-end program planning, cross-functional orchestration, and delivery governance for complex automation infrastructure deployments across our international fulfillment network.

You will lead and develop a team of program managers who each own full lifecycle delivery of a technology program or cross-functional workstream — from capital approval and planning through deployment execution and steady-state handover. You will design the governance mechanisms, operating cadences, and scalable frameworks that enable your team to drive predictable delivery outcomes across multiple concurrent programs, countries, and stakeholder organizations.

You will influence within a VP organization, advise Senior Managers and Directors on deployment strategy, prioritization trade-offs, and program health, and actively grow the next generation of program leaders.

Amazon's culture encourages an entrepreneurial approach and expects engineers and managers alike to take a high level of ownership in solving complex problems in a fast-paced environment.

The role could be based in Berlin, Munich, Barcelona, or London with ~50% travel across Europe during deployment season, with occasional international travel.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and develop a team of program managers operating as Single-Threaded Leaders, each owning end-to-end delivery of a technology program or cross-functional workstream across planning, funding, deployment, and handover.
- Own the team's operating model, governance cadences, and delivery mechanisms, designing scalable frameworks that drive predictable outcomes across multiple concurrent programs and geographies.
- Drive cross-functional alignment across diverse stakeholder organizations including finance, operations, supply chain, site selection, and engineering to remove blockers and accelerate delivery.
- Own capital governance and program prioritization for the team's portfolio, ensuring CARs, plans of record, and financial commitments are on track and aligned to organizational goals.
- Build scalable planning mechanisms, launch readiness frameworks, and standard work that convert first-time program complexity into repeatable, predictable delivery paths adopted organization-wide.
- Advise Senior Managers and Directors on program strategy, prioritization trade-offs, resource allocation, and risk mitigation, influencing within a VP organization on cross-functional program decisions.
- Make trade-offs between short-term delivery needs and long-term sustainability using data-driven decision-making, metrics review, and clear RAG-based program health reporting.
- Set the standard for program management excellence across the team, defining best practices for stakeholder management, executive communication, cross-functional coordination, and delivery rigor.
- Grow and develop program managers through development planning, coaching, and strategic program assignment;
- Identify and develop future program leaders through talent reviews and succession planning.

CDS includes Amazon Simple Email Service (SES) and AWS End User Messaging — cloud-based services that enable customers to reach their audiences across email, SMS, RCS, push notifications, and WhatsApp for marketing outreach, transactional communications, and customer engagement at scale. As messaging evolves toward conversational and agentic AI — where intelligent agents handle customer interactions, resolve issues, and orchestrate multi-step workflows autonomously across channels — CDS is at the forefront of that transformation. In this role you will lead a globally distributed team of Specialist SAs, set the technical bar for the portfolio, and own and lead key business and technical initiatives to grow the CDS business — from defining the technical go-to-market strategy to launching programs that accelerate adoption and revenue.

title: Art Director, Creative Dev, GSS Creative Studio
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Prime Video brings world-class storytelling to global audiences through high-impact creative campaigns and experiences. GSS Creative Studio combines creative and brand expertise with operational excellence to deliver scalable, high-quality creative solutions across Prime Video business lines, channels and marketplaces.
Creative Studio is seeking an Art Director specializing in Creative Development. This is a people management role responsible for leading a team of Art Directors and Visual Designers, and ensuring the creative work produced by that team is strategically grounded, crafted to a high standard and compellingly presented to stakeholders.

The Art Director, Creative Development sets the creative quality bar for their team. They translate business objectives and audience insights into clear creative direction, guide their team from brief through approved execution, and model the standard for how creative work should be developed, presented and defended. They are as comfortable giving detailed feedback on a design as they are building the strategic narrative behind a campaign and presenting it to senior leadership.
This role is the connective tissue between the Creative Leadership's vision and the day-to-day creative output of the team. The ideal candidate is a strong creative practitioner who has grown into a confident people manager — someone who elevates work through both hands-on direction and team development.

Key job responsibilities
Manage a team of Art Directors and Visual Designers by providing ongoing direction, coaching, and professional development support. Set and uphold high creative quality standards across all team outputs, from concept to final delivery.

Lead the creative development on assigned projects and oversee the process across the team’s portfolio. Translate campaign objectives, brand strategy, and audience insights into clear, strategically grounded creative direction. Construct persuasive narratives to explain creative decisions and connect strategic intent to visual execution.

Present and advocate for creative work to internal stakeholders and senior leadership, ensuring clarity and conviction. Collaborate with ADs specializing in Campaign & Brand and Key Art to align on cross-project creative standards. - Experience leading creative work from brief through approved execution.

title: Software Development Engineer, DevX LIFT
descriptionHtml:
Are you a developer advocate? A builder passionate about incredible software? Are you committed to quality, agility, predictability, and consistency? How about having a great time designing the Future? We are looking for senior Software Development Engineers to help us make this vision a reality. Join us!!!

Our team delivers software services and infrastructure for the Amazon networking OS. We are a builder tools team: we build tools for other builders. Our goal is improving the developer experience, by providing world-class tooling that empowers, enables, and fosters ideas. We champion great engineering practices - we make the right things common, common things easy, and ensure uncommon things are possible. We craft great tools: simple, intuitive, reliable, and "feel nice" - we reduce friction and increase output for the same input. Above all, customers come to us because we are a strong, high-quality, and dependable engineering org. We design the future and better their daily-lives. You will join us to influence, innovate, and raise the bar in this mission!

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
You will solve complex and ambiguous problems, efficiently and with high-quality. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the definition, vision, design, roadmap, development, and operationalization of customer-facing services. You will be given an outcome and the freedom to set the direction based on data driven decisions. You will be part of a startup with the backing of a large company.

In this role, you'll contribute to critical and highly-visible function within the AWS business. You will work alongside other talented builders, and across multiple teams. You have the opportunity to hire and shape the team to continue to outperform expectations. You will incorporate customer input and ensure consistency and intuitiveness of our services. You will build highly available and fault tolerant distributed systems. You’ll find this role engaging, challenging, and full of opportunities to learn and grow. You will have a large impact on AWS and the cloud computing industry.

A day in the life
You must ensure our solutions meet the needs of our most important customers — our own developers. You will be a hands-on technical lead. You will work with customers to gather requirements and generate technical designs, and you will carry the project through all the software lifecycle stages. You’ll develop products that enable builders to develop and operate robust, high-quality software and safely, securely, and reliably deploy it. You will use your strong leadership and communication skills to mentor other engineers and provide training and support for our technologies. You will have access to senior leadership and engineering staff.

About the team
We serve many customers, and play a critical role and multiplying effect across Networking services. We run very lean and scale with the business, without repeated technical or operational burden. We use Rust, Go, Python (and many other things) in NAWS. We touch everything from embedded systems and kernel, to GRPC/Rest APIs and your favorite front-end stack (ours is React). We own and support every service across different verticals:

* Product – We own solutions that provide visibility into business-driving metrics, aggregate information, trigger actions, and help leaders manage this domain.
* Build and release – we own the CI/CD charter. We push commits through pipelines that compile binaries, build images, debug symbols, go through multiple stages of validation, and push updates to millions of devices across the Amazon network. We aim to simplify and reduce the time to release new content to the network, automate processes, etc.
* Validation and qualification – builders use our testing frameworks to validate the OS. We own tooling for unit/integration/functional/system testing, and static analysis (but don’t own the tests). We aim to improve quality by reducing defects, increasing the expressiveness of the testing scenarios, and reducing feedback loop.
* Infrastructure – we own and support datacenter labs with tooling that manages inventory, reservations, capacity auto-scaling/provisioning/recovery, sanity checks, etc. This is the underlying infrastructure of the ecosystem.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

title: Global Account Manager, APJ Automotive Sales, AWS
descriptionHtml:
AWS is seeking a senior sales professional to manage a global customer relationship with one of our large global Automotive customers. You will define and execute a CXO relationship strategy within the account, including engaging with a dedicated account team, AWS senior leaders for executive sponsorship, coordinating executive business reviews, enabling customer value creation and growth.

The Global Account Manager ("GAM") will partner with the customer to build strategic relationships, articulate a clear vision, and deliver business value. The successful GAM will develop and execute a broad strategy for earning customer trust and driving AWS solution and service adoption across the customer's IT/Digital, Line of Business (LoB) / Engineering, and Operations leadership. The GAM will work with all appropriate AWS resources (Executives, Solution Architects, Customer Solutions Managers, Industry Specialists, Marketing, Partners, Support, Service Teams and Professional Services) to deliver customer outcomes. This is an Individual Contributor role, but necessitates an account leader mindset, and may include dotted line responsibility for downstream sales, technical and industry specialist resources. The GAM will also effectively leverage existing programs and mechanisms, innovate and scale new mechanisms, and develop formal case studies and other forms of references highlighting outcomes and solutions running on AWS.

Key job responsibilities
-Contributing to, and leading, within an AWS customer account team.
-Identifying and building trusted advisor relationships with key influencers and decision-makers, specifically -CxOs, at the customer, across LoB and functional areas (Digital, Data, Engineering, and Operations).
-Working closely with internal AWS teams (executives, solution architects, industry specialists, marketing, partners, enterprise support, service teams and professional services), as well as external SI and ISV partners, to support the best business solution(s) for customers.
-Defining a CXO relationship strategy within the customer, coordinating executive business reviews, and maintaining customer satisfaction levels.
-Displaying strong leadership presence and being able to command a room in a meeting. Should be seen as an authority in communicating via email, phone, and face to face, and comfortable writing executive briefing documents for, and communicating with, the most senior executives at the company.
-Operating with significant autonomy and discretion. A high degree of decision making is required in routine customer engagement, business judgment is critical.
-Managing a global sales pipeline via Salesforce and facilitating all stages of a sale.
-Participating and leading in the negotiation and closing of legal agreements, such as Enterprise Agreements (EAs), and contracts, such as Private Pricing Addendums (PPAs).
-Maintaining knowledge of AWS's broad solution and service offerings, with a focus on connecting cloud capabilities to the customer's technology and operational priorities.
-Defining product and solution requirements by understanding and evangelizing the needs of customers, including feedback via PFRs or the service teams.
-Working with marketing and communications to develop formal references, PR and case studies highlighting impactful customer activity and workloads running on AWS.

A day in the life
Your day begins with reviewing customer engagement strategies and aligning with your team on priority initiatives. You'll spend time developing and implementing strategies for multi-divisional global companies, leading a cross-functional team of AWS resources in serving customer needs. You'll engage with senior executives to understand their business challenges, facilitate solution discussions with technical teams, and coordinate internal resources to ensure seamless delivery. Throughout the day, you'll be strategizing on approaches to accelerate cloud adoption and measuring progress against key business outcomes.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Our team takes pride in leading customers through accelerated and innovative cloud journeys, creating long-term business relationships built on value and trust. descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about solving complex financial automation challenges at scale? Amazon's Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) team is seeking a Programmer/Analyst II to help revolutionize how we manage financial operations across our global transportation network. In this role, you'll build critical automation solutions that streamline migrations, generate actionable metrics, and enable seamless financial book closures for one of the world's most sophisticated logistics operations.

You'll work at the intersection of software development and financial systems, creating tools and mechanisms that address real customer challenges. Your solutions will empower teams across transportation finance to work more efficiently, make data-driven decisions faster, and adopt new features with confidence. This is an opportunity to make a tangible impact on systems that process financial data at Amazon's scale while growing your technical expertise in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop, and implement well-organized, maintainable code using optimal data structures and algorithms, ensuring solutions are correct, scalable, and customer-focused.
- Troubleshoot and resolve system and software issues by diagnosing root causes, assessing urgency, and mitigating impact while applying available tools and resources effectively.
- Collaborate across teams to define requirements, negotiate priorities, and deliver technical solutions that meet business needs — regularly making trade-offs between time, quality, and resources.
- Identify and optimize operational procedures and best practices, contributing to the long-term reliability and performance of systems and services your team owns.
- Evaluate when and how to integrate generative artificial intelligence tools into workflows, refining outputs and applying responsible practices to improve productivity and solution quality.

A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing code changes and participating in technical discussions with your team. From there, you might spend time writing and testing new features, debugging a production issue, or pairing with a teammate on a design review. You will regularly communicate progress and risks to stakeholders, ask productive questions to clarify requirements, and document your work clearly. Expect to mentor teammates, contribute to peer code reviews, and propose improvements to how your team builds and operates its systems.

About the team
The Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) team plays a crucial role in Amazon's logistics ecosystem, building and maintaining the financial systems that power our global transportation network. We're a collaborative team of engineers and analysts who value creative problem-solving and continuous learning. We foster an environment where curiosity thrives and knowledge-sharing is part of our daily routine. Whether you're automating complex workflows, generating insights from financial data, or building customer-facing features, you'll have opportunities to grow your skills and make meaningful contributions. Join us in shaping the future of transportation finance at Amazon.

descriptionHtml:
Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. The Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) team are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all the robotics and material handling equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role:
The Automation Engineering Apprentice(ship) (AEA) will learn to focus on equipment troubleshooting and maintaining material handling equipment (MHE) such as conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply labeling systems, scales, HMI systems, and control cabinets. During on-the-job learning (OJL) you will work with complex high-performance manufacturing systems and will learn to analyze, troubleshoot, and repair systems to maintain process efficiency. The focus of this role is to learn the skills and abilities to ensure safety regulations and policies are adhered to, assist in the installation, maintenance, and repair of the automated packaging and distribution equipment, ensure preventative maintenance is conducted on time to a high standard, and provide high levels of equipment availability through continuous improvement.

Amazon AEA apprentices are engaged in the assembly and maintenance of complex machines, plants, and systems in the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering sector or in organizations which purchase and operate such mechatronic systems. Apprentices are paired with journey workers to carry out their work at various facilities, including high automation and robotics facilities in connection with service operations. They are expected to work based on technical documents and instructions and carry out their work in compliance with the relevant provisions and safety regulations.

The successful candidate is an effective communicator, works well in a team, and is self-motivated. They should have the ability to work collaboratively and coordinate their activities with upstream and downstream operations partners. In addition to developing your skills, you will be mentored by senior technicians to grow in your role.

What Do We Offer?
Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there’s more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

You will conduct preventative/corrective maintenance and basic troubleshooting of robotics and robotic work cells
You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all material handling equipment components
You will maintain and troubleshoot motors, photo eyes, relays, proximity sensors, solenoids, motor starters, tachs, etc.
You will assist with basic electronics/Programmable Logic Controllers troubleshooting
You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Amazon RME (BB/3P) Mechatronics & Robotics Technician (MRT) experience
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- High School diploma, or equivalent
- Knowledge of basic mathematics
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Can commute to the specified work site
- Can commit to a 2-year onsite apprenticeship following a 12-week training period
- Can complete a 12-week training program at a designated training provider

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in the electrical field, or experience in the mechanical or controls field
- Experience with PLC (Programmable Logic Controller)-controlled automation and issue diagnosis in a continuous process or production environment
- Experience with robotics work cells and their control systems
- Experience with Ladder Logic and structure programming from Siemens, Allen-Bradley, or Codesys PLCs (Programmable Logic Controllers)

title: Pre-Construction Manager, D&C
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Global Engineering Services (GES) North America Design & Construction team is seeking a Preconstruction Manager to serve as Amazon's owner's representative during the preconstruction phase of facility delivery. In this role, you will independently manage difficult, cross-functional industrial preconstruction projects — from site selection and validation through design management, permitting, and contract execution — for new builds, retrofits, expansions, and program initiatives across your assigned region.
You will partner with internal teams — including Real Estate, Design Engineering, Finance, and Construction — and external stakeholders — including architects, engineers, developers, landlords, and permitting agencies — to establish scope, budget, and schedule, and to ensure timely receipt of building and site permits. You are accountable for a clean, well-defined handoff to the Construction Manager, and you remain a key support resource for the construction team throughout the project lifecycle.
Projects include fulfillment centers, sortation centers, delivery stations, and auxiliary buildings supporting Amazon's logistics network, ranging from targeted renovations to large-scale new facility builds. This role combines construction engineering, planning, project management, real estate development, multi-disciplinary design management, and contract management.
This role requires 60% regional travel and availability to work from a corporate office when not traveling. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Relocation assistance may be provided.


Key job responsibilities
• Independently manage difficult, cross-functional industrial pre-construction projects from site selection through design completion, permitting, and contract execution
• Work with internal and external stakeholders — including Real Estate, Design Engineering, Entitlements, Construction, Finance, Launch/Startup, architects, engineers, permitting agencies, developers, and landlords — to secure resources, scope infrastructure builds, set priorities and milestones, and drive delivery to meet deadlines
• Lead site selection and validation, scope development, and design management — coordinating with design teams to develop site plans and composite floor plans in compliance with Amazon's design standards and operational requirements
• Manage multiple concurrent large industrial projects across various locations simultaneously
• Perform conceptual estimating and pricing reviews for scope inclusions and exclusions; negotiate the cost of work with developers, general contractors, and design consultants
• Own comprehensive budget tracking, schedule management, and cashflow forecasting across assigned projects
• Manage vendor procurement and oversee professional service providers, ensuring their skills and competencies meet the requirements for entitling properties and projects
• Coordinate with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) for permitting, regulatory compliance, and approvals; understand zoning, planning, fire code, and building code requirements
• Review and analyze design and construction contracts, related exhibits, and lease agreements; provide detailed analysis of technical matters and site-specific deal structures and terms
• Review additional reports including noise and traffic studies and environmental assessments
• Partner with the Transaction team and developers to optimize schedule and strategy for entitlements and long-lead procurement
• Keep scope under control and accelerate progress by driving crisp, timely decisions, identifying and clearing blockers, and escalating appropriately
• Prepare and present project status and risk reports; translate technical documents and information into clear, concise narratives for leadership and customers
• Identify and resolve upstream issues proactively to support a clean hand off to the Construction Manager; remain a support resource for the construction team throughout the project lifecycle
• Champion Amazon's safety programs and standards across all internal and external project teams during the pre-construction phase
• Optimize pre-construction processes and implement improvements in procedures and playbooks to improve project efficiency and delivery
• Seek sustainable, environmentally responsible solutions throughout the pre-construction process in alignment with Amazon's building practices


A day in the life
Each day, you represent GES NA Design & Construction as Amazon's owner during the preconstruction phase — navigating uncertainty, proactively unblocking project barriers, and influencing the best project decisions. Your day may include:
• Coordinating with architects, engineers, and design consultants on design document development, scope changes, and project status
• Reviewing site plans, composite floor plans, and design documents for compliance with Amazon's standards and operational requirements
• Negotiating contract terms with developers, contractors, and consultants while driving adherence to schedules and budgets
• Coordinating with AHJ on permitting status, zoning, fire code, and building code requirements
• Preparing and presenting project status and risk reports for leadership
• Partnering with Real Estate and Transaction teams on entitlement strategy and long-lead procurement
• Updating Amazon's project management systems with current budget, schedule, and status information
• Supporting the Construction Manager on active construction projects with pre-construction expertise


About the team
At Amazon, we are all owners and leverage unique opportunities presented to us by owning everything from the design review, permitting to construction bidding and consultant during construction execution prior to final hand-off to our internal stakeholder. We are a diverse, upbeat, creative, team of designers, engineers and managers working daily to develop innovative sustainable facilities and efficient innovative buildings for our customers. We focus on Delivering Results, our speed for Bias for Action and Insisting on the Highest Standards for our customers.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field
- Experience of automated equipment including packaging machinery, sortation and conveyor systems
- Travel up to 25% of the time
- 5+ years of experience as an Architect, Engineer, Construction Manager, Development Manager, Owner's Project Management Representative, or in a related commercial development or construction discipline
- 5+ years of project management experience spanning design phase through implementation and operation, including negotiating construction, procurement, and labor contracts

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Structural, Civil, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering
- Experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including colleagues and leadership, or experience in profee auditing, coding, and documentation requirements
- PMP certificate, or CMA
- Experience operating across at least two disciplines within the construction industry (e.g., General Contracting, Owner's Representation, Commercial Development, Engineering & Design, or Owner's Project Management)
- • Demonstrated capability in planning, design review, implementation, and project management/control of new structures and enhancement of existing facilities
- Experience managing multi-disciplinary design incorporating industrial automation, robotics, or similar
- Knowledge of Building Information Modeling (BIM)

title: Systems Security Development Engineer, US ADC Security
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Security team is looking for a Systems Security Development Engineer to design, build, and integrate security automation and tooling for a U.S. Government program delivering a classified AI Factory on a fully air-gapped platform. This is not a traditional cloud environment; there is no AWS control plane, no internet connectivity, and no existing security automation to inherit. You will engineer the systems that integrate security controls into the platform build, including hardening automation, configuration management, log pipeline engineering, and security tool integration across a multi-vendor COTS stack (Kubernetes, ONTAP, NVIDIA, Cisco, Thales). You will work hands-on with infrastructure engineers to ensure security is built into the platform from day one, not bolted on after delivery.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.


Key job responsibilities
• Engineer security automation for platform hardening, STIG application, and configuration enforcement.
• Build and maintain log pipelines and telemetry collection for the air-gapped SIEM.
• Integrate security tooling (endpoint protection, vulnerability scanning, detection) into the platform stack.
• Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code for security components.
• Support security control implementation and evidence generation for RMF authorization.
• Partner with platform engineering to integrate identity, secrets management, and crypto services.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals (networking, storage, operating systems)
- 3+ years of systems engineering, systems development, or DevSecOps experience.
- Hands-on experience with Linux systems administration, automation (Ansible, Terraform, or equivalent), and scripting (Python, Bash).
- Experience integrating security tooling into infrastructure (SIEM, endpoint, vulnerability scanning).
- Understanding of Kubernetes, containerized workloads, and infrastructure-as-code.
- Current, active US Government Security Clearance of TS/SCI with Polygraph

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in an Agile environment using the Scrum methodology
- Experience in air-gapped, classified, or disconnected environments.
- Familiarity with STIG application, CIS benchmarks, and hardening automation.
- Experience with multi-vendor COTS integration (storage, networking, compute).
- Security certification (e.g., Security+, CySA+, RHCSA)."

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon MQ
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 7, 2026

Amazon MQ is a managed AWS service for Apache ActiveMQ and RabbitMQ that streamlines setup, operation, and management of message brokers on AWS. Every day we make it easier for developers to build applications that use the rich features and power of open-source message brokers. We partner with the maintainers of the RabbitMQ and Apache ActiveMQ open source projects to continually evolve and improve the projects with new features and optimizations.

This position is to provide development support for RabbitMQ. In this role you will spend the majority of your time writing open source software in Erlang.

Key job responsibilities
As a Software Development Engineer with Amazon MQ, you will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and deploying distributed open-source message broker systems and large-scale solutions for our world-wide customer base. In this, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional peers and open source project maintainers to influence our overall strategy and define the team’s roadmap. You will drive the system architecture, spearhead best practices that enable a quality product, and help coach and develop junior engineers. A successful candidate will have an established background in engineering large scale software systems, a strong technical ability, great communication skills, and a motivation to achieve results in a fast-paced environment.

title: Tech Lead Embedded Eng, Annapurna Labs
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for experienced Embedded Software Engineers to join our growing Israel-based teams in Tel Aviv and Haifa.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop, and optimize embedded software (firmware, device drivers, bare-metal and RTOS applications) for Annapurna Labs' next-generation custom hardware.

- Work at the hardware-software boundary — bring up new silicon, develop low-level drivers, and enable high-performance data paths that serve millions of AWS customers.

- Collaborate with hardware engineers, architects, and cross-functional teams to define system-level requirements and translate them into robust, production-quality code.

- Drive technical decisions on architecture, performance tuning, and system design for latency-sensitive, high-throughput embedded platforms.

- Continuously raise the bar on code quality, testing, and operational excellence in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment.

A day in the life
Why Annapurna Labs?

- **Impact at Scale** — Your code will run on the infrastructure behind AWS, serving millions of customers worldwide.

- **Cutting-Edge Technology** — Work on custom silicon (Graviton, Nitro, Inferentia, Trainium) at the intersection of hardware and software.

- **Growth & Innovation** — Benefit from AWS's resources, mentorship programs, and opportunities to publish and present your work.

- **Dynamic Culture** — A fast-paced, open, and collaborative engineering environment rooted in Amazon's Leadership Principles.

Basic qualifications

- B.Sc. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
- 5+ years of professional experience in embedded software development.
- Strong proficiency in **C** (and/or C++) with deep understanding of low-level systems programming.
- Hands-on experience developing firmware, device drivers, or bare-metal / RTOS applications for embedded systems, including direct hardware interaction.
- Solid understanding of computer architecture fundamentals (memory hierarchy, caches, interrupts, DMA, bus protocols).

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with HW/SW interfaces at both the board and chip level.
- Knowledge of SoC development lifecycle — silicon bring-up, validation, and productization.
- Experience with Linux kernel development (kernel modules, device drivers, subsystems).
- Familiarity with networking protocols and data-path development (Ethernet, TCP/IP, RDMA, DPDK).
- Exposure to hardware/software co-design, performance profiling, and optimization.
- Experience with cloud infrastructure or large-scale distributed systems.
- Track record of technical leadership, cross-team collaboration, and mentoring

descriptionHtml:

The Delivery Partner Manager (DPM) is an equal parts advisor and operating partner to Delivery Service Partners (DSP’s) in Spain. Amazon’s team of Delivery Partners assist and guide DSP business owners as they build and grow successful last mile package delivery businesses within Amazon Logistics (AMZL). The DPM will help kick start a net new business as well as being the reference for expected excellence our partners strive towards. They will partner, guide and advise on how to improve the businesses. The DPM will work alongside regional On The Road (OTR) Managers in areas of dual purpose related to transition of responsibility of execution of planning and DSP capability.

The DPM facilitates value-creation opportunities and manages the DSP relationship across the entire lifecycle of the business, from company launch to business growth. They focus on DSP sentiment, compliance, performance and reliable capacity. As trusted advisors, DPM work alongside DSPs to help solve their biggest challenges at a programmatic level; influence their business planning and strategy; and look around corners to identify obstacles and recommend solutions, ensuring DSP owners make effective business decisions and are set up for success, whilst working to deliver quality.

The DPMs will collaborate with a portfolio of owners at different stages as they set strategy, help drive accountability and engagement, and motivate and develop key performance metrics. They will collaborate frequently with a wide array of integrated internal stakeholders such as Partner Relations (PAR), Value Added Service (VAS), Legal, Fleet and Network Health to name a few. The Delivery Partner Managers support owners by removing obstacles and improving financial, operational, and safety practices at the network level. They facilitate and execute Monitoring and Enforcement Policies (MEP) and build two-way feedback channels with OTR teams, DSPs and WW/EU Product and strategy.

You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

title: Senior Manager, Software Development, Ads Performance Measurement
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is continuing to invest in the measurement of its ads products in order to tap into the growing digital advertising marketplace. Amazon Ads' Measurement, AdTech and Data Science (MADS) team is looking for an experienced Senior Manager, Software Development to lead engineering teams building our Performance Measurement systems.

You will own engineering teams responsible for how advertisers measure the performance of their ad campaigns, combining deterministic approaches with modeled approaches to deliver a complete and trustworthy view of advertising outcomes across channels, devices, and the full customer journey.

This role is at the intersection of big data systems engineering, applied science, and advertiser-facing product delivery. You will lead 30-50 engineers across multiple teams, owning petabyte-scale data pipelines that process billions of events daily, real-time and batch attribution systems, experimentation infrastructure (randomized controlled trials at scale), and privacy-preserving measurement architectures. Your systems directly inform how advertisers allocate billions in ad spend.

You think big, have a bias for action, and bring a history of delivering results in complex distributed systems environments. You thrive in ambiguity and are ready to scale advertising measurement. You are equally comfortable diving deep into system architecture as you are setting multi-year technical strategy with senior leadership.

The right candidate will possess a strong engineering leadership background, will have demonstrated experience building and operating large-scale data and ads systems, and will have a well-rounded understanding of advertising, causal inference, and privacy-constrained computation. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an entrepreneurial environment, and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. This means you are not only able to develop and drive high-level technical strategy, but can also roll up your sleeves, dive deep into system designs, and unblock your teams when it matters.

You set technical direction, define system architectures, partner deeply with scientists to translate research into production-grade systems, and build engineering organizations that deliver at high velocity. You will work directly with product managers, scientists, and cross-functional teams to define solutions that balance measurement precision with system latency, privacy constraints, and advertiser trust. You drive prioritization, make build-vs-buy decisions, own operational excellence for mission-critical systems, and develop engineering talent across multiple locations.

You will also drive AI-native development practices across your organization, leveraging agentic AI tooling to accelerate engineering velocity, automate operational workflows, and fundamentally rethink how measurement systems are built and maintained. We expect leaders in this role to be hands-on adopters who push their teams toward AI-augmented development as the default.

- Experience managing multiple concurrent programs, projects and development teams in an Agile environment

title: Design Systems Designer, Amazon Health
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon Health Services, we're building a unified design system that powers consistent, high-quality experiences across our clinical and consumer products — including a growing suite of AI-powered interfaces. We're looking for a Design Systems Designer who brings strong visual design craft, systems thinking, and curiosity about AI-forward design to help scale our component library, define visual patterns, and build the infrastructure that enables dozens of product designers to move faster with higher fidelity.



This is an opportunity to shape the foundational design language for AHS — working on components, tokens, interaction patterns, motion standards, AI interaction patterns, and accessibility guidelines that directly impact every product surface our customers touch. As AI capabilities expand across our products, you'll help define how AI-driven experiences look, move, and behave within the system — ensuring they feel cohesive and trustworthy. You'll also bring AI into the design systems workflow itself: leveraging AI tools to accelerate component creation, automate documentation, explore variant generation, and streamline design-to-code handoff. You'll partner with designers, engineers, and AI/ML teams to ensure what we build is beautiful, usable, and scalable.


Key job responsibilities
Design and maintain scalable UI components, patterns, and guidelines within the AHS design system

Define and evolve visual tokens (color, typography, spacing, elevation, motion) that ensure consistency across products

Audit product surfaces for system adherence and identify opportunities for new or improved patterns

Create detailed component specs including states, responsive behavior, accessibility requirements, and usage guidance

Define and document design patterns for AI-driven experiences (generative UI, conversational interfaces, AI-assisted workflows) within the system

Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure coded components match design intent

Identify and implement AI-powered workflows that accelerate design systems operations — variant generation, automated specs, documentation, and design-to-code handoff

Contribute to design system documentation, making it easy for other designers to adopt and contribute

Participate in design critiques and system reviews, providing feedback grounded in systematic thinking

A day in the life
As a Design Systems Designer at AHS, you might start your morning using AI tooling to generate component variant explorations that would have taken hours manually — then refining the best options with your craft eye. After standup with the systems team, you'll spend focused time in Figma evolving a component's visual states, leveraging AI-assisted prototyping to test responsive behavior across breakpoints. In the afternoon you'll partner with an engineer to review a coded implementation against your spec — possibly using a design-to-code pipeline to bridge the gap — then collaborate with design and tech teams to define patterns for a new UI surface. You'll contribute to automated documentation workflows and end the day exploring visual directions for an upcoming token update — balancing craft with systematic rigor and a bias toward experimentation.

About the team
You'll join the AHS Design Systems team within the Amazon Health Services organization — a small, focused group building the foundational layer that enables all of our product designers to do their best work. We're actively integrating AI into our own workflows — from component generation to documentation to code handoff — and we want people who are excited to push that forward. You'll work alongside teammates in Seattle, San Francisco, and Boston, partnering closely with product designers, front-end engineers, and accessibility specialists. We value craft, experimentation, and supporting each other's growth.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of design experience
- Have an available online portfolio
- Experience working in a collaborative team environment to deliver high-quality design solutions
- Portfolio demonstrating strong visual design skills and systematic design thinking — showing how individual components connect to a larger system
- Experience building and maintaining design systems, pattern libraries, or component libraries
- Understanding of how design decisions translate to code
- Strong eye for typography, color, spacing, and visual hierarchy
- Active use of or strong curiosity about AI tools to accelerate design systems work — component generation, variant exploration, automated documentation, design-to-code pipelines

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of mobile and web design patterns and accessibility standards
- Experience with motion design
- Experience building or contributing to a production design system used by multiple product teams
- Experience designing patterns for AI/ML interfaces — generative UI, conversational experiences, or AI-assisted workflows
- Familiarity with AI tooling for design workflows (generative AI for exploration, prototyping automation, design-to-code pipelines)

title: Advanced Materials Engineer, Global Materials Science
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon's Global Sustainable Packaging (GSP) organization as we pioneer the future of sustainable e-commerce packaging. As an Advanced Packaging Materials Engineer based in the EU, you'll serve as the critical link between our European and North American materials science operations—driving paper-based materials development tailored to the EU supplier base while harmonizing global materials strategies across regions. Embedded alongside our automation hardware development teams, you'll ensure that packaging materials and automation systems are co-developed for seamless integration.

This is a hands-on, technically broad role spanning pulp and paper manufacturing, packaging converting operations, paper-based materials for manual and automatic packaging, and packaging automation equipment. You'll conduct laboratory research, characterize materials properties, establish specifications, and work directly with EU-based suppliers to bring novel materials from concept to production—while serving as the conduit to align materials globally, simplify where possible, and solve for region-specific requirements driven by regulation, material supply availability, and operational differences.



Key job responsibilities
Materials Development & Innovation:
- Lead laboratory research and development of paper-based packaging materials for manual and automatic packaging, with deep understanding of pulp and paper manufacturing processes and converting operations.
- Design and execute experiments to optimize material formulations and processing parameters, applying the materials science triangle framework (processing-structure-properties) across the full range of paper-based packaging materials and converting processes.
- Develop next-generation materials solutions that unlock step-change improvements in performance, cost, sustainability, and automation compatibility—with specific focus on EU supplier capabilities and regional material availability.
- Advance materials innovations from concept, pilot, and deployment phases, ensuring solutions are compatible with EU packaging automation hardware and converting equipment.
- Evaluate and develop paper-based material systems that meet the unique performance demands of automated packaging lines, considering substrate interactions, machine speed requirements, and environmental conditions.

EU Materials Strategy & Global Alignment
- Serve as the primary conduit between EU and NA materials science teams, driving global alignment on materials specifications while identifying opportunities to harmonize and simplify across regions.
- Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of the EU supplier base—including paper mills, converters, and coating suppliers—and how it differs from the North American supply landscape.
- Identify region-specific materials requirements dictated by EU regulations (e.g., REACH, EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation, CEFLEX), regional material supply constraints, and operational differences in EU fulfillment networks.
- Balance global standardization with regional customization—driving simplification where materials can be harmonized and developing tailored solutions where regional requirements demand differentiation.
- Build and maintain a materials roadmap for EU that aligns with global GSP strategy and EU automation hardware development timelines.

Automation Hardware Integration
- Work closely with EU-based automation hardware development teams to ensure paper-based packaging materials are co-developed with automation equipment, optimizing for machine runnability, reliability, and throughput.
- Provide materials expertise during automation system design, commissioning, and optimization—translating materials properties into actionable equipment parameters.
- Develop deep understanding of packaging converting equipment (folders, gluers, sealers, labelers) and how paper-based materials properties influence machine performance at production speeds.
- Support troubleshooting of materials-related automation failures, conducting root cause analysis that spans materials properties, converting conditions, and equipment settings.

Materials Characterization & Testing
- Perform and direct lab engineers to conduct comprehensive materials characterization of physical, structural, strength, resistance, surface, optical, barrier, and recyclability properties while utilizing standards and non-standard methodologies.
- Establish correlations between fundamental materials properties and operational performance in fulfillment environments, with emphasis on how EU-specific substrates and converting conditions affect outcomes.
- Design and execute test plans that validate materials performance against specifications and requirements for both manual and automated packaging operations.
- Analyze test data using statistical methods to drive data-driven materials selection decisions across the EU supplier base.

Specifications & Quality
- Define materials specifications based on critical performance thresholds required for packaging to protect products and survive the fulfillment network, accounting for EU-specific substrate variability and supplier capabilities.
- Translate operational requirements and automation equipment constraints into measurable materials properties and acceptable ranges.
- Develop quality control protocols and testing methodologies to ensure EU supplier compliance with specifications, accounting for differences in regional testing standards.
- Drive specification harmonization between NA and EU where feasible, clearly documenting where and why regional deviations are necessary.

Supplier & Manufacturing Collaboration
- Work directly with EU-based paper mills, converters, and other suppliers to develop and scale new paper-based packaging materials.
Conduct technical evaluations of EU supplier capabilities, pulp and paper manufacturing processes, converting operations, and quality control systems.
- Guide suppliers on process optimization—from pulp preparation and paper machine settings through converting and finishing operations—to achieve target material properties and consistency.
- Build strong technical relationships across the EU supplier base to enable rapid development cycles and ensure supply resilience.

Cross-Functional Partnership
- Collaborate with Packaging Design and automation hardware teams on materials-design-equipment integration, ensuring all three dimensions are optimized together.
- Partner with EU and Global Procurement (GPO) on strategic sourcing, supplier selection, and commercial negotiations within the EU supply base.
- Support sustainability initiatives including carbon footprint modeling, recyclability assessment, and compliance with EU-specific sustainability regulations and reporting requirements (REACH, EU PPWR, CEFLEX).
- Provide technical expertise to program managers, product teams, and deployment teams across both EU and NA organizations.
- Communicate complex materials science and manufacturing concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences across multiple geographies and cultures.

Documentation & Knowledge Sharing
- Author technical reports, test protocols, specifications documents, and research summaries that serve both EU and global audiences.
- Document experimental procedures, results, and learnings to build institutional knowledge, with particular emphasis on EU-NA materials differences and lessons learned.
- Present findings at design reviews, technical workshops, and leadership reviews across regions.
- Contribute to intellectual property generation through public disclosures and patent applications.
- Mentor junior engineers and technicians on materials science principles, pulp and paper manufacturing fundamentals, converting operations, and testing methodologies.


A day in the life
You're bridging continents and disciplines, ensuring Amazon's paper-based packaging materials work seamlessly from lab bench to automated packaging line.
Your morning starts with a technical review alongside the EU automation hardware team, discussing runnability data from a new paper substrate on their latest packaging machine prototype. The converting parameters need adjustment, your deep knowledge of fiber orientation, surface chemistry, and machine dynamics helps the team identify the right combination of material properties and equipment settings for optimal performance.
By midday, you're on a call with a European paper mill, discussing modifications to their pulp furnish and machine settings to improve tensile energy absorption, a critical property for automated forming operations. You're also comparing their capabilities against what your NA colleagues are achieving with North American suppliers, identifying where specifications can be unified.
Your afternoon shifts to lab work, where you are directing a lab engineer to characterize a new paper-based material system for high-speed automated packaging on recycled substrates and a global alignment session with your NA counterparts. You're presenting a proposal to harmonize material specifications across regions, having identified that three separate specs can be consolidated into one without compromising performance in either geography.
Where regulatory or supply differences demand regional solutions, you've clearly documented the rationale and developed parallel qualification paths.

This role sits at the intersection of materials science, manufacturing processes, automation engineering, and global supply chain strategy. Your holistic understanding of how pulp becomes paper, how paper becomes packaging, and how packaging runs through automated systems makes you uniquely positioned to solve problems that span traditional disciplinary boundaries, all while keeping EU and NA aligned on a simplified, high-performing materials portfolio.


About the team
The Global Materials Science (GMS) organization is Amazon's Center of Excellence for packaging materials development and supply chain transformation. Our team represents a fundamental shift in how Amazon approaches packaging innovation—moving from supplier-dependent solutions to owning the invention, development, and optimization of materials that power our fulfillment network.

Our Mission: We build deep expertise in packaging materials through rigorous research and testing, develop innovative packaging solutions that unlock automation potential and sustainability improvements, and establish robust supply chains that deliver superior solutions at lower cost.

Our Vision: To be the global leader in e-commerce packaging materials science and innovation, enabling the best customer packaging experience at the lowest cost to serve.

What Makes Us Unique: We're not just specifying materials—we're fundamentally understanding them through the materials science triangle framework (processing, structure, properties). Our integrated capabilities span from molecular-level materials characterization, to full packaging system testing, to automation compatibility testing. This end-to-end ownership enables us to innovate faster, unlock step-change improvements impossible for suppliers alone, and maintain freedom to operate across multiple supply chains.

Our Impact: We're driving Amazon's transition from plastic to paper packaging, developing breakthrough materials and establishing supply chains that reduce costs while advancing our 2040 net-zero commitment. Our work directly influences automation success, customer experience, and sustainability metrics.

Our Culture: We operate with high technical rigor while moving at startup speed. We embrace calculated risk-taking in R&D, fail fast, and iterate based on data. We believe in radical collaboration—our success requires seamless partnership across engineering, procurement, operations, and sustainability teams. We're building something that's never been done before in e-commerce, and we're looking for engineers who thrive in ambiguity, think globally while executing locally, and are energized by complex, high-impact challenges.

Our Team: We bring together materials scientists, chemists, engineers, and program managers who are passionate about solving hard problems. We partner with world-class academic institutions, leading materials suppliers, and internal Amazon teams to push the boundaries of what's possible in packaging materials. Our EU presence ensures we're co-located with automation development and deeply embedded in the European supplier ecosystem

- Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product design from concept to production
- Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
- Experience with materials selection, testing, and scaling to manufacturing
- Bachelor's degree in materials science engineering, chemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, pulp/paper engineering or a related technical discipline

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or higher in materials science engineering, chemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, pulp/paper engineering or a related technical discipline
- Engineering experience in pulp, paper, packaging or related field
- Experience in characterization of physical, structural, strength, resistance, surface, optical, barrier, and recyclability properties with standard (ASTM, TAPPI, ISO, EN, ISTA, CEPI) and non-standard methodologies
- Laboratory management experience

title: Principal, International CX, Amazon Customer Service
descriptionHtml:
Come build the future of international customer experience with us. CXI's vision is to ensure every one of them — regardless of where they shop, what language they speak, or whether they ever contact us — gets an experience worthy of Amazon's promise. You will dig deep into customer friction across all of Amazon's international stores — EU, India, MENA, LATAM, AU/ZA, and emerging markets — trace it back to its source, and drive upstream and downstream product improvements to improve CX. You will force-multiply the work of CXI's regional teams by building the frameworks, mental models, and measurement approaches they need to solve CX problems at scale — and influencing across organizations and senior leadership to drive systemic, durable change for international customers.

• Improve customer experience by proactively identifying and eliminating sources of friction across all international stores
