• Author product strategy documents that drive alignment and investment decisions at VP and SVP level
• Define and own the metrics framework for international CX — including developing new measurement approaches that capture customer harm beyond traditional contact-based metrics, and that quantify the impact of policy and enforcement decisions on genuine customers

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. title: Software Development Engineer, Generative AI, Annapurna Labs - Neuroboros Team
descriptionHtml:
You will join a dynamic team working at the cutting edge of the GenAI revolution by applying AI to AI. You will work on building agents, tools, and models to simplify and accelerate customer adoption of Neuron, the software stack supporting Amazon's Machine Learning silicon: Trainium. Partnering with external and internal customers, you will identify key obstacles and opportunities to accelerate their migration to AWS's ML silicon. You will be a key contributor driving impact by building AI agents and tools that simplify Amazon Neuron adoption, which is critical to Amazon's Generative AI business.

Key job responsibilities
This role requires collaborating with other Neuron Software teams, Science, AWS AI Services, external partners and customers with a potential high impact on Amazon's top and bottom line. As a member of the team applying Generative AI to accelerate Neuron adoption, you will play a key role in shaping this space with the following technical responsibilities:

* Research implementations that deliver the best possible experiences for customers.
* Deliver on goals to improve the time and effort it takes to port and optimize Machine Learning workloads on Neuron.
* Build and operate agentic evaluation frameworks, monitoring, and feedback loops that ensure the correctness, reliability, and continuous improvement of AI agents
* Design, implement, test, deploy and maintain innovative software solutions to transform service performance, durability, cost, and security.
* Build high-quality, highly available, always-on products.
* Potentially contribute intellectual property through patents



About the team
We pursue the ambitious goal of leveraging and expanding Generative AI technologies to help customers benefit from the scale and price/performance equation offered by Amazon Machine Learning hardware. The creation of the team in NYC is key to Annapurna Labs’ location strategy, with the goal of creating an additional hub attracting top talent with varied backgrounds to work on challenging problems, using and building state-of-the-art tooling.

Amazon Annapurna Labs team (our organization within AWS UC) is responsible for building innovation in silicon and software for our Amazon customers. We are at the forefront of innovation by combining cloud scale with the world’s most talented engineers. Our team covers multiple disciplines including silicon engineering, hardware design, software and operations. Because of our team’s breadth of talent, we have been able to improve AWS cloud infrastructure in high-performance machine learning with Neuron, Inferentia and Trainium ML chips, in networking and security with products such as Nitro, Enhanced Network Adapter (ENA), and Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA), and in computing with Graviton and F1 EC2 instances.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- 3+ years of relevant, broad engineering experience.
- Computer Science core: object-oriented design, data structures, and performance analysis with at least 2 programming languages.
- Hands-on technical experience working in the Generative AI space
- Knowledge of professional software engineering practices & best practices for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations.
- Experience in one or more of the following areas: ML compilers, production coding agents, GenAI model architecture, model training, neural network optimization, or alternatively applied math.
- Passion for customer experience and usability, including successful delivery of customer self-service tools and automated management/optimization of services, and a strong services orientation

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or equivalent
- 2+ years in machine learning or other computational modeling environments with an emphasis on hosting, building or optimizing models for diverse hardware platforms
- Proven track record in building AI agents that automate ML workload optimization, ML compiler tuning, distributed inference and training, or ML kernel authoring and optimization
- Experience working with open-source software communities in the optimization space or related areas
- Domain-level knowledge of AWS services
- Knowledge of the state-of-the-art technology used in the Machine Learning space and its mathematical underpinning

title: Applied Scientist, Amazon Transportation Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s Middle Mile transportation network runs on physical assets and operations that generate an enormous volume of imagery and video. The Network Engineering, Scheduling, Technology (NEST) Science team within the Amazon Transportation Services organization is looking for an Applied Scientist with deep Computer Vision (CV) expertise and the versatility to apply machine learning broadly, to help turn that visual data into automated, operational decisions, spanning asset condition, automated inspection, object and component detection, and other visual understanding problems across the network.

In this role, you will develop, train, and productionize computer vision models across a portfolio of high-impact use cases and business challenges, owning the scientific approach from problem formulation through production. You will work closely with other scientists, business owners, and engineering teams to advance modeling approaches, design rigorous experiments to validate them, and launch them to production. This is a hands-on applied science role with a broad scope and direct, measurable business impact.


Key job responsibilities
-Develop and apply visual perception and representation learning across image and video domains, including recognition, detection, segmentation, and tracking, with deep spatial and temporal reasoning enabled by modern deep learning and foundation-model architectures.
-Own large-scale model training, fine-tuning, and learning from heterogeneous or weakly supervised data, including self-supervised and semi-supervised techniques.
-Tackle real-world CV challenges at scale: large unlabeled datasets, class imbalance, high visual variability, and inconsistent capture conditions (angle, lighting, occlusion, motion blur).
-Partner with product/program, operations, and engineering stakeholders to translate operational problems into well-defined CV objectives with measurable success criteria.
-Design rigorous evaluation frameworks with explicit precision/recall tradeoffs and operating-point selection tied to real-world business cost, including the cost asymmetry between false negatives and false positives.
-Build and maintain custom training and inference pipelines, and partner with engineering teams to deploy models into production.
-Frame ambiguous operational problems from first principles and select the right approach for each, applying CV where it’s the best tool and other machine learning or simpler methods where they are not.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
- Experience developing and implementing deep learning algorithms, particularly with respect to computer vision algorithms
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in professional software development

Preferred qualifications

- Have publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience in designing experiments and statistical analysis of results
- Experience in investigating, designing, prototyping, and delivering new and innovative system solutions
- Experience in transportation or supply chain

title: Senior Startup Investor Manager, AWS, Startup Investor Management
descriptionHtml:
Would you like to shape the future of cloud computing by identifying and working with the most promising early-stage startups and venture capital firms? Do you have the technical depth, business acumen, and investment insight to help establish AWS as the foundation for the next generation of technology companies?

AWS makes the power of cloud computing accessible to all. We give founders everywhere access to the same technology that powers the world's largest companies. The AWS Startups team helps founders prove that their world-changing ideas are possible, at any stage of growth, and any level of funding. This is why more startups, and over 80% of unicorns, choose to launch on AWS.

As a Senior Startup Investor Manager within AWS, you will work with venture capital firms to accelerate portfolio company success. You'll work with key investors to help unlock the potential of their portfolio companies on AWS, enabling faster innovation and scaling. title: Front End Engineer , Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:

You will work with React and Next.js to design, build, and ship features that serve customers worldwide. Many of these experiences are built from zero-to-one, so you will regularly move from ambiguous problem to working product. You will own the full software development lifecycle, collaborating with product, marketing, business, and backend engineering partners to deliver accessible, performant interfaces. If you enjoy working with AI-driven development workflows, picking up new frameworks quickly, and turning complex requirements into clean user experiences, this is the role for you.

title: Liaison Engineer, 1st Shift, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

To deliver on that mission, Amazon is looking for talented candidates who combine superb technical, research and analytical capabilities with a demonstrated ability to get the right things done quickly and effectively.

In this role, you’ll join Leo's Structural Integrity and Analysis team as a Liaison Engineer to innovate and solve engineering issues that arise during Leo production operations leading to every flight of our constellation of satellites. You will be working on the shop floor along side Manufacturing and Quality teams to develop engineering dispositions related to non-conformances. You will work hard, have fun, and make history!

This Liaison Engineer must have Material Review Board (MRB) experience in aerospace programs, and must be able to understand the balance between engineering judgment versus analysis rigor and when each is appropriate.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- This position will work 1st shift, 6:00am-4:30pm, 4 days a week back half Wednesday-Saturday
- Review and disposition non-conformance events of the spacecraft and its ground support equipment that may occur in all phases of the Leo operations: procurement, storage, handling, manufacturing, assembly, testing, transportation, final integration, launch and orbital operations
- Develop standard repairs, rework procedures, propose design for manufacturing (DFM) improvements, improved processes and work instructions
- Conduct root cause investigations and develop corrective actions
- Document static, dynamic and fatigue stress analyses when needed to support dispositions, interpreting established structural analysis reports
- Develop analysis methods to address common non-conformances
- Work with Quality, Manufacturing, and Engineering experts to provide root cause failure analyses
- Interact with internal customers, external customers, and suppliers

A day in the life
This Liaison/MRB Engineer will be providing engineering support to resolve engineering issues that arise during manufacturing and assembly processes, quality inspection and acceptance tests, through the application of engineering and design principles, consulting the engineering development teams as needed.


About the team
The Liaison Engineering team is part of the Leo Structural Integrity and Analysis teams (Structural Analysis, Loads and Dynamics, Materials and Processes and Reliability) that is ultimately responsible for Integrity of not only the spacecraft but all other commodities supporting the program, inside and outside of the Mechanical Engineering group.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of working in mechanical engineering or equivalent experience
- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
- 3+ years of demonstrated experience in a Liaison Engineer / Material Review Board (MRB) role with aircraft, spacecraft, or launch vehicle structures

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in the design of complex mechanical products and equipment at volume
- Strong fundamentals in engineering fundamentals (statics, dynamics, modal, frequency response, random vibration, sine and acoustic analyses/tests)
- Experience with fatigue and fracture analyses
- Knowledge of or experience with spacecraft technology and related primary, secondary and tertiary structures
- Familiarity with Manufacturing Execution System (MES)
- Strong understanding or Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing

title: Engineering Operations Technician , DCEO
descriptionHtml:
This position serves as a technical resource to support Amazon.com within its owned and operated data centers. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels of data center operations.

The Data Center Engineering Operations Technician, Shift Engineer, will be responsible for ensuring the overall operation and maintenance of all electrical, mechanical, and HVAC equipment within the Datacenter. This equipment supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. The Data Center Engineering Operations Technician will continue to maintain high reliability and performance while keeping operating costs in facilities at a minimum, the engineer will drive innovation to reduce operational costs.

The Data Center Shift Engineers are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems that include but not limited to switchgear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

Physical Requirements:

· Walk jobsites in uneven terrain.
· Work at heights and from ladders.
· Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or craw.
· Regularly lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more.
· Carry objects weighing up to 49 pounds for short distances
· Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration.
· Respond to off hour emergency calls.
· Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
· Coordinate body movements when using tools or equipment
· Reach and stretch to position equipment and fixtures while maintaining balance
Responsibilities:

· Supervise contractors who perform servicing or preventive maintenance.

· Assist in performing root cause analysis for operational issues.
· Perform first level trouble-shooting for facility and rack level events.
· Ensure all personnel on site utilize proper safety methodology.
· Work on-call and a rotating schedule when required.
· Take daily operational readings and provide to Senior Engineers for metrics reporting.
· Perform basic support concepts such as ticketing systems, root cause analysis, and task prioritization.


Key job responsibilities
Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability

Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)

Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)

Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA

Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment

Technical writing to support change management program

Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion

On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation

Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.

Role may support more than one location/site.

title: Integration & Deployment Planning & Scheduling Leader, One MHS
descriptionHtml:
OMHS is building the team that installs and commissions Amazon's next-generation material handling systems. We are looking for a planning and scheduling leader to own the integrated master schedule across our full portfolio of concurrent installation programs.

If you have spent your career coordinating large-scale industrial projects, you know that predictable execution starts months before boots hit the ground. This role puts that planning discipline at the center of the deployment lifecycle. You will build and maintain the end-to-end execution plans that align workforce forecasting, installation sequencing, vendor deliverables, and site readiness, ensuring every project hits its milestones without surprises.

You will own deployment planning end-to-end: developing resource-loaded schedules, identifying constraints before they become delays, and driving continuous improvement through scheduling analytics, digital planning platforms, and emerging AI-enabled tools to improve forecast accuracy, schedule reliability, and deployment scalability.

Key job responsibilities
Own integrated deployment schedules aligning labor, vendor deliverables, engineering milestones, and site readiness across multiple concurrent projects.
Develop workforce forecasts based on project scope, installation sequencing, productivity assumptions, and historical performance to ensure proper resourcing.
Build execution plans coordinating engineering deliverables, procurement, permitting, and field activities into a single critical path view.
Translate design packages into labor hour estimates, trade mix, and duration assumptions that drive the master schedule.
Identify levers for resource movement across the portfolio, including crew reallocation, phase overlap, and cross-site labor sharing to recover schedule variance.
Resolve scheduling conflicts between concurrent projects, facilitating trade-off decisions when constraints require priority sequencing.
Quantify schedule risks from labor constraints, vendor performance, permitting delays, or site readiness gaps; develop mitigations and communicate impacts to leadership.
Maintain planning dashboards providing visibility into schedule health, labor forecasts, milestone status, and resource conflicts.
Utilize Primavera P6, digital planning platforms, and AI-enabled forecasting tools to improve accuracy and schedule reliability.
Partner with Site Leaders and Workforce Development to align training output with staffing demand curves.
Lead post-deployment schedule reviews to capture lessons learned and drive continuous improvement.
Develop schedule sensitivity models showing headcount and cost impact of scope changes.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Bachelor's degree in Operations, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or another technical field
- 5+ years of construction or project management experience
- Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
- 5+ years of experience with scheduling tools (Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, or equivalent)

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in engineering, mechanical, operations, supply chain, business administration, or equivalent STEM field
- Experience in Lean Management, Six Sigma and other operations engineer tools
- Experience building launch readiness frameworks, standard work, playbooks, and scalable deployment mechanisms across multiple concurrent sites
- Experience with reporting and Data Visualization tools such as Quick Sight / Tableau / Power BI or other BI packages
- Experience in construction, industrial installation, or large-scale equipment deployment environments

title: Pr Solution Architect, Strategic Accounts
descriptionHtml:
The AWS Strategic Accounts team is committed to helping some of the largest and most complex customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect within the Strategic Accounts segment, you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable & technically capable customers, to design cloud architectures utilising AWS services. As part of this team, you will blend business acumen with technical guidance to effectively engage with Enterprise scale organizations at all stages of cloud adoption, helping them reinvent their businesses using AWS technology, guiding them on their cloud journey.

In this role, you will help our customers solve business challenges such as rapidly releasing products/services to the market or building an elastic, scalable, cost optimized application. You will engage with AWS product owners to influence product direction and help our customers develop their new markets by utilising AWS Services and newly defined architectural approaches.

Through your work with our customers you will define patterns and trends that can be applied across broad industries and segments to help other customers accelerate their innovation.

As a trusted customer advocate, you will help organizations understand and implement advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate and scale existing workloads in the cloud. You will have the opportunity to shape and execute a strategy to build knowledge and broad use of AWS. You will also need to be adept at interacting, communicating and partnering with other teams within AWS such as services teams, marketing, and professional services, as well as representing your team to executive management.

For this role, we are looking for candidates who have technical breadth complimented by technical depth in one or two areas, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Strong communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging our customers at all levels of seniority.

If you are excited about the prospect of using your architecture experience to assist our most valuable customers, tackling challenging problems, have a hand in shaping the future of cloud adoption, enhancing and growing your own skills, and having fun, then we would love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities

Strategic account SAs build long-term customer relationships, getting to know the details of each customer’s environment and business. They offer strong technical guidance and proactively seek to improve the architectural position of the customer.
Lead trusted relationships with the C-suite (CIO, CTO, CISO, etc.) and Enterprise architects; understand the customer’s technology challenges; dive deep and understand stated, unstated business needs, and challenges.
Own the overall technical relationship between - customers and AWS. Influence leaders on topics such as AI/ML, app modernization, reliability, and operational efficiency, security, cost, and performance.

Working backwards from the customer's business needs, create a holistic technology vision, strategy and practical transformation plan; addressing technology challenges but also increasing business impact, innovation and agility, addressing skills and org challenges.

As a key member of the team, ensure success by formulating, co-authoring and executing a technical and sales strategy to aid the customers adoption of AWS technology.

Advocate for and Influence the AWS technology strategy internally and externally, at industry events, meet-ups, and summits.
Author AWS customer-facing publications such as solutions, blog posts and white-papers.


About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
- Experience in specific technology domain areas like software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics
- Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
- Knowledge of at least one relevant technology domain area (e.g., compute, hardware, network, software, big data, security, etc.)
- Experience developing technology solutions and evangelising end-to-end technology roadmaps that guide IT transformations toward cloud computing
- Experience creating and delivering written and oral communications for technical and non-technical audiences

title: Creative Director, Retail Experience, Device Brand Studio
descriptionHtml:
As the Creative Director for Retail Experience, you are passionate about the retail experience and expert in user experience (UX) design and brand principles. You help create the content strategy for how new products like Echo, Fire TV, Fire Tablets and Kindle come to life, ensuring every touchpoint is intuitive, engaging, and customer-centric.

Working in a cross-functional team environment, you are looked to as the expert for Amazon retail across the voice assistant and smart home categories. You understand the retail landscape, demo and fixture technologies, and translate creative direction to our technology framework while applying UX design methodologies to optimize customer interactions. You develop customer journey maps, and design experiences that reduce friction and delight shoppers at every stage of their in-store discovery process.

This position will play a pivotal role in gathering requirements for all asset needs across channels and devising efficient strategies for the launch of content at scale for our demo devices, digital screens and detail page experiences. You'll leverage UX best practices—including, wireframing, and iterative design—to ensure our retail fixtures and demo experiences are accessible, discoverable, and conversion-optimized.  

As the Creative Director for Retail Experience, you are also responsible for overseeing the end-to-end content creation and upload for Amazon's retail store and demo experiences. This role blends project management expertise with a deep understanding of brand architecture, content strategy, creative vision, and our target audience to deliver innovative and impactful content. You design for retail environments, and validate design decisions through customer feedback and behavioral data.  

You strive to invent and simplify, creating strategies and playbooks that the global retail teams can use to make their everyday jobs easier. Your North Star is creating engaging retail experiences that are quickly recognized by Amazon shoppers globally, while staying true to our brand voice and delivering exceptional user experiences that convert browsers into buyers.

• Clarify project commitments and maintain accountability by leading stakeholder meetings, ensuring UX requirements are prioritized

• Develop comprehensive playbooks incorporating UX design standards, accessibility guidelines, and conversion optimization tactics 

• Stay updated on retail UX design trends, interactive fixture technologies, and customer experience innovation 

• Implement scalable processes maintaining high UX quality standards across channels 

• Champion the offline playbook, incorporating UX research insights into continuous improvement 

• Design navigation flows for digital touchbars that reduce cognitive load and create clear paths to purchase 

• Proven track record of taking Ownership and Delivering Results

title: Procurement Manager, APAC Procurement Excellence Team
descriptionHtml:
アマゾンは、数億種類に渡る商品をお客様へ提供し続けることによって、世界的に認知度が高く、グローバルリーディングカンパニ—としての地位を確立しています。また、“地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業”であり続けるため、日々改善と改革を行っており、それらの業務へ貢献できる経験豊富な人材を求めています。

グローバル調達事業部 アジアパシフィック調達本部 （英語名称: APAC Procurement）は、グローバルの調達組織におけるアジアパシフィックエリアの中核部門として調達プロセスの構築・実行・改善に取り組んでいます。APAC Procurementはグローバル調達事業部 (GPO: Global Procurement Organization) およびアジアパシフィック地区 (APAC: インド、オーストラリア、シンガポール) の調達部門、エンジニアリング部門やオペレーション部門、ファイナンス部門と連携し、「品揃え」「低価格」「利便性」を継続的に向上させることがミッションです。様々な専門分野の調達のプロフェッショナル人材が国境を越えて闊達な議論を行って、最良の調達ソリューションを提案し、数ヶ月後にはそれが実際のコストセービングとなって直接会社そしてお客様に数字で貢献できるところに仕事の面白さと醍醐味があります。
APAC Procurementの主な調達品は、物流拠点のローンチ・オペレーションに必要な搬送機械設備(MHE)・ロボット・棚(Storage)・ファシリティ等の設備や関連工事から、梱包資材、電力やビルメンテナンスといったサービス等の多岐にわたります。さらに、APAC ProcurementではAPACの調達組織と連携したプロジェクトの統括、管理をしています。

Key job responsibilities
Amazon’s Global Procurement Organization (GPO) is seeking a Procurement Manager to drive procurement standardization, governance enhancement, and process improvement across APAC Region. This role is critical to establishing consistent procurement practices, strengthening compliance frameworks, and leading transformative initiatives that optimize how Amazon procures goods and services in the APAC region. The successful candidate will operate at the intersection of strategic procurement leadership and operational excellence, working cross-functionally with internal stakeholders across APAC countries to elevate procurement capabilities and deliver measurable business impact.
1. Procurement Standardization & Governance
Design, implement, and continuously refine procurement standards, policies, and operating procedures for APAC, ensuring alignment with GPO global frameworks. Establish governance mechanisms that drive consistency in sourcing decisions, vendor management, and contract execution across all procurement categories. Develop and maintain compliance frameworks to ensure adherence to internal policies and regulatory requirements, conducting periodic assessments to identify gaps and implementing corrective actions. Lead the creation of standardized templates, decision matrices, and approval workflows that reduce variability and increase auditability in procurement activities.
2. Process Improvement & Optimization
Identify, prioritize, and execute process improvement initiatives that enhance procurement efficiency, reduce cycle times, and deliver cost savings across APAC. Leverage data analytics, cost engineering methodologies, and benchmarking to diagnose process bottlenecks and develop evidence-based solutions. Drive the adoption and localization of global procurement tools and systems, collaborating with digital technology teams to ensure seamless integration with existing APAC workflows. Manage end-to-end project execution for improvement initiatives, from opportunity identification through implementation and benefits realization, ensuring sustainable outcomes that scale across the organization.
3. Cross-functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management
Partner with buyer teams, Finance, Engineering, and Operations departments across APAC countries to align procurement strategies with business objectives and secure buy-in for standardization and improvement initiatives. Report regularly to stakeholders—including GPO management, APAC leadership, —in both Japanese and English, through written documentation and verbal presentations, to maintain visibility and secure appropriate support. Navigate complex organizational dynamics under uncertain and ambiguous conditions, employing stakeholder management and risk management skills to build consensus and drive execution. Travel internationally as needed for direct engagement with APAC counterparts, with primary destinations including India,Australia and NA.
AmazonのGlobal Procurement Organization (GPO) では、APAC地域における調達活動の標準化、ガバナンス強化、およびプロセス改善を推進するProcurement Managerを募集しています。本ポジションは、APAC各国の調達活動に一貫した基準を確立し、コンプライアンスフレームワークを強化し、調達のあり方を最適化する変革的なイニシアチブをリードすることが求められます。戦略的な調達リーダーシップとオペレーショナルエクセレンスの接点で活動し、APAC地域の社内ステークホルダーとクロスファンクショナルに連携し、調達組織の能力向上と実測可能なビジネスインパクトの創出を担います。
1. 調達標準化・ガバナンス強化
APAC地域における調達基準、ポリシー、業務手順を設計・導入し、GPOグローバルフレームワークとの整合性を確保しながら継続的に改善する。ソーシング判断、ベンダーマネジメント、契約執行における一貫性を担保するガバナンス体制を確立し、全調達カテゴリーにわたり運用する。社内ポリシーおよび規制要件への準拠を確保するコンプライアンスフレームワークを開発・維持し、定期的な評価を通じてギャップを特定し是正措置を実行する。また、調達活動におけるばらつきの低減と監査対応力の向上を目的とした標準テンプレート、意思決定マトリクス、承認ワークフローの構築をリードする。
2. プロセス改善・最適化
APAC地域全体の調達効率向上、リードタイム短縮、コスト削減に寄与するプロセス改善イニシアチブを特定、優先順位付け、実行する。データ分析、コストエンジニアリング手法、ベンチマーキングを活用してプロセス上のボトルネックを診断し、エビデンスに基づいたソリューションを開発する。グローバル調達ツールおよびシステムの導入・ローカライズを推進し、デジタルテクノロジーチームと連携して既存のAPAC各国のワークフローとのシームレスな統合を実現する。機会の特定から導入、効果実現までの改善イニシアチブのエンドツーエンドのプロジェクト実行を管理し、組織全体にスケール可能な持続的成果を確保する。
3. クロスファンクショナル連携・ステークホルダーマネジメント
APAC各国のバイヤーチーム、ファイナンス部門、エンジニアリング部門、オペレーション部門と連携し、調達戦略を事業目標と整合させ、標準化・改善イニシアチブに対する合意を形成する。GPOマネジメント層、APACリーダーシップ、ステークホルダーに対し、日本語・英語両言語で書面および口頭による定期的な報告を行い、プロジェクトの可視性を高め適切な支援を得る。不安定・不確実・複雑・曖昧な状況下でもステークホルダーマネジメントとリスクマネジメントのスキルを駆使し、合意形成と実行を推進する。プロジェクト推進に必要と判断する場合は海外出張を行い、APACメンバーとの直接的なミーティングやワークショップを実施する（主な出張先：インド、オーストラリア、アメリカ）。

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

title: Infrastructure Deployment Engineer, OID , OID
descriptionHtml:
We are looking to hire a highly motivated, best-in-class Infrastructure Deployment Engineer II to join our growing team within Corporate Infrastructure Services. This role serves as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for infrastructure deployment, driving technical solutions for complex, undefined problems with limited guidance. The Infrastructure Deployment Engineer II will design and implement solutions that address multi-faceted networking challenges, influence technical decisions across teams, and act as an escalation point for domain-specific issues.

Our ideal candidate possesses deep technical expertise at a CCNP level (or equivalent demonstrated experience) in advanced routing protocols, network design principles, and sophisticated troubleshooting methodologies. They bring a comprehensive understanding of enterprise network architecture and interdependencies, enabling them to adapt existing architectures to new challenges and create solutions where no established patterns exist. They communicate complex technical concepts effectively across teams and influence technical decisions through strong argumentation and data-driven analysis.

In this role, you will operate independently on challenging problems, seeking guidance only for novel situations with broad organizational impact. You will influence process improvements across teams, develop implementation standards, and produce documentation that becomes long-term reference material. You will provide technical guidance to engineers across teams, mentor junior engineers, and contribute to the development of standards and best practices that shape technical direction.

Infrastructure Deployment Engineers at this level are expected to identify systemic problems, propose architectural improvements, and consider long-term maintenance and scalability in their approach. They drive adoption of best practices within their domain and influence team technical direction through SME expertise. The desire and ability to work in an ambiguous, collaborative environment — solving undefined problems and creating new solutions — is essential for success.

Basic qualifications

- BS in Information Systems, Computer Science, or equivalent experience, coupled with certifications such as CCNP, JNCIP, or equivalent demonstrated practical expertise + industry experience.
- 5+ years of experience as a network engineer with hands-on deployment and design of large-scale enterprise networks, including complex infrastructure installations, hardware integration, and advanced network configurations.
- 5+ years' experience with advanced routing protocols (BGP, MPLS) and network design principles across multiple infrastructure domains (networking, storage, server, OS platforms).
- Demonstrated ability to solve complex, undefined problems independently and act as a technical escalation point for peers.
- 3+ years' experience developing implementation standards, influencing technical decisions across teams, and producing reference-quality technical documentation.

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years' hands-on experience with Cisco routers, switches, and firewalls, including advanced configuration and troubleshooting across multiple domains.
- Experience designing and implementing complex network solutions that address multi-faceted challenges across enterprise environments.
- Experience working with data centers and telecom carriers to procure, deliver, and activate network circuits at scale.
- Experience administering, deploying, or supporting Cisco or Aruba wireless network equipment in large-scale enterprise environments.
- Demonstrated track record of influencing technical decisions through data-driven analysis, acting as a recognized SME in specific network domains.
- Experience mentoring engineers and providing technical guidance across teams.

Our HR Partners care deeply about the employee experience, proactively listening to Builder sentiment, and serving as a connector between Builders, managers, and HRBPs.

In this role, you will collaborate with Data Center Operations leaders, HRBPs, and partner teams to innovate, implement, and deploy HR strategies from talent and performance management, compensation, employee relations and other HR functions across the cluster of Data Centers you support. descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Data Center Capacity Delivery Asia-Pacific Controls Deployment and Service (DCCD APAC CDS) team delivers and services the control systems which monitor and ensure the health of our data centers. APAC CDS’ mission is to safely provide our customers with the unmatched reliability, security, and performance that AWS is known for. APAC CDS covers three core disciplines of controls deployments, projects, and service, with five additional supporting disciplines in colocated controls, systems, fleet, on-call support, and governance.

As Amazonians, we work in a competitive environment. Our customers are always beautifully, wonderfully dissatisfied. Being successful in our roles is not just about doing our jobs well, but also evolving and innovating. Change is the only constant, and applies to our customers, our roles, our team organization, our tools, and our mechanisms.

To be successful in this team, you will also have:
- Ability to thrive at the pace and scale of Amazon
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple competing priorities
- Ability and willingness to collaborate with peers around the globe, which may involve some participation in meetings at odd hours
- Ability and willingness to travel domestically or globally as and when needed
Controls Deployment & Service (CDS) Technicians support data center building automation systems, including Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). In this role, you will deploy and service these critical systems to ensure optimal data center health and performance.

Your responsibilities include deploying new BMS or EPMS installations during data center construction, upgrading existing Amazon-owned or leased facilities, and implementing Amazon hardware in colocated environments. You'll also provide regional servicing expertise to our fleet or data centers in your region, and occasionally support global operations.

Success in this position requires effective collaboration with multiple Amazon teams, including Construction, Commissioning, Critical Projects, Data Center Operations, Procurement, Program Management, Design, and Engineering teams. You'll maintain strong vendor relationships that drive successful deployments and operations.


Key job responsibilities
* Deploy and maintain critical systems: Install, upgrade, and troubleshoot BMS and EPMS systems across multiple data centers, ensuring optimal performance through diagnostics, programming, and hardware maintenance.
* Execute technical projects: Manage installations from server provisioning to sensor calibration, supervise contractor work, and ensure all activities meet AWS safety and quality standards.
* Drive operational excellence: Provide commissioning support, conduct root cause analysis, create system documentation, and follow change management processes to maintain system integrity.
* Enable team success: Mentor facilities teams on system operations, collaborate with vendors on Factory Witnessed Tests, and recommend design improvements based on operational insights.
* Deliver reliable service: Respond to emergencies, manage on-call rotations, oversee service agreements, and prioritize work through ticketing systems to maintain data center availability.

A day in the life
- Join the cloud leader: AWS has the most proven operational and security expertise, and the business is innovating at a faster clip—especially in new areas such as Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence, the Internet of Things, Serverless Computing, and custom-designed processors and chips.
- Be at the nexus of action: Your involvement in data center delivery will be mission-critical to the successful deployment of our data centers. You won’t just be observing from the sidelines; you’ll be representing Amazon, building relationships across a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders.
- Build at scale: Build and operate infrastructure at an enormous scale, participating in Amazon’s global presence.
- Your unique background will be an asset: At Amazon, our ability to innovate on behalf of our global customers and communities is dependent upon the skills, perspectives, and knowledge of people from all backgrounds.
- Continuous growth and learning: You may not be an expert in AWS when you join our company, but you will have support to become one. Benefit from direct access to industry-leading specialists, latest training materials, and courses to propel your career.

descriptionHtml:

The mission of Agentic WorkSpaces is to enable AI agents to work the way people do. Across the industry agents are becoming digital workers. Like every team member they need identity, permissions, governance, and a trusted place to do their work. The Agentic WorkSpaces Client team builds the front door to that place: the client software people use to securely access and operate the desktop and web applications their businesses rely on and the software AI agents will use to do the same.

We build the client software that runs on customer endpoints across major operating systems and browsers and we own critical parts of the connection and user experience for Amazon WorkSpaces a highly scaled system that delivers remote desktops and streamed applications to millions of end users every day. We are evolving that same client experience to carry agentic workloads which require secure access, enterprise permissions, governance, observability, and human oversight. Learn more: https://aws.amazon.com/workspaces/ We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to design build and operate customer-facing capabilities across native and web clients advancing the client that enterprise agents will work through while supporting a system that millions of people depend on today. Industry consensus points to a growing share of cloud desktop workloads becoming agentic in the coming years. We build the client software those desktops are reached through which is exactly why the Agentic WorkSpaces Client team can lead that shift. Today most of the team's work is building and running the clients our users rely on; the agentic share of the roadmap grows from there. Your work includes secure session connectivity, client lifecycle, cross-platform architecture, user experience, performance, software updates, and operational telemetry and integrations supporting human and agentic workflows. You will own features from design through production collaborate with teams across AWS solve complex issues in customer-managed environments and maintain a high bar for security reliability and operational excellence.

The problems span operating systems web technologies networking security and distributed services and your work will directly influence how people and AI agents securely interact with enterprise applications. In this role, you will be the operational backbone of outbound transportation execution — scheduling palletized freight shipments and small parcel packages, tracking shipments in transit, resolving exceptions and delays, and ensuring every delivery meets our customer promise.

You will work directly with carriers, customer service teams, and RAD Operations shipping teams to coordinate daily pickup projections, set customer delivery appointments, investigate shipment inquiries, and identify transportation consolidation opportunities that reduce cost while protecting service quality. You will provide solutions for customers by proactively resolving shipping exceptions, recommending optimal service levels, and ensuring every delivery commitment is met. This role requires someone who can balance customer obsession with frugality — making smart service-level decisions on every shipment while delivering an exceptional customer experience.

If you thrive in a fast-paced logistics environment, enjoy solving problems in real time, and take pride in keeping shipments moving, this is the role for you.



Key job responsibilities
Transportation Scheduling & Execution
- Schedule and coordinate both less than truckload and full truckload palletized freight shipments and small parcel packages across North America fulfillment locations
- Use multiple carrier platforms and shipping systems to generate labels, book shipments, and confirm carrier pickups
- Rate quote customer shipping requests and make service-level decisions balancing customer obsession and frugality
- Identify transportation consolidation opportunities to optimize cost and reduce shipment volume

Shipment Tracking & Exception Management

- Track shipments in transit from origin to destination, monitoring status across parcel, LTL, and ground networks
- Action shipments with exceptions and delays, escalating with carriers and customer service teams to drive resolution
- Conduct shipment inquiries, file freight claims and support customer shipment investigations, providing timely updates to stakeholders
- Troubleshoot shipping errors and resolve issues end-to-end, escalating complex problems when necessary

Customer Experience & Delivery Support

- Provide customer experience support by setting and managing customer delivery appointments when required
- Communicate daily pickup projections and volume forecasts to carriers to ensure capacity alignment
- Support RAD Operations shipping teams with transportation coordination and shipment execution needs

Carrier & Stakeholder Communication

- Communicate professionally via email and phone with parcel, LTL, and FTL transportation providers
- Serve as the transportation liaison between GTL, RAD Operations, and cross-functional partners
- Maintain carrier compliance records including arrival and departure times for scorecard development
- Coordinate with business partners, stakeholders, and peers to ensure seamless daily operations

About the team
Global Transportation & Logistics (GTL) is the logistics solutions execution arm supporting the Global RAD Operations business across North America. We manage multi-modal transportation in support of Amazon internal customers— parcel, LTL, FTL, flatbed and auto transport. Our team operates with customer obsession and solutions mindset at the core, balancing service quality with cost optimization every day. We are a collaborative, fast-paced team that values ownership, communication, and continuous improvement.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook) experience
- Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and be able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
- 1+ years of transportation and supply chain experience

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Experience using tracking platforms for high volume customer shipments, investigating shipment exceptions, delays, and customer inquiries
- 2+ years of experience in transportation coordination, freight scheduling, or logistics operations
- Experience with Transportation Management Systems (TMS), carrier platforms, or shipping software
- Experience scheduling both palletized freight (LTL/FTL) and small parcel shipments
- Experience investigating shipment exceptions, delays, and customer inquiries

title: Account Executive, Federal, Worldwide Public Sector
descriptionHtml:

This role is responsible for supporting a portfolio of strategic government accounts, developing account plans, and delivering revenue targets while helping customers achieve their cloud and AI transformation goals.

The Account Executive will work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment alongside Solutions Architects, Professional Services, and Partner teams to deliver innovative cloud solutions that improve public sector outcomes. You will be expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, build strong executive relationships, and act as the commercial point of contact for your accounts.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and execute account plans for assigned public sector customers, driving revenue growth and cloud and AI adoption
- Build and maintain relationships with senior stakeholders (Director/SES level) across government agencies
- Manage a robust sales pipeline from lead generation through qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Solutions Architects, Technical Account Managers, Professional Services, and Partners to deliver customer outcomes
- Identify customer business challenges and map AWS solutions to deliver measurable value
- Navigate government procurement processes including panel arrangements, RFPs/RFTs, and standing offers
- Present business reviews and account updates to sales leadership on a regular cadence
- Contribute to team knowledge sharing, process improvement, and best practice development

Preferred qualifications

title: Sr. Product Marketing Manager, AI Studios
descriptionHtml:
Shape the future of cinematic storytelling: for creators, by creators. We're seeking a founding Product Marketing Manager to own how the industry understands our GenAI-enabled creative platform — built at Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios to help professional creators bring animation, live action, and VFX content to screen. AI Studios is a fast-growing team operating as a startup within Amazon, with direct ownership of studio-level goals.

You will build the product marketing function for AI Studios' content creation platform from the ground up and own its strategy end to end. You are accountable for how our platform is positioned, differentiated, and understood at scale — the narrative, competitive positioning, and market brand that drive awareness and demand across Amazon MGM Studios, AWS, and the broader creative industry. You will operate with independence in a space where the long-term strategy is not yet defined, set the marketing strategy, and bring the data-driven judgment to make the hard positioning trade-offs. The single most important thing you bring is credibility in the AI content-creation industry: you know the tools, you have made content with them, and you can hold your own in any room — with the best creators and filmmakers, and with the most skeptical executives.

Key job responsibilities
As AI Studios' founding Principal Product Marketing Manager, you will define and own the product marketing strategy for the platform, with long-term impact on how it is perceived across the industry. You will:

- Own the platform's core positioning and value proposition — the messaging and go-to-market narrative that define what it is, who it's for, and why it matters — so customers and partners understand it clearly and consistently.
- Own competitive differentiation: track a fast-moving landscape, articulate where we lead and where we are heading, and evolve the story as the market and our capabilities change.
- Aggregate and synthesize signals — competitive intelligence, customer and creator needs, industry and model trends — into a coherent marketing strategy and point of view that others build on.
- Build the definitive narrative and asset portfolio, versioned for distinct audiences (executive, artist and creative, technical and model-focused) and kept current with our latest capabilities, so the organization is always ready to represent the platform at its best.
- Drive awareness and demand across internal Amazon (Prime Video, Amazon MGM Studios, AWS, AGI, etc.), converting broad interest into a durable pipeline of engagement rather than one-off scrambles.
- Represent the platform credibly in high-stakes rooms — and equip senior leaders with the framing, competitive answers, and visual aids they need to carry the story themselves.
- Partner with Business Development and go-to-market teams to shape how the platform is positioned for the customer segments it serves over time.
- Create the mechanisms that let product marketing scale as the function grows, force-multiplying your impact through creative partners and the broader team rather than producing everything yourself.
- Collaborate closely with your cross-functional counterparts, including Product Management, UX Design, Engineering, Applied Science, and Creative teams to understand and inform the direction of our product suite.

A day in the life
Your morning starts with a request from leadership for a tailored pitch ahead of an executive meeting — and because you own a current, coherent narrative, you turn it around without pulling anyone off their day job. You sync with a creative lead to capture a fresh demo and usage anecdotes, then sharpen the competitive framing on where the platform leads and where it is heading. After lunch, you prep a model-focused cut of the story with Science for a technical audience and a VP-level cut for an upcoming review, and align with Business Development on how the positioning maps to their go-to-market. You field inbound interest from another team and fold it into the demand plan. You close the day evolving the differentiation story against the latest competitor release. Throughout, you're the person who owns how the industry sees what we're building.

About the team
AI Studios is a small, high-ownership "startup within Amazon," formed by Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios to build multimodal AI tools and models for content creation with human's in the driver's seat. We work directly with professional filmmakers, animators, and VFX artists on active productions. We operate from first principles, learn directly from working creators on real productions, and hold a high bar for craft, safety, and storytelling magic. If you're motivated by invention and inspired by storytellers, this is your seat at the table.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience leading go-to-market for consumer software or hardware product launches
- Experience prior success in driving execution of large-scale project plans with multiple teams in support of business goals

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with customer segmentation, profiling, and targeting
- Hands-on fluency creating content with generative-AI tools
- Experience and credibility in the AI content-creation or media-production industry

title: DevOps Engineer, Fulfillment Optimization
descriptionHtml:
Amazon.com is seeking a Dev Ops Engineer to join a Fulfillment Optimization teams that helps to promise, plan and execute the delivery of millions of packages to customers worldwide faster and cheaper each day, while providing extraordinary customer experience from the website to doorstep delivery. Our systems handle million of requests per second and make business recommendations that impacts billions of dollars each year. With rapid expansion into new geographies, increasing complexity of the transportation network and expanding selection of products, the Fulfillment Optimization team builds solutions that scale and propel the business best in class technology innovations

We are looking for passionate, hard-working, and talented Engineers who have experience supporting innovative, mission critical, high volume applications. You will have an enormous opportunity to work within multiple systems researching and identifying the common issues, and driving the teams towards resolution to have a positive impact on customer experience. This team provides 24x7 oncall support on a rotation basis schedule among the team members. Your solutions will impact our customers directly! This job requires you to hit the ground running and your ability to learn quickly and work on disparate and overlapping tasks will define your success.

The ideal candidate must be detail oriented, have superior verbal and written communication skills, strong organizational skills, able to juggle multiple tasks at once, able to work independently and can maintain professionalism under pressure. You must be able to identify problems before they happen and implement solutions that detect and prevent outages. Your ability to accurately prioritize projects, make sound judgments, work to improve the customer experience, and get the right things done would have direct impact on Amazon Supply Chain Optimization and Fulfillment network efficiency.

Key job responsibilities
As a DevOps Engineer, you will/may:

* Troubleshoot documented issues and determine root cause.

title: Senior Software Dev Engineer , AWS Elastic Container Service
descriptionHtml:
AWS Elastic Container Service (ECS) is building a new team in Seattle to dramatically accelerate how quickly containerized workloads become ready to run. This is a foundational performance challenge at massive scale — and we believe a step-function improvement is technically within reach.

The Workload Optimization team is a greenfield team tackling one of the most impactful challenges in container compute. As a Senior SDE, you will lead the system design and technical direction for low-latency container startup at massive scale. You'll work deep in the stack — Linux kernel, containerd/runc, Bottlerocket, and container networking — to reimagine the launch path from instance creation to workload execution.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the architecture and technical roadmap for container start-up optimization at scale
- Drive system design across the container runtime, OS, and networking layers
- Mentor and grow a team of engineers building foundational infrastructure
- Work directly with senior ECS leadership to shape the future of Fargate performance
- Ensure strong operational practices across your team, including appropriate monitoring, telemetry, runbooks, and retrospective processes, while proactively identifying and resolving root causes of systemic issues.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing operational metrics and addressing any alerts from overnight. By mid-morning, you are deep in a design discussion with engineers on your team, working through trade-offs for a new feature that spans multiple services. After lunch, you pair with a teammate on a tricky implementation, then join a cross-team architecture review where your expertise helps shape a shared interface. You wrap up the afternoon writing a technical design document and providing feedback on a colleague's code review.

About the team
Amazon Elastic Container Service (ECS) makes it easy for customers to run, scale, and secure containerized applications on AWS. ECS powers some of the most demanding workloads on the planet — from startups launching their first container to enterprises running millions of tasks across global infrastructure.

The Workload Optimization team is a brand-new team within ECS, based in Seattle, with a focused mission: fundamentally reduce the time it takes for a containerized workload to become ready to run on AWS Fargate. For the vast majority of Fargate customers, launch latency is one of the biggest factors in their end-to-end experience — and we believe a step-function improvement is achievable.

This is a greenfield team, which means you won't be inheriting legacy systems or processes — you'll be building from scratch. You'll work deep in the systems stack (Linux kernel, container runtimes, OS, networking) alongside a small, senior group of engineers who care deeply about performance, correctness, and customer impact at scale.

We value engineers who think from first principles, are comfortable with ambiguity, and are energized by hard problems that don't have obvious solutions. Our culture is direct, low-ceremony, and high-ownership — you'll have real influence over what we build and how we build it from day one.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience building or operating container-based services, microservices platforms, or cloud infrastructure on AWS.
- Familiarity with container technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, or ECS.

title: Data Center Engineering Technician, DCEO
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are currently seeking a Data Center Engineering Operations Technician to serve as a technical resource within our mission critical Data Center’s. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels of Data Center Engineering Operations. We strive towards building a diverse workforce and look to hire the best people we can regardless of age, gender or ethnicity.

Due to the success of the Amazon Web Services (AWS) operations and rapid expansion of Data Centers we are recruiting suitable candidates to operate/maintain these facilities in Sweden. In this role you will have a positive involvement in both the maintenance of facilities and the improvement of efficiencies to help offer Amazon customer’s better value.



Key job responsibilities
You will also be involved in:
o Assisting in the operation and maintenance of all electrical, mechanical, fire/life safety equipment and HVAC equipment within the Data Center/Facility. This equipment supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.
o Assisting in the maintenance and monitoring of all Data Center systems to include incidents/events, problems, changes, monitoring, problem escalation/notification/resolution and all other aspects of Data Center support.
o Monitoring and troubleshooting all mechanical, electrical, HVAC systems, voice/data, cooling systems, fire/life safety equipment and generators.
o Providing assistance to contractor or data center engineers to ensure proper operation and maintenance of all facility equipment.
o Providing assistance to contractors or data center engineers to deploy new equipment, such as building racks, cabling, and other tasks as necessary.
o Performing site walk throughs to verify proper operation of Facility Equipment and Monitoring Systems.

In addition to acting as a Facilities First Responder to critical events, you will be a part of the team supporting new data center facilities and existing data center facilities!

A day in the life
Day to day activities for this role include;
o Monitoring of all alarms and systems involved in the operation of power, cooling and fire suppression systems in the data center.
o Planning and coordinating vendor works on site to ensure equipment is maintained and uptime retained.
o Supporting other sites and teams during events and planned works.
o Carrying out rack power up and installation duties.
o Monitoring and facilitating new equipment handover.
o Supporting new hires and team members through knowledge share and development.
o Event response and drill participation.


About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of relevant work experience.
- Strong English verbal and written communication skills.
- Electrical, mechanical or instrumentation training and/or relevant experience.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in data center engineering.

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. title: Marketing Manager, RBS Retail Efficiency
descriptionHtml:
Are you customer centric, smart and analytical, strategic yet execution focused, entrepreneurial, and passionate about protecting brands? Do you want to be part of one of the fastest growing and most innovative brand protection businesses? Are you interested in a high impact, high ownership role that sits at the intersection of product authenticity, brand trust, and customer confidence? If yes, this opportunity will appeal to you. Come join our team and help define the course of Amazon's product authenticity and brand protection business.

Amazon's vision is to be Earth's most customer-centric company and the most trusted place for brands to grow and protect their business. We build programs and solutions that help brand owners verify product authenticity, secure their supply chain through serialization, and build customer trust — delighting millions of brands and customers every day.

We are looking for a smart, metrics and results-oriented Product Marketing Manager to independently own our most important brand-facing product authenticity initiatives — the "big rocks" that move the business. You will set the go-to-market and adoption roadmap for our product authenticity and serialization programs, build and scale marketing campaigns across the funnel, and define the dashboards and mechanisms that track enrollment, adoption, engagement, and retention.

Key job responsibilities
1. Owning and driving the biggest, product marketing initiatives for brand protection and authenticity programs end to end — from strategy through execution and measurable business impact.

7. Developing content and thought-leadership strategies (case studies, playbooks, webinars, brand-facing events) that drive awareness and enrollment at scale for product authenticity programs.
8. Establishing best practices and reusable playbooks, and mentoring peers and junior team members to raise the bar across the org.
