title: ID - Rack Lifecycle Tech, Rack Lifecycle Team
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of hardware and network engineers, logistics specialists, security and safety experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are looking for a detail-oriented, technically skilled Rack Lifecycle Tech to join our Rack Lifecycle Team within AWS Infrastructure Operations. In this individual contributor role, you will be a hands-on executor responsible for the physical installation, cabling, handoff, and decommissioning of racks across your assigned data center site. You are the person on the floor who turns capacity plans into operational reality.

As an Rack Lifecycle Tech, you will execute structured cabling, rack installation, and decommission activities with precision and to standard — following established SOPs, escalating deviations to your team lead, and ensuring every rack you touch is installed correctly, cabled to specification, fully documented, and handed off with zero blockers, prepare SOP’s with new processes, stake holder management with cross functional teams. This is an individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities.


Key job responsibilities
🔷 Rack Installation & Cabling
· Execute rack installations including physical placement, power connections, grounding, and cable management per AWS standards and MOPs
· Perform structured cabling including fiber/copper terminations, patch panel connections, labeling, and dressing to specification
· Complete OTDR and power testing; validate results against acceptance thresholds; escalate failures to team lead promptly rather than self-resolving outside approved procedures
· Follow all EHS protocols, lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, and safe work practices during installation activities
🔷 Rack Lifecycle Operations
· Execute work orders and tasks assigned by the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager under direct manager direction, maintaining accurate status updates in workflow management tools (e.g., Boost, MARS)
· Perform quality checks on completed cabling work including port map verification, label accuracy, and as-built documentation updates in CMDB/DCIM
· Identify and escalate issues, blockers, or deviations from SOPs encountered during task execution to the team lead or manager promptly; do not self-resolve outside approved procedures
· Support deployment wave readiness by participating in pre-work site walks, material staging, and tool preparation
🔷 Material Handling & Supply Chain Support
· Receive, verify, and stage incoming rack, cable, optics, and hardware deliveries; validate against BOM and flag discrepancies
· Maintain accurate site inventory records for cables, optics, patch cords, and consumables used during deployments
· Support cycle count activities and assist in identifying inventory shortfalls that may impact deployment timelines
🔷 Handover & Documentation
· Complete all required as-built documentation, port maps, test result records, and workflow sign-offs before handoff to Data Center Operations
· Update CMDB/DCIM and IPAM records accurately following rack installation or decommission activities
· Ensure handoffs are clean and fully documented with zero open blockers, enabling smooth transition to the next lifecycle phase
🔷 Rack Decommissioning
· Execute physical decommission activities per assigned MOPs — including cable removal, power disconnects, asset de-tagging, and rack extraction
· Perform device wipe and media destruction in compliance with AWS Secure Media Destruction and EHS policies
· Sort, label, and stage recovered assets (optics, cables, PDUs, hardware) for RMA, redeployment, or secure disposal per AWS Reverse Logistics policy
· Update DCIM/CMDB, IPAM, and port maps post-decom to ensure accurate space, power, and circuit records
· Validate that reclaimed U-space, power, and cooling capacity is accurately recorded in the available pool
🔷 Quality, Safety & Compliance
· Adhere to all site-level SOPs, quality standards, and governance frameworks for cabling, installation, and decommission activities
· Complete all required safety training and certifications; participate in regular EHS audits and team safety briefings
· Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring quality issues, suggesting process improvements, and sharing feedback with the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager
· Use Rack Lifecycle Team tooling (e.g., Boost, MARS, ALM/DCLM) accurately to record work, track assets, and maintain data integrity
🔷 Cross-Team Coordination
· Support coordination with DCO, DCEO, Network Engineering, and facilities teams during active deployment or decom activities under manager guidance to ensure smooth execution
· Participate in daily stand-ups and pre-work briefings; communicate clearly on task status, blockers, and schedule adherence
· Provide accurate, timely updates on task completion and flag risks or delays to the team lead immediately
🔷 Continuous Learning & Development
· Maintain and develop technical proficiency in structured cabling, fiber optics, rack installation, and data center physical infrastructure
· Complete required certifications and training modules including EHS, LOTO, and any Rack Lifecycle Team-specific technical programs
· Proactively seek feedback from leads and managers to improve personal performance and output quality
· Support the onboarding and training of new team members; share knowledge and best practices with peers to build overall team capability and quality standards
· Stay current on AWS infrastructure tooling, cabling standards, and process updates communicated by the Rack Lifecycle Team


A day in the life
As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, your day is on the data center floor. You might start the morning by reviewing your assigned work orders in Boost, checking in with your team lead on priorities, and staging cables and optics for a rack installation wave. By midday, you could be terminating fiber runs at a patch panel, running OTDR tests to validate loss results against acceptance thresholds, or labeling and dressing a freshly installed rack. In the afternoon, you might be updating CMDB records for completed work orders, de-tagging and staging recovered assets from an EOL decom, or helping onboard a new technician by walking them through the SOP. If you encounter a deviation from the approved MOP, you escalate it to your team lead immediately — you don't improvise. Your role is hands-on, technical, and precise — you execute the work that keeps AWS capacity on track.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and Amazon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
- 2+ years of Computer Hardware Repair, Infrastructure Cabling, Network Deployment, Data Center Operations, or Technical Project Management experience
- 2+ years of network cabling, fiber optics, and test equipment including VFL, power meter, and OTDR experience
- 2+ years of fiber handling and fiber installation processes experience
- Can lift and rack equipment up to 40 pounds

Preferred qualifications

- Can work in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health & safety guidelines
- Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
- Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system
- Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
- Experience working in a data center environment (racking and stacking gear, cable management, hot/cold aisle containment)
- Familiarity with rack decommissioning including device wipe, media destruction, and asset recovery procedures

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Sports BD Manager, Prime Video Live Sports
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking an experienced Business Development Manager to own and scale our global live sports data licensing business. This is a high-visibility, end-to-end ownership role: you will drive the strategy, negotiation, and management of a growing pipeline of licensing deals with data and technology providers that power our live sports customer experience, while partnering closely with Production, Product, and Marketing to bring those deals to life. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of deal-making and operational execution — comfortable leading complex commercial negotiations one day and diving into reporting and milestone tracking the next.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the global live sports data licensing pipeline end to end — working with partner teams to source and qualify opportunities through contract execution and ongoing account management. Develop overarching strategies to improve deal efficiencies across business lines and lower cost.
- Lead contract negotiations with providers that supply underlying data, tools, and infrastructure powering the live sports customer experience, structuring commercial terms that balance business goals with partner needs.
- Manage the full contract lifecycle, including renewals, amendments, compliance tracking, and risk mitigation, in partnership with Legal.
- Build and maintain the business line's reporting cadence, including pipeline health, deal status, revenue/cost tracking, and key milestone reporting to leadership - proactively flagging risks, delays, or renegotiation needs.
- Develop scalable processes and playbooks for deal structuring, negotiation, and pipeline management as the business line grows.
- Act as the primary point of contact for external partners on data licensing matters, representing Amazon.

About the team
You'll have the opportunity to build and scale a global business line from the ground up, working directly with some of the biggest providers in sports while shaping how live sports data and technology powers Amazon's products and content. This is a rare chance to own a business end to end — strategy, deals, and execution — with real visibility into how your work drives impact.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 3+ years of experience in business development, partnerships, and contract negotiation, ideally within sports, media, or data licensing
- 3+ years of experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Marketing, Product Management, Customer Service, Operations, Legal, Finance, and Senior Leadership
- Experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including your peers and leadership
- Experience building measures and metrics, and developing reporting solutions

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or Advanced degree
- Experience specifically in sports data, sports media rights, or live sports production
- Familiarity with the global sports data and technology provider ecosystem
- Experience working in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment while owning a business line independently

You will work with minimum supervision in a dynamic environment to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and assist in the development of innovative ways to automate and scale our network.
To be successful in this role you should possess technical aptitude, written and oral communications skills and the ability to deal effectively with people in a wide variety of situations. In addition, you must possess strong analytical skills with demonstrated problem solving ability. You will be able to leverage your experience exercising high levels of initiative, judgment, and diplomacy.

Physical Requirements:

- Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
- Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to participate in primary responder rotation and provide after-hours support as needed
- Working in cramped and/or elevated and/or noisy environments
- Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

- Installing Fiber and Copper cabling and patching cabling between equipment
- Ensuring proper safety and security standards are maintained during cabling and rack installation,
- Following well established hardware installation procedures and break-fix activities
- Safely using material handling tools and equipment

Traveling within and outside of regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided.

- 1+ years of Computer Hardware Repair, Infrastructure Cabling, Network Deployment, or Data Center Operations experience, or experience in similar technical or vocational roles

title: Principal, Human Resources Specialist, ADC Talent
descriptionHtml:
There has never been a more exciting time to be at AWS. Our business is evolving rapidly, the regulatory landscape is shifting under our feet, and the opportunities to deliver value are endless! We are looking for a Principal, Human Resources Specialist to own and drive strategic employee initiatives for a business segment that delivers essential services to AWS national security customers. In this role, you will partner with a global network of cross-functional teams to design and deliver solutions across compensation strategy, employee engagement, workforce planning, career growth, and culture. You will analyze complex data sets and connect what the data tells you to real business priorities. This is a hands-on, high-judgment role where you will build new approaches from scratch, influence the design of long-term tooling, and collaborate with partners across Human Resources, personnel security, and legal to attract and retain a niche talent segment doing meaningful work.

Note: This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the vision and strategy for employee engagement, career growth, and compensation programs (including bonus design) for a growing matrixed AWS business segment, defining the approach where one may not yet exist.
- Analyze complex and sometimes incomplete workforce data to identify trends, inform business priorities, and deliver actionable recommendations to senior leadership through clear written narratives and presentations.
- Design and deliver engagement strategies that build culture across functionally isolated teams, and lead initiatives that enable leadership cohesion in a matrixed global environment.
- Partner with Human Resources Business Partners, compensation, talent acquisition, workforce planning, personnel security, and legal teams to create compliant, scalable mechanisms that attract and retain specialized talent.
- Leverage AI and available tooling to deliver results quickly while collaborating with Technical Program Management and Business Intelligence partners to shape bespoke tools for long-term support.

A day in the life
You might start your morning digging into workforce data to refine a compensation proposal, then jump into a working session with your Business Intelligence Engineer to scope requirements for a new reporting tool. After lunch, you connect with leaders across multiple regions to align on an engagement strategy for teams that operate in isolated environments. Later, you draft a narrative for a senior leadership review, translating what the numbers are telling you into a clear recommendation. In between, you are fielding questions from HR Business Partners, troubleshooting an emerging customer requirement, and sketching out a plan for a culture initiative that has never been done before.

About the team
We are not a typical Human Resources team. We provide both line support through embedded HR Business Partners and program design through embedded specialists, and we also own tooling development and bonus administration. Our customers have contractual and mission-oriented needs that require us to build original solutions rather than pull from existing playbooks. We partner with compensation, talent acquisition, workforce planning, personnel security, and legal — and we are growing. This role gives you exposure across the full AWS ecosystem, a chance to work with a team that takes real accountability for its work, and the opportunity to shape how we support a critical and expanding customer segment.

- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources Management
- 10+ years of HR specialist, HR generalist (e.g., HR Business Partner or HR Partner), HR manager, or HR program experience
- Experience creating and implementing large-scale organizational programs
- Experience analyzing HR data and translating metrics into actionable workforce strategies
- Experience working effectively across cross-functional teams and partnering well with people at all levels within an organization
- Experience ability to understand and devise new models that work

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or above in human resources
- Experience in security or compliance consulting or advisory work in support of a highly technical environment
- Experience working with customers, technical teams, and management to collect requirements, describe software product features, and technical designs
- Experience delivering programs for large, cross-functional, global teams, using data and metrics to provide insights and drive improvements

title: Supplier Mfg Engineer, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Amazon Leo's Hardware Supply Chain team is looking for a Supplier Manufacturing Engineer to serve as the technical bridge between design engineering, the global supplier base, and internal production operations. This role owns manufacturing process expertise across assigned hardware commodities, working hands-on with suppliers and cross-functional teams to resolve technical issues, improve producibility, and ensure the supply base can deliver conforming hardware at rate. The ideal candidate brings a combination of manufacturing process knowledge, structured problem-solving discipline, and the ability to work across organizational boundaries in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and ambiguity is the norm.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
• Investigate and resolve manufacturing and quality issues at suppliers by analyzing defect data, observing processes firsthand, and applying structured problem-solving (DMAIC, 8D, fault tree) to drive corrective actions to verified closure

• Provide DFM/DFA feedback to design engineers during NPI and production, identifying tolerances, features, or material selections that create manufacturing risk and recommending producibility improvements

• Conduct first article inspections, process validations, supplier capability assessments, and site visits to confirm suppliers can produce conforming parts at rate and to develop their manufacturing capabilities over time

• Collaborate with suppliers to industrialize new materials and processes, supporting tooling, capital improvements, and part qualification (PPAP) while acting as the technical point of contact for manufacturing readiness through launch milestones

• Coordinate with supplier quality engineering to disposition nonconformances, validate corrective actions, and lead containment activities across the supply base

• Serve as the technical bridge between design engineering and supply chain, translating supplier process data and floor observations into actionable feedback and using production data systems (MES, ERP, quality databases) to frame issues in terms of cost, throughput, and delivery impact

A day in the life
A typical day balances supplier engagement with analytical depth. Morning starts reviewing incoming quality data and identifying a yield trend at a supplier that needs investigation. Mid-morning brings a design review where you flag a tolerance that will create manufacturability issues at rate. After lunch, you're on a call with a supplier's engineering team working through a corrective action on a nonconforming lot. Late afternoon means writing up findings, updating the data package, and aligning with stakeholders on next steps. The pace is fast, the problems are real, and the work directly impacts whether satellites get built on time.

About the team
The Supplier Manufacturing Engineering team sits within Hardware Supply Chain and serves as the technical bridge between design engineering, the global supplier base, and internal production operations. The team owns manufacturing process expertise across non-electronics hardware commodities, holding design authority to drive drawing revisions, resolve specification conflicts, and qualify suppliers for critical components. Engineers operate with high independence, applying structured problem-solving to improve cost, quality, delivery, and producibility across both external suppliers and internal factory environments.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, process engineering, or production engineering in aerospace, automotive, medical device, or high-complexity hardware environments
- 4+ years of experience developing, implementing, or monitoring manufacturing processes and controls at suppliers or in a production environment
- Demonstrated experience with structured problem-solving methods (DMAIC, 8D, A3, fault tree, or equivalent) applied to real manufacturing or quality issues
- Hands-on experience with engineering drawing interpretation and GD&T in a production or supplier-facing context

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of Lean, Kaizen, Six Sigma concepts
- Experience with supplier management including audits, capability assessments, and corrective action follow-through
- Working knowledge of DFM/DFA principles applied to electromechanical assemblies
- Working knowledge of statistical tools (SPC, process capability, measurement system analysis) applied in a production context
- Strong communication and collaboration skills with demonstrated ability to work across engineering, quality, and supply chain functions in fast-paced environments
- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline

title: Finance Manager, Transportation Technology & Services Finance
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to drive strategic financial decision-making that powers business growth? As a Financial Analyst III in our Transportation Technology and Services organization, you will play a critical role in providing data-driven insights that guide business decisions across all organizational levels. You'll lead reporting initiatives, standardize planning processes, and establish the right controls to enable sound financial decisions.

This position offers exceptional visibility with leadership and provides meaningful influence in the decision-making process. You'll translate complex financial data into actionable business insights while partnering with stakeholders to identify growth opportunities and optimize resource allocation. Your analytical expertise will directly impact operational excellence and drive continuous improvement across our financial processes.

Key job responsibilities

A day in the life
Your day begins with reviewing key financial metrics and preparing for a meeting with business stakeholders to discuss operational performance and planning needs. Throughout the day, you'll work on deep-dive analyses to address specific business questions, collaborate with cross-functional teams to align on financial reporting standards, and develop improved control mechanisms. You'll participate in strategic planning sessions where your financial insights help shape business decisions, and spend time mentoring team members on financial processes and best practices.

About the team
We are the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team supporting the Transportation Technology and Services organizations. Our team owns central reporting, planning and goals for the organization, including operational expenditures, technology entitlements, and headcount planning. We serve as strategic financial partners, providing data-driven insights that guide decision-making across all levels of the organization.

Our team values analytical excellence, proactive collaboration, and continuous process improvement. We take pride in translating complex financial data into actionable business insights that drive organizational performance and efficiency. If you're passionate about financial planning, analytical problem-solving, and working in a collaborative environment with significant business impact, this is the perfect team for you.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, or a related analytical field (e.g., engineering, math, computer science)

title: Principal Product Manager (Technical), AWS Certificate Manager
descriptionHtml:
Are you excited about the intersection of security, encryption and literally every internet connected device in the world? We're looking for a technical Product Manager to help define the next evolution of public-key infrastructure (PKI), helping our customers easily secure their websites, APIs and devices with digital certificates that just work.

Our organization owns everything "certificates" for Amazon - from AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) for certificate management (TLS and other X.509 certs), to AWS Private Certificate Authority (PCA) for private certificate issuance and AWS Signer for code signing. Our services help customers create, manage, and deploy digital certificates based on strong cryptography and public key infrastructure (PKI) best practices.

We are at a pivotal moment for the certificates space - Post Quantum requirements are around the corner, certificate usage has expanded to secure everything from IoT devices to AI agent workloads, and content signing is in huge demand to protect original work.

The ACM team is looking for a strong technical Principal Product Manager with an interest in information security and identity can help define and drive the vision for our space as we continue to innovate and grow.

As a Principal Product Manager for the Certificates organization you will:
- Understand our customers inside and out
- Invent on behalf of customers
- Develop product strategy and vision and translate it into creative, high quality, simple features
- Make the business decisions that grow the adoption and usage of our services and accelerate the growth of our overall security business
- Set prices, target the right customers, and focus our investments in the right areas
- Work closely with the engineering teams to design, schedule and deliver in an agile environment to deliver products to market
- Launch new features and make sure our sales, marketing, and PR teams are telling the most compelling story

title: Senior Software Development Manager, S3
descriptionHtml:
Amazon S3 Tables is the first cloud object store with built-in Apache Iceberg support, purpose-built for storing and querying tabular data at massive scale. It is fully managed, continuously optimizing, and delivers up-to 10x higher transactions per second than Iceberg tables on general purpose S3 buckets, all within the same foundation that gives S3 eleven nines of durability. Customers are bringing their most demanding analytics workloads to S3 Tables, from streaming ingestion of IoT and application telemetry to multi-petabyte lakehouses powering multiple AWS and partner query engines, and a growing wave of AI agents that query data directly through the Model Context Protocol. Our mission is simple and ambitious which is to make S3 Tables the best place on Earth to store and query Iceberg data, and reinvent what an analytics-native object store can be.

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Manager to lead the multi-team S3 Tables organization. In this role, you will own the technical vision, multi-year roadmap, and execution for the service, working at a scale that very few engineers in the industry ever encounter. Your organization will ship innovations that customers feel directly in query latency, cost per terabyte scanned, ingestion throughput, and the simplicity of running an open lakehouse on AWS.

This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems, open-source table formats, and large-scale analytics. You will help define how Iceberg evolves in the cloud, partnering with the Apache Iceberg community and with engine teams across AWS and partners to make sure S3 Tables is the gravitational center of the open analytics ecosystem. Internally, you will partner with S3 storage, indexing, and control plane teams, and with AWS analytics leadership, to deliver a service that is both deeply integrated and uncompromisingly open.

We want a leader who thinks big, invents on behalf of customers, and is energized by problems that only show up at S3 scale. The bar is high and the opportunity to shape how the world stores and analyzes its data is higher.

S3 Tables is a new, fast moving team building within the most durable and scalable storage system ever built. We are early in our journey, the product is young, the customer base is growing quickly, and the surface area in front of us is large. We are doing this in the open with Apache Iceberg, obsessing over customer workloads, and inventing in places others assume are solved. If you want to help build something into what it can become, rather than maintain what already is, this is the team.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and grow a multi-team organization of senior engineers and engineering managers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, deep ownership, and customer obsession.
- Define and execute a 1 to 3 year technical roadmap, balancing near-term customer wins with long-horizon bets on query performance, table maintenance, metadata scale, and Iceberg evolution.
- Drive architectural decisions for distributed systems at exabyte scale, including metadata services, compaction and optimization pipelines, snapshot and transaction management, and engine integrations.
- Make S3 Tables the highest performing, most cost effective home for Apache Iceberg anywhere, and contribute back to the Iceberg open source project.
- Partner with product, business, and AWS analytics leadership to translate customer needs into engineering priorities that move adoption and trust.
- Establish operational excellence standards across availability, durability, latency, and throughput, and lead the org in exceeding them as the service scales.
- Recruit, develop, and retain top talent, building a diverse, high performing organization with a strong pipeline of future leaders.
- Represent S3 Tables in senior leadership reviews, customer engagements, and external forums with clarity and conviction.

title: Senior Partner Agreements BD Lead, AWS Partner Agreements
descriptionHtml:
We're looking for a builder who wants to stand up and run the deal desk for AWS partner agreement programs. This role owns the end-to-end operational processes that take a partner agreement from program design and partner selection through execution and performance measurement. You'll define how deals move through the pipeline, establish the procedures and quality controls that ensure accuracy at every stage, and build the infrastructure to scale these processes as the portfolio grows.
You'll work across analytics, engineering, and go-to-market teams to:
- Establish and operate the deal desk for partner agreement programs, defining the procedures, checkpoints, and quality controls that govern how agreements move from design through execution
- Build repeatable, scalable deal processes that ensure data accuracy, consistent partner experience, and reliable performance measurement across all agreement types
- Align cross-functional stakeholders (data engineering, sales operations, business planning, finance) on the inputs, validations, and handoffs required at each stage of the deal lifecycle
- Identify and drive opportunities to apply AI and automation to deal desk operations, progressively replacing manual steps with intelligent, scalable systems
- Monitor deal flow health, identifying where processes break, data quality degrades, or cycle times lag, and driving resolution to keep the desk running accurately

This is a high-ownership role. You'll define how the deal desk operates, what the standards are, and how we scale a growing portfolio of agreement programs without sacrificing accuracy or speed. If you like building operational rigor into complex, cross-functional processes, this is for you.



Key job responsibilities
- Stand up and operate the deal desk for partner agreement programs, establishing the procedures, workflows, and quality controls that govern the full deal lifecycle from program design through execution and performance tracking
- Define and enforce deal desk standards across all agreement types, ensuring every deal passes through consistent checkpoints for data accuracy, financial validation, and stakeholder sign-off
- Architect end-to-end deal workflows that reduce manual handoffs, establish clear ownership at each stage, and scale through progressive automation
- Align cross-functional stakeholders across data engineering, sales operations, finance, legal, and business planning on the inputs and validations required at each deal stage
- Identify and implement AI and automation opportunities across deal desk operations, transforming manual, repetitive processes into intelligent systems that improve speed, accuracy, and partner experience
- Incubate new deal processes as the organization introduces new agreement types, prototyping manually, validating with real deals, then codifying proven patterns into scalable procedures
- Monitor deal desk operational health, tracking cycle times, error rates, and process exceptions, and driving continuous improvement


A day in the life
Your day starts at the deal desk. You might begin the morning reviewing the deal pipeline, checking where agreements are stalling and what needs to move. By mid-morning, you're working with a data engineering team to validate that the numbers flowing into a partner's performance report are accurate. After lunch, you're designing the intake process for a new agreement type that doesn't fit existing procedures. Between meetings, you're exploring where AI can eliminate friction: auto-validating deal inputs, flagging data inconsistencies, or streamlining approval workflows. Your stakeholders span data engineering, sales operations, finance, business planning, and field teams.

About the team
We're a small, high-ownership team that builds the systems and processes behind how AWS engages its strategic partners through agreement-based programs. Our work spans the entire partner agreement journey: how programs are designed, how partners are selected, how performance is measured, and how the field supports partners at scale. We sit at the intersection of business development, data engineering, sales operations, and program management. Our team is moving from manual processes toward a scalable, AI-powered platform. You'll join at the ground floor, helping shape what gets built and how it operates. We value builders who take ambiguous problems and create structure.

- 5+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience explaining complex technical concepts to various business and technical audiences
- Experience with technology transformation initiatives
- Experience with data analytics platforms (Power BI, Python, SQL, Tableau), or experience working with Excel, reporting tools, and large-scale data mining tools, such as Power BI, Python, SQL, or Tableau

Preferred qualifications

- MBA
- Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations
- Experience working with data engineers and business intelligence engineers collaboratively
- Experience in developing and managing marketing or channel programs
- Familiarity with AI/ML applications in business process optimization
- 8+ years of experience designing or managing operational workflows and business processes

title: Engineer Operations Technician , DCEO Operations Team
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability

Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)

Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)

Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA

Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment

Technical writing to support change management program

Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion

On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation

Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.

Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:

Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:

Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently

Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds

Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder

Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position

Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance, or 2+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- vocational/technical training or an associate degree or above, or 4+ years of military experience

title: Sr. Program Manager, Financial Risk Mitigation
descriptionHtml:
This Sr. Program Manager role will lead a program within Financial Integrity Trust (FIT), a team embedded within the Financial Risk Mitigation (FRM) organization. FIT is focused on financial integrity of engagement between seller and Amazon by ensuring a secure, transparent, and trustworthy financial relationship between Amazon and its sellers. It is a critical line of defense, stopping bad actors from profiting while ensuring a frictionless experience for SPs. We track “who” is profiting and “where” Amazon disburses funds, and own “when” disbursements occur. We ensure appropriate controls, verifications, and validations for both charge and disbursement instruments, reducing bad actors’ ability to scale fraud and ensure compliance. We also compute and withhold account-level disbursement reserves, govern payment speed, and recover funds from enforced sellers, preventing unpaid fees and misuse of funds.

Key job responsibilities
• Mitigate financial risk and stop bad actors from profiting by building tools and setting policies that control how quickly sellers are paid and disburse. This role will work closely with product, tech, policy, legal, and finance stakeholders and partner teams.

• Own and communicate strategic vision, updates, goals, policy changes and roadmap to stakeholders and senior leaders. Routinely author documents: PRFAQ’s, Working Backwards, BRD’s, WBR’s/MBR’s/QBR’s, Program Updates etc.

• Deliver results and execute multiple high-visibility initiatives simultaneously. Make data-driven tradeoffs to maintain strategic deliverables.

• Operate with a high degree of independence. This role requires a curious, self-starting, fast learner who thrives in ambiguous, challenging spaces.

• Set and achieve challenging goals to solve problems. Drive efficiency improvements by eliminating non-value add processes and introducing automation to maximize impact.

• Develop solutions that scale in a resource constrained environment. Proactively launch mechanisms and build processes that address future challenges.

• Extensively build trust with cross-organizational stakeholders. Use data to influence without authority and drive consensus at all levels of an organization.

• Expertly quantify impact with best-in-class analytics and investigation techniques. Advanced Excel skills are a minimum expectation (Advanced SQL is a plus).

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- Knowledge of general AI tools
- Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions

descriptionHtml:

title: Software Development Engineer, Scaling Planner, CloudTune
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's CloudTune organization is seeking a Software Development Engineer to join the Scaling Planner team and contribute to our suite of products across Reactive and Proactive Scaling. Our systems automate capacity management for thousands of EC2-based Auto Scaling Groups across Amazon's Stores, Devices, and Other (SDO) organization.

Proactive Scaling is the forward-looking engine at the core of Scaling Planner - it ingests business forecasts, applies scaling formulas via the Capacity Calculator, and generates capacity recommendations before demand arrives. This is how Amazon prepares for its highest-stakes moments, including Prime Day, Black Friday, and other High Volume Events. Reactive Scaling is the backstop to unplanned changes in demand - when systems come under stress that scaling can help smooth, we step in and provide automated emergency relief by pulling from a centrally managed capacity pool when real-time metric thresholds are breached.

As Software Development Engineer, you will own the design, delivery, and operation of systems across this portfolio with a primary focus on Proactive Scaling. You will partner with scientists, capacity managers, and service owners to ensure Amazon's infrastructure is always right-sized at the right time - powering services behind Amazon.com, Alexa, Prime Video, and digital devices.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the design, implementation, and operation of Proactive Scaling services that generate capacity overrides using business forecasts, scaling formulas, and the Capacity Calculator.
- Build and improve the automated pipeline that calculates, schedules, and applies capacity recommendations for peak events and daily scaling across supported regions (IAD, PDX, DUB, FRA, ZAZ).
- Drive integration between Proactive Scaling, the Capacity Calculator (formerly CloudSpin), Fleet Management Console (FMC), and CloudTune Capacity Service (CCS) to deliver seamless, end-to-end capacity automation.
- Design and operate systems that support scaling formulas based on MWS metrics, CloudTune forecasts, and Apollo attributes for eligible EC2-based services.
- Define and monitor risk factors, efficiency metrics, and guardrails that trigger iterative improvements with customers to close automation gaps.
- Lead technical design reviews, author design documents, and influence the architectural direction of Proactive Scaling.
- Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, design guidance, and operational best practices.
- Maintain high operational standards, including on-call responsibilities, monitoring, alarming, and incident response for Proactive Scaling services.

About the team
Scaling Planner is CloudTune's capacity automation engine for Amazon's SDO organization. We ensure that thousands of EC2-based services have the right capacity at the right time - whether that means proactively scaling up for Prime Day or reactively absorbing an unexpected traffic surge. Our Proactive Scaling capability is what sets us apart: instead of reacting to traffic spikes, we predict them using advanced forecasting and automatically prepare infrastructure weeks in advance. Reactive Scaling complements this by providing an automated safety net when real-world conditions deviate from forecasts. We work closely with CloudTune Science, capacity management, and service owners across Amazon. We value ownership, operational excellence, and building systems that remove manual toil so Amazon's engineers can focus on their customers.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Implementation Engineer, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

The Role:
Be part of Amazon Leo’s sub-team responsible for defining and implementing the digital chip SOCs for communications via Low Earth Orbit satellites and Amazon gateways. This is a unique opportunity to define a groundbreaking wireless solution with few legacy constraints. The team works with customer requirements and wireless system teams to define modems, high-speed interfaces, embedded processors, and DSP solutions in latest CMOS generation technologies.

In this role you will:
• As the implementation engineer you will work with the ASIC design team to develop the chip power intent using UPF
• As the implementation lead you will work with the ASIC design team to validate UPF at RTL and netlist level using industry standard tools
• As the implementation lead you will set up the flow for both logic and physical synthesis flow for various technology nodes.
• Develop implementation methodologies while embracing AI flow.
• Work with the ASIC design and DFT teams to understand the design and create timing constraints.
• Check the RTL design for clean synthesis run, perform STA and LEC on netlist.
• Work with RFIC teams to make sure the top level integration of analog blocks are done properly and correct by construction, including formal connectivity checks.
• Work with P&R teams to ensure a smooth hand off of netlists, ensure the timely execution of the P&R responsibilities by that team.
• Participate in flow reviews of all the blocks with the P&R team to ensure that they achieve the best PPA for all blocks.
• Lead the timing sign-off for the post P&R database.
• Ensure that the chip meets the required DFM criteria by verifying the IR/EM results.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- 5+ years of experience in ASIC implementation, i.e., synthesis, STA and working with P&R for deep sub-micron nodes, preferably 16nm or smaller.
- Experience leading or solely developing the methodology and scripts for physical synthesis.
- Proven track record in taping out chips that have gone in to high volume production.
- Familiar with implementing chips that have multiple power islands and power gating.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's or Ph.D degree in Electrical / Communications Engineering.
- 7+ years of experience in ASIC implementation.
- Experience in leading physical design.
- Strong exposure to UPF flow for low power design.
- Strong written and verbal skills
- Experience of working in multi-site/multi-team environment

Key job responsibilities
Als Amazon Operations-Praktikant:in hast du die Möglichkeit, deine analytischen Fähigkeiten in wirkungsvollen Projekten anzuwenden, die die Funktionalität und den Service von Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen verbessern. Wichtige Aspekte der Rolle umfassen:

• Bewegung im Gebäude, um mit verschiedenen Teams zu interagieren. Das umfasst aktives Wissenssammeln durch Teilnahme an Aktivitäten wie Vorbesprechungen, Ablaufmeetings und Diskussionen mit dem Führungsteam und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Die Fähigkeit, sich im Arbeitsbereich zu orientieren und zwischen verschiedenen Bereichen zu wechseln, ist für diese Position unerlässlich.
• Flexibilität bei verschiedenen Arbeitszeiten und Schichtmustern nach Bedarf zeigen.
• Möglicher Umzug an den vorgesehenen Arbeitsort.


A day in the life
Unsere Praktika sind Bildungsmöglichkeiten, die es dir als unserer zukünftigen Führungskraft ermöglichen, zu entdecken, wie wir unsere Teams von Versandmitarbeiter:innen führen und entwickeln. Du tauchst in die schnelllebige, komplexe Welt unserer Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen ein und erlebst, wie unsere Führungskräfte ihre Teams einsetzen, um Kundenerwartungen zu erfüllen.

Du lernst, wie unsere Führungskräfte eine sichere, produktive Umgebung schaffen und das volle Potenzial ihrer Teams durch effektive Einbindung und Leistungsmanagement-Strategien nutzen. Das ist deine Chance, Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die dich zu einer lohnenden Karriere bei Amazon führen werden.


About the team
Praktikant:innen-Community:
• Als Amazon-Praktikant:in bist du Teil einer lebendigen, unterstützenden Community, die dein Wachstum und deine Entwicklung fördert. Du arbeitest mit Praktikant:innen aus der ganzen Welt zusammen, knüpfst Kontakte und nimmst an sozialen Veranstaltungen teil, um deinen Horizont zu erweitern. Du kannst auch spezialisierten Gruppen beitreten, die sich auf Bereiche wie Nachhaltigkeit konzentrieren, um deine vielfältigen Interessen zu erkunden.

Basic qualifications

title: Data Center Technician, Data Center Operations (DCO)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is growing rapidly, and we are looking for Data Center Technician to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team.
Data Center Operations designs, installs and maintains the world’s largest Computing Infrastructure. Our scope of work includes systems, repairing, dealing with issues, handling and tracking parts and assisting in Data Center maintenance. Amazon Data Centers are large-scale high-density centers where you will help change the face of Technology in the region.


Key job responsibilities
As Data Centre Operations Engineer, you will be the primary point of contact for internal customers. There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:

• You will troubleshoot technical issues on advanced hardware, ranging from servers, storage and networking devices on a 24/7 basis.
• You will maintain a high level of system reliability and availability.
• You will participate in projects to enhance operational efficiencies with opportunities to share experiences and knowledge with our global network of technical experts.
• You will share knowledge and help train less technical staff on the best practices related to all service owner issues
• You will contribute towards building a great team by getting involved in the Amazon hiring process/candidate interviews


A day in the life
As a successful Data Center Operations engineer, your day-to-day work will include:
• Installation and configurations on Data center Servers and Network systems
• Installation, troubleshooting and replacement of internal and external hardware parts of Servers and Network devices
• Work within a ticket-based environment and work on systematic problem resolution
• Work on rotational shift-based schedule to maintain high system reliability
• Collaborate with internal teams and share ideas and contribute in innovative projects to improve DC work environment and overall efficiencies.
• This is a physically active role, we are always on the move onsite.


About the team
About AWS
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. title: 2027 Pathways Internship – MBA & Master of Engineering | Operations Leadership | Spain
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on Earth. To get there, we are looking for Amazon's next generation of Senior Managers to join the Pathways Leadership Program in Amazon Operations.

The Pathways Leadership Internship is a 10-12 week full-time Internship in our operations network for enrolled MBA/MSc/MEng/PhD with 3+ years of experience in a complex role. You will be given a business critical challenge to find a solution for as well as gaining practical experience of being a leader of large teams. Your internship will conclude by presenting an innovative solution to senior management based on your observations, hands on involvement and analytical research within operations. Upon completion of the internship program, your performance will be evaluated. Your performance evaluation, along with role availability, will determine your opportunity to join the full-time Pathways program in 2028.

Our Pathways internship program requires a minimum of 10 working weeks between beginning of June and beginning of September in 2027. If it is not possible for you to obtain your visa/work permit maximum one week before your Day 1 with us, we may have no other choice than cancelling your internship under this program for the agreed cycle, but we will endeavor you the opportunity to re-interview for another internship or even for a permanent Amazon job in 2027, subject to availability.

About the Pathways Program

Pathways is a three-year program designed to rapidly develop experienced MBA and Master of Engineering-level graduates with the skills needed to be Amazon's next Senior Operations Managers and beyond. This is the opportunity to chart your own course. Pathway’s members are highly visible to senior leadership through an exclusive mentoring network. They have flexibility with changing roles, sites and geographies. Through a series of intense, progressively challenging opportunities in our best in class operations network, we will stretch your leadership capacity to its full potential. The business lessons you learn and credibility you develop will set you up for accelerated career growth and prepare you for future leadership opportunities within Amazon Operations and beyond.

Key job responsibilities

- Lead continuous improvement projects which could impact safety, productivity, quality and most importantly customer experience
- Develop standard operating procedures
- Direct accountability for setting and meeting operational goals

title: Programme de stage « Pathways » 2027 pour les étudiants en MBA ou en Master d'Ingénierie
descriptionHtml:
Chez Amazon, nous nous efforçons de devenir l'entreprise la plus centrée sur le client au monde. Pour y parvenir, nous recherchons la prochaine génération de cadres supérieurs d'Amazon qui rejoindront le programme de leadership Pathways dans le cadre des opérations Amazon.

Le stage de leadership Pathways est un stage à temps plein de 10 à 12 semaines dans notre réseau d'opérations pour les personnes inscrites à un MBA, une maîtrise, une maîtrise ou un doctorat ayant plus de 3 ans d'expérience dans un rôle complexe. Vous serez confrontée à un défi commercial critique pour trouver une solution et acquérir de l'expérience pratique en tant que leader de grandes équipes. Votre stage se terminera par la présentation d'une solution innovante à la haute direction sur la base de vos observations, de votre implication pratique et de vos recherches analytiques au sein des opérations. À la fin du programme de stage, vos performances seront évaluées. L'évaluation de vos performances, ainsi que la disponibilité des postes, détermineront votre opportunité de rejoindre le programme Pathways à plein temps en 2027.

Notre programme de stages Pathways nécessite un minimum de 10 semaines de travail entre début juin et début septembre. S'il n'est pas possible pour vous d'obtenir votre visa/permis de travail au maximum une semaine avant votre premier jour chez nous, nous n'aurons peut-être pas d'autre choix que d'annuler votre stage dans le cadre de ce programme pour le cycle convenu, mais nous ferons tout notre possible pour vous donner la possibilité de passer un nouvel entretien pour un autre stage ou même pour un poste permanent sur Amazon en 2028, sous réserve de disponibilité.

À propos du programme Pathways

Pathways est un programme de trois ans conçu pour former rapidement des diplômés expérimentés de niveau MBA et Master aux compétences nécessaires pour devenir les prochains directeurs des opérations supérieurs d'Amazon et au-delà. C'est l'occasion de tracer votre propre voie. Les membres de Pathway sont très visibles auprès de la haute direction grâce à un réseau de mentorat exclusif. Ils sont flexibles lorsqu'ils changent de rôle, de site et de zone géographique. Grâce à une série d'opportunités intenses et progressivement stimulantes au sein de notre réseau d'opérations de premier ordre, nous allons exploiter au maximum votre capacité de leadership. Les leçons commerciales que vous en tirez et la crédibilité que vous développez vous permettront d'accélérer votre carrière et de saisir de futures opportunités de leadership au sein d'Amazon Operations et au-delà.

Key job responsibilities
Les responsabilités incluent, sans s'y limiter :

- Diriger des projets d'amélioration continue susceptibles d'avoir un impact sur la sécurité, la productivité, la qualité et, surtout, l'expérience client
- Élaborer des procédures opérationnelles standard
- Responsabilité directe en matière de définition et d'atteinte des objectifs opérationnels
- Concepts standardisés en matière de portée et de conception
- Suivez les leaders des opérations pour découvrir ce qu'il faut pour devenir manager chez Amazon
- Avec le soutien de la direction, dirigez de grandes équipes pendant les différentes équipes
- Découvrez comment les dirigeants publient des évaluations économiques hebdomadaires de leurs sites et les aident à les préparer
- Collaborez avec la haute direction et les équipes d'assistance, notamment en matière de sécurité, d'ingénierie, de prévention des pertes, d'assurance qualité et de ressources humaines, afin d'élaborer des plans visant à atteindre les objectifs commerciaux


A day in the life
Ce poste est basé dans l'un de nos entrepôts en France. Les lieux sont sujets à changement.

Pour avoir un aperçu du fonctionnement de nos réseaux, rejoignez-nous pour une visite vidéo de l'un de nos centres de distribution :

https://www.amazontours.com/de/

Avantages

Les avantages peuvent varier selon le lieu de résidence, y compris, mais sans s'y limiter :
- Un programme de relocalisation
- Un code de réduction pour les employés
- Prestations pour soins familiaux
- Assurance-vie
- Programme d'assistance aux employés fournissant un soutien confidentiel gratuit en matière de santé mentale, d'événements de la vie, de vie quotidienne et de questions financières
- Prestations médicales à l'étranger pour les voyages d'affaires internationaux
- Des groupes d'affinité pour créer des communautés et rassembler les employés du monde entier (en savoir plus sur https://www.aboutamazon.com/affinity-groups)

Basic qualifications

- Actuellement inscrite à un MBA/PhD et disponible pendant 10 à 12 semaines entre juin et septembre pour travailler à plein temps
- Plus de 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle complexe (hors stages et études en alternance) en tant que responsable de la gestion et de la réalisation de projets
- Très bonne maîtrise du français (CECR B2) et de l'anglais au moment de la candidature
- Expérience dans la direction de projets ou d'équipes
- Expérience professionnelle dans les domaines de l'ingénierie, de la gestion, de la logistique, de la fabrication, des sciences ou dans tout autre domaine des STEM
- Flexible pour travailler selon des horaires non traditionnels, y compris la nuit et le week-end
- Ouvert à la relocalisation dans le pays dans lequel vous avez postulé pour travailler
- Capacités d'analyse et bon jugement commercial
- A réalisé des projets complexes, dans le cadre desquels vous avez dû impliquer des équipes et des dirigeants pour réaliser des initiatives ou des objectifs commerciaux

Preferred qualifications

- Aptitudes démontrables à prendre des décisions, vous permettant d'utiliser un raisonnement solide selon les besoins
- Expérience de gestion directe des employés et de leurs performances
- Expérience antérieure dans la définition, le suivi et l'amélioration de KPI ou de mesures similaires
- Expérience réussie en matière d'assistance à des clients internes ou externes
- Compétences interpersonnelles et de communication exceptionnelles (écrites et verbales)
- Connaissance des techniques et méthodologies Lean, Six Sigma ou Kaizen

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. Als Amazon Operations-Praktikant:in hast du die Möglichkeit, deine analytischen Fähigkeiten in wirkungsvollen Projekten anzuwenden, die die Funktionalität und den Service von Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen verbessern. Wichtige Aspekte der Rolle umfassen:
• Abschluss von Projekten mit hoher Priorität nach höchstem Standard und Nachweis deiner Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse zu liefern
• Datenanalyse zur Identifizierung operativer Herausforderungen und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten
• Vorschlagen und Testen von Lösungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team zur Umsetzung der effektivsten Ansätze
• Entwicklung von Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften, Stakeholdern und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Bewegung im Gebäude, um mit verschiedenen Teams zu interagieren. Das umfasst aktives Wissenssammeln durch Teilnahme an Aktivitäten wie Vorbesprechungen, Ablaufmeetings und Diskussionen mit dem Führungsteam und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Die Fähigkeit, sich im Arbeitsbereich zu orientieren und zwischen verschiedenen Bereichen zu wechseln, ist für diese Position unerlässlich.
• Flexibilität bei verschiedenen Arbeitszeiten und Schichtmustern nach Bedarf zeigen.
• Möglicher Umzug an den vorgesehenen Arbeitsort.


A day in the life
Unsere Praktika sind Bildungsmöglichkeiten, die es dir als unserer zukünftigen Führungskraft ermöglichen, zu entdecken, wie wir unsere Teams von Versandmitarbeiter:innen führen und entwickeln. Du tauchst in die schnelllebige, komplexe Welt unserer Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen ein und erlebst, wie unsere Führungskräfte ihre Teams einsetzen, um Kundenerwartungen zu erfüllen.
Dieses Praktikum versetzt dich ins Herz unserer Abläufe und ermöglicht es dir, den Weg einer Kundenbestellung zu verfolgen. Du erhältst einen realistischen Einblick in die Vollzeitchancen, die dich in unserem Unternehmen erwarten.
Du lernst, wie unsere Führungskräfte eine sichere, produktive Umgebung schaffen und das volle Potenzial ihrer Teams durch effektive Einbindung und Leistungsmanagement-Strategien nutzen. Das ist deine Chance, Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die dich zu einer lohnenden Karriere bei Amazon führen werden.


About the team
Praktikant:innen-Community:
• Als Amazon-Praktikant:in bist du Teil einer lebendigen, unterstützenden Community, die dein Wachstum und deine Entwicklung fördert. Du arbeitest mit Praktikant:innen aus der ganzen Welt zusammen, knüpfst Kontakte und nimmst an sozialen Veranstaltungen teil, um deinen Horizont zu erweitern. Du kannst auch spezialisierten Gruppen beitreten, die sich auf Bereiche wie Nachhaltigkeit konzentrieren, um deine vielfältigen Interessen zu erkunden.
Unterstützung:
• Das Praktikumsprogramm bietet ein robustes Unterstützungssystem, einschließlich wöchentlicher Praktikant:innen-Sprechstunden, spezieller IT- und HR-Unterstützung sowie einem Programmteam, das sich deinem Erfolg verschrieben hat. Das stellt sicher, dass du die Anleitung und Hilfe hast, die du zum Gedeihen brauchst.
Lernsessions:
• Exklusive Lernsessions werden deine Fähigkeiten weiter verbessern und dir Zugang zu Amazons modernsten Lernplattformen und der Expertise von Branchenführern gewähren. Diese strukturierten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bereiten dich auf den nächsten Schritt in deiner Karriere vor.
Möglichkeiten:
• Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss des Praktikums kannst du für eine Absolvent:innen-Stelle oder ein zweites Praktikum in Betracht gezogen werden, was es dir ermöglicht, deine Reise mit Amazon fortzusetzen. Zusätzlich erhältst du ein wettbewerbsfähiges Monatsgehalt, Umzugsunterstützung und Zugang zu einer Reihe von Mitarbeitervorteilen.
Praktikums-Starttermine über das Jahr:
