title: Senior Account Manager, Policing, AWS UK Central Government Team
descriptionHtml:
Would you like to be part of a team focused on increasing adoption of Amazon Web Services across UK Policing? Do you have the business acumen and technical background necessary to help establish Amazon as a key technology platform provider for law enforcement?

As an Account Manager in Policing, you will have the exciting opportunity to promote the growth and shape the future of cloud technology across UK policing bodies.

The ideal candidate will possess both a business and technical background that enables them to engage at Chief Constable, PCC, and CXO level, as well as with software developers and IT architects. You should be a self-starter who is prepared to develop and execute against a territory coverage plan aligned to national policing strategies.

To succeed in this role, you’ll need:

Experience building strategic relationships with stakeholders, including communicating and collaborating across teams and functions

Experience with pipeline management including utilisation of Salesforce or other CRM tools

Experience in account management, sales, or business development within policing, law enforcement, or public safety

Demonstrated experience working with UK police forces, the Home Office, NCA, College of Policing, or equivalent law enforcement bodies

A track record of managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles typical of policing and public sector procurement

We’d love it if you also bring:

An understanding of the UK policing landscape, including funding models (Home Office grants, PCC precepts), national programmes, and digital transformation drivers

Familiarity with decision-making structures across policing — Chief Constables, Police and Crime Commissioners, the NPCC, Home Office, CIOs, and procurement bodies

Awareness of sector challenges such as data-led policing, digital evidence management, cross-force interoperability, cloud migration, hybrid working, and operational efficiency

Knowledge of relevant procurement routes (Crown Commercial Service, BlueLight Commercial, G-Cloud, Digital Marketplace)

SC (Security Check) clearance or willingness to undergo clearance

The ability to navigate long, consensus-driven procurement cycles involving multiple stakeholders across forces and national bodies

Experience developing account plans aligned to policing strategies (e.g. National Policing Digital Strategy, Policing Vision 2030, force-level digital transformation programmes)

The ability to articulate technology value propositions in the context of policing outcomes — operational efficiency, data-led decision making, and citizen safety

Key job responsibilities
Promote AWS services across a defined territory of UK policing accounts

Develop and execute a comprehensive account and territory plan aligned to national policing priorities (e.g. National Policing Digital Strategy, Policing Vision 2030)

Create and articulate compelling value propositions around AWS services in the context of policing outcomes — including data-led policing, digital evidence management, and interoperability

Facilitate customer adoption of AWS services, navigating complex multi-stakeholder and cross-force procurement processes

Maintain a robust projects pipeline across new and existing policing accounts

Work with partners, systems integrators, and ISVs to extend reach and promote adoption

Contribute to a positive customer experience and build long-term trusted relationships across the policing ecosystem

Engage at senior levels including Chief Constables, Deputy Chief Constables, CIOs, CTOs, and Home Office officials

A day in the life
As an Account Manager in the Policing territory, no two days are the same. You might start the morning preparing for a strategic engagement with a Regional Police leadership team on their cloud-first Digital Policing Platform programme, before joining a cross-functional working session with Solutions Architects and partners to shape a proposal for a next-generation intelligence and analytics capability.

Your internal stakeholders include Solutions Architects, Professional Services, Partner teams, and Specialist sales overlays. Your customers are senior technology and operational leaders within police forces, national law enforcement agencies, Police and Crime Commissioners’ offices. The problems you solve span infrastructure modernisation, secure data sharing across forces, digital evidence management, data-led operational policing, and enabling the sector’s ambition to deliver safer communities through technology.

About the team
Policing is one of the most meaningful verticals in UK Public Sector. The customers you’ll work with are on the front line of keeping people safe, and the technology decisions they make have real-world impact. You’ll be joining a team that cares deeply about getting this right — and you’ll have the backing of the entire AWS ecosystem to help you do it.

We offer a collaborative, high-trust environment where you’ll have genuine ownership of your accounts and the freedom to build your territory your way. If you want to do work that matters, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Data Center Engineering. Operations Facility Manager, ADC InfraOps DCEO
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Data Center Facility Manager to serve as a technical resource and leader within Amazon data centers. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels of data center operations. The Data Center Facility Manager is responsible for the overall operation and maintenance of all electrical, mechanical, and HVAC equipment within the data center. The Data Center Facility Manager will assist in maintaining a high reliability and performance while keeping operating costs in facilities at a minimum. This equipment supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.

This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment such as stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems that include but not limited to switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAC units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire suppression systems, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US citizen and currently possess and maintain an active Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility.

Key job responsibilities
- Oversee all aspects of the data center's critical physical infrastructure. Ensure that all work performed within the space is done to high quality and without impact to internal/external customers
- Manage teams of 24x7 engineering technicians in all facets of their career
- Engage in improvement projects, often requiring reaching out to a variety of support teams, and drive them from conception to completion
- Coordinates daily with a multitude of third party vendors ensuring adherence to contracted SLAs
- Effectively and efficiently manage the operations budget and expenditures
- Routinely operate as the afterhours on-call Data Center Facility Manager for the data centers in the region. This will include responding to any issues within the data centers and managing the investigation, mitigation, and recovery of the issue(s).

Physical Requirements:
- Walk jobsites in uneven terrain.
- Work at heights and from ladders.
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or craw.
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more.
- Carry objects weighing up to 49 pounds for short distances
- Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration.
- Respond to off hour emergency calls.
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Coordinate body movements when using tools or equipment
- Reach and stretch to position equipment and fixtures while maintaining balance
- Bend or twist the body into unusual positions while working
- Perform physical tasks all day without becoming overly tired
- Use hands to manipulate small wires and objects
- Apply force quickly to objects and equipment
- Push or pull heavy objects into position
- Work in a noisy environment
- Work at depths, such as under raised floors

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of management/team lead function experience
- Current, active US Government Security Clearance of Top Secret or above
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- Current, active US Government Security Clearance of Top Secret with SCI eligibility or above

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- Experience in a management position with 5 or more direct reports
- 4+ years of work in data centers with an emphasis on building and equipment operation experience
- Experience in root cause analysis and troubleshooting or problem solving
- Experience in reading and understanding schematics and building drawings

title: Head of Regulatory Approvals, Australia, Prime Air
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Prime Air is building a drone delivery service that will safely get packages to customers in 30 minutes or less. As Prime Air evaluates Australia and other countries, we are hiring a Head of Regulatory Approvals, Australia — the person responsible for navigating Australia's aviation regulatory system and securing every approval required to deliver to Australian customers by drone.

This role owns the full spectrum of Australian regulatory approvals: drone system certification and type approvals under CASA's regulatory framework, airspace authorizations and flight permissions, and the operating certificates and compliance frameworks that govern Prime Air's flight operations in Australia. You will be the primary relationship owner with the Civil Aviation Safety Authority (CASA) and will coordinate closely with Airservices Australia, state and local planning authorities, and community stakeholders.

This role is based in Sydney or Canberra, AU, and reports to the Leader, Prime Air Expansion — Asia Pacific. You will work in close partnership with Prime Air's global regulatory, engineering, legal, and public policy teams. Your success will be measured by the approvals you obtain, the timelines you hit, and — ultimately — Australian customers receiving drone deliveries.

Key job responsibilities
1. Drone System & Type Approvals
- Lead Prime Air's engagement with CASA on drone system certification and approval, including type acceptance and special airworthiness certificates, coordinating with Prime Air engineering to develop and submit complete technical documentation packages.
- Manage regulatory dossiers end-to-end: track submission status, respond to CASA technical queries, and maintain audit-ready approval records.
- Monitor Australian drone certification developments and advise leadership on implications for Prime Air's certification strategy.

2. Airspace Integration & Approvals
- Obtain all airspace authorizations for Prime Air operations in Australia, including CASA flight approvals and controlled airspace waivers under CASR Parts 101 and 102; engage Airservices Australia on flight route and UTM integration.
- Work with state, territory, and local governments on ground-level approvals, community consultations, and land use permissions for Prime Air flight corridors.
- Maintain ongoing airspace compliance: manage permit renewals, boundary updates, and change notifications as operations scale.

3. Operating Approvals & Ongoing Compliance
- Obtain all operating certificates required for Prime Air to conduct drone delivery in Australia, and develop operations manuals and safety management system documentation meeting CASA requirements.
- Serve as Prime Air's primary regulatory interface with CASA post-approval: manage the relationship, respond to inquiries, and ensure ongoing compliance with all approval conditions.
- Track Australian drone regulatory developments; assess impact on Prime Air's approvals and brief leadership proactively.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in aerospace, aviation, or a closely related technical field — in roles involving regulatory engagement, program management, or technical operations.
- Background in aerospace or aviation sufficient to engage credibly with CASA on technical certification and airworthiness matters, and to interpret and apply Australian civil aviation regulatory requirements.
- Prior engagement with CASA or another national civil aviation authority on aviation or UAS/drone approvals, including preparation and submission of formal regulatory applications or technical dossiers.
- Familiarity with Australia's drone regulatory framework and Specific Operations Risk Assessments (SORA).
- Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Aviation, Engineering, Science, or a related technical or policy field; or equivalent professional experience.
- Must be based in or willing to relocate to Sydney or Canberra, AU.

Preferred qualifications

- Regulatory certification and compliance experience: Hands-on experience leading or supporting the certification, type approval, or operational approval of an aerospace or aviation product — drone, aircraft, avionics, or related system — through a national aviation authority. Familiarity with certification plan development, compliance demonstration, and managing authority review cycles.
- Direct CASA UAS/drone approval experience: Prior experience obtaining BVLOS approvals or drone operating certificates directly from CASA, including familiarity with CASA's RPAS regulatory team's documentation expectations and review process.
- Aerospace engineering background: A degree or professional background in aerospace engineering is a strong plus — particularly for candidates interfacing with CASA on airworthiness and technical certification questions. Not required if offset by equivalent regulatory experience.
- Existing CASA relationships: Established working relationships with CASA's RPAS regulatory team that can be leveraged to accelerate Prime Air's approval timelines and navigate ambiguous regulatory questions.
- Safety case authoring: Experience writing safety cases or SMS documentation for aviation or UAS operations to a standard acceptable to a national aviation authority.
- Advanced degree: Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Aviation, Law, Public Policy, or a related discipline.

title: Senior Program Planning & Scheduling Analyst
descriptionHtml:

It’s Day 1 for Amazon’s next billion-dollar business and the Kuiper Government Solutions (KGS) business is looking for an entrepreneurial minded Sr. Program Planning & Scheduling Analyst to work in a start-up environment who is passionate about technology, who thinks/acts globally, and has the ability to create and implement solutions, processes and controls with a focus on the public sector.

The KGS team is focused on Government customers around the world, including U.S. DoD and other national security customers.

The successful candidate will be responsible for executing day-to-day program planning & scheduling tasks within KGS, providing qualitative and quantitative data analysis for program performance management, ensuring the business meets critical deliverables, program schedules (Integrated Master Schedule), as well as risk and opportunity tracking, management, and mitigation.

This leader will work cross-functionally alongside the program finance team, as well as the program management and engineering teams to ensure Government-funded programs are tracked and performed on cost and schedule.

As KGS grows and takes on more complex contract types, the successful candidate will be responsible for performing Earned Value Management (EVM) activities. While still in the start-up phase, KGS will be tracking EVM "lite" metrics from an internal management perspective for program performance.

The program planning organization will have responsibility for aligning our product roadmaps with Kuiper availability, ensuring we have products Government customers can use when Kuiper service comes online.

title: Network Infrastructure Eng I, Amazon Dedicated Cloud
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Network Infrastructure Engineer to build Amazon Dedicated Cloud regions as part of our Infrastructure Operations team. As dedicated cloud regions continue to expand and grow, Infrastructure Operations is looking for builders to take on the challenge of scaling network systems allowing us to stay ahead of customer demand.

As a Network Infrastructure Engineer, you will work in a dynamic environment to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and assist in the development of innovative ways to automate and scale our network. The position's responsibilities include scaling support of several data center locations and day to day assistance with capacity management. Engineers will work closely with internal customers and external vendors to facilitate smooth project execution as directed by Technical Program Managers.

The ideal candidate should be highly autonomous, very detail oriented, possess strong written and verbal communication skills and have significant experience in supporting large scale, enterprise class networks. Excellent network implementation and troubleshooting skills combined with a proven documentation methodology is also required. The desire and ability to work in a fast paced, collaborative environment is essential. In addition to providing top-tier management and support of Amazon’s vast network infrastructure, Network Infrastructure Engineers are expected to build or enhance tools, develop best practices, refine operational procedures and think proactively.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
- Clearly communicate project status and blockers to leadership and project management.
- Perform device build and cabling validation activities.
- Manage cabling vendor activities and performing quality assurance activities.
- Support Network Engineering deployment activities during scheduled change management windows and participate in the migration (possibly off business hrs), basic configuration and rollout of new or upgraded hardware
- Complete customer requests via Remedy trouble ticketing system
- Troubleshoot networking, routing and inter connectivity issues, including troubleshooting of network device configuration and low-level application interaction.
- Deliver simple, sustainable and repeatable solutions and processes.
- Manage work and priorities through ticketing system and workflow and Collaborate with various stakeholders to remove project obstacles
- Travel within geographical work area is required, up to 40% travel outside traditional work area may be required possibly including international travel and experience with small project scopes and ambiguous details within a relevant work environment

A day in the life
A day in the life of a Network Infrastructure Engineer on our team includes attending meetings, creating and executing change management activities in the data center, deploying hardware, connecting cabling, troubleshooting links, updating tickets, working with peers from all across AWS to innovate and develop, and finding new ways to do it all better for our customers.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

- 1+ years of network cabling, fiber optics, and test equipment including VFL, power meter, and OTDR experience
- Experience with networking fundamentals

- General comprehension of the various components and sub-components of data center infrastructure

title: Principal Product Marketing Manager, Ads Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Come build the future with us! What unites all Amazonians (across teams and geographies) is that we are all striving to delight customers and make their lives easier. Amazon Ads is dedicated to driving measurable outcomes for brand advertisers, agencies, authors, publishers, and entrepreneurs. Our ad solutions leverage Amazon's innovations and insights to find, attract, and engage intended audiences throughout their daily journeys.

We're seeking a strategic and customer-obsessed Product Marketing Manager to join our Ads Product Marketing team. In this role, you'll serve as a critical bridge between product development and go-to-market execution, helping unify how advertisers discover, plan, and activate campaigns across Amazon's full portfolio of advertising surfaces — from streaming and video to display, audio, and sponsored placements.

The advertising industry is shifting from format-by-format buying to outcome-driven activation. Advertisers increasingly expect a single system that starts from their business objective and optimizes across surfaces, rather than requiring them to navigate separate products and workflows. As a Product Marketing Manager, you'll help translate this omnichannel vision into clear, compelling narratives that resonate with advertisers and internal stakeholders alike. You'll partner closely with Product Management, Go-to-Market, and cross-functional teams to shape how we position and bring to market solutions that simplify the buying experience, connect measurement across formats, and help advertisers achieve outcomes at scale — whether they're managing campaigns manually or through automated, objective-first workflows.

Your work will sit at the intersection of several critical industry dynamics: the rise of outcome-based automation, the growing accessibility of cross-channel measurement tools, and the increasing demand for simplified campaign setup that removes complexity on behalf of the advertiser. You'll need to synthesize customer research, competitive intelligence, and product strategy into go-to-market plans that articulate not just what our products do, but how they work together as a unified system.

The ideal candidate combines analytical rigor with creative storytelling, thrives in ambiguous environments, and has a proven track record of launching products that achieve measurable business impact. You'll need to balance strategic thinking with tactical execution, moving seamlessly from conducting advertiser research to developing sales enablement materials to presenting product vision to senior leadership.

Key job responsibilities
Conduct in-depth research and competitive analysis to identify the most promising opportunities for Amazon Ads products, including how cross-format and outcome-based buying trends are reshaping advertiser expectations.

Communicate the product vision and direction to internal and external stakeholders, establishing a regular cadence of engagement that connects individual product narratives and workstreams to a cohesive omnichannel story.

Partner with Product Managers to recommend customer feedback prioritization, support effective Alpha/Beta testing, and refine the strategic roadmap — particularly where multiple products intersect or where the advertiser experience spans campaign types.

Align GTM strategy to the product roadmap, translate complex cross-surface product capabilities into simple and clear language, and continue to gather customer feedback post-launch to inform how products work together and where the unified experience can improve.

Develop single-source-of-truth documentation to enable sales and marketing with positioning, messaging, product availability, best practices, implementation guides, and FAQs — with an emphasis on articulating the value of multi-format activation and simplified, objective-first buying.



Basic qualifications

- 9+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience driving direction and alignment with cross-functional teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with creating GTM initiatives at scale
- Experience working cross-functionally across marketing, product management, analytics, UX, and research

title: Senior Account Executive , North America, Fulfilled By Merchant Business Development
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking a dynamic and motivated Senior Account Executive for our Selling Partner Services team (sell.amazon.com), supporting the North America Fulfilled by Merchant (FBM) organization. This role is chartered with building and managing a pipeline of high-value seller accounts and executing consultative sales and account management strategies that deliver results against bold growth goals.

You will own the full engagement lifecycle for strategic sellers who fulfill orders from their own warehouses, helping them adopt Amazon's automation tools and Amazon-managed fulfillment solutions. The core of the work is diagnostic and solutions-focused: analyzing a seller's shipping and delivery performance, identifying the gaps that slow their delivery promises, and guiding them to changes that shorten click-to-delivery times, protect their account health, and unlock incremental sales.

Success in this role means building trusted relationships with key decision-makers inside seller organizations, partnering with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams (product, tech, and program), and translating seller pain points into compelling, data-backed recommendations. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy in an ambiguous, fast-moving space and act as a voice of the seller back into Amazon.

The ideal candidate brings 5+ years of successful B2B sales or account management experience, preferably in e-commerce, logistics, retail technology, supply chain, or SaaS. Demonstrated success exceeding targets through a consultative, data-driven approach is required, and experience selling nascent products or services into new markets is a strong plus. Candidates must have excellent communication and presentation skills, be comfortable working with data in Excel to build a narrative, thrive in ambiguity, and bring a genuine passion for continuous improvement through collaboration. A bachelor's degree is required.

Key job responsibilities
- Drive a portfolio of high-value seller accounts end to end, from identification and outreach through adoption and launch, consistently surpassing ambitious revenue and adoption targets.
- Influence senior decision-makers within seller organizations, establishing yourself as the strategic authority on fulfillment and delivery performance.
- Diagnose complex shipping and delivery gaps through rigorous data analysis, uncovering root causes that others miss.
- Architect and sell tailored solutions using automation tools and Amazon-managed fulfillment, tying every recommendation to measurable business impact such as faster delivery promises, stronger account health, and incremental sales.
- Lead cross-functional partners across product, tech, and program to break down barriers and accelerate results.
- Champion the voice of the seller, surfacing recurring pain points and opportunities to shape product and program roadmaps.
- Own pipeline accuracy and forecasting in Salesforce, using data to prioritize effort and report on results.
- Operate with a high degree of autonomy in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment, and continuously refine your approach through experimentation and collaboration.

A day in the life
No two days look the same, and that's by design. You own your book of business, so where you invest your time is a strategic decision, not a checklist.

You might open the day inside a seller's shipping data, spotting a pattern in their delivery promises that's quietly costing them sales, then shaping that insight into a recommendation they can't ignore. By midday you're leading a consultative conversation with senior seller leadership, reframing how they think about fulfillment and earning their commitment to change.

In the afternoon you partner with a product team to escalate a pain point you've diagnosed across multiple accounts, influencing the roadmap with evidence, not opinion. Throughout, you're deciding where to go deep and where to move on.

You thrive in ambiguity, make judgment calls without a playbook, and are measured not by activity, but by the outcomes you drive and the trust you build.

About the team
We are the North America Strategic MFN (Merchant Fulfilled Network) team, part of Selling Partner Services. We partner with sellers who fulfill orders from their own warehouses, helping them use Amazon's automation tools and Amazon-managed fulfillment solutions to deliver faster, protect their account health, and grow their business.

We work in a fast-moving, ambiguous space where the playbook is still being written, which means the ideas you bring genuinely shape how the program evolves. We value diverse perspectives, learning through experimentation, and supporting each other. We take our work seriously, and we take care of each other while we do it.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 7+ years of B2B or enterprise sales with a focus on hunting new business experience
- Experience proactively growing customer relationships within an account while expanding their understanding of the customer's business
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in e-commerce (sales or marketing)
- Experience communicating clearly and concisely with leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams
- Experience building cross-functional partnerships and influencing stakeholders across the organization to act without having a direct reporting relationship
- Experience in e-commerce, logistics, supply chain, retail technology, or SaaS.

descriptionHtml:
We are a smart team of doers that work passionately to apply new advances in technology and to solve real-world problems that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we can’t even imagine yet. As an Automation Engineer you will help develop and deploy our standard automation control system onto assembly automation machines at vendor and contract-manufacturer sites, from configuration & commissioning through a running production line. You will have the opportunity to work with a wide variety of technologies from AI models to robotics and custom automated manufacturing systems. You will own the quality of major deliverables end-to-end, working closely with multiple engineers and teams to execute them.

Key job responsibilities
As an Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for driving world class manufacturing software solutions to scale assembly automation globally. This will involve architecting, innovating software solutions for assembly processes, explore new technologies, implementing and scaling it globally. You will be driving the development working alongside team members from Asia pacific. You will be the main interface between the hardware, Contract Manufacturers (CMs) and Product Design Engineering teams; with local and Offshore Operations teams within Lab126 and our OEM partners.

A day in the life
• Design and develop scalable software architectures to program assembly automation solutions. This involves creating machine sequences (state machines, process flows) using AI assistants, validating AI-generated code and configuration (device drivers, hardware/connection config, production UI/HMI) to meet production quality standards.
• Perform root cause analysis, troubleshoot live hardware to optimize manufacturing performance
• Scale automation solutions working closely with Contract Manufacturers (CMs)
• Document software code, specifications for internal and external stakeholders.
• Train CM engineers to operate, extend, and troubleshoot the system independently.
• Create standardized reports for recurring issues and platform gaps back to the core platform and AI-tooling teams.

About the team
You will be working with highly skilled individuals with varying skills and backgrounds from China and US. Partner teams will look to you to solve complex issues using automation and come up with new ways to improve the overall product design to delight our customers.

Basic qualifications

- Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems, or experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Experience communicating clearly and concisely with leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams
- Experience working on and delivering end to end projects independently
- 5+ years of industrial controls and automation experience, or Bachelor's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering, engineering technology or equivalent
- Hands-on experience with assembly-automation hardware and drivers/protocols: robots, vision systems, motion controllers, barcode/DIO/conveyors, over TCP/Serial/EtherCAT/Modbus/OPC UA.
- Ability to evaluate code and config (e.g., C#, XML) and resolve errors before they reach a production line.
- Comfort with AI-assisted workflows: writing clear specs/prompts, reviewing generated artifacts, and iterating with AI assistants.

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechatronics, computer science. or equivalent
- 3+ years of embedded software engineering experience, including standards, reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- PLC programming experience (Structured Text, register maps, Modbus/OPC UA).
- Prior field-service or commissioning experience on assembly lines.
- MES integration and data-tracking exposure.
- Experience training or mentoring engineers.

title: Sr. Product Design Mechanical Engineer, Data Center Engineering - Electrical Products and Services
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.


You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.


Within Infrastructure Services and Data Center Engineering, the Electrical Products and Services team is developing resilient electrical distribution products and systems. Our designs are fundamentally changing the data center, providing operational and financial benefits that are critical to the success of the AWS business and its millions of customers. Our engineers solve challenging technology problems and take big bets on new concepts, enabling AWS services to continue to revolutionize the industry.


We're seeking a Senior Product Design Mechanical Engineer to own end to end product design and development of electrical power distribution equipment such as Low Voltage Switchgear and Power Distribution Cabinets. You will directly lead product design and development and be a part of the process from concept to implementation. You must be capable of defining equipment specifications and evaluating the merit of design changes. The ideal candidate brings experience working on end to end electro-mechanical product design and manufacturing.


This position requires approximately 30% travel to AWS offices, data centers, suppliers, vendors, and product validation sites. While most travel is domestic, some international travel may be required.


Open to hiring this position in Austin, Atlanta, Columbus, Northern Virginia or Seattle.

Key job responsibilities
- Work with internal partner teams to solicit customer input and define design requirements for product design.
- Lead new product design, development and qualification of critical electrical power distribution equipment for AWS data centers including LV and MV switchgear, power distribution cabinets and panels.
- Ensure compliance with UL, CSA, IEC and federal, state and municipal requirements and building codes across different countries through appropriate levels of testing.
- Validate design through prototype, pre-production and first-of-kind builds, conducting DFx and value engineering analysis through each step and updating design and documentation.
- Work with field engineering and commissioning teams to properly test and validate installation, operation, and performance of electrical products.
- Ability to provide support for manufacturing activities for the new products on concurrent projects in multiple geographical locations.
- Be a leader within the product development team as well as within internal and external teams that support the data center.

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

#DCE_P&S

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production.
- 10+ years leading new product design, development, testing and manufacturing support of electronic components.

Preferred qualifications

- Professional Engineering or Architectural License
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents

title: Software Engineer III, AWS Elastic Block Store (EBS) Data Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services is looking for senior engineers to help us define and build the future of computing. The AWS Elastic Block Store (EBS) service delivers high performance virtualized storage "in the cloud" for EC2. Data service offerings are the differentiating factor that drive customer adoption of AWS and EBS within public cloud marketplace. As a member of the EBS team you'll work alongside bar-raising engineers and leaders to develop and operate one of the largest distributed storage systems in the world. We strive to delight our customers with features that simplify their business and operational workflows while staying conformant to security and performance requirements

Key job responsibilities
You will work with a high performance C++ software stack to reduce latency measured at microsecond scale. You will design and solve for performance, availability and scalability problems. You will have opportunities to develop software on the latest platforms and drive the roadmap for the next generation. You will have an immediate impact on millions of customers, improving their experience as their applications run in the AWS Cloud.

A day in the life
You will collaborate with and learn from the industry's best minds to solve interesting and challenging problems at an enormous scale on a daily basis. This collaboration extends beyond just the team in EBS. You will have the opportunity to work with many other teams in AWS to build a secure, performant, and reliable system.

About the team
The AWS Elastic Block Store (EBS) Data Services team is comprised of a diverse set of deep systems level software experts. We are responsible for the movement and transformation of data between the EBS storage primitives of volumes and snapshots. We own everything from the long term roadmap, design, implementation, and testing to the day to day monitoring and observability of the system.

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Project Manager, Technology Deployment, Global Energy, sustainability, and Automation
descriptionHtml:
The Global Energy, Sustainability, and Automation team is seeking an experienced and highly organized Project Manager to lead the deployment of infrastructure technologies across Amazon's fulfillment and logistics network.

The Tech Deployment team serves as a scalable execution function for infrastructure and technology programs across Amazon's operational facilities. The team partners with engineering, operations, construction, technology teams, vendors, and other stakeholders to deploy solutions spanning electrical infrastructure, HVAC and building systems, controls and automation, metering, sensing and location technologies, and other emerging infrastructure technologies.

In this role, you will manage multiple concurrent deployment programs from planning through field execution, validation, and operational handoff. You will translate technical requirements into executable deployment plans, coordinate vendors and internal stakeholders, manage schedule and execution risks, and establish repeatable processes that enable technologies to scale across a large and geographically distributed portfolio.

The successful candidate will have experience delivering complex technical or infrastructure projects and operating effectively in environments with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and evolving technical requirements. Experience with electrical systems, HVAC, controls and automation, material handling equipment, sensing technologies, or other building and operational infrastructure is preferred.

This role requires a self-starter who can independently manage multiple projects, identify and resolve execution barriers, and influence stakeholders across organizational boundaries. The candidate must also demonstrate the ability to quickly understand unfamiliar technologies and technical requirements sufficiently to lead their successful deployment.

This is a travel-based role. Travel across North America of up to 50% or more may be required depending on project needs.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage multiple concurrent technology and infrastructure deployment programs from planning through implementation, validation, and operational handoff.
- Develop deployment strategies, project plans, schedules, milestones, and execution mechanisms that enable repeatable deployment across multiple sites.
- Translate engineering and technical requirements into executable field deployment plans in partnership with engineering teams, vendors, contractors, and site stakeholders.
- Coordinate internal and external stakeholders to ensure projects are executed safely, on schedule, and in accordance with technical requirements.
- Manage vendors and contractors, including performance, quality, schedule adherence, execution risks, and corrective actions.
- Manage escalations, installation deviations, field constraints, and rework, driving issues through resolution with appropriate technical and business stakeholders.
- Analyze deployment and audit data, including vendor KPIs, installation quality, schedule performance, and other execution metrics, to identify systemic issues and opportunities for improvement.
- Develop working knowledge of technical systems and facilitate root-cause analysis and issue resolution when deployment challenges arise.
- Work across hardware, software, controls, networking, and physical infrastructure interfaces where required to support successful technology integration.
- Develop mechanisms, standard work, documentation, and best practices that improve deployment consistency, quality, and scalability.
- Provide clear program updates, risk assessments, escalation paths, and recommendations to senior leadership and execution teams.
- Use data and metrics to evaluate deployment performance and identify opportunities to improve processes, resources, vendor performance, and execution models.
- Build effective partnerships across engineering, operations, construction, procurement, technology teams, and other global stakeholders to support long-term scalability of deployment programs.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience working cross-functionally across several teams both technical and non-technical
- Experience in project management including resource planning, managing schedules, reporting project status and prioritizing tasks
- 3+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
- Experience managing and coordinating multiple projects simultaneously

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
- PMP certificate
- Experience building scalable programs and repeatable scalable processes, levering various tools and methods to create scale and efficiency
- Experience working with multiple groups of stakeholders
- Experience with one or more infrastructure domains such as electrical systems, HVAC, controls and automation, material handling equipment, metering, sensing technologies, networking, or building systems.
- Experience operating in a geographically distributed, multi-site environment.

title: HR Business Partner, Sub-Same Day Fulfillment Centers
descriptionHtml:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People eXperience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. The HR Business Partner provides HR generalist support to a large population of hourly employees and business leaders, bringing expertise in leadership development, employee experience, and operational excellence.

In this role, you will partner with business leaders to deliver HR initiatives focused on talent management, employee engagement, and internal customer service. Success requires leveraging data-driven insights and understanding the importance of HR metrics to drive business impact. You may also lead a team of entry-level HR employees and own projects that enhance the employee experience.

The HR Business Partner balances strategic and tactical responsibilities, driving organizational success through partnership with leaders. They execute core PXT processes while providing guidance on talent processes, performance management, and cultural initiatives. By building trust and influence through sound business acumen, they manage increasingly complex issues and deliver solutions that enhance both employee experience and business outcomes.

You will be expected to work onsite at an Amazon facility.

Key job responsibilities
- Improve site effectiveness by identifying systemic patterns, addressing root causes, and making high-judgment decisions that align with policy intent while minimizing risk. Establish and implement mechanisms that ensure consistent, fair application of policies while maintaining compliance with evolving regulations.

- Use data analytics to identify emerging trends, predict future challenges, and implement proactive solutions at the site level. Turn insights into practical initiatives that drive measurable improvements in employee experience and business performance.

- Execute and monitor employee engagement strategies and recognition programs. Maintain meaningful floor presence to gather insights, identify early signs of disengagement, and partner with leaders to drive targeted improvements.

- Coach Business Leaders on effective people management practices, including performance feedback, team development, and complex employee relations matters. Support leaders in building inclusive, high-performing teams.

- Partner with leaders to ensure equitable talent practices across selection, development, and advancement decisions. Champion initiatives that create an inclusive environment where all employees can thrive.

- Drive adoption of HR technology solutions, AI, and self-service tools, ensuring effective utilization while maintaining focus on high-touch service delivery in critical moments. Identify opportunities to enhance user experience and process efficiency.

A day in the life
Your day will be a dynamic blend of strategic thinking and data-driven decision-making. You'll focus on driving organizational effectiveness and employee engagement, leveraging advanced analytics and AI-enabled tools to identify trends, anticipate business needs, and develop solutions that enhance workplace experience and deliver measurable results.

From coaching leadership teams on workforce and talent management to driving HR process excellence, you'll collaborate with business leaders to develop forward-looking strategies focused on operational objectives and team effectiveness. You'll build strong partnerships across all levels of the organization while contributing to meaningful workplace improvements.

Success in this role comes from your ability to navigate organizational dynamics, lead change initiatives, and make high-judgment decisions in ambiguous situations. Through a combination of business acumen, data-driven insights, and strategic partnerships, you'll help create a workplace culture where employees feel valued and empowered, while driving long-term organizational success and adaptability in a rapidly evolving business landscape.

About the team
Sub-Same Day Fulfillment Centers (SSD-FC) are an integral part of meeting Amazon’s customer promise through Prime same-day delivery. In tandem with its Rapid and Rural Logistics business parallels, these locations strive to serve over 80% of Prime customer demands across North America. – And with people at the heart of it all, our commitment to provide HR functional excellence continues and grows.

Known as People, Experience and Technology (PXT) , our HR team members are present onsite to help drive tactical leadership direction, while providing top-notch internal customer support. PXT teams are flexible, thoughtful, socially responsible, and are always planning for the future.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- 2+ years of human resources or equivalent (e.g., operations, customer service, retail, distribution, shipping/logistics, healthcare, hospitality, manufacturing) experience
- Experience supporting or leading employee-focused processes including onboarding, benefits, investigations, training or talent management

Preferred qualifications

- Master's Degree or MBA
- Experience supporting operational environments (manufacturing, distribution, or similar)
- Ability to effectively train, guide, and support others in the use of various HR technologies and digital platforms, with a focus on increasing user adoption and enhancing end-user experience
- Demonstrated ability to build effective partnerships with business leaders
- Experience handling employee relations matters and conducting workplace investigations
- Strong coaching and influencing skills with ability to guide leaders through complex situations
- Experience supporting employee engagement and development initiatives with measurable impacts on employee retention or satisfaction

title: HR Partner, Human Resources, AMZL
descriptionHtml:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People eXperience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. The HR Partner role offers an exceptional opportunity to build your career in human resources, focusing on employee experience, engagement, leadership development and HR operational excellence.

As an HR Partner on the (AMZL) PXT team, you will support PXT operations through consistent standard work execution, relationship-building, and timely issue resolution. With a visible presence across site operations, you'll foster team culture, support engagement, and coach leaders on PXT practices. You'll create positive employee experiences while building your skills in navigating increasingly complex issues and influencing without authority. Success in this role comes from building strong partnerships, demonstrating sound judgment, and maintaining a customer-centric approach. You'll learn to use data-driven insights and HR technologies to enhance the employee experience while developing core HR capabilities that will serve as the foundation for your career growth.

You will be expected to work onsite at an Amazon facility.

Key job responsibilities
- Support a positive employee experience by executing key programs, reinforcing workplace standards, and partnering with PXT and Operations to create a culture where employees feel valued, heard, and supported.

- Execute standard work with consistent quality and timeliness, meeting established service level agreements (SLAs) and maintaining accurate documentation of HR processes and employee interactions.

- Provide frontline employee support by responding to inquiries, addressing concerns, and ensuring appropriate resolution or escalation of employee matters. Handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.

- Assist in running and monitoring feedback channels such as roundtables, floor walks, and employee engagement activities. Support issue tracking and follow-up, partnering with senior PXT team members to drive resolutions and improvements in employee experience.

- Coach frontline leaders on behaviors that impact engagement and retention. Reinforce expectations and guide leaders in selecting and effectively utilizing available tools to improve team communication, recognition, and performance conversations.

- Support the execution of site-level engagement, communication, and culture-building initiatives. Coordinate logistics, gather feedback, and monitor effectiveness.

- Learn to track and summarize PXT-related data (e.g., attrition/attendance trends, hiring data, employee sentiment). Help prepare insights for site reviews or team discussions.

- Promote the use of self-service tools to resolve routine employee and manager questions. Help identify recurring gaps and escalate opportunities to improve tool usability or adoption.

A day in the life
A typical day involves balancing standard work execution with responsive employee support. You'll maintain consistent presence on the operations floor, engaging directly with hourly employees and partnering with leaders to address concerns and drive engagement initiatives. Operating under the guidance of senior team members, you'll execute core HR processes while ensuring quality service delivery.

Through data tools and HR technologies, you'll assist in tracking metrics and identifying trends, while developing your ability to build trust through personal interaction. You'll support employee engagement activities, help coordinate feedback channels, and assist in coaching and development of others. When complex issues arise, you'll seek guidance from senior team members, learning to navigate challenging situations while developing sound judgment.

title: Principal Product Manager Tech, Product Quality
descriptionHtml:
Amazon customers expect every product they purchase to be authentic and to meet the highest quality standards. The Product Quality team harnesses AI and technology to prevent quality complaints before they happen, and to respond proportionally when issues arise, ensuring customers receive products that are as described, in the condition and functionality they expect, while trustworthy selling partners thrive. We care deeply about our selling partners' success, and the experience they have with our policies and decisions. We work to ensure every decision is clear, fair, and easy to resolve for our well-intentioned selling partners.

As a Principal Product Manager, Technical for PQ Seller Experience, you will own how selling partners experience product quality policy and enforcement across Amazon. You will define the unified seller experience that sits above any single program vertical, establishing the common language, evidence standard, and remediation paths. You will own the vision for the end to end seller journey across enforcement, appeals, and reinstatement, and you will set the standards that make every quality decision explainable, consistent, and resolvable in the seller's own workflow. This is a highly ambiguous, high impact charter that requires clarity, problem framing, and building the frameworks and tenets that enable organizational action.

This charter requires a deep understanding of selling partner experience. You will drive alignment across partner teams, policy owners, and enforcement teams that each own a piece of the seller journey, holding a single, consistent product direction spanning multiple organizations. Working alongside Principal Engineers, you will own the technical direction for how policy is encoded once and served consistently to both the systems that enforce it and the surfaces that explain it to sellers. This is the connective product leadership that delivers a seamless experience for our selling partners.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the 3 to 5 year product vision and roadmap for the product quality seller experience, and where opportunity and strategy are undefined, drive clarity and create the frameworks and tenets that enable organizational action.

- Own the selling partner experience across all PQ enforcements as one coherent surface, developing recognized expertise through direct engagement with senior decision makers, and define a unified seller journey so that the right decision reaches the right seller with clarity, consistency, and a resolvable path.

- Own the explainability and communication standard for product quality as an organizational standard, establishing the structured evidence contract and quality bar every enforcement decision must meet, and replacing static templated communications with policy grounded, context aware messaging delivered to selling partners.

- Drive alignment across the multiple partner organizations that author, enforce, and communicate quality policy at the senior leadership level, integrating their policies and systems onto a common knowledge layer and a single seller experience, and serving as the senior product voice for the seller experience across those organizations.

- Author strategic narratives, including PR/FAQs, vision documents, and investment proposals, own the executive review mechanisms such as MBRs and QBRs that measure progress against seller trust, contact reduction, and quality outcomes, and define the success criteria that distinguish output, outcome, and guardrail metrics for the seller experience.

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

- Experience technical product management

- Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement

title: Corporate Counsel, Japan Operations Legal
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Japan Legal seeks an experienced attorney to support our rapidly growing transportation business in Japan, with a primary focus on the last mile delivery business. You will advise the business on commercial, regulatory, and compliance matters while working alongside the latest AI tools.

Amazon Japan Legal is looking for an experienced, smart, and motivated attorney to support our rapidly growing transportation and logistics business in Japan. The position reports to the operation and logistics legal lead in Japan.

The Operations Legal team supports Amazon's global logistics and transportation business that fulfills orders and delivers packages to customers. We advise on the infrastructure, transportation networks, and technology that make deliveries happen; from transporting items into and out of fulfillment sites, to middle-mile linehaul, to delivering packages to the customer's doorstep through our channels. Operations Legal plays a key role in the innovation and technology that make Amazon's products and services best in class.

This position will be responsible for supporting Amazon's rapidly growing transportation and delivery business in Japan, with a primary focus on last-mile delivery, including new and innovative businesses and services. You will serve as the primary lawyer responsible for counseling the business on a broad range of commercial, regulatory, and compliance matters across transportation and delivery in Japan. You will work directly with the business, serving as counsel on compliance challenges arising from the rapidly evolving regulatory environment; advising on strategic deals and on the launch of new products and services; negotiating, structuring, and drafting complex commercial transactions; coordinating with public policy and engaging with regulators to influence pending legislation and rule-making and in response to regulatory inquiries; and advising on compliance requirements and assisting the business in designing and implementing risk-tested and scalable compliance. You will also advise on cutting-edge legal questions at the frontier of delivery, including new types of delivery vehicles and delivery methods enabled by the latest technology.

At Amazon, you will work alongside the latest AI and Generative AI (GenAI) tools that are increasingly woven into how legal teams operate, from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate research and analysis to GenAI that helps you focus on the work that matters most. You will have the opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into our culture.

This position will be based in Amazon Japan's Meguro office.


Key job responsibilities
• Serve as the primary legal counsel for Amazon's last-mile delivery operations in Japan.
• Draft, structure, and negotiate complex commercial agreements across transportation, delivery, and supply chain, including delivery partner, carrier, and logistics service agreements.
• Advise on regulatory and compliance matters under Japan's transportation and logistics framework, including trucking and vehicle-for-hire regulations, subcontracting and freelance-related rules, and labor and safety requirements.
• Counsel business teams on the launch of new delivery products, services, and operating models.
• Partner with public policy to engage regulators on pending legislation and rule-making and to respond to regulatory inquiries.
• Identify legal risks in a fast-changing environment and design scalable, risk-tested compliance mechanisms.

A day in the life
A typical day involves providing practical, business-focused legal support across a range of commercial and regulatory matters in the transportation and delivery space. You will draft and negotiate agreements with delivery and logistics partners, advise internal stakeholders on the transportation program and new delivery models, and manage ongoing legal and regulatory risks in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. You will work closely with operations, program, and public policy teams, and use the latest AI tools to work more efficiently and focus on high-judgment work.

- Experience troubleshooting and repairing operational items
- Knowledge of mathematics
- Experience measurement reading and interpretation
- Work flexible schedules including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- Experience conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures
- Experience troubleshooting and diagnosing material handling equipment (MHE)

title: Area Manager
descriptionHtml:
Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. As an Area Manager, you’ll make sure your site is running as smoothly as it should so that we can meet customer demand. You will be leading a team that helps keep our operations safe, efficient, and of a high quality and taking on a number of projects across our network to drive productivity.

Key job responsibilities
- Promote a culture of safety and wellbeing
- Analyse and implement corrective actions to make sure quality and productivity are at consistently high levels, and business objectives are met across all shifts
- Support and lead a team and handle administrative work alongside building and supporting a strong team culture
- Analyse performance and suggest process improvements to optimise work and improve customer service

A day in the life
You’ll work shifts and be based at one of our sortation centers. Your main focus will be to maintain safety standards within your team and across your site. You’ll also monitor and maintain process efficiency. Being a key part of the operations team involves working with colleagues in other teams and external partners to make sure we stay on track to meet our customer demands and targets. About the team

Using air, sea and road transport, as well as sortation centres equipped with the latest technology, you’ll help Amazon’s transport run at maximum efficiency. Our team captures data and uses it to drive decisions. They are key to making Amazon more innovative and efficient.
We put safety first as our people are our priority. And we use the expertise of our people to get packages to their destination – quickly, conveniently and sustainably.

title: Solutions Architect Public Sector, German Speaker, Greenfield
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we are inventing the future of cloud computing with a team of builders who try new things and dream big dreams. Our web services provide a platform for IT infrastructure in the cloud that is used by hundreds of thousands of developers and businesses around the world.
We are seeking a German-speaking Solutions Architect to join the World Wide Public Sector (WWPS) Greenfield team based in London. In this role, you will help new-to-cloud public sector customers across the UK, Germany and International Organization. accelerate their cloud journey on AWS. You will serve as the primary technical point of contact for German-speaking public sector customers, conducting discovery sessions, designing foundational architectures, and building trusted relationships that drive long-term cloud adoption.
The Greenfield SA function focuses on proactive customer engagement: helping customers move beyond reactive technical needs toward strategic cloud adoption. You will partner closely with Account Executives across The UK and Germany territories to develop engagement strategies and deliver outcomes.

Key job responsibilities
• Serve as the technical point of contact for new-to-cloud public sector customers in the UK, Germany and international organizations, guiding them from first workload to production.
• Conduct technical discovery sessions in English and German to understand customer pain points and recommend AWS-based solutions.
• Partner with Account Executives on territory planning, account prioritization, and customer engagement strategies across the UK, Germany and international organizations.
• Design and present foundational cloud architectures aligned with customer business outcomes and public sector requirements in both markets.
• Build repeatable plays and enablement assets for common customer scenarios (cost optimization, compliance, legacy migration).
• Evangelize AWS technology through workshops, proof-of-concept engagements, and technical content in English and German.
• Navigate German public sector procurement and compliance requirements alongside EU and UK specific procurement frameworks.
• Contribute to the growth of the Greenfield SA organization through mentorship, knowledge sharing, and operational best practices.
• Share the voice of the customer to influence the roadmap for new AWS features and services.


A day in the life
You partner with Account Executives to break into new public-sector accounts — translating agency missions into technical strategies that land first workloads on AWS. Your days blend research (understanding an agency's IT landscape, compliance posture, and modernization drivers) with hands-on engagement: leading technical discovery calls, whiteboarding architectures, building proof-of-concept demos, and crafting migration roadmaps that give prospects confidence to move forward. You help AEs navigate complex procurement cycles by articulating technical differentiators in RFI/RFP responses, and you coordinate with AWS service teams, partner SIs, and security specialists to assemble the right solution. You maintain technical win plans for your accounts, contribute to pipeline reviews with data-driven assessments, and stay current on AWS services so you can match emerging capabilities to customer problems. The role rewards curiosity, builder instincts, and the ability to earn trust fast with technical and executive audiences alike.

About the team
The WWPS Greenfield SA team accelerates cloud adoption for public sector customers who are new to AWS. We pair Solutions Architects with dedicated Account Executives across defined territories to create structured, proactive engagement models. Our SAs participate in a structured Greenfield Academy covering SA-AM engagement models, go-to-market strategy, discovery, and customer-facing best practices.

- Speak, write, and read fluently in German
- Experience within specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics).

- Experience in IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, computer engineering, or related field
- Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
