title: Design Verification Lead, Nitro Team
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs is the team behind AWS Nitro, the purpose-built system that powers the security, performance, and innovation of every EC2 instance. We operate like a start-up with the scale of the world's largest cloud provider.

We're looking for a Design Verification Team Lead - a design verification technical lead that is responsible for complex SoC sub-system, with cutting edge technology for Nitro system SoC, the foundation of AWS's virtualization, networking, and storage offload infrastructure.

It starts at product definition - we engage from day one, shaping requirements and translating product intent into verification strategies before a single line of RTL is written

It extends into software - we work side-by-side with SW teams, verifying hardware-software interfaces and ensuring seamless integration across the stack, with particular emphasis on networking workloads such as ENA and EFA

It reaches into physical design - we verify physical design aspects within functional verification, bridging the gap between logical correctness and silicon reality

It closes the loop - from spec to silicon, our verification touches every team and every stage of chip development

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and execute verification plans for IO sub-systems - covering interconnect protocols, peripheral interfaces, and system-level integration with a strong connection to networking flows (ENA/EFA)

- Verify IO sub-system features, including interconnect protocols and various accelerator engines

- Develop and debug C embedded SW as part of hardware-software integration verification

- Build and maintain UVM-based verification environments for various clusters and sub-systems

- Verify ARM advanced interconnect protocols (AMBA CHI/ACE/AXI) ensuring correct coherency transactions, performance verification, and protocol compliance

- Verify the IO virtualization SMMU/TLB operations, page table walks, translation granules, and memory attributes (cache-ability, share-ability)

- Develop constrained-random and directed test strategies targeting corner cases in IO protocol hazards, coherency races, and system boundary conditions

- Drive coverage closure using functional coverage models, assertion-based verification, and formal methods where applicable

- Contribute to performance verification - ensuring micro-architectural implementations meet performance targets alongside correctness

A day in the life
As a Design Verification Team Lead on the Nitro team, you will be responsible for leading the verification of complex SoC sub-systems, driving industry-leading verification methodologies, and ensuring our next-generation Nitro system SoC meets the highest quality bar before reaching silicon.

About the team
What Sets Us Apart?

Full system ownership - our verification leaders gain deep understanding of all system flows and the full SW stack, truly owning the technical scope from product definition through post-tapeout activities. This end-to-end ownership is what defines verification at Annapurna Labs

Agentic AI is embedded in our workflow - not as an experiment, but as a core part of how we design and verify chips

Cutting edge methodologies drive every stage of our verification process

Relentless innovation - we don't settle; we actively seek new approaches that raise the bar on silicon quality

We do classic functional verification (SV/UVM/TLM), but beyond that, we touch physical design aspects, to ensure that the quality of our silicon is beyond logical functionality

Performance optimization at all levels is at the heart of our targets on top of logical correctness verification

Our verification underpins the infrastructure that runs millions of active workloads across AWS, where networking performance and security are non-negotiable

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in design verification of complex SoC or ASIC projects
- Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate across design, software, and physical design teams
- Proven track record leading verification of IO sub-systems, interconnect fabrics, or system-level integration blocks
- Deep expertise in UVM/SystemVerilog-based verification environments
- Experience driving verification from product definition through post-tapeout silicon validation
- Experience with performance verification methodologies alongside functional correctness

Preferred qualifications

- Strong knowledge of ARM interconnect protocols (AMBA CHI/ACE/AXI) and coherency verification
- Experience with IO virtualization verification (SMMU, TLB, page table walks, memory attributes)
- C/C++ embedded software programming and firmware-level debug skills
- Experience with hardware-software co-verification
- Familiarity with networking data paths and offload architectures
- Understanding of physical design aspects and their impact on functional verification (e.g., clock domain crossings, power-aware verification)

title: Principal Partner Marketing Manager, Global Consulting Partner Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a talented, self-directed Principal Partner Marketing leader to drive joint strategic planning, thought leadership, and demand generation with Global System Integrator (GSI) partners and Business Consulting and Advisory Partners (BCAP) globally.

This is a senior marketing leadership position responsible for developing complex, enterprise-level marketing strategies and enabling the execution of programs that have significant cross-organizational impact and require C-suite level influence with strategic partners.

The role demands deep business knowledge to drive organizational alignment and growth, to establish marketing best practices, and to influence investment priorities across multiple stakeholder groups.
The position requires exceptional judgment in handling ambiguous situations, building consensus across global AWS and partner teams. Successful candidates must have prior experience in marketing and business development, working at a top technology vendor, a global system integrator, or a business consulting and advisory partner, and must use this understanding to align our partners and AWS business objectives.


Key job responsibilities
• Define global Partner Marketing strategy in alignment with the field, enabling complex programs with broad cross-organizational impact and C-level influence
• Operate with complete autonomy on strategic initiatives, defining vision and strategy in undefined problem spaces
• Make strategic trade-offs between opportunity, resources, and long-term AWS and partner outcomes
• Represent complex strategic decisions to senior leadership (SVP level), articulating trade-offs and options with exceptional clarity
• Identify and mitigate risks before they become roadblocks
• Work directly with senior executives in our partners to build marketing strategy and joint-marketing plans that drive customer acquisition and revenue growth from AWS and partner services
• Develop deep knowledge of partner business objectives and investment priorities to inform and evolve strategy and execution effectiveness

title: Operations Manager, Operations Manager, Vizag
descriptionHtml:
About Amazon


At Amazon, we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven leaders with unique experiences and skills to advance our innovative culture. If you would like to help us build the place to find anything from A-Z, this is your chance to make history.

The Workforce Staffing (WFS) team is looking for a non-exempt Staffing Coordinator. The Staffing Coordinators are the primary candidate facing members of our field teams, serving in both executional and decision making roles. Staffing Coordinators will be responsible for ensuring that our candidates and stakeholders experience the highest level of Customer Obsession. In this high volume hiring space, you will support staffing project initiatives, daily assignments, and general task completion. In this multi-purpose role; you will execute candidate engagement and optimization for a defined geography (node). The Staffing Coordinator will focus on owning the tactical development and delivery of community engagement plans, supporting labor demand plans for multiple sites across the node, and execution of candidate engagement activities. You will be an analytical thinker who can see around corners and demonstrate a passion for process improvement, candidate experience and onboarding process improvement. You will work with a team of Staffing Coordinators who thrive in an innovative, fast-paced environment. Our WFS node teams work flexible schedules, shifts, and areas to include evenings. We roll up our sleeves, work hard, have fun and make history!

The WFS Staffing Coordinator – key responsibilities:

· Serves as the lead to pre plan, execute, and audit New Hiring Events (NHE) based on labor projections to meet the labor order demands and fill on-time. Completes post-event audit of event and communicates event metrics to staffing leadership
· Meets critical deadlines for initiating background screening and completing drug test process to achieve labor orders
· Ensures 100% compliance for work authorization documentation for associates
· Consults with applicants on the best match for their desired position and available opportunities in Node
· Guides applicants through the hiring process in accordance with Amazon’s policies and procedures
· Effectively executes NHE activities including Greeter, Welcome Event Presenter, Candidate Care Specialist, Computer Assistance, Badge Photo, and/or Drug Test Administrator
· Serves as the lead to pre plan, execute, and audit New Hire Orientation (NHO) (proctored) or (virtual). Communicates and coordinates with site HR and Operations Leadership team for proctored NHO greeting. Completes post-even audit of proctored NHO event and communicates event metrics to site and staffing leadership
· Utilizes Applicant Tracking System to move candidates through the application process and updates appointment arrival status for NHE and NHO
· Initiates Candidate onboarding and matching them to the proper requisition
· Resolves candidate escalation issues by contacting them to identify issues, offering to reschedule them, or assisting candidates who are having virtual NHO technology issues, or assistance with any other concerns
· Partners with Staffing Manager to support community groups such as workforce development agencies or local community colleges to leverage grassroots sourcing channels to develop talent communities to fill positions
· Contacts candidates with cleared contingencies in order to eliminate risk of not meeting labor orders
· Ensures all documents are scanned into the digital file management system
· Trains Staffing Coordinators, Staffing Administrators, and Staffing Ambassadors on best practices and ensure standard work is followed
· Maintains confidentially on candidate sensitive topics.
· Tracks and maintains statistics on effectiveness of Recruitment through weekly reports on recruiting data for presentation to HR leadership and business partners
· Must be able to travel as needed to conduct events in various locations within your designated Node or assigned geographical area. Transports NHE supplies and materials to/from off-site hiring events
· Staffing Coordinators are required to work a flexible schedule. This means a varying shifts to include evenings and weekends in multiple sites. Overtime may also be required to support the needs of the business
· Local travel up to 75% required – National travel up to 10% of the time

About You

The basic qualifications, we require:
· A completed Bachelor’s degree or 2+ years of internal Amazon experience in lieu of degree
· Experience in a fast paced, customer oriented environment, such as operations, administrative support, customer service, retail, hospitality, staffing, recruiting, human resources or other related field
· Intermediate to advanced level proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word and Excel) required

· Prior experience working in Human Resources, Staffing, or Recruiting is preferred

title: Controls Engineer, EMEA Controls
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to keep the cloud running at a time of rapid growth? Amazon Web Services (AWS) Infrastructure Services is expanding its data center footprint, and we need a Controls Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and improving the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS) that govern the mechanical and electrical infrastructure of our data centers. You will plan and execute preventive and corrective maintenance, manage improvement projects, and collaborate with operations teams to ensure our facilities run safely and reliably.

This is a compelling time to join: you will have the opportunity to shape controls standards from the ground up while driving improvements across an expanding portfolio. If you are a self-starter who thrives on solving complex technical problems and wants to grow your expertise in mission-critical infrastructure, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Plan, coordinate, and perform preventive and corrective maintenance on BMS and EPMS systems, adjusting work plans based on equipment conditions and risk assessments to maintain safe, reliable data center operations.
- Manage the scope, schedule, and execution of controls improvement projects, including developing the sequence of operations (SOO), modifying controls logic programming, and commissioning new systems during data center builds.
- Troubleshoot complex mechanical and electrical control issues across generators, switchgear, chillers, cooling towers, and related infrastructure, escalating abnormal conditions when necessary and acting as an escalation point during incidents.
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders, design teams, and external vendors to review maintenance outcomes, align on project deliverables, and ensure all work complies with applicable codes and standards.
- Contribute to process improvements and provide hands-on training to less-experienced team members on equipment operation, BMS/EPMS configuration, and technical best practices.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing maintenance actions and aligning priorities with your facility manager. Much of your time is spent on the data center floor — inspecting equipment, validating controls sequences, and working alongside vendors to commission new systems or resolve open issues. Between site visits you collaborate remotely with design and project teams, reviewing drawings, updating logic programming, and reporting progress to stakeholders. As part of a global on-call rotation, you also stay prepared to provide immediate technical support when the unexpected happens.

About the team
Our controls team sits within AWS Infrastructure Services, the organization that designs, builds, and operates all of AWS's global data center infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running — ensuring the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling systems our customers depend on are always available. The team is growing quickly and playing a central role in delivering reliable infrastructure at scale.

You will work alongside engineers, operations managers, and supply chain specialists in an inclusive culture that encourages bold ideas and continuous learning. You will have real impact on the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- Experience in vendor management
- Experience in a data center or other critical environment
- Experience with Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
- Experience in project management

Preferred qualifications

- Electrical or mechanical Journeyman License
- operating engineering license such as DC II, DC III, or equivalent
- Experience in construction or project management

title: Data Center Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.
Data Center Technician position involves in-depth hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair as well as participating in an on-call rotation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
- Performing server rack installations, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, and carrying out routine network, server hardware, and operating system repairs to contribute to the overall availability of AWS services
- Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors
- Performing on-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities
- Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues
- Helping to interview, train and onboard new team members

Physical Requirements:
- Lifting and moving material up to 40 pounds each
- Working in cramped and/or elevated locations
- Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching
- Standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation
- Work in an industrial environment
- Work shifts longer than 8 hours to support 24/7 operations (covering both night and day shifts).
- This role supports data centers in various o perational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
Our Data Center Technician professionals, who have industry-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while they:

- Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution
- Show a strong aptitude for troubleshooting and problem solving
- Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context
- Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting
- Are biased to act in the absence of direction or support
- Improve effectiveness through process innovation
You will be required to work shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of computer/server hardware troubleshooting experience, or experience related IT
- 2+ years of computer layer 1/2 networking (including troubleshooting and repair) experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of network design, protocols and troubleshooting
- Knowledge of Linux/Unix Administration
- Bachelor's degree in an IT-related field (e.g., Computer Science, Network Engineering), or experience in professional or military IT-related roles
- Experience in a data center or other critical environment
- Experience training and onboarding of new team members

title: Data Center Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.

Data Center Technicians should be willing to work both independently and with a team. Work prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to success. In addition to hardware and network repair, candidates will install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix problems within the data center space. This team works in an environment that operates 24/7. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
- Performing server rack installations, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, and responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, escalating to senior technicians and management as needed/required
- Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors
- Performing on-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities
- Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues
- Helping to train and onboard new team members

Physical requirements:

- Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
- Working in cramped and/or elevated locations
- Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching
- Standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation
- Work in a noisy environment
- Work shifts longer than 8 hours to support 24/7 operations (covering both night and day shifts).

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

-Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution
-Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context
-Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting

You will be required to work shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon operates the world's most complex supply chain — fulfilling global demand for hundreds of millions of products at lighting fast delivery speeds. A core part of making this possible is predicting the future: How much will customers order? How long will new inventory take to arrive? What is the long-term customer impact of changes in availability and delivery speed? And much more.

We address these questions through state-of-the-art machine learning systems that generate hundreds of millions of fine-grained predictions. These forecasts are automatically consumed by systems that order, store, and route inventory — ensuring customers find the products they want, when they need them, and delivered faster than ever. And we're focused on doing it faster than ever

title: Applied Scientist, AI Security
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an Applied Scientist to join our AI Security team, which builds AI-based security analysis services that identify, validate, and help remediate vulnerabilities in Amazon source code and cloud configurations. The team combines large language models, security knowledge, code analysis, and security-engineer feedback to help builder teams detect security issues earlier in development and maintain security coverage across Amazon.

As an Applied Scientist, you will research, model, design, and implement machine learning and agentic systems that reason over source code, infrastructure, and security context. You will collaborate with applied scientists, security engineers, software engineers, internal partners, and external researchers to improve finding precision, severity assessment, remediation quality, and continuous scanning coverage. Your work will enable continuous, AI-driven security analysis across Amazon’s software estate, converting source-code and infrastructure signals into validated, prioritized findings and proposed fixes that help builders prevent security defects from reaching production.

Key job responsibilities
• Research and develop accurate and scalable methods to solve our hardest AI security problems
• Lead cross-functional work with applied scientists, software engineers, and security engineers to develop models and technical designs for AI systems that analyze source code, validate security findings, and generate remediation guidance at Amazon scale.


About the team
As an Applied Scientist on the AI Security team, you will research, develop, evaluate, and productionize models that identify security vulnerabilities in source code and cloud configurations. You will design experiments, build evaluation datasets and metrics, and apply large language models, program analysis, and security knowledge to improve finding precision, severity assessment, and remediation quality. You will work with applied scientists, security engineers, and software engineers to deliver systems that convert security signals into validated, prioritized findings and proposed fixes for builder teams across Amazon.

Your work will shape how Amazon identifies and addresses security defects throughout the software development lifecycle. You will investigate model behavior, analyze failure modes, develop methods to improve recall and precision, and measure the impact of new capabilities before deployment. The role provides opportunities to solve applied machine learning problems across source code, infrastructure, cloud services, and security operations.

About the team

The AI Security team develops systems that analyze source code and cloud configurations to identify, validate, and help remediate security vulnerabilities. We combine large language models, security engineering, automated evaluation, and feedback from builders and security engineers to improve security coverage across Amazon. The team works on problems including vulnerability detection, severity assessment, false-positive reduction, remediation generation, continuous scanning, and security-data analysis.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values varied professional and life experiences. We encourage candidates from traditional and nontraditional career paths, including candidates early in their careers and candidates with alternative technical backgrounds, to apply.

Why Amazon Security?

Security is central to customer trust and Amazon’s products and services. Our organization establishes and maintains security standards across Amazon. Team members build experience across cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture

Amazon Security brings together people with different experiences, technical backgrounds, and perspectives. We invest in learning opportunities and create space for teams to examine security problems from multiple viewpoints.

Training and Career Growth

The team provides knowledge-sharing, technical training, mentorship, and opportunities to work across security domains. Applied Scientists can deepen their expertise in machine learning, security research, evaluation systems, and production AI services.

title: Data Center Engineering Principal Engineer, Data Center Engineering Principal Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on Earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people.

Amazon’s AWS Data Centers are a major component of worldwide cloud-computing infrastructure and are industry leading examples of mission critical facilities. The pace, scale, and growth of Amazon’s data center platform will challenge you. Our uncompromisingly high standards as we continually seek to innovate on behalf of our customers will push you to new levels of creativity.

The Infrastructure Operations organization is looking for an extraordinary individual with proven and tested technical acumen and leadership skills to lead our Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) for AMER. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels of data center operations.

A DCEO Principal Engineer is one of our most senior leadership roles in the data center environment. As engineers at Amazon we are responsible for achieving a world class uptime for our customers. In this role you will be responsible for leading the overall infrastructure management (e.g. electrical, mechanical, and HVAC systems) and be accountable for delivering operational excellence in the areas of safety, security, availability of an expanding portfolio of AWS data centers. The role requires a highly driven, self-managed individual who demonstrates initiative and proactively seeks innovative solutions to highly complex technical problems. This role reports directly to the Director of AMER Operations.

The DCEO Principal Engineer is a leader and evangelist, working with and leading cross-functional teams which include: technical program management, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, control engineering, supply chain management, operations, end users as well as safety and security teams.

The ideal candidate should be able to operate comfortably at an strategic and tactical level. It requires the individual to be able to see the big picture, guide, direct, educate, and develop members of the team while at times shifting to being hands-on on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment such as stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems that include but not limited to switchgear, transfer controllers, UPS units, PDUs, battery technologies and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAC units, centrifugal chillers, EVAP, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment includes fire suppression systems, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States)

Key job responsibilities
- Drive a safety-first culture that is underpinned by Amazon Leadership Principles and the utmost regard for adherence to standard operating procedures, operational excellence, and continuous improvement mindset;

- Be a leader within the Data Center engineering staff across the region, including engineering technicians, chief engineers, facility and area managers;

- Partner with senior leaders and DCEO cluster managers to drive prevention of Large Scale Events and Critical Site Events. Review and advise on technical work, support with event management, and help lead the strategic direction and improvements of our DCEO organization;

- Work with construction and commissioning teams to properly test and validate installation, operation, and performance of mechanical, electrical and plumbing (MEP) systems.

- Maintain existing IT, mechanical, electrical infrastructure as well as pioneer new technology and processes. Work with internal teams to understand design requirements, solicit customer input, and drive innovative infrastructure solutions within business constraints;

- For issues that arise in data centers, provide support and guidance to the teams involved in root-cause analysis, mitigation and remediation strategies, sharing lessons learned with global partners, and support with long-term corrective measures including reporting and documentation.

- Act as a mentor and subject matter expert to operations staff through one-on-one coaching and mentoring.

- Actively oversees and plans infrastructure goals for key initiatives and metrics that support service availability and Data Center management

- Works independently and has frequent reviews with business leadership, other Principal Engineers and Senior Engineers across AWS.

- Communicate clearly and effectively at the appropriate level of detail with people from a wide range of technical abilities and backgrounds.

- Have fun while offering creative, out of the box solutions.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance, or 10+ years of data center or mission critical facilities (example: hospital, military facility, public safety facility, etc.) experience
- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or a related field
- Professional Engineering registration, or 5+ years of managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience motivating others to meet the daily challenges of an extremely deadline-driven environment
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience working with customers with a passion for delivering exceptional service
- Experience with large-scale technical operations or large-scale compute farms
- Experience performing complex business case analysis to justify technical decisions and presenting the justification to management in a high-level review
- Knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and controls systems for critical infrastructures
- Knowledge of IT system hardware and network concepts

title: RF Comms Systems Integration and Test Engineer, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

As a RF Comms Systems Integration and Test Engineer, you will work with a wide variety of functional groups and will be deeply involved in system integration and test of next generation Amazon Leo Satellites.

The Role:

This is a unique opportunity to define a groundbreaking, high-throughput wireless solution with few legacy constraints meet with 3GPP standards. The team works with customer requirements and wireless implementation teams to bring-up, integration and tuning, and debugging of advanced PHY/MAC and beamforming radio systems for state-of-the-art satellite communication system.

In this role you will:
• As a technical contributor, be at the forefront of bring-up, integration, and debugging of advanced PHY/MAC and beamforming radio systems for state-of-the-art satellite communication system.
• Architect, document, and execute 3GPP based testing for satellite to ground networks. Work with vendors to define equipment requirements to achieve 3GPP conformance testing. Ability to adapt test plans daily based on capabilities of HW/SW delivered by the dev teams.
• Collaborate across disciplines—including PHY algorithms, RF design, digital beamforming and antenna, MAC, and firmware teams - to ensure seamless integration and best-in-class wireless performance.
• Understand Doppler pre and post compensation techniques with CFO/SFO in LEO comms systems and test them in the laboratory environment for 3GPP. Knowing channel emulators is a plus.
• Ability to trade link budget and verify RF line-up for payloads in RF and IF configurations.
• Characterize performance, analyze data, root-cause system-level issues, and ensure high product quality.
• Work with a team and take responsibility for power, clock, RF, air, network debugging in lab.
• Contribute development-test bring up procedures with Linux, Python, bash scripting etc.
• Experience with wireless synchronization and signal generators / spectrum analyzers to verify that time/frequency requirements are being met.
• Experience, knowledge and skills on wireless system design, integration, bring up and debug of wireless PHY and RF systems on SoC platforms.
• Strong understanding of OFDM and MIMO-based wireless systems across both baseband and RF domains, with a solid foundation in related communication theory and signal processing.

title: Analyst, Network Strategy and Performance, Network Strategy and Performance
descriptionHtml:
As an Analyst within the Network Strategy Performance team, you will own analytics that directly shape where and how Amazon serves customers globally. You will model network scenarios spanning 100+ sites across 40+ countries, inform multi-year investment decisions, and deliver insights that influence headcount allocation, site strategy, and contact routing for one of the world's largest customer service networks.

This isn't a reporting role — you'll tackle ambiguous, high-stakes questions: Where should we expand next? How do we balance cost-to-serve against customer experience across geographies? What's the optimal site mix for the next three years? Your analysis will flow directly into monthly, OP and 3YP cycles that leadership uses to allocate resources.

You will partner closely with Operations, Products, FP&A, and Service Delivery teams — identifying gaps, measuring performance, and driving automation and process improvement initiatives. You will contribute to the team's AI-driven transformation agenda by applying AI tools to increase the speed, quality, and scale of analytical outputs.


Key job responsibilities
- Own analytical inputs for network planning — model contact allocation scenarios, site investment options, and capacity strategies across geographies. Build and maintain the frameworks that determine how millions of weekly customer contacts are distributed across the global CS network, coordinating with Finance, and Service Delivery teams to ensure alignment with cost and CX targets.
- Translate complex or ambiguous network strategy questions into structured analysis — e.g., site expansion feasibility, cost-to-serve trade-offs, regional performance variance. Dive into the heart of ambiguous problems with non-defined inputs and outputs, identify root causes driving site or network-level performance gaps, and derive recommendations that influence headcount allocation, site investment, and network architecture decisions.
- Independently apply AI tools (e.g., Amazon Q, generative AI assistants, AgentZ) to accelerate analytical workflows, identifying opportunities to improve speed and quality of planning outputs. Develop side-of-desk automation for repetitive tasks within your workstream, demonstrating measurable productivity improvement.
- Design, implement, and support self-service analytics platforms that provide business teams with ad-hoc access to large datasets. Drive automation of data requirements by scaling data processes, creating dashboards, and building efficient queries across diverse data sources (contact volumes, productivity metrics, cost data, CX scores) to provide a holistic view of network performance.
- Communicate complex analytical insights and translate network performance data into clear narratives for Finance, Service delivery and senior leadership. Present analysis to leadership audiences with clarity and conviction. Participate in strategic and tactical planning discussions (OP, 3YP, QXG), producing well-structured documents that tie conclusions to business outcomes.

About the team
The Network Strategy and Performance (NSP) team defines and delivers the right human-assisted support to Amazon customers under demand and labor supply volatility, by optimizing the Amazon Customer Service (CS) network for customer experience, associate experience, and cost. We are responsible for: (1) planning customer support staffing; (2) preserving the customer experience when customers contact Customer Service; and (3) ensuring best costs for providing customer support.

We analyze historical data and anticipate potential business events to accurately predict the number of Customer Service Associates (CSAs) required for a given period. Our areas of expertise span forecasting, planning, optimization, data analytics, execution and reporting. We deliver our vision using operations research, data science, and program management — and we continue to challenge the status quo, invent and simplify, and deliver excellence for our customers.

The Network Performance team is on a transformation journey. We are building a future-ready team that combines analytical rigor with AI fluency, executive-level communication, and the ability to drive outcomes across organizational boundaries. We are seeking a Analyst to join this team and help shape how Amazon plans, staff, and optimizes its Customer Service network.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- 2+ years of supply chain experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization

This role pairs long-term strategic planning with the challenge of reacting quickly to new threat scenarios. You will set direction for a team of security professionals, evolve the security assurance process they run on, and — critically — define how we measure whether that process is actually working. As we transform the role of security from a point-in-time gate into a continuous, outcome-driven discipline, you will be responsible for building the metrics and data analysis that show how your team is performing, where the risk actually lies, and whether the security bar is rising over time.

As a Security Engineering Manager, you speak authoritatively on behalf of your team, and your technical knowledge demonstrates both depth and breadth. You are responsible for your team's structure and how it operates within the larger AWS Security organization — leveraging the strengths of individual engineers, delegating appropriately, and managing delivery of long-term projects. You have deep knowledge in application security, are a sought-after thought leader across the organization, and actively participate in the organization's planning processes. You will provide clear technical direction and risk-mitigation guidance to engineering and business leaders at every level, and you will be comfortable diving into complex engineering discussions to ensure proper risk assessment and threat analysis is performed.

Measurement is central to this role. You will define metrics that quickly and accurately present your team's performance and variance against its goals, use data to understand input drivers and where to invest, and communicate status and results effectively across the division. You will coordinate and contribute to cross-AWS security initiatives, and you will foster the professional growth of your engineers — seeking out stretch assignments and developing the next generation of security leaders on your team.

- Set the strategy for raising the application security bar across your area, and evolve the security assurance process your team operates
- Define metrics and data analysis to measure team performance, security outcomes, and whether the security bar is rising — moving beyond activity counts to demonstrated risk reduction
- Own security reviews, threat modeling, and penetration test coordination for your portfolio
- Drive and contribute to cross-AWS security initiatives, communicating status and results across the organization
- Manage recruiting, team composition, and hiring bar for your area
- Identify and deliver process and operational improvements that scale the team's review capacity
- Directly represent the organization to business leaders and technical staff at all levels
- Demonstrate reliable judgment, integrity, business acumen, and mature communication skills

-Reviewing your team's active security reviews and threat models, unblocking engineers and weighing in on the highest-risk or most ambiguous findings
-Digging into the data on how your team is performing — review throughput, SLA adherence, finding quality, and risk reduced — and deciding where to invest next
-Coaching and developing your engineers through 1:1s, stretch assignments, and hands-on technical guidance
-Partnering with service and business teams to guide penetration test coordination and drive remediation of security issues
-Providing clear technical direction and risk-mitigation guidance to engineering and business leaders across the organization
-Setting and evolving the strategy for how your team raises the application security bar as the business grows and threats change
-Contributing to cross-AWS security initiatives and representing your team's work and results to leadership

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Help shape how Whole Foods Market merchants plan, forecast, and make decisions, and put AI-powered tools in their hands to do it better. As a Senior Product Manager, you'll own the product strategy for intelligent automation, next-generation forecasting models, and the data foundations that connect them. You'll work at the intersection of AI/ML, merchant experience, and supply chain data to build capabilities that fundamentally change how category managers operate across one of the world's most trusted grocery brands.

Whole Foods Market is known as the number one grocer suppliers want to be in, and our merchants are central to that reputation. Your job is to make them faster, sharper, and more confident in their decisions, whether that's through AI agents that surface insights at the point of decision, forecasting models that replace legacy planning systems, or data integrations that give merchants end-to-end visibility from supplier to shelf. You'll partner closely with engineering, UX research, analytics, and business teams spanning Amazon and WFM to translate complex technical capabilities into tools merchants trust and adopt.

Key job responsibilities
Own the product strategy and roadmap for AI-powered merchant intelligence tools, including adoption strategy, capability governance, and merchant enablement

Lead cross-functional execution of forecasting model migration: defining success criteria, orchestrating data readiness, managing cross-team dependencies, and driving go/no-go decisions

Drive data integration and catalog harmonization initiatives across multiple systems and organizations, resolving complex upstream and downstream dependencies

Define product requirements for new analytical capabilities, including store clustering, category intelligence, and assortment optimization, from problem framing through OP1 commitment

Earn merchant trust through direct engagement: translating technical capabilities into business value, validating solutions in the field, and building feedback loops that inform the roadmap

Navigate a complex stakeholder landscape spanning product, engineering, supply chain, UX, and merchandising organizations across both Amazon and Whole Foods Market

A day in the life
You'll move between strategic planning and hands-on execution in a single day. One hour you're reviewing AI capability adoption trends and refining the product roadmap, the next you're in a cross-functional sync resolving data dependencies with engineering and analytics partners. After lunch, you might walk category managers through a new capability prototype, then pivot to a UX research debrief that reshapes how you think about the planning workflow. You'll regularly translate between technical ML conversations and practical merchant needs. Expect to partner with teams across Amazon and WFM, navigate ambiguity, and drive clarity where there isn't any yet.

About the team
Our team builds the tools and platforms that Whole Foods Market category managers rely on to plan, price, promote, and merchandise products. Our portfolio spans assortment planning, pricing optimization, promotions planning, and space and merchandising execution, all powered by a shared data foundation and increasingly driven by AI. We're at an inflection point: transitioning from legacy planning systems to intelligent, data-driven capabilities that change how merchants work. We build in close partnership with Amazon's retail, technology, and operations teams. We move fast, operate with high ambiguity, and value PMs who earn trust with both engineers and merchants.

- 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience as a product manager or owner
- Experience owning feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights

Preferred qualifications

- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Usage of generative AI tools to enhance workflow efficiency, with a willingness to learn effective prompting and evaluation practices.
- Ability to recognize opportunities where generative AI could enhance products, workflows, or customer experiences.

title: Data Scientist II, Data Scientist, Decision Science
descriptionHtml:
What will customers want from Amazon Devices one, two, or three years from now? As a Data Scientist II on our Devices forecasting team, you will answer that question by building econometric and machine learning models that project long-term demand, assess the incrementality of new products, and quantify willingness to pay for specific features. Your analysis will directly shape portfolio decisions, helping product managers decide what to build next. This is a team that is investing in AI to accelerate how science informs business strategy, making now a particularly exciting time to join.

Key job responsibilities
- Build and validate econometric and machine learning models that generate long-term demand forecasts for Amazon Devices, selecting the right methodology based on data characteristics and business context.
- Assess the incrementality of new products and quantify willingness to pay for product features, translating model outputs into clear narratives that help product managers adjust their portfolio strategy.
- Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders to scope analytical projects, define metrics, and identify the data requirements needed to answer ambiguous forecasting questions.
- Communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences through clear documentation, effective visualizations, and well-structured presentations that drive informed decisions.
- Mentor less experienced data scientists through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and active participation in scientific discussions and team planning.

A day in the life
You might spend your morning refining a demand forecast model, testing how a new product feature variable improves prediction accuracy. After lunch, you could be walking product managers through your incrementality analysis and aligning on what the numbers mean for their roadmap. Later, you might review a teammate's willingness-to-pay study or experiment with an AI-based approach to accelerate your modeling pipeline. Your work moves between deep independent analysis and collaborative sessions where you translate complex results into actionable recommendations.

About the team
Our team owns long-term forecasting and product analytics for Amazon Devices. We build the science that tells the story of where customer demand is headed and what drives it. You will work alongside scientists, engineers, and product managers who value rigorous analysis and practical impact. We are currently expanding our use of AI to accelerate how we deliver insights, and we are looking for people who are curious, collaborative, and ready to help shape that direction.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience
- 2+ years of data scientist experience
- 3+ years of machine learning/statistical modeling data analysis tools and techniques, and parameters that affect their performance experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience applying theoretical models in an applied environment

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in Python, Perl, or another scripting language
- Experience in a ML or data scientist role with a large technology company

• Develop integrated systems extending the life of data center infrastructure products.
• Simplify, optimize and lower costs of data center mechanical and associated sub components.




Key job responsibilities

- Collaborate with internal and external ecosystem partners to design and develop new data center product solutions.

- Provide technical subject matter expertise to peers, senior management and partner teams.

- Lead key initiatives for the organization while demonstrating ownership.

- Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 25% of the year.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. title: Aerospace Transformation Business Dev leader, Auto & Manufacturing Industry Specialists and Solutions
descriptionHtml:
AWS is seeking an experienced Business Development Manager to join the Industry Specialists team and help build our dedicated Aerospace footprint across EMEA.

In this role, you will own business development for aerospace workloads across the commercial aviation, defense-adjacent, and space value chains — including supply chain optimisation, predictive maintenance and MRO, digital twin and PLM, connected aircraft, and AI/ML for engineering.

You will engage directly with C-suite executives and VPs at leading European airframe OEMs, propulsion suppliers, Tier-1 systems integrators, and MRO providers to translate their most complex operational challenges into cloud-enabled opportunities, build a qualified pipeline, and shape AWS's aerospace-specific go-to-market plays and partner motions.

The ideal candidate will have deep aerospace industry expertise combined with a business development, consulting, or solutions background — with demonstrated experience engaging CxO/VP-level stakeholders at major aerospace companies.

You should understand the tightly coupled aerospace value chain, where product design changes, certification delays, and supply constraints cascade across company boundaries.

This is an individual contributor role for a builder who thrives in ambiguity, can create structure where none exists, and has the ownership and scrappiness to incubate a new segment from the ground up.

Key job responsibilities
- Build and execute the EMEA aerospace BD strategy aligned with the global OneAWS Aerospace roadmap, identifying priority customer targets, use cases, and partnership opportunities across commercial aviation, defense-adjacent, and space segments.

- Engage C-level and VP stakeholders (CEO, COO, CTO/CIO, VP Engineering, VP Supply Chain, VP MRO, VP Digital) at target European aerospace companies to understand their strategic priorities, build trust, and position AWS as a long-term transformation partner.

- Develop and manage a high-quality business development pipeline by identifying, qualifying, and advancing opportunities across aerospace-specific workloads: supply chain visibility and optimisation, MRO predictive maintenance, digital twin and simulation, PLM modernisation, connected product / IoT, compliance (CMMC/ITAR), and AI/ML for engineering.

- Lead the "Reuse, Adjust, Build" approach for EMEA — leveraging proven Automotive & Manufacturing solutions (digital twin, predictive maintenance, supply chain, IoT) and adapting them for aerospace-specific requirements such as MRO workflows, regulatory compliance (FAA/EASA, CMMC, ITAR/EAR), sovereignty, and aircraft lifecycle management.

- Drive strategic partner motions in EMEA with ISVs and system integrators to create differentiated joint solutions for European aerospace customers.

- Provide thought leadership on aerospace digitisation through executive briefings, industry events (Farnborough, Le Bourget, MRO Europe, Hannover Messe), workshops, and published content — positioning AWS as the aerospace industry provider with production-grade AI deployments and measurable business outcomes.

- Leverage Pan-Amazon proof points (Amazon Leo satellite constellation, Amazon Air fleet operations, Amazon Robotics) to build credibility and demonstrate how AWS technologies solve real-world aerospace challenges at scale.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with AWS field sales (AWSI, AGS), solutions architects, professional services, WWPS (for defense-adjacent workloads), partner teams, and product teams — acting as the single-threaded aerospace specialist who brings coherence across organisational boundaries.

- Serve as the "voice of the customer" internally, synthesising aerospace-specific market trends, competitive dynamics, regulatory developments, and customer feedback to influence AWS product and solution development.

A day in the life
No two days look the same in this role — and that's the point. You might spend the morning in Toulouse whiteboarding on how to modernise PLM architecture, and the afternoon on a call with a Tier-1 engine manufacturer's VP of MRO exploring how predictive maintenance could cut unplanned downtime. In between, you're swapping notes with your partner counterpart on a joint MRO workshop you're co-building, or briefing an AWS Solutions Architect on a customer's sovereignty and ITAR constraints before a technical deep-dive.

On any given week, you could find yourself:
- Preparing an executive briefing for a CSCO who wants to understand how AWS can help untangle a multi-tier supply chain visibility problem
- Co-developing an aerospace-specific use case (digital twin, engine health monitoring, connected aircraft) with the SA team to present at MRO Europe or Farnborough
- Reviewing competitive intelligence and drafting a plan leveraging Pan-Amazon proof points

- Running an internal "Aerospace Deep Dive" to educate field sales on why generic manufacturing messaging doesn't land with aerospace customers

- Aligning with the WWPS team on CMMC compliance positioning for a defense-adjacent account

- Updating shared account plans and tagging opportunities in the CRM so the broader team has visibility

- Drafting a 2-pager for leadership on a market signal or a customer win that could shape the GTM playbook

The common thread: you're always at the intersection of deep industry knowledge and cloud technology, building credibility with senior aerospace leaders while creating structure and momentum in a segment AWS is standing up from scratch.

About the team
AWS is building a dedicated Aerospace go-to-market capability within the Industry Specialists organisation. Our approach leverages the deep structural overlap between aerospace and our proven Automotive & Manufacturing solutions portfolio — reusing what works, adjusting for aerospace-specific requirements, and building only where critical gaps exist.

We combine AWS's breadth in AI/ML, IoT, HPC, and sovereign cloud with Pan-Amazon proof points (Leo, Amazon Air, Robotics) and a curated partner community to deliver measurable outcomes — not generic cloud messaging.

If you're energised by the prospect of building a new industry vertical from the ground up, working with some of the world's most iconic aerospace companies, and shaping AWS's position in a market where the next 12–18 months will define competitive positioning for a decade — we'd love to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or an equivalent field
- Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders
- 8+ years of experience in the aerospace industry — in roles such as business development, management consulting, solution sales, product management, or programme management — spanning one or more of: commercial aviation, defense, space, or MRO.
- Demonstrated track record of engaging and influencing C-level and VP executives at major aerospace companies (OEMs, engine manufacturers, Tier-1 suppliers, or MRO providers).
- Strong understanding of the aerospace value chain and its key operational challenges: supply chain complexity and multi-tier visibility, MRO and predictive maintenance, digital engineering and PLM, regulatory compliance (FAA/EASA, CMMC, ITAR/EAR), and sovereignty requirements.
- Familiarity with enterprise platforms and technologies used in aerospace (e.g. SAP, PTC Windchill, Dassault 3DEXPERIENCE, Siemens Teamcenter, IFS) and how cloud and AI/ML technologies complement or transform them.
- Proven ability to develop and execute market development strategies in complex, matrixed environments that deliver measurable pipeline and revenue results.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building and maintaining C-level client relationships
- MBA or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Operations Research, Supply Chain, or related field.
- Experience with aerospace-specific technologies and concepts: digital twin for aircraft simulation and fleet monitoring, predictive maintenance for engine health and component failure, MRO transformation, HPC for CFD/structural analysis, CMMC/ITAR compliance frameworks, and connected aircraft / IoT.
- Experience working with or for a major aerospace company (e.g. Airbus, Safran, Rolls-Royce, Thales, Leonardo, BAE Systems) or a management consultancy on aerospace transformation engagements (e.g. McKinsey, BCG, Roland Berger, Deloitte, Accenture, Capgemini).
- Understanding of the defense-industrial base and its intersection with commercial aerospace — including dual-use technology considerations and cross-sector compliance requirements.
- Track record of evangelising new technologies at aerospace industry events (Farnborough, Le Bourget, MRO Europe, Paris Air Forum, Aeromart).
- Experience incubating new market segments or industry verticals — building go-to-market from zero, not just executing established playbooks.
- Proficiency in French is a strong advantage given the Toulouse/Paris aerospace hub; German, Italian, or Spanish are a plus.
- Willingness to travel across EMEA and occasionally to the US (estimated 30–40%).

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The AWS Environmental team is an expanding and dynamic team that is critical to enabling AWS's growth around the world, as well as ensuring compliance of AWS's global operations, including physical data centres and other AWS facilities. The team has responsibility for architecting and implementing AWS's environmental programmes, including defining and implementing risk management and compliance systems; setting and refining policies and procedures; overseeing the development of standards, tools, auditing and metrics; and engaging with all AWS business units to provide scalable and effective compliance strategies that support current and future business objectives while ensuring compliance with environmental regulations.

The Regional Environmental Engineer (REE) will be responsible for environmental compliance at data centers in Hong Kong. The REE will develop standards and policies to support regulatory compliance and provide environmental compliance guidance for regional operations and construction teams. The individual will complete environmental performance analysis, establish and monitor metrics, and guide the teams in implementation of Amazon environmental standards. The REE will work with internal and external partners (through respective teams) that include government entities, contractors, consultants, design, construction, operations and other key stakeholders. This position is based in the HKG region and will require regular domestic travel and occasional international travel. Cantonese, Mandarin Chinese and English speaking and writing proficiency is required.

The REE must have excellent communication skills, strong environmental regulatory knowledge, particularly with respect to Hong Kong regulations and standards, demonstrated success in program management, and experience leading teams in complex and technical projects.



Key job responsibilities
• Manage and oversee compliance with local and federal environmental regulations of Hong Kong and Amazon standards and policies.
• Develop regional strategic programs by integrating with engineering, construction, and operations. Drive an environmentally responsible culture within the organization.
• Function as a leader regarding assistance with Hong Kong regulatory agency interactions, permit evaluation and processing, and new process and technology introduction
• Ensure work performed by contractors, consultants, and employees is completed in accordance with Amazon standards.
• Develop environmental metrics to measure, monitor and forecast performance
• Conduct thorough and accurate environmental audits of data centers in the HKG region for continuous improvement.
• Prioritize and manage multiple technically complex assignments concurrently.
• Assist legal and/or public policy teams at appropriate levels with governmental agencies.
• Build collaborative relationships with various stakeholders to ensure risks are identified early and managed appropriately.
• Submit time critical reports to the public policy team, which will be interacting with various governmental agencies
• Complete thorough and accurate environmental incident investigations and associated regulatory reports and develop appropriate corrective actions

Basic qualifications

- A completed Bachelor’s Degree in chemistry, chemical or environmental engineering or related field of study.
- Minimum of 7 years of experience serving as an environmental technical resource, environmental manager, program specialist, or environmental consultant
- Experience with environmental permit evaluations and applications, planning approvals, environmental authorisation, regulatory compliance with air and noise emission, water discharge and waste management in Hong Kong
- Proficient with MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems

Preferred qualifications

- Broad knowledge of global environmental regulations and programs
- Experience leading change in multiple site environments and the ability to influence those that are not direct reports or within your organization
- Experience successfully implementing environmental systems
- Excellent organizational and project management skills
- Strong interpersonal skills: excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong relationship builder, solid influencing and negotiation skills, and the ability to coach at multiple levels and comfort interfacing with senior leaders inside and outside the company
- Experience in a fast paced, changing/growing organization
- Strong analytical skills with demonstrated problem solving ability
- Experience working in data center infrastructure sector

title: Software Development Engineer II, Relay Yard Automation, Relay Yard Automation
descriptionHtml:
Amazon moves millions of packages daily through a global logistics network of Fulfillment Centers, Sort Centers, and Delivery Stations. Every facility has a trailer yard — the physical space where line-haul vehicles arrive, get loaded or unloaded, and depart. Tracking what's happening in these yards in real time (which trailers are where, what state they're in, who's arriving and departing) is a hard problem that sits at the intersection of physical operations and software systems.

The Relay Yard Automation (RYA) team builds the software that manages these trailer yards across 6,000+ Amazon facilities on three continents. Our products handle 200K+ gate transactions
per day and facilitated the arrival and departure of 55M vehicles last year. We integrate computer vision, RFID, GPS, ultrasonic sensors, and IoT edge devices to automate what were historically manual, associate-staffed processes, from gate check-in/check-out to in-yard trailer movements. Our gate automation program has already eliminated millions of manual transactions, with a long-term goal of fully autonomous yard operations.

The tech stack is diverse by necessity: Android mobile apps for yard associates and drivers, React web applications for remote gate agents and yard operators, Java/TypeScript backend services on AWS, and hardware integrations running on edge compute devices deployed in the field. Systems are loosely coupled, event-driven, and must operate reliably in environments ranging from 1M+ sq ft North American fulfillment centers to small urban European delivery stations.

As an SDE on this team, you will design and build features and services that power yard automation across Amazon's logistics network. You will write high-quality code across the full stack, contribute to system design discussions, and deliver projects from technical design through production launch. The role involves working across backend services, web and mobile applications, and integrations with physical sensor systems at the edge. You will make thoughtful engineering trade-offs, participate in design and code reviews, and contribute to the team's operational excellence practices — supporting tier-1 systems where your work directly impacts driver experience and Amazon's ability to meet customer delivery promises.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement software for yard and gate automation products across tier-1 systems. Your code runs in production where defects directly impact driver experience and customer delivery promises.

- Lead large projects end-to-end: define the technical approach in ambiguous problem spaces, decompose work into parallel workstreams, and deliver cohesive launches.

- Own system architecture for your team's services. Proactively simplify code, resolve architecture deficiencies, and remove bottlenecks across Java backend services, TypeScript/React web apps, Android mobile apps, and IoT edge devices.

- Make short-term vs. long-term trade-off decisions and communicate them clearly to your team and stakeholders.

- Integrate with physical systems — RFID readers, computer vision cameras, ultrasonic sensors, GPS — running on edge compute in variable warehouse environments. Debug problems that span hardware and cloud software.

- Own operational excellence for services you build: monitoring, alarming, runbooks, incident response, and root-cause corrective actions.

- Influence technical direction beyond your team through design reviews with partner teams across Transportation Technology.

- Act as a force multiplier. Raise the engineering bar through code reviews, design artifacts, and reusable frameworks. Mentor junior engineers toward their next level.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
