This is where your ideas turn into real impact.
You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure?

What’s in it for you?
An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

Key job responsibilities
Work backwards from the customer, identifying inputs to grow Amazon's most strategic brands and improve their performance within a retail category.

Support vendor managers in providing a suite of services designed to help brands succeed, collaborating with cross-functional teams including in-stock and marketing.

Develop analytical and problem-solving skills by collecting, analysing, and interpreting data to drive category performance.

Build an understanding of customer pain points, requirements, and potential value across retail, advertising, and merchant services.

Identify target accounts using market data and industry intelligence to support business growth.

Identify opportunities to improve products, services, processes, systems, and tools across the business.

Work with different parts of the Amazon business to implement improvement projects, including category teams, product teams, and technical support teams.



A day in the life
Every day is a little different as a Retail Vendor Manager Working Student. Working alongside a vendor manager, you'll learn how Amazon handles its e-commerce retail business across product categories — from books to fashion, electronics to grocery, and everything in between. You might spend your morning analysing category performance data and identifying growth opportunities for strategic brands, then spend your afternoon working with marketing or in-stock teams to implement an improvement project that enhances the customer shopping experience.

Amazon is a customer-obsessed business, so no matter which retail category you join, part of your role will involve working backwards from the customer to identify what matters most. You'll gain exposure to Amazon's advertising products and merchant services, learn how we create custom opportunities to delight clients, and partner across functions to deliver results — building your analytical, commercial, and problem-solving skills in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Extra perks for Amazonians such as: exclusive Amazon.de discount; Deutschlandticket (Transportation Ticket); bike rental; gym membership discount; Beta testing on new Amazon products; and free mental health, legal, and financial support for you and your family.

Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.

About the team
Intern Community:
As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a dynamic, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.

Support:
The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.

Learning Sessions:
Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's industry-leading learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.

Opportunities:
Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.

Internship Start Dates across the year:
We are hiring interns to start anytime from January through September 2027. Each month, we'll hold 1-2 onboarding days for new hires.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in German and English at C1 level or above
- Currently in your penultimate or final year and working towards a university degree with an anticipated graduation date after the completion of your internship.
- Relevant studies in Business, Marketing, Economics, E-Commerce, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering or related field
- Available to commence your Working Student role between January and September 2027. Yes, our start dates are flexible! You should then be available between 6 and up to 12 months (10 up to 20h/week). Working Student length is subject to availability.
- Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel (e.g. macros, pivots, lookups, VBA).
- You must have the right to work in the country of employment.
- You will be based in Munich for the duration of the contract.

Preferred qualifications

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify process improvements and innovative solutions.
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills, able to collaborate effectively with others.

title: Senior Applied Scientist
descriptionHtml:
At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

ABOUT THIS ROLE
As a Senior Applied Scientist, you will solve large complex real-world problems at scale, draw inspiration from the latest science and technology to empower undefined/untapped business use cases, delve into customer requirements, collaborate with tech and product teams on design, and create production-ready models that span various domains, including Machine Learning (ML), Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Generative AI, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Reinforcement Learning (RL), real-time and distributed systems.

ABOUT YOU
Your work will focus on inventing and extending scientific approaches, models, and algorithms driven by customer needs at the product level, framing new research problems even when the problem is ill-defined and no textbook solution exists. You will lead the design, implementation, and delivery of scientifically complex, end-to-end solutions that are deployed into production, defining system-level requirements and writing a significant portion of the critical-path code. You will develop reusable science components and services that resolve architecture deficiencies and customers’ pain points, while making technical trade-offs for long-term/short-term. You will work independently with limited guidance, and your decision-making will consistently incorporate robust, data-driven business and technical judgment. You will drive your team’s scientific agenda, author internal or external peer-reviewed publications that validate the novelty of your work, mentor and develop other scientists, and build consensus across multiple teams. You will have the opportunity to innovate, invent, and think big, and influence the experiences of millions of customers. We are looking for a results-oriented Senior Applied Scientist with deep expertise in ML, NLP, Deep Learning, GenAI, and/or large-scale distributed computation.

As an Applied Scientist, you will...
- Understand complex, ambiguous use cases across the business and adopt/extend/design/invent solutions/models that are scalable, efficient, and automated, where neither the problem nor the solution is well defined
- Work closely with fellow scientists and software engineers (at Audible and Amazon) to build and productionize models, and deliver novel and highly impactful features
- Review models of peers for the purpose of reducing and managing risk to the business, while improving customer experience
- Lead the design, development, and production deployment of scientifically complex, end-to-end solutions for Content Understanding, Recommendations, and GenAI-based product features, defining system-level requirements
- Drive and lead initiatives that employ the most recent advances in ML/AI/GenAI, drive your team’s scientific agenda, and author peer-reviewed publications
- Mentor and grow scientists on the team and across Amazon, and push the boundary of innovation

ABOUT AUDIBLE
Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

Basic qualifications

- Experience working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage
- Experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware, or experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing
- PhD plus 5+ years of research experience, or a Master’s degree plus 10+ years of research experience in one of the following disciplines: Machine Learning, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Applied Math, or a related quantitative field
- 5+ years of experience in Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing/Understanding, GenAI and/or Reinforcement Learning
- Experience with Python, SQL, other scripting languages
- Experience delivering science solutions into production systems

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application experience
- Author of publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals, cited by other scientists
- Experience with building Recommendation Systems and/or large-scale content understanding systems
- Experience with large-scale online experimentation / A/B testing to validate science solutions in production
- Machine Learning Pipeline orchestration with AWS (SageMaker, Batch, Lambda, Step Functions) or similar cloud platforms
- Experience with Agile Software Development, and programming in at least one compiled language such as Java, C++, C#
- Experience mentoring scientists and leading science/design reviews across teams, and domain knowledge of comparable products (digital, retail)

title: Finance Manager, EU Fleet Finance
descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

Amazon Logistics (AMZL) delivers millions of packages to customers every day across Amazon's Last Mile network. Amazon Transportation Services (ATS) operates a complex, dynamic Surface Transportation (ST) business. Supporting AMZL and ATS, the Global Fleet and Products (GFP) organization manages Fleet technology, capacity, vehicle in-life services programs, vendor management, planning and execution, and establishes vehicle requirements to move goods between Amazon Operations locations and deliver parcels to customers' doorsteps.

EU Fleet Finance is a specialized team of 8 finance professionals partnering with GFP in EU to drive strategic investment decisions and optimize fleet performance across 10 European countries. Finance is providing planning, analysis, and cost controllership for the middle and last mile fleet of tractors, trailers and delivery vehicles. Together with operations leaders and AMZL, ATS and DSP Finance organizations we optimize fleet costs, define vehicle economics, and shape Amazon's delivery model. Our work directly influences strategic decisions on preferred vehicle types, alternative mobility solutions, and partner remuneration models. We are continuously expanding this business partnership to international GFP activities.

The team is seeking a Finance Manager to connect team activities across sourcing, project and program activities, for both middle and last mile, coordinating and consolidating quantitative and qualitative information when it comes to planning and reporting. This role requires an experienced finance professional who will independently assess and handle priorities in an increasingly complex environment, ensuring appropriate stakeholder management.

Given our team's size and scope, you'll engage with numerous stakeholders across GFP operations teams and Finance organizations, providing subject matter expertise to senior leaders. You'll define, track and help to improve metrics measuring vehicle operating costs, cost per package, route economics, and kilometer efficiency. The role combines European-wide perspective with country-level insights, evolving with fleet lifecycle management, new vehicle acquisitions, and innovative sourcing models.

Key job responsibilities
• Own, execute and develop financial reporting and planning processes for Middle and Last Mile Fleet cost: (1) Lead execution of Weekly Business Reviews, Month-End-Close, Monthly Financial Reviews, and planning cycles with limited oversight; (2) ensure accuracy through proactive auditing and key controllership activities CapEx and OpEx; (3) Build financial models addressing complex fleet cost questions; convert data into actionable insights and recommendations for senior leadership;
• Stakeholder Management: (1) ensure accurate and concise reporting on vehicle financials, relevant for multiple Finance teams; (2) communicate financial performance expectations and results to L8 operations stakeholders; (3) influence tactical and strategic fleet decisions to meet financial commitments;
• Metrics Development: (1) Develop and track fleet economics metrics including cost per package, route, load and kilometer; (2) analyze vehicle operating costs across 10 European countries
• Process Improvement: (1) Identify automation opportunities, reduce defects, and implement solutions that scale across the European fleet finance function; (2) support establishing WW process standards within WW Fleet Finance.

Basic qualifications

- A degree in Finance, Mathematics, Economics, or another relevant field
- Relevant experience in a finance role including partnering with a variety of stakeholders across the business
- Relevant experience working with Excel and large-scale data mining and reporting tools such as Python, SQL or Tableau
- Relevant experience in financial modelling

Preferred qualifications

- Advanced or master’s degree in finance, economics or mathematics, such as a CA, CMA, CWA or MBA
- Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
- Experience working in large teams or at a national/multinational organisation
- Experience communicating complex information and solutions to senior stakeholders and influence decisions

title: Senior Security Engineer, AI Security
descriptionHtml:
Join the team that helps protect the Amazon and our customers. The scale of Amazon and diversity of customers means your work would have far-reaching impacts across a broad range of industries around the world.

Our highly collaborative, global team thrives on flexibility and is committed to each team member's growth regardless of where they are. If you want to grow your interest in AI/ML services like Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, generative AI, large language models, and responsible AI - we're right here on the journey with you.

The Amazon AI Security team is looking for a Security Engineer to design security controls and help validate that our AI/ML services, applications, and emerging technologies are designed and implemented to the highest security standards. Your responsibilities include analyzing the security of AI/ML applications and services, discovering and addressing security issues, building security automation, and decisively taking action to mitigate emerging threats throughout a full secure development life-cycle (SDLC).

This role will provide career growth opportunities as you gain new security skills in the course of your work. Security Engineers on the AI Security team have an opportunity to experiment, learn, build tools, and work with teams building new AI/ML technology and services at a massive scale. Security Engineers at all levels have the opportunity to learn from and be mentored by those who are building and securing our AI services. A Security Engineer is also expected to be a mentor for others and be a trusted security advisor within the organization.

A Security Engineer at Amazon is expected to make significant contributions to the AI Security team and to multiple groups throughout Amazon. Security Engineers are expected to develop custom solutions to complex security risk problems and apply appropriate technologies while following security engineering best practices. This role requires a Security Engineer who can be trusted within AI Security and by teams throughout Amazon on at least one knowledge domain, while being able to apply security engineering best practices in a broad range of technical areas.

A Security Engineer must demonstrate strong Amazon Leadership Principles. This role requires the ability to foster constructive dialogue and seek resolution when confronted with differing opinions on security risks. Engineers in this role are expected to participate fully in the planning of the AI Security team and constantly seek opportunities for process improvement.

A successful candidate will need a combination of troubleshooting, technical, and communication skills. An AI Security Engineer must have the ability to take ownership and deliver multiple complex objectives which may include project and software development work.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Security reviews for AI/ML products, technologies, and services.
- Secure design, architecture, and implementation of AI/ML systems.
- Secure development life-cycle (SDLC) practices including threat modeling and security testing.
- Influence decision-makers and stakeholders throughout the organization in multiple teams to achieve a consistently high security bar.
- Lead penetration testing engagements and create new testing methods and exploits.
- Create security guidance and documentation.
- Develop security tools and automation.
- Develop and deliver security training and outreach to internal development teams.
- Develop and improve metrics that drive desired behavior and security outcomes.
- Lead security projects (including security reviews, tool development, and creation of new security practices) with end-to-end ownership.
- Support for mentoring, team building and recruiting activities

Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. Striking healthy harmony between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren't focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we're happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well-balanced life—both in and outside of work.

We are dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. title: Human Resources Business Partner , Worldwide Grocery Stores
descriptionHtml:
This role supports Whole Foods Market stores, within the Worldwide Grocery Stores organization.

Amazon is seeking a strategic and solution-focused Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP) to power the trajectory of our business by ensuring we have the right talent mix, leadership, and capabilities to innovate and deliver exceptional customer and Team Member experiences. As an HRBP, you will serve as a leader of people and organizational strategy — accelerating business outcomes through diagnosis, development, and execution of integrated solutions.

You will build trusted relationships with leaders and act as the client face of TMS (Team Member Services), interfacing and liaising with Recruiting, Team Member / Team Leader Development, Compensation, Benefits, HRIS, and the Legal organization. You will coach, act as a change agent, and influence critical decisions around talent and organizational design to drive business results while ensuring compliance with corporate policies, government regulations, and statutory requirements.

This role requires travel up to 25% of the time.


Key job responsibilities
Organizational Effectiveness

Leverage deep knowledge of the business — including P&L, retail operations, and the competitive grocery/retail landscape — to tailor people-focused solutions that drive business outcomes

Interpret key people metrics and trends, utilizing mechanisms to inspect, monitor, and proactively mitigate organizational risks

Design, recommend, and implement effective organizational structures that align with business strategy, strengthen culture, and enable inclusive decision-making

Partner with leaders to build customer-centric, Team Member–focused organizations that foster agility and empower frontline decision-making

Ensure dynamic assessment of organizational capability — strengths, weaknesses, and opportunities — on a forward-looking basis

Recommend new approaches, policies, and procedures to drive continual improvement in TMS service delivery

Leader and Leadership Team Effectiveness

Assess both long-term and immediate leader talent needs to achieve business goals

Develop strategies to build required leader skills and establish inclusive talent pipelines

Coach and advise individual leaders and leadership teams on improving management abilities, addressing business challenges, and strengthening culture

Challenge leaders when necessary to break mental models on ways of working, biases, structure, and talent decisions

Reinforce difficult decisions that align with organizational strategies and values

Change Management

Use listening mechanisms to identify trends, risks, and hotspots to inform change plans and maximize both customer and Team Member experience

Drive effective change environments by leveraging multiple perspectives and inclusive communication strategies

Influence and coach leaders as they build their teams' ability to navigate organizational changes

Monitor and evaluate implemented changes to assess effectiveness and durability

Talent Planning & Workforce Strategy

Build long-term, inclusive workforce plans aligned with business objectives; proactively identify current and anticipated workforce capability gaps and develop strategies to close them

Coach and support leaders in executing workforce plans and making resource-allocation decisions

Anticipate industry trends and talent needs, determining gaps in current and future capabilities

Create talent goals and cadence with the Leadership Team, building inclusive talent mechanisms into the organization's rhythm of business

Team Member Relations & Compliance

Consult with and advise organizational leaders and Team Members on TM relations and related issues within assigned client groups

Provide sound policy interpretations and practice decisions; ensure adherence to company policies and applicable federal, state, and local regulations (including FMLA, ADA, HIPAA, and Leaves of Absence)

Provide assigned client teams and leaders with training, coaching, and guidance to maintain compliance

Serve as a neutral, approachable TMS professional who recognizes and proactively resolves potential people and organizational issues — escalating as appropriate

A day in the life
This is an in-person role. You’ll be on-site in our stores four days per week, working shoulder-to-shoulder with the leaders and Team Members you support — walking the floor and being a familiar, trusted face, not working from behind a desk or screen.
This role requires balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will partner with business leaders to develop HR solutions aligned with business objectives, support organizational design initiatives, drive talent strategies, and create mechanisms to assess organizational health. You must be comfortable dealing with ambiguity while building structured approaches to drive successful and equitable outcomes.
The HRBP serves as a trusted advisor and member of the business leadership team — expected to bring perspectives on the intersections of people strategy and business performance. You will engage as a subject matter expert on TMS-related topics and model a commitment to customer service, Team Member well-being, and the values that set our organization apart.
The best HRBPs in our stores are the ones leaders and Team Members know by name — approachable in the aisle and the break room, not just in meetings. Strategy matters, but only when it’s grounded in real understanding of the people doing the work every day.

- 2+ years of human resources or equivalent (e.g., operations, customer service, retail, distribution, shipping/logistics, healthcare, hospitality, manufacturing) experience

title: HR Business Partner
descriptionHtml:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People eXperience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. The HR Business Partner provides HR generalist support to a large population of hourly employees and business leaders, bringing expertise in leadership development, employee experience, and operational excellence.

In this role, you will partner with business leaders to deliver HR initiatives focused on talent management, employee engagement, and internal customer service. Success requires leveraging data-driven insights and understanding the importance of HR metrics to drive business impact. You may also lead a team of entry-level HR employees and own projects that enhance the employee experience.

The HR Business Partner balances strategic and tactical responsibilities, driving organizational success through partnership with leaders. They execute core PXT processes while providing guidance on talent processes, performance management, and cultural initiatives. By building trust and influence through sound business acumen, they manage increasingly complex issues and deliver solutions that enhance both employee experience and business outcomes.

You will be expected to work onsite at an Amazon facility.

Key job responsibilities
- Improve site effectiveness by identifying systemic patterns, addressing root causes, and making high-judgment decisions that align with policy intent while minimizing risk. Establish and implement mechanisms that ensure consistent, fair application of policies while maintaining compliance with evolving regulations.

- Use data analytics to identify emerging trends, predict future challenges, and implement proactive solutions at the site level. Turn insights into practical initiatives that drive measurable improvements in employee experience and business performance.

- Execute and monitor employee engagement strategies and recognition programs. Maintain meaningful floor presence to gather insights, identify early signs of disengagement, and partner with leaders to drive targeted improvements.

- Coach Business Leaders on effective people management practices, including performance feedback, team development, and complex employee relations matters. Support leaders in building inclusive, high-performing teams.

- Partner with leaders to ensure equitable talent practices across selection, development, and advancement decisions. Champion initiatives that create an inclusive environment where all employees can thrive.

- Drive adoption of HR technology solutions, AI, and self-service tools, ensuring effective utilization while maintaining focus on high-touch service delivery in critical moments. Identify opportunities to enhance user experience and process efficiency.

A day in the life
Your day will be a dynamic blend of strategic thinking and data-driven decision-making. You'll focus on driving organizational effectiveness and employee engagement, leveraging advanced analytics and AI-enabled tools to identify trends, anticipate business needs, and develop solutions that enhance workplace experience and deliver measurable results.

From coaching leadership teams on workforce and talent management to driving HR process excellence, you'll collaborate with business leaders to develop forward-looking strategies focused on operational objectives and team effectiveness. You'll build strong partnerships across all levels of the organization while contributing to meaningful workplace improvements.

Success in this role comes from your ability to navigate organizational dynamics, lead change initiatives, and make high-judgment decisions in ambiguous situations. Through a combination of business acumen, data-driven insights, and strategic partnerships, you'll help create a workplace culture where employees feel valued and empowered, while driving long-term organizational success and adaptability in a rapidly evolving business landscape.

About the team
AMXL-Fulfillment Centers, Sort Centers, and Inbound Crossdock (AMXL-FC/SC/IXD) ensures Heavy/Bulky packages move safely and efficiently to AMXL-DS to be delivered to our customers. In AMXL, most of our sites are collocated with different combinations between FC, SC, IXD, and DS.

The AMXL-FC/SC/IXD PXT Team is a diverse team that inspires intellectual curiosity, champions growth and innovation, fosters agile partnerships and supports the business and stakeholders through policy parity and process improvement. Our mission is to leverage technology, existing and new mechanisms and human intervention to deliver the best experience for all Amazonians. Our PXT team provides strategic and tactical leadership direction to support our internal customers: associates and operations leaders.

- 5+ years of HR work within an international, fast-paced, and customer-driven environment experience
- Knowledge of local labor law
- Experience in HR within an international, fast-paced and customer-driven environment
- Experience in a call center, distribution center, or manufacturing environment
- Experience supporting hourly employee client group
- Experience with MS Office tools and HR Information Systems
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in human resources with companies supporting 250-500 or more associates
- Experience managing and leading employees

descriptionHtml:

- Providing end-to-end tax calculation requirements for projects and business initiatives.

- Actively participate in selected projects throughout their life-cycle.

- Strong analytical skills.

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of indirect tax in a global regions

title: Engineering Manager, Product Security, AWS Security
descriptionHtml:
Help us protect not only the Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud computing environment but all of our customers as well! Since 2006, our great team at AWS has been enabling our customers to bring great ideas to life in ways that aren’t possible in traditional IT environments. With AWS you can flexibly harness compute, storage, security, and other services from across the globe as your business demands them.

AWS Security works at the forefront of security challenges across cloud services, Internet of Things (IoT), identity and access management, mobile devices, virtualization, and custom hardware, all operating at massive scale. Our highly collaborative team is committed to each team member's growth as our business grows.

As a part of the Product Security group within AWS Security, we help AWS launch new products/services and new features to existing products securely. You will be responsible for leading a team of security engineers conducting security reviews, threat modeling and hands on security evaluations. You will also own evolving the security assurance process, and creating metrics to demonstrate your team’s performance. You will help set the direction for a team of security professionals that is responsible for all AWS products and services. This role combines long term strategic planning to raise the bar on security across the enterprise with the excitement and challenge of quickly reacting to new threat scenarios.

This position will provide you with a challenging opportunity to define and drive fundamental security outcomes for everything underlying the global AWS business, from tangible hardware devices to operational procedures.

The successful candidate must be comfortable diving into complex engineering discussions, and leveraging deep security expertise to ensure proper risk assessment and threat analysis is performed. You will provide crystal-clear technical direction and risk mitigation guidance for diverse engineering and business leaders at all levels.

By applying your hard-earned years of practical security engineering expertise in projects related to enterprise networking, hardware-rooted security, operating system hardening, and cloud-scale administrative infrastructure, you will literally shape the future of cloud computing.

As an Engineering Manager III at Amazon, you own a strategically important system architecture, major technology product, and/or suite of products with significant business impact. As a manager, you are responsible for establishing the right engineering team structure and overall technology strategy to meet a long-term business need. You determine whether it is appropriate to make a case to resource a large engineering initiative (spanning multiple years) and when to prioritize the resolution of an endemic problem over a current request. You are able to recognize where there needs to be a team boundary to better encapsulate technologies and where teams could combine for a better outcome. You are accountable for the execution and overall experience of your engineering team(s), the systems they create, their quality, and how they meet business goals. To make sure everyone understands our Leadership Principles, you audit adherence and drive initiatives that show them in action.

Core Responsibilities:
* Team management, growth, and organization
* Professional development of team members
* Project management
* Metrics and projections
* Driving security initiatives
* Recruiting
* Process Improvement
* Define the strategy for raising the security bar of core AWS services

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. title: Deal and Contract Ops Manager, eero Business Operations
descriptionHtml:
We are hiring a Deal and Contract Operations Manager to join our Business Operations team in San Francisco. In this role, you will design and own the end-to-end deal and contracting processes mainly by supporting and training deal owners on contracting workflows, including operational ownership of our contracting tool, acting as the escalation point before deals get stuck, coordinating across internal approver teams such as Legal, Tax, and Finance to keep deals moving forward, and ensuring every signed partner has a smooth onboarding experience by involving the right stakeholders pre- and post-close.

Because you sit at the center of every deal, you will have a unique vantage point to spot what needs to be standardized, automated, or tooled across the deal lifecycle, and coordinate with the rest of the functions under Bizops (i.e. Sales Ops, Order Management, Business Systems etc.) to make it happen. You will use that perspective to build frameworks, drive process automation, and continuously reduce the time it takes to get from contract signing to customer onboarding, ensuring downstream teams like Partner Success, Order Management, and Logistics are engaged at the right time.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and maintain the end-to-end contract operations processes, from template selection support through approval alongside Legal so that deal owners (i.e. Business Development and Partner Success teams) can move deals through the process efficiently and with minimal friction.
- Project-manage deals from contract signing through customer onboarding, ensuring downstream teams (Partner Success, Order Management, RevOps, Logistics) are engaged at the right time prior to deal close, and that non-standard terms are highlighted and passed along to the correct stakeholders.
- Troubleshoot Contract Lifecycle Management (i.e.) workflow issues, advise on routing and approvals, and unblock bottlenecks so deal owners can keep momentum.
- Train and equip Business Development teams to be self-sufficient in the contracting process: how to create CLM workflows, select the right contract template and deal term configuration, route to the correct approvers, and anticipate approval requirements
- Ensure contract templates are properly created and maintained within the CLM system in adherence with the Amazon policy, and assist Business Development with escalating redlines to Legal and driving alignment on accepted terms.
- Use your centralized vantage point across all deals to spot patterns and identify what needs to be standardized, automated, or tooled, translating those insights into process improvements that make the entire deal lifecycle faster and more consistent.
- Lead process automation initiatives with the goal of decreasing contract throughput time and increasing deal signing velocity.
- Develop lightweight tooling and streamlined processes for higher-frequency, lower-complexity deals (e.g., direct Enterprise deals), including enabling 3P sales reps to independently handle NDAs and select contracting workflows on our behalf.
- Develop AI-based mechanisms to handle specialized deals with exception approvals for non-standard requests.
- Collaborate closely with Sales Ops and Order Management to feed process automation ideas and ensure the right tooling gets built to reduce manual effort across the deal-to-onboarding lifecycle.
- Continuously improve the onboarding experience for B2B customers by removing avoidable friction points, with decreasing time-to-onboard as a key success metric.

A day in the life
You might start your morning checking in on active deals in Contract Central, spotting one that's waiting on Tax approval and flagging to the BD owner how long that step usually takes. By midday, you could be helping a Business Development lead pick the right contract template and approval routing for a non-standard deal, or bringing Partner Success and Order Management in ahead of a signing so onboarding starts smoothly. Afternoons often involve working with Legal, Finance, and Sales Ops to clear a recurring bottleneck, followed by turning what you've seen across deals into a standard workflow or an automation idea. You will regularly train deal owners on contracting best practices and present recommendations to leaders on reducing time from signing to onboarding.

About the team
Our team keeps eero's partner deals and orders moving, from contract signing through delivery. As part of eero Business Operations, we work closely with Business Development, Partner Success, Legal, Finance, Order Management, and Logistics teams to build the processes and tools that help ISPs, Enterprise customers, and retail partners around the world get eero into their customers' homes and businesses. We value ownership, creative problem-solving, and using AI and automation to take manual work off our plates so we can focus on our partners. As we grow into new channels and regions, you will have the opportunity to shape how we scale deal and contract operations.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
- Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software
- Experience defining, refining and implementing sales processes, procedures and policies or equivalent
- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- Experience in verbal and written communication for executive level leaders
- 3+ years of experience in operations or program management that is GTM and business team facing.
- Working familiarity with contracts approval tools, like Amazon’s Contract Central, or the like
- Hands-on experience in ushering deals from contracts signing through successful onboarding by involving the right stakeholders at the right time.
- Experience translating legal, tax and finance requirements into operational guidance for business teams, and speeding up deal approval processes.

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of finance, business management and sales operations experience
- Experience managing multiple internal stakeholders and advising cross-functional teams
- Knowledge of Amazon approval policies and experience writing Amazonian-style documents (6-pagers, narratives).

title: Software Development Manager, Security Hub
descriptionHtml:
AWS Security Hub is a new unified cloud security solution that prioritizes customers' critical security issues and helps them respond at scale. It detects issues by automatically correlating and enriching security signals from multiple sources — posture management, vulnerability management (Amazon Inspector), sensitive data (Amazon Macie), and threat detection (Amazon GuardDuty) — then turns complex signals into actionable insights through intuitive visualizations and automated response workflows.

Every one of those insights reaches a customer through an interface — and the interface decides whether they act on it. We're looking for a Software Development Manager to lead the frontend team that builds it, across Security Hub and the broader AWS security services family.

Our biggest bet right now is agentic CX: reimagining how security teams investigate and respond with AI at the center. That means a brand-new web app built around agentic workflows, and an MCP app that brings Security Hub into customers' own AI workflows. Alongside that, your team owns the console experiences for 5 independent public facing services — rare breadth for a frontend org, and a lot of surface area to shape.

You'll lead a tight-knit, distributed team of frontend engineers, working alongside principal engineers and senior frontend engineers who set the technical bar. You'll own hiring and growth as the team scales, partner with product and design on a large roadmap, and drive decisions on architecture, frameworks, and AI implementation strategy. Development here is AI-assisted by default, meetings are light, and work lands with customers fast.

You don't need a security background to succeed. What you do need is a genuine interest in working at the bleeding edge of frontend and AI, the ability to build and grow a team while shipping, and the desire to have fun doing it — all while delighting customers with the experiences you deliver.

Key job responsibilities
- Own delivery, quality, and roadmap for the frontend team's portfolio: the new agentic web app, the MCP app, and the console experiences for Security Hub and other Security Services.

title: Lead, Regulatory Affairs, AMER, Amazon Leo Regulatory
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. This is a unique opportunity to work in the development of a global broadband satellite communication system and make a difference in bridging the digital divide.

The Lead, Regulatory Affairs, Americas (AMER) supports the development and execution of regulatory strategies aligned with business and service availability priorities, and identifies potential regulatory risks that may impact Amazon Leo’s ability to deploy services throughout the region. This role is primarily focused on South America, with potential engagement across the broader Americas as needed. The candidate will work on strategies and mechanisms to mitigate those risks, and engage and maintain liaison with national and regional telecommunications organizations. The Lead, Regulatory Affairs, AMER will contribute to shaping regulations affecting non-geostationary satellite orbit (NGSO) systems, telecommunications service providers, the access to and use of Ka-band band and other frequencies for satellite services, including emerging direct-to-device (D2D) spectrum bands, and other relevant regulations, in collaboration with relevant stakeholders. The ideal candidate will be responsible for educating regulators on satellite and spectrum regulations, telecommunications services, and other issues involved with deploying and maintaining a global satellite broadband service. The ideal candidate will have experience shaping regulatory frameworks for satellite communications systems -- to include space stations, earth stations/gateway stations, customer/user equipment, spectrum, the provision of services (wholesale and retail models), and the regulatory obligations applicable to satellite operators and telecommunications service providers, be familiar with regulatory agencies in the AMER, and be able to assess and, if necessary, recommend improvements to regulatory frameworks in order to optimize Amazon Leo service to customers. The Lead, Regulatory Affairs, AMER will engage cross-functionally with Public Policy, Legal, Business, Public Relations, Engineering and Operations professionals, and collaborate closely with Amazon Leo Regulatory team members supporting Global Licensing, Engineering, Global Service Compliance, Technical Program Management, and Law Enforcement Response and Intercept.

This position may require access to information, technology, or hardware that is subject to export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Employment in this position is contingent upon obtaining any required export licenses or other approvals from the United States government. As such, the successful candidate must be eligible to obtain any necessary export licenses or approvals based on their nationality, citizenship, and any other factors considered by the applicable export control regulations.

Key job responsibilities
• Contribute to shaping national and regional regulations affecting NGSO communications systems, telecommunications service providers, the access to and use of Ka-band band and other frequencies for satellite services, and other relevant regulations, in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.
• Identify potential regulatory risks that may impact Amazon Leo’s ability to deploy services, and propose strategies to mitigate those risks.
• Support alignment with Amazon Leo business, technical, and customer objectives to execute on regulatory strategies in countries throughout AMER and enable Amazon Leo services.
• Engage with national and regional telecommunications organizations, while maintaining liaison with regulators, relevant industry actors, and trade associations in the region.


A day in the life
In this role, you will contribute to shaping national and regional regulations affecting NGSO systems, telecommunications service providers, the access to and use of Ka-band band and other frequencies for satellite services, and other relevant regulations, in collaboration with relevant stakeholders. You will support efforts to enable and protect Amazon Leo’s use of radio frequency spectrum and authorization to provide telecommunications services at home and abroad, helping to define and advance the regulatory agenda to allow Amazon Leo service. You will collaborate with trade associations, government agencies, multilateral organizations, and other operators to shape rules and regulations in the best interest of our customers, and work in close collaboration with Amazon Leo business, technical and operations teams to optimize for customer experience, as well as with Amazon’s Public Policy, Public Relations, and Legal teams to enhance the overall regulatory strategy in priority countries. You will work closely with other regulatory country and domain leads and other Amazon Leo teams to ensure alignment on a country and regional basis, anticipating bottlenecks, and communicating risks clearly to leaders. You will take initiative to drive decisions within your scope, escalate effectively, remove blockers, and will deliver results across the AMER region.

You will report to the Senior Lead, Global Regulatory Affairs for Amazon Leo and work in close collaboration with other team members within the Regulatory team and across Amazon Leo to ensure timely service delivery at scale.


About the team
The Regulatory team enables and protects Amazon Leo’s use of radio frequency spectrum and satellite orbits worldwide, defining and leading the Amazon Leo regulatory agenda to benefit our customers. We operate globally, engaging with the International Telecommunication Union (ITU), regional/sub-regional organizations, regulatory authorities, and governments. We obtain the required ITU filings and licenses for Amazon Leo operations, coordinate spectrum use with satellite and terrestrial operators, and shape/promote space safety and sustainability. We advocate for rules and regulations in the best interest of our customers at the national, regional, and ITU treaty level, working with governments, trade associations, and operators. We work with the design, operational, and business teams to promote alignment between business objectives, the Amazon Leo Program of Record, and regulatory requirements and delivery. We partner with the Legal, Public Policy and Public Relations teams to execute the regulatory strategy.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- 5+ years of regulatory frameworks and policy analysis methodologies experience
- Bachelor's degree in relevant discipline (e.g., telecommunications, international relations, or engineering)
- 5+ years of experience in shaping national, regional, and international regulations for the provision of communications services

- Demonstrated ability to manage complex regulatory issues and drive them to resolution

- Experience in ownership of projects and communicating timelines and executing independently

- Proficiency in Spanish and Portuguese, with experience engaging regulators and stakeholders in those languages

title: Sr. Engagement Manager, AWS Professional Services India
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Senior Engagement Manager to lead and deliver complex, multi-work stream cloud transformation programs for AWS Professional Services (ProServe) APJC (ANZ, ASEAN, INDIA, Korea, Japan). In this role, you will own the end-to-end delivery lifecycle of large and complex customer engagements, shaping cloud strategies, driving business outcomes, and acting as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders.
The ideal candidate is an experienced program leader with deep IT consulting expertise, a proven track record in delivering complex technical programs across enterprise customers, and the ability to navigate ambiguity with limited guidance. You thrive in a fast-paced, growth environment, insist on incredibly high standards, and are passionate about mentoring others and scaling delivery best practices across teams.
You will lead matrixed teams of AWS consultants, partners, and customer resources across multiple work-streams simultaneously. You are expected to drive delivery excellence, maximize engagement value, manage risks proactively, and serve as a force multiplier for your peers and the broader organization. You will actively contribute to per-sales, build deep customer trust, and leverage AI/Gen AI to drive delivery innovation.
In this capacity you will be based in India and are expected to travel occasionally (30-40%) to customer sites in APJC. You will report into the India ProServe Engagement Management Delivery Practice Manager.


Key job responsibilities
• Own and lead end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-workstream cloud transformation programs, ensuring business outcomes are achieved within schedule, scope, and financial constraints.
• Shape and validate cloud delivery strategies for complex engagements, applying frameworks such as the Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF), Well-Architected Framework (WAF), and Engagement Delivery Framework (EDF).
• Serve as a strategic advisor to senior customer stakeholders, leading steering committees, driving alignment, and building deep trusted relationships.
• Proactively identify, manage, and escalate risks and issues; develop and execute mitigation plans; redirect distressed programs to delight customers.
• Maximize engagement value by negotiating conditions of acceptance, managing scope changes, and amending contractual terms within project constraints.
• Drive delivery excellence across engagements by defining and sharing EM best practices, creating reusable mechanisms, and establishing operational excellence.
• Actively mentor and develop team members; perform Technical Promotion Assessments (TPAs) and coach Engagement Managers to raise the bar.
• Participate in pre-sales activities, contributing to proposals, scoping, and business development for complex services engagements.
• Leverage Agentic AI and GenAI to optimize delivery processes, improve team productivity, and drive innovative customer outcomes.
• Collaborate with cross-functional AWS teams including Delivery Consultants, Account Executives, Cloud Architects, and Partner teams to solution and deliver cloud programs.


About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale experience
- 7+ years of leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements experience
- Knowledge of the value proposition of the public cloud and cloud engagement delivery (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
- Experience with Agile and project management toolsets like Jira, Rally, VersionOne or Taiga
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 7+ years of project/program management experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with and presenting to C-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent
- PMP, Prince2, PgMP, SAFe or SCRUM/Agile certification
- 9+ years of working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
- AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification
- Partner delivery experience — enabling and managing delivery through third-party partners

title: オペレーションマネージャー, SSD
descriptionHtml:
※このポジションの勤務地は埼玉県三郷市の物流拠点です。

アマゾンジャパンのフルフィルメントネットワークは、アマゾンのカスタマーに毎日多くのパッケージと笑顔をお届けしています。当社は地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業を目指しており、意欲的でカスタマー志向の強いOperations Managerを募集しています。

当社の物流拠点のビジネスゴールを達成するためにチームのオペレーションを管理する責任を負います。あなたのチームは20～300 名程度のメンバーで構成されます。数十億円の予算規模の年間の運営計画を立て、その実行責任を負います。分析スキルや問題解決スキルに加え、チームとしてパフォーマンス目標を確実に達成するため、メンバーと良好な関係を構築し、チームのリーダーシップを強化するためのコーチングやメンタリングなどの人材管理スキルを発揮することやや新しいサービスの導入を進めていく改善スキル、推進力も期待されます。

私たちは毎年新しいオペレーション拠点を立ち上げ、プロフェッショナルとしての成長機会を提供しています。パートタイムのアソシエイトからDirectorまで、多様なBackgroundを持つメンバーとのCross-functionalワークを通じて、新しい視点やスキルを身に付けることができます。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。


Key job responsibilities
【キャリアパス】
Operations Managerは、大きな組織をリードしリージョンやネットワークの取り組みを実行する次のSite LeaderまたはSenior Operations Managerへと成長することが期待されます。また、Supply Chain、Transportation、およびLogisticsなどAmazon のオペレーションのあらゆるOpportunityを模索することもできます。

【具体的な業務内容】
- 物流拠点運営、ソートおよびディスパッチオペレーションのリードおよび監督
- シフト全体の安全性、品質、パフォーマンス、カスタマーサービス向上
- 組織の方針と手順に従っての監督責任
- オペレーション目標の達成、および、それを上回る成果の実現
- 物量等の予測に基づく、戦略的な計画立案、パフォーマンスの評価、問題の解決および人材配置に関するニーズへの対応
- メンバーがより生産的で、パフォーマンスが高く、多様性があり、インクルーシブになるようサポート、指導し、動機付けします。チームメンバーの個人的な成功に対するビジョンとコミットメントを持って、共感を持ってリーダーシップを発揮し、楽しく仕事をし、メンバーに楽しんでもらいましょう。
- Learning and Talent Developmentチームとのパートナーシップにより、人材の獲得、パフォーマンスとキャリア開発、育成、サクセッションプランに関する計画の立案と実行
- 年間のオペレーション計画を編成し、日次/週次の生産計画と実績確認、短期/長期の需要変動対応、3PLを含む関係者との調整を通じて、コストを管理しながら、年間のオペレーション計画を実行します。
- DEI やSustainability関連の大規模プロジェクトや、Family Day、ボランティアイベントなどの大規模イベントをリードします。
- 部署間、シフト間、およびネットワーク間でベストプラクティスが着実に共有されるように、積極的なアクションを講じます。

このポジションに求められるのは、経験に裏打ちされたプロセスの改善能力と、Amazonの成長速度に合わせ、メンバーのモチベーションを高めながらさまざまなチャレンジに対して短期間で成果を出していく能力を持つ候補者です。また、さまざまな経験、バックグラウンドを持つ多様なメンバーと協業していく柔軟性が求められます。
まだ若い組織であり、組織やビジネスとともに成長できる高い意欲とポテンシャルをもった方を求めています。


A day in the life
※こちらの職種は日勤帯を中心としたシフト勤務（土日祝日含む交替制勤務）となりますが、職務遂行上必要な場合には夜勤帯で勤務していただく場合もございます。

title: シニアエリアマネージャー, SSD
descriptionHtml:
※このポジションの勤務地は東京都品川区を予定しています。

私たちのグローバルオペレーションネットワークは、日々何百万もの荷物と笑顔をAmazonのお客様にお届けしています。私たちは、シニアエリアマネージャーとして私たちのチームに加わってほしいと考え、意欲的で顧客重視の人材を探しています。この役割では、複数メンバーのチームをリードし、シフト中のチームの安全性、品質、出勤率、およびパフォーマンスを最高水準に維持するため、チームに働きかける責任があります。また、お客様の注文が適切な時間に適切な場所へ確実に配送されるよう、お客様の期待に応えることにおいても重要な役割を担います。

私たちの業務の流れには3つの主要な要素があります。
商品が保管され注文に備える「ファーストマイル」、注文品をお客様のエリアまで輸送する「ミドルマイル」、そして商品をお客様の玄関先までお届けする「ラストマイル」です。各拠点で運営方法に若干の違いはありますが、一貫して変わらないものが一つあります、それは顧客を第一に考える私たちのビジョンと献身的な姿勢です。

本ポジションはAmazonの新しいエキサイティングな物流拠点で業務を行います。可能な限り最速でお客様のご自宅に商品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。


Key job responsibilities
【具体的な業務内容】
■生産・業務計画の立案、進捗・実績・各種指標管理、人員・労務管理
想定物量を予測する部署と連携し、生産・業務計画を立案します。
配送ルートや人員配置の全体計画を立てます。
具体的には、物量に応じて必要となる人員数を算出し外部協力会社（派遣会社や業務委託会社など）との連携。
また社内システムを用いて各種計画の進捗・実績管理などを実施。現場と連携し、生産性向上を実現していきます。

■各種プロジェクト・改善活動の取りまとめ、人員育成・チームビルディング
今の生産性を維持するのではなく、改善を図って向上させるのがAmazonのシニアエリアマネージャーです。
業務改善プロジェクトなどの進行・取りまとめ役となり、最新テクノロジーの導入や工程の見直し等検討し、教育プランの策定も行います。
ミーティングはオペレーションマネージャーやエリアマネージャーと定期的に実施します。

■業務上で発生したトラブルや問題の解決
例えば、コンベアが停止した際のリカバリープランの立案・実施など。
商品が物流拠点内で滞留しないよう、トラブルに合わせて人員配置や対応方法などを検討します。


A day in the life
※勤務は土日祝を含むシフト勤務になります。
※業務状況に応じて事前に計画した上で夜勤が発生する場合がございます。

title: エリアマネージャー, SSD
descriptionHtml:
※このポジションの勤務地は東京都葛飾区を予定しています。

私たちのグローバルオペレーションネットワークは、日々何百万もの荷物と笑顔をアマゾンのお客様にお届けしています。私たちは、エリアマネージャーとして私たちのチームに加わってほしいと考え、意欲的で顧客重視の人材を探しています。この役割では、複数メンバーのチームをリードし、シフト中のチームの安全性、品質、出勤率、およびパフォーマンスを最高水準に維持するため、チームに働きかける責任があります。また、お客様の注文が適切な時間に適切な場所へ確実にお届けされるよう、お客様の期待に応えることにおいても重要な役割を担います。

私たちの業務の流れには3つの主要な要素があります。
商品が保管され注文に備える「ファーストマイル」、注文品をお客様のエリアまで輸送する「ミドルマイル」、そして商品をお客様の玄関先までお届けする「ラストマイル」です。各拠点で運営方法に若干の違いはありますが、一貫して変わらないものが一つあります、それは顧客を第一に考える私たちのビジョンと献身的な姿勢です。

本ポジションはAmazonの新しいエキサイティングな物流拠点で業務を行います。可能な限り最速でお客様のご自宅に商品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Key job responsibilities
■業務内容■
「エリアマネージャー」には、他業種・職種も含めこれまでの経験、スキルを活かし、改善点を模索しながら、「People First」の考え方で、各種プロジェクトをリードし、またピープルマネージメントを行っていただきます。また、「エリアマネージャー」は拠点の全ての工程を担当し、上司の示す部署全体の方針や安全・品質・生産性の年間目標に沿って、担当工程における改善を積み重ね、日々の計画、進捗、実績管理に責任をもち活動いただきます。

具体的な業務は以下の通りです。

主な責任と職務内容：
① チームメンバーの育成とサポート
現場の最前線にいるマネージャーとしてチームメンバーと積極的に関わり、メンバーからの意見に基づく職場改善によりエンゲージメントを高めます。また、数名から数十名のチームのマネージャーとして、業務上の知識・スキル、アマゾンカルチャー等の指導を行うことはもちろん、部下の悩みに傾聴し、問題の解決に向けて自ら動きます。さらに、部下の勤怠や労働時間等の把握、管理を適切に行います。

② 担当プロセスの安全・品質・作業効率の向上
マネージャーはそれぞれ特定のプロセスを担当し、そのプロセスの安全・品質・作業効率の向上をリードします。日々の安全活動、品質チェックに加え、作業環境の改善、トレーニングの進捗管理など多岐にわたる改善活動が該当します。問題を特定し、対策を立案し、チームメンバーを巻き込みながら実行に移し、結果を出していくことが求められます。

③ 日々のオペレーション対応
物流拠点のすべての工程を管理し、商品の管理からお客様へお届けするまでの一連の流れの中で計画を立案し管理していただきます。日々のオペレーションにおいてお客様にお約束した納期を確実に守るため、物量の上振れや下振れ、急な労働力不足、システムトラブル等の変動要素に際し、適切に判断して対応していくことが求められます。

④ プロジェクトリーダーとして改善を推進
Amazonでは日々改善が推進されています。エリアマネージャーは通常業務と並行して、安全上のリスクや生産性を改善するプロジェクトのリーダーとして拠点内の年次/月次プロジェクト活動を推進します。これらのプロジェクトにおいては関連部署との協業等も含まれます。

title: Equipment Quality  Manager, Merch on Demand
descriptionHtml:
■ 主な職務内容と責任範囲
アマゾンでは、地球上でもっともお客様を大切にする企業であることを目指しています。これに向けて才能にあふれ、聡明かつ実行力の高い人材を求めています。現在、アマゾンではプロダクションセンターにて Quality Vendor Equipment Manager を募集しています。品質管理を主軸に、生産設備の稼働率・生産性向上をリードし、ベンダーおよび社内設備管理チームと連携しながらオペレーションの継続的改善を推進してくれる方を求めています。新規設備の導入においては現場のPOCとして検証から生産への落とし込み、Production Teamへのハンドオーバーまでを一貫して担い、ビジネスとともに自分自身を成長させようと考えている方を歓迎します。

■ マネージャーとしての責務
品質管理を主軸として、生産設備の稼働率・生産性改善をリードし、安全・品質・カスタマーエクスペリエンスの向上に継続的に取り組む
ベンダーおよび社内設備管理チームと協業し、設備の安定稼働・予防保全・改善活動を推進する
Operationに新規導入する設備のPOCとして、技術検証・生産条件の最適化・現場への落とし込みを主導し、Production Teamへの円滑なハンドオーバーを実現する
QCサークルやLean手法を活用したプロセス改善・品質改善プロジェクトをドライブし、メトリクスTargetの達成をリードする
戦略的な設備投資計画・パフォーマンス評価・問題解決・必要に応じた人材採用を行う
3〜4名の直属チームメンバー（Associate / PA）に対し、キャリア開発・指導・フィードバック・成長機会を積極的に提供する
チームメンバーへの成功事例の共有および能力開発を継続的に実施する
本ポジションは、People Managerとしてチームを率いながら、Project Managerとして複数のステークホルダーを横断するプロジェクトを自ら推進するICの能力も求められる、高い実行力と影響力を兼ね備えたユニークなポジションです。

■ その他
8時間のシフト制勤務（土日祝含む交代制）／年間公休120日
マイカー通勤可、バイク通勤不可
※勤務はシフト制となります。短期間ですが、ピーク時には夜勤の可能性がございます。
勤務地は神奈川県座間市となります。プロジェクトやお客様の需要によって勤務時間への柔軟な対応が可能であることが必須です。
Amazonは多様かつインクルーシブな職場づくりを目指しています。Amazonは男女雇用機会均等法を順守しています。人種、出身国、性別、性的指向、障がい、年齢、その他の属性によって差別することなく、平等に採用選考の機会を提供しています。障がいをお持ちの方は、以下をご覧ください。https://www.amazon.jobs/disability/jp
Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool・生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazonでは学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Key job responsibilities
品質管理の観点から生産設備の稼働状況・不良率・生産性を日次で管理し、トラブル発生時はベンダーや設備管理チームと連携してリカバリープランを策定・実行します。設備の稼働・メンテナンス計画を週次で立案し、ステークホルダーと調整しながらコスト最適化と継続的な改善提案を推進します。3〜4名の直属メンバーのPeople Managerとして、定期的な1on1・育成・評価・従業員の声の収集を通じて職場環境の改善に取り組みます。新規設備の導入では技術検証から量産条件の最適化・標準作業手順の整備を主導し、Production Teamが自立して運用できる状態を確立した上でハンドオーバーを完了します。

A day in the life
出勤後、まず前日の設備稼働実績・品質メトリクス・不良発生状況をレビューし、当日の生産リスクを算出します。リスクがある場合は各チームへ報告し、ベンダーおよび設備管理チームと連携してリカバリープランを策定・実行します。
午前中はフロアを巡回し、設備の稼働状況を直接確認します。チームメンバーからの報告を受け、品質異常や設備不具合への即時対応を判断します。並行してベンダーとの定例会議や進行中のプロジェクトのステータス確認を実施します。
午後はチームメンバーとの1on1やブリーフィングを通じてVOA（従業員の声）を収集し、職場環境の改善に向けたアクションを設定します。担当するプロセス改善・品質改善プロジェクトの進捗確認と次のアクション決定を行い、関係ステークホルダーと調整します。翌日の設備稼働・メンテナンス計画を作成し、必要なリソース調整を関連チームと協議して終業します。

About the team
私たちはAmazon Merch on Demand（MoD）のプロダクションセンターQCB7で、オンデマンドプリント製品の製造・出荷を担うチームです。
お客様が注文した瞬間から、一つひとつの製品を「大切な人へのギフト」として心を込めて創り上げ、欲しい時に欲しいモノを届けるという約束を守り続けています。安全を最優先とした作業環境のもと、全員がリーダーとしての自覚を持ち、現状を疑い、破壊と構築を繰り返しながら革新し続けるチームです。互いを理解し心理的安全性を確保することで、一人ひとりが組織の課題を自分事として捉え、行動を起こしています。
Quality Vendor Equipment Managerは、このチームの品質基盤と設備能力を支える重要な役割です。技術的な専門性とリーダーシップの両面で、チームおよびサイト全体のオペレーション進化に貢献します。

Basic qualifications

- 製造技術・生産技術・設備技術における3年以上の実務経験
- 製造ラインの稼働率・生産性改善に向けた設備改善の実務経験
- データを活用した問題解決・継続的改善（Kaizen / Lean / PDCA）の推進経験
- People Managementの経験（直属メンバーへの指導・育成・評価）
- 複数のステークホルダーを巻き込んだプロジェクト推進経験（Project Manager / IC）

Preferred qualifications

- 外部ベンダーとの折衝・品質基準や納期などの契約管理の経験
- QC検定（2級以上推奨）または同等の品質管理資格・実務経験
- 新規設備・新技術の導入プロジェクト（技術検証〜量産化・ハンドオーバー）の経験
- 英語でのビジネス文書作成・メール対応の経験（グローバルチームとの書面でのやり取りが発生します）

title: Sr Manager Ops, AMZL, IN AMZL
descriptionHtml:
External job description
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Amazon is one of the most recognizable brand names in the world and we distribute millions of products each year to our loyal customers

Amazon is seeking Senior Manager Operations for its Transportation team.

We're seeking a Senior Manager Operation. In this role you will be responsible for Setting up the delivery infrastructure in the city which includes identifying the locations for delivery stations and ensure rapid growth in the delivery infrastructure through out the city.

Essential Functions

Defining, building and responsible for the execution of transportation processes, right from FC to customers and leveraging our Delivery center network.

Building capacity in the network by appointing Service Partners and planning IHS points. He/ she maintains relationships with the Service Partners and builds their capability.

Responsible for Hiring, training and building up a highly motivated workforce for the delivery teams, with support from HR and training team , to meet the operational requirements for the city , continuously meeting the high bar on quality and productivity.

Ensure enough bandwidth in citywide delivery team for peak time delivery management.

Coordinate with Finance, CS, FC and Projects team to matters related to city operations.

Conduct the performance appraisals of the Delivery Center Managers and Channel Relationship Managers and mentor them for handling efficient operations.

Continuously improve the delivery process and attain a sustained level of delivery performance standard. Initiates improvements to enhance quality standards, reduce waste, and eliminate unnecessary work.

Analysis of the data reports to identify performance bottlenecks and improve the performance.

Implement the formal process control and process improvement mechanisms such as Kaizen

Essential Skills

Strong leadership capabilities and people management skills

Good communication skills. Ability to communicate and explain to individuals & the team, what needs to be achieved for the Delivery Center /Amazon to achieve its objectives. Listening skills: Gains input and commitment from all involved in delivering their specific part.

Ability to set and achieve timelines for tasks: Set realistic and stretching performance expectations for self and others. Regularly reviews progress and acts to ensure optimal results for the business.

Strong Bias for great customer service: Engage the Team in developing their understanding of Customer Experience and knowledge of what Customers actually needs/expects.

High Ownership: Follows through to ensure the delivery of changes/solutions/services that fulfill the Customer’s needs.

Analytical Skills: Effectively analyze and interpret information, identifying & validating the key facts, including reviewing alternatives to determine advantages and associated risks.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of equivalent experience

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent

title: Account Manager, CA AVS, Paid Selling Partner Services
descriptionHtml:
About Amazon

Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience – Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. descriptionHtml:
Are you looking for your next role but not sure where to start? You've found the right place. At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth, and to get there we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people who are extraordinary at getting things done.

As a Senior Customer and Community Engagement Leader, you'll own the end-to-end relationship with a strategic customer, serving as the primary point of contact between AWS and the customer's leadership. You'll design, build, and deliver programs that create meaningful impact for the customer's communities, and you'll excel at building deep, long-term relationships while matching those communities to the full range of opportunities AWS can offer.

What you'll do:
You'll own the strategy and execution of a customer engagement program, shaping how AWS invests in communities through mentoring, career exploration, tech education, and skills development. You'll represent AWS at the customer's flagship events, such as national summits and gatherings, and coordinate senior executive participation, including engagement at the board and Trustee level.

This role is about creating the strategy and execution of community engagement to drive impact in untapped markets, with a focus on long-term, innovative, high-impact programs that leverage Amazon's unique assets and culture. You'll apply program planning, event management, communications expertise, and project management and collaboration skills, while coordinating and communicating business outcomes and results.

The successful candidate is self-motivated, enthusiastic, and community-driven, with a positive attitude and a readiness to be a team player. This role is for you if you want to contribute, learn, build, and be challenged.

In this role, you'll demonstrate that:
-You build and own deep, trust-based relationships with senior external customers and their leadership, serving as the face of AWS and aligning both organizations around shared goals and measurable outcomes.

-You own the overall strategy of a large engagement program and successfully manage all stages, from concept to delivery. Your program meets challenging business goals and shows measurable improvements in community impact, program reach, engagement, or customer satisfaction.

-You represent AWS at external events, summits, and Trustee or board-level engagements, coordinating the participation of senior Amazon leaders, including Directors and VPs, to maximize impact and visibility.

-You communicate ideas effectively, verbally and in writing, to a wide range of audiences, including Directors, VPs, and external executives. You foster constructive dialogue, harmonize discordant views, and lead the resolution of contentious issues to build consensus. You partner successfully with customers, stakeholders, and internal teams.

-You define clear goals and objectives, drive crisp decisions about which initiatives move forward and in what priority order, and proactively identify risks, bringing them to your team and stakeholders with mitigation plans before they become roadblocks.

-You are a simplifier who judiciously adds, refines, and removes procedures, applying best practices to increase the productivity and effectiveness of the teams you work with.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the customer relationship. Serve as the primary point of contact between AWS and a strategic customer's leadership, building deep, trust-based relationships and aligning both organizations around shared goals and measurable outcomes.
- Lead program strategy and execution. Own an engagement program end to end, from concept and design through delivery, measurement, and continuous improvement.
- Drive community impact. Shape how AWS invests in communities through mentoring, career exploration, tech education, and skills development, with a focus on reaching untapped markets.
- Represent AWS externally. Act as the face of AWS at the customer's flagship events, national summits, and community gatherings, including engagement at the board and Trustee level.

- Define goals and prioritize. Set clear objectives, make crisp decisions about which initiatives move forward and in what order, and keep work aligned to the highest-impact outcomes.

- Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Critical Projects Implementation (CPI) team is a project management and execution team that manages construction activity within the operational data center spaces. The CPI team is tasked with critical infrastructure improvement projects to optimize utilization of space, power, and cooling within operation data centers around the globe. These activities are outside of the scope of standard construction delivery and regular preventative maintenance tasks.

We are currently seeking an energetic Data Center Project Manager to serve as a technical resource within Amazon data centers. title: Graphics Tech Producer, GFX/Tech Ops
descriptionHtml:
Prime Video is seeking a Graphics Technical Producer for our growing Global Live Sports Production team. This role will work with the Technical Operations team to support the entire Live Sports Production team with live game and studio graphics projects. The position will focus on the technical and operational aspects of the Real-Time Graphics department including the coordination and management of graphic systems, data integration and studio builds.

A successful candidate will have experience managing technical workflows and collaborating with both creative and technical personnel, in addition to having a strong knowledge for the most current graphics software and hardware used in game and studio broadcasts. This position will need to be a quick learner who can adapt and thrive in a fast-paced environment with tight timelines and at times little oversight.

The desire and ability to learn and be curious while staying on the leading edge of graphic and broadcast technology will be of the utmost importance. Understanding the nuances and needs of each Prime property will be critical and overall sports knowledge is a must.

Key job responsibilities
• Manage implementation of VizRT, Chyron, and other real-time graphic systems.
• Provide project management for all graphic elements and systems, working closely with Remote and Studio teams.
• Plan and document data feed interfacing and integration across various leagues and vendors.
• Coordinate AR/XR implementation, focusing on studio environments while also supporting AR integration for live games as needed.
• Support internal teams such as AWS with innovative broadcast approaches and advanced data integration.
• Test new software and updates (versions, scripting, and major template changes) before on-air deployment.
• Facilitate training for staff and freelance employees on graphic platform software and workflows.
• Oversee licensing of graphics software for the entire department.
• Collaborate with Media Management to archive all animation and graphic elements.
• Interface with Sales and Production teams on sales-related deliverables.
• Master new graphic platforms as studio tools expand.
• Partner with Technical Operations to enhance existing tools and workflows, identifying areas for improvement and proposing new or upgraded solutions.
• Ensure broadcast asset deliveries meet Prime Video Live Sports Guidelines.
• Work closely with Production/Prod Ops to coordinate Operator training and help host key review meetings.
• Some business travel required.

The GFX team is responsible for delivering technical graphics and building efficient delivery processes across Prime Video Live Sports productions. GFX collaborates with Technical Operations to support the entire Live Sports Production with live game and studio graphics projects.

- 5+ years of technical program management or technical production experience with creative graphics and/or software engineering teams
- 5+ years of experience implementing and operating broadcast real-time graphics systems (e.g., Viz, Chyron, Ross), with a particular focus on Viz Trio.
- Experience leading technical aspects of live sports productions and studio graphics projects
- Experience and knowledge of digital graphic assets and file formats
- Experience executing sales deliverables for live games and shoulder programming

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leading and collaborating with a large cross-functional team
- Experience in advanced data analysis, extracting and synthesizing data for metrics and quantitative analysis
- Experience with a new studio build out for live broadcast
- Experience managing AR/XR systems in live broadcast
- Experience managing complex projects and engaging with multiple stakeholders (tech and non-tech)
