As a single-threaded leader, you'll coordinate efforts across teams, balancing the intricacies of global trade regulations with practical, innovative solutions.

Your work will involve regular collaboration with a broad network of partners, including Technology, Procurement, Compliance Operations, Legal, Tax, and Public Policy teams.

The ideal candidate possesses deep functional knowledge of international customs regulations, tariff classifications, and export controls, combined with the project management skills needed to turn complex regulations into frictionless trade workflows.

Key job responsibilities
Develop and implement comprehensive import and export compliance programs across multiple countries and regions

Partner with Amazon's regional teams to execute, drive, and enforce import/export processes across dedicated lanes, identifying opportunities for automation and technology enablement

Research and analyze trade requirements and regulatory obligations for new and existing markets

Work cross-functionally to help achieve execution against regulatory requirements and internal policies

Deep dive complex regulator topics including customs valuation, duty mitigation, various supply chain models and complex trade barriers (product compliance, licenses, encryption and certification)

Drive compliance program integration with RIVR business teams and supply chain

title: Sr Mgr, Solutions Architecture, US Healthcare and Life Sciences
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about helping medical device companies get life-changing technologies to patients faster and more safely? Do you know the systems that run the medical technology industry, from connected devices and Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) to regulated quality systems, manufacturing, and global supply chains? Most of all, do you want to lead a team of Solutions Architects who help the world's leading MedTech companies migrate, modernize, and innovate on the cloud?

Amazon is where innovation, risks, and ideas are celebrated. We are builders. We try new things and dream big dreams. At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we are inventing the future of cloud computing. AWS is where the cloud first came to life. Now we're inventing for the decades ahead. It is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be part of our diverse teams of thinkers, builders, and doers. Come join us and work with the latest cloud computing technologies that help our customers do more with technology and change the world in their industries.

We are looking for an experienced, customer-obsessed leader to hire, coach, and grow a team of Solutions Architects dedicated to Medical Technology (MedTech) customers in our US Healthcare and Life Sciences (HCLS) organization. MedTech is a distinct segment for AWS. It is built on large-scale migration and data center exit programs, and it is increasingly shaped by connected care, generative AI, and intelligent manufacturing. Your team will be trusted technical advisors to customer executives and engineering leaders. They will help customers design architectures that meet the demands of a highly regulated industry while getting products to market faster.

You need to be technically credible with both customers and architects. You should understand the medical device lifecycle, from design controls and regulatory submission through manufacturing, distribution, and post-market surveillance. You will develop your team's skills in solution selling, architecture design, presentations, and executive engagement, and you will build the specialized domain depth that sets them apart in this industry. You will also work closely with sales, business development, specialist teams, AWS service teams, Professional Services, and partners, and represent your team to executive leadership.

Please apply if you are passionate about the following:

- Using cloud technology to help medical device companies improve patient outcomes and deliver care beyond the hospital
- Helping customers migrate and modernize complex, regulated workloads at enterprise scale
- Deep technical discussions about design, and keeping your technical skills current while tracking MedTech industry trends
- Our company credo: "Work hard. Have fun. Make history." Loving what you do and taking pride in the value you bring to customers matters here

Key job responsibilities
- Lead a team of Solutions Architects supporting strategic MedTech customers, including leaders in medical devices, diagnostics, surgical robotics, and connected health.
- As a key member of the HCLS Solutions Architecture leadership team, set and drive technical strategy for the MedTech segment. This includes large-scale migrations and modernization, connected device and IoT platforms, SaMD, generative and agentic AI, smart manufacturing, and supply chain resilience.
- Hire, onboard, train, and develop Solutions Architects from internal and external sources. Build both AWS technical depth and medical device domain knowledge.
- Partner with Sales and Business Development leaders on account strategy, prioritize engagements, and adjust resourcing to drive revenue, adoption, and market share for AWS.
- Create scalable ways to deliver technical guidance, such as reference architectures, compliance-ready patterns, workshops, and one-to-few and one-to-many enablement.
- Act as a link between customers, AWS service teams, and Support, and bring MedTech customer needs into the AWS product roadmap.
- Communicate clearly with a wide range of audiences. Write strategic documents and lead business and technology discussions with senior leaders inside and outside AWS.
- Represent AWS in the MedTech community through customer executive briefings, industry conferences, and thought leadership.

A day in the life
Your morning starts with a review of engagement updates and migration milestones across your customers, then a sync with your sales counterparts to align on priorities. Mid-morning, you coach an architect preparing an executive briefing on a connected device platform. After that, you join a design review of a manufacturing data architecture that has to meet validation requirements. In the afternoon, you meet with an AWS service team about a customer need for a regulated AI workload, then work on a strategy document outlining your team's goals for the year. You finish with a career development one-on-one with a member of your team.

About the team
The US HCLS Solutions Architecture team helps healthcare and life sciences organizations use the cloud to improve patient outcomes, speed up innovation, and run more efficiently. Our MedTech team works with some of the most innovative medical device companies in the world, supporting everything from enterprise-wide migrations to next-generation connected care and AI-powered products. We value curiosity, technical depth, and domain expertise equally, and we are building an inclusive, collaborative place where people grow. As MedTech adoption of the cloud speeds up, our mission is growing, and we are looking for a leader who wants to help shape it.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of sales, technical pre-sales, product development, or customer facing resources experience
- 7+ years of managing a technical team of solution architects, sales engineers or similar technical roles experience
- Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud

Preferred qualifications

- Experience architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc.
- Knowledge of software development tools and methodologies
- Bachelor's degree

title: ASIC Design Verification Engineer, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

The Role:
Be part of Amazon Leo’s sub-team responsible for defining and implementing the digital chip SOCs for communications via Low Earth Orbit satellites and Amazon gateways. This is a unique opportunity to define a groundbreaking wireless solution with few legacy constraints. The team works with customer requirements and wireless system teams to define modems, high-speed interfaces, embedded processors, and DSP solutions in latest CMOS generation technologies.

In this role you will:
· Implement a state of the art verification environment to facilitate testing of the RTL against reference Matlab/C models
· Develop detailed test plans and write tests, run regressions, collect coverage matrices and report progress to the program
· Write tests in C/C++ to execute on embedded CPU
· Develop tests for FPGA and emulation platforms
· Run formal verification of complex blocks to ensure functional correctness
· Work with the design and communication systems team and participate in system level verification using test benches constructed using UVM, System C and DPI-C
· Develop a highly automated environment to run regressions that can be used to make builds and maintain organization of the database

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- 5+ years of UVM, C, System C, and scripting experience
- 5+ years of verification work preferably in communication systems experience

Preferred qualifications

- Master's or Ph.D degree in Electrical / Communications Engineering
- 7+ years in digital verification, preferably in communication systems
- Familiarity with Matlab
- Modem design verification experience
- System C or Matlab model : development or DV integration experience
- Familiarity with formal verification techniques
- Strong written and verbal skills

title: Sr. Strategic Account Manager, US Global Selling Team
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a candidate with a passion for e-commerce and a desire to make a real impact on global customers in a Day One business. Our mission is to expand selection from US-based retailers and brand owners worldwide. Although we are already a multi-billion-dollar business, we believe we are just getting started, as less than 5% of US-based sellers have started their international journey. This role offers the opportunity to innovate and elevate the seller and customer experience on a global scale.
As a Sr. Strategic Account Manager on the Amazon Global Selling team, you will work with top Amazon.com sellers, helping them expand their online retail business to Amazon's stores worldwide. You will work with sellers' CXO-level leadership teams, identifying key decision-makers and aligning them to prioritize actions required to expand their online retail business to Amazon's global stores such as Amazon.co.uk, Amazon.de, Amazon.com.mx. You will build and cultivate strong relationships with sellers in your portfolio and be a trusted e-commerce and global sales advisor to the CXO leadership in seller organizations. You will partner with external service providers to help your sellers obtain the required tax and product-level compliance certifications for selling in new markets. You will be comfortable with long sales cycles, often lasting more than 8 months, taking sellers through step-by-step processes to launch in a new market. Success in this role will be evaluated based on the scale of the sellers you manage, the number of new markets into which you help your sellers expand, unique selection additions in global markets, and the global sales revenue you drive from sellers in your portfolio. You will utilize a wide range of sales and negotiation skills and work across cross-functional areas to drive the performance of sellers in your portfolio.
In addition to your day-to-day role working with sellers, you will also contribute to business strategy development and identify the correct input metrics that drive business growth for sellers in Amazon's global stores. You will use customer feedback, market growth trends, competitive best practices, and Gen AI developments to suggest new features required in our products and promotional programs to accelerate seller growth or improve the selling partner experience. You will partner with cross-functional teams in the US and worldwide teams to drive key programs that accelerate post-launch seller growth.
Ideal candidates will thrive in an ambiguous and dynamic environment where they must develop, evolve, and implement business strategies to deliver results, have relentlessly high standards, and operate as business owners with end-to-end responsibility to deliver business growth.


Key job responsibilities
• Build strong relationships with CXO-level stakeholders in sellers' organizations to drive decisions and actions required to launch sellers' businesses on Amazon's global online stores.
• Pitch CXO-level stakeholders on the benefits of selling their products on Amazon's global online stores in Europe, Asia, and South America.
• Guide sellers through the step-by-step process for global account registration, KYC, tax and product compliance, etc.
• Provide ongoing post-launch support on selection expansion, deals, sponsored ads, etc., to help sellers grow sales on Amazon's global stores.
• Prepare and conduct monthly business reviews with CXO stakeholders in sellers' organizations regarding progress and strategies to increase their revenue on Amazon's global websites.
• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders and program leaders to drive business growth.
• Pilot new initiatives and iterate the existing best practices to improve productivity and impact.
• Identify automation opportunities for manual tasks and partner with Gen AI product team to scale automation across our WW global selling team.
• Leverage agentic tools to provide personalized experience to sellers and scale your and team’s impact.


About the team
The Amazon Global Selling team's vision is to be the first choice for all US retail businesses to go global. We operate with the agility of a startup and a singular mission to empower US-based sellers to expand their businesses worldwide. We are committed to building an AI-native, agentic organization — one where AI agents increasingly handle execution at breadth and speed, while our account management team owns the strategy, the deep insights, the judgment, and the outcomes. The US Global Selling (USGS) team owns the full business lifecycle of North American sellers, expanding them into 20 global markets. Our mission is to make US selections available to customers worldwide. We're dedicated to simplifying global expansion and international selling for US-based sellers, working closely with them on both tech and non-tech aspects of product, supply chain, compliance, and international logistics.

- 4+ years of full sales cycle, technology sales or equivalent business development experience
- Experience proactively growing customer relationships within an account while expanding their understanding of the customer's business
- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- Experience in data analysis and extracting insights to make data-backed business decisions
- 3+ years of experience owning a customer portfolio and building a sales pipeline across high-value existing accounts.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience exceeding sales targets using a consultative, solutions-focused approach or equivalent

title: Data Center Engineering Operations Engineer, ICN - DCEO
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services Korea is looking for a detail-oriented individual to join our Data Center Engineering Operations Team. This committed group works to maintain the critical physical infrastructure that supports Amazon Web Services. Specifically, this team works to ensure that the data center's MEP operates at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups within the data centers.

The Data Center Engineering Operations is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating within contract parameters within third party Colocation facilities. Often this will be including risk management and mitigation, corrective and preventative maintenance of critical infrastructure, vendor management and metric reporting.

한국 AWS DCEO팀에서는 데이터센터에 열정이 있는 MEP(Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) 전문가를 채용하고 있습니다. 데이터센터 엔지니어링 운영팀은 Amazon Web Services의 물리적 인프라의 유지 및 관리를 통해 데이터 센터 MEP의 100% 가용성을 보장합니다.

DCEO는 데이터 센터 내의 모든 전기, 기계 및 화재 / 안전 장비가 계약 조항에 맞게 운영되도록 벤더 및 시설을 관리하는 업무를 담당합니다. 주요 업무에는 인프라의 장애 예방/유지 관리, 리크스 관리, 업체 관리 및 관련 보고 업무가 포함됩니다.

Key job responsibilities
• Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all aspects of the critical facility operations and maintenance
• Responsible for the on-site management of shift technicians, senior shift technicians, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices and procedures.
• Manage relationship with third party Colocation providers and their facility staff
• Responsible for the operation of and management of both routine and emergency services on a variety of critical systems such as: switchgear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, etc.
• Data Center capacity planning and reporting
• May assist in the design and build out of new facilities
• May assist in projects to increase current Facility efficiency
• Work with IT managers and other business leaders to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability and efficiency
• Deliver quality service and ensure all customer demands are met
• Procurement for DCEO related expenditure
• Responsible for asset and inventory management

• 미션크리티컬 시설 운영/유지 보수 성능의 벤치 마크, 분석 및 보고서 작성
• 모든 작업이 절차에 따라 이루어 지도록 벤더 테크니션 현장 관리
• 코로케이션 벤더 및 서드파티(3rd party) 관리
• 스위치 기어, 발전기, UPS 시스템, 전력 분배 장비, 냉각기, 냉각탑, CRAH, 빌딩 모니터링 시스템(BMS) 등과 같은 다양한 크리티컬 시스템 서비스의 운영 및 관리

• 고객 수요를 충족하는 양질의 서비스 제공
• DCEO 관련 구매
• 자산 및 재고 관리

title: Area Manager, Amazon Logistics, Ravenhall
descriptionHtml:
Area Manager

Here at Amazon we are currently seeking for experienced Area Manager to join the business and play a critical role in leading our team of associates within our Delivery Station in Ravenhall, VIC

Do you have a passion for motivating, mentoring, and coaching a team? Do you pride yourself in maintaining the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance and performance? As an Area Manager, you will play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

The hours of the role are Wed - Saturday 01:00 - 11:00


Key job responsibilities
• Reviewing and understanding the transportation process from Fulfilment Centres to delivery stations
• Measure and Ensure enough bandwidth in sortation team to ensure peak time delivery management
• Assist and work alongside Area Managers to review performance appraisals of the station supervisors and learn on how to mentor them for handling efficient operations
• Continuously improve the through put and attain a sustained level of delivery performance improvement
• Review and assist on analysis of the data reports to identify performance bottlenecks and improve the performance

You will be an inspiring leader within our Delivery Stations, where you will work to continuously improve the efficiency of delivery processes, ensuring that customer orders are delivered as quickly, accurately, and cost-effectively as possible. - Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

title: Enterprise Support Leader - Strategic Accounts
descriptionHtml:
As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

Amazon has built a reputation for excellence with recent examples of being named #1 in customer service, #1 most trusted, and #2 most innovative. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is carrying on that tradition while leading the world in Cloud technologies. As a member of the AWS Support team you will be at the forefront of this transformational technology assisting a global list of companies that are taking advantage of a growing set of services and features to run their mission-critical applications. The AWS Support team is seeking an Enterprise Support Operations Manager that enjoys solving problems, working with customers, and who has a background from a variety of different fields. Works directly with Amazon Web Service engineers to ensure that customer issues are resolved as expediently as possible

Executive leadership, ability to hold AWS technical conversations.

title: Robotics Systems Engineer, Tech Deployment
descriptionHtml:
Are you enthusiastic about the latest advancements in industrial automation and robotics? Would you like to play a vital role in Amazon's investment in advanced technologies? If you have a passion for making an impact on the future today, consider joining Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovations (RDPI) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) org. In RDPI, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in RDPI develop. Project durations vary from a few days to several months, with travel across North America. This is a travel-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.

As a Systems Engineer in RDPI, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro-mechanical and network systems, demonstrating leadership in installation, maintenance, upgrades, and troubleshooting of technologies being deployed across North America. You will work with cross-functional partners across our engineering, product strategy, software, supply chain, third-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go-live of each project. Candidates should have a proven track record of successfully leading multiple concurrent projects across one or more automation solutions.

**Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston, Nashville or Austin will be required for the role.



Key job responsibilities
As a Systems Engineer I, you will work with a team of 1-5 engineers and collaborate with an on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on the installation of both third party and Amazon designed robotics equipment that may be in various phases of the product life cycle. These deployments require extensive collaboration with various stakeholders, including third-party installers, contracted engineers, construction, hardware, software, IT, and other partner teams. Strong communication skills are essential for interacting with both internal and external partners and customers. As an Amazonian, you must demonstrate independent initiative to identify and solve problems in real time during deployments. A strong technical understanding, love for field work, and a keen interest in diving deep into the understanding of Amazon’s robotics systems are key attributes for this role.

- You will support and guide installation of robotics, packaging and sortation technologies at Amazon fulfillment centers

- You will develop detailed knowledge of the operation of robotic systems and guide installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting of these systems both on site and remotely

- You will manage technical ambiguity around integration of work cells in fulfillment centers

- You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams

- You will travel to project sites and collaborate both virtually and in person to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status

- You will manage day to day project scheduling and budget management

- You will work on continuous improvement activities to improve the projects in your space

- You will generate and implement continuous improvement ideas around work-scopes

- You will lead teams of other engineers on projects

- You will travel to both live warehouses and new construction sites, the scopes may vary significantly in length and include heavy travel

- You will travel to project sites across North America, upwards of 75% or more

A day in the life
In this role you will be focused on execution of end-to-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure the product you are deploying, is both ready for deployment and capable of achieving the business requirements. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day-to-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve the projects in your space. You will spend time with mentors and your manager to develop your professional skills and collaborate amongst your team to move the needle on the services you are accountable for.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!



About the team
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you’ll fit right in here at Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation (RDPI) within Amazon Robotics (AR). We are a smart, collaborative team of enthusiastic doers that work passionately to apply new and innovative advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we can’t even image yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are RDPI and we will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun

RDPI Tech Deployment are missioned with enabling the delivery of large scale automation technologies designed and manufactured by Amazon. The team is multi-disciplinary, and consists of Field Deployment Engineers, Controls Engineering, Design for Deployment, Product Single Threaded Leaders, and a Program Management Office team, who collaborate on enabling the delivery of new technologies and packaging solutions that delight our customers, and improve the safety, quality and costs within the Amazon fulfillment processes. The team is geographically located across four North America hub locations. The work we deliver directly impact high priority goals set each year to our most senior leadership at Amazon.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, or related STEM field
- 1+ years' Experience working on mechanical, electrical, IT networked, or software systems
- Understanding of data collection, reporting processes, and ability to make data-driven decisions
- Ability to review data to set troubleshoot priorities on highly complex technical systems
- Ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
- Interest to work primarily in a construction or warehouse environment in a field-based role
- Ability to travel domestically 75% or more of the year

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of engineering, construction, manufacturing, or warehouse environment experience
- Proven experience working on hardware integration or complex mechanical-electrical or networked industrial equipment. Knowledge of specific robotic equipment (Fanuc, ABB), and Allen Bradley PLC experience
- Knowledge of networking protocols such as HTTP, DNS and TCP/IP
- Certified in OSHA, ANSI, or other Automation Safety Certifications. Familiarity with LEAN or Six Sigma, certifications are a plus

title: Ausbildung - Mechatronik
descriptionHtml:
Deine Chance: Technik, die bewegt
Bei uns hältst du die Systeme am Laufen, die Produkte vom Klick bis zur Haustür bringen. Du analysierst Störungen, wartest komplexe Anlagen und arbeitest mit Mechanik, Elektrotechnik, Pneumatik und Steuerungssoftware, mit echtem Einfluss vom ersten Tag an.
Hier ist deine Arbeit nicht abstrakt. Sie ist sichtbar, unmittelbar und bedeutsam. Und dein Weg? Den gestaltest du selbst, mit endlosen Möglichkeiten, dich weiterzuentwickeln.

Du tüftelst gerne, packst mit an und willst früh Verantwortung übernehmen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Key job responsibilities
• Installation, Überwachung, Wartung und Instandhaltung mechanischer und elektrischer Anlagen.
• Analyse und Behebung von Störungen an automatisierten Systemen.
• Arbeiten in den Bereichen Metallbearbeitung, Elektrotechnik, Hydraulik, Pneumatik und Steuerungstechnik.
• Messen, Prüfen und Programmieren von Komponenten nach Vorgaben und Sicherheitsstandards.
• Unterstützung bei der vorbeugenden Instandhaltung und Inbetriebnahme neuer Anlagen.


A day in the life
Deine Ausbildung verbindet Theorie und Praxis von Anfang an. Deine theoretische Ausbildung absolvierst Du in unserer modernen Partnerlehrwerkstatt sowie der Berufsschule, während Du die praktischen Kenntnisse direkt bei Amazon am Standort erwirbst.
Ein typischer Tag? Du analysierst eine Störung an einer Förderanlage, tauschst Komponenten aus und bringst das System wieder zum Laufen. Am nächsten Tag programmierst du eine Steuerung, führst eine vorbeugende Wartung durch oder unterstützt bei der Inbetriebnahme neuer Technik.
Du arbeitest von Anfang an Seite an Seite mit erfahrenen Techniker:innen, die dich fördern und fordern. Du übernimmst schrittweise mehr Verantwortung, probierst Dinge aus und lernst Fähigkeiten, von denen du vorher nicht wusstest, dass es sie gibt.

Basic qualifications

- Du hast mindestens einen Hauptschulabschluss zum Beginn der Ausbildung
- Fortgeschrittene Deutschkenntisse in Wort und Schrift (B2-Niveau)
- Gute Schulnoten in Mathematik und Physik (abhängig von der Schulform)

Preferred qualifications

- Du besitzt handwerkliches Geschick und verfügst über ein technisches Grundverständnis
- Grundkenntnisse in Englisch (A2-Niveau)
- Du bringst bereits erste Vorerfahrungen im handwerklichen Bereich mit
- Eigeninitiative, Vorbildfunktion und „Hands-on-Mentalität“
- Proaktives Vorantreiben von Veränderungsprozessen und eigenverantwortliche Entscheidungsfindung
- Bist du interessiert? Wir freuen uns darauf, von Dir zu hören! Bitte bewirb Dich mit deinen vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen auf Deutsch (Lebenslauf, Zeugniskopie – ein PDF mit 5 MB max.). Sollten die Bewerbungsunterlagen nicht vollständig sein, können wir deine Bewerbung leider nicht berücksichtigen! Bitte beachte, dass du im Rahmen des Einstellungsprozesses ein Videointerview über ein externes Tool durchführen musst. Mit der Übersendung Deines Lebenslaufs erklärst Du Dich mit der Speicherung Deiner Daten zum Zwecke der Feststellung der Eignung für dieses und zukünftige Stellenangebot/e in der weltweiten Amazon Konzernpersonaldatenbank, die derzeit in den USA geführt wird, einverstanden.

Du arbeitest von Anfang an Seite an Seite mit erfahrenen Techniker:innen, die dich fördern und fordern. Du übernimmst schrittweise mehr Verantwortung, probierst Dinge aus und lernst Fähigkeiten, von denen du vorher nicht wusstest, dass es sie gibt.

title: Area Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our Worldwide Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly employees and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key part in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Rapid and Rural Logistics (R2L) is an exciting organization within Amazon specializing in delighting our customers with speed in which we can make items appear on their doorsteps. We are a combination of operations and support teams aligned to innovate for the last mile customer experience. Come build the future with us!

- Lift up to 49 pounds, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach, as well as continuously climb and descend stairs
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments, and grocery locations include refrigerated environments)
- Work a flexible schedule (weekends and/or overnight shifts)

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

descriptionHtml:

We offer you the opportunity to deliver and lead high visibility & high-impact innovation for customers across the Cart application services in Amazon. We extend to you the opportunity to develop upon multi-tiered, low-latency, highly resilient distributed systems on a grand scale. You will play a pivotal role in crafting solutions that profoundly enhance the shopping experience, handling vast data volumes, delivering lightning-fast response times, and simplifying the cart process to a remarkable degree. You must understand the importance of quality and testability in regards to the long term health and operational excellence of the Amazon eco system and you will be expected to drive improvements to current and future systems in these areas. You will contribute to both funcational and non-functional aspects of the application in the form of enhacing customer experience, improving latency, performance, and business investigations. You will learn and grow by working closely with senior engineers across our organisation.

The ideal candidate will have excellent technical design, problem solving, Computer Science fundamentals, and communication skills. The candidate should be comfortable interacting with technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels. The ability to work backwards and think from a customer perspective is crucial as the ideal candidate is expected to contribute to the product vision in addition to the technical design and implementation.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and develop full-stack solutions for Cart/Checkout services, considering scalability, performance, and reliability across multi-tiered distributed systems
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, design, and operations to understand customer needs and translate them into technical implementations
- Investigate and optimize system performance, latency, and resource utilization through data-driven analysis and experimentation
- Contribute to code quality and system testability by establishing best practices, conducting thorough code reviews, and identifying areas for improvement
- Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and participate actively in design and architecture discussions

A day in the life
As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you'll work on full-stack solutions that handle massive transaction volumes while maintaining lightning-fast response times. Your day might include collaborating with product and design partners to understand customer pain points in the post add to cart experiences, writing and reviewing code for distributed systems that process millions of requests, investigating performance bottlenecks to optimize latency, and participating in design discussions with engineers across our organization. You'll balance building new features with strengthening the foundational systems that keep our services reliable and resilient. Beyond coding, you'll contribute to our culture of operational excellence by identifying opportunities to improve system quality, testability, and long-term health.

About the team
We're a collaborative group of engineers passionate about delivering seamless post add to cart and cart experiences for Amazon customers worldwide. Our team focuses on building the infrastructure and services that make purchasing simple and dependable, even during peak shopping periods. We work closely with engineers at all levels across the organization, learning from one another and sharing knowledge to solve complex distributed systems challenges. Together, we're committed to continuously improving how customers interact with our platform, and we're excited to have someone join us who thinks deeply about both technical excellence and customer impact.

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Instandhaltungstechniker - Frankenthal
descriptionHtml:
Das Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist für unseren Betrieb von fundamentaler Bedeutung – es sorgt dafür, dass unsere technischen Systeme und Anlagen laufend funktionieren. Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du für die Wartung und Instandhaltung unserer förder- und haustechnischen Anlagen sowie Produktionsanlagen zuständig. Du hilfst, die höchsten Sicherheitsstandards im Arbeitsschutz zu gewährleisten und Maschinenausfallzeiten zu verhindern. Unser technisches Team stellt eine hohe Verfügbarkeit der technischen Anlagen sicher und verbessert die Qualität unserer Geräte.


Key job responsibilities
- Ausführung präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an einer breiten Vielfalt von Geräten an unseren Standorten
- Durchführung von Reparaturen und Fehlerdiagnosen
- Verwendung neuester Tools zur Maximierung der Geräteeffektivität
- Einhaltung aller Arbeitsschutzrichtlinien und -praktiken
- Unterstützung der Entwicklung und des beruflichen Fortschritts von Auszubildenden am Standort
- Arbeit an Projekten zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Einführung von Best Practices an verschiedenen EU-Standorten

A day in the life
Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren tätig, um schnell auf technische Störungen reagieren zu können. Du führst eine Reihe geplanter präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an Geräten durch, um für ihren sicheren Betrieb zu sorgen. Außerdem reagierst Du als Instandhaltungstechniker:in unverzüglich auf Störungen und Ausfälle. Du untersuchst die Ursachen, findest so schnell wie möglich Lösungen und wendest sie an. Zudem machst Du Vorschläge für langfristige Verbesserungen.

In Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Kolleg:innen nimmst Du tägliche Wartungsaufgaben wahr und kommunizierst mit Dienstleistern, falls Du externe Expertise benötigst. Du arbeitest in rotierenden Schichten, damit wir rund um die Uhr unsere Standorte unterstützen – und dafür sorgen, dass Amazon weiterhin in dem Tempo liefern kann, für das wir bekannt sind.

About the team


Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) sorgt dafür, dass unsere Geräte und Ausstattung jederzeit optimal funktionieren. Wir sind ein Team von Techniker:innen und Ingenieur:innen, das aus hervorragenden Teamplayern besteht und von erfahrenen Führungskräften geleitet wird. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, die Geräte in unserem gesamten globalen Netzwerk von Fulfillment-Centern zu warten, zu reparieren und ihre Fehler zu beheben. Einige unserer Mitarbeiter:innen sind Führungskräfte, die das Team bei der Arbeit an spannender, innovativer Technologie beaufsichtigen – die es teilweise nur bei Amazon gibt. Von der Installation automatisierter Verpackungssysteme bis hin zur Beaufsichtigung der allgemeinen Wartungsarbeiten eines Standorts sowie der Reparatur von für den Vertrieb wesentlichen Geräten wickelt unser Team einen Großteil der technischen Aufgaben bei Amazon ab. Unter anderem sorgt es auch dafür, dass Gebäude weiterhin den rechtlichen Auflagen entsprechen, damit alle sicher bleiben und unsere Standorte mit maximaler Effizienz betrieben werden. Es gibt zahlreiche Aufstiegschancen im RME-Team selbst ebenso wie im gesamten Amazon-Unternehmen. Alle unsere Aktivitäten sind darauf ausgerichtet, die Ausfallzeiten an Amazons wichtigsten Betriebsstandorten zu reduzieren, damit Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen rechtzeitig erhalten. Oft arbeiten wir früh morgens, spät abends oder in der Nachtschicht, um Wartungsarbeiten mit den geringstmöglichen Störungen vorzunehmen. title: Data Center Engineering Operations - 2027 Internship
descriptionHtml:
Want to be part of the team that keeps the world's largest cloud running? As an Engineering Operations Technician Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will get hands-on experience with the critical infrastructure behind Amazon's global data centers — and your work will directly impact millions of customers worldwide.

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Engineering Operations Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:

- Students in the last year of their Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career.

It is a requirement to be graduated by the end of the internship.


About the Role

As an intern, you will provide technical support within Amazon's owned and operated data centers. Your work will ensure that the data center's mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems operate at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups on site.

You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

What You Will Do

The Engineering Operations team is Amazon's front-line responders for hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. You will work with equipment that supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. This equipment includes, but is not limited to:

- Stand-by diesel generators and switchgear

- Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPSs) and Power Distribution Units (PDUs)

- Air Handling Units (AHUs), chillers, and cooling towers

- Chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs)

- Building automation systems

Your day-to-day duties include:

- Maintaining mechanical and electrical equipment

- Assisting with root cause analysis of equipment failures

- Troubleshooting facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs)

- Taking daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment

- Using internal Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) to manage building workflows

- Interacting with third-party vendors and contractors working on site

Internship Structure

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 3 consecutive months, starting in summer 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Sunday through Thursday.

Please note that full-time Engineering Operations Technician roles operate on a rotating shift pattern, which may include days, nights, weekends, and public holidays. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will troubleshoot and maintain the systems that keep AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.

Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. From cloud computing to artificial intelligence, the systems you maintain power it all.

Action. You will move fast, experiment, and learn by doing. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.

Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.

Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Beyond that, you will find continuous learning opportunities and the chance to work on different projects. Your journey here is yours to shape.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.

You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.

Basic qualifications

- In pursuit of a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, graduating in 2027 - before the end of the internship.
- Professional English proficiency, both written and verbal
- Ability to work well with others in a team environment, with strong time management skills
- You must have access to your own transport (note: public transit options may be limited)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in program or project management
- Knowledge of mechanical systems (Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning systems, controls)

title: UK&I Engagement Manager -, Prototyping AI and Customer Engineering
descriptionHtml:
You will be a Prototyping Engagement Manager in the AWS PACE (Prototyping and Customer Engineering) team, based in London. You are the face of PACE for customers in the UK&I — helping enterprises turn their most ambitious ideas into working technology proofpoints on AWS.

You work at the intersection of business strategy and emerging technology. You identify the opportunities where generative AI, agentic systems, and cloud-native architectures can create the most value for a customer — then you shape, qualify, and drive those engagements from first conversation to working prototype and beyond.

You pilot a pipeline of high-value innovation opportunities, you earn the trust of C-suite and technical leaders alike, and you create the conditions for brilliant engineers to do their best work. You pair with hands-on Prototyping Architects to deliver multi-week hands-on engagements that de-risk transformation, prove out new workloads, and accelerate customers' paths to production.

You thrive in ambiguity. Your customers are navigating generational technology shifts — foundation models, autonomous agents, intelligent automation — and you help them cut through the noise, make crisp decisions, and move fast. You work backwards from customer outcomes, you insist on the highest standards in scoping and delivery, and you invent on behalf of customers who don't yet know what's possible.

This role is based in London and supports customers across UK&I, working alongside account teams, specialist organisations, and partners to drive workload adoption at the frontier of what AWS can do. The team works closely with the broader AWS PACE EMEA team sharing best practices and collaborating on solving frontier challenges.

Key job responsibilities
You build and pilot a pipeline of innovation opportunities across UK&I — working with account teams, specialists, and partners to proactively identify where generative AI and cloud-native architecture can unlock the most value.

You qualify with rigour. You ask the hard questions early — is there a real business outcome, a committed customer, a path to production? You invest resources where they matter and disqualify where they don't.

You scope engagements that set teams up for success — working backwards from customer outcomes to define crisp, time-boxed prototypes with clear success criteria.

You drive engagements from kickoff to close — coordinating customer developers, AWS architects, and partners, mitigating risk, and ensuring every engagement closes with demonstrated value and a concrete next step.

You are a trusted advisor to senior leaders — helping executives navigate generational technology shifts and make confident investment decisions.

You scale what works — packaging repeatable motions and sharing them across the PACE community worldwide.

You represent the customer internally — feeding engagement insights back into AWS service teams and product roadmaps.

A day in the life
You start with a standup — a customer's engineering team is two weeks into a generative AI prototype and needs your help unblocking a decision. Mid-morning, you're scoping a new engagement with a Saudi enterprise exploring agentic AI. After lunch you review your pipeline, update qualifications, and plan resourcing with your Prototyping Architect. Later, you're with a customer's CTO — they've seen prototype results and want to talk path to production. You finish the day writing up a repeatable pattern you spotted, something the wider PACE team could use.

About the team
PACE (Prototyping AI and Customer Engineering) is AWS's hands-on customer innovation team. We work directly with enterprise customers to turn their boldest ideas into working technology — building prototypes that de-risk transformation and accelerate adoption.

Our model pairs Engagement Managers with Prototyping Architects: you shape the opportunity, they shape the technology, and together you deliver something real. This role sits within EMEA PACE, supporting customers across UK&I , backed by a worldwide community that shares patterns, tools, and lessons learned.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in technical program management working directly with software engineering teams
- Experience managing cross-functional programs and release schedules
- Experience building and evaluating system-level technical design
- Experience developing and executing/delivering product and technical roadmaps
- Experience managing technical programs across cross-functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience working directly with engineering teams
- Experience in system design

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field

title: Data Center Technician - 2027 Internship
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.

This is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most cutting-edge data centers in the world. Amazon data centers are large-scale, high-density facilities where you will help change the face of cloud technology in the region — and your work will directly impact millions of customers.

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Data Center Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:

- Students in the last year of their Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field such as Information Technology, Computer Hardware Repair, or similar. It is a requirement to be graduated by the end of the internship.

Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying.


As a Data Center Technician Intern, you will work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure. This position involves hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair.

You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

What You Will Do

You will provide our internal teams with infrastructure-related support, resolving tickets related to hardware (motherboards, Random Access Memory, Central Processing Units, Graphics Processing Units, and more) and networking (link-down events, optics replacements, switch replacements, and more).

In addition to hardware and network repair, you will learn how to install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix complex problems within the data center environment.

Your day-to-day duties include:

- Troubleshooting server hardware alongside experienced AWS technicians

- Meeting Service Level Agreements (SLAs) against assigned trouble tickets

- Shadowing AWS technicians during network troubleshooting to build your diagnostic skills

- Replacing media (Solid State Drives and Hard Disk Drives) in accordance with AWS Data Tech guidance

- Performing regular server hardware repairs (drives, motherboards, and other components) under the guidance of experienced technicians

- Interacting with third-party vendors and contractors working on site

Internship Structure

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 3 consecutive months, starting in summer 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Sunday through Thursday.

Please note that a full-time Data Center Technician position could involve day, evening, or weekend shifts and on-call rotations. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will diagnose and repair the servers and networks that keep AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.

Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. Every server you repair and every network issue you resolve keeps the cloud running.

Action. You will move fast, learn by doing, and solve real problems from day one. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.

Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.

Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing. Projects and tasks are assigned in a way that leverages your strengths and helps you further develop your skill set. Your journey here is yours to shape.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.

You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.

Basic qualifications

- In pursuit of a Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field such as Information Technology, Computer Hardware Repair, or similar, graduating in 2027 – before the internship´s end date.
- Professional English proficiency, both written and verbal
- Ability to work well with others in a team environment, with strong time management skills

Preferred qualifications

- Basic knowledge of computer hardware components
- Ability to manage work and priorities through a ticketing system and coordination with Manager.
- An interest in computer sciences and information technology

title: Refrigeration Systems Quality Engineer, GES NA Quality (Design & Construction)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon operates one of the most sophisticated logistics networks in the world, and the physical infrastructure behind it — including sub-same-day (SSD) grocery sites, sortation centers, and delivery stations — depends on complex commercial refrigeration systems that must perform reliably from day one. As a Refrigeration Systems Quality Engineer within Global Engineering Services (GES) North America Quality, you are Amazon’s owner’s-side technical authority on the quality of refrigeration systems across the design, construction, and commissioning lifecycle.
In this role, you are the dedicated subject matter expert responsible for the inspection, commissioning verification, and specification conformance of commercial refrigeration systems — including CO₂/transcritical and conventional architectures — as they are installed at new builds, retrofits, and expansions. You verify that what is designed, specified, and installed will operate as intended, and you drive the early detection and prevention of defects before they reach launch and operations.
You serve as the primary technical interface between Amazon and its external partners — general contractors (GC), architects of record (AoR), design engineers, third-party commissioning agents, and authorities having jurisdiction (AHJ) — while collaborating closely with internal stakeholders across Design, Construction, Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME), and Operations. You operate with a high degree of independence within your assigned region, supporting multiple concurrent sites, and this role requires 80% regional travel within North America.


Key job responsibilities
Refrigeration Quality Inspection & Field Verification Conduct field inspections of installed commercial refrigeration systems — piping, compressors, rack systems, evaporators, condensers, door hardware, sensors, and controls — to verify conformance to approved plans, Amazon standards, and applicable codes. Identify installation defects and non-conformances and drive their correction with the responsible owner.

Commissioning, IOQ & Performance Validation Witness operational, pressure, and leak tests. Perform installation, operational, and performance qualifications (IOQ) and review commissioning submittals and turnover documentation. Validate that monitoring and alarming (CO₂ and refrigerant leak detection) function reliably under real field conditions — not merely at sign-off.

Specification & Standards Conformance Review design documents, drawings, and specifications for conformance; identify gaps early. Confirm as-built conditions match approved specs, and define testing and acceptance criteria.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management Partner with contractors, design engineers, and commissioning agents to set quality expectations and hold partners accountable. Collaborate with Design, Construction, RME, and Operations teams. Audit vendor performance and address underperformance directly.

Documentation, Data & Reporting Prepare inspection and verification reports, maintain quality data, analyze defect trends, and lead process improvements that move quality upstream — from reactive field correction to prevention by design.

A day in the life
You support one or more refrigeration sites that vary in scope, complexity, and phase of delivery. Your day may include a site walk to inspect piping, rack systems, and door hardware against approved specs; witnessing a leak or operational test and verifying that CO₂ detection and alarming respond correctly; and reviewing a third-party commissioning exit report and IOQ package. You may flag a non-conformance — such as a sensor that passes commissioning but fails to alarm in a simulated leak — and drive resolution with GC and design team. Throughout, you communicate progress and risk and keep Amazon's systems current.

About the team
The GES NA Quality team is a diverse group of engineers and quality professionals dedicated to delivering high-quality, reliable facilities and infrastructure for Amazon's logistics network. We are employee owners who insist on the highest standards — owning quality from design review through construction, commissioning, and operational handover.

We are never satisfied with status quo. We continuously raise the quality bar, capture lessons learned, and feed them back into our standards and mechanisms so every site is better than the last. We collaborate, support one another, and leverage subject matter expertise to deliver on Amazon's promise to customers and communities.

Basic qualifications

- Experience reading and interpreting construction drawings and specifications, or experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
- 4+ years of refrigeration industry experience, or experience in reliability/maintenance environments
- 5+ years of hands-on experience in commercial or industrial refrigeration — spanning installation, commissioning, inspection, or maintenance of refrigeration systems.
- Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, HVAC/R Engineering, or a related technical/STEM field.
- EPA Section 608 Universal certification.

Preferred qualifications

- Refrigeration Trade School certificate
- Knowledge of AutoCAD, VBA, and SQL at the intermediate level
- Experience working with and managing third party vendors
- Direct experience with CO₂/transcritical refrigeration systems.
- Experience with refrigeration controls and monitoring platforms (e.g., Copeland/Emerson controllers, advanced refrigeration monitoring systems).
- Owner’s-representative, quality-assurance, or large-program experience delivering concurrent projects across multiple sites.

title: Senior Risk Manager, INFORM Act, Account Compliance Risk
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an experienced compliance professional to join the Account Compliance Risk & Quality (ACRQ) team within Amazon's 1st Line of Defence, providing dedicated, independent risk oversight of the INFORM Consumers Act program. The INFORM Act requires online marketplaces to collect, verify, and disclose information about high-volume third-party sellers to protect consumers from fraud and illicit goods.

Sitting within Account Compliance Risk, the role operates independently from the teams responsible for day-to-day execution of INFORM requirements and controls. You will provide senior-level regulatory risk judgement and an independent view of compliance and risk exposure to senior leadership and governance forums. You are the person who sees the full picture across Legal, Technology, Program, and Operations, connects the dots across workstreams, and raises red flags when the program's risk posture is trending in the wrong direction. The team is actively building AI-powered risk assessment tools and automated monitoring frameworks, and you will be expected to engage with and help shape how these capabilities are applied to oversight work.

Key job responsibilities
- Own and maintain the INFORM Obligation Register and Compliance Requirements Document (CRD), ensuring all regulatory requirements are mapped, current, traceable to controls, and translated into actionable compliance requirements for programme teams.
- Provide independent, evidence-based assessment of the end-to-end INFORM risk and control environment, covering seller identification, verification, certification, disclosure, enforcement, and reporting. Review and challenge control design and operating effectiveness using monitoring results, operational metrics, incidents, and complaints.
- Identify emerging risks, systemic weaknesses, and concentrations of regulatory exposure. Lead regulatory horizon scanning, translate changes into impacts for the control environment, and maintain risk appetite thresholds and escalation mechanisms in partnership with Legal.
- Produce clear, decision-oriented risk reporting for senior leadership and governance forums covering current exposure, control effectiveness, issue health, and direction of travel. Support regulatory enquiries and examinations where required.
- Drive continuous improvement of the oversight framework through data and automation, manage dependencies with adjacent domains such as KYC, seller experience, and data privacy, and hold programme teams accountable for timely remediation through structured escalation.

A day in the life
Your morning starts with a question you return to every day: does the compliance picture people believe match the evidence underneath it? Before the US comes online, you use the quiet hours to look past the dashboards, not to read the green, but to test whether it is real or whether a control is quietly drifting behind a reassuring number.

Mid-morning you are building the oversight framework itself, defining how obligations map to controls, how risk is assessed and calibrated, and how a signal travels from a monitoring exception to a decision in front of leadership. After lunch the work turns live. You join Program, Technology, and Legal partners across time zones, often as the only person on the call holding the regulatory-risk lens, and you challenge whether a change lands cleanly against an INFORM obligation before it ships.

About the team
The ACRQ team provides independent risk oversight of some of Amazon's most significant regulatory compliance programs. We are a small, senior team operating across multiple entities, jurisdictions, and regulatory regimes, working closely with Legal, second line of defence, programme teams, and senior leadership. Over the past year we have invested heavily in AI-powered risk assessment and automated monitoring, and that investment is accelerating.

This role is a genuine springboard. The combination of regulatory expertise, independent oversight, and senior stakeholder engagement prepares you for compliance leadership or broader risk positions. The INFORM space is still evolving, so you will have the opportunity to shape the framework rather than inherit a settled one. If you want to do work that matters at a global scale and grow while doing it, we would love to hear from you.
