title: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, AWS Insights and Optimizations
descriptionHtml:
Every AWS customer wants to know the same thing: am I paying for more cloud than I actually need? AWS Insights and Optimizations is the team that answers that question, for millions of accounts, across compute, storage, databases, and commitment purchases. We analyze resource insights, compute recommendations against the latest AWS offerings and pricing models, and build the tooling that automates the optimization workflow end to end.

That question has gotten harder and more expensive to get wrong. AI and machine learning workloads are now the fastest growing line on many customers' bills. Accelerated compute is scarce and costly, training and inference usage is bursty and hard to forecast, and the usual rules of thumb for whether a resource is right-sized do not transfer cleanly to a GPU fleet or an inference endpoint. Customers want the same clarity on their AI spend that they have come to expect on the rest of their infrastructure, and today most of them do not have it. Closing that gap is a significant part of where this team is going.

You would own the foundation the whole experience is delivered on. Customers come at optimization from a lot of directions: the console, our public APIs, a partner product, an export into their own reporting stack, a conversation with their support team, or an agent asking on their behalf. Every one of those paths runs through the platform in this role, so the work is a customer experience problem before it is an infrastructure problem. A finance lead needs to see an entire organization at once rather than one account at a time. An engineer deciding whether to accept a change needs the answer quickly, needs it to reflect this week's usage and not last quarter's, and needs to understand how we reached it before they will act on it. A partner or a customer's own automation needs to build on us and still work a year from now.

Who we serve is also changing. The experience was designed for a person clicking through a console, and it is increasingly driven by agents that run continuously, ask in bulk, and need to know not only what we recommend but why. We treat that as a build mandate rather than a buzzword. You would help redesign the optimization experience around generative AI: opening the platform to agents through MCP and agent-friendly contracts, carrying enough provenance with every recommendation that an agent can justify an action to the human accountable for it, supporting multi-step and batch work instead of one question at a time, modernizing authentication for machine-to-machine scale, and making the system behave under continuous, bursty, non-human load. You would use the same tools on your own work. Agents are already part of how this team builds and operates, and we would want you pushing that further.

If you like owning a broadly used API surface, care about the difference between a recommendation that is technically correct and one that earns a customer's trust, and want your work to show up as real dollars off real bills, come talk to us.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the public API surface customers, partners, and other AWS services depend on to enroll, retrieve recommendations, export data, and express how they want their environment optimized, including the cross-account and organization-wide access model behind it.
- Design for agents as first-class consumers: programmatic and MCP access, bulk and multi-step operations, machine-to-machine authentication, and capacity and throttling behavior that holds up under continuous automated load.
- Extend the platform to AI and accelerated compute spend, including the question of what optimal even means for workloads whose usage patterns look nothing like a traditional server fleet.
- Make recommendations explainable and self-diagnosable, so that customers and support teams can answer why a recommendation says what it says, or why it is missing, without an engineer in the loop.
- Raise the operational bar: how we monitor, test, deploy, and expand across Regions and partitions, and how much of the recurring operational load we can automate away instead of absorbing.
- Grow the engineers around you. Review designs, mentor, and write the documents that build consensus with stakeholders across organizations.
- Work directly with product managers and with the teams building on your APIs to decide what to build, proactively identify what is blocking the team and what the platform will need as usage grows, before either becomes a constraint.

A day in the life
You might spend the morning in a design review arguing whether a new capability belongs in the public API, then pair with an engineer on failure handling in a cross-account delivery path, then dig into a signal that says customers are enrolling but encountering issues in the optimization journey, then point an agent at your own API to find out how badly it reads to a non-human caller. Some weeks are heads-down implementation. Some weeks are writing the document that decides the next six months.

About the team
AWS Insights and Optimizations is a group of engineers who like problems that sit between large-scale data processing and customer-facing APIs, and we are unusually close to the outcome of our work, because we can measure it in savings customers actually realized. We are among the more fastest-moving adopters of generative AI in AWS cloud financial management, in the product and in how we build and operate it. We care about operational excellence, we write things down, and we would rather have the hard architectural conversation early than live with the shortcut for three years. The charter is expanding and there is real room to shape it.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience building and operating public, customer-facing APIs, including versioning and backward compatibility over a long service life
- Experience with multi-tenant systems and the authorization, isolation, and quota problems that come with them
- Experience building agent-facing or LLM-integrated systems, for example MCP servers, tool and function interfaces, or retrieval over structured data
- Experience with large-scale data processing, indexing, or search systems behind a customer-facing product

descriptionHtml:

title: Senior Adapt Programmatic Solutions Consultant, Amazon Ads
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Ads is looking for a Senior Adapt Programmatic Solutions Consultant to support high-impact, time-bound customer initiatives on our demand-side platform, Amazon DSP.

As a Senior Adapt Programmatic Solutions Consultant (PSC), you will drive success across a dynamic portfolio of strategic customer projects — from advertiser onboarding and platform migrations to new feature adoption and account expansion. Rather than managing a standing book of business, you will be deployed rapidly across critical opportunities where your expertise, ownership, and speed to value directly shape customer outcomes. A core part of that impact is building lasting capability within the customers you serve: you don't just solve the problem in front of you, you equip customers to solve the next one themselves. The Adapt PSC has deep experience in advertising technology and the programmatic domain, and applies that expertise to solve high-stakes challenges with urgency, precision, and a relentless focus on long-term customer success. In this customer-facing role, you will work closely with programmatic traders at agencies and advertisers, as well as Amazon Ads internal sales, product, and support teams to deliver measurable results within defined project timelines.

Key job responsibilities
Taking full ownership of project-based customer engagements — from scoping and planning through execution and measurement — across a range of strategic use cases including onboarding, migrations, beta testing, and account expansion

Delivering targeted services such as onboarding support, feature training, platform consultation, and campaign strategy guidance within structured, time-bound engagements, with a focus on building customer sophistication at every stage

Analyzing and interpreting data to rapidly identify improvement areas, root causes, and actionable recommendations that drive customer outcomes within project timelines

Driving self-service enablement by developing scalable resources, repeatable frameworks, and customer-facing guidance that reduce dependency and accelerate independent platform proficiency

Driving the evolution of Amazon DSP by supporting customers through product beta participation, capturing and synthesizing customer feedback, and collaborating closely with cross-functional Amazon teams (Product Management, Engineering, Analytics, and Specialists)

Proactively sourcing and qualifying new project opportunities, contributing to intake and prioritization processes, and sharing knowledge and best practices that strengthen the broader PSC team

A day in the life
As an Agile PSC, your work is structured around discrete, high-impact projects rather than a standing book of business — you move fluidly across customer engagements, taking full ownership of each project from scoping through delivery and holding yourself to the highest standards at every step. You are brought in at critical moments — a new advertiser coming onto the platform, a customer testing a new capability, a strategic account at an inflection point — and your job is to deliver a clear outcome within a defined window. You bring structure to ambiguity, advocate for customers in internal forums, provide troubleshooting support and triage when needed, and simplify and propagate customer feedback to inform product and services design. A key measure of success is the self-sufficiency you leave behind: customers who finish an engagement with you should be more capable, more confident, and less reliant on escalation than when you arrived — gradually developing into proficient, independent users of our DSP. Between projects, you are actively identifying the next opportunity and contributing to the knowledge base that makes the broader PSC team stronger.

You will be passionate about understanding customer objectives and addressing them using our book of services and engagement best practices to drive adoption of Amazon technologies. Your ownership, curiosity, and domain knowledge will allow you to comprehensively understand the details of our offerings and speak to them with passion, authority, empathy, and clarity — even in ambiguous or fast-moving situations.

About the team
Amazon Ads helps brands create experiences that delight customers and deliver meaningful results. With 300+ million worldwide active customer accounts, and first-party insights based on shopping, streaming and browsing signals, brands can craft relevant campaigns that enhance customer experiences. Our solutions on Amazon.com, services like Twitch, IMDb TV, Alexa, Amazon Music, and partnerships with third-party publishers and exchanges make Amazon Ads the ultimate amplifier for brands to reach the right audiences in the right places, both on and off Amazon.

Our programmatic advertising platform, the Amazon Demand Side Platform (DSP), is becoming increasingly popular with major advertisers and agencies worldwide. We believe we understand e-commerce advertising better than anybody else and want to turn it into a science of its own that all users can leverage for their programmatic advertising.

Here at Amazon Advertising, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have 13 employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences. Amazon's culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfilment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

- Experience with annual brand and media planning
- Experience creating processes and improving tools with measurable impact on advertisers
- Experience in digital creative production, ad serving, cross-channel attribution, and media analytics
- Experience in omni-channel marketing, search engine marketing or search engine optimization
- Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers
- Experience in a client facing consultative role working with large, complex enterprise customers
- Experience (technical and operational) with multiple domain areas of programmatic advertising technologies (DSP, RTB, bid shading, machine learning optimization, ad verification, ad tracking, ad attribution, bidding engines, second-price vs first-price auctions, pixel and tag managers, cookies, viewability, etc.)

descriptionHtml:
Do you want to solve solve business challenges through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on scalable services where your code has a direct, measurable impact?

The Zamboni team sits at the intersection of software and physical hardware, managing the fleet of custom Glacier storage units that power Amazon S3's cold storage at exabyte scale. As an SDE II on this team, you'll build and operate the NAWS-based automation that keeps 2,000+ Glacier storage units healthy across global regions — from firmware deployment pipelines to break-fix remediation workflows to the operator tooling that other teams rely on every day.

This is hands-on systems work with real stakes. When a Glacier storage unit goes offline in IAD, your code is part of the response. When a firmware rollout needs to scale across a global fleet, your automation makes it safe. You'll work closely to solve problems that span the full stack — from DynamoDB concurrency to custom storage hardware.

At Amazon, we hire engineers who think big and want to define what comes next. Every day brings new challenges, new skills, and the kind of growth that's hard to find elsewhere. If you want your software to directly impact infrastructure that millions of customers depend on, this is the role.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and operate NAWS-based services (Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, SQS) that automate Glacier fleet operations including firmware deployment, library onboarding, hardware monitoring, and break-fix remediation
- Contribute to automation projects that reduce manual operational toil — including automated offline library remediation, drive blocklisting, stuck job workflows, and automated ticket escalation
- Build and maintain operator tooling and Fleet Commander integrations that enable safe, auditable fleet operations at scale
- Collaborate with hardware vendors (BDT, Quantum), DCO technicians, partner with other S3 Keystone and Glacier teams to design solutions that bridge software and physical hardware
- Participate in on-call rotations, respond to operational events, and drive improvements that reduce future toil
- Write high-quality Java/Python/Go code with infrastructure defined in CDK


A day in the life
On any given day you might be debugging why a firmware update stalled on a Glacier storage library in IAD, writing a new step function workflow to automate a remediation path, reviewing a design doc for the next phase of Fleet automation, or working through a tricky DynamoDB concurrency issue. The work spans from low-level hardware interactions to distributed NAWS service design. You'll be on-call, you'll ship real automation, and you'll see the direct impact of your work on Glacier storage fleet availability.

About the team
The Zamboni team, part of the S3 Moirai organization, owns the health and availability of Glacier's custom storage hardware: libraries, firmware, fleet automation, and the operator tooling that keeps Glacier running at 99.95% data availability across 12+ regions worldwide. We operate at the intersection of hardware and software, building NAWS-based services that manage a fleet of 2K+ Glacier storage libraries, collectively storing exabytes of customer data.

Our roadmap is ambitious: automated firmware qualification and deployment, predictive hardware monitoring, self-service tooling, and scaling fleet operations to 2X growth year-over-year. If you want to see your code directly impact a storage fleet at AWS scale, this is the team for you.

descriptionHtml:
Nous cherchons à recruter des techniciens réseau hautement motivés et de premier ordre pour rejoindre notre équipe en pleine croissance au sein des opérations d'infrastructure. Les candidats travailleront avec un minimum de supervision dans un environnement dynamique afin d'assurer la stabilité et la durabilité de nos réseaux de nouvelle génération, et de développer des moyens innovants pour automatiser et faire évoluer notre réseau à mesure que nous nous développons.

Les responsabilités du poste incluent le soutien à la mise à l'échelle de plusieurs centres de données AWS en Alberta, ainsi que la gestion quotidienne de la capacité. Le technicien réseau travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les clients internes d'AWS et les fournisseurs externes afin de faciliter la bonne exécution des projets, sous la direction des gestionnaires de programmes techniques.

Les candidats idéaux seront très autonomes, extrêmement soucieux du détail, posséderont d'excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale, et auront une expérience significative dans le soutien de réseaux d'entreprise à grande échelle. D'excellentes compétences en mise en œuvre et en dépannage réseau, combinées à une méthodologie de documentation éprouvée, sont également requises. De solides compétences en communication écrite et verbale ainsi que la capacité d'interagir efficacement avec les collègues et les clients sont indispensables. Le désir et la capacité de travailler dans un environnement collaboratif et au rythme soutenu sont essentiels. En plus de fournir une gestion et un soutien de premier niveau pour la vaste infrastructure réseau d'Amazon, les techniciens réseau doivent créer ou améliorer des outils, développer les meilleures pratiques, affiner les procédures opérationnelles et constamment penser de manière proactive et innovante.We are looking to hire highly motivated, best-in-class Network Technicians to join our growing team within infrastructure operations. The candidates will work with minimum supervision in a dynamic environment to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and to develop innovative ways to automate and scale our network as we expand.

The position responsibilities include scaling support of several data center locations of AWS in Alberta, and be responsible for day-to-day assistance with capacity management. The Network Technician will work closely with both internal customers of AWS and external vendors to facilitate smooth project execution as directed by Technical Program Managers.

Ideal candidates will be highly autonomous, very detail oriented, possess strong written and verbal communication skills and have significant experience in supporting large scale, enterprise class networks. Excellent network implementation and troubleshooting skills combined with proven documentation methodology are also required. Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to interact efficiently with peers and customers are required. The desire and ability to work in a fast paced, collaborative environment is essential. In addition to providing top-tier management and support of Amazons vast network infrastructure, Network Technicians are expected to build or enhance tools, develop best practices, refine operational procedure and constantly think proactively and innovatively.


Key job responsibilities
En tant que technicien réseau ID, les responsabilités clés, les connaissances et l'expérience requises incluront les éléments suivants :

Surveiller la file d'attente pour les nouvelles demandes, les changements ou les projets
Planifier et mettre en œuvre les projets assignés conformément aux processus et normes définis
Estimer les exigences des projets en termes de temps, de coûts et de ressources
Suivre les directives de gestion du changement lors de l'exécution des projets ; travailler avec les fournisseurs selon les besoins des projets et surveiller leur travail ; collaborer avec les équipes interfonctionnelles, y compris les gestionnaires de programmes techniques réseau et les ingénieurs ; se tenir informé des nouvelles technologies, processus et conceptions ; respecter les normes de sécurité et de sûreté
Dépanner les problèmes réseau ou de composants physiques selon les besoins lors du déploiement
Communiquer avec les parties prenantes, partager des mises à jour régulières et travailler à l'élimination des obstacles aux projets
Dépanner les problèmes de réseau, de routage et d'interconnectivité, y compris le dépannage de la configuration des équipements réseau et des interactions applicatives de bas niveau
Gérer le travail et les priorités via le système de billetterie et les flux de travail
Des déplacements pouvant aller jusqu'à 30 % peuvent être requis
Dépanner les problèmes de connectivité de l'infrastructure de câblage, y compris les panneaux de brassage et les cordons de raccordement
Traiter les demandes des clients via le système de billetterie
Participer à l'installation, la migration, la configuration de base et le déploiement de matériel nouveau ou mis à niveau
Familiarité avec les termes courants de réseautique
Expérience substantielle dans la mise en œuvre de réseaux à grande échelle en centres de données et le soutien de la couche physique de l'infrastructure réseau
Connaissances en réseautique TCP/IP
Compréhension générale des technologies d'infrastructure
Connaissance du câblage réseau, des types de fibres optiques et des équipements de test, tels que le VFL (localisateur visuel de défauts), le puissance-mètre et l'OTDR (réflectomètre optique temporel)
Expérience avec les meilleures pratiques et méthodologies d'infrastructure de câblage
Familiarité avec les termes courants de réseautique
As ID Network Technician key responsibilities, Knowledge and Experience required will include the following :
• Monitoring the queue for new requests, changes or projects
• Plan and implement assigned project as per defined processes and standards
• Estimate project requirements in terms of time, cost and resources
• Follow change management guidelines during the execution of projects work with vendors as needed for the projects and monitor their work collaborate with cross functional teams including network TPM and engineers remain updated about the new technologies, processes and designs follow safety and security standards
• Troubleshoot network or physical component issues as needed during deployment
• Communicate with stakeholders and share regular updates, and work to remove project obstacles
• Troubleshoot networking, routing and inter connectivity issues, including troubleshooting of network device configuration and low level application interaction
• Manage work and priorities through ticketing system and workflow
• Up to 30% travel may be required
• Troubleshooting cabling infrastructure connectivity issues, including patch panels and patch cords.
• Complete customer requests via trouble ticketing system
• Participate in the installation, migration, basic configuration and rollout of new or upgraded hardware
• Familiarity with common networking terms.
• Substantial background in large-scale datacenter network implementations and support of physical layer of network infrastructure.
• TCP/IP networking knowledge
• Broad understanding of infrastructure technologies
• Knowledge of network cabling, optic types, and test equipment, such as VFL, power meter, and OTDR.
• Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies.
• Familiarity with common networking terms.


About the team
L'entité AWS Infrastructure Services est responsable de la conception, de la planification, du déploiement et de l'exploitation de l'ensemble de l'infrastructure mondiale d'AWS. Autrement dit, nous sommes ceux qui assurent le bon fonctionnement du cloud. Nous prenons en charge tous les centres de données AWS ainsi que les serveurs, les systèmes de stockage, les réseaux et les équipements d'alimentation et de refroidissement qui garantissent à nos clients un accès continu aux innovations sur lesquelles ils comptent. Nous nous attaquons aux défis les plus complexes, impliquant des milliers de variables affectant la chaîne d'approvisionnement, et nous recherchons des talents désireux de contribuer à cette mission. Vous vous joindrez à une équipe diversifiée composée d'ingénieurs (logiciel, matériel, réseau), de spécialistes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, d'experts en sécurité, de gestionnaires des opérations et d'autres professionnels aux rôles essentiels. Vous collaborerez avec des équipes de tout AWS pour garantir les normes les plus élevées en matière de sûreté et de sécurité, tout en offrant à nos clients une capacité quasi illimitée au coût le plus bas possible. Finalement, vous évoluerez au sein d'une culture inclusive qui encourage les idées audacieuses et vous donne les moyens de les mener à bien.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ ans d'expérience en centre de données
- 2+ ans d'expérience en réseaux informatiques
- Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent
- Capacité à soulever et installer des équipements dans des racks pesant jusqu'à 40 livres (environ 18 kg)
- Connaissance des normes de câblage en fibre optique et en cuivre, des équipements de test et des méthodologies de dépannage
- Puisque ce rôle nécessite que l’employé interagisse avec d’autres entités d’Amazon à l’échelle mondiale ainsi qu’avec des employés et intervenants dans d’autres provinces canadiennes, la connaissance du français et de l’anglais est exigée pour ce poste.
- ************
- 2+ years of data center experience
- 2+ years of computer networking experience
- High school diploma or equivalent
- Ability to lift and install equipment in racks weighing up to 40 lbs (approximately 18 kg)
- Knowledge of fiber-optic and copper cabling standards, testing equipment, and troubleshooting methodologies
- Due to the nature of the role that requires interaction with other Amazon entities globally and with Amazon employees and stakeholders in other provinces in Canada, bilingualism French and English is required for this position

Preferred qualifications

- Expérience des meilleures pratiques et méthodologies en matière d'infrastructures de câblage
- ************************
- Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies.

title: Principal Solutions Architect, Strategic Accounts
descriptionHtml:
As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Principal Solutions Architect within the Strategic Accounts segment, you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud architectures utilizing AWS services. In this role, you will help our customers solve business challenges such as rapidly releasing products/services to the market or building an elastic, scalable, cost optimized application. You will engage with product owners to influence product direction and help our customers tap into new markets by utilizing AWS Services. You will also look for patterns and trends that can be broadly applied across an industry segment or a set of customers that can help accelerate innovation. Along the way, you will get the opportunity to enhance your own body of knowledge and have some fun.

As a core member of the account team, you will drive AWS usage and adoption across a specific customer. As a trusted customer advocate, you will help organizations understand and implement advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate and scale existing workloads in the cloud. You will have the opportunity to shape and execute a strategy to build knowledge and broad use of AWS. You will also need to be adept at interacting, communicating and partnering with other teams within AWS such as services teams, marketing, and professional services, as well as representing your team to executive management.

For this role, we are looking for folks who have technical breadth complimented by technical depth in Accelerated Computing, Containers, Storage, Networking, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Strong communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging with Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.

If you are excited about the prospect of using your cloud architecture experience to assist our most valuable customers, tackling challenging problems, have a hand in shaping the future of cloud adoption, enhancing and growing your own skills, and having fun, then we would love to hear from you.


Key job responsibilities
Principal Solutions Architects work on the most complex customer challenges and opportunities. They have a leading role in developing both the strategy and the team itself. They combine an informed view of the market with their understanding of emerging technology trends to speed-up innovation across their customer segment. Externally, they are recognized thought leaders and influence the strategy of our customers. Internally, they earn a reputation of role models and deliver bar-raising guidance to the broader Solutions Architecture team. Act as a thought leader in the wider community, playing a key role in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops.

Share the voice of the customer to influence the roadmap of new features and services for the AWS platform. Proactively work within the organization to influence the evolution of the platform.

Serve as a key technical member of the Solutions Architecture team through influencing decision makers across multiple domains to ensure customer success in building applications and services on the AWS platform which align to long-term business goals.

About the team
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

About the Team
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers where they are in their cloud journey and work backwards from their industry specific needs to transform their business and their entire industry. Our team speaks the language of our industry customers, which means that we focus on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

Basic qualifications

- 12+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- Experience developing technology solutions and evangelising end-to-end technology roadmaps that guide IT transformations toward cloud computing
- Experience with programming languages like Python, JavaScript, Go, .Net, Java or equivalent
- 12+ years of architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc. experience
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field of study or 12+ years of related work experience

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of distributed systems design and implementation or equivalent
- Knowledge of presentations and whiteboarding skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with internal and external executives, IT management, and developers
- Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
- Knowledge of software development tools and methodologies
- Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment, or experience communicating complex information and solutions to senior stakeholders and influencing decisions
- Experience in technology/software sales, pre-sales, or consulting

title: Senior Energy and Water Public Affairs Manager, AWS East Energy and Water Team
descriptionHtml:
AWS is building data center infrastructure to support our digital way of life, and the public conversation around that growth — power demand, grid reliability, and water use, — is increasingly shaped by regulators, policymakers, elected officials, and community stakeholders. The Energy & Water team is looking for a Senior Manager in Public Affairs, to lead how we engage in that conversation.

In this role you bring a public affairs lens to energy and water: you understand industry trends and the regulatory landscape, you engage with the right internal and external stakeholders, and translate that understanding into the right messaging, You are the expert who shows up, engages authentically with community members, organizations, public officials, builds lasting relationships , and contributes to an informed, transparent, and productive public dialogue. You will be one of a small cohort of 3–4 regional representatives who collectively own how the Energy & Water team builds public engagement, in coordination with our policy, legal, community, comms, and economic development partners.

Key job responsibilities
Public Representation:
Represent Energy & Water in public and community settings — open houses, boot camps, hearings, and stakeholder forums— building trusted relationships with officials, regulators, and community stakeholders.

Engage with regulatory bodies, agency staff, elected officials, and policy stakeholders alongside our Public Policy and Legal teams, representing the Energy & Water perspective accurately and with sound judgment.

Field live questions about energy sourcing, power demand, grid impact, water use, wastewater — including detailed questions from engaged community members and advocacy groups

Engage authentically on energy and water topics in real time — accurately representing Amazon's approach and genuinely addressing community questions

Energy and Water Messaging and Content Ownership

In this role you bring a public affairs lens to energy and water: you understand industry and energy-sector trends and the regulatory landscape, you engage credibly with regulatory bodies and policy audiences, and you translate that understanding into the right messaging, delivered in the right tone, to the right stakeholders.

Develop and maintain talking points, FAQs, and Q&A guidance on energy and water topics for use by the broader team, Comms, and cross-functional partners

Provide the energy and water subject matter foundation to develop materials and translate complex topics into channel-specific formats

Serve as a key resource when the team needs to respond quickly to emerging topics or prepare a spokesperson

Cross-Functional & Team Support

Serve as the Energy & Water liaison to Public Policy, Legal, Community Engagement, and Economic Development partner teams, aligning on messaging, sequencing, and tone before positions reach external audiences

Work closely with the External Engagement team to ensure E&W subject matter is well-represented in event programming

Coordinate with Water and Energy SMEs to stay current on technical data (FAQ maintenance, approved stats, updated infrastructure positions)

Support regional leads and the broader team with ad hoc communications needs — presentations, talking points for senior stakeholders, positioning for emerging issues

Drive negotiations and agreements to support community benefit energy and water projects as needed

Basic qualifications

- Experience conveying complex technical concepts to both technical and business audiences
- 7+ years of experience in energy, water, environmental, or infrastructure— with a track record of translating technical complexity into accessible public narrative – Or: 7+ years of experience in public affairs, communications, government or regulatory affairs or related field with a focus in energy, water, or infrastructure.
- Demonstrated experience representing an organization publicly in live, high-visibility settings — community meetings, public hearings, stakeholder forums, or equivalent
- Strong understanding of at least one of: energy (utility, interconnection, rate policy) or water (sourcing, treatment, sustainability); familiarity with both strongly preferred
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills — you write crisp, you speak with authority, and you know when to be direct and when to listen
- Experience in or alongside a public affairs, communications, or government/community relations function
- Comfort with ambiguity, evolving facts, and situations where you are not the decision-maker but are the face in the room

Preferred qualifications

- Background in both energy and water disciplines
- Working knowledge of the energy and/or water regulatory landscape (e.g., utility regulation, interconnection, rate and reliability policy, water sourcing and permitting).
- Experience in regulated utility environments, state/local government, or environmental consulting
- Experience working in a large-scale infrastructure or industrial development context
- Familiarity with Amazon's data center infrastructure, land development, or community permitting processes

title: Senior Product Manager - Tech, Electrical Products and Services, Data Center Engineering
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain, and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Sr. Technical Product Manager creates and drives the next generation of medium voltage (MV) products, including Medium Voltage Switchgear (MVS) and Medium Voltage Transformers (MVT), from concept to at-scale global deployment. This role provides a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of power distribution infrastructure and hyper-scale data center growth. The Sr. PM-T applies their expertise to:

- Design, develop, launch, and support MV switchgear and transformer products critical to data center electrical infrastructure
- Lead New Product Introduction (NPI) efforts for MVS and MVT programs, coordinating design validation, prototype builds, testing, and production readiness milestones
- Drive supplier qualification activities, evaluating and onboarding MV equipment suppliers to meet AWS quality, reliability, and capacity requirements
- Identify and execute cost reduction initiatives across the MV product portfolio while maintaining or improving product performance and reliability
- Engage with internal and external Amazon customers and support teams to capture critical medium voltage power distribution needs for current operations, rack roadmaps, and new data center designs
- Utilize those insights to define product requirements, create a product vision, and own the product development roadmap for MVS and MVT programs
- Coordinate between multiple teams to develop business cases that substantiate value, define product prioritization, and outline budget and resources required to implement product roadmaps
- Drive continuous advancements within MV electrical designs and communicate technical direction to Sr. Management
- Own and drive the complete product lifecycle from idea conception through implementation and wide-scale deployment to eventual deprecation
- Work independently in a high-pressure environment with all levels of leadership and exercise sound judgment where clear guidelines may not exist

This role works closely with a cross-functional team of Product Design Engineers (PDEs), Product Lifecycle Engineers (PLEs), Structural Engineers, and Technical Program Managers (TPMs). The PM-T partners with PDEs on new product development, collaborates with PLEs on customer engagement and lessons learned, and coordinates with TPMs on first-of-a-kind deployments. The ability to lead across these disciplines without direct authority is critical to success.

Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. These MV technologies are essential for meeting our customers' expectations for service and value and meeting Amazon's goals for efficiency, speed, and reliability as we continue expanding our data centers at hyper-scale speed. We are a smart team of doers who work passionately to apply advances in data center technology. We will rely on the Sr. PM-T's ability to understand customer needs and build them into the overall product design and strategy. The ideal candidate:

- Is passionate about understanding customers' needs and translating them into MV product requirements
- Has passion for product development, electrical infrastructure design, and medium voltage power distribution equipment
- Is great at solving problems across technical and commercial domains
- Has the ability to lead multiple products and projects at different stages while staying organized
- Earns trust and builds relationships with different stakeholders (e.g., Engineering, Product Development, Finance, Operations, Suppliers)
- Is comfortable addressing and resolving ambiguity
- Recognizes and appreciates diversity of thought and perspectives

Each day the Sr. PM-T will interact with different teams responsible for engineering, product development, finance, integration, and operation of these complex MV technology programs. They prioritize their activities to support data center product development, identify and resolve problems and blockers, and focus on the actions that are most impactful for product success.

This role requires travel of 30%+ to manufacturing facilities, AWS engineering hubs, data center sites, and supplier locations to drive NPI, supplier qualification, and at-scale deployment.

If you meet these qualifications, exude passion, and enjoy the challenge of innovative projects at hyper-scale size, this job is for you!

Key job responsibilities
- Manage and own the roadmap for medium voltage switchgear (MVS) and medium voltage transformer (MVT) products designed for Amazon data centers
- Engage with internal and external Amazon customers and support teams to gain insights and capture critical medium voltage power distribution needs for the business today and in the future
- Utilize those insights to identify specific product requirements, create a product vision, and own the product development roadmap for critical segments of the data center MV electrical infrastructure
- Coordinate between multiple teams to develop compelling business cases to substantiate business value, define product prioritization, and outline budget and resources required to implement product roadmaps
- Lead New Product Introduction (NPI) programs from concept through design validation, testing, and production readiness to ensure on-time product launches
- Drive supplier qualification activities, evaluating and onboarding MV equipment suppliers to meet AWS quality, reliability, and capacity requirements
- Identify and execute cost reduction initiatives across the MV product portfolio through design-to-value, material optimization, and manufacturing process improvements
- Drive continuous advancements and improvements within our data center MV electrical designs, and communicate technical direction to Sr. Management
- Own and drive the complete product lifecycle from idea conception through implementation and wide-scale deployment to eventual deprecation
- Develop product features and deployment strategies to improve profitability and penetration in new applications and use cases
- Work independently in a high-pressure environment with all levels of leadership and exercise sound judgment where clear guidelines may not exist


About the team
*Why AWS*

title: Software Development Engineer, Finance Technology
descriptionHtml:
We are responsible for billions of dollars of payments each month to millions of Amazon vendors across the globe. We delight our vendors by paying them when they want and how they want, accurately and on time.

We build software applications that facilitate global financial transactions worth billions (USD) annually, rivaling the complexity and scope of dedicated payments fintech companies. Our systems decide how and when a payment happens, carry it out across the world's payment networks, and account for it — all under real regulatory, tax, and audit obligations, in every geography Amazon operates in.

You will have the opportunity to work in a high-paced environment leveraging the AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC) within our core principles of engineering, to deliver faster and ship features incrementally.

Ownership is the center of this role, and ownership here means the whole lifecycle rather than just the code. You will take features from working backwards from the customer through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and documentation — and you stay accountable for how they behave in production long after they ship.

Own features and components of our payment systems end-to-end. The business problem and the technology direction will be understood; how to actually build it will not be, and that part is yours.
Design the solution and make the tradeoffs. You will code independently, and you will have senior and principal engineers to pull in when a tradeoff is genuinely hard or when a design needs to line up with where the architecture is heading.
Work directly with product managers and business stakeholders — finance, tax, and accounts payable operations — to understand what they need and why, so that you build the right thing. You will hear the requirement first-hand rather than through a written hand-off, and you will be expected to push back when the ask and the outcome do not line up.
Ship incrementally. Large payment changes land safely through staged rollout and measurement, not through a single release.
Reduce operational load. Our best work turns a recurring manual intervention into a code fix or a self-healing mechanism, not another runbook step.
Leave the system better explained than you found it. What you build should be maintainable and extensible by an engineer who has never seen it, which means clear documentation and design choices that hold up without you in the room.
Raise the bar around you: code review as a teaching mechanism, mentoring engineers earlier in their careers, and getting new teammates productive on how our software is built, how it operates, and how it fits into the bigger picture.

Building with agentic AI
We are not experimenting with AI on the side — it is how we work. You will use AI agents across the development lifecycle: exploring unfamiliar systems, drafting and reviewing designs, generating and testing code, triaging production issues, and automating the operational work that used to consume a week of on-call. We expect engineers to be strong directors of these agents and rigorous verifiers of their output. The judgment stays with you: you are accountable for what ships, whether you typed it or an agent did. Agentic capabilities are increasingly part of the systems themselves — automating decisions and investigations that previously required a human in the loop — and you will have room to build them.

Why this team
Payments is one of the few places in software where the business logic is genuinely hard, the scale is enormous, and a mistake has an immediate real-world consequence — a vendor who does not get paid when they expected. If you want real ownership, global scope, and the freedom to build with the newest tools available rather than waiting for permission to try them, this is a good place to build a career.

title: Broadcast Engineer, Live Sports Production, Prime Video Live Sports
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 4, 2026

Prime Video Live Sports delivers live events to tens of millions of customers worldwide -- NFL Thursday Night Football, NBA, NHL, NASCAR, MLB, UEFA Champions League, Roland Garros, Wimbledon, and more. The Technical Operations team is the engineering backbone of every broadcast: responsible for the planning, signal integrity, and on-the-ground execution of the infrastructure that makes each live event possible.

We are looking for a Broadcast Engineer who brings deep technical expertise and a willingness to do whatever the production requires -- from architecting signal flows and managing vendor deployments to pulling cable on a truck an hour before airtime. If you thrive in the controlled chaos of live sports production and take personal ownership of every broadcast you touch, we want to hear from you.

This is a remote-based role with regular travel to live events, on-location productions, and our Culver City, CA headquarters -- the home base for Prime Video Live Sports.


Key job responsibilities
Project Management & Cross-Functional Coordination

• Manage technical project lifecycles from pre-production through post-event wrap: timelines, task assignment, milestone tracking, and on-time delivery.

• Coordinate across production operations, graphics, audio, comms, cloud engineering, and

Technical Integration Management

• Maintain project documentation and status reporting; drive process improvements and scalable solutions across productions.
Infrastructure & Documentation

• Maintain and upgrade Prime Video broadcast infrastructure, field equipment, inventory records, and procurement tracking.

• Develop and maintain operational runbooks, SOPs, cable maps, signal flow diagrams, and system configuration documentation.

• File post-event technical reports, track recurring issues, and evaluate emerging broadcast technologies for workflow improvements.

Remote Deployment & Vendor Oversight

• Plan and execute remote deployments end-to-end: scope, technical solutions, logistics, and readiness confirmation.

• Oversee vendor and contractor performance against SLAs; liaise with third-party operators, host broadcasters, and equipment vendors on signal flow and handoff procedures.

• Track risks across concurrent deployments; manage vendor relationships, performance evaluations, and procurement decisions.

Event Readiness and Technical Execution

• Set up, operate, and troubleshoot live broadcast systems: video/audio routing, cameras, encoding, replay, intercom, IP transport, and transmission.

• Coordinate signal flows, conduct pre-show validations, and deploy contribution circuits (fiber, satellite, IP) with carriers and partners.

• Serve as on-site technical contact; monitor signal quality in real time, troubleshoot failures, and ensure compliance with broadcast standards.

A day in the life
Every broadcast begins long before the red light. You arrive at the venue to confirm vendor gear integrates to plan, Prime Video systems are healthy, and contribution circuits are live.

Once rolling, you support the full signal chain, monitoring paths, checking in with truck technicians, logging drift and driving it to resolution before it becomes a problem. On-site tests for new initiatives run alongside live production, so you coordinate those while providing engineering support from power to specialty cameras, graphics, and comms.

Between events, you partner with technical operations, production, and vendor teams to move initiatives to their next milestones, flagging risks early and keeping standards high.

About the team
The Prime Video Live Sports Technical Operations team supports live sports properties in the US and internationally. The team works closely with production operations, audio, comms, graphics, cloud engineering, and Technical Integration Management to raise the technical bar on our broadcasts and evolve our production model. We oversee vendor supplying various mobile production facilities, manage Prime Video-owned broadcast equipment across remote integrations, and coordinate with centralized production facilities and a Broadcast Operations Center to deliver events at scale.
We are engineers who take pride in doing the work, not just overseeing it.

- 10+ years of experience in broadcast engineering in live production environments.
- Experience with mobile production units (OB trucks) or remote/at-home production workflows.
- Experience operating broadcast equipment and integrating remote feeds into host broadcast or third-party signal chains.
- Experience managing vendor and contractor performance in live broadcast environments.
- Experience with audio/video signal flow and routing, including SDI, SMPTE ST 2110 IP video, and broadcast infrastructure (routers, multiviewers, frame synchronizers, and production switchers).
- Experience with IP contribution protocols (SRT, RIST, or RTMP) and transmission coordination (fiber or satellite).
- Experience with streaming technology, OTT delivery, and live streaming workflows.
- Experience troubleshooting technical problems in live broadcast environments.

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, or Media Technology.
- Project management training or certification (PMP, CAPM, or equivalent), and experience with project tracking tools (Asana, Jira, or similar).
- SBE Certified Broadcast Engineer (CBE) or higher, or SMPTE IP media training.
- Ability to travel to live events and Prime Video Live Sports offices in Culver City, CA, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and on short notice.
- Experience working with technical and business stakeholders across global cross-functional teams.
- Experience communicating with technical and non-technical audiences, including executive-level stakeholders or clients.
- Experience with automation or scripting languages such as Python, Java, Perl, PHP, Ruby, Bash, or Shell.

descriptionHtml:

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

For over 15 years, Amazon Web Services (AWS) has been the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud computing platform. What is cloud computing? Cloud computing is the on-demand delivery of IT resources over the Internet.
In 2019, Amazon announced The Climate Pledge, which includes our commitment to power our operations with 100% renewable energy by 2025, on the path to achieving net zero carbon across our businesses by 2040. To learn more about AWS, visit https://aws.amazon.com and https://sustainability.aboutamazon.com/environment/the-cloud.

The Environmental team has responsibility for developing and implementing AWS’s global environmental programs.

We are seeking an Environmental Engineer to support AWS environmental compliance in Tokyo, Japan. The environmental engineer will ensure standards and policies support regulatory compliance, and they will provide appropriate environmental guidance to regional operations teams. The individual will support environmental performance analysis, reporting, monitor metrics, support due diligence processes and guide the operations teams in implementation of Amazon environmental procedures. The environmental engineer will work with internal and external partners that include government entities, contractors, consultants, design, construction, operations and other key stakeholders.

The Environmental Engineer must have excellent communication skills, local language skills, strong environmental regulatory knowledge, demonstrated success in supporting roles for program development and management of complex and technical projects.

Support the growth of the business through environmental due diligence reviews and permitting support.

Ensure work performed by contractors, consultants, and employees is completed in accordance with Amazon standards.

Develop, analyze, and forecast environmental metrics, horizon scan for risk and effectively communicate insights to internal stakeholders
Support environmental audits to drive continuous improvement.

Build collaborative relationships with various stakeholders to ensure risks are identified early and managed appropriately.

Complete thorough environmental investigations and associated regulatory report including working with operations and necessary stakeholders to develop and implement appropriate corrective and preventive actions.

title: Loss Prevention Expert, WWOS
descriptionHtml:
Our operations network, known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service, delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. To keep our operations network secure and assure operational continuity, we are looking for hands-on and detail-oriented professionals who want to join our team as Loss Prevention Expert. In this key role, you will deliver security as a service to our operational sites across the end-to-end supply chain to protect our people and prevent loss.

Key job responsibilities
• Support resilience of our business operations by contributing to emergency and crisis planning for sites within your area of responsibility
• Contribute to the identification of vulnerabilities (e.g., loss, associate experience, process improvement) and define appropriate mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards
• Serve as point of contact for and coordinate measures to manage risk with local management and external stakeholder (e.g., law enforcement agencies and industry associations) on all security-related matters
• Ensure compliance of your assigned sites with Amazon global security standards
• Own Security and Loss Prevention-related projects on the local, regional, and country level

A day in the life
As a Loss Prevention Expert, you will join a team of Security and Loss Prevention professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area.

You perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. During your investigations, you collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analysing data reports, and conducting interviews.

Your findings contribute to identifying vulnerabilities in our processes and you identify and drive mitigating measures. You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our sites by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems and, jointly with subject matter experts and external suppliers, maintain their functionality.

Furthermore, you identify and act upon initiatives improving our physical security infrastructure and contribute directly to the budgetary planning for our external suppliers. You interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience. Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams across all management levels and manage the implementation of our Security and Loss Prevention plan.

About the team
Sitting within the Global Security Operations organization, Security and Loss Prevention supports the accomplishment of Amazon´s business targets and the strengthening of our brand by effectively protecting against relevant threats and by managing security and loss prevention risks that could:


• Put our associates and customers under jeopardy
• Disrupt the continuity of our business operations
• Inflict damage to our assets
• Have adverse impact on our brand reputation

title: Procurement Manager, Logistics Procurement
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history.

We are seeking a leader with procurement experience to strategically source for India Market Transportation Fulfillment Procurement. The person in this role will coordinate with several teams across Amazon and interact with our most important suppliers to satisfy organizational requirements. The position will work and partner with multiple teams to develop and execute category sourcing strategies, deliver savings and improve productivity across the category. The ideal candidate is a self-starter, and a creative, critical thinker with a motivation to learn. You must be an effective communicator and be able to work independently and as a leader of peers to generate high-quality work product in a collaborative, creative, ever-changing, and sometimes ambiguous environment. You must have a professional demeanor and be able to partner with people at every level.

Key job responsibilities
- Establish logistics sourcing strategies, lead cross-functional teams, negotiate with suppliers and execute contracts to optimize Amazon’s competitive position.
- Drive appropriate relationships with logistics suppliers, with a principal objective of achieving the optimal solution and cost of ownership that meets the business’ goals supported by a culture of continuous improvement with performance benchmarks in use.
- Manage logistics suppliers to proactively identify, monitor and optimize opportunities.
- Act as a market intelligence provider regarding logistics; anticipate strategic opportunities and keep key stakeholders informed.
- Drive category suppliers in Supplier Relationship Management activities to mitigate risk, improve performance and add value to Amazon.
- Identify, achieve and report on savings and value targets for category sourcing activities.
- Align with internal customers and understand the business application of the category.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS
- Earn the trust of key stakeholders in Logistics organization to drive alignment with the business.
- Create a strategy in conjunction with internal customers to ensure there is a comprehensive, unified approach.
- Achieve yearly cost saving or value targets appropriate to the aligned with annual budget processes.
- Define and report on key metrics that measure effectiveness of supply and cost savings.
- Champion standards and process improvements.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years of procurement experience

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in management, business administration, economics, engineering, marketing, or Bachelor's degree or equivalent

title: Instandhaltungstechniker :in, RME ERF1
descriptionHtml:
Das Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist für unseren Betrieb von fundamentaler Bedeutung – es sorgt dafür, dass unsere technischen Systeme und Anlagen laufend funktionieren. Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du für die Wartung und Instandhaltung unserer förder- und haustechnischen Anlagen sowie Produktionsanlagen zuständig. Du hilfst, die höchsten Sicherheitsstandards im Arbeitsschutz zu gewährleisten und Maschinenausfallzeiten zu verhindern. Unser technisches Team stellt eine hohe Verfügbarkeit der technischen Anlagen sicher und verbessert die Qualität unserer Geräte.

Key job responsibilities
- Ausführung präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an einer breiten Vielfalt von Geräten an unseren Standorten
- Durchführung von Reparaturen und Fehlerdiagnosen
- Verwendung neuester Tools zur Maximierung der Geräteeffektivität
- Einhaltung aller Arbeitsschutzrichtlinien und -praktiken
- Unterstützung der Entwicklung und des beruflichen Fortschritts von Auszubildenden am Standort
- Arbeit an Projekten zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Einführung von Best Practices an verschiedenen EU-Standorten

A day in the life
Ein typischer Arbeitstag

Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren tätig, um schnell auf technische Störungen reagieren zu können. Du führst eine Reihe geplanter präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an Geräten durch, um für ihren sicheren Betrieb zu sorgen. Außerdem reagierst Du als Instandhaltungstechniker:in unverzüglich auf Störungen und Ausfälle. Du untersuchst die Ursachen, findest so schnell wie möglich Lösungen und wendest sie an. Zudem machst Du Vorschläge für langfristige Verbesserungen.
In Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Kolleg:innen nimmst Du tägliche Wartungsaufgaben wahr und kommunizierst mit Dienstleistern, falls Du externe Expertise benötigst. Du arbeitest in rotierenden Schichten, damit wir rund um die Uhr unsere Standorte unterstützen – und dafür sorgen, dass Amazon weiterhin in dem Tempo liefern kann, für das wir bekannt sind.

About the team
Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) sorgt dafür, dass unsere Geräte und Ausstattung jederzeit optimal funktionieren. Wir sind ein Team von Techniker:innen und Ingenieur:innen, das aus hervorragenden Teamplayern besteht und von erfahrenen Führungskräften geleitet wird. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, die Geräte in unserem gesamten globalen Netzwerk von Fulfillment-Centern zu warten, zu reparieren und ihre Fehler zu beheben. Einige unserer Mitarbeiter:innen sind Führungskräfte, die das Team bei der Arbeit an spannender, innovativer Technologie beaufsichtigen – die es teilweise nur bei Amazon gibt.
Von der Installation automatisierter Verpackungssysteme bis hin zur Beaufsichtigung der allgemeinen Wartungsarbeiten eines Standorts sowie der Reparatur von für den Vertrieb wesentlichen Geräten wickelt unser Team einen Großteil der technischen Aufgaben bei Amazon ab. Unter anderem sorgt es auch dafür, dass Gebäude weiterhin den rechtlichen Auflagen entsprechen, damit alle sicher bleiben und unsere Standorte mit maximaler Effizienz betrieben werden. Es gibt zahlreiche Aufstiegschancen im RME-Team selbst ebenso wie im gesamten Amazon-Unternehmen.
Alle unsere Aktivitäten sind darauf ausgerichtet, die Ausfallzeiten an Amazons wichtigsten Betriebsstandorten zu reduzieren, damit Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen rechtzeitig erhalten. Oft arbeiten wir früh morgens, spät abends oder in der Nachtschicht, um Wartungsarbeiten mit den geringstmöglichen Störungen vorzunehmen. Falls wir eine bessere Möglichkeit finden, eine bestimmte Aufgabe zu erledigen, verfügen wir über die Fertigkeiten und Gelegenheiten, vollständig neue Prozesse oder bahnbrechende Technologie wie Amazon Robotics oder unseren Complex Item Sorter einzuführen.

Basic qualifications

- Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung, anerkannt durch die Industrie- und Handelskammer (IHK) oder Handwerkskammer (HWK) oder Nachweis eines erfolgreich abgeschlossen Hochschulstudium im Ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Bereich (Maschinenbau / Elektrotechnik oder artverwandt) einer deutschen Hochschule oder anerkannte ausländische Hochschulabschlüsse (BA, B. Sc., MA, M. Sc., Dipl.-Ing.)
- Mindestens zweijährige Berufserfahrung in dem entsprechenden Handwerk
- Erfahrung in der Instandhaltung von industriellen Produktionsanlagen
- Fortgeschrittene Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Preferred qualifications

- Erfahrung mit zustandsorientierter Überwachung
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Druck- und Applikationsmaschinen
- Erfahrung in der Störungssuche und Wartung von Förder- oder Automationssystemen

title: AML Compliance Analyst with Italian Language, KYC
descriptionHtml:
PLEASE NOTE: This job can either be worked from home (but within Luxembourg) or from the Amazon Office in Luxembourg.


Amazon Payments Europe S.C.A. (APE) and Amazon Payments UK Limited (APUK) is seeking a dynamic, innovative and motivated Compliance Analyst to join our growing KYC Compliance Operation team. This role is critical to support the rapid expansion of Amazon’s payments business and ensure rigorous adherence to regulatory compliance standards across all licensed products under APE and APUK.
As part of the first line of defence (1LOD), the Compliance Analyst plays a key role in completing and reviewing customer due diligence (CDD) and broader compliance tasks. The role includes delegated authority to approve cases, ensuring that regulatory obligations are met while balancing operational efficiency and customer experience. Analysts collaborate with wider operations team, the 2LoD Compliance Office, process team, the KYC program, and screening team, and will contribute to projects that enhance processes and controls.


Key job responsibilities
- Conduct onboarding and ongoing KYC Customer Due Diligence (CDD) checks, including identity and business verification.
- Review sanctions and PEP screening results and request approval from senior management where required.
- Exercise delegated authority to approve cases once performance and competency are demonstrated. Review escalation and apply holistic assessment.
- Identify and document exceptions, escalate areas of concern and ensure appropriate records are maintained.
- Support the implementation of regulatory changes into processes.
- Drive process improvements to strengthen regulatory compliance, improve quality and support better customer experience.
- Identify process gaps and recommend changes that improve efficiency, strengthen compliance controls, and reduce KYC-related risks.
- Prepare and report KYC/AML metrics

Basic qualifications

- Fluency in German and English
- Bachelor’s degree preferably in Business, Law, Science, Compliance or Economics.
- 1-2 years previous AML/Compliance experience.
- Strong working knowledge of Compliance, AML and KYC related laws and other relevant regulations.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft office programs.

Preferred qualifications

- Payments or e-commerce background.
- Fluency in other European languages is an added advantage Amazon is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Technik údržby, RME
descriptionHtml:
Tým odborné údržby (Reliability Maintenance Engineering – RME) ve společnosti Amazon má zásadní význam pro náš provoz – jsou to právě jeho pracovníci, kdo udržují životně důležité stroje v neustálém chodu. Jako technik/technička RME budete provádět údržbu široké škály zařízení a pracovišť a zároveň dodržovat osvědčené postupy v oblasti bezpečnosti a ochrany zdraví. Budete pomáhat zajišťovat bezpečnost svých kolegů a předcházet odstávkám strojů. Naši technici RME zvyšují kvalitu našich zařízení a současně pracují i na zlepšování provozního prostředí.



Key job responsibilities
Klíčové pracovní povinnosti:

- Proaktivní a preventivní údržba široké škály zařízení na pracovišti.
- Za provozu provádět diagnostiku závad v distribučním skladu a návazné opravy.
- Používat nejnovější nástroje k maximalizaci efektivity zařízení.
- Dodržovat všechny zásady a postupy v oblasti bezpečnosti a ochrany zdraví při práci.

- Pracovat na projektech neustálého zlepšování a zavádět osvědčené postupy na řadě pracovišť v rámci EU.

A day in the life
Náplň pracovního dne:

Naši technici RME působí přímo na provozních pracovištích, takže mohou rychle reagovat na případné problémy se stroji. Budete provádět řadu plánovaných preventivních údržbových prací na zařízeních v našich provozech s cílem zajistit jejich bezpečné fungování. Jako technik/technička RME budete také pohotově reagovat na havárie, co nejrychleji zjišťovat jejich příčiny a zároveň hledat a realizovat řešení. Budete také předkládat návrhy na dlouhodobá zlepšení.
Po boku zkušenějších kolegů budete provádět každodenní údržbářské činnosti, jako jsou lakýrnické a instalatérské práce, a bude-li třeba externí odborné pomoci, budete spolupracovat s dodavateli. Budete pracovat v různých směnách, abyste zajistili nepřetržitou podporu našich pracovišť – což společnosti Amazon umožňuje poskytovat služby rychlostí, kterou vyniká.

Basic qualifications

- Elektrotechnické vzdělání

Preferred qualifications

- Doplňující kvalifikace: Doplňující kvalifikace nejsou podmínkou toho, abyste se mohli ucházet o pracovní pozici ve společnosti Amazon. Pokud splňujete všechny výše uvedené základní kvalifikace, budeme rádi, když se nám ozvete.
- Znalost anglického jazyka úrovně B1
- Zkušenosti s monitorováním podmínek.
- Zkušenosti s prací s tiskovými a aplikačními stroji.
- Zkušenosti s vyhledáváním závad a údržbou dopravníkových nebo automatizačních systémů.
- Zkušenost práce v údržbe

title: System Development Engineer, Tactical Automation Group (TAG)
descriptionHtml:
The Tactical Automation Group (TAG) within Operations Infrastructure Services (OIS) is looking for an experienced Systems Development Engineer to join the team in Austin. TAG develops and operates the automation services that connect Amazon's 2,300+ fulfillment sites to the cloud. Our software orchestrates infrastructure deployments across thousands of AWS accounts, manages the lifecycle of network devices at fleet scale, and ensures every new site gets connectivity without human intervention. If our systems don't run, sites don't connect and packages don't move.

We own multiple production services spanning site connectivity orchestration, device management, VPN automation, and infrastructure control plane operations. Our systems are built on AWS serverless technologies (Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, Fargate, CloudFormation, CloudWAN) and operate across thousands of AWS accounts serving a global fleet.

Key job responsibilities
In the TAG team, the System Development Engineer (SysDE) plays a crucial role in ensuring the smooth and secure operation of Amazon's FC solutions. The ideal candidate will:

- Identify business problems, gather data, propose solutions, and lead implementation across distributed automation services operating at fleet scale
- Design scalable backend systems and APIs that integrate with Amazon's network infrastructure
- Lead the development and maintenance of serverless control plane systems (using AWS Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, Fargate, CloudFormation, CloudWAN) that orchestrate multi-account infrastructure deployments, ensuring high availability, scalability, and performance
- Partner closely with Network Engineering, site onboarding teams, and cross-functional infrastructure teams to deliver scalable, self-service, zero-touch solutions for network provisioning and management
