title: Talent Marketing Manager, AIM (Attraction, Influence and Marketing)
descriptionHtml:
We're reinventing how to attract and hire quality talent at scale — come join us.

We're seeking a Talent Marketing Manager to lead the strategy, execution and performance behind two of the AIM organization's most critical marketing functions: activation management and integrated marketing and campaign planning across Workforce Staffing's global hiring portfolio. This role starts with the customer: understanding hiring needs, translating them into marketing goals, and owning how those goals are achieved. You define how marketing support is prioritized, how campaigns are strategically planned, measured and optimized, and how the team scales its impact through automation, data-driven decisioning, and cross-functional orchestration.

You help thousands of people get a job every year.

As a marketing strategist and cross-functional operator, you set the vision for how activation logic, campaign planning, override management, and performance optimization work together to drive fill rate outcomes at scale across priority geographies globally. You translate complex performance data into decisive activation recommendations, manage daily pacing and spend governance, and own the narrative for senior leadership. You flex between deep-focus, data-rich environments and wide-focus, relationship-heavy environments with equal confidence.

You shape organizational strategy, build trust, drive clarity, and solve problems before they escalate.

Your insights don't just inform decisions — they define them. You influence partner team roadmaps and align business managers on fill risk strategy, and represent both the activation and campaign functions in cross-functional planning. You identify gaps between teams and processes, hold partner teams accountable for improvements, and build scalable mechanisms that outlast your direct involvement. You build the trust, mechanisms, and reporting that close the existing gap. You don't wait for perfect data — you make decisions with what exists and build toward what's needed.


Key job responsibilities
Performance Optimization & Marketing Strategy: Define the annual marketing strategy and plan the direction for channel mix, spend efficiency, fill rate improvement, and labor order trajectory across your portfolio. Lead quarterly strategy reviews, updating priorities based on performance data, market shifts, and evolving business needs. Partner with analytics teams to move beyond single-metric measurement to comprehensive campaign performance frameworks. Push back on media recommendations with data where channel performance does not support continued investment.

Activation Strategy & Risk Management: Own the strategic framework for weekly marketing activation logic across assigned markets, including application need and paid application need assessments. Define the override governance model, ensuring decisions are logged and structured to accelerate automation development. Set the standard for how risk is identified, escalated, and resolved across the portfolio.

Integrated Campaign Planning & Execution: Own annual integrated campaign plans for assigned markets, with focus on building and testing during low-volume periods and maintaining readiness for high-volume hiring events. Lead working-backwards planning from hiring projections, site capacity, and historical performance data. Consult senior leadership on quarterly strategy, budget allocation, and major campaign pivots. Translate changing labor order visibility into dynamic marketing adjustments, flagging risks and mitigation plans early.

Cross-Functional Orchestration: Drive collaboration with Performance Marketing, Journey Orchestration, Creative, Talent Engagement, Marketing Analytics, and Business stakeholders. Manage stakeholder expectations across business partners, country leads, and global teams. Bridge the gap between marketing capabilities and operational hiring realities. Manage a wide portfolio of countries with varying levels of data maturity, labour order certainty, and stakeholder sophistication.

Pacing & Spend Governance: Oversee daily pacing reviews, implementing ramp-down or pause decisions when application delivery targets are met. Share insights with Performance Marketing to improve paid marketing efficiency. Own escalation thresholds and spend decision governance.

Stakeholder Communication & Alignment: Own weekly and monthly Business Review deep dive presentations for senior leadership, translating risk sites and marketing performance into clear strategic narrative. Maintain regular alignment with Business Managers and cross-functional partners on fill rate risk and marketing actions. Influence investment priorities and partner team roadmaps through data-driven business cases. Adapt communication to audience maturity — from sophisticated data-driven forums to foundational trust-building conversations.

Application Quality & Fill Rate Improvement: Monitor performance against goals including fill rate, non-paid application share, spend per hire, and application-to-usable application ratios. Implement data-driven optimisations for underperforming sites. Identify quality gaps (geo-targeting, shift messaging, channel mix) and coordinate with Paid Marketing, Creative, and Owned Marketing teams to resolve. Own the activation logic that balances cost efficiency with fill rate delivery.

Automation & Process Improvement: Identify, develop, and drive adoption of mechanisms that improve activation efficiency, reduce manual override volume, and accelerate the path to automated decisioning. Own the automation of campaign planning processes — from discovery through recommendation to implementation. Eliminate redundant workflows and hold partner teams accountable for process improvements across both functions.


A day in the life
Your morning starts with reviewing overnight pacing data across your markets and making activation decisions for the day. You join the weekly reporting call with your stakeholders, leading the marketing view for your area with a clear recommendation for each at-risk site. Mid-morning, you're on a stakeholder call with business partners in Brazil translating application pacing risk into language they understand and building alignment on marketing levers available. After lunch, you're deep-diving a high-spend site in Germany where channel efficiency has dropped — pulling site-level data, identifying the issue, and producing an internal discussion analysis for the Paid Marketing team. In the afternoon, you're working through quarterly initiatives with other teams — defining what to learn, which markets to test in, and how results will inform next quarter's strategy. Later, you prepare the MBR narrative for senior leadership, connecting this month’s activation decisions to fill rate outcomes. You close the day connecting the dots: what patterns are emerging across your portfolio, what's working, what needs to change, and how to translate that into the quarterly strategy update you're presenting to leadership next week.

About the team
Workforce Staffing (WFS) hires thousands of Amazonians every year. The Attraction, Influence, and Marketing (AIM) team achieves high-volume hiring goals by delivering exceptional, multi-channel candidate experiences — engaging and hiring job seekers with maximum efficiency and precision. Leveraging paid digital advertising, owned channels, web experience, and local grassroots efforts, AIM delivers quality candidates at scale. Practicing transformational thinking empowered by leading-edge tech and tool development, this team constantly innovates new processes to increase marketing efficacy.

Basic qualifications

- Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements
- Experience in marketing or marketing research
- Experience presenting metrics and progress to goal to senior leadership
- Experience driving direction and alignment with cross-functional teams
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using SQL to pull data and metrics to deliver reports

A Security Engineer is a leader who is expected to participate in the planning of the work and to seek opportunities for process improvement. Training and Career Growth

title: Software Development Engineer II, Payroll Tech - Xylem
descriptionHtml:
Are you looking for an opportunity to build a highly available, large scale, enterprise-wide software solution? Does it excite you to find patterns and build generic, composable software solutions to solve complex problems? Are you looking for inventing newer and simpler ways of building solutions? If so, we are looking for you to fill a challenging position in Amazon Payroll Technology team.
Payroll Technology at Amazon is all about enabling our business to perform at scale as efficiently as possible with no defects. As Amazon's workforce grows, both in size and geography, Amazon's payroll operations become increasingly complex, and our customers are asked to do more with less. Process can only get them so far, and that's where we come in with technology solutions to integrate and automate systems, detect defects before payment, and provide insights.  As an SDE II on our team, you will be responsible for leading the architecture, design, development and launch of some of the core product features. You will have significant influence on our overall strategy by helping define these product features, drive the system architecture, and spearhead the best practices to delivery high quality products.
This position requires that you are a significant and autonomous contributor. Your work is consistently high quality. You solve complex problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. Your focus is on designing, developing and effectively applying automated solutions that test major portions of software (e.g., significant component, set of features, mid-size application, service, etc.). You prevent and find defects early. You apply software testing techniques, such as equivalence class partitioning, boundary value testing, etc. You build complete test and/or measurement solutions (e.g., performance, load, scalability, usability, etc.) You use data from testing, deployment, and production to measure quality and provide actionable improvement to the product. You write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to make trade-offs. Your solutions are pragmatic. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time (or at least minimize incidental complexity). You consider the legacy of the code you produce, limiting the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You re-use where possible, while being judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., designing to avoid impacting the system under test.)
This is an exciting opportunity for a seasoned engineer. In this position, you will play a leading role in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large-scale and complex financial applications. You will push your design and architecture limits by inventing and simplifying complex problems. You have strong verbal and written communication skills, are self-driven, and can deliver high quality results in a fast-paced environment. You will work with Amazon engineering and business teams across the globe in planning, designing, executing and implementing this new platform.

Job description
AWS is looking for a Network Deploy Technician to join our growing team within infrastructure operations. You will work with minimum supervision in a dynamic environment to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and assist in the development of innovative ways to automate and scale our network.

The position's responsibilities include scaling support of several data center locations and day to day assistance with capacity management. You will work closely with internal customers and external vendors to facilitate smooth project execution as directed by Network Leadership and Technical Project Managers.

You will leverage your experience supporting large scale, enterprise class networks as well as network implementation and troubleshooting. As a Network Deploy Technician, you will work in a fast paced, collaborative environment with regular peer and customer interaction. In addition to providing management and support of AWS’ vast network infrastructure, Network Deploy Technicians establish and follow best practices and refine operational procedures.

All physical requirements are expected with reasonable accommodations:
• Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
• Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to participate in primary responder rotation and provide after-hours support as needed
• Working in cramped and/or elevated and/or noisy environments
• Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
• Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

• Managing work and priorities through ticketing system and workflows to complete customer requests and projects
• Collaborating with various stakeholders to remove project obstacles
• Troubleshooting networking, routing and interconnectivity issues, including patch panels and patch cords

Traveling within and outside of regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided.

Providing the first level networking devices to serve our customer racks entails various tasks (the name of the game is efficiency): You will track network rack intake and delivery; work with various onsite teams to request for rack space, power, and cooling for network racks. 2. There is also console builds (and room builds) that are really exciting. You'll be exposed to more teams whose goal is to provide more space and capacity for customer racks.
3. Work with ID-Scaling peers to build higher-level networking devices.

- 1+ years of computer networking experience

The Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) is part of AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS), responsible for driving revenue and accelerating adoption across enterprise customers. You will define, design, and execute large-scale migration architectures that accelerate adoption of AWS services across storage, applications, and infrastructure domains. You will engage with senior engineers, architects, infrastructure leaders, and executives at strategic enterprise customers to influence migration decisions and provide structured feedback to AWS product teams.

As the ideal candidate, you bring deep technical expertise in enterprise migrations and the business acumen required to lead complex data center exit programs with large enterprises. You have hands-on experience with storage migration strategies, application modernization patterns, VMware migrations, database migrations, and infrastructure-as-code approaches. You are able to credibly advise senior technical and executive stakeholders on migration trade-offs, risks, and long-term optimization strategies.

title: Software Development Manager, Selection Intelligence & Growth
descriptionHtml:
Selection Intelligence & Growth helps Amazon Sellers worldwide reach their full potential. Leveraging science and data across Amazon, we catalyze seller growth with comprehensive data, insights, actionable recommendations and growth plans. We strongly believe that any Amazon seller should be able to grow their businesses and reach their full potential by using our Ml powered, agentic and scaled self-service tools.

We're building something transformational - a centralized intelligence layer that will fundamentally change how millions of sellers worldwide grow their businesses on Amazon. Rather than requiring sellers to seek out opportunities across disconnected tools, relevant insights and actions are brought front-and-center to their attention wherever they are working — contextually, proactively, and across domain boundaries. This new experience answers the questions every seller carries with them: "What matters to my business right now? Where should I invest my time and energy, and why?"

As the Software Development Manager, you'll build Growth Advisors — our agentic AI offering that autonomously executes growth strategies on behalf of sellers.

You'll lead the team that will design and develop GA, which:

- Produces coherent, sequenced growth plans by optimizing cross domain

- Generates transparent reasoning that explains why actions are recommended and what outcome the seller can expect

- Delivers hyper-personalized guidance by integrating seller goals, constraints, behavioral signals, and business characteristics

- Ensures consistency across all seller-facing surfaces (Next Gen Selling, Seller Assistant, SP-API)

- Tracks outcomes to create continuous feedback loops that improve recommendation quality over time

This is a highly visible, high-impact role. You'll partner closely with Senior Engineering leadership, Product Management, Scientists, UX designers, and multiple cross-org engineering teams.

Key job responsibilities
As a Software Development Manager at Amazon, you will take your technical experience to a new level by leading a team of engineers to deliver seller facing applications with generated insights/recommendations.

In the primary scope of this role you and your team will own piloting a major growth solutions for concrete business use cases for our sellers.


A day in the life
You will be a part of an agile development team following innovative best practices in software development where you'll lead a team on technical designs and architecture. To build our seller facing applications, you will interact with various roles of different skillsets, including PM, Scientist, UX, Seller Consultant to gather requirements, support feasibility analysis and to provide technical solutions to provide highly accurate data insight generation and top-notch UI/API. One of the important aspects of the role is to develop the best, and you’ll have opportunities to build a team and mentor others by sharing your knowledge across multiple teams.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience
- 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in many disparate technologies, typically ranging from front-end user interfaces through to back-end systems and all points in between
- Demonstrated experience leveraging generative AI tools to enhance workflow efficiency and productivity, with the ability to craft effective prompts and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs in a professional setting
- Experience identifying opportunities to integrate AI solutions into products and services to drive business value

title: Risk Manager, Selling Partner Identity Verification (SPIV)
descriptionHtml:
The Selling Partner Identity Verification (SPIV) team is looking for a motivated, data savvy risk manager to act as a force multiplier supporting our team's mitigation and prevention of fraud and abuse. This position will manage a portfolio of Gap prevention projects aimed at finding a balance between making it harder for bad actors to operate on our stores as well as improving the seller experience for genuine sellers. You will interact with partner teams and stakeholders in operations, product, risk, tech, and science roles in order to execute against your projects. An ideal candidate is highly flexible, a strong communicator, and demonstrates significant bias for action, and loves diving deep.



Key job responsibilities
1. Complete risk analyses using complex data sets (SQL, Python, R etc.).
2. Use high-level judgment to own our most complex risk mitigation and prevention initiatives.
3. Identify gaps and risks in Amazon's current mechanisms and policies and recommend solutions to product/policy owning teams.
4. Use data and/or technical skills to discover new ways to scale risk signals resulting in the identification of abuse risk.
5. Break problems into manageable pieces, meticulously prioritizing, and delivering results in an ambiguous and constantly changing environment.
6. Conduct large scale deep dives to derive insights about abuse, identifying gaps and risk in Amazon's current mechanisms, systems, and policies.
7. Discover solutions and convey detailed technical knowledge (verbally, in writing, and via diagram) to engineering, legal, and program/product management teams


A day in the life
Propose and gain alignment on mitigation and prevention plan with partner team stakeholders.

Launch, monitor and communicate with stakeholders about the progress of current mitigation and prevention.

Influence stakeholders to adopt, integrate, or fix gaps in order to allow sunsetting of existing mitigations.

Monitor reporting of established mechanisms and evaluate for effectiveness.

Inspect metrics and anecdotes to find false positives and false negatives, then develop improvements to address misses.

Listen, learn, engage, communicate, execute, analyze, and influence.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience with SQL and Excel

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of program or project management experience

title: Técnico/a de Mantenimiento, DCC Communities
descriptionHtml:
Estamos buscando Técnicos/as de operación para respaldar los centros de datos. Como Técnico/a de operaciones, tendrás la oportunidad de ser responsable de supervisar la continuidad operativa de todos los equipos eléctricos, mecánicos y de seguridad dentro del centro de datos.

 Los/las Técnicos/as de operaciones también tienen la tarea de impulsar la innovación y reducir los costos operativos en las instalaciones. Son el primer punto de contacto para resolver problemas que afectan la disponibilidad del centro de datos. Este equipo incluye, pero no se limita a generadores diésel de reserva y sistemas de combustible relacionados, tableros/interruptores, UPS, BBUs, STS´S, FPC´S PDU, DAHU, CRAHU, CRAC, bombas, motores, VFD, ENFRIADORES y sistemas de automatización de edificios.


Key job responsibilities
Las responsabilidades clave del rol incluyen:

-Ejecutar rondas operativas en infraestructura crítica (sistemas eléctricos, mecánicos, protección contra incendio) documentando hallazgos, desviaciones
-Operar y monitorear equipos de potencia (UPS, generadores, PDUs, switchgear) y enfriamiento (CRAH/CRAC, chillers) bajo procedimientos estandarizados.
-Ejecutar procedimientos operativos de emergencia (EOPs) y mantenimientos correctivos/preventivos según MOPs aprobados.
-Responder a alarmas y eventos operacionales, ejecutando troubleshooting inicial y escalando según corresponda.
-Coordinar actividades con vendors on-site, validando cumplimiento de procedimientos de seguridad y estándares AWS.
-Mantener documentación operativa actualizada: tickets, bitácoras, reportes de turno.
-Participar en actividades de comisionamiento de nueva infraestructura, incluyendo validación de secuencias y puesta en servicio.
-Cumplir y hacer cumplir estándares de seguridad (LOTO, arc flash, trabajo en altura, espacios confinados) en toda actividad operativa.

A day in the life
Esta posición maneja proyectos de mediana complejidad. Las principales responsabilidades son revisar los Métodos de Procedimientos y Procedimientos Operativos Estándar, escribir y/o ejecutar Gestiones de Cambios Modelados, respuesta a alarmas, mitigación de Puntos Únicos de Falla, auditorías, mantenimiento general del sitio/instalaciones, mantenimiento correctivo y preventivo en equipos mecánicos y eléctricos, gestión de proveedores, gestión de repuestos e Instalación de Racks. También es responsable de actividades relacionadas con Medio Ambiente, Seguridad y Protección, incluyendo Permisos de Trabajo, informes locales de seguridad y seguimiento. Además, monitorea el desempeño de todos los equipos eléctricos, mecánicos y de seguridad contra incendios dentro del centro de datos. Se asegura de que todos los procedimientos de seguridad se cumplan durante la ejecución del trabajo y queden los registros debidamente resguardados en el sistema de gestión electrónico.

 Esta posición tiene también un componente físico que requiere que la persona pueda levantar y transportar equipos de hasta 18Kg. Puede ser necesario trabajar en espacios reducidos o en lugares elevados, respetando las directrices de salud y seguridad. Puede requerir viajes locales y/o internacionales;

 La operación del centro de datos consiste en equipos multidisciplinarios que trabajan 24x7 en esquema de turnos.

- Título universitario o técnico en área Eléctrica, Mecánica o similar
- Conocimiento de sistemas mecánicos (mecánicos, sistemas HVAC, controles) o conocimiento de sistemas eléctricos (generadores, subestaciones)
- Conocimiento de sistemas de controles de potencia, así como recopilación y análisis de tendencias de datos
- Experiencia liderando y gestionando operaciones de instalaciones críticas que requieran conocimiento profundo en sistemas eléctricos, mecánicos y de control
- Inglés nivel A2

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ año de experiencia en ingeniería de centros de datos
- 1+ año de experiencia en operaciones y soporte on-call para instalaciones de centros de datos, plantas de misión crítica o instalaciones de producción

title: Senior Technical Program Manager - ASIC, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon LEO is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon LEO will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

The Amazon LEO team is looking for a Sr. Technical Program Manager with experience in complex ASIC/SOC development of managing various phases of pre-silicon such as architecture, front end design, pre-silicon verification, FPGA prototyping, Emulation, Physical design, BROM, FW, substrate and package design, Tapeout; and post-silicon phases such as silicon manufacturing with foundry and OSAT, silicon bring-up, functional and system validation, embedded FW/SW, ATE, Reliability, Qual, and NPI. The role will interface with cross-functional engineering and program/product management teams to develop ASIC/SOCs solutions that will go into Satellites and Ground equipment/terminals. Join us and make a difference in the lives of people around the world.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Collaborate with engineering leaders (ASIC/SOC leads) to create project execution plans for ASIC/SOC development considering all criteria to design products the meet the power/performance and functional specs for all use conditions.
- Work with ASIC, communication system, EE, and software teams to define ASIC bring-up readiness and test plans.
- Work with product/program management lead to ensure that ASIC/SOC development meets schedule, cost, and quality requirements.
- Drive engineering project execution, make technical trade-off recommendations, understand the technical challenges, enable solutions, track and report on status, and resolve blocking issues.
- Collaborate with Architecture, hardware, software, firmware, packaging and PCB teams on ensuring cross-functional deliverables are identified and tracked.
- Work with external IP, Fabs, OSAT silicon services and partners to complete the execution of projects in time.



A day in the life
You must be fully competent in a variety of project management tools, SOC/IP design methodologies and techniques for all phases of the project life-cycle and exhibit demonstrated proficiency in core project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality and risk management, reporting and metric development/tracking. In addition, the candidate needs to drive ASIC bring-up readiness (HW/SW) and ASIC bring-up plan. Lastly, the candidate should have the experience of working through the various design phases of Silicon development from architecture definition, RTL design, Verification, IP design, Physical design, silicon bring up, test, characterization, quality, reliability and post silicon management.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent
- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 3+ years of ASIC development experience (RTL, Verification, Validation, or Product/Test Engineering)
- Experience managing programs across cross-functional teams, building processes, and coordinating release schedules
- 7+ years of working directly with ASIC engineering teams

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Network Technician to join our growing team within infrastructure operations. You will work in a dynamic environment to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and assist in the development of innovative ways to automate and scale our network.

The position's responsibilities include capacity scaling support of several data center locations and day to day assistance with capacity management. You will work closely with internal customers and external vendors to facilitate smooth project execution as directed by Network Scaling Leadership and Technical Program Managers. You will leverage your experience supporting large scale, enterprise class networks as well as network implementation and troubleshooting.

As a NW Deployment Build Lead I you will work in a fast paced, collaborative environment with regular peer and customer interaction. In addition to providing management and support of Amazon Web Services vast network infrastructure, Network Technicians establish and follow best practices and refine operational procedures.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

* Any physical requirements are expectations with reasonable accommodations
* Manage work and priorities through ticketing system and workflows to complete customer requests and projects

3. Work with ID-Scaling peers to build higher-level networking devices.

This team covers the whole Pennsylvania region with all the sites inside and outside the perimeter. There is travel involved as we move where the capacity is needed.

title: Propulsion Functional Technician, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. The Propulsion team is seeking a Manufacturing Functional Technician to join the team to support production manufacturing of future flight hardware.

The Propulsion Manufacturing Functional Technician will work within the Amazon Leo Propulsion Manufacturing Team supporting the build and integration of electric propulsion subsystems, including feed systems, thrusters, cathodes, PCBAs, tanks, and the integrated propulsion system.
This technician will be knowledgeable across multiple manufacturing process paths, perform troubleshooting activities, support training programs, and lead process improvement initiatives within their scope. The ideal candidate brings hands-on manufacturing experience with flight hardware and thrives in a fast-paced production environment.

Additional Requirements:

Standing for long periods of time, climbing up and down ladders, bending, grasping, sitting, pulling, pushing, stooping, and stretching may be required to perform the functions of this position

Able to lift-up to 25lbs. unassisted

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Candidates must be 18 years or older with the ability to understand and adhere to all job requirements and safety guidelines.

The starting pay for this role in Washington State is up to $33.50 / hour and employees are eligible for incremental raises based on tenure. This information is provided per the Washington State Pay Transparency Act. Base pay information is based on market location. Applicants should apply via Amazon’s internal or external careers site.



Key job responsibilities
Assemble, fabricate, and process materials into complex manufactured products across propulsion subsystems per engineering documentation and SOPs, following one or more defined process paths.

Learn to perform troubleshooting activities associated with manufacturing products, observing, receiving, and obtaining information from all relevant sources to assist in debug and root cause analysis. Seek guidance when deviation from available procedures is needed.

Learn to perform hardware inspections and document discrepancies. May assist with development stage assemblies and first article builds under guidance of senior peers.

Read, interpret, and work from engineering documentation and drawings following well established processes.

Provide engineers with feedback on tooling, consumables, debug observations, and process issues through structured channels such as MES WOT entries.

Identify training needs for the team and assist in the training of new hires and junior peers to help them scale in their role.

Contribute to process improvement ideas within your project scope, working with leaders and engineers individually or in group settings.

Follow best practices as defined by leaders, lead techs, manuals, and SOPs. Meet productivity and quality standards consistently.

Uphold job and site safety standards and operations protocol. Follow proper procedure when quality or safety issues occur.

Attempt to resolve individual work blockers before escalating. Identify additional tasks once assigned work is complete and communicate to Lead Technician before proceeding.

Utilize MES and SAP systems for production tracking, traceability, and work order documentation. Capture and record data accurately in applicable systems.

May assist with servicing, repairing, calibrating, regulating, fine tuning, and testing machines, devices, and equipment.

Attend all relevant technical trainings offered by the organization.

A day in the life
The Propulsion Manufacturing Functional Technician will perform a variety of hardware manufacturing, testing and integration tasks across propulsion subsystems to ensure hardware meets production requirements for flight. They will work closely with engineering teams to provide feedback on processes and identify improvements.
This technician is expected to be knowledgeable across multiple process paths, support peers and new hires, and lead process improvements within their scope. They will utilize MES and SAP systems for daily production tracking and traceability and will actively support the team in resolving work blockers and general operational needs.
A successful candidate thrives in a fast-paced, start-up-like environment and can apply their technical expertise and commitment to quality to positively impact team metrics and organization goals. To be successful they will need to be highly motivated and detail oriented while showing the highest standards of execution.

About the team
The Amazon Leo Propulsion Team is responsible for the design and development of the propulsion system which provides maneuvering capability to the spacecraft. The Propulsion Team is made up of a variety of sub-teams which are responsible for various aspects of the development process, such as mechanical design, systems engineering, subject matter experts, manufacturing, and test. This integrated team structure allows direct communication and rapid process feedback while also promoting close collaboration across the team.

Basic qualifications

- Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- High school diploma or equivalent
- 2+ years relevant aerospace/automotive manufacturing experience or equivalent industry experience
- 2+ years of hands-on work experience with electro-mechanical assemblies, final integration and/or harness integration experience
- 2+ year’s experience in a fast-paced production environment with flight hardware
- 2+ years of hands-on experience with precision torque, measurement and inspection devices (i.e., automated and manual torque wrenches, calipers, micrometers, profilometers, optical inspection devices, multi-meters, etc.)
- Proficiency in reading, interpreting, and working from engineering documentation and/or drawings
- Ability to work effectively in a team environment

Preferred qualifications

- Aircraft & Powerplant certification/license, automotive certifications, or other technical certifications/Associate's degree
- Experience working with FOD, ESD sensitive hardware and clean room requirements
- Experience working with MES software packages (SAP, SFC transactions, traceability)
- Experience with root cause analysis (RCA) and corrective action processes
- Experience contributing to or owning SOP development and process documentation
- Experience with 6S, Kaizen, or continuous improvement methodologies
- Experience with PCBA inspection/rework and troubleshooting

title: Applied Scientist, Safe Control, Amazon Robotics, Compass
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an Applied Scientist to join Compass. In this role, you will develop the core Control Barrier Function (CBF) algorithms that form the mathematical foundation of the Compass safety system. You will ensure they don't just work in theory but perform reliably on real robots under real-world conditions. You will push the boundaries of concepts central to CBFs: computing robust invariant sets, designing hybrid system formulations that handle contact transitions and mode switches, and developing backup-set approaches that leverage learned policies and multiple controllers. A key challenge of this role is bridging the gap between the mathematics of set invariance and the realities of hardware, including sensor noise, model uncertainty, computational budgets, and discrete state transitions. You will ensure that these algorithms are not only provably correct but also implementable within a safety-critical architecture that must be certified by a third-party. You will contribute directly to the next generation of CBF theory and its practical deployment across Amazon's diverse robot fleet.

Key job responsibilities
• Develop and implement novel CBF algorithms that provide formal safety guarantees while minimizing conservatism to maximize the permissible operating envelope for each robot platform
• Compute and refine invariant sets for complex, high-dimensional robotic systems, developing scalable methods that go beyond what existing analytical approaches can handle
• Design formulations for hybrid dynamical systems, handling discrete mode transitions (e.g., contact/no-contact, stance/flight phases) with provable safety across switching boundaries
• Address the theory-to-practice gap by developing methods that are robust to model uncertainty, sensor noise, actuation delays, and computational latency
• Create reduced-order and full-order dynamics models with both white-box and black-box approach
• Implement real-time optimization solvers that execute within the tight timing budgets of safety-critical control loops
• Develop formal arguments and documentation sufficient to support third-party safety certification of algorithms
• Validate algorithms through rigorous simulation and hardware experiments, characterizing failure modes and quantifying safety margins
• Contribute to the theoretical foundations of CBFs through publications at top-tier controls and robotics venues
• Collaborate with perception, planning, locomotion, and manipulation teams to accommodate the needs of upstream and downstream systems

A day in the life
Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
Work with the inventors of control barrier functions on a novel, universal approach to safe autonomy: one that scales across mobile robots, manipulators, mobile manipulators, and future robot platforms with dynamic stability. You'll push the boundary of safe performance by integrating safety with motion planning, RL, and foundation models, ensuring that safety is never a blocker to robot performance. Your work will underpin robots operating alongside people at Amazon's unprecendented scale.

Basic qualifications

- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of deep learning, computer vision, human robotic interaction, algorithms implementation experience
- Deep expertise in Control Barrier Functions, including theoretical foundations and practical implementation
- Strong mathematical background in dynamical systems theory, nonlinear control, and formal verification or reachability analysis
- Proficiency in C++ and Python with experience implementing control algorithms for real-time systems
- Publication record at relevant venues (e.g., CDC, ACC, ICRA, RSS, Automatica, TAC)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in professional software development
- Experience validating safety-critical algorithms on physical robotic hardware (not simulation-only)
- Experience with hybrid systems theory and formulations that handle discrete transitions (e.g., contact events, mode switches)
- Experience with robust or adaptive methods that account for parametric uncertainty or unmodeled dynamics
- Knowledge of functional safety standards (IEC 61508, ISO 13849, ISO 26262) and experience preparing algorithms for third-party certification
- Familiarity with real-time embedded systems and the constraints of deploying optimization-based controllers on safety-rated hardware
- Experience formulating and solving optimization-based controllers (QPs, SOCPs) for real-time safety filtering

We’re committed to helping our builders grow through continuous learning, mentoring, and collaboration with industry experts. Are you ready to build the future of secure cloud computing in Australia?

Key job responsibilities
The Systems Engineer leads the design, implementation, and automation of complex Windows infrastructure solutions across multiple environments. This role serves as the technical specialist for infrastructure automation, system architecture, and enterprise-scale Windows environment management, focusing on developing automated solutions for managing large server fleet.

- Design and implement automated solutions for Windows infrastructure deployment and management
- Architect and maintain Active Directory and domain controller infrastructure across multiple security domains
- Develop comprehensive Infrastructure as Code templates for Windows environments
- Create automated workflows for system administration using PowerShell, Python, and other automation tools
- Design and implement scalable solutions for meeting rooms, video walls, and enterprise printing services
- Lead technical initiatives for infrastructure improvements and automation
- Mentor junior engineers on automation best practices and Windows infrastructure management


A day in the life
Your morning starts with a review of overnight automation runs. The Infrastructure as Code deployment you scheduled has completed successfully — fifty servers provisioned, configured, and domain-joined without a single manual touch. You verify the results, make a minor template refinement, and commit the update to the repository.

Mid-morning, you're deep in an Active Directory architecture session. A new security domain is being stood up, and you're designing the domain controller topology, trust relationships, and Group Policy structure that will govern it. You sketch the architecture, validate it against security requirements, and begin translating your design into automated deployment scripts.

After lunch, a junior engineer pings you for guidance. They're building a PowerShell workflow to automate a recurring maintenance task, and they've hit a logic challenge. You pair with them for twenty minutes, guiding them toward a cleaner approach while explaining the "why" behind your suggestions. They push their updated code with confidence.

Later, you're tackling a scalability challenge for the enterprise meeting room infrastructure. The current solution works, but it won't scale to the next phase of growth. You prototype an automated provisioning approach that can handle ten rooms or a hundred with the same template — and document it so the team can extend it further.

Before wrapping up, you review a pull request from a teammate, run a quick validation on a Python automation script you've been developing for fleet-wide patching, and update the team's technical roadmap with progress on your current initiative. Another day where automation won, and manual toil lost.

The Propulsion team is seeking a Manufacturing Functional Technician to join the team to support production manufacturing of future flight hardware.
The Propulsion Manufacturing Functional Technician will work within the Amazon Leo Propulsion Manufacturing Team supporting the build and integration of electric propulsion subsystems, including feed systems, thrusters, cathodes, PCBAs, tanks, and the integrated propulsion system.
This technician will be knowledgeable across multiple manufacturing process paths, perform troubleshooting activities, support training programs, and lead process improvement initiatives within their scope. Attend all relevant technical trainings offered by the organization.

This technician is expected to be knowledgeable across multiple process paths, support peers and new hires, and lead process improvements within their scope. They will utilize MES and SAP systems for daily production tracking and traceability and will actively support the team in resolving work blockers and general operational needs.

The Amazon Leo Propulsion Team is responsible for the design and development of the propulsion system which provides maneuvering capability to the spacecraft. The Propulsion Team is made up of a variety of sub-teams which are responsible for various aspects of the development process, such as mechanical design, systems engineering, subject matter experts, manufacturing, and test. title: Corporate Counsel, Energy & Water Legal
descriptionHtml:

You'll work on complex, high-value deals—many of them first-of-kind—while supporting our commitment to reach net-zero carbon by 2040 through one of the world's largest renewable energy procurement programs.

Key job responsibilities
- Structure, draft, and negotiate complex energy project agreements including power purchase agreements, utility special contracts, and power generation and interconnection arrangements
- Provide legal counsel on the interaction between deal structures, grid interconnection processes, and regulatory requirements in the energy sector
- Lead transactions from initial concept through closing, managing multiple workstreams and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders
- Support AWS's renewable energy procurement program by advising on transaction structures, risk allocation, and compliance with applicable energy regulations
- Collaborate with business development, infrastructure, and sustainability teams to identify legal solutions that advance both business objectives and climate commitments

A day in the life
As a Corporate Counsel on our Energy & Water Legal team, you'll take the lead on structuring, drafting, and negotiating complex energy project agreements including utility special contracts, power purchase agreements, and power generation and interconnection arrangements. Your work will span multiple deal phases—from initial concept through closing—where you'll analyze how deal structures interact with grid interconnection processes and evolving energy regulations. Some days you'll be deep in contract language; other days you'll be advising stakeholders on regulatory implications or exploring innovative deal structures that haven't been tried before.

About the team
We are a dedicated legal team supporting AWS's rapid expansion into energy procurement and infrastructure development. Our mission is to enable AWS to build the cloud and AI infrastructure our customers depend on while advancing our Climate Pledge commitment. We work closely with business partners across AWS to structure deals that are not only legally sound but also innovative and scalable. You'll join a collaborative group of attorneys and business professionals who are passionate about solving complex problems at the intersection of technology, energy, and sustainability. Together, we're helping to accelerate the global transition to renewable energy while supporting one of the world's most ambitious corporate climate commitments.

Basic qualifications

At Amazon, our tech isn't just a tool, it's your playground. Our engineers work on scalable systems, cloud services, and customer-facing products that operate at global scale. This is an environment where you learn by building. Whether you're creating cloud-native solutions, optimizing machine learning models, or building products that drive experiences for millions of customers around the globe, your work reaches the world, fast. You'll take ownership early, collaborate across teams and disciplines, and grow your skills as you tackle new problems. There's no single path forward here, with a chance to explore different directions and shape your journey as you go. This is where ambition meets opportunity and, where the impact of what you build helps define what comes next, for customers and for you. 

What's in it for you? An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You'll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

NOTE: By applying to this position, your application will be considered for all ASIC Engineer roles at all locations we hire for in the United States including but not limited to: Greater Seattle Area (Seattle, Bellevue, Redmond), Greater Bay Area (San Francisco, Sunnyvale, Santa Clara), San Diego (CA), Greater DMV (DC, MD, VA), Austin (TX), New York City (NY), Minneapolis (MN).

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The intense focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world’s most beloved brands. Customer obsession is part of our company DNA.

As part of a project team you will work alongside Senior ASIC Engineers; supporting the design, debug, validation and optimization of the products. You will be involved in projects from concept through production, gaining exposure to the complete design lifecycle. You will also support engineering builds gaining experience with high volume manufacturing. Some positions may require international travel.

Key job responsibilities
As an ASIC Engineer you will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary staff to conceive and design innovative consumer products. You will work closely with an internal inter-disciplinary team, and outside partners to drive key aspects of product definition, execution, and verification. You must be responsive, flexible and able to succeed within an open collaborative peer environment.
Responsibilities:
● Participate in logic design, verification and post-silicon validation as part of Amazon custom silicon solutions.
● Work with physical design teams to achieve performance and area requirements.
● Develop a deep understanding of the end customer requirements, including software applications, use models, system architecture and the SoC architecture/micro-architecture of our solutions.
● Develop and execute design automation mechanisms and flows.

A day in the life
We’re on the lookout for the curious, those who think big and want to define the world of tomorrow.
At Amazon, you will grow into the high impact, visionary person you know you’re ready to be. Every day will be filled with exciting new challenges, developing new skills, and achieving personal growth.
How often can you say that your work changes the world? At Amazon, you’ll say it often. Join us and define tomorrow.

About the team
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

title: Production Planning Analyst, Latam Production Planning Team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is a US-based multinational electronic commerce company headquartered in Seattle, Washington. Amazon.com started as an online bookstore, but soon diversified into many other categories, with a vision to be earth’s most customer-centric company and to build a place where people can come to find and discover anything they might want to buy online.
The Global Finance Solutions (GFS) team is a fast-paced, team-focused, and dynamic environment, and delivering great experiences for our customers is the top priority. GFS is seeking a Production Planning Analyst to support our Latam Production Planning team.
At Amazon, delivering great experiences for our customers is the top priority.
The Production Planning Team ensures Amazon’s Fulfillment Centers (FCs) have robust and cost-optimal labor plans while constantly innovating in a number of areas aimed at improving our customers’ experience. We are looking for a passionate, analytical, and technical person to work with us on innovating and improving our processes on behalf of our customers across different geographies. If you are someone who has shown success in analyzing and diving deep into complex data, streamlining and identifying process-improvement opportunities, and pioneering new ways to do things, we’d like to talk to you.



Key job responsibilities
The Production Planning analyst will be expected to deliver weekly capacity plans for Amazon fulfillment centers (FCs). These capacity plans will help influence network level strategic decisions through partnering with senior stakeholders in the FC as well as the network. The ideal candidate will possess both an analytical background that enables them to support network planning and demonstrate the ability to think broadly and strategically about operational initiatives. They will experience a wide range of problem solving situations, requiring extensive use of data collection and analysis. They will work in lock-step with multiple business teams including FC operations’ leadership, HR, finance leadership, supply chain and transportation teams of the network they will plan for.

Basic qualifications

- 2+years of experience in Planning Capacity, Workflow, Financial Planning, Operations Field Management or related fields.
- Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, finance or related field
- Effective English and Portuguese language skills (verbal and written)
- Advanced Excel skills
- Strong problem solving and stakeholder management

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in Operations, demand and Capacity Planning or Supply Chain
- Experience in SQL/VBA or any visual analytics platform like PowerBI or Tableau
- Experience with performance metrics

descriptionHtml:
Department Overview:
At Amazon Transportation Services (ATS), delivery volumes continue to grow year over year as we strive to reliably deliver products to our customers. The "last mile" delivery segment—from the final shipping hub to the customer's doorstep—demands industry-wide transformation, requiring the rapid development of innovative delivery services and network infrastructure.

Team Overview (Tech Team):
The Tech Team is responsible for maintaining and operating the system infrastructure that supports collaboration with major delivery partners, as well as driving automation of business processes. We contribute to the efficiency and quality improvement of our rapidly expanding delivery business through configuration management of transportation management systems (aka, ATROPS in Amazon), promotion of transportation-related system and product development, and automation of data input workflows. Driving product development in coordination with overseas development teams is also a key part of our mission.

Position Overview:
This position is responsible for the configuration and maintenance of transportation management systems, while also collaborating with overseas development teams (primarily the India team) to drive operational process optimization and product development related to new services and the growth of existing businesses. In system development, the role requires close engagement with business teams and external stakeholders to identify challenges and gather requirements, as well as working closely with offshore development teams to drive the smooth development of transportation-related systems and products.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

Key job responsibilities
● Configuration changes and maintenance of transportation management systems (ATROPS)
●      Driving transportation-related system and product development in coordination with overseas development teams
●      Technical requirement coordination and communication with internal and external stakeholders
● Business process automation (scripting and systemizing data input workflows, etc.)
● Investigation and resolution of system issues and incidents

title: Principal Solutions Architect, ASEAN Tech
descriptionHtml:
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and customer obsessed support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for experienced and motivated technologists who possess a unique balance of technical breadth/depth and strong interpersonal skills. As a Solutions Architect, you will partner some of the world’s leading AI model providers companies, AWS Sales, and several other AWS teams to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services.

As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mindshare and broad use of AWS from startups to enterprise customers.

The ideal candidate must be self-motivated with a proven track record to connect technology to measurable business value. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.

Here are some other qualities we are looking for:

- Enjoy working with large, global customers. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.
- Have a strong understanding of large-scale accelerated computing solutions. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep-dive education and design exercises to create world-class solutions built on AWS.

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the 8 description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Key job responsibilities
- As a key member of the account team, partner with customers to ensure their long-term success by helping them harness the power of AWS services to accelerate their business.
- Formulate and execute a cloud adoption strategy that delights our customers and builds strong relationships that lead to strategic revenue streams that exceed AWS objectives.
- Become a trusted advisor by gaining deep knowledge of AWS services, design patterns and best practices, and sharing that knowledge with clients, other SAs and the wider AWS builder community.
- Act as the voice of the customer for AWS service teams to enhance the AWS platform
- Work with other SAs to develop reusable solutions to common business and architectural problems.
- Educate customers by leading workshops and hands-on classes to demonstrate how to use AWS services.
- Network and build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customer organizations to enable them to be cloud advocates.
- Author and contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers, blog posts and open source projects, and speak at public events.
- Help hire, on-board and train new SAs via mentorship and builder programs.

About the team
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- 15+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- Experience developing technology solutions and evangelising end-to-end technology roadmaps that guide IT transformations toward cloud computing
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences and at C-level, including training, workshops, publications

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of distributed systems design and implementation or equivalent
- Knowledge of large scale automation and workflow management or equivalent
- Knowledge of presentations and whiteboarding skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with internal and external executives, IT management, and developers
- Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
- Experience with generative AI technologies, including foundation models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic architectures, and multi-agent systems.
- Familiarity with AWS AI/ML services (Bedrock, AgentCore, SageMaker, Q) and cloud-native architectures.

title: Electrical Engineering Program Manager, EU AMZL Sustainability Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon as a Electrical Engineering Program Manager and help scale our electrification transformation across Europe's last-mile and middle-mile delivery network. You'll design and implement electrical standards that enable our fleet to transition to zero-emission vehicles, directly contributing to our commitment to reach net-zero carbon by 2040.

The applicable collective agreement for this role is CBA for employees of Logistics, Delivery and Shipping Sector. The position is classified at level 1 or above, depending on the candidate's skills, competences and experience.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and manage vendor relationships to ensure installation capacity, quality of commissioning, and effective coordination with health and safety and operations teams on-site
- Validate electrical designs to confirm that teams are adhering to electrical standards during the installation of electrical equipment and EV charging infrastructure
- Align stakeholder expectations by defining and communicating electrical standards for equipment that improves carbon footprint and supports adoption of new tools and processes across EU delivery stations
- Monitor cost control and financial performance while maintaining focus on installation reliability and program outcomes
- Report progress to leadership on program and project milestones, ensuring accurate tracking of deliverables and outcomes

A day in the life
As an Electrical Engineering Program Manager, you'll engage with stakeholders across multiple levels of the organization to drive decisions that impact our entire delivery station network. Your day might include collaborating with Operations, Process Improvement, Health and Safety, Finance, and Procurement teams to design and deploy new EV charging infrastructure and electrical equipment into delivery stations. You'll validate electrical designs to ensure teams are meeting our standards during installation, coordinate with external vendors on commissioning quality, and provide regular updates to leadership on program progress. You'll work in a cooperative environment where colleagues share a commitment to making Amazon a global reference for sustainability.

About the team
We are EU AMZL Sustainability Engineering, responsible for defining and continuously improving electrical standards for EV charging networks and smart grid solutions. Our team partners closely with Global Fleet, Field Engineering, Maintenance, and Operations teams to ensure reliable design while maintaining cost efficiency—we believe that resource optimization is essential to meaningful sustainability impact. The scale of Amazon's last-mile network means we establish partnerships across the organization to translate plans into installations that reduce our carbon footprint. You'll be part of a group dedicated to building the infrastructure that enables our electrification mission.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience working with vendors or partners
- Experience in the electrical field, or experience working with electrical and mechanical conveyance systems
- Experience in planning, scheduling and auditing maintenance activities
- Knowledge about process quality management and or infrastructure commissioning

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of AutoCAD, VBA, and SQL at the intermediate level
- Experience with Six Sigma, lean manufacturing

descriptionHtml:

The Amazon Customs and Trade (ACT) team provides customers a one stop shop for international transportation, delivering end to end supply chain solutions. We are seeking a customer centric individual who wants to be part of this journey and manage daily operational tasks and customer queries.

A Sr Customs Specialist owns daily operations for customs clearance on ocean, air, rail and truck cross border shipments, for both third party and first party entry filing. title: Logistics Area Manager, FC Operations
descriptionHtml:
Il team Operations è il cuore pulsante di Amazon. Svolge un ruolo fondamentale per il nostro business, perché ci permette di evadere e spedire gli ordini in modo efficiente, così che i nostri clienti li ricevano nei tempi previsti. Nel ruolo di Area Manager, dovrai garantire la regolare operatività del tuo sito logistico, per riuscire a soddisfare le richieste dei clienti. Sarai a capo di un team che contribuisce a garantire la sicurezza, l’efficienza e l’alta qualità dei nostri processi e ti occuperai di una serie di progetti su tutta la nostra rete con lo scopo di incrementare la produttività.

Il contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro applicabile a questo ruolo è Logistica, Trasporto Merci e Spedizione. La posizione è inquadrata al Livello 1 o superiore, in base alle competenze, capacità ed esperienza del/della candidato/a.

Key job responsibilities
- Creare, portare avanti e promuovere una cultura incentrata sulla sicurezza e sul benessere.
- Analizzare e implementare cambiamenti per mantenere qualità e produttività a livelli costantemente elevati.
- Supervisionare progetti di miglioramento dei processi, ottimizzare la produttività e incrementare la qualità del servizio ai clienti all’interno della tua area di responsabilità.
- Analizzare le prestazioni dei turni rispetto agli obiettivi aziendali e mettere in atto azioni per migliorare la nostra eccellenza operativa.
- Lavorare in collaborazione con i colleghi manager per standardizzare le prassi adottate nei turni.

A day in the life
Lavorerai su turni presso uno dei nostri siti logistici, garantendo la massima produttività possibile. Il tuo obiettivo principale sarà promuovere una cultura della sicurezza e il rispetto degli standard di qualità e di performance durante i turni. Dovrai inoltre supervisionare le attività di miglioramento dei processi nella tua area e agevolarne l’implementazione. La tipica giornata di lavoro è molto varia: dovrai occuparti di attività di routine di gestione del team, avrai responsabilità quotidiane volte al miglioramento dei processi e iniziative contingenti di gestione operativa su più ampia scala. Dovrai anche fungere da esempio e da guida per i nuovi manager.

About the team
Il team Customer Fulfilment, o CF, è il nucleo originario di Amazon. Tutto è partito da un piccolo gruppo di librai, per poi diventare un team sofisticato dalla presenza globale, che gestisce oltre 1,5 milioni di ordini al giorno. Questo team è alla base della nostra attività ed è grazie al suo impegno che l’azienda ha saputo diversificarsi, ampliando la propria presenza geografica e l’offerta di servizi. Grazie alle nuove tecnologie, siamo sempre alla ricerca di modi per offrire una gamma di prodotti più ampia e migliore, con consegne tempestive a costi contenuti.
Il team CF è il primo anello della catena che ci permette di consegnare i prodotti con la velocità che ci contraddistingue. Opera all’interno dei Fulfilment Centre, aree chiave della frenetica rete operativa di Amazon e che a volte vengono definiti “First Mile”, primo miglio, perché è proprio lì che la maggior parte dei pacchi Amazon inizia il suo viaggio. Il team aiuta a gestire un inventario dinamico e agevola consegne tempestive 24 ore su 24.
Nei Fulfilment Centre operano le figure più disparate, quindi le opportunità abbondano e c’è bisogno di competenze eterogenee. C’è chi gestisce fisicamente i prodotti e chi si occupa di analizzare i dati per aiutare il personale a prendere decisioni oculate.

title: Software Development Engineer, Special Projects
descriptionHtml:
Are you excited about building software that empowers scientists to develop new products? As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you will design and deliver systems at the intersection of machine learning and the life sciences. We are scaling our model and method execution infrastructure so scientists can generate, analyze, and deliver new products and insights to researchers and internal teams across Amazon. Today the platform processes thousands of ML inference jobs weekly, and we need a collaborative, curious engineer to help us meet rapidly growing demand.
