title: Senior Solutions Architect, National Security Solutions Architecture Team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a Senior Solutions Architect to support our US Government customers in the Northern Virginia / DC Metro area. (Relocation assistance is available.)

This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph. The position further requires the candidate to opt into a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

As a Solutions Architect on the National Security team, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to your Intelligence Community customers. You are the “face of Amazon” to your customers, and they will consult you regarding a broad variety of technical challenges that are complex and mission-critical. You can build sample solutions, “think big,” and provide architecture designs and cloud enablement strategy that suit your customer’s business and technical needs. This is a high-visibility role where you collaborate with and influence external stakeholders (our government customers) and internal AWS teams like Sales and Platform Engineering.

National Security Solutions Architects are regarded as technical “thought leaders” within the Intelligence Community who evangelize emerging technologies on a conceptual level and on a practical, architectural level. Our SAs have played a critical role in the widespread adoption and advancement of cloud computing capabilities within the Intelligence Community. SAs think outside of the box to deliver results to our customers and provide solutions that are cost-effective, time-saving, and secure. As a National Security SA, you’ll solve problems at both the business and technical levels. You'll work backwards from our customers’ requirements and envision new mechanisms and strategies we can leverage that would enable agencies to operate more efficiently and better execute on their goals. Then, you'll figure out how to make the puzzle pieces fit together from the technical side and deliver the offering to the customer at scale. Frequently, you will be responsible for mission-critical solutions with life-saving implications.

Sometimes, the best way to innovate around a customer pain point is to create a new product altogether. This position offers you the unique opportunity to drive the AWS service roadmap to support our customers’ requirements within the complex technical constraints of the cleared environment.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for technologists who align with our Leadership Principles and possess a unique balance of technical depth and strong interpersonal skills. You will partner with customers, AWS Sales, and several other AWS teams to craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address Intelligence Community customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with Sales, you will drive revenue growth across a broad set of customers. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mindshare and broad use of AWS within the Intelligence Community. The ideal candidate is be self-motivated, with a proven track record in software/technology sales or consulting. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.

We are looking for someone who is passionate about the following:
- Be great fun to work with at AWS. We have a credo of “Work hard. Have fun. Make history." In this role, you will love what you do and instinctively know how to make work fun. You will be dynamic, creative, and willing to take on any challenge and make a big impact.
- Enjoy working with Intelligence Community customers. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a diverse and challenging set of Intelligence Community customers.
- Have a strong understanding of large-scale computing solutions. The ideal candidate will have past experience working as a systems or support engineer and pre-sales experience. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep-dive education and design exercises to create world-class solutions built on AWS.

This position can have periods of up to 25% travel.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
- In partnership with the sales team, formulate and execute a sales strategy to exceed revenue objectives through the adoption of AWS
- As a key member of the business development and sales team, ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform
- Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
- Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS
- Capture and share best-practice knowledge among the AWS solutions architect community
- Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers and other reusable content
- Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates
- Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. You'll apply your problem-solving and technical skills to real challenges, while developing important communication and professional soft skills through hands-on experience. title: Sr. Product Designer, AWS Billing
descriptionHtml:
Every AWS customer, from a solo developer to a Fortune 100 finance team, eventually asks the same questions. What am I spending? Why am I spending it? What should I do about it? AWS Billing answers those questions for millions of customers, inside a business running at a $169 billion annualized revenue run rate.

That job is changing as AI agents are starting to act on customers' behalf. They forecast spend, recommend commitments, flag anomalies, and increasingly take action on customer’s behalf. When an agent touches someone's money, the design questions get harder: What is it allowed to do on its own? How does it explain itself? How does the customer stay in control and undo what it did? Few products anywhere face these questions at this scale or with these stakes.

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to help answer them. You'll define how customers and AI agents work together to understand, forecast, and control cloud spend, and you'll set the patterns other teams build on.

- Design for trust where it matters most. Billing is where customers decide whether to trust AWS with their money, and where AI has to earn that trust.

- Define agentic UX, not just screens. Shape what agents do on a customer's behalf, where humans approve, and how automated actions stay transparent and reversible.

- Work with a wide range of customers and rich data. Design for developers, FinOps practitioners, CFOs, and channel partners, using some of the richest usage and spend data at AWS.

- Ship as an embedded partner. Work alongside product, engineering, and data science from problem framing through post-launch iteration.

Key job responsibilities
- Frame ambiguous problems before solving them. Drive clarity when requirements, customers, and feasibility are undefined.

- Define how AI agents act on customers' behalf: what they do autonomously, where humans approve, and how customers take control back.

- Design trust patterns that surface an agent's confidence, reasoning, and attribution, so customers understand why it acts.

- Design human-in-the-loop, approval, and undo patterns for actions that move money.

- Create coherent experiences across conversational, agent-driven, and console interfaces.

- Lead design from problem framing through launch, then use data signals to improve what ships.

- Partner early with data science, legal, and policy as co-designers on AI features with financial or compliance complexity.

- Establish patterns and standards that become how the team operates. Mentor other designers.

- Write narratives and strategy documents that move decisions forward, and present them to senior leadership.

A day in the life
Your morning starts with usage data from an anomaly-alert flow you shipped last month. Then you meet your PM and engineering lead to frame a new problem: when should an agent pause spend without asking? You prototype two directions with AI tools and bring them to critique. After lunch, you work with data science and legal on how an agent explains a commitment recommendation. You end the day refining a narrative for leadership review. Your customers range from solo builders to CFOs. Your work decides whether they trust an agent with their money.

About the team
AWS Billing sits at the intersection of trust and scale. Every customer, from a first-time builder to a Fortune 100 enterprise, relies on us to make spending transparent and controllable. We are a tight-knit design group within the larger AWS Design organization. We work with product, engineering, and data science. We move fast without lowering the craft bar. We are designing agents that can spot a cost spike and help stop it before the bill arrives. We believe billing should not just work. It should build confidence. If hard problems and high ownership energize you, you'll fit right in.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of design experience
- Have an online portfolio or samples of work on resume, demonstrating experience creating great end-to-end, user-centered design solutions and patterns, across desktop and mobile devices
- Experience using AI tools in your design workflow, such as AI-assisted prototyping, code generation, or research synthesis
- Experience designing complex, data-dense workflows and information architecture

Preferred qualifications

- Experience designing AI-powered or agentic experiences, including delegation, trust, and human-in-the-loop patterns
- Experience prototyping in code using AI coding tools
- Experience turning qualitative and quantitative insights into design decisions with measurable outcomes
- Experience designing for billing, payments, finance, or FinOps products
- Experience designing across conversational and traditional console interfaces
- Experience writing narrative documents that drive product decisions

title: Software Dev Engineer II, AWS Applied AI Solutions
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

On Agentic WorkSpaces, our vision is to enable AI agents to work the way humans do — with access to real applications, real interfaces, and real computing environments. For enterprises to trust autonomous agents with their essential business applications, they need a full suite of governance capabilities: an identity for every agent, human-in-the-loop controls to audit and approve what agents do, and the ability for a human intervene in an agent's session when required. Our team is building these systems end to end. Upcoming launches will give every agent a verifiable identity, record every desktop action as a reviewable visual audit trail, enforce policy on every tool call before it executes, pause agents for human approval on sensitive actions, and let a human take control of an agent's session mid-task before handing it back to the agent, which resumes with full context of what changed. Identity and agentic governance present hard problems in our industry today, and we're excited to on the forefront of solving them.

We're looking for an SDE II who can ramp quickly deliver features end-to-end and thrive in greenfield work. Much of what we're building doesn't exist yet. You'll take early designs to production make pragmatic calls about what to build versus what to compose from existing AWS services and ship on a schedule tied to real customer milestones. The pace is high with re:Invent deliverables targeted for this year and an ambitious 2027 roadmap. If you like owning features from design through production and want your work to be the reason enterprises trust AI agents this team is for you.

Key job responsibilities
• Own features end-to-end: design implement test deploy and operate in production
* Build new services for policy enforcement, session recording and replay, human-in-the-loop approval workflows, and human takeover of agent sessions
* Integrate with AWS services and make build-vs-compose decisions with your team
* Handle customer content with care: recording pipelines retention and access controls where correctness is the product
* Collaborate with engineers on adjacent teams to unblock dependencies and align on interfaces
* Contribute to operational excellence: oncall runbooks alarms and incident response

A day in the life
Your mornings are usually free for focus work - writing code reviewing CRs and working through whatever problem you've picked up. Around 11 you'll have standup then grab lunch with the team (if you like) before the afternoon opens up for integration work cross-team syncs or design reviews. Our pipelines are full CD our ticket queue is small and when something pages us we fix the root cause - not just the symptom. The problems are interesting and the pace is high but we believe we can move fast do exceptional work and have a full life outside of it.

AWS is looking for an exceptional Data Center Security Specialist with a strong track record of supporting security programs within data center facilities, demonstrable program/project management experience, comprehensive security operations knowledge, and a deep understanding of physical security standards, processes, and requirements.

As a Data Center Security Specialist (DSS) at an AWS site, you will own the execution of multiple security disciplines in support of fast-moving operations and manage a wide array of projects designed to protect personnel, customer data, and critical infrastructure from insider and external threats. You will also be responsible for managing onsite security forces. You must obsess over internal and external customers and successfully deliver support and services in an environment where priorities shift extremely fast. Duties include ensuring consistent deployment of all required security policies and procedures and participate in re-occurring site audits and reviews and testing new security technologies.

A day in the life
As a Data Center Security Specialist, your day begins with reviewing overnight security reports and incident logs to ensure continuity of operations. You'll conduct morning walkthroughs of the data center perimeter and red zones, verifying that all physical security controls are functioning properly and documenting any anomalies.

Throughout the day, you'll coordinate with onsite security forces, providing guidance on post orders and responding to real-time security events. You'll participate in construction coordination meetings to ensure security requirements are integrated into ongoing build activities, reviewing access requests and ensuring compliance with AWS security standards.

Mid-day often involves hands-on work—testing security equipment, conducting badge audits, or investigating incidents that occurred during previous shifts. You'll collaborate with Data Center Operations teams to balance security requirements with operational needs, ensuring customer workloads remain protected without impacting availability.

Your afternoon may include updating security procedures based on lessons learned, conducting training sessions with contract security officers, or participating in site audits to validate compliance with security policies. You'll also spend time on vendor management, coordinating with security technology providers to resolve equipment issues or implement enhancements.

As the day closes, you'll prepare shift handover documentation, brief incoming security personnel on any ongoing situations, and update your Multi Cluster Security Manager on key activities and upcoming priorities. You'll also dedicate time to continuous improvement initiatives, identifying opportunities to enhance security operations and drive process efficiencies across the site.

This role requires flexibility—no two days are identical, and you must be prepared to pivot quickly as priorities shift in support of fast-moving data center operations.

descriptionHtml:
Do you want to build the products that help AWS ProServe and Frontier AI teams understand customer needs, develop the right solutions, and deliver them at scale? descriptionHtml:
Join the AI Studios Engineering org within Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios as a Machine Learning Engineer on CreativeFlux, the ML platform powering Nara, our AI-native content creation platform for professional animation and live action/VFX.

You will own the training and serving infrastructure that puts generative models in front of artists working on Prime Video's animated and live action productions. You'll work daily with Applied Scientists, animators, filmmakers, and storytellers, building the systems that turn new model architectures into production-grade tools artists can rely on under tight deadlines.

This role suits engineers who want their work to expand what storytelling can look like, putting new generative capabilities into the hands of the people building Prime Video's animated and live action shows.

Key job responsibilities
Design, deploy, and operate ML training and inference workloads on EKS, including GPU node groups, custom schedulers, autoscaling, resource quotas, and gang scheduling for multi-GPU jobs
Integrate generative ML models (image, video, audio) into production inference pipelines, partnering with Applied Scientists to take new architectures from research to scaled deployment

Build training and fine-tuning pipelines on EKS and SageMaker, including data preparation, distributed training, evaluation harnesses, and checkpointing strategies

Improve GPU utilization, throughput, and latency on the inference fleet through batching, quantization, model compilation, serving framework tuning, and Kubernetes-native scaling primitives (HPA, KEDA, custom controllers)

Build automated evaluation pipelines and quality metrics that catch model regressions before they reach Artists, including human-in-the-loop review where needed

Drive integrations with Digital Content Creation (DCC) tools such as Adobe Animate, After Effects, Maya, and Storyboard Pro at the points where models are surfaced to creators

Own operational health of model endpoints on EKS, including monitoring, alerting, on-call response, capacity planning, and post-incident analysis
Write clean, well-tested code and participate in design and code reviews

Stay current with generative ML, distributed training, inference optimization, and GPU efficiency techniques, and apply them to move team metrics

A day in the life
As an MLE on the AI Studios team, you'll deploy and tune generative ML models, optimizing inference pipelines, and build EKS infrastructure that empowers Scientists productionalize new model architectures. A typical day includes scaling video generation endpoints, debugging multi-GPU training pipelines, or supporting a Scientist to migrate a new image model from a research notebook to a serving fleet. You'll work with other Nara platform teams to ensure ML capabilities land cleanly in production artists workflows. You'll join team standups, model review sessions, on-call rotations, and platform-wide design reviews. You'll learn from experienced engineers and scientists to gradually take on more complex challenges over time.

About the team
We're AI Studios within Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios, building Nara, our AI-native content creation platform. Our mission is to make Amazon a leader in AI-enabled content creation, giving creators direct control over model outputs while reducing the cost and timeline of animation and live action productions.

Our engineering team spans distributed systems engineers building scalable infrastructure, ML engineers optimizing 1P model training and inference, and full-stack engineers building creative facing agentic tools.

- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience

- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

descriptionHtml:

title: Interdisciplinary System Engineer, Devices & Services Energy
descriptionHtml:
Amazon has co-founded and signed The Climate Pledge, a commitment to reach net zero carbon by 2040. As a team, we leverage GenAI, sensors, smart home devices, cloud services, material science, and Alexa to build products that have a meaningful impact for customers and the climate.

In alignment with this bold corporate goal, the Amazon Devices & Services organization is looking for a passionate, talented, and inventive Interdisciplinary System Engineer to help build revolutionary products with potential for major societal impact. Great candidates for this position will have expertise in the areas of battery management systems, energy storage optimization, time-series forecasting, and control systems for battery dispatch. This includes owning end-to-end battery system architecture, design, and technical execution across the team's hardware launches, and experience designing ML-driven algorithms for battery management (BMS) that operate reliably under embedded/edge compute constraints, building forecasting models for energy usage and demand response, applying reinforcement learning or control theory to battery dispatch and charge/discharge optimization, and developing predictive models for battery health and degradation. You will strive for simplicity and creativity, demonstrating high judgment backed by statistical proof.

Key job responsibilities
As a Interdisciplinary System Engineer, you'll own end-to-end battery system architecture for new-to-Amazon devices, including power electronics, BMS, wireless connectivity, and HW/FW/SW integration — driving architecture decisions from concept through mass production. You'll serve as a key technical interface with battery vendors on system-level design and component selection, and lead design reviews and validation plans to ensure product quality and safety. You'll design and deploy ML-driven algorithms that autonomously optimize battery charge/discharge behavior, dispatch, and energy usage, and develop forecasting systems that integrate real-world usage data and grid signals to deliver context-aware, cost-saving recommendations to customers.

Beyond technical innovation, you'll drive critical technical trade-offs — BMS algorithm fidelity versus compute constraints, power electronics efficiency versus BOM cost, safety margin versus usable capacity — serving as a subject-matter expert on energy storage systems for Director and VP-level technical reviews. You'll drive end-to-end product development from research through production deployment on embedded and cloud systems, collaborating with cross-functional hardware, firmware, and software teams, and establish rigorous experimentation frameworks to validate model performance and measure business impact.

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering
- Experience with electrical systems
- 4+ years of hardware design and validation of components, subsystems and systems experience
- Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems, or experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AI/ML technologies
- Knowledge of battery electro-chemistry and manufacturing processes.
- Familiarity with energy systems and energy devices beyond batteries

descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Security Compliance Investigations team protects our most sensitive and regulated data by monitoring and investigating access at scale. We are seeking an experienced Support Engineer to lead complex investigations, set quality standards, and help the team grow.

In this role, you will lead high-stakes investigations that require advanced SQL analysis and pattern recognition across large datasets to determine compliance with data access policies. This is a hands-on, investigation-heavy role for engineers who combine technical depth with sound judgment.

title: Software Development Manager, EBS Server Agility
descriptionHtml:
If leading a team that builds secure, autonomous systems to test, deploy, and patch server software for one of the world's largest storage services excites you, the EBS Server Agility team is the place to do it. EBS is a foundational AWS service on which most other AWS services depend, and our teams build and operate the Continuous Integration platform and the deployment and patching infrastructure that keep EBS server software fast to ship, current, and secure across 400,000 bare-metal servers, infrastructure that serves millions of AWS customers and exabytes of data every day.

We are looking for a Software Development Manager to lead an engineering team in our DevOps space. This is the space that spans Continuous Integration, which builds the platform that decides whether a change is safe to ship, and Deployments and Patching, which safely rolls that change out to a stateful storage engine serving live customer I/O. Both sit in the critical path for feature velocity and security compliance, and both are places where strong engineering leadership has outsized impact.

You will not be writing the code or designing the systems yourself. You will lead the engineers who do: hiring and growing the team, setting clear technical direction, removing ambiguity, and delivering results predictably. You will decide where your systems sit in their lifecycle, define goals tied to business needs, and build the mechanisms that let the team deliver consistently without wearing out its best people. The guiding philosophy is simple and demanding: every manual step in the operator path is a defect in the system, and your team builds the test frameworks, CI infrastructure, and deployment services that engineer that toil away.

Server CI and deployment at EBS shape how the software evolves to support new hardware platforms, new partitions (including edge and Outpost), and new operational models. You will partner with principal engineers and leaders across EC2 and EBS, and represent your team's work in discussions that shape how EBS evolves. If you want your leadership to have real impact at AWS scale, and you are excited by building a team that builds systems that test, deploy, and patch themselves, we would love to talk to you.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead, hire, develop, and promote a team of software engineers (up to Senior SDE, L6) across the CI and Deployments domains, building a team with sustainable on-call and clear growth paths

- Own and set the technical direction and roadmap across both the CI platform and the deployment and patching systems, and be accountable for how they work together

- Deliver a CI platform that answers "is this change safe to deploy to 400,000 servers," including distributed test orchestration, intelligent test selection, and observability across x86 and Graviton

- Deliver deployment pipelines and automated security patching that safely update a stateful storage engine across all AWS regions and partitions with zero customer impact and manifest consistency on a biweekly cadence

- Drive toward secure, autonomous operations: automated canary analysis, rollback, anomaly detection, and self-healing automation that takes the operator out of the loop

- Own operational health across both domains: on-call, patch compliance, and the cadences that keep the fleet green

- Define goals tied to business needs and deliver them predictably, building mechanisms so the team ships consistently

- Lead the team through change with clarity and empathy, and influence technical direction beyond your immediate team

A day in the life
Your day moves across many disparate topics. You might align the team on a roadmap for the quarter, coach an engineer through a design, review progress against goals, and make a principled call that trades a little speed for safety on a change headed to the fleet. You will remove blockers, set priorities, and keep on-call sustainable while the team ships. You will partner with principal engineers and leaders across EBS and EC2, and you will represent your team's work to senior leadership.

This is a high-visibility role. The work in this space affects every EBS customer, and your team's output is regularly reviewed by senior leadership. You will collaborate across organizational boundaries, influence technical direction beyond your immediate team, and build a team that is better for your presence but does not need you to be successful.

We value managers who lead through ambiguity, reduce toil through smart automation, make principled tradeoffs between speed and safety, hire and grow strong engineers, and elevate everyone around them.

About the team
EBS Server Agility is the DevOps space for EBS Server, owning the Continuous Integration platform and the server deployment and patching infrastructure. Our engineers build distributed test orchestration and qualification systems, deployment pipelines that safely deliver validated server software to 400,000 bare-metal servers, automated patching that keeps software secure on a biweekly cadence, metrics and crash observability, and secure operational tooling for autonomous operations. We move fast to deliver for customers while maintaining operational excellence across these mission-critical services.

We are a Boston-based group building toward a future where server software tests, patches, and deploys itself: safely, securely, on schedule, with full visibility. There is significant greenfield opportunity, because CI and safe deployment for stateful bare-metal systems at global scale have almost no off-the-shelf solutions, so our teams design from first principles.

We are dedicated to supporting the people on the team. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we are building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Senior members give one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, design and code reviews. We care about career growth and work to assign projects that stretch each engineer so they feel empowered to take on more complex problems over time.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of engineering experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product and program management teams
- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations, or experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Sr. Power Systems Engineer, Energy Storage, AWS Global Energy
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about large power infrastructure systems? Do you love to innovate, discover, and apply your knowledge to advance world-class systems? Do you get excited about the idea of pushing the boundaries of power systems to handle the latest emerging technology? We are seeking a power systems engineer with experience in power systems and energy storage to support our growing requirements for novel solutions to delivering power to AWS data centers.

We are looking for a candidate with a track record of working on difficult power system problems and deep understanding of energy and power systems. As a Sr. Power Systems Engineer, Energy Storage you will work within the Power Generation Solutions team to develop advanced electrical systems, model and evaluate power flow, design energy storage requirements, and lead design integration to maximize the capacity out of our systems. You will own challenging problems that span multiple teams and drive technical decisions that impact AWS’ global infrastructure strategy. You will work on the technical strategy of different power and energy configurations, including developing optimization and control logic to ensure that we can exceed our customers’ expectations for delivering highly available power at the lowest costs for our data centers. You will work across multiple organizations, including utility-facing teams, data center and hardware engineering teams, compute and software teams, operations, finance, legal, and public policy teams to advance new concepts. Your technical expertise on power systems and energy storage will guide cross-functional teams in making critical design decisions, evaluating trade-offs, and managing technical risks across complex power systems.

Amazon has a global presence, therefore, domestic and international travel may be necessary. Teamwork is absolutely necessary for us to accomplish our goals. You must be able to work within a team and collaborate with others to accomplish the required tasks. This includes working with internal groups as well as external suppliers and consultants, including utilities, manufacturers, vendors, and contractors.

At Amazon Web Services (AWS), our data centers are industry leading examples of innovation in the areas of data center critical infrastructure design, space utilization, energy efficiency, and cost effectiveness. We are known for our speed to market, reliability, and lowest total cost of ownership. Our Engineers are on the forefront of creating and delivering the most innovative products to our customers and are known for being a diverse and upbeat team that is continually improving the world of cloud computing. We continue to grow and are looking for individuals that can support our mission, enjoy a challenge, and have a desire for professional growth and continuous learning. AWS’s work environment is unique and offers an exceptional opportunity for the right candidate. If you are a creative, smart, and driven individual that enjoys working with complex problems, we want YOU!

Key job responsibilities
As a Sr. Power Systems Engineer, Energy Storage on the Power Generation Solutions team, you will be responsible for:

• Developing designs and analysis of different energy storage technologies, including, but not limited to; battery energy storage systems, long duration energy storage systems, and utility-scale energy storage
• Support the integration of energy storage systems with different power sources, such as electric utilities, diesel generators, reciprocating engines, gas turbines, fuel cells, microgrids, distributed energy resources, and renewable energy, to serve data center loads in grid connected or grid independent configurations
• Understanding current trends in data center power demands and grid integration of large loads
• Having a deep understanding of analytical methods for evaluating power demands throughout the data center architecture and means to maximize capacity and utilization
• Understanding grid interconnection standards and requirements, including working on microgrid design and controls, and distributed energy resources
• Understanding the design and functionality of the global data center fleet, including existing, upcoming, and unique site designs
• Interpreting, evaluating, and developing Single Line Drawings (SLD), engineering drawings, equipment submittals, equipment specifications documentation, and performance data to advance concepts and solutions
• Providing input and direction to Data Center Engineering teams for design revisions for new data centers as well as to Field Engineering for operational data center upgrades to meet critical strategic requirements
• Working independently and have frequent reviews with Senior and Principal Engineers in the team and with partner teams
• Working on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions
• Being positive and offer creative, out of the box solutions
• Continuously learning curious about how things work, and willing to test and push new ideas
• Having fun and working hard!

About the team
The Power Generation Solutions team creates and delivers product and engineering solutions in for power and energy to help advance AWS’ mission to deliver world-leading cloud services. Our solutions are guided by four main principles; unlocking capacity growth, maintaining high infrastructure uptime, minimizing infrastructure costs, and advancing our net-zero carbon Climate Pledge. To deliver these solutions, our team provides technical input to realize a shared vision and strategy with partner teams and provides engineering support across the project or product lifecycle to deliver the solution. We provide grid analytics and manage and develop models for determining the total energy and water use within our fleet of data centers and work with partners on improving overall performance.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
- Knowledge of critical data center mechanical and electrical equipment
- 6+ years of experience with power systems or electrical design
- Experience with dynamic and transient power system modeling software, such as PSCAD, PSSE, or similar software.
- Experience and knowledge of energy storage equipment, systems, controls, including, but not limited to battery energy storage systems and long duration energy storage technologies.
- Ability to interpret wiring diagrams, single and three-line diagrams, submittals, sequence of operations, and electrical drawing packages
- Possess data analytics skills, data querying skills/language, scripting, and comfort with working in vast amounts of data in new and evolving environments

Preferred qualifications

- Professional Engineering or Architectural License
- Knowledge of building codes and regulations for your region
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents
- 6+ years of data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance experience
- Master's degree in electrical engineering or equivalent
- Working knowledge of continuous operating redundant electrical systems and power infrastructure. This includes but is not limited to; uninterruptable power sources, medium and low voltage electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches.
- Experience in electrical power design, including interpreting wiring diagrams, single and three-line diagrams, P&ID drawings, sequence of operations, and electrical drawing packages, failure mode analysis.
- Experience with gathering, compiling, and analyzing data to identify availability and/or performance risks within the design and operations of critical power infrastructure, including an understanding of data analysis methodologies and statistical techniques.
- Experience with scripting languages (e.g., Python, R), or statistical/mathematical software (e.g., R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) and machine learning or related optimization frameworks
- Possess excellent attention to detail and communication skills in order to maintain high quality standards for being organized, setting priorities, meeting deadlines, and staying within budgets
- Possess leadership and problem-solving skills

title: Software Engineer II - AI/ML, Neuron Inference, Inference
descriptionHtml:
The Annapurna Labs team at Amazon Web Services (AWS) builds the AWS Neuron SDK, the software development kit used to accelerate deep learning and GenAI workloads on AWS Trainium machine learning accelerators.

The Neuron Inference organization is at the forefront of optimizing inference performance for a wide range of ML models and model architectures on AWS's custom ML accelerators. We are working across the stack from PyTorch to the hardware-software boundary, our engineers build systematic infrastructure, develop high-performance kernels for ML functions, ensuring every compute unit is fine-tuned for optimal performance forour customers' demanding workloads. We combine deep hardware knowledge with ML expertise to push the boundaries of what's
possible in AI acceleration.

As part of the broader Neuron organization, our team works across multiple technology layers — from frameworks and kernels through to compiler, runtime, and collectives. We not only optimize performance on open weight models but also contribute to future architecture designs and work closely with customers to enable optimal performance on their models. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of machine learning, high-performance computing, and distributed architectures, where you'll help shape the future of AI acceleration technology.

As a Software Engineer II - AI/ML, you will design and implement business-critical features and own the performance of models on AWS Trainium end to end. We operate in spaces that are very large, yet our teams remain small and agile. There is no blueprint. We're inventing. We're experimenting. It is a very unique learning culture. The team works closely with customers on their model enablement, providing direct support and optimization expertise to ensure their machine learning workloads achieve optimal performance on AWS ML accelerators. The team also collaborates with open source ecosystems to provide seamless integration and bring peak performance at scale for customers and developers.

This role is responsible for development, enablement, and performance tuning of a wide variety of LLM model families, including massive-scale large language models like the GLM, GPT-OSS, Kimi, and beyond. The Model Enablement team works side by side with compiler engineers and runtime engineers to create, build, and tune distributed inference solutions with AWS Trainium.

You can learn more about Neuron:

* https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/neuron-guide/neuron-cc/index.html
* https://aws.amazon.com/machine-learning/neuron/
* https://github.com/aws/aws-neuron-sdk
* https://www.amazon.science/how-silicon-innovation-became-the-secret-sauce-behind-awss-successAre you passionate about building software that operates at massive scale and directly impacts millions of customers? As a Software Development Engineer II at Amazon, you will design, build, and maintain systems that solve complex problems while delivering meaningful results. You will contribute across the full software development lifecycle — from working backwards from customer needs to designing, implementing, testing, deploying, and operating production software. This role offers the opportunity to tackle challenging technical problems, collaborate with talented engineers, and grow your skills while making a real impact. If you are a curious, self-motivated engineer who thrives on turning ambiguity into clarity and shipping high-quality code, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
This role contributes to building distributed inference support for PyTorch in the Neuron SDK, and tunes models to ensure the highest performance and maximize efficiency running on AWS Trainium. Strong software development in Python, system-level programming, and ML knowledge are all critical to this role. Our engineers collaborate across compiler, runtime, framework, and hardware teams to optimize machine learning workloads for our global customer base. Working at the intersection of software, hardware, and machine learning systems, you'll bring expertise in low-level optimization, system architecture, and ML model acceleration. In this role, you will:

* Design, develop, and optimize machine learning models and frameworks for deployment on custom ML hardware accelerators.
* Participate in all stages of the ML system development lifecycle, including distributed-computing-based architecture design, implementation, performance profiling, hardware-specific optimizations, testing, and production deployment.
* Build infrastructure to systematically analyze and onboard multiple models with diverse architectures.
* Understand and produce NKI (Neuron Kernel Interface) kernels, and design and implement high-performance kernels and features for ML operations, leveraging the Neuron architecture and programming models.
* Analyze and optimize system-level performance across multiple generations of Neuron hardware, using knowledge of the underlying Trainium hardware architecture to guide optimization decisions.
* Conduct detailed performance analysis using profiling tools to identify and resolve bottlenecks.
* Implement optimizations such as fusion, sharding, tiling, and scheduling.
* Conduct comprehensive testing, including unit and end-to-end model testing with continuous deployment and releases through pipelines.
* Work directly with customers to enable and optimize their ML models on AWS accelerators.
* Collaborate across teams to develop innovative optimization techniques, and share proposals, findings, and learnings with internal developers and external customers via high-quality designs and documentation.


A day in the life
You will collaborate with a cross-functional team of applied scientists, systems engineers, and product managers to deliver state-of-the-art inference capabilities for Generative AI applications. Your work will involve debugging performance issues, optimizing memory usage, and contributing to the future of Neuron's inference stack across Amazon and the Open Source Community. As you design and code solutions to help our team drive efficiencies in software architecture, you'll create metrics, implement automation and other improvements, and resolve the root cause of software defects.

You will also build high-impact solutions to deliver to our large customer base and participate in design discussions and code reviews, and communicate with internal and external stakeholders. You will work cross-functionally to help drive business decisions with your technical input. You will work in a startup-like development environment, where you're always working on the most important initiative.You will start your day reviewing operational metrics and addressing any alerts from the systems you own. From there, you might dive into designing a new feature, writing and reviewing code, or pairing with a teammate to debug a tricky issue. You will participate in design discussions, contribute to sprint planning, and document your systems so that others can learn from and extend your work. Expect regular collaboration with product and engineering partners as you shape solutions that serve customers at scale.

About the team
The Model Enablement team fosters a builder's culture where experimentation is encouraged and impact is measurable. We emphasize collaboration, technical ownership, and continuous learning. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop their engineering expertise so they feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future. Join us to solve some of the most interesting and impactful infrastructure challenges in AI/ML today.Our team builds and operates software that powers key experiences for Amazon customers. We value technical excellence, collaboration, and a commitment to continuous improvement. Every engineer on the team has a voice in shaping our technical direction and the opportunity to mentor others. We are focused on building reliable, scalable systems while creating an inclusive environment where engineers at all levels can learn, grow, and do their best work. If you want to solve meaningful problems alongside a supportive and motivated group of engineers, this is the place for you.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Knowledge of Python and/or C++ programming
- 3+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- Experience debugging, profiling, and implementing best software engineering practices in large-scale systems
- Strong understanding of system performance, memory management, and parallel computing principles.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with machine learning and LLM fundamentals
- Knowledge of machine learning model architecture and inference
- Experience with performant ML kernel development eg. CUDA, Triton or FlashInfer, etc.
- Knowledge of syntax and tile-level semantics similar to Triton
- Experience with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT or similar platforms in production environments
- Experience with PyTorch, JIT compilation, and AOT tracing

title: Finance Manager, Advanced Robotics Finance
descriptionHtml:
The Advanced Robotics Finance team seeks a Finance Manager to partner with the Engineering, Procurement and Accounting teams of the Advanced Robotics organization. The organization is a vertically integrated program spanning foundational AI, hardware engineering, procurement, and manufacturing at scale, with multi-billion-dollar capital investment and ambitious commercial milestones over the next three years.

This role will own financial strategy and governance for Advanced Robotics Capital Investment, drive capital optimization, controllership and provide early warning systems for supply chain disruption risks. The work will directly impact investment decisions, ensure financial discipline across long lead equipment, hardware & raw material procurement, inventory & working capital management, and also influence building appropriate tech tools and solutions for a vertically integrated program.

This is an opportunity to shape both the fixed and working capital management from inception rather than inherit one. The role will partner with engineering, equipment design, procurement, and operations leaders to model landed costs, govern purchase commitments, and optimize supplier relationships. The insights provided will influence make-vs-buy decisions, capital allocation, and risk mitigation strategies for our rapidly scaling robotics infrastructure. from day one.
The successful candidate will be comfortable operating with limited direction, deal with ambiguity, and partner with the aforementioned leaders with an entrepreneurial approach.

Key job responsibilities
1. Own the full capital governance lifecycle across sites including appropriation requests, capital project register, and Capital Work in Process (“CWIP”) to placed-in-service asset transition governance, depreciation schedules, and accurate recording of asset disposals.
2. Own long-lead equipment planning partnerships and associated financial governance, track commitments and financial exposure on equipment orders.
3. Own lease agreements, tenant improvement allowances, and real estate financial commitments across all sites, coordinating with legal, tax, and corporate real estate on multi-jurisdiction implications across Texas, California, Massachusetts, New York, and Washington.
5. Own raw material, WIP, and finished goods inventory financial oversight including min/max inventory level modeling, freight cost forecasting, and variance reporting against BOM logistics cost assumptions; coordinate with Amazon's existing fulfillment, logistics, and supply chain infrastructure.
7. Leverage AI and automate obsolescence/excess inventory risk flagging, landed cost models across a dynamic supplier base, purchase commitment exposure, and supplier financial health monitoring.

- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field
- 5+ years of finance experience, with at least 3 years in supply chain, procurement, or operations finance.
- 3+ years of finance experience in Capital Asset management, Capital spending against plan, budget tracking and reporting.

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or CPA
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results
- 6+ years of solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) experience
- Knowledge of SQL/ETL
- Knowledge of one or multiple accounting frameworks (including US GAAP, IFRS, or local GAAP frameworks), with the ability to apply them in day-to-day financial activities

title: Sr Technical Program Manager, AWS Analytics Engineering
descriptionHtml:
AWS Analytics Engineering (AAE) is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead delivery and cross-organization coordination for the Foundational Data Technology (FDT) organization. FDT is the central org within AAE that supports AWS Product Analytics — owning the foundational datasets, data platform infrastructure, service transformations, reporting operations, and data content and stewardship that power AWS revenue reporting, usage analytics, and product intelligence.

You will own the delivery strategy across FDT's core programs — Unified Revenue, Unified Actuals, Unified Usage — and a portfolio of internal initiatives including security, compliance, infrastructure modernization, and central engineering programs. This is a cross-organizational role. You will work across AWS Sales, Finance, Product, and CP Platform organizations to drive discussions, seek alignment, and ensure FDT's data products meet the needs of stakeholders across the AWS business. Within AAE, you will partner with data engineering managers across five sub-teams to drive programs, remove blockers, and hold teams accountable to commitments.

You will represent FDT in leadership meetings, present program status and strategy to Director and VP-level audiences, and serve as the primary point of contact for cross-org partners. You will partner directly with the AAE Director and Principal Engineers to shape how the team delivers against its roadmap.

The ideal candidate brings deep understanding of data — including data modeling, pipeline architectures, and analytical workflows — and can step up to perform basic data analysis using SQL or AI-assisted tools when needed to validate assumptions, investigate discrepancies, or support deep dives. You can hold the full picture of a multi-workstream program while diving into technical details, and communicate with clarity to audiences ranging from engineers to VPs.

Key job responsibilities
• Responsible for the end-to-end project management functions of large programs including planning, risk and issue management, trade-offs and execution, anticipating bottlenecks, managing escalations, and balancing business needs versus technical constraints.
• Defining project scope, prioritization, managing sprints planning from project initiation till final launches and status reporting to stakeholders. Create, maintain and disseminate project information to stakeholders.
• Effectively cooperate with customers, technical staff and leaders, business leaders and executives to define and deliver complex features.
• Drive programs that require coordination across multiple in-org and cross-org teams — writing business cases, driving funding, and aligning roadmaps across organizational boundaries.
• Leading requirement gathering, design/technology selection initiatives, design reviews.
• Empower technical and non-technical, internal customers to drive their own analytics and reporting (self-serve reporting).
• Deep dive current-state processes, understand operational challenges, collaborate cross-functionally to brainstorm solutions, and ask the right questions to identify the right technical approach. Evaluate emerging AI technologies and guide teams through responsible adoption.
• Develop deep understanding of vast data sources and know exactly how, when, and which data to use to solve particular business problems.
• Work with Product Managers, Finance, Service Engineering Teams and Sales Teams on day-to-day basis to support their new analytics requirements.
• Manage numerous requests concurrently and strategically, prioritizing when necessary
• Partner/collaborate across teams/roles to deliver results.
• Mentor other engineers, influence positively team culture, and help grow team.


About the team

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent
- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience developing and executing/delivering product and technical roadmaps
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

title: Area Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly workforce and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Key job responsibilities
* Support, mentor, and motivate your hourly workforce
* Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
* Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
* Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
* Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
* Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
* Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
* Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience managing a team of 20+ employees
- Experience with process improvements (Lean process, Kaizen, and/or Six Sigma)
- Excellent customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills
- A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field.
- Industry experience in: retail, F&B, military, manufacturing, automotive, biotech, electronics, energy, instrumentation, machinery, defense/aerospace, medical, cosmetics, production or distribution environments.

title: オペレーションマネージャー, SSD
descriptionHtml:
※このポジションの勤務地は大阪府茨木市近郊を予定しています。

アマゾンジャパンのフルフィルメントネットワークは、アマゾンのカスタマーに毎日多くのパッケージと笑顔をお届けしています。当社は地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業を目指しており、意欲的でカスタマー志向の強いOperations Managerを募集しています。

当社の物流拠点のビジネスゴールを達成するためにチームのオペレーションを管理する責任を負います。あなたのチームは20～300 名程度のメンバーで構成されます。数十億円の予算規模の年間の運営計画を立て、その実行責任を負います。分析スキルや問題解決スキルに加え、チームとしてパフォーマンス目標を確実に達成するため、メンバーと良好な関係を構築し、チームのリーダーシップを強化するためのコーチングやメンタリングなどの人材管理スキルを発揮することやや新しいサービスの導入を進めていく改善スキル、推進力も期待されます。

私たちは毎年新しいオペレーション拠点を立ち上げ、プロフェッショナルとしての成長機会を提供しています。パートタイムのアソシエイトからDirectorまで、多様なBackgroundを持つメンバーとのCross-functionalワークを通じて、新しい視点やスキルを身に付けることができます。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。


Key job responsibilities
【キャリアパス】
Operations Managerは、大きな組織をリードしリージョンやネットワークの取り組みを実行する次のSite LeaderまたはSenior Operations Managerへと成長することが期待されます。また、Supply Chain、Transportation、およびLogisticsなどAmazon のオペレーションのあらゆるOpportunityを模索することもできます。

【具体的な業務内容】
- 物流拠点運営、ソートおよびディスパッチオペレーションのリードおよび監督
- シフト全体の安全性、品質、パフォーマンス、カスタマーサービス向上
- 組織の方針と手順に従っての監督責任
- オペレーション目標の達成、および、それを上回る成果の実現
- 物量等の予測に基づく、戦略的な計画立案、パフォーマンスの評価、問題の解決および人材配置に関するニーズへの対応
- メンバーがより生産的で、パフォーマンスが高く、多様性があり、インクルーシブになるようサポート、指導し、動機付けします。チームメンバーの個人的な成功に対するビジョンとコミットメントを持って、共感を持ってリーダーシップを発揮し、楽しく仕事をし、メンバーに楽しんでもらいましょう。
- Learning and Talent Developmentチームとのパートナーシップにより、人材の獲得、パフォーマンスとキャリア開発、育成、サクセッションプランに関する計画の立案と実行
- 年間のオペレーション計画を編成し、日次/週次の生産計画と実績確認、短期/長期の需要変動対応、3PLを含む関係者との調整を通じて、コストを管理しながら、年間のオペレーション計画を実行します。
- DEI やSustainability関連の大規模プロジェクトや、Family Day、ボランティアイベントなどの大規模イベントをリードします。
- 部署間、シフト間、およびネットワーク間でベストプラクティスが着実に共有されるように、積極的なアクションを講じます。

このポジションに求められるのは、経験に裏打ちされたプロセスの改善能力と、Amazonの成長速度に合わせ、メンバーのモチベーションを高めながらさまざまなチャレンジに対して短期間で成果を出していく能力を持つ候補者です。また、さまざまな経験、バックグラウンドを持つ多様なメンバーと協業していく柔軟性が求められます。
まだ若い組織であり、組織やビジネスとともに成長できる高い意欲とポテンシャルをもった方を求めています。


A day in the life

title: シニアエリアマネージャー, SSD
descriptionHtml:
※このポジションの勤務地は兵庫県尼崎市近郊を予定しています。

私たちのグローバルオペレーションネットワークは、日々何百万もの荷物と笑顔をAmazonのお客様にお届けしています。私たちは、シニアエリアマネージャーとして私たちのチームに加わってほしいと考え、意欲的で顧客重視の人材を探しています。この役割では、複数メンバーのチームをリードし、シフト中のチームの安全性、品質、出勤率、およびパフォーマンスを最高水準に維持するため、チームに働きかける責任があります。また、お客様の注文が適切な時間に適切な場所へ確実に配送されるよう、お客様の期待に応えることにおいても重要な役割を担います。

私たちの業務の流れには3つの主要な要素があります。
商品が保管され注文に備える「ファーストマイル」、注文品をお客様のエリアまで輸送する「ミドルマイル」、そして商品をお客様の玄関先までお届けする「ラストマイル」です。各拠点で運営方法に若干の違いはありますが、一貫して変わらないものが一つあります、それは顧客を第一に考える私たちのビジョンと献身的な姿勢です。

本ポジションはAmazonの新しいエキサイティングな物流拠点で業務を行います。可能な限り最速でお客様のご自宅に商品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。


Key job responsibilities
【具体的な業務内容】
■生産・業務計画の立案、進捗・実績・各種指標管理、人員・労務管理
想定物量を予測する部署と連携し、生産・業務計画を立案します。
配送ルートや人員配置の全体計画を立てます。
具体的には、物量に応じて必要となる人員数を算出し外部協力会社（派遣会社や業務委託会社など）との連携。
また社内システムを用いて各種計画の進捗・実績管理などを実施。現場と連携し、生産性向上を実現していきます。

■各種プロジェクト・改善活動の取りまとめ、人員育成・チームビルディング
今の生産性を維持するのではなく、改善を図って向上させるのがAmazonのシニアエリアマネージャーです。
業務改善プロジェクトなどの進行・取りまとめ役となり、最新テクノロジーの導入や工程の見直し等検討し、教育プランの策定も行います。
ミーティングはオペレーションマネージャーやエリアマネージャーと定期的に実施します。

■業務上で発生したトラブルや問題の解決
例えば、コンベアが停止した際のリカバリープランの立案・実施など。
商品が物流拠点内で滞留しないよう、トラブルに合わせて人員配置や対応方法などを検討します。


A day in the life

title: Engineering Operations Technician - Night Shift, Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO)
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection
- This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.
Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility
Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work a flexible work schedule including evenings, overnights, and weekends
- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities

Preferred qualifications

- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field
- 2+ years of data center engineering experience

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The starting pay for this position is listed below. Final starting pay will be based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Starting Day 1 of employment, Amazon offers EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, 401(k) matching. Learn more about our benefits at https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/benefits.
