title: ICT Design Engineer, DC Design Engineering
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

At AWS, we're revolutionizing the design of critical communications pathways, spaces, and cabling within our data centers. We're looking for innovative people who can continue raising the bar for our ICT design, accelerating our time to market, and who have a desire for professional growth and continuous learning.



Key job responsibilities
In this role, you’ll work with engineers and managers company-wide to develop solutions for the physical layer. Your responsibilities will include developing pathway, space, and cabling designs, along with specifications for construction and permitting. Additionally, you’ll engage with industry suppliers and manufacturers to define product requirements and explore emerging technologies.

- Ensure timely delivery of scalable fiber optic & copper plant designs and specifications.
- Review and approve of ICT pathway, cabling and equipment submittals.
- Identify and respond to risks and high-priority issues rapidly and effectively.
- Support new technology and design activities that improve infrastructure quality, reduce cost and installation time.
- Travel 20+% to review projects and coordinate with onsite personnel and contractors at AWS' Data Centers.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel

Data Center Technician position involves in-depth hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair as well as participating in an on-call rotation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. title: Power Systems Engineer TIPM, Global Energy, sustainability, and Automation
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Power Systems Engineer to support electrical reliability, safety, and regulatory programs across Amazon's North American operations network. This role will be responsible for managing the five-year arc flash study refresh program, performing technical quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) of power system studies using SKM Power*Tools, and managing the electrical Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) program across North American facilities.
This position requires a strong understanding of industrial MV and LV power distribution systems. The successful candidate will combine technical engineering expertise with program management capabilities to improve electrical system reliability, reduce operational risks, and maintain electrical safety standards across a large portfolio of operating facilities.
This role requires 50% or more travel to operational facilities across North America to perform technical assessments, investigate equipment reliability issues, validate engineering studies, and support electrical safety program implementation.


Key job responsibilities
Arc Flash Study Refresh Program

- Manage the five-year arc flash study refresh program across North American facilities, ensuring timely completion and alignment with applicable electrical safety standards - across 200+ facilities annually.
- Maintain study inventories, track refresh schedules, and prioritize facilities based on electrical system changes, risk, and program requirements.

- Coordinate with third-party engineering firms and site teams to collect and validate electrical system data.

- Review study deliverables, identify deficiencies and NEC violations, propose appropriate cost-effective resolutions, and track corrective actions through closure, including arc flash labeling, relay/breaker settings adjustment, equipment replacement, and documentation updates.

- Establish program performance metrics and reporting to track study completion, deficiencies, and overall program health.

- Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and develop corrective and preventive actions to address equipment failures and recurring reliability concerns.

- Investigate electrical equipment failures, recurring faults, protective device misoperations, and power distribution system reliability issues.

Power Systems Studies and Technical QA/QC

- Perform detailed technical QA/QC of power system studies using SKM Power*Tools, including short-circuit, protective device coordination, arc flash, and load flow analyses.

- Independently review and validate SKM models, study assumptions, equipment parameters, protective device settings, and engineering calculations.

- Identify modeling errors, inconsistencies, and technical deficiencies in studies submitted by external engineering consultants.

- Verify study results against applicable IEEE, NFPA, and other relevant engineering standards.

- Review engineering recommendations related to protective device coordination, incident energy reduction, equipment ratings, and electrical system reliability.

- Document QA/QC findings, coordinate corrections with engineering consultants, and verify resolution before accepting final study deliverables.

- Develop and maintain standardized study review checklists, technical acceptance criteria, and QA/QC processes.

Electrical Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) Program

- Manage the North American electrical LOTO program, including technical standards, implementation oversight, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement.

- Develop, maintain, and standardize electrical energy control requirements and procedures across operational facilities.

- Review electrical isolation procedures, equipment-specific energy control requirements, and single-line diagrams to ensure technically sound isolation practices.

- Partner with site maintenance teams and Workplace Health & Safety to implement program requirements, identify gaps, and drive corrective actions.

- Establish and monitor program performance metrics, audit findings, and corrective action closure.

- Provide technical guidance on electrical energy isolation, verification of absence of voltage, and safe electrical work practices.

- Coordinate periodic program reviews, procedural updates, and technical training requirements.

Electrical Reliability Engineering

- Provide electrical reliability engineering support for operating facilities, focusing on improving equipment performance, reducing unplanned downtime, and mitigating electrical system risks.

- Evaluate electrical equipment condition, maintenance practices, and failure trends to identify opportunities for reliability improvements.

- Support the development and optimization of preventive and condition-based maintenance strategies for electrical distribution equipment.

- Partner with site maintenance and operations teams to troubleshoot electrical system issues and implement sustainable engineering solutions.

- Provide emergency on-call support to facilities in North America.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or equivalent
- 5+ years’ experience performing power system studies (Short Circuit, Protective Device Coordination, Arc Flash) for medium-voltage and low-voltage industrial electrical distribution systems
- 3+ years of hands-on proficiency with SKM Power*Tools for Windows (PTW), including power system modeling, short-circuit analysis, breaker and relay protective device coordination, and arc flash analysis.
- Experience independently performing technical QA/QC of power system studies, including reviewing and validating SKM models and engineering results.
- Working knowledge of NFPA 70E, IEEE 1584-2018, applicable IEEE power system standards, and local electrical codes.
- Experience interpreting electrical single-line diagrams, protective device settings, and electrical equipment specifications.
- Experience managing multiple engineering projects or technical programs involving multiple stakeholders.
- Ability to travel 50% or more across North America, including frequent visits to operating facilities.

Preferred qualifications

- Professional Engineer (PE) license certification.
- Strong knowledge of MV relay
- Demonstrated expertise in medium-voltage (MV) protective relay settings, coordination, and commissioning, including proficiency in extracting and analyzing event reports for root-cause fault diagnosis.
- Hands-on electrical reliability engineering experience in an operational environment, with a strong understanding of industrial MV and LV power distribution systems, equipment failure mechanisms, preventive maintenance, and electrical troubleshooting
- Demonstrated experience troubleshooting electrical distribution systems, investigating equipment failures, performing root cause analysis, and developing reliability improvements in operating facilities.
- Experience developing preventive maintenance strategies, condition assessments, and electrical equipment lifecycle management programs.
- Experience managing or implementing electrical LOTO or electrical safety programs.
- Familiarity with OSHA electrical safety requirements, including 29 CFR 1910.147, and applicable Canadian regulatory requirements.
- Experience supporting electrical reliability and safety programs across multiple operational facilities.
- Strong analytical, technical writing, and stakeholder management skills.

descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:
AWS is seeking a Data Center Civil Engineer to join its East Design team.

As a Data Center Civil Engineer at AWS, you will lead Civil Engineering designs for Amazon Data Centers. You will be part of a highly creative and efficient design team comprised of Architects, Engineers, and Designers tasked with solving problems and challenging the status quo. As a subject matter expert, you will have a direct impact on the design of prototypical Data Center sites, provide technical design guidance and vendor oversight, solve large-scale implementation issues, and build a strong understanding of site design and program requirements.

Amazon’s Data Centers are industry leading examples of innovation in the areas of space utilization, energy efficiency, and cost effectiveness. We are known for our speed to market and reliability. This role sits within Americas Design Engineering team responsible for the design and operation of critical Data Center facilities located throughout North and South America. Our Design Team is on the forefront of creating and delivering the most innovative products to our customers; and are known for being a diverse and upbeat team that is changing the face of Cloud Computing.

We continue to grow and are looking for motivated team members that can support our speed to market, raise the bar, and have a desire for professional growth and continuous learning. Amazon’s work environment is unique in every aspect and offers an exceptional opportunity for the right candidate. At Amazon we highly support continued learning opportunities and focus on continued employee development.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

title: Food Safety Program Manager II, WWGS Retail Food Safety
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 3, 2026

A typical day centers on keeping the Food Safety Audits programs running smoothly and the 3P auditor relationship healthy and productive. The Program Manager II leads the Worldwide Grocery Stores retail food safety audit program, partnering with a third party audit vendor, food safety analysts, store leadership, and cross functional stakeholders to ensure compliance with FDA Food Code.

Key job responsibilities
The role requires a results-oriented, analytical, customer-service approach to manage the audit program, measure progress, and drive risk management and compliance outcomes.
•Manage the day-to-day execution of the Food Safety Audits programs, including the 3P Food Safety audit cycle — scheduling, coverage, standards alignment, and data integrity; works on one or more projects and may own a program.
•Own accountability to the 3P Food Safety Auditor’s KPI scorecard; monitor audit completion, on-time delivery, scoring consistency, and finding-closure metrics, and act to keep them on target.
•Manage the relationship with the 3P audit provider — align on audit standards and expectations, resolve data and scoring discrepancies, and hold the provider to KPI commitments.
•Analyze and trend large audit data sets from internal and external audits to identify emerging Food Safety risks, recurring violations, and improvement opportunities.
•Verify Food Safety policy and the FDA Food Code are correctly reflected in audit standards, checklists, and scoring criteria.
•Support Food Safety escalations arising from audits; track corrective and preventive actions to closure with Operations stakeholders.
•Optimize audit procedures, processes, and best practices to improve efficiency, data quality, and reporting cycle time.
•Anticipate near-term bottlenecks in the audit program; identify, track, and mitigate immediate issues and risks, escalating when appropriate.
•Write and publish audit performance and trend content for WWGS Business Reviews; convey findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders.
•Collaborate with AMZ & WFM stakeholders to align audit processes with Food Safety policy and Operations needs.
•Stay informed of FDA Food Code updates, regulatory publications, and industry audit benchmarks, and apply them to the audit program.
•Begin to mentor peers and new team members on audit standards, data analysis, and the FDA Food Code.
•Make trade-offs across time, quality, and resources to deliver reliable audit outcomes; decide when to resolve independently versus escalate.

A day in the life
Day-to-day responsibilities include:
•Data governance of internal and third-party audits for stores across the US, Canada, and UK
•Data analysis to identify process gaps and resolution
•Maintaining relevant metrics for a food safety scorecard that measures each store's food safety performance
•Reviewing and resolving clarifications
•Monitor vendor performance through a KPI scorecard
•Ownership of food safety self-audit questions and data
•Creation and publishing of monthly and ad-hoc content for food safety culture (Food Safety Empowerment Teams)

About the team
The Retail Food Safety team supports stores and company facilities with Food Safety policy, mechanisms to efficiently embed Food Safety in store processes, and a means to measure compliance. We bridge Food Safety to cross-functional stakeholders including Operations, Merchandising, Facilities, Procurement, and Leadership.

- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- 5+ years of managing food safety and quality in a large-scale retail or manufacturing environment experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Travel up to 25% of the time
- CP-FS (Certified Professional – Food Safety) certification, or a comparable Food Safety professional certification.
- Expertise in the FDA Food Code and retail food delivery/audit programs.

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization

title: Senior Delivery Consultant, Emerging Tech
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Senior Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

You bring deep solutions implementation and delivery understanding of Physical AI's building blocks (AI for automation, digital twin, robotics, edge solutions, simulation, and autonomous systems) as well as supply chain technologies. Architecting and deploying autonomous systems, robotics, simulation, digital twins, and industrial AI workloads on AWS, you'll provide secure, reliable, and scalable Physical AI infrastructure for customer innovation. You also bring a background in manufacturing, warehousing, logistics, fulfillment, and the larger supply chain landscape, helping enterprise customers plan and implement the technologies to design, operate, and transform their sourcing, production, transportation, and delivery networks. You'll work with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.


Key job responsibilities
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
1. Providing subject matter expertise on manufacturing supply chains including warehousing, logistics, fulfillment, and production-line transformation, conducting on-site assessments, identifying automation opportunities, and building customer trust through demonstrated domain knowledge
2. Owning end-to-end architecture for Physical AI solutions on AWS spanning robot or vehicle hardware, sensors, edge compute, autonomy software, simulation, cloud data and ML pipelines, and enterprise integration, and leading delivery from lab through pilot, production, and multi-site rollout
3. Building simulation, digital twin, and synthetic data pipelines (for example NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, Omniverse, OpenUSD, AWS IoT TwinMaker, SiteWise) and validating sim-to-real transfer on real hardware
4. Designing the fleet data loop, training, evaluating, and retraining perception models and robot policies (imitation and reinforcement learning, vision-language-action models) on SageMaker, and deploying and optimizing them on edge compute (for example NVIDIA Jetson) and industrial GPUs with TensorRT, with OTA, fleet rollout, and health monitoring through AWS IoT Greengrass components
5. Selecting and integrating robot platforms, LiDAR, cameras, GNSS/IMU, and force/torque sensors; calibrating; and integrating machine interfaces including CAN bus, drive-by-wire, PLC I/O, and E-stop circuits
6. Implementing ROS 2 or equivalent autonomy stacks (perception, SLAM, Nav2, sensor fusion, control, manipulation, fleet coordination) and integrating with PLC/SCADA, OPC UA, MQTT, WMS/MES, and fleet management systems
7. Conducting hazard analysis and building safety cases for machines operating near people, implementing safe-stop and speed-and-separation monitoring, and applying device identity, secure OTA, and OT/IT segmentation
8. Defining test plans and autonomy KPIs (stopping distance, localization error, intervention rate, pick success rate, cycle time), running closed-course and pilot-site trials and root cause analysis, and delivering runbooks, operator training, and handoff
9. Developing packaged offerings, delivery accelerators, reference architectures, demos, and training materials, and supporting pre-sales with AWS field teams and Physical AI Business Development teams


A day in the life
This team partners with our customers to assist in innovation within their business using AWS Emerging Technologies.

One week you are on a customer site with a laptop and a CAN sniffer, bringing up a new sensor stack on an autonomous vehicle and running closed-course brake tests. The next week you are in Isaac Sim randomizing lighting and textures to close a perception gap, pushing a retrained TensorRT engine to a hardware nodes fleet through Greengrass, and reviewing the safety case with the customer before pilot. Between engagements you turn what you learned into reference architectures the practice can reuse.

About the team
You'll join the AWS North American Professional Services (ProServe) Shared Delivery Team's Emerging Tech practice, a team focused on helping customers realize solutions with emerging and advanced technologies on AWS. We work directly with customers to solve their solution needs and you'll collaborate with cross-functional teams including specialists, solution architects, data scientists, and engineers. Our team values hands-on builders who are curious about the intersection of business and digital systems, and we're committed to creating an environment where every team member can grow, contribute, and innovate.

ABOUT AWS:
 
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
 
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. 

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

10046

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of cloud based solution (AWS or equivalent), system, network and operating system experience
- 5+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying robotics, autonomous systems, or industrial automation (for example AMR/AGV, robotic arms, autonomous vehicles, drones, humanoids, legged robots, or production-line automation systems)
- Experience with ROS 2 or equivalent robotics middleware
- Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Electrical/Computer/Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience
- Experience programming in Python and C++

Preferred qualifications

- AWS Professional level certification
- 3+ years implementing Physical AI projects such as digital twin or simulation environments, robot policy or perception model training, autonomous system deployment, ROS 2 or equivalent robotics middleware integration, or edge inference on Jetson-class hardware
- Delivery experience across two or more of: warehouse or production-line automation, AMR/AGV or robotic-arm deployment, autonomous vehicle or drone deployment, industrial digital twin or simulation, edge AI and computer vision, OT integration, or supply chain and manufacturing optimization
- Familiarity with the AWS Physical AI stack (Physical AI Toolchain on AWS, IoT Core, Greengrass v2, SiteWise, TwinMaker, SageMaker, Bedrock, Kinesis Video Streams, S3/Glue/Athena, EKS or Batch, CDK) and the NVIDIA robotics stack (Isaac Sim/Lab/ROS, Omniverse, OpenUSD, Jetson, TensorRT, CUDA)
- Experience with autonomy and sim-to-real: perception, SLAM and localization, pose estimation, GNSS/IMU fusion with RTK corrections, NAV2, MoveIt, kinematics, trajectory optimization, real-time control, sensor fusion, multi-sensor calibration, domain randomization, and transfer validation on real hardware
- Experience with hardware and industrial integration: LiDAR, cameras, GNSS/IMU, force/torque sensors, end-effectors and actuators, CAN/drive-by-wire, PLC/I/O, E-stop; and protocols such as OPC UA, Modbus, PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, MQTT with PLC/SCADA, MES, WMS, or ERP

- Experience bringing robots and edge devices online over private/public 5G, Wi‑Fi, and satellite/NTN links, including secure device-to-cloud connectivity (MQTT, VPN) and delivery of real-time correction/telemetry streams.
- Experience applying the AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI-DLC) and AI coding agents to delivery, including working in short bolts, defining units of work, and using agent-assisted integration, debugging, and reference implementations

title: Business Intelligence Engineer, EU STEP FO
descriptionHtml:
Have you ever ordered a product on Amazon and when that box-with-the-smile arrives you wonder how it got to you so fast? Wondered where it came from and how much it cost Amazon? Wondered how Amazon designs its transportation network to scale and reliably deliver hundreds of millions of package to customer’s doorsteps? If so, EU Fulfillment Optimization (EU-FO) team is for you. We are tasked with optimizing the fulfillment on customer orders so that we fulfill all orders in the most intelligent manner while ensuring Amazon customers get their orders on time.

Key job responsibilities

Deliver solutions to support our business and operations
Collect and analyze data to drive decisions and provide business insights
Design, implement and support a scalable and reliable infrastructure for Data Warehousing, BI and Analysis
Work closely with cross functional teams both in business and tech
Use analytic tools and languages, and present analytical results and insights using multiple methods, including written summaries and visualization/reporting tools such as Quicksight

You are a data detective that wants to apply their analytical skills to own and drive real world business problems that impact customers.

Key job responsibilities
• Develop analytical solutions to business problems that utilize the highest standards of analytical rigor and data integrity
• Seek to understand the business objectives relevant to your area, and align your work to those objectives and seek to deliver business value
• Proactively and continually, improve your level of knowledge about Amazon’s business and relevant data resources
• Recognize and adopt best practices in reporting and analysis: data integrity, test design, analysis, validation, and documentation
• Write high quality code to retrieve and analyze data
• Analyze and solve business problems at their root, stepping back to understand the broader context
• Design pragmatic analyses and automated metrics that add value to your business area
• Understand data resources and how, when, and what to use (and what not to use).
• Develop analyses (whether fully formed or exploratory) for the business’ sake, not for analyses’ sake

A day in the life
Inclusive Team Culture
Our team is intentional about attracting, developing, and retaining amazing talent from diverse backgrounds. Yes, we do get to build a really cool service, but we also think a big reason for that is inclusive and welcoming culture we try to cultivate every day.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We care about your career growth. Whether your goals are to explore new design concepts, take on bigger opportunities, or get to the next level, we'll help you get there. Our business is growing fast and our people will grow with it."

About the team
The EU Fulfillment Optimization team is the backbone of Amazon's European operations. We're responsible for ensuring that our complex logistics network runs smoothly, especially during our most challenging high-volume events. Our team thrives on data-driven decision making and developing technology that optimizes the flow of packages through the network. We're constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible in logistics, always with an eye on efficiency, customer satisfaction, and sustainability.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc.
- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
- Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
- Experience with SQL
- Experience in the data/BI space

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
- Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets

title: シフトアシスタント
descriptionHtml:
※このポジションの勤務地は愛知県東海市を予定しています。

私たちのグローバルオペレーションネットワークは、日々何百万もの荷物と笑顔をアマゾンのお客様にお届けしています。私たちは、シフトアシスタントとして私たちのチームに加わってほしいと考え、意欲的で顧客重視の人材を探しています。この役割では他業種・職種も含めこれまでの経験、スキルを活かし、改善点を模索しながら、より便利でお客様に満足いただける高い品質のサービスを提供できるビジネスをつくる事、安全・快適・楽しい職場環境の構築を行う、将来の組織のリーダーを目指していただける事を期待しています。また、お客様の注文が適切な時間に適切な場所へ確実に配送されるよう、お客様の期待に応えることにおいても重要な役割を担います。

私たちの業務の流れには3つの主要な要素があります。
商品が保管され注文に備える「ファーストマイル」、注文品をお客様のエリアまで輸送する「ミドルマイル」、そして商品をお客様の玄関先までお届けする「ラストマイル」です。各拠点で運営方法に若干の違いはありますが、一貫して変わらないものが一つあります、それは顧客を第一に考える私たちのビジョンと献身的な姿勢です。

本ポジションはアマゾンの新しいエキサイティングな配送拠点で業務を行います。可能な限り最速でお客様のご自宅に商
品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！


■業務内容■
具体的にはマネージャーのサポートのもと、以下の業務に責任をもち遂行いただきます。

① 安全・品質・作業効率の向上
安全安心な作業環境の維持・向上のため、日々の安全活動、品質チェックに加え、標準作業手順書の作成や多岐にわたる問題解決・改善活動を行います。

② 日々のオペレーション対応
商品を入荷、在庫として管理し、注文があった商品を出荷するという一連の流れを各工程間で連携をとりながら、業務を円滑に進める事が求められます。お客様とお約束した期日までに商品を迅速かつ正確にお届けするため、時間ごとの計画に沿ってオペレーションを実施することに責任を持ちます。

③ 新規プロジェクトの導入・セール時など、オペレーション拡大時の準備
新しいサービスやシステムの導入に備え、現場での手順変更・導入方法を検討し円滑な導入に向けて準備を行います。また、新規入職者でもAmazonの標準作業に則った手順がスムーズに身につくためのトレーニング構築やマニュアルを作成します。

④ イレギュラーへの対応
作業で発生する様々な課題の原因を追求し問題解決を行います。また、再発防止策案の検討、実施を行います。
※上記業務はマネージャーやチームのサポートのもと実施していただきます
※配送ステーション内での配送を通じて、物流の仕組みやマネジメントについて学ぶことができます
※社内公募により、マネージャーへのキャリアアップや他部署への異動機会もあります
※勤務は交代制（夜勤あり）です
※1日の流れ：以下ページをご参照ください。
先輩社員インタビュー

■福利厚生■
下記ページをご確認ください。
福利厚生 | アマゾンジャパンキャリアサイト

■教育制度■
入社後、約1週間はAmazonのリーダーとして必要な会社のカルチャーや、配送拠点の基本的な業務を一通り学ぶことができる座学の機会を提供します。各部署へ配属後は、トレーナーのもと、OJTで工程知識やツールの使用方法など基礎知識を学んでいきます。トレーニング資料も完備しており、相互に進捗を確認しながら独り立ちまでしっかりとサポートしますので、未経験者も安心してスタートができる環境です。
最先端の物流システムを学ぶことはもちろん、年齢・性別・国籍問わず様々な仲間と日々の業務を通して、次のステップとなるピープルマネージメントやビジネススキルを学ぶことができます。

■キャリアパス■
シフトアシスタントからキャリアをスタートし、チームマネージャー、統括マネージャー、そして配送拠点の拠点長となった実績も多数あります。また、Amazonでは社内公募制度があり、国内外問わず他部署や異なる職種への異動にチャレンジし、社内で多様なキャリアを築くチャンスもあります。Amazonではご自身で学び成長することを推奨し、キャリア開発できるようサポートを行っています。
キャリアアップストーリー

■会社のカルチャー■
Amazonでは全員がリーダーです。個人の裁量に任される部分が多く、社員の個々の可能性を最大限に伸ばす事を重視しています。様々なバックグラウンドを持った社員が前職で培った多様な経験やスキルを活かして職位や役割に関わらず誰もがチャレンジできる環境です。
また年次有給休暇の取得を積極的に推進しており「働く」、「プライベート」も充実できる環境です。
失敗に寛容な文化：まずは試してみることにこだわります。好奇心を持って学びます。時にはリスクを取り、計画通りいかなかったとしても、よりよい成果に繋げられることが私たちの強みだと信じています。

最後に、募集しているポジションや組織、お仕事の詳細については以下のリンクよりご確認いただけます。

・シフトアシスタントについて：プロセスアシスタント/シフトアシスタント特設サイト
・配送拠点で働くリーダーのインタビュー：インタビューをご覧ください。
・部門のご紹介：フルフィルメントセンター (FC)/デリバリーステーション（DS）
・職種：オペレーション

以下のリンクより、本ポジションに関連する部署等の詳細をご確認ください。 *アマゾンは多様性とインクルージョンのある職場づくりを目指しています。アマゾンは雇用機会均等法を遵守しています。人種、出身国、性別、性的指向、障がい、年齢、その他の属性による差別なく、平等な採用・選考の機会を提供しています。障がいをお持ちの方は、以下をご覧ください。
https://www.amazon.jobs/disability/jp

オペレーション部門のDEIの取り組み（Japanese Only）

Basic qualifications

- 社会人経験（業界は問わず）
- 業務または工程の改善経験（規模の大小は問わず）
- エクセル初級レベル（四則演算/SUM関数ができる）
- ビジネスレベルの日本語

Preferred qualifications

- ビジネスレベルのネパール語
- ピープルマネジメント経験（アルバイトでも可）
- 様々な世代とのコミュニケーション経験
- エクセル中級レベル以上（VLOOKUP、ピボット、マクロ等）
- チームワークを重視し、チームプレーのための気配りができる方
- 向上心があり、今よりも成長したいという熱意がある方
- 臨機応変に行動し、理論的に物事の判断ができる方

title: Data Center Technician, Data Center Operations (DCO)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is growing rapidly, and we are looking for Data Center Technician to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team.
Data Center Operations designs, installs and maintains the world’s largest Computing Infrastructure. Our scope of work includes systems, repairing, dealing with issues, handling and tracking parts and assisting in Data Center maintenance. Amazon Data Centers are large-scale high-density centers where you will help change the face of Technology in the region.


Key job responsibilities
As Data Centre Operations Engineer, you will be the primary point of contact for internal customers. There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:

• You will troubleshoot technical issues on advanced hardware, ranging from servers, storage and networking devices on a 24/7 basis.
• You will maintain a high level of system reliability and availability.
• You will participate in projects to enhance operational efficiencies with opportunities to share experiences and knowledge with our global network of technical experts.
• You will share knowledge and help train less technical staff on the best practices related to all service owner issues
• You will contribute towards building a great team by getting involved in the Amazon hiring process/candidate interviews


A day in the life
As a successful Data Center Operations engineer, your day-to-day work will include:
• Installation and configurations on Data center Servers and Network systems
• Installation, troubleshooting and replacement of internal and external hardware parts of Servers and Network devices
• Work within a ticket-based environment and work on systematic problem resolution
• Work on rotational shift-based schedule to maintain high system reliability
• Collaborate with internal teams and share ideas and contribute in innovative projects to improve DC work environment and overall efficiencies.
• This is a physically active role, we are always on the move onsite.


About the team
About AWS
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
- Experience with computer hardware troubleshooting and repair

Preferred qualifications

- Can work in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health & safety guidelines
- Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
- Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system
- Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
- Experience working in a data center environment (racking and stacking gear, cable management, hot/cold aisle containment)

title: Senior Solutions Architect (Polish Speaker), CEE Enterprise, FSI

You will be part of the Financial Services Enterprise team, leading technical strategy and innovation across the region. You'll be at the forefront of emerging technologies, guiding customers through their journey to adopt agentic AI workloads, autonomous systems, and intelligent automation that reshape how financial institutions operate and serve their customers.

In this role, you'll leverage the full breadth of AWS cloud technologies to design scalable, secure, and compliant architectures that accelerate digital transformation across multiple markets. You'll champion innovation by identifying opportunities to apply agentic architecture patterns, AI-SDLC methodologies, and modern application designs that deliver measurable business outcomes. Working closely with C-level executives and technical leaders across the region, you'll translate complex business challenges into agentic, cloud-native solutions that drive competitive advantage in the rapidly evolving financial services landscape.

Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and unwavering support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

title: Engineering Operations Technician – Water Engineer, Data Center Engineering Operations
descriptionHtml:

This role combines expertise in water chemistry, treatment systems, and infrastructure management to ensure the reliable operation of AWS data centers.

title: Sr Software Engineer, Amazon Now
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is building India's Quick Commerce offering — Amazon Now — delivering everyday essentials to customers in minutes. We build world-class technology that powers store launches at scale, curates hyper-local selection, and drives seamless operations across our network. We are looking for a seasoned Software Development Engineer to serve as the senior technical leader for the team, owning the architecture and engineering direction across all of our charters — with a primary focus on the Selection experience: how we curate, manage, and scale the right assortment for every customer, in every city. This is a high-impact role where your technical decisions directly fuel Amazon Now's expansion across India. You will set the technical bar for the team, drive the hardest design problems end-to-end, and multiply the impact of every engineer around you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the technical strategy and architecture for Selection — curating city-specific assortments, managing per-store catalogs, and simplifying the experience of listing and onboarding new items at scale
- Provide senior technical oversight across all of the team's charters — store launches, catalog and selection, inventory, picking, staging, and store operations — ensuring architectural coherence across them
- Architect systems that onboard new stores rapidly across cities, and that scale reliably to hundreds of stores while maintaining low operational latencies
- Lead the hardest design decisions end-to-end: evaluate trade-offs, simplify complexity, and set patterns the rest of the team builds on
- Mentor and coach engineers, raise the technical bar, and drive adoption of engineering best practices across the team
- Partner closely with product, operations, and business teams to translate ambiguous, complex business problems into durable technical solutions
- Champion operational excellence (CI/CD, monitoring, on-call), lead design reviews, and own a high quality bar for all deliverables

A day in the life
You'll review operational metrics to ensure system health across live stores, unblock engineers on their toughest technical challenges, and dive deep into system designs — weighing trade-offs and cutting complexity. You'll lead design reviews across the team's charters, mentor engineers on architecture patterns, and shape deployment plans for features rolling out across multiple cities, ensuring rollback strategies, monitoring, and alarms are in place before launch. As a senior, you'll help set technical direction and priorities, with Selection as your primary canvas.

About the team
Amazon Now builds the technology behind India's Quick Commerce experience — from the moment a store goes live, to how selection is curated for each neighborhood, to how every order is picked and staged for delivery in minutes. We work at the intersection of technology and physical retail, solving hard problems in real-time inventory, catalog and selection management, store automation, and partner enablement. Our work reaches millions of customers who count on us for everyday essentials, fast.

This role is the senior technical anchor of the team, setting architectural direction across every charter we own — with Selection as the primary focus. It's a rare scope: deep ownership of one of our most important problem spaces, combined with technical influence across the whole team.

We embrace our differences and are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have employee-led affinity groups reaching thousands of employees globally. We are dedicated to supporting new members through mentorship and knowledge sharing, and we strive to assign opportunities that help each team member develop into a well-rounded contributor.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Instandhaltungstechniker:in für unseren Standort in Lengede
descriptionHtml:
Das Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist für unseren Betrieb von fundamentaler Bedeutung – es sorgt dafür, dass unsere technischen Systeme und Anlagen laufend funktionieren. Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du für die Wartung und Instandhaltung unserer förder- und haustechnischen Anlagen sowie Produktionsanlagen zuständig. Du hilfst, die höchsten Sicherheitsstandards im Arbeitsschutz zu gewährleisten und Maschinenausfallzeiten zu verhindern. Unser technisches Team stellt eine hohe Verfügbarkeit der technischen Anlagen sicher und verbessert die Qualität unserer Geräte.

Key job responsibilities
Ausführung präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an einer breiten Vielfalt von Geräten an unseren Standorten
Durchführung von Reparaturen und Fehlerdiagnosen
Verwendung neuester Tools zur Maximierung der Geräteeffektivität
Einhaltung aller Arbeitsschutzrichtlinien und -praktiken
Unterstützung der Entwicklung und des beruflichen Fortschritts von Auszubildenden am Standort
Arbeit an Projekten zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Einführung von Best Practices an verschiedenen EU-Standorten

A day in the life


Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren tätig, um schnell auf technische Störungen reagieren zu können. Du führst eine Reihe geplanter präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an Geräten durch, um für ihren sicheren Betrieb zu sorgen. Außerdem reagierst Du als Instandhaltungstechniker:in unverzüglich auf Störungen und Ausfälle. Du untersuchst die Ursachen, findest so schnell wie möglich Lösungen und wendest sie an. Zudem machst Du Vorschläge für langfristige Verbesserungen.
In Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Kolleg:innen nimmst Du tägliche Wartungsaufgaben wahr und kommunizierst mit Dienstleistern, falls Du externe Expertise benötigst. Du arbeitest in rotierenden Schichten, damit wir rund um die Uhr unsere Standorte unterstützen – und dafür sorgen, dass Amazon weiterhin in dem Tempo liefern kann, für das wir bekannt sind.

About the team
Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) sorgt dafür, dass unsere Geräte und Ausstattung jederzeit optimal funktionieren. Wir sind ein Team von Techniker:innen und Ingenieur:innen, das aus hervorragenden Teamplayern besteht und von erfahrenen Führungskräften geleitet wird. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, die Geräte in unserem gesamten globalen Netzwerk von Fulfillment-Centern zu warten, zu reparieren und ihre Fehler zu beheben. Einige unserer Mitarbeiter:innen sind Führungskräfte, die das Team bei der Arbeit an spannender, innovativer Technologie beaufsichtigen – die es teilweise nur bei Amazon gibt.
Von der Installation automatisierter Verpackungssysteme bis hin zur Beaufsichtigung der allgemeinen Wartungsarbeiten eines Standorts sowie der Reparatur von für den Vertrieb wesentlichen Geräten wickelt unser Team einen Großteil der technischen Aufgaben bei Amazon ab. Unter anderem sorgt es auch dafür, dass Gebäude weiterhin den rechtlichen Auflagen entsprechen, damit alle sicher bleiben und unsere Standorte mit maximaler Effizienz betrieben werden. Es gibt zahlreiche Aufstiegschancen im RME-Team selbst ebenso wie im gesamten Amazon-Unternehmen.
Alle unsere Aktivitäten sind darauf ausgerichtet, die Ausfallzeiten an Amazons wichtigsten Betriebsstandorten zu reduzieren, damit Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen rechtzeitig erhalten. Oft arbeiten wir früh morgens, spät abends oder in der Nachtschicht, um Wartungsarbeiten mit den geringstmöglichen Störungen vorzunehmen. Falls wir eine bessere Möglichkeit finden, eine bestimmte Aufgabe zu erledigen, verfügen wir über die Fertigkeiten und Gelegenheiten, vollständig neue Prozesse oder bahnbrechende Technologie wie Amazon Robotics oder unseren Complex Item Sorter einzuführen.

Basic qualifications

- Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung, anerkannt durch die Industrie- und Handelskammer (IHK) oder Handwerkskammer (HWK) oder Nachweis eines erfolgreich abgeschlossen Hochschulstudium im Ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Bereich (Maschinenbau / Elektrotechnik oder artverwandt) einer deutschen Hochschule oder anerkannte ausländische Hochschulabschlüsse (BA, B. In this role you are accountable for business outcomes, not just project milestones. You will help shape what we commit to, negotiate it with customer executives, and deliver it profitably.

Most of our engagements are delivered on a fixed-price, outcome-based model. You will turn customer ambitions into measurable outcomes, clear acceptance criteria and a milestone plan that both the customer and AWS can stand behind. You will work with sales and solution architects before signature to make sure what we sell is deliverable. After signature, you will manage scope, change and commercial performance with discipline: tracking earned value, protecting margin, and negotiating trade-offs with customer executives when priorities shift. You are comfortable having difficult conversations early, and you know how to protect both the customer relationship and the commercial position.

You will lead delivery teams that use AI throughout the delivery lifecycle, from requirements and design through code generation, testing and operations, to deliver outcomes faster and at higher quality than traditional approaches. You are hands-on with AI-assisted delivery tools, and fluent enough in architecture and engineering to challenge AI-generated plans and designs, make informed trade-offs on performance, security, scalability and cost, and keep quality high as delivery speed increases. You apply AWS frameworks such as Well-Architected and the Cloud Adoption Framework, and you build automated quality gates so standards hold as delivery scales.

Our largest programs combine AWS builders with AWS Partner Network (APN) partners and sometimes customer-selected system integrators. You will orchestrate this mixed workforce to a single quality bar. That means setting clear accountability, consistent acceptance criteria and mechanisms that make standards hold by design rather than by inspection. You will also drive change management on the customer side, so the organization adopts what we build and the business value is realized.

You will build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders up to C-level, report progress in terms of business value delivered, and spot leading indicators of risk such as velocity, environment stability, partner quality and team health, acting on them before they become escalations. As you grow, you will lead larger multi-workstream programs, help shape how we price and measure outcomes, and contribute reusable assets, patterns and AI-enabled practices that make the next engagement faster than the last. You are expected to achieve and maintain relevant AWS certifications, including in AI, and to develop deep domain expertise.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud and AI initiatives. We provide a collection of offerings that help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption, and focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies and industries.


Key job responsibilities
- Owning delivery of complex, outcome-based cloud and AI programs end to end, accountable for customer business outcomes, delivery quality and commercial performance
- Working with sales and solution architects before signature to shape scope, define measurable outcomes and acceptance criteria, and confirm what we commit to is deliverable
- Negotiating scope, milestones and trade-offs with customer executives, and managing fixed-price engagements through disciplined change control, earned-value tracking and margin protection
- Managing engagement revenue and financial health: forecasting revenue against milestones, maintaining an accurate estimate at completion, driving timely milestone acceptance and billing, and identifying expansion opportunities that grow the customer relationship
- Leading delivery teams that use AI across the lifecycle (requirements, design, code generation, testing and operations), and applying enough technical depth to challenge AI-generated output and make informed trade-offs on security, performance, scalability and cost
- Orchestrating mixed teams of AWS builders, AWS Partner Network partners and customer-selected integrators to a single quality bar, with clear accountability, consistent acceptance criteria and automated quality gates
- Driving customer-side change management and adoption, so the organization realizes the value of what we build
- Reporting progress to senior stakeholders in terms of business value delivered, and acting on leading indicators of risk (velocity, environment stability, partner quality, team health) before they become escalations
- Contributing reusable assets, patterns and AI-enabled delivery practices that make each engagement faster and more repeatable than the last


About the team
Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Technik BHP
descriptionHtml:
Bezpieczeństwo i dobrostan naszych pracowników to najwyższy priorytet w Amazon. Nasi Technicy BHP odgrywają kluczową rolę w jego zapewnianiu. To stanowisko jest szansą na rozpoczęcie kariery w dziedzinie bezpieczeństwa pracy i rozwój w międzynarodowej firmie. Będziesz ściśle współpracować z naszymi ekspertami, monitorując swój obiekt, dzięki czemu każdego dnia zobaczysz, jaką różnicę robisz dla dobrostanu ludzi.

Key job responsibilities
- Przeprowadzanie ocen ryzyka i audytów.
- Monitorowanie obiektu w celu zapewnienia zgodności procesów z procedurami bezpieczeństwa Amazon.
- Tworzenie i aktualizacja raportów dotyczących wskaźników bezpieczeństwa do przeglądu przez współpracowników.
- Współpraca z kolegami z działu Operations i całej firmy przy zadaniach związanych z bezpieczeństwem oraz doradztwo w zakresie procesów.
- Wsparcie we wdrażaniu nowych środków bezpieczeństwa.

A day in the life
Będziesz pracować w jednym z naszych obiektów. Oznacza to, że będziesz mógł/mogła ściśle śledzić to, co się dzieje, a pracownicy będą mogli łatwo zadawać Ci pytania podczas swoich zmian. Ta rola polega na identyfikowaniu potencjalnych problemów, zanim się pojawią. Będziesz poświęcać dużo czasu na sprawdzanie obiektu i poznawanie sposobu, w jaki ludzie korzystają ze sprzętu. Rozumiejąc, jak działa każde zadanie i każda maszyna, będziesz w stanie znaleźć najlepszy sposób na zapewnienie bezpieczeństwa procesów.

Będziesz również jedną z osób wdrażających zmiany w zakresie bezpieczeństwa, co oznacza, że będziesz ściśle współpracować z wieloma osobami. Oprócz codziennych i tygodniowych zadań będziesz wspierać zespół Operations w doraźnych pracach związanych z bezpieczeństwem.

Bezpieczeństwo jest niezwykle ważne w Amazon, a Ty pomożesz nam gromadzić kluczowe dane, które pozwalają nam kontrolować nasze procesy i wyprzedzać wszelkie problemy. Będziesz również dzielić się tymi danymi z pracownikami w całej firmie i współpracować z innymi zespołami, aby zapewnić, że bezpieczeństwo jest zawsze na pierwszym miejscu.

Szukamy osób gotowych do pracy zmianowej (zmiana dzienna i zmiana nocna), dni pracy mogą przypadać także w weekendy. Charakter pracy na tym stanowisku pozwala na 3 dni wolne od pracy (4 dni pracy po 10 godzin dziennie).

About the team
Zespół Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) odgrywa kluczową rolę w zapewnieniu dobrostanu psychicznego i fizycznego naszych pracowników. Nasz zespół współpracuje z kierownikami, pracownikami i lokalnymi władzami we wszystkich naszych obiektach, dbając o zgodność z politykami Amazon i przepisami prawnymi oraz zapewniając bezpieczeństwo naszych środowisk pracy. Zespół oferuje różnorodne możliwości — od Techników BHP po Kierowników Programów. Niezależnie od Twojego stanowiska, będziesz przyczyniać się do rozwoju i wdrażania strategii bezpieczeństwa w całej sieci.

Basic qualifications

- Wykształcenie Technik BHP lub wyższe z zakresu BHP (zgodnie z Rozporządzeniem Rady Ministrów Dz.U.1997.109.704).
- Odpowiednie doświadczenie w wykorzystywaniu analizy danych do generowania i objaśniania wskaźników.
- Znajomość polskiej legislacji w zakresie BHP.
- Biegła znajomość języka polskiego i podstawowa znajomość angielskiego (A2), w mowie i piśmie.

Preferred qualifications

- Preferowane kwalifikacje nie są wymagane do aplikowania na stanowisko w Amazon. Jeśli posiadasz wszystkie powyższe kwalifikacje podstawowe, chętnie poznamy Twoją kandydaturę.
- Doświadczenie z metodologiami Lean, 5S lub Kaizen.
- Doświadczenie w planowaniu lub zarządzaniu inicjatywami proekologicznymi.
- Umiejętność pracy samodzielnej oraz w zespole.

title: Transportation Network Design PM, Network Design Programs
descriptionHtml:
The role can be based in Luxembourg or London.

At Amazon, we are always exploring new opportunities to shape our global business. Our Program Managers help us move forward with our best ideas and get everything in place to drive success. As you take on different projects, you’ll become an expert in our processes and see your experience evolve. Along the way, you’ll work closely with different functions across Amazon and see how working together makes us a leader in what we do.

The role will involve understanding the full transportation network connecting upstream design to downstream implementation including physical and virtual transportation processes, from our fulfillment centers on to our final mile carriers who deliver our packages to our customers. As part of the EU Network Design Programs team you will combine business process knowledge, data expertise, and influencing skills to identify and drive programs to manage change across our transportation network.

To be successful in the role, you need strong analytical skills, excellent communication skills, ability to influence across business functions and manage stakeholders’ expectations effectively. You will work in a fast-paced, deadline driven environment that requires you to be detail-oriented and comfortable in working with multiple business and technical teams.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end delivery of network design programs, from scoping through deployment and benefit measurement

- Define and manage program roadmaps aligned to the team's planning calendar, ensuring milestones land when downstream teams need them

- Govern the quality of inputs that feed network optimization models, working with data providers to ensure accuracy, timeliness, and visibility of gaps

- Translate technical model outputs into clear, actionable plans for operations and configuration teams

- Drive cross-functional alignment across operations, finance, technology, and carrier management to execute network changes

- Build and maintain mechanisms (dashboards, trackers, governance processes) that reduce reliance on manual oversight and tribal knowledge

- Identify process inefficiencies and propose structural improvements, not just incremental fixes

- Communicate program status, risks, and trade-offs to senior leadership with clarity and precision

A day in the life
No two days look the same. One morning you might be tracing why high-value network proposals were rejected and fixing the root cause before the next cycle. The next, you could be reassessing a facility constraint that just shifted and summarizing the trade-off for leadership.

Priorities change frequently. An urgent capacity issue can reprioritize your week, and you will need to judge what can wait and what cannot. The constant is that you are closing the gap between what the network should look like and what it actually looks like in production. The path there is rarely the same twice.

About the team
EU Network Design Programs is part of Amazon's Transportation Network Optimization (TNO) organization. TNO owns the full lifecycle of transportation network changes across Europe: from analytics and network modeling, through governance and validation, to deployment into Amazon's operational systems. The organization brings together network designers, analysts, engineers, and program managers working toward a shared goal.

Within TNO, our team drives the programmatic execution of optimization cycles and network transformation initiatives. We value simplicity over complexity, automation over manual effort, and outcomes over activity. Every cycle, your work moves the needle on how fast millions of customers receive their packages, and you can see it in the data the next day.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Experience in program or project management
- Experience in defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience leading process improvements
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
- Experience using AI and automation tools to streamline repetitive workflows, improve data quality, or accelerate decision-making processes

descriptionHtml:

Extraordinary Business Intelligence Engineer skills along with exceptional managerial capabilities.
Impeccable attention to detail, adept at juggling multiple projects and priorities with finesse.
A knack for thriving in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment, where adaptability is key.

descriptionHtml:

Amazon's Central Operations Finance team is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to serve as a trusted finance partner for Defect Cost Controllership (DCC), supporting operational and functional leaders across the network.

The NACF DCC finance team provides cost controllership and project return on investment alongside financial insights for end-to-end defect reduction processes and initiatives across the supply chain. This role will directly influence controllership over defect costs spanning damages, concessions, and missorts, driving measurable cost reduction across fulfillment centers. Our team translates operational KPIs into financial impact so stakeholders have the most current and reliable information to make the best possible decisions for Amazon.

Your time will be split between deep analytical work, building forecasts, cost bridges, and ROI models, and collaborative sessions with cross-functional stakeholders to align on strategy and present findings to senior leadership.

The team plays a key role in decision making and developing financial insights as part of monthly and quarterly business reviews, leading cost business reviews, and providing ad-hoc analysis on large or ambiguous deliverables. descriptionHtml:
As a member of the Global Controls Team, you will collaborate with highly motivated operators, engineers and technicians in the data center industry to maintain and optimize critical infrastructure systems. You will be responsible for troubleshooting and maintaining the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) while developing new processes and standards that drive innovation in the controls space.

AWS data centers utilize sophisticated industrial control systems to automatically operate mechanical equipment, maintaining optimal temperature and pressure conditions throughout the facilities. These systems integrate and monitor multiple critical components, including generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic and static transfer switches, air-cooled and water-cooled chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), and air economizers. Within this industrial control system infrastructure, the BMS serves as the primary control platform for all mechanical systems within the data center, while the EPMS functions as the primary monitoring platform for all electrical systems. This position offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in mission-critical environments while contributing to the reliability and efficiency of AWS's global infrastructure.

Manage small to medium-sized projects and programs.

Perform point-to-point checkouts between field devices and controllers.

Perform first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting, and maintenance of programming code and hardware associated with BMS and EPMS in data centers.

Follow change management processes to generate work requests and methods of procedures.

Participate in factory witness tests at vendor or panel builder facilities.

Actively manage service agreements including vendor labor scheduling, quality assurance, and financial invoice review.

Participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying, or moving up to 50 lbs of equipment, and utilize OSHA-standard safety equipment including limited weight-bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools, and personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety harnesses.

Perform other tasks as assigned by manager.

descriptionHtml:
The Data Center Global Controls team is looking for exceptional individuals to join our Controls organization as a Controls Technician for Service & Construction of the Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) within Amazon data centers. If you are passionate about the Customer Experience, think and act globally and have the ability to contribute to major new innovations in the area of building controls and automation this is the challenge you are looking for! The candidate will possess technical background and experience in installation, troubleshooting, operations and/or maintenance of field sensors, controllers, wiring, networking and programming associated with the industrial controls systems. The candidate may also have relevant experience operating and maintaining mission critical electrical and mechanical systems. A Controls Technician shall be responsible for participating in the installation, testing, troubleshooting and startup of equipment and controls system associated with the BMS and EPMS system deployment in the data centers. A Controls Technician is expected to actively innovate on behalf of their customers in the area of Data Center building automation.

Key job responsibilities
• Primarily work in and support multiple data centers by deploying, servicing, and upgrading BMS and EPMS systems.
• Mentor and train Facilities team members on the operation and control of BMS and EPMS systems.
• Manage small to medium-sized projects and programs.
• Perform point-to-point checkouts between field devices and controllers.
• Perform first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting, and maintenance of programming code and hardware associated with BMS and EPMS in data centers.
• Execute provisioning processes for servers, controllers, industrial PCs, and network configurations, including communication testing between third-party devices and controllers or servers.
• Install, replace, configure, and calibrate sensors.
• Read and interpret electrical schematics and control panel drawings with a basic understanding of closed-loop controls, field sensor scaling, and functions typically performed by industrial controllers.
• Supervise low-voltage electrical contractors performing wiring and installation of field devices in compliance with AWS requirements.
• Provide commissioning and systems-level testing support.
• Create red-lined drawings and documentation of systems.
• Follow change management processes to generate work requests and methods of procedures.
• Participate in factory witness tests at vendor or panel builder facilities.
• Perform root cause analysis during testing and commissioning.
• Ensure personnel on site utilize proper safety methodology.
• Perform service activities including monitoring and reviewing ticketing systems, conducting root cause analysis, and prioritizing tasks.
• Actively manage service agreements including vendor labor scheduling, quality assurance, and financial invoice review.
• Participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying, or moving up to 50 lbs of equipment, and utilize OSHA-standard safety equipment including limited weight-bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools, and personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety harnesses.
• Perform other tasks as assigned by manager


Physical Requirements:
· Walk job-sites in uneven terrain and work at heights and from ladders.
· Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch
or crawl.
· On occasions, lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more.

A day in the life
A typical day is attending morning construction/commissioning meetings, assessing and prioritization of project tasks and service tickets for the given day. Field work which requires configuring controllers, testing sensors, troubleshooting, safety site walks, and supporting general startup processes. Technician is responsible for logging their daily efforts in construction and service related AWS tools.

The mission of the Data Center Controls Engineering team is to manage the design, deployment, and service of a highly reliable electrical and mechanical control system for the life-cycle of an AWS data center.

About the team
As a member of the Global Controls Team, you will collaborate with highly motivated operators, engineers and technicians in the data center industry to maintain and optimize critical infrastructure systems. You will be responsible for troubleshooting and maintaining the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) while developing new processes and standards that drive innovation in the controls space.
AWS data centers utilize sophisticated industrial control systems to automatically operate mechanical equipment, maintaining optimal temperature and pressure conditions throughout the facilities. These systems integrate and monitor multiple critical components, including generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic and static transfer switches, air-cooled and water-cooled chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), and air economizers. Within this industrial control system infrastructure, the BMS serves as the primary control platform for all mechanical systems within the data center, while the EPMS functions as the primary monitoring platform for all electrical systems. This position offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in mission-critical environments while contributing to the reliability and efficiency of AWS's global infrastructure.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Basic understanding of Industrial controls system, knowledge of meters, devices, sensors, relays and troubleshooting utilizing standard hand tools, digital metering, or calibration/diagnostic equipment in a data center, hospitals, large commercial complex, water, power, oil & gas or similar industries
- 1+ years of experience working with low voltage controls, wiring, networking signals, electrical and mechanical systems, computers and operating systems
- Ability to work non-standard hours and differing work rotations/shifts and overtime as required.

Preferred qualifications

- High School or equivalent diploma
- International Society of Automation (ISA) Certified Controls System Technician (CCST) Level I or higher certification.
- Experiencing using common communication protocols (MQTT, BACnet, and/or MODBUS).
- 5+ years of experience in controls/automation, construction or related field in a technical environment
- Demonstrated understanding of engineering documentation, electrical and mechanical diagrams, and standard operating procedures.
- Experience in data centers or mission critical environment
- Fundamental knowledge of network design and layout as well as low voltage (copper/ fiber) cabling.
- Prior AWS/Amazon experience
- 4+ Yr. Military Service

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.
