title: Software Development Manager, Frontier Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC)
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 5, 2026

The Frontier ADC team delivers the AWS GenAI and Agentic AI service portfolio to customers in GovCloud and isolated environments. We expand Frontier AI services into new regions, automate service deployment and operations, and build solutions that meet the security, availability, and scale requirements of government customers. Our teams build and operate massively scalable distributed systems across services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Quick, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and Kiro.

We are seeking a Software Development Manager who can think big, set technical and organizational direction, and build a high-performing engineering team. This leader will simplify complex problems while ensuring our customers receive a secure, reliable, and consistent experience.

A successful Software Development Manager will lead a team responsible for building, launching, and operating Frontier AI services across GovCloud and isolated environments. They will work closely with Amazon’s largest and most demanding government customers, own the team’s technical roadmap and delivery commitments, develop engineers, and drive the resolution of complex technical and operational issues. They will partner across service teams, security, infrastructure, product, and operations to deliver solutions that address the unique requirements of these environments.

This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
The ideal candidate will:
- Be great fun to work with. Our company credo is “Work hard. Have fun. Make history.” The right candidate will enjoy building teams, creating an inclusive environment, and helping engineers do the best work of their careers.
- Build and develop high-performing teams. You have experience hiring, coaching, and developing software and systems engineers. You set clear expectations, provide direct feedback, recognize strong performance, and help engineers grow into larger roles.
- Have strong technical judgment. You have experience with Linux, networking, software development, and large-scale distributed systems. You can guide architecture and design decisions, ask the right technical questions, and lead teams through complex troubleshooting and post-incident reviews.
- Deliver through others. You translate customer and business requirements into clear priorities, establish mechanisms that make progress visible, remove blockers, and hold the team accountable for delivering secure and reliable services.
- Love solving difficult problems. You will lead teams addressing complex service-build and operational challenges in GovCloud and isolated environments. You understand systems design, operations, automation, security, and process improvement.
- Think big. You will establish a strategy for building and deploying solutions across multiple services and regions. You will create mechanisms that allow the organization to scale without scaling operational effort at the same rate.
- Raise the bar. You establish strong engineering practices, guide design and operational reviews, and create a culture that values ownership, technical rigor, and continuous improvement.

A day in the life
As a Software Development Manager in Frontier ADC, you will build and lead a team that expands AWS services into GovCloud and isolated regions while improving the resiliency and operational efficiency of our existing services. You will own the team’s strategy, roadmap, staffing, execution, and operational performance. You will use customer feedback and operational data to make decisions, manage risks, and communicate progress to senior leaders and partner organizations.

You will lead the development and operation of AWS Frontier AI services that enable customers to use generative AI and agentic capabilities in secure environments. These environments create engineering challenges involving infrastructure scale, service parity, deployment automation, security compliance, and long-term operations. The Frontier ADC team resolves operational issues, automates repetitive work, builds customer solutions, executes security campaigns such as blocked-software remediation and host patching, and delivers service-parity programs.

As a Software Development Manager, you will:
- Hire, develop, and retain a high-performing team of software and systems development engineers.
- Establish the team’s technical strategy, roadmap, goals, and delivery mechanisms.
- Own service delivery and operational performance across GovCloud and isolated environments.
- Remain technically engaged through architecture reviews, design reviews, operational investigations, and critical customer escalations.
- Partner across engineering, product, security, infrastructure, recruiting, and operations organizations.
- Build constructive dialogue, reconcile competing perspectives, and drive decisions on complex or contentious issues.
- Manage priorities, dependencies, staffing, and delivery risks across multiple concurrent initiatives.
- Establish mechanisms that improve engineering quality, operational readiness, security, and service scalability.
- Communicate strategy, status, risks, and decisions clearly to engineers, partner teams, customers, and senior leaders.
- Demonstrate Customer Obsession, Ownership, Hire and Develop the Best, Invent and Simplify, Insist on the Highest Standards, and Deliver Results.

About the team
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- 1+ years of developing large-scale, multi-tiered distributed software systems using service-oriented architecture experience
- 5+ years of Software Engineer, Software Developer, or related occupational experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams
- Current, active US Government Security Clearance of Top Secret with SCI eligibility or above

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Software Engineer - Simulation, Fauna
descriptionHtml:
Fauna uses simulation to train robots, evaluate their behavior, and develop new capabilities before deploying them in the real world. We’re looking for a Simulation Software Engineer to build the environments, tools, and systems that make this possible—from generating diverse virtual worlds to testing robot behavior and running simulation at scale.

You’ll partner with scientists, robotics engineers, and technical artists to expand what robots can experience in simulation and what our teams can build with it. Your work could span procedural scene generation, automated evaluation, interactive experiences, and remotely hosted simulation. We welcome backgrounds in robotics, real-time systems, simulation, and scalable data infrastructure.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop workflows for generating, configuring, and managing diverse scenes, assets, and scenarios.

- Extend simulation to support robot capabilities and interactions among robots, people, and dynamic environments.

- Make simulation experiments reproducible and easy to inspect, with tools for automated evaluation, debugging, and regression testing.

- Build reliable pipelines for generating, processing, and managing simulation data.

- Scale simulation through automation, workload orchestration, and remote hosting, supporting both batch workloads and interactive use.

- Partner with scientists and technical artists to improve simulation performance, usability, and fidelity to real robot behavior (sim2real).

About the team
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.

We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.

Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.

At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.

If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’d like to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
- Experience developing robotics software, simulation systems, real-time applications, or scalable data pipelines.
- 2+ years of non-internship experience designing or architecting new and existing systems, including design patterns, reliability, and scaling.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with robotics simulation frameworks or real-time 3D engines, such as Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, Unreal Engine, or Unity.
- Experience with procedural scene generation, asset management, sensor simulation, or rendering.
- Experience with distributed systems, cloud-hosted simulation, or infrastructure for model inference and evaluation at scale.
- Experience building evaluation frameworks or tools for inspecting, replaying, and testing complex system behavior.
- Familiarity with sim2real transfer, domain randomization, or evaluating robot capabilities across varied environments.
- Working knowledge of 3D math, including coordinate transforms, quaternions, and camera models.

title: Reliability Maintenance Engineering Technician, RME
descriptionHtml:
The Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team at Amazon is fundamental to our operations – they’re the ones keeping vital machinery running at all times. As an RME Technician, you’ll maintain a wide range of equipment and workspaces while upholding Health and Safety best practices.

You'll help to keep your colleagues safe and prevent machine downtime. Our RME Technicians boost the availability and quality of our equipment and work to enhance the operational environment too.

Key job responsibilities
- Proactive and preventative maintenance tasks on a wide range of site equipment
- Carry out reactive repairs and fault diagnosis in a live distribution warehouse
- Use the latest tools to maximise equipment effectiveness
- Uphold all health and safety policies and practices
- Support the development and progression of on-site apprentices
- Work on continuous improvement projects and roll out best practices across a range of EU sites

A day in the life
Our RME Technicians are based on-site, so they can respond quickly to any machinery issues. You’ll carry out a range of planned preventative maintenance to our sites’ equipment to make sure it’s working safely. As an RME Technician, you’ll also respond promptly to breakdowns, investigating, finding, and implementing solutions as quickly as possible. You’ll also make suggestions for long-term improvements.

Working alongside senior colleagues, you’ll undertake day-to-day maintenance tasks and will liaise with contractors if you need external expertise. You’ll work on a range of shifts to make sure our sites are supported around the clock – allowing Amazon to deliver at the speed we’re known for.

About the team
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering or RME team keep our equipment performing at its best. We're a technically minded team, made up of excellent team players and guided by experienced leaders. We work together to maintain, troubleshoot and repair equipment across our global network of fulfilment centres. Some of our people are leaders, who oversee the team as they work on exciting technology – some of which only exists at Amazon.

From installing automated packaging systems to overseeing the general maintenance of a site to repairing key distribution equipment, our team handles most aspects of Amazon’s technical side. This includes keeping buildings legally compliant, so everyone is safe, and our sites are operating at maximum efficiency. There are lots of opportunities for progression, both within the RME team and more widely across Amazon.

Everything we do focuses on reducing downtime in Amazon’s crucial operations sites, so customers get their orders on time. We often work during early or late hours to carry out maintenance with minimal disruption, including night shifts. If we spot a better way to do something, we have the skills and the opportunity to develop and introduce completely new processes or cutting-edge tech like Amazon Robotics and our Complex Item Sorter.

title: Cellular Systems Engineering Lead, Direct-to-Device, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon LEO is building a Low Earth Orbit satellite constellation designed to provide connectivity to customers around the world.

We are looking for an experienced cellular systems engineering lead with end-to-end experience across the radio access network (RAN), the 5G core, and commercial devices for direct-to-device (D2D) services. This role covers the complete cellular side of the service, everything except the satellite itself, and connects it into one working system.

The ideal candidate has worked on real D2D, NTN, satellite-to-cellular, or closely related systems, with deep RAN expertise, solid 5G core knowledge, and hands-on device experience. We are looking for someone who understands how RAN, core, and devices behave together end to end, can work directly with RAN, core, and chipset and device vendors, and can find and resolve issues that cross those boundaries.


The successful candidate will combine broad cellular and service knowledge with strong customer and partner skills, strong ownership, and the ability to lead in a fast-moving, international environment.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Key job responsibilities
• Own the cellular system view of the D2D service across RAN, 5G core, and devices, including requirements, interfaces, and end-to-end behavior.
• Define and review RAN system requirements for NTN operation, including scheduling, HARQ, timing advance, mobility, and access control.
• Define and review 5G core requirements and interfaces (including interworking with terrestrial networks, QoS and policy, and charging), and their interaction with the RAN.
• Own device-side system requirements and behavior, including 3GPP NTN feature support, UE requirements, mobility between terrestrial and satellite networks, and device-side connection management.
• Work directly with RAN, core, chipset, and device vendors to resolve end-to-end issues, from protocol analysis to root cause and fix.
• Support end-to-end integration and interoperability activities across RAN, core, and devices, in the lab, in RF chambers, and over the air.
• Analyze end-to-end call flows and performance (attach, registration, sessions, handover, voice, messaging, data) and translate findings into requirements and design recommendations.
• Track 3GPP NTN standards evolution and assess its impact on the RAN, core, and device roadmap.
• Act as the subject matter expert for RAN, core, and device systems, and work closely with System Architecture, Systems Engineering, Integration and Test, and Telco Service Development.
• Work effectively across geographically distributed, international and multicultural engineering and partner organizations.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in a related field
- 8+ years of professional experience in cellular systems, including at least 3 years in the Direct-to-Device (D2D) ecosystem, NTN, or direct satellite-to-cellular connectivity.
- Deep experience with 4G or 5G RAN systems, protocols, and procedures (L1 to L3).
- Solid working knowledge of the 5G core architecture and interfaces, including interworking with terrestrial networks
- Experience with commercial devices or chipsets, including device logs and analytics tools, in support of cellular or D2D services.
- Working knowledge of 3GPP NTN standards
- Experience resolving end-to-end issues with RAN, core, and device vendors.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with satellite-based RAN architectures for NTN.
- Experience with voice over NR (VoNR/IMS), messaging, and emergency services.
- Experience with device interoperability testing and certification programs.
- Strong communication skills with demonstrated ability to work effectively across engineering teams, vendors, partners, and leadership organizations.

title: Supply Chain Product Manager – EE
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we design, build, and operate the global infrastructure that powers the cloud. Our team manages one of the most complex supply chains in the world to support large-scale data center hardware deployments.

We are seeking a Supply Chain Product Manager to ensure critical semiconductor components are ready to support new hardware launches. This role focuses on aligning component readiness with product timelines, identifying and mitigating supply risks, and enabling scalable, resilient component selection.

Key job responsibilities
1. Product Roadmap Alignment
Partner with hardware engineering teams to ensure component readiness aligns with product development timelines. Track component level readiness across development phases (prototype to production) and identify gaps early. Drive alignment on mitigation plans to support successful product launches at scale.

2. Early Design Influence
Engage with engineering teams early in the concept or design phase for component selection decisions. Provide input on supply resilience, scalability, and qualification timelines. Help ensure designs are optimized for multi-sourcing and long-term supply continuity.

3. BOM Risk Assessment & Mitigation (NPI to MP) including New, Unique, Difficult and Different (NUDD)
Analyze bill of materials (BOM) to identify supply risks, including single/sole sourcing, supplier capacity constraints, manufacturing and technology dependencies, and lifecycle and end-of-life exposure. Work cross-functionally to drive mitigation plans and track progress to closure.

4. Alternative Sourcing
Owner of identifying high risk components, driving multiple source selection from cradle to grave in NUDD process. Partner with engineering and quality teams to enable early qualification of alternate components. Ensure alternative solutions are ready ahead of key development milestones. Resolve issues impacting product readiness.

5. Risk Visibility & Reporting
Develop clear visibility into component-level risks and mitigation status. Communicate updates on key risks and escalation items to stakeholders.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of working with Core Cloud Technology Services, including, but not limited to Compute, Edge, Hybrid, Security, and/or Networking experience

title: Network Development Manager, Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) Networking
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 5, 2026

Amazon's network is a key differentiator for AWS, enabling the global operation of thousands of applications across hundreds of thousands of servers worldwide. Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) extends that platform to the U.S. Government's most sensitive workloads, delivering AWS inside air-gapped, classified regions where the bar for reliability, security, and operational rigor is at its highest.

We are looking for a Network Development Manager to hire, manage, and develop a team of Network Development Engineers responsible for the end-to-end operational health of the ADC network. You will own capacity management and forecast planning, implementation, automation, change control, process management, and continuous improvement across the classified partitions. You will represent networking to service teams, infrastructure partners, and government stakeholders, ensuring we meet their needs for innovation, delivery, and safe operations in an environment where the margin for error is small and much of the tooling and telemetry commercial teams rely on has to be built.

At Amazon, we ask our technical leaders to be strong engineers who dive deep and help their engineers make sound decisions and deliver quality solutions. You will maintain a solid technical understanding of routing, switching, optical transport, and network automation, and ensure the right expertise exists on the team. You will also be a thoughtful people manager who mentors your engineers and builds an environment of mutual trust and respect, which matters even more in ADC where teams are smaller, more isolated, and carry a heavier operational load per person. descriptionHtml:
We are hiring Principal and Senior Principal Engineers to join AWS Infrastructure Services.

Infrastructure Services operates like a startup that ships at hyperscale. We own the full stack — from demand forecasting algorithms and supply chain planning systems to fleet security and network architecture — and every system we build goes live supporting production infrastructure serving millions of customers. There's no handoff to another team. You see it through.

As a Principal or Senior Principal Engineer here, you'll set the technical direction for the intelligent systems layer that powers AWS's data centers. • Mentor and guide engineers while solving complex technical challenges hands-on

• Balance technical expertise with strong analytical skills to make informed architectural decisions


About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We specialize in the systems that keep the cloud running. Our software platforms, automation engines, security infrastructure, and network architecture orchestrate billions of dollars in infrastructure assets — managing everything from rack planning and power utilization to supply chain fulfillment and fleet lifecycle security. When AWS scales to meet demand that didn't exist yesterday, it's because our systems made it possible. Every architectural decision we make reverberates across millions of workloads and customers worldwide.

National Security Solutions Architects are regarded as technical “thought leaders” within the Intelligence Community who evangelize emerging technologies on a conceptual level and on a practical, architectural level. Our SAs have played a critical role in the widespread adoption and advancement of cloud computing capabilities within the Intelligence Community. SAs think outside of the box to deliver results to our customers and provide solutions that are cost-effective, time-saving, and secure. As a National Security SA, you’ll solve problems at both the business and technical levels. You'll work backwards from our customers’ requirements and envision new mechanisms and strategies we can leverage that would enable agencies to operate more efficiently and better execute on their goals. Then, you'll figure out how to make the puzzle pieces fit together from the technical side and deliver the offering to the customer at scale. Frequently, you will be responsible for mission-critical solutions with life-saving implications.

Sometimes, the best way to innovate around a customer pain point is to create a new product altogether. This position offers you the unique opportunity to drive the AWS service roadmap to support our customers’ requirements within the complex technical constraints of the cleared environment.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for technologists who align with our Leadership Principles and possess a unique balance of technical depth and strong interpersonal skills. You will partner with customers, AWS Sales, and several other AWS teams to craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address Intelligence Community customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with Sales, you will drive revenue growth across a broad set of customers. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mindshare and broad use of AWS within the Intelligence Community. The ideal candidate is be self-motivated, with a proven track record in software/technology sales or consulting. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.

We are looking for someone who is passionate about the following:
- Be great fun to work with at AWS. We have a credo of “Work hard. Have fun. Make history." In this role, you will love what you do and instinctively know how to make work fun. You will be dynamic, creative, and willing to take on any challenge and make a big impact.
- Enjoy working with Intelligence Community customers. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a diverse and challenging set of Intelligence Community customers.
- Have a strong understanding of large-scale computing solutions. The ideal candidate will have past experience working as a systems or support engineer and pre-sales experience. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep-dive education and design exercises to create world-class solutions built on AWS.

This position can have periods of up to 25% travel.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
- In partnership with the sales team, formulate and execute a sales strategy to exceed revenue objectives through the adoption of AWS
- As a key member of the business development and sales team, ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform
- Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
- Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS
- Capture and share best-practice knowledge among the AWS solutions architect community
- Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers and other reusable content
- Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates
- Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
- Bachelor's degree, or CASP+ (CompTIA Advanced Security Practitioner) or CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional) or Cloud+ or CSSLP (Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional)
- 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience

Preferred qualifications

title: Gestionnaire de programme technique, Infrastructure — AWS/AWS Technical Program Manager, Infrastructure, CAN
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Data Services Canada, Inc. a un poste à combler immédiatement pour un gestionnaire de programme technique (Technical Program Manager, TPM) chargé de soutenir l'expansion de l'infrastructure de livraison de capacité au Canada. AWS Infrastructure Services assure la conception, la planification, la livraison et l'exploitation de l'ensemble de l'infrastructure mondiale et des centres de données d'AWS. Autrement dit, nous sommes ceux qui font fonctionner l'infonuagique en fournissant les serveurs, le stockage, le réseautage, l'alimentation électrique et l'équipement de refroidissement qui garantissent à nos clients un accès continu à l'innovation sur laquelle ils comptent. Nous nous attaquons aux problèmes les plus complexes, avec des milliers de variables qui influent sur la chaîne d'approvisionnement de l'infrastructure — et nous sommes à la recherche de personnes talentueuses qui souhaitent y contribuer. Vous vous joindrez à une équipe régionale diversifiée de 15 à 20 autres TPM, principalement situés dans le Nord-Ouest du Pacifique, travaillant dans des régions de tailles variées à travers les Amériques, au sein d'une organisation plus vaste comprenant des ingénieurs logiciels, matériels et réseau, des spécialistes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, des experts en sécurité, des gestionnaires des opérations et d'autres rôles essentiels. Vous évoluerez dans une culture inclusive qui accueille les idées audacieuses et vous donne les moyens de les mener à terme. Vous travaillerez avec un haut degré d'autonomie, tout en partageant les leçons apprises et en favorisant la cohérence dans l'ensemble de la région. Le TPM agira à titre de responsable unique (single-threaded owner) de la livraison de capacité dans les grappes de centres de données qui lui sont attribuées, en coordonnant des équipes interfonctionnelles de la conception jusqu'au déploiement. La gestion de l'échéancier et des parties prenantes englobera des équipes disparates, notamment la planification, la conception, les finances, l'immobilier, l'énergie, la construction, la mise en service, les contrôles et autres. L'objectif principal de ce rôle est de collaborer à l'échelle de l'organisation afin de garantir que la livraison de capacité répond aux besoins de l'entreprise, voire les dépasse, tout en communiquant et en atténuant les risques. La personne idéale sera une communicatrice exceptionnellement solide, tant à l'écrit qu'à l'oral, et possédera au moins 3 ans d'expérience en gestion tactique de projets d'initiatives hautement techniques, ainsi qu'en gestion stratégique de programmes. Une expérience de la gestion de déploiements d'infrastructure de centres de données constitue un atout. Un baccalauréat ou une expérience technique additionnelle est exigé. Les candidats possédant une formation en architecture/conception, en génie mécanique/électrique, en génie logiciel/matériel, en infrastructure/exploitation de centres de données et/ou en construction, qui ont fait la transition vers une discipline de gestion de programme, bénéficieront d'un avantage certain. La personne candidate doit être à l'aise de gérer des équipes de livraison de projet à distance et posséder la capacité d'animer des séances techniques de type « whiteboard » pour résoudre les problèmes de mise en œuvre des projets et éliminer les obstacles à leur réussite. Il est essentiel de savoir mettre sur pied des équipes interfonctionnelles, d'établir un climat de confiance avec diverses parties prenantes réparties sur plusieurs fuseaux horaires, de gérer des budgets d'immobilisations, d'éliminer les activités sans valeur ajoutée, de concevoir des solutions, de lever les obstacles et de trouver des moyens créatifs d'accélérer la livraison des projets. Le TPM maîtrisera parfaitement une variété d'outils, de méthodologies et de techniques de gestion de projet pour toutes les phases du cycle de vie du projet, et fera preuve d'une compétence démontrée dans les disciplines fondamentales de la gestion de projet, notamment la gestion de la portée, de l'échéancier, du budget, des ressources, de la qualité et des risques, ainsi que la production de rapports et l'élaboration et le suivi des indicateurs. Les autres exigences comprennent la maîtrise de MS Office, MS Project et MS SharePoint. Une expérience de Tableau, Smartsheets, SQL et de l'intégration de systèmes constitue un atout. Ce poste exige des déplacements à hauteur de 25 % (voyages nationaux et internationaux vers les grappes de centres de données d'AWS). Si vous répondez à ces qualifications, débordez de passion et aimez les défis liés au déploiement de projets hautement techniques et innovants à très grande échelle, cet emploi est pour vous!

Amazon Data Services Canada, Inc. has an immediate opening for a Technical Program Manager (TPM) supporting capacity delivery infrastructure expansion in Canada. AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure and data centers. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running by providing servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the infrastructure supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help. You'll join a diverse regional team of 15-20 other TPMs, mostly located in the Pacific Northwest, working in various sized regions across the Americas, within a broader organization including software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. You'll operate with a high degree of autonomy while sharing lessons learned and driving consistency across the region. The TPM will serve as the single-threaded owner for capacity delivery in assigned data center clusters, coordinating cross-functional teams from inception through deployment. Schedule and stakeholder management will include disparate teams including planning, design, finance, real estate, energy, construction, commissioning, controls, and others. The primary objective of this role is to work across the organization to ensure capacity delivery meets or exceeds business needs, while communicating and mitigating risks. The ideal candidate will be an exceptionally strong communicator, both written and verbally, and possess 3+ years of experience in tactical project management of highly technical initiatives, as well as strategic program management. Experience in managing data center infrastructure deployments is a plus. A Bachelor's Degree or additional technical experience is required. Candidates possessing a background in architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering, data center infrastructure/operations, and/or construction, who have transitioned to a program management discipline will have a distinct advantage. Candidate must be comfortable managing remote project delivery teams, and possess the ability to facilitate technical whiteboard sessions to troubleshoot project implementation issues, and remove barriers to project success. Being able to stand up cross-functional teams, establish trust with a variety of stakeholders across multiple time zones, manage capital budgets, eliminate non-value-add activity, design solutions, remove blockers, and find creative ways to accelerate project delivery is a must. The TPM will be fully competent in a variety of project management tools, methodologies and techniques for all phases of the project lifecycle and exhibit demonstrated proficiency in core project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality and risk management, reporting and metric development/tracking. Other requirements include proficiency with MS Office, MS Project and MS SharePoint. Experience with Tableau, Smartsheets, SQL and systems integration a plus. This position requires 25% Travel (Domestic and International trips to AWS Data Center Clusters). If you meet these qualifications, exude passion, and enjoy the challenges of deploying highly technical and innovative projects at massive scale, this job is for you!

Key job responsibilities
• Assumer la responsabilité globale de l'échéancier, de la portée et de la gestion des risques des programmes de livraison de capacité d'infrastructure dans les grappes de centres de données attribuées, en prenant des décisions nettes et en levant les obstacles afin de maintenir les projets sur la bonne voie.
• Coordonner des équipes interfonctionnelles — notamment la planification, la conception, la construction, la mise en service et les contrôles — afin de livrer des constructions d'infrastructure qui peuvent nécessiter une modification des gabarits définis pour atteindre les objectifs du programme.
• Communiquer clairement et de façon concise l'état d'avancement, les risques et les compromis du programme aux parties prenantes de tous les niveaux, en veillant à ce que les bonnes personnes participent à la conversation et que les décisions soient bien éclairées.
• Repérer et atténuer tôt les risques de livraison en analysant les interdépendances entre les systèmes en amont et en aval, et faire remonter l'information de manière appropriée lorsque les constructions proposées sont trop complexes ou présentent un risque élevé.
• Favoriser l'amélioration continue en appliquant des méthodologies d'amélioration des processus, en définissant des indicateurs de réussite et en intégrant des pratiques d'excellence opérationnelle aux plans de programme.

• Own the overall schedule, scope, and risk management for infrastructure capacity delivery programs across assigned data center clusters, driving crisp decisions and clearing blockers to keep projects on track.
• Coordinate cross-functional teams — including planning, design, construction, commissioning, and controls — to deliver infrastructure builds that may require modification from defined templates to meet program goals.
• Communicate program status, risks, and trade-offs clearly and concisely to stakeholders at all levels, ensuring the right people are part of the conversation and that decisions are well-informed.
• Identify and mitigate delivery risks early by analyzing interdependencies across upstream and downstream systems, escalating appropriately when proposed builds are too complex or carry elevated risk.
• Drive continuous improvement by applying process improvement methodologies, defining success metrics, and incorporating operational excellence practices into program plans.

A day in the life
Vous commencez votre matinée en passant en revue les tableaux de bord de livraison de capacité et en triant les problèmes survenus durant la nuit et signalés par les équipes partenaires. En milieu de matinée, vous dirigez une réunion debout (stand-up) interfonctionnelle avec les responsables de la conception, de la construction et de la mise en service afin de vous aligner sur les jalons et de régler les points en suspens. Après le dîner, vous pourriez animer une séance technique de type « whiteboard » pour résoudre un défi de mise en œuvre, puis passer à la mise à jour de votre registre des risques et à la préparation d'un compte rendu de situation pour la direction. Tout au long de la journée, vous échangez avec des parties prenantes réparties sur différents fuseaux horaires, en conciliant la résolution tactique de problèmes et la planification stratégique afin de faire progresser vos programmes.

You start your morning reviewing capacity delivery dashboards and triaging any overnight issues flagged by partner teams. By mid-morning you are leading a cross-functional stand-up with design, construction, and commissioning leads to align on milestones and resolve open items. After lunch you might facilitate a technical whiteboard session to troubleshoot an implementation challenge, then shift to updating your risk register and preparing a status narrative for leadership. Throughout the day you connect with stakeholders across time zones, balancing tactical problem-solving with strategic planning to keep your programs moving forward.

About the team
Notre équipe fait partie d'AWS Infrastructure Services, l'organisation responsable de la conception, de la planification, de la livraison et de l'exploitation de l'ensemble de l'infrastructure mondiale d'AWS. Nous faisons fonctionner l'infonuagique en veillant à ce que les serveurs, le stockage, le réseautage, l'alimentation électrique et l'équipement de refroidissement soient en place afin que les clients aient un accès continu aux services dont ils dépendent. Avec des milliers de variables qui influent sur la chaîne d'approvisionnement de l'infrastructure, nous nous attaquons à certains des problèmes de logistique et d'ingénierie les plus complexes chez Amazon. Vous vous joindrez à une équipe régionale inclusive de gestionnaires de programme travaillant à travers les Amériques, soutenue par des ingénieurs matériels et réseau, des spécialistes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, des experts en sécurité et des gestionnaires des opérations. Nous valorisons les idées audacieuses et vous donnons l'autonomie nécessaire pour les mener à terme, tout en partageant les leçons apprises dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Vous vous joindrez à une équipe diversifiée d'ingénieurs logiciels, matériels et réseau, de spécialistes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, d'experts en sécurité, de gestionnaires des opérations et d'autres rôles essentiels. Vous collaborerez avec des personnes de partout chez AWS pour nous aider à offrir les normes les plus élevées en matière de sûreté et de sécurité, tout en fournissant une capacité pratiquement illimitée au coût le plus bas possible pour nos clients. descriptionHtml:
The AWS Professional Services (ProServe) Telco, Media & Entertainment, Gaming and Sports (TMEGS) Delivery Practice is seeking a Sr. Engagement Manager (EM) to own the delivery of complex, outcome-based cloud and AI programs for our customers. In this role you are accountable for business outcomes, not just project milestones. You will help shape what we commit to, negotiate it with customer executives, and deliver it profitably.

Most of our engagements are delivered on a fixed-price, outcome-based model. You will turn customer ambitions into measurable outcomes, clear acceptance criteria and a milestone plan that both the customer and AWS can stand behind. You will work with sales and solution architects before signature to make sure what we sell is deliverable. After signature, you will manage scope, change and commercial performance with discipline: tracking earned value, protecting margin, and negotiating trade-offs with customer executives when priorities shift. You are comfortable having difficult conversations early, and you know how to protect both the customer relationship and the commercial position.

You will lead delivery teams that use AI throughout the delivery lifecycle, from requirements and design through code generation, testing and operations, to deliver outcomes faster and at higher quality than traditional approaches. You are hands-on with AI-assisted delivery tools, and fluent enough in architecture and engineering to challenge AI-generated plans and designs, make informed trade-offs on performance, security, scalability and cost, and keep quality high as delivery speed increases. You apply AWS frameworks such as Well-Architected and the Cloud Adoption Framework, and you build automated quality gates so standards hold as delivery scales.

Our largest programs combine AWS builders with AWS Partner Network (APN) partners and sometimes customer-selected system integrators. You will orchestrate this mixed workforce to a single quality bar. title: Sr. HR Business Partner , SSD-FC
descriptionHtml:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People eXperience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. The Senior HR Business Partner (Sr. HRBP) is a key strategic partner on the SSD-FC PXT team, bringing expertise in leadership development, employee experience, culture, and change management. This role balances tactical excellence with strategic insight, leveraging both technology and human judgment to align local leadership, centralized support, and systems in delivering high-quality employee experiences.

The Sr. HRBP contributes to excellence in PXT service delivery through leadership and strategic insight. They support team development and process optimization while upholding high standards and risk management practices. Leveraging data and experience, they inform business decisions and help implement scalable solutions. Their influence extends across the organization, collaborating with leaders to advance key initiatives and deliver solutions that balance immediate needs with long-term objectives.

You will be expected to work onsite at an Amazon facility.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and develop a diverse team of HR professionals, coaching them to elevate beyond tactical execution to become strategic partners who proactively identify and mitigate organizational risks while delivering exceptional service.

- Drive a culture of proactive risk identification and mitigation by establishing early warning systems, leveraging data insights, and building strong partnerships across functions. Guide your team in developing sound judgment to spot emerging people-related risks before they impact the business.

- Shape the strategic vision for employee experience and organizational health. Challenge status quo thinking and drive innovation in HR practices while ensuring sustainable execution. Enable your team to move beyond immediate problem-solving to address systemic issues and opportunities.

- Partner with business leadership to develop and execute integrated talent strategies that address both current needs and future capability requirements. Coach leaders on effective talent development while building a strong succession pipeline within your own HR organization. Anticipate future talent needs and evolving workforce dynamics to future-proof both operations and HR.

- Lead your team in effective use of analytics and AI tools to uncover hidden patterns, predict emerging risks, and drive data-informed decision making. Translate complex insights into compelling narratives that influence senior stakeholders and drive organizational change.

- Set clear goals for culture transformation with business leaders. Design and implement comprehensive strategies to systematically strengthen organizational health, talent capabilities, and leadership effectiveness. Champion initiatives that measurably enhance diversity, equity and inclusion.

- Drive strategic adoption of HR technology to enable both efficiency and excellence in service delivery. Guide your team to leverage automation while preserving high-touch support for sensitive employee matters requiring human judgment and empathy.

A day in the life
A typical day involves balancing strategic insight with tactical execution. You'll provide expertise in employee relations, coach leaders through performance and development matters, and drive HR functional excellence. Operating with autonomy, you'll partner with leaders at multiple levels to develop forward-looking strategies focused on employee experience and operational objectives.

Through data analytics and AI-enabled tools, you'll identify trends and opportunities while maintaining the human connections essential for building trust. You'll support critical HR processes such as investigations and talent management while leveraging technology to enhance service delivery and decision-making, knowing when automation creates efficiency and when personal interaction remains crucial.

Success in this role comes from effectively enabling strong people leadership, influencing at scale, and addressing root causes of systemic issues. Through a combination of data-driven insights and strategic partnerships, you'll help create and maintain a workplace culture where employees feel valued, supported, and empowered to perform at their best.

In tandem with its Rapid and Rural Logistics business parallels, these locations strive to serve over 80% of Prime customer demands across North America. – And with people at the heart of it all, our commitment to provide HR functional excellence continues and grows.

Known as People, Experience and Technology (PXT) , our HR team members are present onsite to help drive tactical leadership direction, while providing top-notch internal customer support. PXT teams are flexible, thoughtful, socially responsible, and are always planning for the future.

- Experience supporting or leading employee-focused processes including onboarding, benefits, investigations, training or talent management

- Knowledge of employment law, employee relations, and HR compliance requirements
- Experience resolving sensitive employee relations issues
- Experience partnering with, coaching, and guiding senior leaders as a strategic HR business partner

title: Data Center Infrastructure Delivery Manager
descriptionHtml:
Transform the backbone of digital infrastructure by leading a dynamic team that builds and maintains the critical networks powering global technology. In this role, you'll drive operational excellence, optimize data center deployment strategies, and create seamless connectivity solutions that support Amazon's massive technological ecosystem.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the clouds running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States)

Key job responsibilities
The ideal candidate will possess a technology background that enables them to understand the complexities of the sophisticated network architecture of Amazon data centers. To be a qualified candidate for this role you must have experience operating in large-scale data center or a background in telecom networks and display a demonstrated ability to think broadly and strategically, as this is needed to align the future of Infrastructure Delivery with the larger objectives of the business.
You will be responsible for managing a group of technicians who are installing and building server rack capacity for our customers. You must be passionate about Customer Experience, think and act globally and want to contribute to innovations in Data Center Infrastructure.

Managing and developing teams of technicians and engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring the highest levels of performance.

Delivering capacity to existing Data Centers

Helping build and bring online new Data Centers

Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve

Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors

Liaising with internal teams & management groups

Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers

Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes

Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc.



This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
This role requires managers to conduct daily in person safety inspections, meetings, and operational tasks across Northern Virginia data center locations. Attendance in person at weekly regional manager staff meetings at AWS corporate locations (Herndon, VA) may be required.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering or operations experience
- 2+ years of team management experience
- 2+ years of networking (such as DNS, DHCP, SSL, OSI Model, and TCP/IP) experience

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in an IT-related field (e.g., Computer Science, Network Engineering), or experience in professional or military IT-related roles
- Work a flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

title: Senior Product Manager Tech - Business Process Architecture, Amazon LEO
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we've designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager Tech – Business Process Architecture to serve as the single-threaded owner of Amazon Leo's enterprise process architecture. Acting as a strategic orchestrator, you will define how Leo's manufacturing, supply chain, quality, and operational processes move from their current "as-is" state to a deliberately designed, governed, and measurable "to-be" state. You will own the enterprise process methodology toolbox and apply the right method to each problem rather than forcing a single framework, using process mining, simulation, and data-driven discovery to replace opinion with objective insight.

This role spans the full enterprise process-architecture competency set. On the transformational side, you will build the business case and vision, communicate it, and lead the organizational change required to make process transformation stick. On the operational side, you will discover formal and informal processes, model and analyze them, design improved target states, and establish the governance model, process policies, and performance management that link process inputs and outputs to business outcomes. On the technical side, you will translate target processes into solution architecture, applying agile and model-driven delivery and designing for usability — realizing business goals through a clear understanding of the business, information, and technical architectures.

You will be the connective tissue across Leo's enterprise application landscape, with a deep focus on ERP (SAP S/4HANA) and PLM (Teamcenter) and their integration with the broader estate — MES, supply chain planning, and quality systems. You will define integration and data-flow patterns, protect master-data integrity across the digital thread, and ensure that process designs are feasible, adoptable, and durable before resources are committed.

Key job responsibilities
- Build the business case and vision for process transformation, articulating alignment with business strategy and demonstrating value through operations and process metrics for ROI and system investment.
- Author OP1/OP2 narratives.
- Apply project management principles to drive transformation, balancing constraints against desired outcomes.
- Communicate transformation goals, benefits, and successes to gain stakeholder support, and apply change management to overcome resistance to process change.
- Lead business process discovery to identify formal and informal processes and understand the "as-is" state.
- Model, analyze, and design processes — visually depicting them to assess impact and design improved "to-be" states.
- Partner with manufacturing, supply chain, quality, finance, IT, and engineering leadership to elicit requirements, build consensus, and resolve competing priorities.
- Own process performance management, linking process inputs and outputs to business performance to identify improvement areas.
- Deliver solution architecture and design across ERP (SAP S/4HANA), PLM (Teamcenter), and the broader enterprise estate — realizing business goals through business, information, and technical architectures.
- Use agile and model-driven development to rapidly deliver process improvements.
- Apply process optimization and simulation to test the impact of changes before implementation.
- Analyze user interactions with processes to improve usability.

title: Head of Business Affairs, Japan, Amazon MGM Studios Business Affairs
descriptionHtml:
Amazon MGM Studios is seeking a senior Business Affairs leader to drive deal-making for original film and television content in Japan — one of the world's most dynamic entertainment markets. This is an opportunity to shape the future of Japanese storytelling for a global audience on Prime Video.

As the development and production arm of Amazon, Amazon MGM Studios produces original content for Prime Video customers worldwide. In this role, you will be a leader on the business affairs team for all scripted and unscripted deals in Japan, reporting to the Head of International Business Affairs. You will bring significant experience negotiating original content development (e.g., original scripts, book options, underlying rights, overalls) and production matters (e.g., actor, writer, director, producer, and production company agreements). A comprehensive working knowledge of international film and television industry business models, development, and production methodologies is essential.

The ideal candidate understands what is market and what isn't, and can develop creative solutions to challenges that arise when blending traditional studio work with a global streaming service.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead all business affairs activities for Amazon MGM Studios Japan across scripted and unscripted original content
- Negotiate development deals including original scripts, book options, underlying rights, overall deals, and first-look arrangements
- Structure and negotiate production agreements with actors, writers, directors, producers, and production companies
- Manage, mentor, and develop a team of business affairs professionals, ensuring operational excellence and professional growth
- Advise senior creative and production executives on deal structures, risk assessment, and market-competitive terms under time-sensitive conditions
- Partner with Legal, Finance, Creative and Production to ensure deals align with corporate parameters and business objectives
- Monitor and advise on evolving market trends, competitive deal terms, and industry practices in the Japanese entertainment landscape
- Collaborate with the international Business Affairs team to ensure consistency and share best practices across territories
- Manage a varied, high-volume workload efficiently while maintaining composure in high-pressure situations

A day in the life
Your week might begin reviewing term sheets for an upcoming original series, followed by a negotiation session with a major Japanese production company. By midday, you're advising a creative executive on deal structure options for a new film project, then jumping on a call with the international Business Affairs team to align on global deal standards. Between meetings, you're coaching a team member through their first complex talent negotiation. No two days look the same — but every day involves creative problem-solving, strategic thinking, and close collaboration across Amazon MGM Studios.

About the team
The Amazon MGM Studios Japan Business Affairs team is part of the broader International Business Affairs organization. We work at the intersection of creative ambition and business strategy, partnering with development, production, legal, and finance teams to bring original Japanese content to Prime Video's global audience. Our team values collaboration, intellectual curiosity, and a passion for entertainment.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of entertainment industry deal negotiation experience
- Experience in negotiating complex agreements with an understanding of legal terminology and reasoning
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience managing a team

Preferred qualifications

- J.D., MBA, or equivalent advanced degree
- Experience in content negotiation, acquisition or business development
- Experience in a studio, production company, streamer or television network

title: エリアマネージャー
descriptionHtml:
※このポジションの勤務地は東京都町田市を予定しています。

私たちのグローバルオペレーションネットワークは、日々何百万もの荷物と笑顔をアマゾンのお客様にお届けしています。私たちは、エリアマネージャーとして私たちのチームに加わってほしいと考え、意欲的で顧客重視の人材を探しています。この役割では、複数メンバーのチームをリードし、シフト中のチームの安全性、品質、出勤率、およびパフォーマンスを最高水準に維持するため、チームに働きかける責任があります。また、お客様の注文が適切な時間に適切な場所へ確実にお届けされるよう、お客様の期待に応えることにおいても重要な役割を担います。

私たちの業務の流れには3つの主要な要素があります。
商品が保管され注文に備える「ファーストマイル」、注文品をお客様のエリアまで輸送する「ミドルマイル」、そして商品をお客様の玄関先までお届けする「ラストマイル」です。各拠点で運営方法に若干の違いはありますが、一貫して変わらないものが一つあります、それは顧客を第一に考える私たちのビジョンと献身的な姿勢です。

本ポジションはAmazonの新しいエキサイティングな物流拠点で業務を行います。可能な限り最速でお客様のご自宅に商品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！


Key job responsibilities
■業務内容■
「エリアマネージャー」には、他業種・職種も含めこれまでの経験、スキルを活かし、改善点を模索しながら、「People First」の考え方で、各種プロジェクトをリードし、またピープルマネージメントを行っていただきます。また、「エリアマネージャー」は拠点の全ての工程を担当し、上司の示す部署全体の方針や安全・品質・生産性の年間目標に沿って、担当工程における改善を積み重ね、日々の計画、進捗、実績管理に責任をもち活動いただきます。

具体的な業務は以下の通りです。

主な責任と職務内容：
① チームメンバーの育成とサポート
現場の最前線にいるマネージャーとしてチームメンバーと積極的に関わり、メンバーからの意見に基づく職場改善によりエンゲージメントを高めます。また、数名から数十名のチームのマネージャーとして、業務上の知識・スキル、アマゾンカルチャー等の指導を行うことはもちろん、部下の悩みに傾聴し、問題の解決に向けて自ら動きます。さらに、部下の勤怠や労働時間等の把握、管理を適切に行います。

② 担当プロセスの安全・品質・作業効率の向上
マネージャーはそれぞれ特定のプロセスを担当し、そのプロセスの安全・品質・作業効率の向上をリードします。日々の安全活動、品質チェックに加え、作業環境の改善、トレーニングの進捗管理など多岐にわたる改善活動が該当します。問題を特定し、対策を立案し、チームメンバーを巻き込みながら実行に移し、結果を出していくことが求められます。

③ 日々のオペレーション対応
物流拠点のすべての工程を管理し、商品の管理からお客様へお届けするまでの一連の流れの中で計画を立案し管理していただきます。日々のオペレーションにおいてお客様にお約束した納期を確実に守るため、物量の上振れや下振れ、急な労働力不足、システムトラブル等の変動要素に際し、適切に判断して対応していくことが求められます。

④ プロジェクトリーダーとして改善を推進
Amazonでは日々改善が推進されています。エリアマネージャーは通常業務と並行して、安全上のリスクや生産性を改善するプロジェクトのリーダーとして拠点内の年次/月次プロジェクト活動を推進します。これらのプロジェクトにおいては関連部署との協業等も含まれます。



A day in the life
■働き方■
・シフト勤務（勤務は、夜勤を含む交代制のシフト勤務になります。）

■キャリアパス■
エリアマネージャーからキャリアをスタートし、オペレーション統括マネージャー、そして物流拠点の拠点長となった実績も多数あります。また、Amazonでは社内公募制度があり、国内外問わず他部署や異なる職種への異動にチャレンジし、社内で多様なキャリアを築くチャンスもあります。Amazonではご自身で学び成長することを推奨し、キャリア開発できるようサポートを行っています。

title: Sr. Digital Supply Chain Associate, PV Publishing Ops
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an Image Associate to join our team, specializing in image correction, editing, retouching, and quality assurance. The ideal candidate will have the ability to deliver clean, web-ready image assets based on existing style guides and brand guidelines in a fast-paced production environment.
This position requires strong image editing skills, color correction expertise, acute attention to detail, and an understanding of digital image optimization for web, mobile, and big-screen platforms. The ability to manage multiple projects and handle high-volume image queues is essential.
The candidate will have a comprehensive understanding of image correction processes and software - specifically Adobe Creative Suite (with a focus on Photoshop) along with experience in digital production workflows. A keen eye for visual quality and consistency, and excellent communication skills are a must. An online portfolio demonstrating image editing and correction work is required.

Key job responsibilities
• Perform image correction, retouching, color grading, exposure adjustment, and cropping to meet brand standards.
• Edit and enhance key art, promotional graphics, and product imagery for digital platforms.
• Optimize digital images for web, mobile, and big-screen display ensuring proper resolution, file format, and compression.
• Ensure all image deliverables adhere to product/project guidelines and brand style guides.
• Follow and apply graphic templates, style guides, and image specifications consistently.
• Manage high-volume image queues and fulfill multiple project requests while meeting tight deadlines.
• Conduct quality checks on all image assets to ensure visual consistency and accuracy across deliverables.
• Demonstrate a command of image editing methods, tools, communication, and presentation skills.

About the team
Prime Video is changing the way people watch movies and TV shows. From one service, we deliver versatility in numerous ways to watch hundreds of thousands of titles on the web, mobile devices, and hundreds of Internet-connected TVs, Blu-ray players, and set-top boxes.
Our mission is to be the premier destination for entertainment, offering customers an unmatched viewing experience across every screen and device.

Basic qualifications

- 1 to 3+ years of work experience in image editing, photo retouching, or graphic production in a creative agency or production environment.
- Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, Photography, Visual Arts, or equivalent professional experience.
- Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, with a strong focus on Adobe Photoshop.

title: プログラムコーディネーター, Network Planning & Speed, JP Easy Ship
descriptionHtml:
JP Easy Shipは、出品者さまの商品をAmazonの配送ネットワークに乗せ、お客様へ早く確実にお届けする急成長中のビジネスです。ファーストマイル・ミドルマイル・ラストマイルを一つのエンドツーエンドのネットワークとしてつなぎ、世界最高水準のお客様体験の実現を目指しています。

本ポジションでは、JP Easy Shipのネットワーク管理とスピード改善を支えるプログラムコーディネーターを募集しています。チームが定めたネットワーク戦略・設計方針のもとで、プロジェクトの運営サポートと調整業務を中心に担っていただきます。具体的には、担当プロジェクトの進捗管理、タスク・スケジュールのトラッキング、関係者との連絡調整、データ集計・レポート作成、ドキュメント整備などを通じて、プロジェクトが円滑に進むよう支援します。

活躍していただける方の要件として、以下を想定しています。

・明確に定義された手順や指示にもとづき、担当タスクを正確かつ期限どおりに遂行できる方
・進捗や課題を適時に報告し、必要に応じてマネージャーやプロジェクト担当者にエスカレーションできる方
・社内の関係部門と日常的に連絡を取り、会議調整や情報共有を丁寧に行える方
・スケジュール・タスク・資料を整理し、プロジェクト運営を体系的にサポートできる方（プロジェクトマネジメントの基礎知識〔PMBOK、アジャイルなど〕があれば尚可）
・データの集計やレポート作成に抵抗がなく、正確さと丁寧さをもって業務に取り組める方
・物流・ネットワーク領域が未経験でも、新しい分野に意欲的に取り組み、学ぶ姿勢をお持ちの方

JP Easy Ship is a fast-growing business that puts sellers' products onto Amazon's delivery network to reach customers quickly and reliably. By bringing first mile, middle mile, and last mile together into a single end-to-end network, we aim to deliver a world-class customer experience.

We are looking for a Program Coordinator to support JP Easy Ship's network and speed improvements. Working within the network and speed strategy and design direction set by the team, you will focus on project support and coordination — tracking progress of assigned projects, managing tasks and schedules, coordinating with stakeholders, compiling data and reports, and maintaining documentation to keep projects running smoothly.

We are looking for someone who can:

-Carry out assigned tasks accurately and on time, following clearly defined procedures and direction
-Report progress and issues in a timely manner, escalating to the manager or project owners as needed
-Communicate day to day with internal stakeholders, arranging meetings and sharing information carefully
-Support project operations in a structured way by organizing schedules, tasks, and materials (a basic understanding of project management practices such as PMBOK or Agile is a plus)
-Work comfortably with data compilation and reporting, with care for accuracy and attention to detail
-Be eager to take on and learn a new field — prior experience in logistics or network operations is not required

Amazonでは、最新のAIツール、生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。AIツールは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazonでは学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

At Amazon, you’ll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You’ll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

Key job responsibilities
1. プロジェクト運営のサポート： 定義された目標と設計方針のもとで担当プロジェクトの進捗を管理し、マイルストーン・タスク・スケジュールをトラッキングする。週次で進捗と課題をマネージャー・プロジェクト担当者に報告する。

2. 関係者との連絡・調整： 社内の関係部門と日常的に連絡を取り、会議の設定、アジェンダやアクションアイテムの整理、情報共有を行う。課題やリスクを検知した場合は速やかにエスカレーションする。

3.データ集計とレポート作成： 配送スピードや輸送能力に関するデータを集計し、定期レポートやダッシュボードを更新・整備する。実装前後の指標を正確にまとめ、チームの意思決定を支援する。

4.ドキュメント整備： 課題・進捗・決定事項を簡潔に文書化し、SOP（標準手順書）やチェックリスト、議事録を作成・更新する。チームの情報を整理し、参照しやすい状態に保つ。

5.標準化・運用改善の支援： 繰り返し発生する作業を整理し、マネージャー・プロジェクト担当者の指示のもとで、テンプレートやチェックリストの整備など運用改善をサポートする。

1. Support project operations: track progress of assigned projects against defined goals and design direction, and keep milestones, tasks, and schedules up to date. Report progress and issues to the manager and project owners weekly.

2. Coordinate and communicate: work day to day with internal stakeholders, set up meetings, organize agendas and action items, and share information. Promptly escalate issues or risks as they arise.

3. Compile data and report: gather data on delivery speed and transport capacity, and update and maintain regular reports and dashboards. Accurately summarize before/after metrics to support the team's decision-making.

4. Maintain documentation: concisely document issues, progress, and decisions, and create and update SOPs, checklists, and meeting notes so team information stays organized and easy to reference.

5. Support standardization and process improvement: organize recurring tasks and, under the direction of the manager and project owners, help improve operations by maintaining templates and checklists.

A day in the life
本ポジションでは、JP Easy Shipのネットワークプランニングチームの一員として活動していただきます。日次では、配送スピードや輸送能力のデータを集計してモニタリング資料を更新し、関係部門との連絡・調整を行います。週次では、担当プロジェクトの進捗やリスクを整理してチームに報告し、シニアプログラムマネージャーやプログラムマネージャーと優先順位を確認します。月次以降のサイクルでは、実装した改善の効果を測定・レポートし、繰り返し発生した課題を標準手順（SOP）やダッシュボードの改善に反映する作業を支援します。

In this role, you will be part of JP Easy Ship's Network Planning team. Daily, you will compile data on delivery speed and transportation capacity to update monitoring materials, and communicate and coordinate with stakeholder teams. Weekly, you will organize and report project progress and risks to the team, and review priorities with the Senior Program Manager and program managers. On a monthly and longer cycle, you will help measure and report the impact of implemented improvements, and support reflecting recurring issues into SOPs and dashboards.

About the team

This role sits within JP Easy Ship's Network Planning team, which owns end-to-end network design and capacity control connecting first mile to last mile, balancing delivery speed with cost efficiency across a fast-growing business.
