title: Program Manager, Central Operations Standardization and Cost Out (COSC) team
descriptionHtml:
Central Operations (Ops) JP is looking for an experienced Program Manager with a strong record of achieving results, to own and execute the Program Standardization, Tech Intake, Tool Inventory, and OP1/2 & XBR strategy for the Central Operations Standardization and Cost Out (COSC) team. The COSC team is dedicated to driving operational excellence across Central Operations by establishing robust mechanisms, delivering data-driven insights, and accelerating high-impact programs.

You will own the mechanisms that govern how CO plans, executes, and pays for its programs — from the one-stop program intake and standardization process, to tech request centralization, tool inventory management, and OP1/2 & XBR review cadences. You will solve this by redesigning the program management tooling, elevating update quality from task-level to project-level, and establishing CO as a formal chain in the ACES catalyst review process.

You will work cross-functionally and across geographies with stakeholders at senior levels to understand, implement, and improve program governance and tech intake mechanisms. This role offers the opportunity to partner closely with multiple functions and teams including program management, ACES, delivery station operations, last mile tech, planning, routing, network optimization, and more in Amazon Logistics (AMZL). Such exposure and collaboration with a variety of teams allow opportunities for further career growth within Amazon and beyond.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

Key job responsibilities
- Own and continuously improve the CO one-stop program intake and standardization mechanism: redesign the ASANA-based intake to manage programs at project level under portfolios, ensuring it serves as the single source of truth for all CO program reviews
- Introduce mechanisms (dashboards, newsletters) to measure program update frequency and quality, driving accountability for who-does-what-by-when documentation, entitlement inclusion, and one-pager completion
- Establish CO as a formal chain in the ACES catalyst request review process, implementing internal governance for correct request assignment and clear POC mechanisms
- Centralize and single-thread all tech requests from CO to external tech teams: eliminate duplicate asks, improve request quality, provide advisory on the right tech team, and track OP1/2-level requests to ensure clear ATL/BTL outcomes
- Build and maintain the tool inventory management system for CO's ~200 scrappy tools: document what they are, why they exist, upstream/downstream impact, and create a tracking system to ensure safe usage while seeking opportunities to eliminate or migrate
- Lead OP1/2 planning and XBR review mechanisms: introduce a yearly calendar of operation routines and planning seasons to balance team bandwidth between daily operations and strategic planning
- Scale services, tools, and processes that will enable network growth in volume, complexity, and geographic expansion while maintaining the highest bar for the customer experience

A day in the life
You lead the weekly program intake grooming session, reviewing new proposals with function owners and making approve/not-approve decisions based on standardized criteria. You coordinate with the ACES catalyst team to implement CO's chain in the review process, ensuring requests are correctly routed and no CO-impacting changes slip through without proper review. You deep-dive into the tool inventory, investigating a scrappy routing tool that broke due to an upstream UI change, and documenting the upstream/downstream dependencies to prevent recurrence. You challenge the status quo by proposing a consolidated tech request dashboard that gives tech partners a single, prioritized view of CO's needs. You plan the OP1 timeline, balancing the team's operational firefighting with the need for forward-looking strategic planning. You will continuously find new problems to solve and be required to partner with teams across Japan and the globe to deliver for our customers.

About the team
About Central Ops JP team:
The Central Ops JP team is a back office team remotely supporting AMZL, SSD, AMXL, and Quick Commerce operations across Japan. Our four pillars are standardization, optimization, centralization, and innovation. We offer a variety of services such as route plan, scheduling, volume adjustment, on-road management, system configuration, and risk mitigation. We remove the gemba's burden so they can focus on what matters most under the roof for station associates and on the road for our drivers. We are a diverse and inclusive team offering great opportunities for career growth.

About COSC team:
The Standardization and Cost Out (COSC) team exists to drive operational excellence across Central Operations by establishing robust mechanisms, delivering data-driven insights, and accelerating high-impact programs. COSC operates across three pillars — Metrics & KPI, Cost Out, and Program Standardization & Tech — serving as the backbone that ensures CO's 50+ program managers perform with a high bar, CO's impact is measured and registered in financial reports, and CO's operations are guided by clear, controllable metrics connected to AMZL goals.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of communicating with and presenting to executive and senior audiences experience
- 3+ years of developing program strategies and plans, diving execution, and influencing senior stakeholders experience
- 3+ years of managing stakeholders in cross-functional project experience
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- 3+ years of change management experience
- Bachelor's degree

Preferred qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese

title: EasyShip プログラムサポートスペシャリスト, Easy Ship, AMZL
descriptionHtml:
[English followed by Japanese]

役割概要

プログラムマネジメント（PM）チームの日常的な業務運営、事務管理、レポーティング、データ分析、およびデータ管理活動をサポートし、細部に注意を払い、主体的に行動できるプログラムサポートスペシャリストを募集しています。本ポジションは、PMが戦略的なプログラム推進に集中できるよう、チームの業務およびデータ基盤を管理する重要な役割です。

主な職務内容
レポーティング＆データサポート
PMチーム向けの週次/月次ビジネスレポートおよびダッシュボードの作成、維持、配信
複数のソースからデータを収集、クリーニング、整理を行い、プログラムのトラッキングおよびレビューをサポート
プログラムのマイルストーン、成果物、アクションアイテムに関するトラッカー（Excel、Quip、社内ツール等）の構築および維持管理の支援
PMの要望に応じた臨時データ抽出およびサマリーの作成

データ分析
プログラムおよび業務データにおけるトレンド、パターン、異常値を特定するための初級～中級レベルのデータ分析の実施
ビジネスレビュー（WBR、MBR、QBR）に向けたデータに基づくインサイトの準備においてPMを支援
ピボットテーブル、チャート、ビジュアルサマリーを作成し、生データを実用的なインサイトに変換
データの不整合に対する根本原因分析を実施し、PMに問題を先回りして指摘・エスカレーションする
定期レビューサイクル向けの標準化された分析テンプレートの構築および維持管理
複数のソースからデータを収集・統合し、構造化された形式で調査結果を提示することで、ディープダイブ分析を支援

データ管理
チームレベルのトラッカー、データベース、共有リポジトリにおけるデータの正確性・整合性の維持に一貫して責任を持つ
チームファイル全体にわたるデータ入力基準、命名規則、バージョン管理プロトコルの策定および徹底
重複、欠損、不整合を特定するための定期的なデータ監査の実施
共有データフォルダ、Wiki、ナレッジリポジトリのアクセス権限管理および整理
PMの指示に基づくデータ移行、統合、およびアーカイブ作業の支援
主要プログラムメトリクスおよび業務データの信頼できる唯一の情報源（Single Source of Truth / SSOT）の維持管理

title: PCIe System Integration Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs designs the custom silicon and systems at the heart of AWS (Amazon Web Services). Here you'll move like a startup, build at the scale of the world's largest cloud, and push the limits of what hardware can do.

Annapurna Labs, as part of Amazon, is looking for PCIe System Integration Engineer.

As PCIe System Integration Engineer, you will integrate our new PCIe products, ensure the design works well and drive complex system debugs involving HW, FW and SW components. You will work on an amazingly wide scale and will also provide leadership by driving the teams around you to raise the bar and deliver higher quality products on behalf of Amazon customers.
This is a fast-paced, intellectually challenging position, and you will work with thought leaders in multiple areas of technology. You will set high standards for yourself and everyone you work with, and will be constantly looking for ways to improve the performance, quality, costs, and reliability of AWS products and services.
We are changing the industry, and we want individuals who are ready for this challenge and want to reach beyond what is possible today.

Key job responsibilities
- Approve future products micro-architecture related to the interface you own
- Define new products Validation strategy and lead the execution
- Support ongoing integrations of new products
- Monitor and raise the operational excellence related to the interface you own. 
- Lead triage, debug and root cause analysis of systems in AWS data centers 
- Analyze customers` mode of work / requirements and provide resolutions accordingly
- Cooperate with multiple AWS teams to improve quality and reliability of products operation in the fleet
- Provide Annapurna Labs’ ASIC design, SW development, QA and architecture teams information and requirements from customers’ fleet operation perspectives and represent the customer voice

About the team
Our SPIV team owns the performance and reliability of PCIe and Ethernet across every AWS server. We work end-to-end across the full product lifecycle, including:
• Pre-silicon IP vendor engagement
• post-silicon bring-up and interface optimization
• SerDes, firmware, and system-level debug
• Interface manufacturing test integration
• Fleet health monitoring and customer performance
• Interoperability with third-party components - retimer, switch, active cable, and optics
In partnership with chip design, Server design and Cloud health teams, you will validate new server platform generations; root-cause failures across hardware, firmware, and software boundaries and drive quality improvements that protect millions of customer workloads.
If you are a systems, hardware, or software engineer who thrives at the intersection of silicon, firmware, and server infrastructure — and wants your work to improve reliability across a global fleet — apply now.

Basic qualifications

- B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or in related field.
- 5+ years of HW Design Experience or in Functional or Electrical Integration/ Validation/ Debug
- 2+ years’ experience working with systems and experience with their SW, FW and HW components

Preferred qualifications

- High-speed interfaces knowledge and debug capabilities.
- Knowledge on PCIe
- Large scale data analysis
- Experience with server design and computer systems architecture.
- Experience with operating systems, boot loaders, networking, and remote debugging.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Operations Lead
descriptionHtml:
Der operative Geschäftsbereich ist das Herz von Amazon. Ein effektiv ablaufender Betrieb trägt dazu bei, dass Artikel bearbeitet und rechtzeitig an unsere Kund:innen versendet werden. Als Operations Lead erlebst Du, wie alle unterschiedlichen Teile des Betriebs funktionieren und trägst zu einem reibungslosen Ablauf bei.
Du fungierst als erste:r Ansprechpartner:in für Teammitglieder während ihrer Schicht und hilfst ihnen beim Befolgen der Prozesse, die Deine Manager:innen eingeführt haben. Du sammelst praktische Erfahrung und benutzt analytische Systeme, die zum Erfolg unseres Unternehmens beitragen.

Key job responsibilities
- Messung und Überwachung von Arbeitsflüssen, Verfolgen der Leistung am Standort und Bereitstellung wichtiger Schichtinformationen an die Schicht-/Bereichsleiter:innen im Betrieb, um für schichtübergreifende Operational Excellence zu sorgen
- Unterstützung und Schulung von Mitarbeitenden, damit diese großartige Leistungen erbringen können, und Beaufsichtigung ihrer täglichen Aufgaben
- Unterstützung des/der Schicht-/Bereichsleiter:in bei Projekten zur Prozessverbesserung, Förderung eines sicheren Arbeitsumfelds und Erhöhung des Mitarbeiterengagements
- Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Abteilungen, um Lösungen für häufige Probleme zu finden oder Bedürfnisse in wichtigen Leistungsbereichen zu erfüllen
- Nutzung von Datenanalysen, um Möglichkeiten zur Optimierung von Sicherheit, Qualität und Produktivität zu finden

A day in the life
Als Operations Lead arbeitest Du an einem unserer Betriebsstandorte. Du unterstützt Deine:n Schicht-/Bereichsleiter:in bei der Durchführung des Schichtplans. Du hilft bei der Vorbereitung von Schichtbesprechungen mit Deinem Team und überwachst Verfahren und Abläufe. Damit stellst du sicher, dass Sicherheitsregeln, Qualitätssicherungsprozesse und die Prioritäten für den Tag befolgt werden.
Probleme, die Du bemerkst, eskalierst Du an Deine:n Manager:in. Gelegentlich agierst Du auch selbst als Schichtleiter:in und bietest Deinen Mitarbeitenden die notwendige Anleitung, um ihre Aufgaben zu erledigen. Bei Bedarf unterstützt Du Deine:n Schicht-/Bereichsleiter:in bei der Schichtplanung und sorgst dafür, dass zu Stoßzeiten genügend Teammitglieder eingeteilt sind.

About the team
Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) ist für schwere oder sperrige Artikel wie Möbel und große Haushaltsgeräte zuständig. Unser Team verantwortet den gesamten Service von der Beschaffung über die Lieferung bis hin zu Produktrücksendungen. Die erweiterte Kundenbetreuung unterscheidet diesen Service von den anderen. Neben der Lieferung von Sperrgut erledigen wir auch das Auspacken, Montieren und Installieren der Neuware und kümmern uns auf Wunsch um den Abtransport der Altgeräte. Unser Fokus liegt auf Sicherheit, Produktivität und Innovation. Wir sorgen dafür, dass Kund:innen sperrige Artikel einfacher und bequemer kaufen und erhalten können.
Wir haben ehrgeizige Pläne, darunter den Ausbau unseres Netzwerks spezieller Logistik- und Verteilzentren im gesamten Vereinigten Königreich und in Europa. Unsere Kolleg:innen an den Logistikstandorten arbeiten gelegentlich auch in der Nachtschicht. Die meisten unserer Teammitglieder arbeiten jedoch tagsüber. Unser Team umfasst Mitarbeitende aus den Bereichen Betriebswirtschaft, Lieferkette, Supply Chain, Business Intelligence und Programmmanagement. Wir alle spielen eine entscheidende Rolle dabei, diesen Teil unseres Unternehmens weiterzuentwickeln.

Basic qualifications

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon is seeking a collaborative electrical maintenance professional for our Amazon Web Services Team.
This engineering operations technician position serves as the on-site maintenance technician and operator for an AWS data centre.
The Data Centre Engineering Operations Technician (EOT) is responsible for operating and maintaining all electrical, mechanical, emergency generator, and fire/life safety equipment within the data centre. The EOT serves as a technical resource to support Amazon within its data centres. Data centre equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. EOT’s are also tasked with driving innovation while reducing operational costs in the facilities.

EOT’s are Amazon’s front line responders for hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operation. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchboards/switch-gears, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, pumps, motors, VFD’s, and building automation systems. This role will require shift work.

Responsibilities:
- Operate and maintain mechanical and electrical equipment
- Troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal SLAs
- Perform limited maintenance tasks to include: filter changes, HVAC PMs, rack power installs, rack PDU, and rack ATS replacements
- Provide support to Data Centre Operations technicians
- Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures
- Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to while performing work
- Take daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment through routine rounds/log taking (temperatures, voltages, currents, etc.)
- Utilise internal CMMS to manage building workflows and spare part inventory
- Supervise contractors who perform servicing or preventive maintenance
- Respond to off hour emergency calls per on call rotation for any one of the region’s sites
- Fully comply with all physical security procedures and policies

title: シフトアシスタント
descriptionHtml:
※このポジションの勤務地は東京都葛飾区を予定しています。

私たちのグローバルオペレーションネットワークは、日々何百万もの荷物と笑顔をアマゾンのお客様にお届けしています。私たちは、シフトアシスタントとして私たちのチームに加わってほしいと考え、意欲的で顧客重視の人材を探しています。この役割では他業種・職種も含めこれまでの経験、スキルを活かし、改善点を模索しながら、より便利でお客様に満足いただける高い品質のサービスを提供できるビジネスをつくる事、安全・快適・楽しい職場環境の構築を行う、将来の組織のリーダーを目指していただける事を期待しています。また、お客様の注文が適切な時間に適切な場所へ確実に配送されるよう、お客様の期待に応えることにおいても重要な役割を担います。

私たちの業務の流れには3つの主要な要素があります。
商品が保管され注文に備える「ファーストマイル」、注文品をお客様のエリアまで輸送する「ミドルマイル」、そして商品をお客様の玄関先までお届けする「ラストマイル」です。各拠点で運営方法に若干の違いはありますが、一貫して変わらないものが一つあります、それは顧客を第一に考える私たちのビジョンと献身的な姿勢です。

本ポジションはアマゾンの新しいエキサイティングな配送拠点で業務を行います。可能な限り最速でお客様のご自宅に商
品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！


■業務内容■
具体的にはマネージャーのサポートのもと、以下の業務に責任をもち遂行いただきます。

① 安全・品質・作業効率の向上
安全安心な作業環境の維持・向上のため、日々の安全活動、品質チェックに加え、標準作業手順書の作成や多岐にわたる問題解決・改善活動を行います。

② 日々のオペレーション対応
商品を入荷、在庫として管理し、注文があった商品を出荷するという一連の流れを各工程間で連携をとりながら、業務を円滑に進める事が求められます。お客様とお約束した期日までに商品を迅速かつ正確にお届けするため、時間ごとの計画に沿ってオペレーションを実施することに責任を持ちます。

③ 新規プロジェクトの導入・セール時など、オペレーション拡大時の準備
新しいサービスやシステムの導入に備え、現場での手順変更・導入方法を検討し円滑な導入に向けて準備を行います。また、新規入職者でもAmazonの標準作業に則った手順がスムーズに身につくためのトレーニング構築やマニュアルを作成します。

④ イレギュラーへの対応
作業で発生する様々な課題の原因を追求し問題解決を行います。また、再発防止策案の検討、実施を行います。
※上記業務はマネージャーやチームのサポートのもと実施していただきます
※配送ステーション内での配送を通じて、物流の仕組みやマネジメントについて学ぶことができます
※社内公募により、マネージャーへのキャリアアップや他部署への異動機会もあります
※勤務は交代制（夜勤あり）です
※1日の流れ：以下ページをご参照ください。
先輩社員インタビュー

■福利厚生■
下記ページをご確認ください。
福利厚生 | アマゾンジャパンキャリアサイト

■教育制度■
入社後、約1週間はAmazonのリーダーとして必要な会社のカルチャーや、配送拠点の基本的な業務を一通り学ぶことができる座学の機会を提供します。各部署へ配属後は、トレーナーのもと、OJTで工程知識やツールの使用方法など基礎知識を学んでいきます。トレーニング資料も完備しており、相互に進捗を確認しながら独り立ちまでしっかりとサポートしますので、未経験者も安心してスタートができる環境です。
最先端の物流システムを学ぶことはもちろん、年齢・性別・国籍問わず様々な仲間と日々の業務を通して、次のステップとなるピープルマネージメントやビジネススキルを学ぶことができます。

■キャリアパス■
シフトアシスタントからキャリアをスタートし、チームマネージャー、統括マネージャー、そして配送拠点の拠点長となった実績も多数あります。また、Amazonでは社内公募制度があり、国内外問わず他部署や異なる職種への異動にチャレンジし、社内で多様なキャリアを築くチャンスもあります。Amazonではご自身で学び成長することを推奨し、キャリア開発できるようサポートを行っています。
キャリアアップストーリー

■会社のカルチャー■
Amazonでは全員がリーダーです。個人の裁量に任される部分が多く、社員の個々の可能性を最大限に伸ばす事を重視しています。様々なバックグラウンドを持った社員が前職で培った多様な経験やスキルを活かして職位や役割に関わらず誰もがチャレンジできる環境です。
また年次有給休暇の取得を積極的に推進しており「働く」、「プライベート」も充実できる環境です。
失敗に寛容な文化：まずは試してみることにこだわります。好奇心を持って学びます。時にはリスクを取り、計画通りいかなかったとしても、よりよい成果に繋げられることが私たちの強みだと信じています。

・職種：オペレーション

title: Senior Progaram Manager, Selling Partner Experience (Fixed term contract - 12 months), EU Stores Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Over 2 million Selling Partners (Sellers and vendors) across ten countries list their products for sale on the Amazon Marketplace. Selling partners (SPs) are a critical part of Amazon’s ecosystem to deliver on our vision of offering the Earth’s largest selection and lowest prices. These SPs offer hundreds of millions of unique products providing a broad and diverse inventory of products. In our vision to build a global marketplace, we will enable Sellers to list, make their selection available to customers globally while optimizing their inventory placement across multiple countries. In the EU, we continue to observe an unprecedented wave of legislation that impacts Seller experience (SX), constrains selection and jeopardizes GMS. This increases the complexity and cost of selling in the EU and makes compliance the primary barrier to SP launches in the region.

As a Senior Program manager, Seller Experience, you will be tasked with identifying and implementing scalable mechanisms that will enable us to measure, track and improve seller experience indicators across the compliance business from listing experience to services. You will have the opportunity to audit our existing programs and products, while using your in depth knowledge to enhance these checks and invent new methods to provide best in class compliance seller experience. These efforts will play a critical role to the growth of Amazon’s marketplace business as you will partner closely with business product, tech, business, and policy teams to help identify controls up front to improve customer experience.

To achieve these objectives, you will be responsible for developing mechanisms to proactively identify and evaluate seller pain points in the current experience and define in collaboration with stakeholder teams the technology, processes, and control improvements required to mitigate them. You will also lead engagement with senior stakeholders across the company in order to achieve your objectives. This position has a EU scope across a variety of compliance product and programs products and is an exciting opportunity to be a part of a dynamic and high paced environment.The role will require you to drive clear communication in your contribution to key business and program documents including but not limited to MBRs, QBRs, OP and 3YPs.


Key job responsibilities
• Informing and executing the long-term strategic direction for our EU 3P Seller Experience regarding Compliance
• Integrate EU compliance priorities into global roadmaps.
• Work cross-functionally with business, product, tech, policy and legal to deliver high quality Compliance programs. Continually raise the bar and propose new program strategies, and garner learnings across programs to iterate over time.
• Develop mechanisms, processes, and measurement of all compliance touch points to understand what is working and what needs improvement
• Ability to identify stakeholder needs, implement prioritization
• Frequently presenting to leadership; including scoping new proposals, program reviews for MBRs, QBRs and PRFAQs.

title: Solutions Architect - AWS WWPS DoW, US Army Solutions Architecture, U.S. Army Solutions Architecte
descriptionHtml:
Do you like helping the U.S. Army and broader Department of War implement cloud computing solutions and solve difficult technical problems? Do you have a knack for helping these groups understand application architectures and integration approaches, and the consultative skills to launch a project on a trajectory to success?

As a Solutions Architect II at Amazon, you will help accelerate our rapidly growing Department of War business as part of the World Wide Public Sector practice. You will shape and deliver on a strategy to build broad use of Amazon Web Services (e.g., Amazon EKS, Amazon S3, AWS Lambda, Amazon EC2, Amazon Bedrock, etc.) directly with customers and our ecosystem of system integrators and solution providers. Your work will span data services, generative AI, serverless, compute, and storage, with a particular focus on database modernization and migration efforts that improve how the Army operates and delivers on its mission. This is an opportunity to join a truly collaborative technical team while developing your skills and furthering your career at Amazon.

You will provide thoughtful technical design and offer sensitivity to our customer needs in the Defense markets for cloud computing working with a truly innovative sales and business development team. You will lead efforts to capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS solution architect community. You will have the opportunity to learn from, collaborate with, and educate some of the brightest technical minds in the industry today across the breadth of enterprise architecture.

You should apply to this role if you are passionate about:
- Creating, building, educating, training and designing cloud computing architectures, especially if it’s for Defense Department customers.
- Getting hands on to experiment, build, and demonstrate technology solutions leveraging the latest AI technologies to expedite delivery and quality.
- Deep-dive technical discussions around design and the curiosity to keep your technical skills current while maintaining a pulse on industry trends
- Our company credo: “Work hard. Have fun. Make history.” It’s critical to love what you do and take pride in your value proposition to our customers.

Must be willing to travel within the US and overseas up to 35%. This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and deliver cloud architectures for Army workloads spanning data services, generative AI, serverless, compute, and storage, evaluating trade-offs across areas such as data store selection, scaling strategy, and failover mechanisms.
- Own the technical engagement and success of implementation projects, including defining implementation architectures and responding to RFPs, while developing deep expertise in AWS technologies and how applications are built on the platform.
- Serve as a trusted technical advisor and security subject matter expert to Army and Department of Defense stakeholders, helping them identify opportunities and risks with their technical decisions and guiding solution adoption.
- Lead database modernization and migration engagements, leveraging repeatable design patterns and reference architectures where appropriate and creating new reusable designs when novel approaches are required.
- Capture and share best-practice knowledge across the Solutions Architect community through presentations, workshops, written guidance, and peer collaboration.

A day in the life
Your morning might start with an architecture review alongside Army technical staff, where you help them evaluate database options and security controls for a migration workload. After lunch, you join a peer design review with fellow Solutions Architects to pressure-test a serverless approach you have been developing. Later in the afternoon, you work with a system integrator partner to align on an implementation architecture for an upcoming RFP, then wrap up by preparing a workshop for customer technical leadership.

About the team
Our team is a dedicated group of Solutions Architects within the World Wide Public Sector practice, focused on supporting the U.S. Army and the broader Department of Defense. We partner closely with Army stakeholders, system integrators, and solution providers to understand their goals and architect cloud solutions that create lasting operational impact. As the 16th member of this team, you will join a collaborative group that learns from each other through design reviews, knowledge sharing, and mentorship.

We are expanding our team as we increase capabilities and services for the Army through CY2027 and beyond, making this a compelling time to join. If you are excited about continuous learning and shaping how a critical government organization adopts cloud at scale, this is the team for you.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
- Bachelor's degree, or CASP+ (CompTIA Advanced Security Practitioner) or CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional) or Cloud+ or CSSLP (Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective
- Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
- Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud

title: Technik údržby, RME
descriptionHtml:
Tým odborné údržby (Reliability Maintenance Engineering – RME) ve společnosti Amazon má zásadní význam pro náš provoz – jsou to právě jeho pracovníci, kdo udržují životně důležité stroje v neustálém chodu. Jako technik/technička RME budete provádět údržbu široké škály zařízení a pracovišť a zároveň dodržovat osvědčené postupy v oblasti bezpečnosti a ochrany zdraví. Budete pomáhat zajišťovat bezpečnost svých kolegů a předcházet odstávkám strojů. Naši technici RME zvyšují kvalitu našich zařízení a současně pracují i na zlepšování provozního prostředí.



Key job responsibilities
Klíčové pracovní povinnosti:

- Proaktivní a preventivní údržba široké škály zařízení na pracovišti.
- Za provozu provádět diagnostiku závad v distribučním skladu a návazné opravy.
- Používat nejnovější nástroje k maximalizaci efektivity zařízení.
- Dodržovat všechny zásady a postupy v oblasti bezpečnosti a ochrany zdraví při práci.

- Pracovat na projektech neustálého zlepšování a zavádět osvědčené postupy na řadě pracovišť v rámci EU.

A day in the life
Náplň pracovního dne:

Naši technici RME působí přímo na provozních pracovištích, takže mohou rychle reagovat na případné problémy se stroji. Budete provádět řadu plánovaných preventivních údržbových prací na zařízeních v našich provozech s cílem zajistit jejich bezpečné fungování. Jako technik/technička RME budete také pohotově reagovat na havárie, co nejrychleji zjišťovat jejich příčiny a zároveň hledat a realizovat řešení. Budete také předkládat návrhy na dlouhodobá zlepšení.
Po boku zkušenějších kolegů budete provádět každodenní údržbářské činnosti, jako jsou lakýrnické a instalatérské práce, a bude-li třeba externí odborné pomoci, budete spolupracovat s dodavateli. In 2019, Amazon announced The Climate Pledge, which includes our commitment to power our operations with 100% renewable energy by 2025, on the path to achieving net zero carbon across our businesses by 2040. To learn more about AWS, visit https://aws.amazon.com and https://sustainability.aboutamazon.com/environment/the-cloud.

Amazon is looking for a talented and self-motivated Environmental Audit Program Manager to support AWS in the AMER region. The successful candidate will join the AWS Environmental team, an expanding and dynamic team that is critical to enabling AWS's growth around the world, as well as ensuring regulatory compliance and highest-level environmental performance of AWS's data center global operations. The Environmental team has responsibility for managing Environmental requirements and risk from site selection through to decommissioning. This role requires a highly skilled professional to manage complex, ambiguous audit initiatives across organizational boundaries.

The ideal candidate must lead regional audits, influence stakeholders, and work independently while seeking guidance when needed. Strong strategic and tactical skills are essential, including balancing short and long-term needs, mitigating risks, and delivering simplified solutions. Excellent communication skills are crucial, with the ability to present to senior leadership and write strategic narratives.

Cross-functional collaboration and consensus-building are key. A commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion is vital, focusing on challenging the status quo and creating inclusive products. The successful candidate will significantly impact long-term organizational goals and model best practices in their domain, driving change and innovation across the organization



Key job responsibilities
Leadership and commitment. Support the Environmental Audit program to evolve and meet changing organizational needs, stakeholder expectations, and environmental challenges, and securing necessary resources and support for continuous improvement. Collaborate with wider environmental team, operations leaders and top management to perform reviews and updates needed to ensure the audit program remains relevant and effective.

Risk management and planning. Support the ongoing identification and assessment of environmental risks identified through the audit program across AWS global operations. Develop and implement strategic plans to address significant environmental risks and opportunities, setting ambitious yet achievable improvements.

Implementation and operation. Oversee the design and deployment of our Audit program to enhance environmental performance to ensure compliance with legal and other requirements. Lead associated environmental audit training and awareness programs to embed audit skills throughout the organization.

Performance evaluation. Establish and manage a robust system for monitoring, measuring, and reporting performance of the Audit program. Conduct regular internal audits of Environmental Management System and regulatory compliance and analyze data to identify trends, gaps, and areas for improvement. Present performance reports and recommendations to top management.

title: HR Associate Partner, Fixed-term, PXT
descriptionHtml:
**Dies ist ein 2-Jahres-Vertrag.**

Im Streben danach, der beste Arbeitgeber der Welt zu sein, treiben unsere globalen Human-Resources-Teams – bekannt als People eXperience and Technology (PXT) – den Unternehmenserfolg voran, indem sie eine sichere, inklusive und innovative Unternehmenskultur fördern. Die Rolle des Associate Partners bietet einen Einstieg in den HR-Bereich bei Amazon und konzentriert sich auf grundlegende HR-Prozesse sowie die direkte Unterstützung der Mitarbeitenden. Der Associate Partner sorgt für außergewöhnliche Mitarbeitererlebnisse, indem er sowohl menschliche Expertise als auch technologische Lösungen einsetzt. Er verwaltet wesentliche HR-Transaktionen und baut gleichzeitig bedeutungsvolle Verbindungen zu Mitarbeitenden in einem zunehmend digitalen Arbeitsumfeld auf. Diese Rolle ergänzt Amazons sich weiterentwickelnde PXT-Servicekanäle – von KI-gestützten Systemen bis hin zu persönlichen Supportoptionen – indem sie dort personalisierte Unterstützung und menschliche Nähe bietet, wo diese am wertvollsten sind. Durch die effektive Balance zwischen technologiegestützten Prozessen und bedeutungsvoller Interaktion tragen sie dazu bei, ein nahtloses PXT-Erlebnis zu schaffen, das Amazons Engagement, der beste Arbeitgeber der Welt zu sein, weiter stärkt.

Zu deinen Hauptaufgaben gehören die Bearbeitung von HR-Transaktionen, das Management von Zeit- und Anwesenheitsfragen sowie die grundlegende Unterstützung der Mitarbeitenden – bei komplexeren Anliegen erfolgt die Weiterleitung an erfahrenere Kolleginnen und Kollegen. Je nach Bedarf bist du als Associate Partner für mehrere Standorte innerhalb deiner geografischen Region (Cluster) zuständig und fungierst als erste Anlaufstelle für grundlegende HR-Anfragen. Als Associate Partner im One PXT Team trägst du dazu bei, durch jede Interaktion ein herausragendes Mitarbeitererlebnis zu gestalten. Die Rolle erfordert eine einladende und zugängliche Präsenz sowie die präzise und zeitnahe Unterstützung der Mitarbeitenden zu Themen wie Benefits, Unternehmensrichtlinien und Gehaltsabrechnung.

Du wirst vor Ort an einem Amazon-Standort arbeiten. Bedarfsorientiert unterstützt du temporär auch umliegende Standorte.


Key job responsibilities
• Reaktionsschnelle, freundliche und professionelle Unterstützung der Mitarbeitenden über verschiedene Kanäle (persönlich, digital, per E-Mail, telefonisch) – mit genauen und zeitnahen Informationen zu Benefits, Richtlinien, Gehaltsabrechnung und weiteren HR-relevanten Themen.
• Sicherstellung der Genauigkeit, Integrität und Vertraulichkeit von Mitarbeiterdaten durch die sorgfältige und sichere Pflege und Verarbeitung von Unterlagen.
• Beitrag zu einer positiven und inklusiven Unternehmenskultur durch die Unterstützung und Umsetzung von Mitarbeiterengagement- und Anerkennungsinitiativen – einschließlich der Planung und Durchführung von Veranstaltungen, die den Zusammenhalt fördern und Leistungen würdigen.
• Unterstützung datenbasierter Entscheidungsfindung durch die Erhebung, Prüfung und Analyse wichtiger Personalkennzahlen, darunter Anwesenheit, Fluktuation und Engagement.
• Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften und Supportteams, um Mitarbeitende über KI-gestützte und klassische Self-Service-Tools sowie HR-Ressourcen zu informieren und zu schulen – mit dem Ziel, das Mitarbeitererlebnis und die betriebliche Effizienz zu verbessern. Nutzung von KI als primäres Hilfsmittel bei der Recherche und Problemlösung sowie proaktiver Einsatz verfügbarer Ressourcen und interner Netzwerke.
• Erstellung und Veröffentlichung klarer, professioneller interner Kommunikation für Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte unter Einhaltung der organisatorischen Standards und des gewünschten Kommunikationsstils.
• Erkennung und Weiterleitung komplexer oder sensibler Anliegen an die zuständigen HR- und Führungsverantwortlichen – darunter Gehaltsabweichungen, Dienstplanungskonflikte, Anträge auf Anpassungen am Arbeitsplatz, Schwerbehindertenangelegenheiten, Abwesenheitsfragen, Vorwürfe von Fehlverhalten, Richtlinienverstöße, rechtliche oder betriebsrätliche Anliegen sowie weitere Mitarbeiterbeziehungsthemen.


A day in the life
Ein typischer Arbeitstag umfasst die Unterstützung von Mitarbeitenden bei der Nutzung unserer digitalen HR-Tools und Self-Service-Plattformen sowie die Bereitstellung reaktionsschneller und professioneller Hilfe bei Bedarf. Du verbringst Zeit auf der Betriebsfläche, coachst Mitarbeitende im effektiven Umgang mit HR-Technologie, beantwortest Fragen zu Richtlinien und Programmen und erkennst Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Self-Service-Nutzung. Unter Anleitung erfahrener Teammitglieder stellst du eine genaue Dateneingabe und Dokumentation sicher und leistest dabei einen außergewöhnlichen Service, der Vertrauen und Sicherheit aufbaut.

Im Laufe deiner Schicht bearbeitest du HR-Transaktionen mit verschiedenen Tools und Systemen, verfolgst Servicekennzahlen und vertiefst dein Verständnis des HR-Betriebs. Bei komplexen Anfragen triffst du fundierte Entscheidungen über geeignete Eskalationswege und arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Teammitgliedern an der Lösung zusammen.

Für den Erfolg in dieser Rolle sind eine ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung, Sorgfalt, ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit zur Wahrung der Vertraulichkeit erforderlich. Durch praktische Erfahrung in dieser Einstiegsposition entwickelst du grundlegende HR-Kompetenzen und trägst gleichzeitig zu positiven Mitarbeitererlebnissen bei.

Amazon übernimmt keine Verantwortung für aufenthaltsrechtliche Genehmigungen, einschließlich H-1B, TN und anderer Nicht-Einwanderungsvisa, für diese Stelle.

title: Data Center Controls Tech, Midlothian, Texas
descriptionHtml:
The Data Center Global Controls team is looking for exceptional individuals to join our Controls organization as a Controls Technician for Service & Construction of the Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) within Amazon data centers. If you are passionate about the Customer Experience, think and act globally and have the ability to contribute to major new innovations in the area of building controls and automation this is the challenge you are looking for! The candidate will possess technical background and experience in installation, troubleshooting, operations and/or maintenance of field sensors, controllers, wiring, networking and programming associated with the industrial controls systems. The candidate may also have relevant experience operating and maintaining mission critical electrical and mechanical systems. A Controls Technician shall be responsible for participating in the installation, testing, troubleshooting and startup of equipment and controls system associated with the BMS and EPMS system deployment in the data centers. A Controls Technician is expected to actively innovate on behalf of their customers in the area of Data Center building automation.

Key job responsibilities
• Primarily work in and support multiple data centers by deploying, servicing, and upgrading BMS and EPMS systems.
• Mentor and train Facilities team members on the operation and control of BMS and EPMS systems.
• Manage small to medium-sized projects and programs.
• Perform point-to-point checkouts between field devices and controllers.
• Perform first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting, and maintenance of programming code and hardware associated with BMS and EPMS in data centers.
• Execute provisioning processes for servers, controllers, industrial PCs, and network configurations, including communication testing between third-party devices and controllers or servers.
• Install, replace, configure, and calibrate sensors.
• Read and interpret electrical schematics and control panel drawings with a basic understanding of closed-loop controls, field sensor scaling, and functions typically performed by industrial controllers.
• Supervise low-voltage electrical contractors performing wiring and installation of field devices in compliance with AWS requirements.
• Provide commissioning and systems-level testing support.
• Create red-lined drawings and documentation of systems.
• Follow change management processes to generate work requests and methods of procedures.
• Participate in factory witness tests at vendor or panel builder facilities.
• Perform root cause analysis during testing and commissioning.
• Ensure personnel on site utilize proper safety methodology.
• Perform service activities including monitoring and reviewing ticketing systems, conducting root cause analysis, and prioritizing tasks.
• Actively manage service agreements including vendor labor scheduling, quality assurance, and financial invoice review.
• Participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying, or moving up to 50 lbs of equipment, and utilize OSHA-standard safety equipment including limited weight-bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools, and personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety harnesses.
• Perform other tasks as assigned by manager


Physical Requirements:
· Walk job-sites in uneven terrain and work at heights and from ladders.
· Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch
or crawl.
· On occasions, lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more.

A day in the life
A typical day is attending morning construction/commissioning meetings, assessing and prioritization of project tasks and service tickets for the given day. Field work which requires configuring controllers, testing sensors, troubleshooting, safety site walks, and supporting general startup processes. Technician is responsible for logging their daily efforts in construction and service related AWS tools.

The mission of the Data Center Controls Engineering team is to manage the design, deployment, and service of a highly reliable electrical and mechanical control system for the life-cycle of an AWS data center.

About the team
As a member of the Global Controls Team, you will collaborate with highly motivated operators, engineers and technicians in the data center industry to maintain and optimize critical infrastructure systems. You will be responsible for troubleshooting and maintaining the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) while developing new processes and standards that drive innovation in the controls space.
AWS data centers utilize sophisticated industrial control systems to automatically operate mechanical equipment, maintaining optimal temperature and pressure conditions throughout the facilities. These systems integrate and monitor multiple critical components, including generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic and static transfer switches, air-cooled and water-cooled chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), and air economizers. Within this industrial control system infrastructure, the BMS serves as the primary control platform for all mechanical systems within the data center, while the EPMS functions as the primary monitoring platform for all electrical systems. This position offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in mission-critical environments while contributing to the reliability and efficiency of AWS's global infrastructure.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Basic understanding of Industrial controls system, knowledge of meters, devices, sensors, relays and troubleshooting utilizing standard hand tools, digital metering, or calibration/diagnostic equipment in a data center, hospitals, large commercial complex, water, power, oil & gas or similar industries
- 1+ years of experience working with low voltage controls, wiring, networking signals, electrical and mechanical systems, computers and operating systems
- Ability to work non-standard hours and differing work rotations/shifts and overtime as required.

Preferred qualifications

- High School or equivalent diploma
- International Society of Automation (ISA) Certified Controls System Technician (CCST) Level I or higher certification.
- Experiencing using common communication protocols (MQTT, BACnet, and/or MODBUS).
- 5+ years of experience in controls/automation, construction or related field in a technical environment
- Demonstrated understanding of engineering documentation, electrical and mechanical diagrams, and standard operating procedures.
- Experience in data centers or mission critical environment
- Fundamental knowledge of network design and layout as well as low voltage (copper/ fiber) cabling.
- Prior AWS/Amazon experience
- 4+ Yr. Military Service

title: Engineering Operations Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
• Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
• Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
• Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
• Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
• Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
• Technical writing to support change management program
• Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
• On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
• Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
• Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
• Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
• Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
• Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
• Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
• Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
• Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
• Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
• Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
• Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

- High school or equivalent diploma
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Global Media and Entertainment (GME) Content Security is seeking a Content Security Specialist based in Culver City, CA. title: Senior Program Manager, Prepared Foods, Whole Foods Market
descriptionHtml:
Whole Foods Market is seeking an experienced program manager to define, champion, and execute the menu strategy for our in-store restaurant concepts. In close cooperation with WFM leadership and key partner teams, the Program Manager owns the concept and menu-strategy pipeline that shapes what our Culinary team develops, from consumer and food-trend insight through testing and store-ready launch. This individual works cross-functionally with stakeholders across Whole Foods Market and Amazon to (1) evaluate new concept and menu opportunities, (2) set the strategic framework and priorities for those opportunities, and (3) launch and manage the resulting programs through their lifecycle. The ideal candidate will have experience with menu strategy and concept development at a fast casual restaurant, along with strong program management skills and the ability to influence at senior levels.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the definition and prioritization of new in-store restaurant concepts and menu platforms, grounded in consumer insight, food trends, and the competitive fast casual landscape.
• Set the strategic framework (positioning, priorities, success criteria) that guides culinary development, and partner with WFM Culinary Development, who own item-level creation.
• Build test, pilot, and scaling plans for new concepts and menu platforms, with clear readiness gates before broader rollout.
• Drive execution of program deliverables across internal stakeholder teams and external supplier partners.
• Manage the multi-year concept and menu-strategy pipeline, identifying white space and platform-level opportunities.
• Establish metrics to monitor concept and menu performance and recommend improvements to quality, guest satisfaction, and profitability.
• Prepare executive-ready deliverables and manage alignment and communication with key stakeholders.
• Earn trust and build partnerships with senior leaders across the organization and with external partners.
• Operate as a change agent, with resilience, emotional intelligence, and the ability to navigate ambiguity.
Travel Requirements: Approximately 25% travel may be required.
• Proven track record developing menu strategy and driving execution to deliver business results.
• Understanding of how restaurant menu strategy works: consumer insight, menu architecture and positioning, food cost and margin, and menu-platform lifecycle.
• Strong quantitative background; connects consumer and menu analytics to financial outcomes.
• Ability to think beyond the P&L to arrive at true value and drive impactful decisions.
• Strong oral, written, and formal presentation skills, including Amazon-style business writing.
• Experience operating in a large, complex retail or multi-unit restaurant organization.
• Strategic mindset with strong critical thinking and the ability to craft compelling business cases.
• Aligned to Whole Foods Market’s Higher Purpose, Core Values, and Leadership Principles.



A day in the life
A typical day for the Program Manager on this team blends strategic thinking with hands-on cross-functional collaboration. You might start the morning reviewing consumer insights and menu performance data to identify white-space opportunities, then join a working session with Culinary Development to evaluate a new in-store restaurant concept moving from ideation to pilot readiness. By midday, you could be leading a stakeholder alignment meeting with Category Management, Culinary Operations, and Product Quality to pressure-test a scaling plan, ensuring clear readiness gates and success criteria are in place. Afternoons may shift to building an executive-ready document for senior leadership that connects menu-platform performance to financial outcomes, or partnering with external supplier teams to refine a concept positioning strategy. No two days look exactly the same, but every day centers on translating culinary innovation into scalable, operationally executable programs that shape how customers experience prepared food at Whole Foods Market.

About the team
Our team is at the heart of transforming how customers experience fresh, prepared food at Whole Foods Market. We set the culinary and menu strategy that shapes what lands on shelves and in shopping baskets across hundreds of stores nationwide. We work at the intersection of food, data, and retail, partnering closely with culinary, suppliers, operations, merchandising, and finance to bring innovative, high-quality food programs to life. Our culture rewards curiosity, deep ownership, and creative problem-solving. If you’re passionate about food and want your work to directly shape what customers eat every day, this is the team for you.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience in menu strategy, concept development, or product strategy within a fast casual, quick service, or restaurant environment.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- Knowledge of general AI tools
- Experience working in a physical store

title: Equipment Engineer, Equipment Engineering , Equipment Engineering
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services (AWS) Center for Quantum Computing (CQC) in Pasadena, CA, is looking to hire an Equipment Engineer who will aid in AWS’s effort to bring cloud quantum computing services to its worldwide customer base. The candidate will work in a cleanroom environment alongside research scientists and process engineers, keeping complex semiconductor fabrication & characterization equipment in working order. Responsibilities include troubleshooting equipment-related issues, performing preventative maintenance and calibrations, interacting with vendors during the installation of new equipment and scheduled repairs, making self-guided & team-guided improvements to the lab infrastructure, and taking the lead on aspects of our equipment health program. The facility is focused on research and development, which utilizes equipment ranging from reactive ion etchers, to various material deposition tools, to advanced characterization instruments, most of which are classified as vacuum systems. The candidate will evaluate and develop procedures that provide maximum tool up-time for wafer processing and characterization while maintaining the equipment at optimal performance. Candidates must have a demonstrated background in fundamental engineering principles and must have excellent problem solving and communication skills. Successful candidates will have prior experience working in an academic or industrial fabrication facility, or similar. Working effectively within a team environment is critical.

Key job responsibilities
An Equipment Engineer troubleshoots problems related to equipment and other lab infrastructure, then devises and documents the solutions such that the problems can be more easily solved the next time they occur. When necessary, the Equipment Engineer works with field service engineers from the company that manufactured the equipment, scheduling service calls and supervising & documenting those engineers' work in our labs. The Equipment Engineer is responsible for improving the up-time of equipment, which involves developing better preventative maintenance (PM) plans, executing the PMs, performing equipment calibrations, owning equipment health initiatives, implementing new equipment-tracking initiatives in our manufacturing execution system (MES), and obsessing over the details of the equipment such that it can operate at peak performance. The Equipment Engineer may assist with the development and/or implementation of hardware modifications and new lab upgrades. The Equipment Engineer has ownership of equipment and lab spaces and is responsible for the reliable, excellent performance of our labs and everything that operates within it.

A day in the life
The Equipment Engineer performs a daily morning lab walkthrough to assess the state of their assigned lab areas and equipment. Based on priorities set by the team, the engineer works on solving new problems or existing problems from the previous day. Preventative maintenance checks and/or calibrations are performed according to a schedule. When time permits and there aren't problems to solve that are limiting team productivity, projects centered around the improvement of equipment and lab spaces are undertaken. In all aspects of the work, documentation of notes, procedures, fixes, and projects is pivotal. The engineer's goal is to maximize equipment up-time and performance so their teammates can operate the equipment reliably, and the whole team can deliver fabricated devices for quantum computing experiments.

About the team
Export Control Requirement:

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be either a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be able to obtain a U.S export license. If you are unsure if you meet these requirements, please apply and Amazon will review your application for eligibility.

Our team is comprised of scientists and engineers who are building hardware that enables quantum computing technologies. Doing that requires the fabrication of quantum devices, which necessitates the operation of a suite of fabrication and characterization equipment. Equipment Engineers work to maintain and improve the equipment – and the labs in which the equipment is installed – and work alongside Process Engineers and Research Scientists to help deliver fabricated devices for quantum computing experiments.

Basic qualifications

- Experience problem solving and root cause analysis
- 4+ years of root cause analysis and process design experience
- Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, or 5+ years of conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures experience
- Experience with a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS)
- Experience in development in the last 3 years, or experience with general troubleshooting/debugging of hardware
- Experience interpreting, modifying, and developing mechanical and electrical drawings, or experience with electrical theory, robotics, controls components, and automated equipment
- 5 years or more of Semiconductor Equipment Engineer Experience in one of the Semiconductor modules (Photolithography, Deposition, Etch, Wet Processing Equipment, and Packaging and Assembly Equipment).
- Statistical Process Control (SPC)
- Equipment Qualification
- Associate's Degree (A.S.) in Electronics, Electrical Technology, Mechatronics, Industrial Maintenance, Semiconductor Manufacturing, or a related technical field; or Military Electronics training; or higher degree (B.S., M.S.) in an engineering discipline.
- Proficiency troubleshooting electrical, mechanical, pneumatic, vacuum, and automation systems.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in the design of complex mechanical products and equipment at volume
- 5+ years of directly managing and being responsible for multiple large projects experience, or experience and strong technical background in relevant fields of automated or non-automated material handling equipment
- Experience supporting in one or multiple semiconductor toolsets (Lithography, ALD, CVD, PVD, Etch, Metrology, Packaging).
- Experience leading equipment installations, relocations, and factory acceptance testing (FAT/SAT).
- Experience developing equipment roadmaps and lifecycle strategies.

title: Data Engineer, Amazon Security Experience
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Security Experiences (ASE) organization is the data intelligence backbone of Amazon Security. We build and operate the data platform that powers security insights, builder experience analytics, and tooling decisions across Amazon's security ecosystem. Every insight surfaced to security leadership, from builder productivity trends to security issue quality metrics, flows through systems our team designs, builds, and maintains.

We operate at scale, processing large volumes of security and operational data daily through hundreds of pipelines consisting of transformations, reporting queries, ingestions, and infrastructure management scripts. Our engineers work directly with source systems across AWS and SDO (Security, Developer, and Operations) data domains to procure data, convert it into structured formats, build large-scale processing pipelines, design analytical data models, and maintain infrastructure with the highest security and compliance standards.

We are seeking a Data Engineer I to join our Security Data Intelligence (SDI) team. In this role, you will build and maintain data pipelines that power security analytics across Amazon. Working with well-defined requirements and guidance from senior engineers, you will create physical data models, optimize data pipelines for defined datasets, and deliver reliable, well-documented solutions on schedule. You will partner with teams across ASE, BizOps, MapSec, and other security organizations to implement data ingestion flows and support analytical models that serve the broader Amazon Security organization.

Key job responsibilities
Learn and apply team-established data processing guidelines and best practices when building and testing pipelines. Measure and improve dataset quality across owned pipelines, identifying issues and proposing solutions to the team. Flag limitations or opportunities in data processing tools to senior engineers for evaluation.

Learn and understand the team's existing data architecture, including how security data flows through ingestion, transformation, and serving layers. Build data solutions at the component level within the established team data architecture, following defined logical data models. Create physical data models for assigned datasets, applying appropriate persistence and integration techniques. Understand the implications of implementation decisions (e.g., normalization, distribution) and seek guidance from senior engineers on trade-offs.

Write secure, stable, testable, and maintainable code with minimal defects, following team coding standards. Clearly document solutions for ease of use and maintainability by teammates and data consumers. Get all data models, pipeline designs, and code reviewed by senior engineers before deployment. Test code thoroughly and understand the maintenance characteristics, runtime properties, and dependencies of delivered solutions.

Build and maintain data pipeline infrastructure for assigned datasets using team-established patterns and tools. Apply basic database optimization techniques such as partitioning, distribution, and indexing as directed. Understand the underlying system infrastructure that data solutions depend on, including differences between data persistence solutions. Follow team guidelines for infrastructure management, security compliance, and automation practices.

Solve straightforward, well-defined problems with guidance from senior engineers, for example, building ingestion pipelines for a new security data source where the schema and requirements are defined, or troubleshooting data quality issues in existing datasets by researching root causes and thoroughly resolving defects. Handle problems even outside your own domain by either resolving them or ensuring a clear hand-off to the right owner.

Take well-defined requirements and deliver solutions on schedule within assigned scope. Participate in team design, scoping, and prioritization discussions to understand project context. Manage your own task execution effectively, seeking guidance when blocked or uncertain. Communicate progress and dependencies clearly to your team lead and senior engineers.

descriptionHtml:

As a Business Development Manager for Digital Innovation, you will have an exciting opportunity to lead customer engagements and shape and deliver the Digital Innovation program, working with other Global BDMs, leadership team, and AWSI program leadership. Your primary responsibility will be to identify, develop, and lead engagements with Enterprise customers – engaging line of business and C-suite leaders, qualifying opportunities, leading innovation engagements utilizing Amazon mechanisms and driving resultant prototypes and scaled solutions. The right candidate will have experience delivering Digital Innovation engagements for enterprise customers across all commercial verticals, with depth experience across 3+ verticals. title: Engineering Operations Technician, DCC Communities
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

About the team
Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion of events fosters stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays
- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field
