title: Sr. Software Development Manager, Outbound Agentic Marketing Demand
descriptionHtml:
Outbound is re-imagining the communications and marketing landscape with generative and agentic AI, changing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond.

Amazon reaches shoppers billions of times through email, mobile push, SMS, and other messaging channels. We're turning that into a marketplace. Each shopper's limited attention is the supply. The messages that compete for it, and the marketers, category leaders, and AI agents who create them, are the demand. A separate team runs the auction that decides which message earns each moment. This role builds the demand side: everything that determines how good, how varied, and how dependable the content and campaigns entering that marketplace are.

Today, most marketing email still looks like a catalog printout, and the tools behind it make ambitious creative slow and fragile. We want Amazon's messages to have the visual quality of the best brand content on social, and to be relevant to the specific moment a customer is in. A customer getting into cycling, or planning a first camping trip, should get a story-led series built for that interest, not a generic deal alert. Picture a feed: AI agents continuously generate on-brand, category-specific content from customer and category signals, and the marketplace decides what each customer sees and when. Your team makes that inventory rich, high quality, and trustworthy.

As the Senior Manager, Software Development for Generative Marketing & Demand, you'll build and lead an organization of software engineers, working closely with applied scientists and design technologists. You'll own:
- The authoring platform (open source). A toolkit that takes a design from Figma, a brief in Slack, or a contributor's draft and produces finished, accessible, on-brand content for email, push, and long-form article pages. It covers a shared component and design-token spec, a compiler that produces inbox-safe output that renders as designed in every client, automated checks (accessibility, size, links, deliverability, brand rules), real-client previews, and in-thread review and approval. We intend to build the core in the open under a permissive license, so the industry's best email and design-tool engineers can improve it alongside us, while Amazon's customer data, brand, and sending systems plug in privately through adapters.

- Generative and agentic content. Agents that draft, adapt, and localize creative, generate lifestyle imagery for catalog products, write copy in a brand's voice, and assemble category-specific stories and drip series from customer and category signals and from opportunities the marketplace sends back. Every generated piece passes the same gates as human work before it reaches a customer.

- Campaign planning and execution. The tools marketing teams use to plan, configure, schedule, and operate campaigns and coordinated waves of campaigns, including peak events like Prime Day. The bar is simple: what a marketer plans is what customers get. Operators see the effective send window, the policies that apply (quiet hours, cadence, consent, channel limits), and a reconciled funnel from audience to delivery, with the reason behind every number, before and during a send rather than in a retro afterward.

- Data and audience connectors. A pluggable, documented mechanism for bringing in audiences, catalog and deal data, recommendations, and third-party sources, with timeouts, fallbacks, and validation, so new data sources can be added without platform changes. Connectors built by Amazon teams and by the open-source community use the same contract.

- Send-path reliability. Low-latency, high-throughput content rendering and handoff to Amazon's sending infrastructure at peak-event volumes, with verifiable delivery: every send is traceable, auditable, and reconciles with what was planned.



Key job responsibilities
- Build, hire, and grow a high-performing team of software engineers, including senior and principal engineers and, as the organization scales, managers. Set a high hiring bar and develop the next generation of technical leaders.
- Own the Generative Marketing & Demand vision, roadmap, and multi-year plan (OP1/OP2) with product, design, science, and marketing partners. Turn an ambiguous goal, best-in-class creative and campaign tooling in an industry with strong commercial incumbents, into a delivery plan with measurable milestones.
- Lead the open-source program for the authoring platform. Work with Amazon's open-source office and Legal on licensing and the open/private boundary. Build the community mechanisms that make it a multi-party project rather than an Amazon-only one: public roadmap, RFC process for spec changes, contribution and code-review standards, conformance tests, release management, security response, and named maintainers inside and outside Amazon. Recruit external maintainers and early adopters (other companies, agencies, ESPs, and design-tool developers), and measure the project's health by external contributors and downstream adoption.
- Hold a clear architectural line between open and private: nothing in the open core depends on Amazon systems, no customer data flows through open code paths, and Amazon runs the released open packages rather than a fork.
- Be accountable for outcomes. Creative quality and relevance (engagement, conversion, and incremental lift against holdouts), brief-to-approved-content time, rendering and accessibility defects, plan-versus-actual send accuracy, and marketer adoption are the measures. Opens alone are not.
- Partner with applied scientists on content generation, creative quality scoring, category and interest modeling, and the signals that tell agents which content to create for which customer moment. Move models from research to production quickly and safely.
- Partner with the marketplace team so that content, metadata, and quality signals flow cleanly into the attention auction, and opportunity signals flow back to content agents.
- Make AI-generated content safe by default: brand, legal, claims, accessibility, and deliverability checks block publishing automatically; human reviewers focus on judgment; prompts and outputs are logged; and responsible-AI, privacy, and communications compliance requirements (CAN-SPAM, TCPA, GDPR, consent) are non-negotiable.
- Drive adoption across a broad set of internal tenants, including Retail, Prime, Prime Video, Music, Alexa, and Ads marketing teams, and category leaders who contribute long-form content. Meet them in the tools they already use (Figma, Slack, documents, CLI, and agent clients via MCP) rather than asking them to learn a new console.
- Own operational excellence: on-call health, alarming, COEs, security reviews, service-level goals, and peak-event readiness, including during Prime Day, Prime Big Deal Days, and the holidays.
- Communicate clearly in writing and in reviews with senior leadership, including narratives, PR/FAQs, and business reviews, and represent Amazon externally in the open-source and email-engineering communities.

A day in the life
You might start with the open-source triage: an external contributor's pull request fixes a dark-mode rendering bug in a new mail-client release, and another company has proposed an RFC to extend the spec for interactive modules. Then you'd review the weekly metrics: a category storytelling pilot for outdoor gear is showing incremental new-to-category customers against its holdout, and brief-to-approved time dropped below a day. After that, you'd walk a marketing lead through a readiness review for the next peak event, where the wave view shows every campaign's effective send window and flags one that a channel quiet-hour rule will cut short, so it gets fixed before the event instead of during it. In the afternoon, you'd join a design review for a new connector contract with your principal engineer, meet with an applied scientist on why generated lifestyle imagery is drifting off-brand for one category, and close an offer for a senior engineer who found the team through the open-source project.

About the team
We're a high-ownership team in Outbound Communications, building the tools that decide how good Amazon's messages can be. We build from first principles, work in the open where it makes the product better, and hold to one rule: every message has to be worth the customer's attention.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of engineering experience
- 5+ years of engineering team management experience
- 10+ years of planning, designing, developing and delivering consumer software experience
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams
- Experience managing multiple concurrent programs, projects and development teams in an Agile environment

Preferred qualifications

- Experience partnering with product and program management teams
- Experience designing and developing large scale, high-traffic applications

title: Lab Engineer II, Global Materials Science
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon's Global Materials Science (GMS) organization as a Lab Engineer and be part of pioneering sustainable e-commerce packaging. In this hands-on role, you'll conduct materials testing and characterization that directly supports the development of breakthrough packaging materials. You'll work in state-of-the-art laboratories, operating advanced testing equipment, executing experiments, and generating critical data that enables our team to make informed decisions about materials that touch millions of customer experiences daily.

Key job responsibilities
Materials Testing & Characterization:
- Conduct hands-on materials testing using equipment including tensile testers, burst testers, tear testers, rheometers, and other materials characterization tools.
- Execute test protocols following TAPPI, ASTM, ISO, and ISTA standards as well as internal developed methods.
- Perform testing on packaging materials including paper substrates, adhesives, coatings, and alternative fiber materials.
- Operate and maintain laboratory equipment, ensuring proper calibration and functionality
- Prepare test and store specimens according to specifications and standard operating procedures
- Identify, recommend, and help implement improved lab processes for the team. Learning to create mechanisms.

Data Collection & Analysis:
- Collect, organize, and document experimental data with high accuracy and attention to detail.
- Analyze test results and identify trends or anomalies in materials performance.
- Generate clear and concise test reports summarizing findings and observations.
- Support data-driven decision making by providing reliable, high-quality test results

Laboratory Operations:
- Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions for all testing activities
- Maintain a safe, clean, and organized laboratory environment.
- Participate in laboratory safety programs and equipment maintenance schedules.
- Assist in identifying opportunities to improve testing efficiency and data quality.
- Support inventory management of laboratory supplies and test materials

Cross-Functional Support:
- Collaborate with Advanced Materials Engineers and scientists on experimental design and execution.
- Communicate test results, status updates, and any issues or blockers to team members.
- Support supplier qualification activities by conducting materials testing on vendor samples.
- Assist with sample preparation and testing for field trials and deployment validation.
- Participate in team meetings and contribute to project planning discussions.

Documentation & Continuous Improvement:
- Contribute to the development and refinement of test procedures and SOPs
- Document experimental procedures, observations, and results clearly and thoroughly.
- Identify and recommend improvements to testing methods and laboratory processes.
- Learn and apply materials science principles to understand the significance of test results.
- Seek feedback and continuously develop technical skills and domain knowledge.

Work Environment:
- Primarily laboratory-based work with hands-on equipment operation.
- Standard lab safety protocols and PPE requirements.
- Occasional lifting of materials and equipment (up to 50 lbs), standing, walking, kneeling throughout the day.
- Collaborative team environment with regular interaction with scientists and engineers.

A day in the life
Your day starts in the lab preparing test specimens—cutting paper samples to precise dimensions and conditioning them in the environmental chamber. You're supporting a critical adhesive development project, and today's testing will determine if the new formulation meets performance requirements.

Mid-morning, you're running tensile and burst tests on paper samples, carefully following the test protocol and recording data in real-time. The results look interesting—you notice the tear strength is higher than previous samples and flag this for the materials engineer leading the project.

After lunch, you're operating the rheometer to characterize viscosity profiles of new hot melt adhesive samples from three different suppliers. You meticulously document the temperature ramps and flow behavior, knowing this data will directly inform sourcing decisions.

Your afternoon includes calibrating equipment, organizing test data into clear summary reports, and preparing samples for tomorrow's environmental conditioning tests. You also participate in a team meeting where you present your week's testing results—your data shows one supplier's material consistently outperforms the others.
This is hands-on work that matters. The tests you conduct today generate the data that enables breakthrough materials innovations, supports major procurement decisions, and ultimately improves packaging for millions of customers while advancing Amazon's sustainability goals.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits for you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
The Global Materials Science (GMS) organization is Amazon's Center of Excellence for packaging materials development and supply chain transformation. Our team represents a fundamental shift in how Amazon approaches packaging innovation—owning the invention, development, and optimization of materials that power our fulfillment network.

Our Mission: We build deep expertise in packaging materials through rigorous research and testing, develop innovative packaging solutions that unlock automation potential and sustainability improvements, and establish robust supply chains that deliver superior solutions at lower cost.

Our Vision: To be the global leader in e-commerce packaging materials science and innovation, enabling the best customer packaging experience at the lowest cost to serve.

What Makes Us Unique: We're not just specifying materials—we're fundamentally understanding them through the materials science triangle framework (processing, structure, properties). Our integrated capabilities span from molecular-level materials characterization, to full packaging system testing, to automation compatibility testing. This end-to-end ownership enables us to innovate faster, unlock step-change improvements previously thought impossible.

Our Impact: We're driving Amazon's transition from plastic to paper packaging, developing breakthrough materials and establishing supply chains that reduce costs while advancing our 2040 net-zero commitment. Our work directly influences automation success, customer experience, and sustainability metrics.

Our Culture: We operate with high technical rigor while moving at startup speed. We embrace calculated risk-taking in R&D, fail fast, and iterate based on data. We believe in radical collaboration—our success requires seamless partnership across engineering, procurement, operations, and sustainability teams. We value both technical excellence and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Our Team: We bring together materials scientists, chemists, engineers, lab technicians, and program managers who are passionate about solving hard problems. We partner with world-class academic institutions, leading materials suppliers, and internal Amazon teams to push the boundaries of what's possible in packaging materials.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of hardware development, test lab, space/aerospace maintenance or hands-on engineering environment experience
- Bachelors Degree or higher in Material Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Paper Science Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Materials Science, Materials Engineering, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, paper science engineering or related technical discipline
- 2+ years of laboratory experience in materials testing, quality control, or research environment
- Experience with packaging materials or other forest products testing (paper, adhesives, coatings, or polymers) following standard test methods (TAPPI, ASTM, ISO, ISTA, etc.)
- Hands-on experience with testing equipment such as tensile testers, burst testers, thermal analysis equipment, SEM, DMA, etc. and experience with data analysis tools and statistical methods

descriptionHtml:
ポジション概要
Amazon Transportation Services (ATS) 部門では、年間数億にのぼる商品をお客様とお約束したお届け日に安全かつ正確に商品をお届けすべく、日本全国のAmazon物流拠点を結ぶ大規模な幹線輸送ネットワークを構築・運営しています。1日5,000運行を超えるこの複雑なネットワーク運営の中核を担うRelay Operation Center (ROC) において、幹線輸送における品質を管理するQuality Management (QM) チームのメンバーを募集します。業務を通じてAmazonの輸送オペレーションの仕組づくりに携われるともに業務構築のスキルも身に着け向上させることができます。ぜひあなたの経験と可能性を活かして世界最高品質のECサービスを提供しましょう。

チーム概要
ROC QMチームの主な機能は以下の通りです。

1. 幹線輸送（出荷拠点から配達拠点まで）で発生するトラックの出発遅延や着車遅延、貨物の積み残しに対する輸送品質の管理
2. お盆や年末年始などで発生する渋滞に対する輸送リードタイムのモニタリングと修正
3. 天候災害発生時 (台風・大雪など) の品質維持と早期回復に向けたプロセス管理

上記の品質水準を高めることで、お客様に最上のサービスを提供します。


職務内容
本ポジションでは数名で構成される地域毎のチームのなかでチーム概要の「1」にある幹線輸送における輸送品質管理の業務を担っていただきます。具体的には以下のような業務があります。

- 担当エリアにおけるデリバリー拠点への貨物遅延のモニタリング、原因分析とDailyでのリカバリ対応

- 上記を実施するための業務フローの見直しや標準プロセスの整備

本ポジションの魅力
業界経験・未経験を問わず、業務プロセスの課題や問題に対して率先して取り組めるメンバーが活躍しており、以下のような魅力があります。

- 専門能力：物流業界における輸送品質の管理手法を大規模なフィールドで学べるほか、オペレーションの構築やSQLを用いたデータ分析と仮説検証など、問題解決力のスキルを習得、向上させることができる。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

title: Global Category Manager, CAPEX - EMI (Equipment, Mobility and Infrastructure)
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a leader with procurement experience to strategically source Auxiliary equipment and services for fulfillment operations within CAPEX - Equipment, Mobility and Infrastructure category. The person in this role will coordinate with several teams across Amazon and will interact with suppliers to satisfy organizational requirements. The position will work and partner with multiple teams to develop and execute robust category sourcing strategies, deliver savings, improve supply chain resilience and productivity across the category. The ideal candidate is a self-starter, and a creative, critical thinker with an strong motivation to learn. You must be an effective communicator and be able to work independently and as a leader of peers to generate high-quality work product in a collaborative, creative, ever-changing, and sometimes ambiguous environment.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
• Establish multi year category sourcing strategies, lead cross-functional strategic sourcing teams, negotiate with suppliers and execute contracts to optimize Amazon’s competitive position
• Drive appropriate relationships with category suppliers, with a principal objective of achieving the optimal solution and cost of ownership that meets the business’ goals supported by a culture of continuous improvement with performance benchmarks in use
• Manage category suppliers to proactively identify, monitor and optimize opportunities
• Act as a market intelligence provider regarding categories; anticipate strategic opportunities and keep key stakeholders informed
• Drive category suppliers in Supplier Relationship Management activities to mitigate risk, improve performance and add value to Amazon
• Identify, achieve and report on savings and value targets for category sourcing activities
• Align with internal customers and understand the business application of the category

Key Performance Indicators:
• Earn the trust of key stakeholders to drive alignment with the business
• Create a robust category strategy in conjunction with internal customers to ensure there is a comprehensive, unified approach for the category.
• Achieve yearly cost saving or value targets appropriate to the category aligned with annual budget processes.

title: EMEA Logistics Specialist, Global Transportation and Logistics
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is looking for an experienced EMEA Regional Logistics Specialist to own the transportation of IT assets across various programs in EMEA Region. This is an exciting opportunity to make history by becoming a member of a team whose purpose is to solve complex challenges creating unprecedented customer experiences on a daily basis. This role will require working with business teams across the company and around the world to figure out supply chain solutions for new products/programs and existing operations.

The primary function is to define and deliver global solutions that aid in the speed and scalability of Operations Technology Solutions (OTS) and our Global Operations partners.

Key job responsibilities
- Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with business, operations, and IT stakeholders, while having the ability to work independently in a high-pressure environment with various levels of leadership and exercise sound judgment where clear guidelines may not exist.

- Proficiency at solving complex logistics challenges and possess a bias to get things done and deliver results.

- Coordination with shipping and receiving clerks to support outbound shipping at multiple Rapid Asset Deployment (RAD) locations within the region.

- Working with the Customs, Brokers and Global Trade Services (GTS) to ensure proper documentation on all shipments

- Preparing and validating Commercial Invoices (CI) for international shipments

- Daily communication with transportation providers to ensure timely pickup of shipments and adequate space is available.

- Managing the transportation of Amazon IT assets (both inbound and outbound), including international shipments

- Lead shipment investigations on behalf of the customer. This includes (but is not limited to) tracking shipments, researching lost packages, processing damage reports, filing claims, and authorizing a re-ship of the IT asset.

- Daily monitoring of shipments in order to proactively and quickly resolve issues that could arise during transportation

- Creating SOPs as needed in the absence of defined processes/procedures

- Providing proactive reporting to customers and key stakeholders

- Developing transportation plans for new projects that arise

- Innovating for step-change improvement in safety, quality, cost, and other KPI metrics

- Collaborating with key operational experts across the company to lead, support, and influence new business initiatives.

- Executing strategic business objectives while working with key internal stakeholders to improve the supply chain with the latest internal and external information.

- Participating in Weekly Business Reviews (WBR) within the organization to ensure strict adherence to cost, team goals, and business objectives

- Ownership of all results within your region.

- Engaging current transportation providers to strengthen current partnerships while also identifying potential new providers.

- Travel mainly across the Country around <10% of the time

A day in the life
We support internal Amazon businesses with the transfer of IT assets, new or used, as requested. Our #1 priority is to ensure the package delivers seamlessly to the customer as expected.

About the team
Global Transportation Logistics (GTL) team supports the movement of non-inventory IT equipment (assets, spare parts, and consumables) across our fulfillment and delivery networks (including Data Centers). This team consists of both inbound/outbound logistics, reverse logistics programs, dangerous goods and import/export trade compliance.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field
- Experience in supply chain
- Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
- Experience with Six Sigma tools and Lean techniques

title: Senior Solutions Architect, Benelux Public Sector
descriptionHtml:
Our purpose is to be the trusted advisors and thought leaders who enable Public Sector customers to succeed in their missions. We earn trust by listening to our customers, prioritizing their needs, and delivering value so they can make well-informed decisions and create a better world.

Are you a passionate technologist who enjoys working with public sector customers and who can influence and drive innovation using innovative technology? Do you have a knack for helping groups understand application architectures and integration approaches, and the consultative and leadership skills to launch a project on a trajectory to success? Would you like to be part of a sales group, but have your opinion valued as a technical resource as part of planning and strategies?

AWS is looking for a Solutions Architect to join our thriving technical community and growing business as part of our Benelux Public Sector team based in Brussels, Belgium. You will join a friendly and supportive team, serving the unique needs of our Public Sector customers in Belgium, Netherlands, and Luxembourg.

As an AWS Solutions Architect, you will have ownership of the technical relationship with customers, making recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability, operational efficiency and best-practice architectures.
Internally, you will be an advocate acting on behalf of the customer to help drive continual improvements to the AWS platform, sharing their needs and wants to inform the roadmap of AWS features and services.

In this role, your creativity will link technology to tangible solutions, with the opportunity to implement or document cloud-native reference architectures with the AWS Solutions Architect community.

You will participate in the creation and sharing of recommended practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts) and evangelise and educate about AWS technology (e.g. through workshops, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).

We seek candidates from all backgrounds to join our teams, and we encourage our employees to bring their authentic, original, and best selves to work.

Key job responsibilities
* Own the technical engagement and ultimate success around specific business initiatives and projects. You should (learn to) understand the wider industry, with experience and skill in how applications and services are delivered and consumed.
* Develop a deep expertise in AWS technologies.
* Consult on and provide leadership for the broad AWS cloud strategy in public sector organisations.
* You will help customers articulate and navigate their cloud journey, and be accountable for ensuring tactical activities and point projects are align with the overall technical strategy.
* Exhibit leadership within a very sophisticated IT landscape and become the trusted advisor to different stakeholders in the customer’s organisation’s hierarchy. Enable others to become cloud champions!
* Be a thought leader, comfortable with speaking in public. Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS.
* Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS architecture community, including authoring or otherwise contributing to AWS customer-facing assets such as whitepapers, blogs, code, and sample architectures.
* Act as a technical liaison between customers, engineering teams and support.
* Demonstrate the "art of the possible" using demonstrations and proof-of-concept code.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Experience within specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics).
- In-depth knowledge of cloud computing, data engineering, and enterprise architecture principles.
- Strong background in delivering complex, mission-critical technology solutions.
- Knows how modern software development works
- Excellent communication and presentation skills to effectively engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Dutch native or +5yrs fluent professional C2 level speaking experience
- English fluency on a professional level

Preferred qualifications

- Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
- Experience working with AWS technologies
- Experience architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
- Has experience in the Public Sector industry
- Has experience in using Machine Learning or GenAI

title: Warehouse Automation Manager, Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about designing automation solutions that improve how millions of packages move through a fulfillment network? Amazon is looking for a Warehouse Automation Manager to drive innovation and product development for material handling equipment (MHE) across our operations. In this role, you will own the automation roadmap — from early-stage concept engineering and prototype design through vendor development and full-scale rollout. You will research emerging technologies, evaluate cost-effective alternatives, and collaborate with Safety, Maintenance, Process Engineering, and Finance teams to deliver solutions that increase productivity and capacity. If you thrive on turning ideas into real-world systems that operate at scale, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and standardize automation prototypes for conveyors, lifts, and other MHE, managing the full lifecycle from concept engineering through implementation and performance qualification.
- Build and own the automation roadmap by researching new technologies, benchmarking industry best practices, and evaluating alternative solutions that balance quality, cost, and operational impact.
- Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders — including Safety, Maintenance, Process Engineering, and Finance — to develop material flow layouts and engineering specifications for new and existing facilities.
- Lead vendor qualification, development, and management activities including preparation of Requests for Information (RFI), Requests for Quotation (RFQ), and scopes of work, while driving techno-commercial discussions with procurement and project teams.
- Leverage generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) tools and data-driven analysis to identify process improvements, optimize designs, and accelerate solution development cycles.

A day in the life
You will start your week reviewing progress in business review forums, aligning priorities against the automation roadmap, and adjusting plans based on operational feedback. Much of your time is spent independently — prototyping concepts, analyzing power requirements, and refining engineering specifications — then shifting into collaborative sessions with partner teams to pressure-test designs and resolve technical trade-offs. You will stay connected to the professional community and market trends, bringing fresh ideas back to the team to keep solutions affordable and forward-looking.

About the team
Our team is on a mission to strengthen Amazon's automation charter by creating innovative MHE solutions that scale operations across fulfillment buildings. We work at the intersection of mechanical engineering, controls, and product development, turning ideas into systems that move real packages every day. Senior leaders provide strategic vision while team members take ownership of execution, building expertise through self-directed learning and engagement with the broader engineering community. This is a team where your work directly translates into measurable productivity and capacity gains.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience of automated equipment including packaging machinery, sortation and conveyor systems
- Experience with Kaizen and Continuous Improvement Process

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in a fast-paced, automated, industrial, logistics, production or manufacturing environment
- Experience in preventative maintenance systems

title: Senior Engineer, JP Ops Eng, JCFS, JP Ops Eng, JCFS
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Japan はビジネスの成長をサポートする新しいフルフィルメントセンター,インバウンドクロスドック,アウトバウンドソートセンターなどFirst Mile/Middle Mileの新規サイト立ち上げおよび数十の既存サイトにおける改造プロジェクトにおいて、設置されるマテハン機器や自動化設備の安定稼働に向けて設備の安全性や品質、信頼性、生産性の改善を技術的にリードする Senior Engineer を探しています。本ポジションは、アマゾンのグローバルチームや国内外のサプライヤーと協力し共に成長しながら技術的なリーダーシップを発揮し、安全性やコストバランスを維持しつつ設備およびプロセスの能力と品質を最大化させます。また、オートメーションを含む最新鋭の搬送設備の導入に伴い新たに発生する技術課題に対しても状況に応じて最適なソリューションを提案し、関係するステークホルダーとの合意形成をとりながらタイムリーに解決へ導くことで新規ソートセンターの立ち上げを成功させ、日本のお客様へお届けする商品のリードタイム短縮と輸送コスト削減に貢献します。そして幅広い技術力や経験知を指導することでチーム全体の技術力を底上げし、さらに設備仕様や業務プロセスの標準化へつなげていくことで技術のスケールアップにも貢献します。下記が主な業務となります。
- 日本のオペレーションが計画する中期および年次計画に基づいてフルフィルメントセンターおよびソートセンターの立ち上げを実現すること。
- 設備の技術問題に対して重大性や影響度を迅速かつ正確に捉え、状況に応じて安全、日程、品質、コストの全体最適となるソリューションを提案し解決させること。
- 既存のコミュニケーションチャネルとワークプロセスの更なる改善を行い、社内外のステークホルダーとの信頼関係を構築しながらコンフリクトを解消し合意形成に結び付けるようマネージすること。
- グローバルのエンジニアリングチームと連携し、最先端の設備や業務プロセスを日本に導入して、入出荷能力の向上や業務効率化を図ること。また、日本のベストプラクティスはグローバルへ提案し標準化すること。
- 国内外の協力会社と連携するだけでなく、継続的にそれら協力会社の能力を高め、安全性・品質の向上と低コスト化を推進すること。
- 安全基準とエンジニアリング指針に則り、標準作業作りなどを通してメカニズムを構築し安全な職場を実現すること。

Amazon Japan is seeking an Senior Engineer to manage the construction of the material handling equipment and automation equipment, verify the operational capability, and start up the new fulfillment center/IB cross-dock/OB sort center that handles First mile/Middle mile delivery. This position will demonstrate technical leadership while working and growing with Amazon's global team and domestic and international suppliers to maximize facility and process capability and quality while maintaining safety and cost balance. In addition, we propose optimal solutions for new technical issues that arise with the introduction of state-of-the-art transportation equipment, including automation. By guiding them, we will successfully launch a new sort center and contribute to shortening lead times and reducing transportation costs for products delivered to Japanese customers. In addition, by teaching a wide range of technical skills and empirical knowledge, we will raise the technical skills of the entire team, and furthermore, we will contribute to the scale-up of technology by leading to the standardization of equipment specifications and business processes.
The following are the main duties.
- Realize the launch of fulfillment centers and sort centers based on the mid-term and annual plans planned by the Japanese operations.
- Quickly and accurately grasp the severity and impact of technical problems with equipment, and propose and resolve solutions that optimize overall safety, schedule, quality, and cost, depending on the situation.
- Further improve existing communication channels and work processes, build relationships of trust with internal and external stakeholders, resolve conflicts, and manage to build consensus.
- Collaborate with global engineering teams and introduce new technology and processes to Japan to improve shipping and receiving capabilities and improve business efficiency. In addition, Japan's best practices should be proposed globally and standardized.
- In addition to collaborating with partner companies in Japan and overseas, continuously improve the capabilities of these partner companies, and promote improvements in safety and quality as well as cost reductions.
- According to safety standards and engineering guidelines, create a mechanism through the creation of standard work, etc., and realize a safe workplace.
More Information (Japanese Only)
- Department: Japan Customer Fulfillment Solutions
- Job:Engineer
- Location:Tokyo Office

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。


Key job responsibilities
- マテリアルハンドリングや各種自動化設備の設置から試運転テストそして検収プロセスをリードする。
- Amazon 社内関係者や外部ベンダーとの信頼関係を構築しながら安全と品質、コストの全体最適を考慮した上で技術的課題やコンフリクトを解決し、計画どおりのプロジェクト遂行をリードする。
- グローバルのエンジニアリングチームと協力して、新しい安全・品質の管理プロセスまたは標準を日本に導入し、また日本のベストプラクティスをグローバルチームに提案して展開します。
- 工事安全や品質に関わる事象と原因を深く掘り下げて本質的課題を特定・解決し、再発防止につながる仕組みや基準を構築する。
- 最高の価値と競争力を実現するために、調達やその他ビジネス パートナーへの設備仕様と技術サポートを提供する。

- Lead the installation of material handling and various automated equipment, commissioning tests and acceptance inspection processes for both new site launch and also legacy site retrofit/expansion.
- Resolve conflicts after considering overall optimization while building trusting relationships with Amazon internal stakeholders and external vendors, and lead the project in a short period of time with high quality and low cost.
- Collaborate with global engineering teams to introduce new safety and quality management processes or standards to Japan, and propose and deploy the best practices in Japan to global teams.
- Dive deep on technical details to identify and solve the technical problems and to build a mechanism or standard that leads to recurrence prevention.
- Assist in providing equipment specifications and technical support to procurement and other business partners for best value and competition.

A day in the life
一週間に 3~4 日を工事中のサイトで勤務し現場の工事安全を統括リードし、各ベンダーや関係部署にまたがる複雑な技術課題の解決をリードします。グローバルチームメンバーと協業しながら業務プロセスや標準の改善に向けてドキュメントを作成し提案、実行します。業務を進めるうえで何か迷うことがあれば、チャットや F2F の会話を通して気軽に相談しながら、チーム全体でサポートし合います。フレックスが基本ですが、原則 18 時以降は会議やメールは行いません。有給休暇の取得率も高く長期休暇も、もちろん取得可能です。

An acting site lead works 3 to 4 days per week in a site under construction, leading safety management and solving complex technical issues that cross vendors and other departments. Propose, and implement documents to improve work processes and standards while collaborating with global team. If they have any questions while working, feel free
to consult other members through chat or F2F conversations, and the entire team will support each other. Flextime is the norm, and generally there are no meetings or emails after 6pm. We have a high rate of paid vacations, and of course they can take long vacations.

About the team
チームメンバーは総勢36名で、年間 2～4サイトの新規サイト立ち上げるおよび数十の既存サイトにおける改造プロジェクトにおいて、現場リード 1 名と施工管理者複数名が着工から稼働までプロジェクトを指揮します。 チームメンバーは機械・電気工学から建設の分野までさまざまなバックグラウンドを持っていますが、定期的なチームミーティングや現場レビューを通じてお互いの知識や経験を共有し、オープンな議論を行っています。 そうすることで個人のスキル向上を促しながら、チームとしての成長を目指しています。

There are 36 members in the team, and in order to launch 2 to 4 new greenfield sites and multiple legacy site retrofit projects per year, a site deployment lead and multiple construction managers per site will lead the project from the start of construction to go live. Team members have various backgrounds ranging from mechanical and electrical engineering to architectural design, but through regular team meetings and on-site reviews, they share their knowledge and experience and engage in open
discussions. By doing so, we aim to grow as a team while improving individual skills.

descriptionHtml:

Amazon MGM Studios is re-inventing how customers connect with their favorite shows, teams, and products by combining high-quality immersive interactive features and exclusive access to some of the world's most loved movies and TV series. All from a single service available on the web, mobile, and TV in 240+ countries and territories around the world.

Amazon MGM Studios is the movies and television development and production arm of Amazon. title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

This role will be physically based at our new MDD Pecos, TX site.

Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.



A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

-2+ years of relevant work experience
-Experience in relevant work
-Can bend or twist the body into unusual positions while working
-Can use hands to manipulate small wires and objects
-Can walk on job sites in uneven terrain
-Can work at heights and from ladders

Preferred qualifications

-4+ years of data center engineering experience
-Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
-Knowledge of network design and layout as well as low voltage (copper/ fiber) cabling
-Experience in data center engineering
-Can perform physical tasks all day without becoming overly tired

This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary.

As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis.

The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Current valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification by an approved emergency cardiac care (ECC) provider; AND must have one of the following:
- Current valid Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) OR Paramedic Certification from the Department of Health OR the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT); OR
- Current active Athletic Trainer Certification, by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification.

Preferred qualifications

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program
- Experience managing musculoskeletal disorders, ergonomics, and coaching on body mechanics
- Demonstrated work experience with OSHA regulations and Workers Compensation
- Proficient in digital recordkeeping
- In the last year, six months job experience in the Military as a Combat Medic (U.S. Army), Field Medic (U.S. Army), Healthcare Specialist (U.S. Army), Hospital Corpsman (U.S. Navy), or Aerospace Medical Service Technician (U.S. Air Force)

title: Network Technician AWS, Global Network Delivery
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are looking to hire a highly motivated, best-in-class Network Technician to join our team within network infrastructure deployment. The candidate will work with minimum supervision in a dynamic environment to drive the expansion of our next-generation networks.

This is primarily a cable infrastructure role. The successful candidate will own end-to-end cabling project delivery — tracking project milestones, managing cabling vendors, and ensuring quality standards are met across all deliverables. A core part of this role is holding vendors accountable to SLAs, identifying risks early, and driving resolution to keep capacity delivery on schedule.

The position responsibilities will include scaling support of several data center locations and be responsible for day to day assistance with capacity management. The Network Technician will work closely with both internal customers and external vendors to facilitate smooth project execution as directed by Technical Program Managers.

Our ideal candidate is highly autonomous, very detail oriented, possesses strong written and verbal communication skills and has significant experience supporting large scale, enterprise class networks. Excellent network implementation and troubleshooting skills combined with a proven documentation methodology is also required. Strong written and verbal communication skills and an ability to interact efficiently with peers and customers are required. The desire and ability to work in a fast paced, collaborative environment is essential.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage work and priorities through ticketing system and workflow
- Collaborate with various stake holders to remove project obstacles
- Troubleshoot networking, routing and inter connectivity issues, including troubleshooting of network device configuration and low to mid-level application interaction
- Troubleshooting cabling infrastructure connectivity issues, including patch panels and patch cords.
- Specifying Power and Cooling requirements and ensuring Hardware Racking/Stacking completed for new equipment

title: Senior Program Manager, EU AMXL
descriptionHtml:
Our Program Managers are always thinking about the bigger picture. At Amazon, every position offers the chance to influence business decisions and shape what comes next. As a Senior Program Manager in EU AMXL Growth, Profitability and Programs, you will sit at the center of one of Amazon's most premium selection businesses: the operation that moves, delivers, assembles, and installs the largest and most valuable items customers buy. You will own programs that span the entire value chain, from fulfilment and middle mile through last mile, delivery, returns, and the profitability engine that ties it all together.

This is the strategic arm of the EU AMXL Strategy Execution team. You will be the connective tissue that keeps a fast-scaling, multi-country organization coordinated, accountable, and aligned on what matters. You will build and run the operating infrastructure that lets EU AMXL leadership deliver critical programs, track progress, and make high-quality decisions with confidence, and you will personally lead the high-stakes programs that define the three-year path for the business.

You will captain the strategic leadership reviews that steer the organization: Quarterly Business Reviews and the OP1 and OP2 operating plans. You will manage programs that cut across every EU AMXL function and coordinate with NA and International teams, including the country expansion portfolio that brings the AMXL service to new markets. The role carries frequent exposure to seior leaders and decison makers, so you will shape narratives, challenge content quality, and drive clarity at the most senior forums in the organization.

This is a role for someone who thrives on bringing order to complexity: designing the frameworks, cadences, and mechanisms that let a large, distributed organization move fast without losing sight of the long-term vision.

Key job responsibilities
1) Own and operate the EU AMXL planning cadence (OP1, OP2), business reviews, and reporting that keeps the organization aligned from working teams to VP forums.

2) Captain the strategic leadership reviews end to end (QBR, MBR, BMBR, OP1, OP2), coordinating content across 10+ teams to quality bar-raising and executive readiness.

3) Lead high-stakes programs spanning Fulfilment, Middle Mile, Last Mile OTR and UTR, and Returns, driving measurable improvement against the three-year profitability plan.

4) Own the country expansion portfolio: coordinate the programs that bring AMXL to new EU markets, working backwards from launch readiness across operations and finance.

5) Build the mechanisms that keep the organization on plan: trackable goals, quarterly status, year-end reviews, and governance that surfaces risk and drives resolution.

6) Design program management infrastructure (templates, trackers, SOPs) that lets EU AMXL compare initiatives, plan projects, and report results in a common language.

7) Coordinate across Supply Chain, Transportation, Finance, Safety, People, CX, and ACES, and partner with NA and International counterparts across regions.

8) Own the technology roadmap to automate EU AMXL reporting at parity with NA, replacing manual document production with scalable, self-serve mechanisms.

9) Develop program management talent: mentor and coach PMs across EU AMXL teams, and spread the standards and ways of working that make the organization stronger.

A day in the life
No two weeks look the same, because you sit at the intersection of strategy and execution for the whole EU AMXL business. One morning you are running the timeline for a VP-level Quarterly Business Review, pulling inputs from a dozen section owners across four countries and sharpening the strategic narrative before it reaches a Director. That afternoon you are deep in the profitability program, connecting a middle-mile cost initiative to its downstream effect on last-mile delivery and returns, so leadership sees one coherent story instead of six disconnected updates.

The next day you are working the country expansion portfolio: syncing with reatail, 3P, Transporation and Ops teams on launch readiness, comparing mechanisms that already work in other regions, and translating them into an EU plan. You will facilitate a pre-review with directors to pressure-test an OP2 narrative, then step back to improve the goal-tracking framework so the next quarter's updates are more actionable.

You will work shoulder to shoulder with Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Safety, and CX leaders, not as a passive coordinator, but as a thought partner who understands the business well enough to challenge the content and push for clarity. Some weeks lean heavy on document production and stakeholder management. Others are about stepping back to design the systems that make the whole machine run. Across all of them, you are the person who connects fulfilment, middle mile, last mile, returns, and profitability into a single line of sight, and who keeps the organization moving in the same direction.


About the team
Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) looks after heavy and bulky items like large domestic appliances and furniture. Our team manages the end-to-end supply chain across fulfilment, delivery, and returns. What sets this service apart is the extra level of customer care: we don't just deliver large items, we unpack, assemble, and install them, and take away old items where needed. The EU AMXL Strategy Execution team is the operating and strategic backbone of the EU AMXL organization. Having our offices, labs, test floors, and factories all co-located means that we can design the hardware, write the code, test, build, and watch it all come to life. You will partner with Supply Chain, Engineering, Facilities, and Operations teams, and regularly communicate with senior management on status, risks, and change control. You will prioritize high-impact projects, obtain approval from relevant functional leaders, schedule resources, and drive crisp decisions about which work is essential, which can be triaged, and which can be omitted. title: Space Threat Specialist , Leo Launch Security
locations: Kennedy Space Center, FL, United States
descriptionHtml:
This role is essential to deliver consistent, mission-aligned security postures at every launch site; eliminating operational variance, ensuring traceability, and maintaining compliance throughout the mission lifecycle.
The ideal candidate will bring expertise in infrastructure security assessments, aerospace operations security, and stakeholder engagement with launch providers. This is a field-facing, technically oriented role responsible for conducting standardized security evaluations of new or unfamiliar facilities, developing mission-specific security requirements, and working directly with launch providers to establish Amazon-controlled expectations rather than relying on provider-defined standards.
With Amazon's expanding launch operations currently spanning multiple launch providers with additional contracts and locations under evaluation; this role provides the scalability needed to ensure security grows in pace with the program's increasing footprint and launch cadence.
Must be able to pass and maintain a Federal Kennedy Space Center badge


Key job responsibilities
• Provide tailored analysis that combines deep space-domain knowledge — orbital environment, launch and range operations, ground segment, and the commercial and national-security space ecosystem — with open-source data to forecast how threats translate into business impact for Amazon’s space program.
• Identify, analyze, and mitigate security threats to the satellite constellation, launch sites, payload processing, and ground infrastructure, keeping the emphasis on measurable security outcomes and risk reduction.
• Set strategy where it is undefined: define the business problem, set objectives, analyze data, and influence resource allocation and trade-offs across Leo and partner organizations using threat-driven, business-impact justification.
• Translate specialized space-threat analysis into forward-looking security posture, mechanisms, and standards that partner teams adopt, and embed space-threat considerations into system design, site security assessments, and mission planning.
• Develop per-campaign and per-mission threat profiles assessing site-specific, regional, and geopolitical risk to launch operations, and integrate them into site security assessments, evaluation frameworks, and mission security plans in partnership with Launch Operations and Program Management.
• Track the evolving space-threat landscape — counter-space developments, threats to orbital and ground systems, commercial espionage, and supply-chain risk across the space supply base — and forecast how they translate into business and operational impact over time.
• Build repeatable mechanisms and processes that mitigate risk for partner organizations, decouple dependencies, eliminate duplicate effort, and increase the speed and quality of security delivery in the space domain.
• Advise senior leadership through clear written narratives and verbal briefings that drive business and technical decisions, communicating to internal, cross-org, and leadership teams.
• Conduct competitive and commercial analysis of the space sector to anticipate risks to Amazon’s position, including adversary targeting of peer space operators and the broader space supply base.
• Partner with export-control and industrial-security teams to ensure analytical activities and products align with ITAR/EAR and related requirements, and interpret their impact on space programs and cross-border technology flows.
• Hold the team and partners to a high standard for both solutions and practices; mentor and develop others in space-threat analysis and tradecraft.
• Develop and maintain relationships with industry peers, government agencies, space operators, and space-security communities to strengthen Amazon’s space-threat awareness and represent Amazon in external engagements.


A day in the life
No two days look the same, and that is the nature of the role. You might start the morning reviewing open-source developments across the space sector and assessing what a competitor’s launch anomaly, a new counter-space capability, or a shift in the geopolitical picture means for Amazon’s upcoming campaigns. By mid-morning you could be partnering with Launch Operations to shape the threat profile for an upcoming mission, then joining an engineering discussion where you help the team weigh a security trade-off for a upcoming launch. In the afternoon you might brief a Director on how an emerging risk could affect a launch window, build a mechanism that lets partner teams act on space-threat considerations without you in the room, and mentor a teammate through their first mission threat assessment. Throughout, your work stays anchored to a single question: what reduces real risk to the mission, and how do you move the organization to act on it before a threat becomes a problem.

About the team
Leo's Launch Security Team protects Amazon's intellectual property, hardware assets, and launch operations across production and production sites worldwide. The Launch Security pillar delivers governance, intelligence, risk management, and compliance assurance; including infrastructure security assessments, risk treatment planning, audit management, guard force oversight, access control validation, incident response readiness, and new-site security baselining. We work with internal engineering, operations, legal, and corporate security teams as well as external auditors, regulatory bodies, and vendors to ensure Leo's production facilities maintain a robust and continuously improving security posture at every stage, from site activation through operational maturity.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of program management, project management or product management experience
- 7+ years of experience in threat analysis, security analysis, or risk assessment within a government, critical-infrastructure, or highly-regulated sector, with direct experience in space, aerospace, defense, or national security.
- Demonstrated deep domain expertise in the space-security threat landscape — counter-space capabilities, threats to orbital and ground systems, and adversary targeting of commercial space operators.
- Demonstrated ability to provide tailored analysis combining space-domain knowledge with open-source data to forecast business and operational impacts.
- Experience working across an organization to define strategy, influence resource allocation, and lead execution on complex, cross-functional security programs.
- Experience distilling complex analysis into clear written narratives and briefings for senior leadership and executive audiences.
- Ability to travel up to 20% to support launch campaigns, site evaluations, and partner engagements at domestic and international locations.
- Bachelor’s degree in security management, homeland security, risk assessment, or related field.

Preferred qualifications

- Possess an active TS/SCI clearance or have held a TS/SCI clearance within the last 2 years.
- Experience overseeing security protocols in aerospace environments with complex regulatory and operational risk landscapes.
- Experience in industrial security design implementation within high-security technology or manufacturing environments.
- Familiarity with security industry standards (CPTED, ASIS standards, tiered classification frameworks).
- Experience working with contract security providers (guard force, monitoring services, system integrators).
- Knowledge of access control, intrusion detection, video surveillance, and alarm monitoring systems.
- Professional certifications such as CPP, PSP, PCI, or equivalent security industry credentials.
- Experience with export control compliance (ITAR/EAR) in a manufacturing or lab environment.
- Experience managing capital and operational security budgets across multiple facilities.
- Experience building launch playbooks or repeatable processes for new site security standup.
- Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity, drive programs to completion, and influence without authority

title: Partner Solutions Architect, SAP, AWS EMEA APO Partner Solutions Architecture, Enterprise Applications
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about how SAP workloads transform when they move to the cloud — and about the innovation that becomes possible once they are there? As a Partner Solutions Architect focused on SAP, you will work with AWS Consulting and Technology Partners across EMEA to help them build, migrate, and modernize SAP solutions on AWS, and then unlock new value on top of those estates with AWS data, analytics, generative AI, agentic systems, and intelligent automation.
You will enable partners on SAP on AWS architectures — migration, resilience, security, and modernization — and guide them to combine SAP with AWS capabilities to deliver differentiated customer outcomes at scale. SAP sits at the core of how millions of companies run their day-to-day operations; you will help partners modernize these mission-critical estates and build the next generation of intelligent solutions on top of them, accelerating their customers’ businesses across EMEA.
This is a role for a self-starter who is energised by ambiguity, has a bias for action, and can identify untapped opportunities — someone who sees what others miss and builds where others wait, operating at the intersection of enterprise SAP landscapes, AWS cloud, and emerging technology.

Key job responsibilities
• Support Partner go-to-market motions with technical guidance and thought leadership on SAP on AWS — covering migration, modernization, resilience, security, and innovation on top of SAP.
• Enable AWS Partners and internal AWS teams on the adoption and delivery of SAP on AWS solutions — architecture, migration methodology, workshop delivery, and customer engagement across the full lifecycle.
• Create best practices and architectural guidance on SAP on AWS — landing zones, high availability and disaster recovery, security and compliance, and cost optimization — being a thought leader in the area.
• Drive SAP + AWS innovation — generative AI, agentic AI, and intelligent automation — architecting and delivering demonstrations, proofs of concept, and reference architectures that partners can replicate and customize for their customers.
• Support go-to-market for SAP solutions including SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), Business Data Cloud, and Cloud ERP (GROW with SAP), tying together AWS and partner offerings across data, analytics, AI, and infrastructure into comprehensive solutions.
• Build and grow partner capabilities (GSIs, ISVs, regional SIs) through enablement workshops, technical guides, and co-build engagements.
• Be the technical reference on SAP for the EMEA Partner Organization, collecting and surfacing the work done across the region.
• Collaborate with AWS account teams, professional services, and commercial sales to bridge partner capabilities with customer demand for SAP transformation.
• Engage line-of-business executives and key stakeholders through business-value-led conversations on strategic opportunities.
• Represent partner needs to AWS service teams, influencing roadmaps and advocating for features that accelerate partner adoption of SAP on AWS.
• Publish thought leadership (blogs, whitepapers, reference architectures), represent AWS at industry events, and contribute to the Partner Solutions Architecture community through knowledge sharing, mentoring, and hiring.


A day in the life
No two days are the same. You might start by whiteboarding an SAP on AWS landing zone with a consulting partner’s delivery team, reviewing high-availability, disaster-recovery, and security design for a large S/4HANA migration. Later, you could be building a generative AI demo on Amazon Bedrock that orchestrates SAP workflows, or showing a partner how to extend SAP with AWS data and analytics services.
After lunch, you might run a workshop with SI partners on a new reference architecture, before ending the day in a strategy session to refine an ongoing sales play based on newly released AWS for SAP solutions. You will also spend time creating reusable enablement assets, guiding partners through SAP on AWS best practices, and collaborating with AWS field teams to match partner capabilities with customer demand. Some days are heavy on building; others on presenting, teaching, or strategizing — but the pace of innovation is constant.

About the team
You will join the EMEA Partner Solutions Architecture (PSA) organization within the AWS Partner Organization (APO). The PSA team serves as a scale engine for AWS, propelling growth by recruiting, activating, and developing partners. We provide the technical enablement and thought leadership that helps partners build and sell solutions on AWS.
This role sits within the Solutions PSA team, which drives AWS growth through differentiated partner solutions across industries and horizontals — including SAP and enterprise applications. The team operates across EMEA, collaborating with commercial sales, industry SAs, and the broader partner ecosystem. You will have flexibility to travel across the region to work directly with partners and attend industry events.
AWS champions diversity and welcomes candidates with non-traditional backgrounds and varied experiences. Our team environment emphasizes curiosity, mentorship, and continuous learning, and we support professional growth while maintaining work-life harmony.

- Experience developing technology solutions and evangelising end-to-end technology roadmaps that guide IT transformations toward cloud computing
- Experience in specific technology domain areas like software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences and at C-level, including training, workshops, publications
- Professional working proficiency with SAP
- Experience in the automotive and manufacturing domains
- 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of large scale automation and workflow management or equivalent
- Knowledge of database design and implementation or equivalent
- Knowledge of presentations and whiteboarding skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with internal and external executives, IT management, and developers
- Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
- Hands-on experience migrating or operating SAP workloads on the cloud (S/4HANA migrations, SAP HANA, high availability and disaster recovery).
- Experience extending SAP with cloud data, analytics, or generative AI — e.g. integrating SAP business data with data lakes, analytics, or AI/ML services.
