title: Data Center Controls Tech, Deployment
descriptionHtml:
The Data Center Global Controls team is looking for exceptional individuals to join our Controls organization as a Controls Technician for Service & Construction of the Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) within Amazon data centers. If you are passionate about the Customer Experience, think and act globally and have the ability to contribute to major new innovations in the area of building controls and automation this is the challenge you are looking for!

The candidate will possess technical background and experience in installation, troubleshooting, operations and/or maintenance of field sensors, controllers, wiring, networking and programming associated with the industrial controls systems. The candidate may also have relevant experience operating and maintaining mission critical electrical and mechanical systems. A Controls Technician shall be responsible for participating in the installation, testing, troubleshooting and startup of equipment and controls system associated with the BMS and EPMS system deployment in the data centers. A Controls Technician is expected to actively innovate on behalf of their customers in the area of Data Center building automation.

Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

Key job responsibilities
· Primarily work in and support multiple Data Centers by Deploying, Servicing, and Upgrading BMS and EPMS systems.
· Mentor and train Facilities team members on operation and control of the BMS and EPMS systems.
· Audit, maintain, and manage computer enterprise asset management systems for BMS and EPMS installations
· Manage small to medium size projects and programs.
· Perform point to point checkouts between field devices and controllers.
· Perform first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting and maintenance of programming code and hardware associated with the BMS and EPMS in data centers.
· Perform provisioning process for servers, controllers, industrial PCs and network configurations and communication testing between third party devices and controllers or servers.
· Installation, replacement, configuration, and calibration of sensors.
· Able to read and understand Electrical schematics, control panel drawings. Basic understanding of close loop controls, field sensors scaling, and functions typically performed by industrial controllers.
· Supervise low voltage electrical contractors who performing wiring and installation of field devices in compliance with AWS requirements.
· Commissioning and systems level testing support.
· Create red-lined drawings and documentation of systems.
· Follow change management process to generate work requests and method of procedures.
· Participate in Factory witnessed tests at vendor's or panel builder's facility.
· Perform other tasks as assigned by manager.
· Recommend design improvements based on consultation with users and system operation.
· Perform root cause analysis during testing and commissioning.
· Ensure all personnel on site utilize proper safety methodology.
· Work on-call and a rotating schedule when required and respond to after-hours emergencies.
· Perform service activities such as monitoring/reviewing ticketing systems, performing root cause analysis, and prioritizing tasks.
· Actively manage service agreements to include vendor labor scheduling, quality assurance, and financial invoice review.

Physical Requirements:

· Walk jobsites in uneven terrain and work at heights and from ladders.
· Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.
· On occasions, lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

*Why AWS*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of professional work experience, or experience in technical work related to computer systems and technology components
- Technical (Military/ Trade School) School diploma or Associate degree with one year experience related to industrial instrumentation/controls or equivalent electrical or mechanical operations experience.
- Minimum one year of experience with mission critical low and medium voltage electrical and/or mechanical systems.

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of relevant work in a data center or other critical environment experience
- Fundamental knowledge of network design and layout as well as low voltage (copper/ fiber) cabling.
- Basic understanding of Industrial controls system, controllers, and programming including troubleshooting of industrial controls analog, discrete and networked input/output field signals.
- International Society of Automation (ISA) Certified Controls System Technician (CCST) Level I or higher certification.

title: Package Engineer, Annapurna Labs - AI Silicon Packaging
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs designs silicon and software that accelerates innovation. Customers choose us to create cloud solutions that solve challenges that were unimaginable a short time ago. Our custom chips, accelerators, and software stacks enable us to take on technical challenges that have never been seen before, and deliver results that help our customers change the world.

The Package Technology Development team within Annapurna Labs is building the packaging, substrate/PCB, interposer, and assembly technologies for the next-generation Trainium AI accelerators. The team works at the intersection of silicon, package, board, system, and rack, partnering closely with design, manufacturing, supply chain, and reliability teams to bring bleeding-edge AI systems from concept to volume production.

Key job responsibilities
- Define and drive package technology development across architecture, design, materials, processes, yield, warpage, reliability, and system-level integration for next-generation Trainium systems, from early concept through volume production.
- Partner with OSATs and component/material/equipment suppliers on capability validation, test vehicle development, qualification, TGA, FMEA, risk retirement, root-cause analysis, and corrective/preventive actions
- Evaluate tradeoffs across performance, cost, yield, manufacturability, warpage, thermal performance, and reliability to guide technology decisions and qualification strategies.
- Represent the package technology team in cross-functional design reviews, sign-off milestones, and program checkpoints with silicon, board, system, and supply chain teams.
- Identify opportunities for novel packaging architectures and process simplifications to reduce cost, improve yield, and accelerate time-to-market.

Basic qualifications

- Experience coordinating between technical teams, peers and business stakeholders
- Bachelor's in Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or 6+ years of industry experience in a related field
- Expertise in at least one: substrate/PCB technology, interposer technology, or package and board assembly technology
- Track record of driving technology development from concept through qualification

Preferred qualifications

- Master's in Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or 8+ years of industry experience in a related field
- Or PhD in Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or 6+ years of industry experience in a related field
- Familiarity with package-level SI/PI concepts (impedance control, PDN design, crosstalk-aware routing) sufficient to collaborate with SI/PI engineers
- Experience with substrate/PCB architecture, materials, processes, yield, warpage, and DFM for advanced systems, including HDI, microvias, fine-line/space, and high-speed/power routing
- Experience with interposer fabrication and DFM for 2.5D/3D systems (e.g., CoWoS-R/L), including RDL, TSV, silicon bridges, microbumps, and package floorplanning
- Experience with package and board assembly processes, including flip-chip, thermal compression bonding, hybrid bonding, underfill, molding, TIM, and fine-pitch assembly. Co-packaged optics (CPO) experience is a plus.

title: Area Manager, Operations
descriptionHtml:
When you join Amazon as an Area Manager, you’ll gain experience leading a large and diverse team to make sure your area of the business keeps pace with demand. In this hands-on role, you’ll learn about the complexity of operations at a global business and what it takes to make everything run seamlessly. While you implement your team’s approach to drive productivity, you’ll also work closely with your colleagues to address challenges, which means no two days will be the same.

Key job responsibilities
- Promote a culture of safety and wellbeing
- Analyse and implement corrective actions to make sure quality and productivity are at consistently high levels, and business objectives are met across all shifts
- Support and lead a team and handle administrative work alongside building and supporting a strong team culture
- Analyse performance and suggest process improvements to optimise work and improve customer service
- Collaborate with other managers to standardise shift processes

A day in the life
You’ll work shifts and be based at one of our operational sites. Your main focus will be to maintain safety standards within your team and across your site. You’ll also monitor and maintain process efficiency. Your days will always include prioritising routine team management and daily operational tasks, alongside other tasks like individual escalations, process improvement work and wide-scale operational contingency planning.
Being a key part of the operations team involves working with colleagues in other teams and external partners to make sure we stay on track to meet our customer demands and targets. This will involve analysing data and performance metrics with leaders in your business area, as well as discussing the operational pros and cons of technical improvements with engineers.

About the team
Customer Fulfilment, or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. CF has scaled up from a humble team of booksellers to a sophisticated global team which handles more than 1.5 million orders every day. The team is the foundation of our business and its efforts have helped us diversify across new regions and services. With the help of emerging technology, we’re always looking for ways to offer a bigger, better product range – delivered quickly and affordably.

The CF team are the first people in the chain that helps customers get products at the speed we’re known for. We’re based in Fulfilment Centres, which are at the heart of Amazon’s fast-paced Operations network. Our centres are sometimes referred to as the ‘First Mile’ because it’s where most Amazon packages start their journey. We help to manage dynamic inventory and facilitate speedy deliveries round the clock.

Lots of different people work in our Fulfilment Centres, so there are plenty of opportunities for every skillset. Some of us work with physical products, while others analyse data to help everyone across the business make smart decisions.

Basic qualifications

- Experience managing people
- Experience working with multiple groups of stakeholders
- Experience using data to influence business decisions
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- Bachelor's degree, or Advanced degree
- Local Language Proficiency

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma and Kaizen techniques
- Experience working with the MS Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) in a professional environment
- Experience working in another logistics environment

title: Sr. Regional Enviro Engineer -Water Compliance, AWS Environmental Team
descriptionHtml:
As a Regional Environmental Engineer (REE) specializing in water compliance, you will support water-related environmental compliance at AWS data centers. You will provide technical expertise in permitting and compliance across National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (NPDES), Significant Industrial User (SIU) discharge, potable water systems, groundwater wells, onsite wastewater treatment systems, stormwater, and water-quality monitoring and reporting. You will evaluate existing and proposed infrastructure, develop scalable compliance programs and technical standards, monitor environmental performance, and partner with design, construction, operations, and other stakeholders to incorporate water-related regulatory requirements into site design and operation.

Key job responsibilities
• Lead water compliance programs for water supply and discharge across US data center locations
• Develop and maintain the water compliance program that guides how sites and REEs obtain, renew, modify, interpret, and implement NPDES and other water discharge permits under the Clean Water Act, 40 CFR Part 122, and applicable state regulations, and translate effluent limitations, monitoring, operating, reporting, and notification requirements into site-level compliance programs
• Provide guidance on evaluating regulatory applicability and permitting requirements for new sites, expansions, operational changes, and new or modified discharges
• Provide guidance on evaluating industrial wastewater and stormwater permitting and compliance, including federal pretreatment under 40 CFR Part 403, local sewer-use ordinances, POTW requirements, pollution-prevention plans, inspections, best management practices, monitoring, and reporting
• Provide technical guidance on potable water systems and onsite wastewater systems, including design, operation, monitoring, and compliance under applicable drinking-water and septic requirements
• Develop standard templates and technical guidance for water-quality sampling and monitoring plans, review site plans, and set standards for sampling equipment, monitoring systems, and analytical methods under 40 CFR Part 136
• Evaluate water and wastewater treatment processes, system performance, waste-stream characterization, water balances, and discharge pathways to determine permitting and compliance implications
• Build the mechanisms, dashboards, and metrics that track water-quality data, lab reports, DMRs, and compliance performance, and support sites in identifying trends, exceedances, corrective actions, and forecasting across sites
• Read and evaluate engineering plans, process-flow diagrams, P&IDs, and specifications, and partner with design, engineering, construction, and operations teams to build water-related controls into current and future designs early
• Clearly communicate the technical and regulatory basis for environmental requirements and influence partner teams to implement compliant, practical, and scalable solutions
• Set the standards and oversight mechanisms that keep work by employees, contractors, and consultants aligned with applicable environmental requirements and Amazon standards
• Support REEs and sites in their interactions with regulatory agencies, utilities, POTWs, consultants, and contractors, and engage directly on program-level matters
• Support time-critical regulatory notifications, permit applications, and monitoring reports, and support emergency response planning and incident investigations, including root causes and corrective and preventive actions
• Develop and deliver water compliance training for relevant staff
• Stay current with evolving water regulations and industry best practices for domestic and non-contact cooling, particularly in the data center sector


About the team

title: Principal Business Development Manager, AWS Private Equity
descriptionHtml:
Would you like to own managing relationships with the Private Equity (PE) community, and influencing decision making towards utilizing Amazon Web Services as the basis for their portfolio companies’ infrastructure? Do you have the business savvy, the technical insight, and the background necessary to mesh with the PE ecosystem and to help further establish Amazon as the leader in the cloud computing space?

As a business development manager within AWS, you will have the exciting opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy to build mind share and broad use of Amazon’s cloud computing platform within the PE firms and their portfolio companies. Your responsibilities will include identifying appropriate PE’s to target, driving the necessary business, strategic and technical relationships with the PE and their portfolio companies to establish new business in those accounts, and working closely with the AWS sales team to drive the day-to-day interactions with the portfolio companies in order to build long-term business opportunity. title: EHS Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. As a Workplace Health & Safety Specialist (WHSS), you'll be at the forefront of transforming workplace safety culture at one of the world's most innovative companies. Your expertise and dedication will directly protect employees, ensuring they return home safely to their families every day. You'll facilitate new approaches to safety, combining technology with human-centered solutions to create an environment where safety and productivity thrive together. This isn't just about maintaining safety standards – it's about revolutionizing how we think about and implement workplace safety, making a lasting impact on our people and operations. As your building's designated safety champion, you'll have the unique opportunity to build relationships, influence positive change, and help write the next chapter in Amazon's commitment to becoming Earth's Safest Place to Work.

Core Impact Areas:
Safety Program Excellence & Implementation - Drive comprehensive safety programs through data-driven strategies. Lead daily safety audits, incident investigations, and risk assessments while implementing innovative solutions to prevent injuries. Deliver engaging safety training that resonates with associates and promotes a proactive safety culture. Champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance workplace safety while maintaining operational efficiency.

Associate Advocacy & Cultural Leadership - Serve as a trusted safety advisor and advocate for associate wellbeing, building strong partnerships across all levels of the organization. Foster a culture where safety is everyone's priority through effective communication, coaching, and positive reinforcement. Develop strong relationships with frontline associates and leadership to drive behavioral changes and ensure safety best practices become natural habits. Transform safety data into compelling narratives that influence positive change and drive engagement in safety initiatives.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site

Must be available to work flexible shifts including days, nights and/or weekends.

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent
- A minimum of 1 year in an Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) related field OR; A Bachelor’s degree in EHS-relevant background OR; 6 months experience performing in a safety-related role within Amazon
- Knowledge of OSHA regulations specifically 29 CFR 1910
- Experience using Microsoft Word and Excel in a professional capacity
- Experience maintaining confidentiality in matter involving security and/or personnel issues in the workplace

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree or higher, preferably in a safety related field
- Strong communication, teamwork, analysis, judgment, and customer focus skills
- Experience leading and managing a team, ability to analyze accident data, new processes, and machinery for potential safety concerns, and conduct job hazard and job safety analyses
- Experience in emergency response and currently holds First Aid and CPR certificates
- Experience in workers compensation case management

descriptionHtml:

The Credit & Lending team at Amazon Pay is building Amazon's next-generation lending platform to enable seamless credit experiences for millions of customers across Latin America. We are looking for a strong Software Development Engineer to join our Brazil engineering team and build highly scalable, resilient lending systems from the ground up.

This is a greenfield opportunity. You'll design and deliver critical components of the lending platform including underwriting, loan servicing, repayments, regulatory reporting, and customer-facing experiences. You'll work with latest fintech challenges: real-time decisioning, payment orchestration, compliance automation, and financial data integrity at scale.

This role is ideal for an engineer who wants deep ownership, loves solving hard technical problems, and is energized by the ambiguity and pace of building something new in a regulated, high-stakes domain.

What You'll Do
Design and build core services for the 1P Lending platform in Brazil—spanning underwriting, servicing, repayments, accounting, and compliance.
Write high-quality, production-ready code for backend and Frontend services, with a focus on reliability, testability, and operational excellence.
Own system architecture decisions for your area—API design, data modeling, event-driven flows, and integration patterns with internal and external partners.
Build for compliance—implement systems that meet Brazilian financial regulations (Central Bank reporting, PIX, Open Finance) with auditability and data integrity baked in.
Operate what you build—own monitoring, alarming, on-call, and incident response for your services. Drive high availability and low-latency targets.
Solve ambiguous problems—break down complex business and regulatory requirements into clean, extensible technical solutions.
Collaborate cross-functionally—work closely with product, finance, tax, risk, legal, and partner integration teams to translate requirements into working systems.
Contribute to platform reuse—build shared libraries, frameworks, and architectural patterns that enable scaling across LATAM markets.
Raise the bar—participate actively in code reviews, design reviews, and hiring. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team culture.

A day in the life
Own a critical product pillar of the 1P Lending platform in Brazil (define the product vision, technical strategy, and execution roadmap.
Work with a team of 7-8 SDEs, setting a high bar for engineering excellence, code quality, operational rigor, and customer obsession.
Be an engineering voice on the ground, driving local execution while staying tightly connected to the broader LATAM and global platform teams.
Design and build highly scalable, resilient, and secure distributed systems for real-time underwriting, loan servicing, repayments, accounting, and compliance.
Drive technical decisions on architecture, API design, data modeling, and system integration with internal services and external financial partners.
Navigate regulatory and compliance complexity—partner with legal, finance, tax, and risk teams to build technology that meets Brazilian financial regulations (Central Bank, PIX, Open Finance).
Establish operational excellence—own system availability, latency, monitoring, alarming, on-call processes, and incident management for your product area.
Influence the broader platform by contributing reusable components, shared libraries, and cross-market architectural patterns.

Basic qualifications

- Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
- Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Duales Studium - Automation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Du möchtest verstehen, wie Roboter, Sensoren und automatisierte Anlagen zusammenspielen?

Bei Amazon setzt du dein Wissen direkt in der Praxis ein. Du arbeitest an Anlagen, die Produkte durch eines der komplexesten Logistiknetzwerke der Welt bewegen. Vom ersten Tag an übernimmst du Verantwortung, arbeitest Seite an Seite mit erfahrenen Automation Engineers und siehst den direkten Einfluss deiner Arbeit.

Als Teil von Amazon eröffnet sich dir ein Universum an Möglichkeiten: Zugang zu modernster Technik, vielfältige Karrierewege und ein Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen zählen und du früh gefördert und gefordert wirst.

Während des dualen Studiums besuchst du die Hochschule, um einen Bachelor of Engineering (B.Eng.) mit Vertiefung Automatisierungstechnik zu erwerben. In einem Trainingszentrum erhältst du eine praktische Grundausbildung, und bei Amazon wendest du dein Wissen direkt an, an der Seite von erfahrenen Automation Engineers, die dich fördern und fordern.

Dabei entwickelst du Kenntnisse in Elektronik und Elektrotechnik, Informationstechnik, Programmierung sowie Automatisierungs- und Steuerungstechnik. Gleichzeitig tauchst du in Zukunftsthemen wie Robotik, Smart Systems und IoT ein.

Beginn: 01.08.2027
Standort: Winsen (Luhe)
Hochschule: HAW Hamburg
Ausbildungszentrum: Siemens AG Hamburg

Du tüftelst gerne, packst mit an und willst früh Verantwortung übernehmen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Key job responsibilities
• Hardware Engineering und Konfiguration von Anlagen
• Inbetriebnahme komplexer Infrastruktursysteme
• Arbeit mit Automatisierungssystemen und Prozessvisualisierungen
• Intelligente Fabrikautomation mit Cloud-Konnektivität
• IoT-Anwendungen in der Gebäude- und Anlagentechnik
• Installation elektrischer Einrichtungen
• Prüfung von elektrischen, pneumatischen und hydraulischen Steuerungen
• Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Automation Engineers und technischen Teams an realen Projekten

A day in the life
Deine Ausbildung verbindet Theorie und Praxis von Anfang an. Deine theoretische Ausbildung absolvierst du an der Hochschule sowie in einem Trainingszentrum, während du die praktischen Kenntnisse direkt bei Amazon an deinem Standort erwirbst.

Ein typischer Tag? Du analysierst gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Automation Engineers eine Störung an einer Förder- oder Sortieranlage, tauschst Komponenten aus und bringst das System wieder zum Laufen. An einem anderen Tag konfigurierst du eine Steuerung und nimmst neue Technik in Betrieb. Und dann gibt es die Tage, an denen du an einem Projekt rund um Robotik, Sensorik oder IoT mitarbeitest.

Kein Tag ist wie der andere – mal stehst du an der Anlage, mal suchst du Fehler vor Ort, mal analysierst und optimierst du Systeme am Computer.

Du arbeitest von Anfang an mit erfahrenen Automation Engineers zusammen, lernst von ihnen und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung. Du probierst Dinge aus und lernst Fähigkeiten, von denen du vorher nicht wusstest, dass es sie gibt.

Basic qualifications

- Allgemeine Hochschulreife, Fachhochschulreife / fachgebundene Hochschulreife
- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (C1-Niveau)
- Fortgeschrittene Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (B2-Niveau)
- Erste praktische Erfahrungen im Bereich Elektro-/ Automatisierungs-/ Steuerungstechnik oder verwandten Bereichen

Preferred qualifications

- Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Eigeninitiative, Vorbildfunktion und „Hands-on-Mentalität"
- Proaktives Vorantreiben von Veränderungsprozessen und eigenverantwortliche Entscheidungsfindung
- Umgang mit MS-Office (insbesondere Kenntnisse in Excel, Word und PowerPoint)
- Bist du interessiert? Wir freuen uns darauf, von Dir zu hören! Bitte bewirb Dich mit deinen vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen auf Deutsch (Lebenslauf, Zeugniskopie – ein PDF mit 5 MB max.). Sollten die Bewerbungsunterlagen nicht vollständig sein, können wir deine Bewerbung leider nicht berücksichtigen! Business Growth

title: Delivery Consultant - Migrations, AWS Professional Services
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in leading large-scale portfolio assessment and application disposition for enterprise data centre exit programmes spanning multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions. You'll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure through discovery tooling and application owner interviews, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS — assigning R-strategies (Rehost, Replatform, Refactor, Retire, Retain, Relocate) and designing wave plans that respect dependency groupings, capacity constraints, and regulatory frozen zones. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on migration best practices, risk mitigation, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the end-to-end migration assessment process, ensuring adherence to AWS well-architected principles, optimizing wave sequencing, and managing risks throughout the programme lifecycle.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key job responsibilities
• Own Portfolio Assessment for assigned application estates (1,000+ servers), scoring apps across dimensions from Technical Designs and CMDB data
• Apply the migration decision tree to assign R-strategies (Rehost/Replatform/Refactor/Retire/Retain/Relocate) and document rationale in Architecture Decision Records
• Build and maintain dependency maps using applications, resolving conflicting data between tooling output and application owner interviews
• Design wave plans: group applications by dependency, balance capacity, respect regulatory frozen zones, and coordinate across geographies
• Run Tech Bridge sessions with customer application owners to validate disposition decisions and unblock migration paths
• Feed wave planning into AWS Transform, ensuring move groups are sized, sequenced, and ready for factory execution
• Proactively identify and escalate risks to wave timelines — then propose and drive mitigations before they become blockers
• Collaborate with Security, Networking, and Replatform teams to ensure cross-cutting dependencies are addressed in wave sequencing

title: Sr. Lab Buildout and Operations Manager, Integration & Test, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a hands-on Lab Buildout and Operations Manager to own the deployment, readiness, and sustained operation of RF, networking, and system-integration lab environments. This role will manage lab infrastructure buildouts across Austin and Seattle ensuring labs are built, instrumented, networked, documented, and operationally ready for engineering use.

The ideal candidate has a strong mix of lab operations, RF test infrastructure, networking, procurement, vendor management, and hands-on systems experience. This person should be comfortable working across engineering, facilities, procurement, vendors, and site leadership to turn unclear lab requirements into executable build plans.

Key Responsibilities
Lab Buildout and Site Readiness
- Own end-to-end lab buildout execution for RF and system-integration environments across Austin and Seattle.
- Coordinate deployment of racks, benches, chambers, RF infrastructure, test equipment, control stations, cabling, power, grounding, cooling, and secure lab network access.
- Drive readiness for RF test areas, integrated system test beds, hardware-in-the-loop environments, and production-representative lab setups.
- Partner with Facilities, Networking, Security, Hardware, RF, Software, and Test teams to ensure lab spaces are usable, safe, scalable, and -operationally reliable.
- Maintain lab bring-up schedules, punch lists, dependency trackers, and operational readiness checklists.

RF, Network, and Test Infrastructure Operations
- Support RF lab environments including chambers, antennas, attenuators, channel emulators, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, RF cabling, timing sources, and related instrumentation.
- Support lab network design and operations, including VLANs, routing, switching, firewall access, remote access, control-plane connectivity, and test-device isolation.
- Ensure lab infrastructure can support integration, regression, throughput, latency, mobility, handover, timing, and multi-device validation.
- Drive uptime and reliability improvements for lab systems, including monitoring, alerting, access control, inventory tracking, and failure-response processes.
- Standardize lab configurations, diagrams, runbooks, rack elevations, port maps, cable labels, and operational procedures across sites.

Procurement, Vendor, and Budget Execution
- Own procurement tracking for lab equipment, RF components, network gear, racks, cables, tools, fixtures, chambers, and facility-dependent infrastructure.
- Translate technical needs into BOMs, purchase requests, vendor quotes, lead-time tracking, and delivery schedules.
- Manage vendor coordination for chamber deployment, electrical work, cooling, RF infrastructure, installation labor, and equipment calibration.
- Track CapEx/Opex needs, delivery risks, dependencies, and site constraints; escalate issues early with clear options and impact.
- Maintain asset inventory and lifecycle tracking for lab hardware, instruments, network devices, and shared test infrastructure.

Cross-Site Execution and Travel
- Travel regularly to Austin and Seattle to support lab buildouts, readiness reviews, vendor work, infrastructure deployment, and operational handoffs. 20-30% travel
- Act as the on-site execution lead during critical lab moves, new building bring-up, chamber installations, RF infrastructure deployment, and major test-bed readiness efforts.
- Build repeatable lab standards so each site can be deployed and operated consistently while still supporting local engineering needs.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with the project management of technical projects
- 7+ years of experience in lab operations, hardware development management, systems development, RF test, network operations, or infrastructure deployment.
- Experience building, operating, or maintaining engineering labs, RF labs, network labs, telecom labs, or hardware-in-the-loop environments.
- Working knowledge of RF test environments, including chambers, antennas, RF cabling, attenuators, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, or channel emulators.
- Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including switching, routing, VLANs, IP addressing, firewall rules, remote access, and lab network segmentation.
- Experience managing procurement, BOMs, vendors, delivery schedules, asset tracking, and equipment lifecycle.
- Ability to create and maintain lab documentation, rack diagrams, port maps, build plans, readiness checklists, and operational runbooks.
- Ability to travel regularly between Austin and Seattle.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with satellite communications, wireless systems, telecom, RF validation, mobility, maritime, or customer-terminal validation.
- Experience supporting anechoic chambers, RF shielded rooms, integrated RF test beds, or large-scale system-integration environments.
- Experience with Linux and Windows lab hosts, test controllers, remote access systems, automation frameworks, and telemetry/logging tools.
- Experience with lab monitoring, dashboards, alerting, inventory systems, and uptime reporting.
- Experience with network gear from vendors such as Cisco, Arista, MikroTik, Juniper, or similar.
- Experience coordinating facilities work such as electrical, grounding, cooling, rack power, structured cabling, and space planning.
- Strong ability to operate in ambiguous environments where lab requirements, schedules, and dependencies are still being defined.

title: Area Manager II - Tracy, CA
descriptionHtml:
Lead a frontline team inside one of Amazon's most advanced robotics fulfillment centers.

As an Area Manager at our Tracy, CA site (OAK4), you own a shift and a team — you'll directly shape how millions of customer orders move safely, accurately, and on time. This isn't a desk job; it's a leadership proving ground where your decisions have same-day impact and your team looks to you to set the tone.

Our Operations network delivers for Amazon customers every day across three major workflows: First Mile (where product is housed and ready for order), Middle Mile (where the order is hauled to your area), and Last Mile (when the product is delivered to the customer's door). All workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our dedication to the customer.


What you'll gain
You'll run a shift inside one of Amazon's most advanced robotics (AR) sortable fulfillment centers — a high-tech operation where your team works alongside automation to move products at scale. This is hands-on experience you can't get just anywhere: leading people in a fast-paced, tech-forward environment, driving process improvement, and building operational expertise that's valued across the industry. You'll sharpen skills in people leadership, data-driven decision-making, safety and quality management, and continuous improvement.

Life at OAK4
OAK4 is a high-tech robotics (AR) sortable fulfillment center — a 1M+ sq ft operation where associates work alongside automation to move products smaller than a microwave. It's a modern, tech-forward floor: a place to build real Lean / process-improvement expertise and lead in a innovative operations environment.

Why Tracy, CA?
Tracy gives you Bay Area access without Bay Area housing prices — sitting at the crossroads of I-205, I-580, and I-5 with easy reach to the Bay and Sacramento. Expect roughly 73% sunny days a year, above-average schools, low crime, parks, farmers markets, and local wine country. A great fit for families and anyone who wants more space for their money.

What you'll do
- Support, mentor, and motivate your hourly team — your leadership is the difference-maker
- Own safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises for your area
- Partner with Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, and Human Resources to hit business goals
- Drive continuous improvement and solve problems in real time on the floor

Key job responsibilities
* Support, mentor, and motivate your hourly workforce
* Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises

title: Sr Manager, Portfolio Strategy , XCM
descriptionHtml:
The Portfolio Strategy & Planning team determines how Amazon invests its fixed marketing portfolio across the Amazon and Prime brands in North America. We build the planning frameworks, investment strategies, and inspection cycles that shape where, when, and how brand marketing shows up for customers. This is a strategy role. You will support and co-lead the analytical foundation that turns consumer research, business intelligence, media performance data, and econometric/ROI reads into investment recommendations for senior executive audiences. You will contribute to telling senior leaders where to invest, where to cut, and why. The primary output of this team is written memorandums for senior leadership (Directors upwards), so the ability to make data tell a clear story on paper without “marketing fluff” is the core skill.
You will work primarily with the Cross-Category and Channel Marketing (XCM) organization in North America, and partner closely with finance, measurement, performance marketing, and media planning teams. This is not a media planning role. Media planning is a close collaborator. Our job as Portfolio Strategists is to build the strategic scaffolding that media planning executes against.



Key job responsibilities
What You'll Do
- Support the annual Operating Plan (OP1/OP2) development for North America's fixed marketing portfolio, coordinating inputs from media, campaign teams, customer insights, finance, and measurement into a single integrated investment recommendation.
- Reconcile top-down financial guardrails with bottom-up media cost realities. Co-lead in defining the trade-offs and present them with a clear recommendation, not a menu of options.
- Own the Quarterly Business Review (QBR) process: inspect input and output metrics, surface risks early, and recommend course corrections with quantified impact.
- Manage spend tracking across budget owners (media, production, measurement) and coordinate quarterly guidance updates with Finance.
- Co-Lead bi-annual portfolio laydown reviews to ensure execution stays aligned to strategy. Flag drift and propose fixes.
- Synthesize consumer research, business intelligence, econometric models, and media performance data into a holistic view of which marketing bets to fund, scale, or cut.
- Support the development of investment strategies that optimize short- and long-term returns across Amazon's priority categories, including grocery and healthcare.
- Partner with business intelligence and measurement teams to improve marketing and customer lifecycle measurement. Push for better data where current reads are insufficient.
- Write and present high-quality documents to Directors and support in the creation of VP and SVP documents. Support in the translation of complex analytical findings into clear investment narratives.
- Build scalable planning processes and frameworks that allow the portfolio function to operate at the pace the business requires.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- 6+ years of developing and managing acquisition marketing or channel programs experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience in marketing (non-internship)
- Experience presenting metrics and progress to goal to senior leadership
- Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements
- Experience communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred qualifications

- Experience driving direction and alignment with large cross-functional teams and agency partners
- Experience designing and executing joint marketing plans with strategic alliance partners with global footprint

title: Sr Software Dev Engineer, ALG Software and Network Integration and Test
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is a initiative within Amazon that aims to revolutionize global connectivity through the development of a state-of-the-art Low Earth Orbit (LEO) interconnected satellite communication constellation. Our mission is to bridge the digital divide by delivering high-speed, low latency, internet services to underserved and unserved communities and remote communities around the world. By leveraging satellite technology, we are working towards a future where everyone has access to reliable and high-quality internet connectivity regardless of their location.

The Amazon Leo for Government (ALG) Engineering organization is a multi-disciplinary technology team established to rapidly address the needs of targeted government and international customers with specific solutions that have the potential to scale. ALG Engineering leads the development and delivery of targeted and scalable solutions for custom space and terrestrial applications. ALG collaborates closely with Project LEO to leverage the constellation of advance satellites to provide seamless and efficient communication capabilities to meet the needs of our customers. The ALG Engineering team is seeking highly technical and talented individuals who are passionate about creating unique solutions that result in a positive impact on a global scale.

About the Role
In the Integration & Test (I&T) team, you will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary team to design, develop, and own software tooling and frameworks that enable integration testing within system lab environments for space-based and terrestrial applications. This role sits at the intersection of software engineering and systems verification — you will define how teams test, not just what they test.

Working within Amazon Leo for Government (ALG) Engineering Integrated Systems Solutions, you will architect and deliver reusable test platforms, automation frameworks, and lab infrastructure software that accelerate verification of complex integrated hardware and software systems. You will serve as the technical owner of lab tooling strategy, driving decisions on architecture, interfaces, and developer experience while collaborating across inter-disciplinary teams, partners, and suppliers.

The successful candidate will have demonstrated experience working on complex Hardware/Software systems with a diverse set of talented individuals, as well as with partner organizations.

Security Clearance: This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a US Government security clearance of TS/SCI.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a U.S. Citizen in order to comply with U.S. government-imposed requirements related to the nature of the work and/or where it will be performed


Key job responsibilities
- Define and own the technical vision, architecture, and long-term roadmap for test automation frameworks, orchestration platforms, and CI/CD-integrated tooling consumed by I&T engineers and subsystem teams in hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and system lab environments
- Lead the end-to-end design, development, and evolution of software tooling — including test algorithms, scripts, calibration routines, and data visualization — required for verification and validation of complex hardware systems; drive architectural decisions that balance scalability, reliability, and maintainability across multiple product lines
- Establish and evangelize tooling best practices, coding standards, and reference architectures across the lab engineering organization; champion patterns for automation, observability, and infrastructure-as-code that raise the bar org-wide and influence adjacent teams
- Analyze test data at scale and engage cross-functionally with engineering leadership, partners, suppliers, and customers to evaluate product performance, identify systemic trends, and drive proactive improvements that reduce defect escape rates
- Author and present technical design documents, test strategy white papers, and executive-level reports documenting test results, coverage, performance metrics, and KPIs; influence prioritization decisions through data-driven communication with senior leadership
- Own the end-to-end lifecycle of test anomalies, defects, and systemic failure modes; lead root-cause investigations, define corrective actions, and drive continuous improvement initiatives across control systems in a high-rate production environment
- Identify strategic gaps in test infrastructure, author proposals with cost-benefit analysis, and drive multi-quarter implementation plans — making pragmatic tradeoffs between speed, long-term maintainability, and organizational scalability
- Mentor and develop mid-level and junior engineers through technical design reviews, code reviews, architecture discussions, and career development guidance; raise the engineering bar across the team
- Drive cross-organizational collaboration with systems engineers, hardware teams, program management, and external partners to ensure tooling supports all phases of integration, test, verification, and validation across satellite and ground element campaigns; represent the team in technical reviews and architecture forums

About the team
Amazon Leo for Government (ALG) Engineering is a multi-disciplinary technology team established to rapidly address the needs of targeted customers with specific solutions that have the potential to scale. These solutions are tailored to meet the needs of government and international customers for both space-based and terrestrial applications. The Integrated Engineering Solutions organization under ALG Engineering plays a vital role in the entire life cycle of the development of an engineering solution, including architecture development, requirements and interface definition through assembly, integration, and test (AI&T), verification, and post-delivery and operational support.

title: Data Center Chief Engineer Night Role
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic Data Center Engineering Operations Team and become a critical architect of the infrastructure that powers global cloud computing. You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of Amazon Web Services' physical infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that support millions of customers worldwide.
The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves both planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response to emergent issues. The CE serves as an expert technical resource reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager, interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third-party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center and to support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers. Data center equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.
Chief Engineer will be responsible for managing small-to-medium large impact projects from conception to completion. These projects can involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. The CE will be tasked with creating and delivering milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities.
The Chief Engineer directs, trains and supports EOT’s in their role of providing hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment-specific training exercises is also expected. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchgear, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, chillers, cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, VFD’s, and building automation systems.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States)

title: Infrastructure Partner Management Intern, AWS Infrastructure Services
descriptionHtml:
Internship period : 4 Jan 2027 - 30 June 2027

Amazon Web Services (AWS) · APAC — Data Center Supply Solutions · 6-month placement
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on challenging problems with thousands of variables — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.
You'll join a diverse team of supply chain specialists, operations managers, security and engineering experts, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them.
About the Infrastructure Partner Management (IPM) team
AWS doesn't only run its own data centers. It also places infrastructure inside data centers owned and operated by external providers — known as "colocation" partners. The IPM team manages these partnerships from the AWS side, across the whole life of a site, from the day a contract is signed to the day the site is closed.
We are the bridge between the AWS teams who run the data centers and the partners who host them. We work to make sure both sides deliver on what was agreed, and that the partnership runs smoothly day to day. We measure performance against agreed service levels (SLAs) so that it's transparent and objective for everyone, and when challenges come up we help bring the right people together to resolve them. Above all, we invest in strong, trusted relationships — understanding how each partner operates, working through problems together, and finding solutions that work for both sides, so our shared customers can depend on the infrastructure.
The work falls into a few repeating cycles:

* Business reviews. We run a regular Colocation Business Review (CBR) program — scheduled meetings with each partner to review performance against agreed service levels (SLAs) and align on actions together.
* Relationship management. We build long-term, trusted relationships with each partner — understanding how they operate, working through challenges together, and finding the win-win — so the partnership stays healthy well beyond any single review.
* Performance tracking. Between reviews, we track service levels, open action items, and follow through to resolution.
* Issue resolution. When a challenge comes up between AWS teams and a partner, we help bring the right people together and work it through.
* Commercial oversight. We manage our colocation contracts so that all parties are clear on their commitments and delivering against them.
* Continuous improvement. We keep reviewing our own ways of working and build better processes — including automation — so the team runs more efficiently over time.

This is not a hands-on engineering or on-site operations job. It's about working with data, supporting partner reviews, and learning how AWS manages and strengthens its colocation partnerships.
About the role
This 6-month placement supports the IPM team. You won't own a partner portfolio on your own — you'll work alongside experienced Infrastructure Partner Managers, take on well-defined pieces of real work, and always have an IPM close by to guide and review what you produce.
No two days look the same, but a typical one pulls from the cycles above. You might spend the morning preparing for a partner business review — pulling service-level data into the review pack — then sit in on the review itself to see how the partnership is managed in practice. The afternoon might turn to data: tidying up an export, spotting a trend across a few sites, and writing a line on what it tells us. Along the way you'll help keep our records up to date, follow up on open actions, and make progress on your own improvement project with your mentor. The throughline is simple — you're supporting and learning, not owning the partner relationships.


Key job responsibilities
Supporting business reviews

* Help set up and prepare Colocation Business Reviews (CBRs) — building the data packs, pulling service-level numbers, and drafting the summary slides the IPM presents
* Sit in on reviews to learn how the partnerships are managed, and capture the actions that come out of them
* Help draft one-pagers — short summary documents for a business review or a specific topic — pulling the facts together for an IPM to review and finalise
* Help develop automation that supports the team's business reviews

Tracking and follow-up

* Help keep action items and open topics up to date in our tracking systems, and follow up so nothing slips
* Track service-level performance across sites and partners, and surface anything that needs an IPM's attention

Commercial and data/AI work

* Help build and maintain simple trackers, contract/obligation lists, and dashboards
* Pull and clean data, surfacing insights or trends the team can take clear, objective action on

Learning the wider role

* Work with AWS teams — Safety, Security, Operations, Engineering, Finance, and Business Development — to see how the partnerships are managed day to day
* Sit in on partner conversations beyond the formal reviews, and see how IPMs build trust and work through challenges collaboratively
* Support one process-improvement or automation project end to end, with a defined outcome and a mentor

title: Ingénieur projet maintenance industrielle (Expert Maintenance Support et développement), RME
descriptionHtml:
Notre équipe d’ingénieurs RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering) veille à ce que nos équipements fonctionnent au mieux. Guidés par des responsables expérimentés, nous sommes une équipe à l’esprit analytique. Nos collaborateurs·trices possèdent à la fois des connaissances techniques poussées et un bon esprit d’équipe. Nous travaillons ensemble pour assurer l’entretien, le dépannage et la réparation des ressources de notre réseau mondial de centres d’expédition. Certains de nos employé·es occupent des postes à responsabilités et sont chargés de superviser l’équipe dans son travail sur des technologies passionnantes, dont certaines n’existent que chez Amazon.
De l’installation de systèmes d’emballage automatisés à la supervision de la maintenance générale d’un site, en passant par la réparation d’équipements de distribution essentiels, notre équipe assure le bon fonctionnement de la plupart des éléments techniques d’Amazon. Nous veillons, par exemple, à ce que les bâtiments soient conformes à la législation, afin d’assurer la sécurité de tous et le fonctionnement à plein régime de nos sites. Les possibilités d’évolution sont nombreuses, tant au sein de l’équipe RME qu’à l’échelle d’Amazon.
Tout ce que nous faisons vise à réduire les temps d’arrêt dans les principaux sites logistiques d’Amazon, afin que les clients reçoivent leurs commandes à temps. Nous travaillons souvent tôt ou tard pour effectuer les tâches de maintenance avec un minimum de perturbations, y compris en équipes de nuit. Si nous voyons qu’il existe une méthodologie plus aboutie pour faire les choses, nous avons les compétences nécessaires pour développer et introduire des processus nouveaux ou des technologies de pointe, comme Amazon Robotics ou notre robot de tri ultra sophistiqué.

Key job responsibilities
Nous créons une nouvelle équipe RME chez Amazon, et nous cherchons des profils comme le vôtre pour la composer.
Votre mission ?
Vous serez le point de contact clé pour nos techniciens sur site. À distance, vous les guiderez, les soutiendrez dans leur développement, et résoudrez avec eux des problèmes techniques complexes pour maintenir nos opérations en marche.
Concrètement, vous allez :


- Résoudre des problèmes d'équipement à distance pour réduire les temps d'arrêt (sur différents shift avec nuit inclus)
- Accompagner et développer nos techniciens terrain comme leur premier point de contact (déplacements sur plusieurs sites à envisager)
- Appliquer et faire respecter les meilleures pratiques de sécurité
- Identifier des opportunités d'amélioration continue et harmoniser les processus à l'échelle européenne
Nous recherchons des profils expérimentés et sommes ouvert aux techniciens expert en fiabilisation/formation technique par exemple.

Pourquoi rejoindre cette équipe ?
Vous ferez partie d'un projet pilote innovant, avec des technologies de pointe, des opportunités de formation continues, et la possibilité de façonner les standards de maintenance pour tout le réseau européen d'Amazon.
C'est une opportunité rare de construire quelque chose de nouveau, tout en développant votre carrière dans un environnement qui valorise l'innovation et l'apprentissage.
Pourquoi c'est différent ?
- Vous construisez les règles du jeu (pas de "on a toujours fait comme ça")
- Vous évoluez vite (nouvelles compétences, nouvelles responsabilités, nouveau territoire)
- Votre impact est européen (pas juste local)
- Vous travaillez avec les meilleures technologies et les meilleurs talents

A day in the life
À chaque quart de travail, vous serez à la tête d'une équipe en vous assurant que tous ses membres disposent du matériel nécessaire et que celui-ci fonctionne parfaitement. Cela implique la supervision des processus pour veiller au respect des normes et des politiques, ainsi que de garantir que l'entretien préventif approprié est effectué pour augmenter le temps de fonctionnement des équipements.

À partir de ce que vous observerez lors de vos quarts de travail, vous proposerez des améliorations destinées à augmenter l'efficacité et la productivité de nos systèmes et, par la suite, vous mettrez en œuvre ces changements dans tous nos centres de l'UE. Vous devrez également utiliser des outils tels que Scada pour superviser les processus afin de garantir leur performance, en plus de collaborer étroitement avec votre superviseur direct dans les tâches administratives.

Votre lieu de travail sera l'un de nos centres opérationnels. Vous travaillerez par quarts, ce qui peut inclure certains week-ends et nuits. À mesure que vous acquerrez de l'expérience dans ce secteur si fascinant d'Amazon.

About the team
Notre équipe d'ingénieurs de maintenance et de fiabilité (RME) est responsable du bon fonctionnement de nos systèmes à plein rendement. Nous nous caractérisons par notre grande aptitude technique et notre excellente capacité de travail en équipe, dirigés par des responsables ayant une grande expérience. Notre travail comprend la maintenance, la réparation et la résolution de problèmes liés aux équipements dans tout notre réseau mondial de centres de distribution. L'équipe dispose d'une série de profils de direction qui sont chargés de superviser le développement de technologies fascinantes, dont certaines n'existent que chez Amazon.

Notre équipe s'occupe de la plupart des aspects techniques d'Amazon, en effectuant des tâches allant de l'installation de systèmes d'emballage automatisés à la supervision de la maintenance générale d'un centre ou à la réparation d'équipements clés de distribution. Cela inclut l'adaptation des bâtiments à la législation en vigueur, afin que tout le personnel soit en sécurité et que nos installations fonctionnent avec la plus grande efficacité possible. L'équipe RME, comme c'est le cas dans d'autres départements d'Amazon, offre de nombreuses opportunités de progression professionnelle.

Tout notre travail tourne autour de la réduction des périodes d'inactivité dans les centres d'opérations cruciales d'Amazon, afin que les clients reçoivent leurs commandes à temps.

Basic qualifications

- Une expérience confirmée en maintenance (électricité + automatisme)
- Pédagogue avec une bonne communication (vous savez expliquer, rassurer, et motiver à distance)
- Une appétence pour les nouvelles technologies (vous êtes curieux et vous adaptez vite)
- Un esprit d'équipe et une envie d'avoir un impact réel
- Niveau d'anglais: niveau Intermédiaire ou courant (avoir un minimum de bases pour effectuer des calls)

Preferred qualifications

- Les compétences souhaitables sont un plus, mais ne sont pas obligatoires pour postuler au poste. Si vous remplissez les conditions de base mentionnées, nous serions ravis de vous rencontrer.
- Expérience dans des environnements avec de nombreux prestataires et sur différents sites, en interaction avec une multitude de sous-traitants et différentes localisations.
- Vous comprenez les systèmes de contrôle basés sur des automates programmables (PLC) et les exigences réglementaires.
- Expérience dans l'utilisation de systèmes informatiques permettant de planifier la maintenance proactive et d'enregistrer les tâches réactives.
- Diplôme universitaire, de préférence dans une discipline technique, en gestion des opérations ou en administration des entreprises.

title: Senior Power Electronics Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Are you excited about designing power-conversion hardware that will operate at megawatt scale inside data center infrastructure? Amazon Web Services is looking for a Senior Power Electronics Engineer to lead the design of solid-state transformer (SST) conversion stages, with deep expertise in high-voltage silicon carbide (SiC) devices and isolated high-power converter topologies.

You will own the dual active bridge (DAB), CLLC, and series-resonant converter stage designs from bench prototype through megawatt-class deployment, including SiC device selection and qualification. You will tackle device paralleling, current sharing, switching-loss optimization, and thermal derating challenges while guiding risk reduction through simulation and prototype correlation. You will also mentor fellow power electronics engineers, lead design reviews, and contribute to patent and technology decisions that shape the future of data center power delivery.



Key job responsibilities
- Lead architecture decisions for DAB, CLLC, and series-resonant converter stages, defining power-stage topologies that scale from prototype to megawatt deployment while meeting efficiency, thermal, and serviceability targets.
- Select and qualify high-voltage SiC power devices, evaluating switching losses, body-diode behavior, dynamic on-resistance, device paralleling, current sharing, and thermal derating for high-current operation.
- Coordinate converter-stage interfaces with the medium-voltage front end, 800 VDC output bus, controls, magnetics, and cooling subsystems to ensure cohesive system performance.
- Drive technical risk reduction through simulation, prototype testing, and measurement correlation, leading design reviews that set engineering quality standards across the team.
- Mentor power electronics engineers, contribute to patents and publications, and support technology roadmap decisions that advance data center power infrastructure.

A day in the life
You will split your time between hands-on design work and cross-functional collaboration. In a typical morning you might run converter simulations, review SiC device characterization data, or correlate prototype bench measurements against your models. Afternoons often shift to design reviews with magnetics, controls, and thermal engineers, or working sessions with partner teams on system-level interface specifications. You will regularly present technical trade-off analyses to stakeholders, coach junior engineers through design challenges, and carve out time to explore new converter architectures or draft patent disclosures.

About the team
Our team within AWS Infrastructure Services is focused on developing next-generation power delivery systems for data centers worldwide. We work at the intersection of power electronics, electrical infrastructure, and large-scale deployment, partnering closely with mechanical, controls, and construction engineering teams to bring new technology from concept to production.

We value an inclusive, collaborative culture where engineers at every level contribute ideas and learn from one another. If you are eager to solve complex power-conversion problems that directly improve the reliability and efficiency of global cloud infrastructure, this is the team for you.

About AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering.
- Hands-on experience with SiC high-voltage power-electronics
- Experience scaling power conversion from prototype/bench level to high-power deployment
- Experience documenting design decisions, assumptions, trade-offs, risks and technical specifications
- Demonstrated working effectively with adjacent engineering disciplines and contributing to full A-to-Z product ownership

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering.
- 10+ years of power-electronics experience with proven delivery of DAB/CLLC/SRC and HV-SiC design scaled to high power.
- Deep knowledge of DAB/CLLC/SRC converter topologies
- Demonstrated strong understanding of thermal management, current sharing, protection and design-for-serviceability.
- Demonstrated operating effectively in a greenfield environment where standards and reference designs may require interpretation and adaptation.

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Support
descriptionHtml:
Work hard, have fun, and make history at AWS! Amazon Web Services has been rated one of the most admired companies globally, both for Innovation and Customer Service. At AWS Kumo, you will be on the forefront of driving Cloud innovation for industry leaders around the globe.

Kumo (pronounced ‘Koo-mo’, the Japanese word for "cloud") is the global product and engineering organization for AWS Support, a multi-billion $ business. Kumo’s products, used by AWS customers and the internal Amazonian teams that help them, are vital to ensuring exceptional customer experiences on AWS. Kumo has a broad portfolio of customer-facing and internal services. Our public-facing properties include AWS Trusted Advisor, AWS Health, Automation, Recommendations & Insights, AWS Support Center, AWS Knowledge center, and many more. Our internal AWS Support teams rely on Kumo services to interact with AWS customers, diagnose and resolve customer issues, and safely share information across AWS teams. These services must work seamlessly, and be available when AWS services are not. Any changes to these tools has a force multiplicative effect on how customers experience AWS and the efficiencies of the internal workforce.

The Kumo organization is globally distributed, with larger teams located in Seattle - Washington, Cape Town - South Africa, and Vancouver - Canada.

We are looking for engineers to join our team in building the services that allow AWS customers to communicate with AWS Support Engineers. Your work will be the face of AWS Support to our customers; you will work to expand the communication channels we support so that our customers can reach out with convenience, within the context of their work. You will utilize cloud-native technologies developed right alongside you: AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway, etc. You will innovate on the user experience by working closely with our customers and partners.

Our team applies modern development practices and utilizes native AWS tools to do them. We operate in a multi-region redundant environment to ensure reliability; we continuously deploy to all regions through an automated pipeline; we use CloudWatch and other tools to help us monitor and diagnose. We loosely follow an agile methodology, and most of all, we focus on getting things done and delivering value to customers.

We combine the culture of a startup, the innovation and creativity of a R&D Lab, the resources, support, and work-life balance of a mature organization, and technical challenges at the scale of AWS. Come join us!

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.

· Write high-quality, efficient, testable code in Kotlin, Java and other object-oriented languages.
· Build highly available, secure, distributed systems in micro-services, container, and distributed cluster-compute architectures.
· Collaborate with high calibre engineers in the industry to work on some of the most complex challenges in large-scale computing.
· Own and operate the systems that you build based on real-time customer data and demanding service-level agreements.
· Contribute to planning, design, implementation, testing, operations, and process improvement as a member of a Scrum team.

You must insist on the highest standards for quality, maintainability, security, and performance as you will ensure that engineering best practices are followed and that software is designed to be highly available, dynamically scalable, and resilient to continuity threats. You are a person with a commitment to team work and who enjoys working on ground breaking technology, is customer obsessed, and thrives on the challenge of building something new that will eventually operate at world-wide scale.
