title: Transportation Associate
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to help Amazon deliver world class service in its transportation operations? Transportation Associates will perform trailer moves in the trailer yard, coordinate yard activities (such as checking in trailers, traffic flow, internal communications with operations, etc.), conduct yard audits, complete applicable driver training programs (Hostler, Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) School, etc.), and operate multiple vehicle types based on business need (including but not limited to hostlers and day cabs) to support Amazon’s transportation network. Benefits of being a Transportation Associate include the opportunity to work outside and understand the new and exciting world of transportation operations.
As a Transportation Associate you will:
• Make safety a priority by adhering to company rules and regulations. You will follow and enforce safety measures and policies to all who operate vehicles on behalf of Amazon and those who enter the yard, including vendors and senior team members
• Perform various functions within the yard, support site operations teams, internal transportation field teams, and external carriers, as needed, to ensure all trailers arrive and depart on time with zero defects and to maintain workflow for buildings.
• Be professionally trained to operate Commercial Motor Vehicles (CMVs) on non-public roads or in yard to move trailers to/from dock and parking locations.

title: Sr Package Engineer, JCFS CPEX
descriptionHtml:
Amazonでは、環境に配慮した新たな梱包資材の開発・導入を進めています。これを担うオペレーション技術統括本部（JCFS: Japan Customer Fulfillment Solutions）のCustomer Packaging Experience（CPEX）部門では、事業の成長と、お客様の購入体験の保護、そして環境・サステナビリティへの貢献を同時に実現する梱包イノベーション（新しい梱包資材の設計・開発）を推進しており、体制強化のため新たなメンバーを募集しています。

近年、当日配送のGrocery（食品・日用品）ECサービスが急速に拡大しており、新しい業態特有の商品・配送形態に対応した梱包資材の開発リソースの確保が急務となっています。本ポジションは、こうしたGrocery配送サービスの拡大に伴う資材開発リソースを確保・強化するために新設された枠であり、拡大するビジネスを支える新たなメンバーを募集しています。

シニア パッケージエンジニアは、「配送・資材コストの低減」「お客様の購入体験」「環境配慮」の3つを両立できる新しい梱包資材の設計・開発や、既存資材のデザイン見直しを担当します。資材メーカー（サプライヤー）との折衝・共同開発や、実際に梱包作業を行う物流現場のメンバーとの対話を通じて、導入までを一貫してマネジメントします。Amazonはさまざまな形状・サイズの商品を扱い、多くの物流拠点で梱包資材を使用しているため、求められる要件は日々変化します。既成概念にとらわれず、新しいアイデアを形にするプロジェクトを推進していただきます。Amazonで使用する梱包資材の設計・開発・導入に責任を持ち、複数の大規模プロジェクトを主体的に管理します。

Amazon is committed to reaching net-zero carbon by 2040, and Amazon Japan is looking for a technically strong Senior Package Engineer to help achieve this goal within the JCFS (Japan Customer Fulfillment Solutions) team in Tokyo. In the Customer Packaging Experience (CPEX) organization, you will design, develop, and roll out packaging materials that balance business needs, customer experience, and sustainability, working closely with internal teams and external packaging suppliers.
With the rapid growth of same-day grocery (food and daily-goods) e-commerce services, securing additional packaging-development resources for the unique products and delivery formats these new businesses require has become a priority. This position has been newly created to secure and strengthen packaging-development capacity as these grocery delivery services expand.

As a Senior Package Engineer, you will design new packaging or improve existing designs based on business requirements, customer feedback, and our sustainability goals, in cooperation with packaging suppliers, your manager, and team members. You will lead material-strength testing, prototype verification, hands-on efficiency studies at fulfillment sites, and validation of packaging behavior on automated handling and conveyor lines, and you will negotiate with and guide suppliers for joint development.
Not everything on a project goes as planned, so you are expected to solve unexpected problems and ask for support from the team and leaders whenever needed. Your results will be shared with Japan and global leadership through regular business reviews. Because packaging has a wide influence on Amazon’s e-commerce business, close collaboration with internal teams (fulfillment operations, supply chain, finance, delivery, engineering) and external partners (vendors, marketplace sellers, and packaging suppliers) is essential.

The CPEX mission is to delight customers by advancing packaging innovations that reduce waste, cost, and carbon emissions. Our programs range from simplified shipping (sending orders in the product’s own box, without extra Amazon packaging) and lighter paper-based packaging, to right-sizing packaging to customer order dimensions and adopting more sustainable materials. The Package Design & Development team designs new packaging to balance business, sustainability, and customer experience, and deploys it in the field.


Key job responsibilities
• Amazonで使用する梱包資材の設計・開発・導入に責任を持ち、マネージャーが描く方針に沿って、優先度の高い梱包施策の開発・導入をリードします。
• 資材メーカーとの交渉・技術指導・共同開発、試作品の検証、資材の強度評価、梱包作業の効率（工数）検証、物流現場の搬送・自動化ライン上での不具合検証と解決を行います。
• データ分析担当や他部門と連携し、CO2やプラスチックの削減につながる機会を見つけ、新技術のアイデアを提案します。中長期を見据えた新規資材の先行開発も担います。
• 複数の大規模プロジェクトを主体的に管理し、若手メンバーの指導・育成を行います。成果は定量的に評価し、社内外の関係者と共有・合意を図り、結果に責任を持ちます。

• Own the design, development, and rollout of packaging used across Amazon, leading high-priority packaging initiatives aligned with your manager’s direction.
• Negotiate with and guide suppliers for joint development; verify prototypes; evaluate material strength; run packing-efficiency studies; and validate and resolve issues on automated handling and conveyor lines.
• Directly manage multiple large-scale projects and coach junior members, and report key results clearly and on time to internal and external stakeholders.
• Report to the CPEX Manager within JCFS, while serving as a point of contact for packaging and technology teams in Japan and across global regions.

A day in the life
シニア パッケージエンジニアは、デスクワーク（データ分析、設計仕様の作成、資材メーカーとの折衝、プログラム資料の作成）と現場（物流拠点での試作品検証、資材の強度試験、ライン検証）の両方に時間を使い、コスト・お客様の購入体験・サステナビリティを両立する梱包イノベーションを推進します。
A Senior Package Engineer divides time between desk work (data analysis, design specifications, supplier negotiation, and program documents) and the field (visiting fulfillment sites for prototype verification, material-strength testing, and line validation), driving packaging innovation that balances cost, customer experience, and sustainability.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of industrial engineer, operations engineer, manufacturing engineer, or project engineer in a manufacturing environment experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Visio, and MS Project) at an advanced level
- Experience leading cross-functional teams across engineering, operations, and field execution through launch readiness and go-live phases

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of AutoCAD, VBA, and SQL at the intermediate level
- Experience working with and managing third party vendors
- Experience with Six Sigma, lean manufacturing

This is where your ideas turn into real impact.
You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure?

What’s in it for you?
An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

Amazon is a data-driven business, so no matter which project you are working on, part of your role will involve extracting insights from data to drive decisions. title: Software Development Engineer, ADC2S
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 7, 2026

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Software Development Engineer II to design, build, and operate Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) control-plane services in air-gapped regions. You will help governments run secure cloud infrastructure at scale.

In this role, you will join a team of engineers who build and operate software for EC2's control plane, fleet health, and capacity operations in air-gapped cloud environments. You will own features and services from design through production, make sound trade-offs within your area, and help raise the quality of what the team ships. Commercial tooling often does not exist in isolated regions, so you will build what the team needs instead of configuring an off-the-shelf product.

The candidate selected must obtain and maintain a security clearance at the TS/SCI with polygraph level. Upon start, the selected candidate will be sponsored for a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and operate EC2 control-plane services, fleet health automation, and capacity tooling across air-gapped cloud environments.
- Own features end to end: write the design, implement and test the code, deploy it through pipelines to disconnected regions, and operate it in production, including on-call.
- Improve monitoring, alarming, and deployment safety for the services you own, and drive the fix when an operational issue reveals a gap.
- Work with partner teams and stakeholders across the air-gapped partitions to deliver shared infrastructure.
- Take part in design and code reviews, and help new engineers ramp up on the team's systems.
- Use generative artificial intelligence tools and techniques to improve automation, code quality, and team productivity.

A day in the life
You might start the morning finishing a design document for a new capacity automation feature, then review a teammate's code change to how instance lifecycle events are processed in a disconnected region. After lunch, you work with a partner team to get your change into a shared deployment pipeline, then spend the afternoon tracking down the root cause of an alarm from last night's on-call shift. You write code most days, and you are expected to propose better ways to automate capacity and remediation workflows in the systems you own.

About the team
We own the software that keeps EC2 running in the air-gapped partitions: control-plane services, fleet-health automation, and the capacity tooling our government customers depend on. We operate what we build, so the engineers who design a remediation workflow are the ones it pages. Because the commercial tooling for a problem frequently does not exist in an isolated region, you build the thing rather than configure it. The team defaults to written design documents and clear ownership boundaries, and you will work alongside engineers who are passionate about solving hard infrastructure problems in the most demanding regulated cloud environments.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or CSSLP (Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional)
- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, PCT Partner Connection Technology
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's last-mile delivery network relies on thousands of independent Delivery Service Partners (DSPs)- small businesses whose drivers deliver packages to customers every day. We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to shape the technical direction of the platforms that support the full driver journey: from onboarding and qualification to communication, recognition, and the tools DSP owners use to manage and grow their teams.

In this role, you will own the architecture and technical strategy across multiple engineering teams. You will lead large, cross-team initiatives from concept to production, design scalable distributed systems, and drive operational excellence across a global, regulated domain spanning 20+ countries. You will go wherever the problem is—including partnering with teams across Amazon—to deliver the right solution for customers.

This is a high-ownership role where you will balance hands-on engineering with strategic leadership, mentoring engineers, and influencing partner teams' roadmaps.
•Scope: Technical leadership across multiple engineering teams and production services.
•Technologies: Java, TypeScript, React, and AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, ECS, API Gateway, SNS/SQS, CDK).

Key job responsibilities
• Own the technical strategy and multi-year architecture across multiple teams and platforms; author the design documents and technical vision those teams build against.
• Lead large, ambiguous, cross-team projects from concept to production; decompose them into milestones other engineers can own and deliver.
• Design and build secure, scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems with robust authentication, authorization, and data-handling practices.
• Turn regulatory requirements from multiple countries into configurable, global solutions—partnering closely with product, compliance, and legal teams.
• Drive operational excellence through monitoring, root-cause analysis, deployment best practices, and continuous improvement of availability, latency, and cost.
• Mentor engineers across teams, contribute to hiring, and raise the engineering bar through code reviews, design reviews, documentation, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

A day in the life
You will work across teams and systems—connecting the dots and helping move things forward. That means design reviews, hands-on coding, debugging production issues, and pairing on APIs that power real-world driver workflows. You will collaborate with product, compliance, legal, and engineering partners across multiple countries. Beyond the roadmap, you might interview candidates, contribute fixes across codebases, support on-call, or run workshops to help fellow engineers grow.

About the team
Partner Connection Technology builds the systems connecting Amazon with its Delivery Service Partners (DSPs)—independent small businesses whose drivers deliver Amazon packages. We manage the full driver lifecycle: onboarding, identity checks, vehicle/route qualifications, communication across email, apps, and messaging, and recognition experiences like customer-to-driver thank-yous. Serving DSP owners, drivers, and Amazon support teams in 20+ countries, our three engineering teams focus on absorbing complexity so small business owners don't have to—building configurable global solutions, not one-off fixes. The domain is regulated and fast-moving, with real architecture challenges and room to shape it.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Sr. Financial Analyst, Sponsored Products & Brands FP&A
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to own worldwide planning and analysis for one of the largest advertising businesses in the world? Amazon is seeking a Sr. Financial Analyst to drive forecasting and financial controllership for a multi-billion-dollar, double-digit-growth business within our advertising organization. You'll have direct visibility to senior finance and business leaders, and real influence over the mechanisms used to forecast and shape our business. This role offers a unique opportunity to combine advanced financial modeling with strategic partnership, where your variance analysis and insights will directly inform decision-making at the highest levels. You'll work with complex data, solve challenging problems in a fast-paced environment, and proactively improve financial processes while collaborating with cross-functional partners across product, finance, and business teams.

Key job responsibilities
• Own end-to-end forecasting processes for Sponsored Products and Sponsored Brands, proactively identifying variance drivers, understanding their implications, and proposing solutions to improve mechanisms and controllership
• Build and maintain financial models and reports using Cognos and other financial systems, ensuring accuracy through regular audits and diving deep into data discrepancies to identify root causes and implement fixes
• Conduct complex variance analysis against prior guidance, plan, and prior year results, translating data into clear insights and recommendations for senior finance and business leaders
• Partner with Central FP&A, Advertising product teams, and business stakeholders to support planning cycles including guidance, Monthly Financial Review, Operating Plan 1, and Operating Plan 2
• Actively leverage and advance AI integration and automation using Amazon's plethora of AI tools into our pre-existing processes as we invent new ways to work.
• Work nimbly with ambiguity to respond to requests from senior leadership with immediate ownership, synthesizing information quickly and communicating findings clearly to drive data-driven decision making


A day in the life
Your day blends analytical depth with collaborative partnership. You'll spend time building forecast models, conducting variance analysis to understand performance against prior guidance and plan, and producing reports in Cognos. You'll sync regularly with business and finance partners to explain drivers and resolve open questions, applying your knowledge of financial processes and controllership. Occasionally, senior leadership will have same-day requests that require you to take immediate ownership, dive deep into the data, and deliver clear recommendations under tight timelines. But regardless of the day, you'll work on highly collaborative FP&A team that depends on each other to work comprehensively.

About the team
The Sponsored Products and Brands Financial Planning and Analysis team operates with exceptional collaboration and shared accountability. Different team members own different responsibilities that interconnect comprehensively, and we rely on each other to deliver worldwide forecasting and reporting across Sponsored Products and Sponsored Brands. We partner closely with Central FP&A, Advertising product teams, and senior business leaders to shape critical planning cycles. Our team drives financial strategy for one of the fastest-growing businesses at Amazon, where your work directly influences investment decisions and business direction. We foster an inclusive environment where knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and mutual support enable everyone to grow their skills and take on increasingly complex challenges.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of finance, accounting, or related analytical field experience
- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
- MBA, or CPA
- Knowledge of Tableau
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)

title: Sr. Engagement Manager, U.S. Federal ProServe
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a highly skilled and versatile Engagement Manager (EM) to join our team and lead the delivery of complex cloud solution projects. In this role you will combine technical expertise with strong project leadership skills to drive successful implementations of AWS-based solutions for our clients. You will bridge business requirements with technical solutions, facilitating technical discussions and ensuring alignment with customer outcomes. Applying AWS frameworks like Well-Architected and Cloud Adoption Framework while demonstrating technical credibility across diverse stakeholders, you will distill customer needs into clear technical requirements, decompose complex problems, and make informed trade-off decisions considering performance, scalability, security, and business impact.

Possessing strong technology and program/project management experience, you will validate technical solutions against business goals, recognize when additional technical evaluation is needed, and manage technical risks. You will be expected to achieve and maintain relevant AWS certifications, develop domain-specific expertise, and effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and business audiences. As you progress, you’ll lead increasingly complex technical projects, shape cross-organizational technical strategies, and establish best practices in your domain. In this role you will apply your management and leadership capabilities to successfully execute project plans, proactively identify and manage risks, resolve issues, escalate when appropriate, and drive projects to successful completion, while exceeding customer expectation

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

title: 2027 Amazon Air Supply Chain Manager Intern
descriptionHtml:
There’s a universe of opportunity at Amazon.
At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and connect every day. This is where your ideas turn into real impact. You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure?

What’s in it for you?
An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

At Amazon, we are excited to offer undergraduate students the opportunity to launch into big careers with limitless possibilities. We know searching for an internship role is as much about finding a company where you can picture yourself being successful as it is about finding the right role. We look forward to meeting you and your classmates this year. As we get to know you more, we invite you to get to know us better.

Do you have a passion for aviation, transportation, or supply chain management, and want to leverage your data analytics and problem solving skills to improve customer experience? If so, apply to Amazon Air, Amazon’s internal air cargo network operating a fleet of 90+ aircraft, as a Supply Chain Manager intern for the summer of 2027! During your 12-week internship, you will be placed on one of Amazon Air’s corporate teams to lead a complex, cross-functional aviation project. Potential teams include Aviation Sourcing, Airport Affairs, Air Performance and Engineering, Customer Experience, Labor Planning, Technical Operations, Network Planning, and Safety. Your project will require you to formulate a problem statement, collect and analyze data, build tools or frameworks, and lead stakeholders through each project milestone. At the end of the internship, you will present a final six-page whitepaper with findings and recommendations to Air’s senior corporate leadership!
The ideal candidate for this internship will be someone who is customer obsessed, earns trust with project stakeholders, insists on high standards and is ready to think big and innovate in the aviation and transportation space. The ideal candidate will also have strong written and oral communication skills, the ability to analyze data in Excel and create dashboards or visualizations, and an interest in using AI tools to accelerate project work.
Key Job Learning Opportunities
• Learning about aviation, air cargo, transportation, supply chains, e-commerce, and continuous process improvement
• Developing a business case around a real operational problem, building tools or frameworks, and driving implementation
• Data analysis, dashboard creation, and leveraging AI tools for operational decision making
• Cross-functional stakeholder management and building alignment across teams
• Comprehensive six-page whitepaper writing and presentation skills

A Day in the Life
Each day, you will work among teams at Amazon Air to dive deep into a specific project that will improve planning, operations, safety, efficiency and overall customer experience. The position is based in Bellevue, WA and you will have the opportunity to work in person with the team you are on. You will have one-on-one meetings to get an in-depth knowledge of the area your project focuses on, and dive deep into collecting, analyzing and leveraging data to develop a final recommendation for your given project. Past intern projects have included building automated tracking systems, designing network optimization frameworks, and developing data driven feedback processes with quantifiable cost savings.

About the Team
We are a diverse, upbeat, creative team of leaders working daily to develop innovative aviation solutions to ensure our customers can get ever faster deliveries, while ensuring our associates have the safest environment possible. Each team owns every aspect of their project, from review and iterative development, to the final implementation and benefit to our customers.
Please note:
• This role is for Bellevue, WA only. Applicants must be open to relocation.
• There will be two start dates for this internship (May 17 and June 14, 2027), which will be for a 12-week, consecutive period.
• We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role or consider students with visa sponsorship needs.
• Interns will be expected in the office 5 days per week.
• For more information, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/career-programs/university/undergraduate-non-tech.

Basic qualifications

- Are 18 years of age or older
- Work 40 hours/week throughout the course of a 12-week summer internship between May through September
- Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s degree program with a graduation conferral date between December 2027 and June 2028

Preferred qualifications

- Strong academic, leadership, and/or extracurricular record.
- Effective interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills.
- Ability to analyze large datasets.
- Ability to influence across all levels of an organization.
- Strong time management skills.

descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Scholar team sits within the Global Specialty Recruiting (GSR) team. GSR is a highly specialized group focused on hiring exceptional talent for complex, hard-to-fill scientific, design, academic, & executive tech and non-tech roles across Amazon.

What makes our Global Specialty Recruiting team unique is our deep domain expertise and breadth of experience. Our recruiters are embedded within the academic, scientific and technical communities, allowing us to leverage academic and industry connections, innovative sourcing tactics, and a nuanced understanding of specialized skill sets.

As a full life cycle recruiter on the GSR Scholar team, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented peers, influence at the most senior levels, and make a meaningful impact on the growth and success of Amazon Science. You'll be a vital strategic partner to our science leaders, helping to shape our approach and elevate the candidate experience for some of the most sought-after academicians in the world.

If you're passionate about the sciences, driven to find exceptional talent, and eager to work alongside a best-in-class recruiting organization, this is an unparalleled opportunity to grow your career and opportunity for impact.

title: Grid Analyst EMEA, Infrastructure Energy Team (IET) | Amazon Web Services
descriptionHtml:
AWS is building one of the largest energy portfolios in Europe, the Middle East, and Africa — and we need someone who can connect the dots across a complex, multi-country programme. As a Grid Analyst, you will drive programme visibility and business analytics for the energy infrastructure that powers AWS data centres across EMEA.

This is not a desk-bound reporting role. You will own the programme rhythm — aggregating data from multiple workstreams, building dashboards that surface risks early, and ensuring leadership has a clear, single view of cost, schedule, and capacity across the portfolio. You will work at the intersection of programme management and analytics, turning fragmented project data into decisions.

Day to day, you will:

- Build and maintain portfolio-level reporting that tracks grid connection milestones, utility timelines, and energisation schedules across EMEA markets
- Design automated dashboards and KPI frameworks using tools like Smartsheet and QuickSight
- Drive programme cadence
- Partner with legal, finance, and capacity delivery teams to align cost and schedule across workstreams
- Identify process gaps and implement improvements that reduce manual effort and increase reporting accuracy
- Provide analytical context on grid connection timelines and regulatory requirements to support decision-making

This role suits someone with strong programme management and business analytics skills who wants to apply them in the fast-moving energy infrastructure space. Prior power or utility experience is a plus but not required — what matters is your ability to structure ambiguity, build clarity from data, and keep complex programmes on track.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.


Key job responsibilities
- Support and collaborate with cross-functional teams (Legal, Finance Capacity Delivery) on the day-to-day programme management and reporting across the portfolio of infrastructure power delivery projects

- Enable effective decision making by managing and aggregating datasets and key performance indicators from multiple sources to provide a single source of truth on status, cost, capacity and key dates management across a portfolio of infrastructure power delivery projects

- Develop and oversee the implementation of continual process improvement initiatives related to operational efficiency, team effectiveness and new value-add activities

- Facilitate internal and external meetings by managing agendas, facilitating scheduling, owning meeting minutes, and following through on action items

- Coordinate and report on capex/programme implications

- Design and develop reporting dashboards and automated reporting solutions using tools such as Smartsheet and QuickSight

A day in the life
Your morning starts with data — scanning dashboards for overnight changes across the EMEA portfolio: a shifted energisation date in the Nordics, a permitting milestone in Ireland, updated cost forecasts in Southern Europe. You triage what matters before the weekly programme review. By mid-morning, you are the connective tissue between legal, finance, & capacity delivery — translating grid timelines into business context. Afternoons shift between building QuickSight dashboards that shape investment decisions & driving process improvements that eliminate manual reporting. Some weeks you support leadership deep-dives or stand up reporting frameworks for new country teams. No two weeks look the same.

About the team
The Infrastructure Energy Team (IET) secures and delivers the power infrastructure required to enable AWS growth across Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA). The team is seeking a results-orientated individual to join in the role of Grid Analyst. In this role you will support the stakeholder, administrative and contractual lifecycle of delivering power to existing and future AWS data centers throughout EMEA. This role provides an opportunity for a technically minded individual interested in building a foundation to further develop their skillset and advance their career within the energy sector. The successful candidate will be the single point of contact for AWS' grid connection applications, offers and agreements, overseeing application preparation and contractual terms management. The successful candidate will possess strong communication skills and an ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams (Energy, Legal, Finance, Supply Strategy, Real Estate and Capacity Delivery) on reporting status, issues and key risks across a portfolio of infrastructure power delivery projects. The candidate will standardize processes and develop tools necessary to provide a single source of truth on status, budget, expenditure, capacity, key dates and contractual terms management across the portfolio of infrastructure power delivery projects in EMEA. The candidate will support due diligence assessments on power connection costs, timelines and key risks for proposed data centre sites.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, AWS

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fuelled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

- Experience as a strong leader who can prioritize well, communicate clearly and effectively influence across cross-functional teams

- Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
- Experience in business intelligence and analytics

title: Finance Manager, WW DSP Finance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Delivery Service Partner (DSP) program is responsible for delivering packages (and smiles) to households/businesses across the planet. Our finance team closely partners to support this program as part of Amazon's Last Mile delivery business, providing critical decision support and financial planning and analysis. We are seeking a talented Finance Manager to own the financial position on DSP pricing, offers, and program investment for Americas, sizing program investments and delivering the end-to-end financial perspective that enables leadership to make informed decisions on the largest cost levers in the DSP program.

The Finance Manager, DSP Americas, Pricing, Offers & Program Investment, owns rate card economics end-to-end including hourly base rate, seasonal incentives, wage analysis, and route economics, spanning all carriers across US, CA, and LATAM. You will own the financial position on DSP offers and program investments, lead financial analysis for Ignite Live announcements, and provide financial modeling for emerging initiatives and new delivery programs including change management. Core responsibilities include weekly WBR commentary, quarterly and annual planning, seasonal incentive scenario analysis, and OP entitlement sizing, partnering with business and program leadership to inform strategic investments and cost optimization across DSP Americas.

The role operates in an environment where strategy is often undefined, requiring the finance team to build frameworks with minimal predefined operational assumptions. The Finance Manager carries a dual mandate: maintaining rigorous financial controllership on rate card decisions while actively driving cost-to-serve improvement in service of a healthy, sustainable DSP program. These objectives are often in tension, requiring sound judgment to balance immediate cost savings, long-term partner relationship health, DSP and Driver sentiment, and legal compliance risk. The Finance Manager independently partners with senior leaders across multiple organizations to influence strategic decisions, challenge business partner plans, and set financial requirements that hold teams accountable. Strong communication skills and executive presence are essential to influence without authority spanning multiple lines of business.

Key job responsibilities
- Own Americas DSP rate card economics end-to-end including hourly base rate, seasonal incentives, and route and service type level economics

- Own seasonal incentive scenario analysis and financial position for peak and high volume events

- Own the financial position on DSP offers and program investments for Americas

- Deliver weekly WBR commentary and support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reviews, forecasting, and planning

- Lead financial analysis and data preparation for annual Ignite Live announcements

- Provide financial modeling for emerging initiatives and new delivery programs, establishing measurement frameworks and financial guardrails before scale

- Serve as primary finance liaison and thought leader to DSP Americas Change Management, providing financial sizing, impact assessment, and strategic input

- Partner with senior leaders across multiple organizations to influence strategic decisions and hold teams accountable through data-driven recommendations

- Collaborate with EU and WW DSP Finance teams to share best practices and drive consistency across regions

- Identify opportunities to scale and automate financial processes and reporting, leveraging AI

- Contribute to the broader Amazon finance community through mentoring, knowledge sharing, and development of best practices

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field
- 5+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience
- 5+ years of contributing to cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or CPA
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results
- 6+ years of solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) experience
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)

title: Machine Learning Engineer, SageMaker AI Inference
descriptionHtml:
Demand for large language model (LLM) inference is growing fast, and the engineers who make it faster and more efficient are shaping the future of AI at Amazon. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to focus on inference performance optimization, kernel tuning, and LLM serving efficiency. You will work across the full software development lifecycle to design, build, and measure systems that reduce latency and improve throughput for production inference workloads. This is a hands-on engineering role where your work directly translates into better performance for internal teams and, ultimately, for Amazon's customers. If you are an engineer who enjoys profiling bottlenecks, writing high-performance code, and finding elegant solutions to hard systems problems, we want to talk to you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement kernel-level optimizations and inference pipeline improvements that reduce latency and increase throughput for LLM serving workloads.
- Profile, benchmark, and tune model inference performance across hardware and software stacks, identifying bottlenecks and delivering measurable gains.
- Write well-organized, maintainable code and participate actively in code reviews, providing constructive feedback to peers and mentoring newer engineers on the team.
- Collaborate with applied scientists, ML engineers, and infrastructure teams to translate model requirements into production-ready inference solutions.
- Evaluate emerging tools, frameworks, and generative AI techniques for inference optimization, recommending adoption where they improve efficiency or quality.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing benchmark results from an overnight profiling run, then dig into a kernel implementation to shave milliseconds off a critical inference path. After lunch you could pair with an applied scientist to understand a new model architecture's compute profile and plan your optimization approach. Throughout the day you will participate in code reviews, document your design decisions, and share findings with the broader team so that improvements compound across projects.

About the team
Our team owns SageMaker AI inference at Amazon, and inference performance optimization is becoming increasingly important as LLM workloads scale. Performance optimization is one of our key differentiators, and every improvement we ship has a direct impact on cost, speed, and the experience our customers receive. We value collaboration, technical depth, and a culture where every engineer's perspective is heard. If you want to solve hard systems problems in an environment that rewards curiosity and rigorous engineering, this is the team for you.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with CUDA kernels or ML/low-level kernels
- Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution

title: Area Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly workforce and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

* Support, mentor, and motivate your hourly workforce

* Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
* Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
* Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
* Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- A Bachelor's degree or International Equivalent, OR 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience, OR 6+ years of Military Experience

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience managing a team of 20+ employees
- Experience with process improvements (Lean process, Kaizen, and/or Six Sigma)

Team Manager, Vendor Consultants Team - RBS AVS
As a Vendor Consultants Manager in Retail Business Services (RBS), you will have the exciting opportunity to help shape and deliver on the strategy for managing Amazon vendors.
RBS team is looking for a customer centric, driven, and creative people leader to join our team. - Design and build custom APIs and middleware solutions for security system integration

title: Installation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Transform network infrastructure by joining our dynamic team! You'll be at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that drive network stability and scalability, using your technical expertise to create automated systems that power global technological advancement.

Infra Delivery Install Technicians will collaborate with cross-functional teams, troubleshoot complex technical scenarios, and implement strategic solutions that keep our network running seamlessly. Expect to engage in hands-on technical work that requires creativity, precision, and a passion for technological innovation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
- Moving and implementing large enterprise equipment
- Installing Fiber and Copper cabling and patching cabling between equipment
- Ensuring proper safety and security standards are maintained during cabling and rack installation,
- Following well established hardware installation procedures and break-fix activities
- Safely using material handling tools and equipment
- Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided

Physical Requirements:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
- Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to participate in primary responder rotation and provide after-hours support as needed
- Working in cramped and/or elevated and/or noisy environments
- Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Computer Hardware Repair, Infrastructure Cabling, Network Deployment, or Data Center Operations experience, or experience in similar technical or vocational roles
- High School diploma or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- industry standard certification (CompTIA, CCENT, or Network+)
- Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
- Knowledge of network cabling, optic types, and test equipment

title: Data Center Controls Technician
descriptionHtml:
As a member of the Global Controls Team, you will collaborate with highly motivated operators, engineers and technicians in the data center industry to maintain and optimize critical infrastructure systems. You will be responsible for troubleshooting and maintaining the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) while developing new processes and standards that drive innovation in the controls space.

AWS data centers utilize sophisticated industrial control systems to automatically operate mechanical equipment, maintaining optimal temperature and pressure conditions throughout the facilities. These systems integrate and monitor multiple critical components, including generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic and static transfer switches, air-cooled and water-cooled chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), and air economizers. Within this industrial control system infrastructure, the BMS serves as the primary control platform for all mechanical systems within the data center, while the EPMS functions as the primary monitoring platform for all electrical systems. This position offers the opportunity to work with technology in mission-critical environments while contributing to the reliability and efficiency of AWS's global infrastructure.

Key job responsibilities
Manage small to medium-sized projects and programs.
Perform point-to-point checkouts between field devices and controllers.
Conduct first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting, and maintenance of BMS/EPMS programming code and hardware.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, and low-cost cloud platform that powers thousands of businesses in over 190 countries.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

descriptionHtml:

title: Sr. Product Manager, Refunds CX, Refunds CX
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce (WWRR), we aspire to zero: zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects.

We are an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, company, and environment. We are constantly innovating to create long-term value at Amazon by investing in the future and focusing on the planet, not just on the bottom line. WWRR includes business, product, program, operational, data, and software engineering teams, who together manage the lifecycle of returned and damaged products.

WW R&R includes business, product, operations, data, and software engineering teams, who together manage the lifecycle of returned and damaged products. In WW R&R, you will partner across these teams to help customers get the most value out of Amazon’s products; improve the customer returns experience; and reduce defects, waste, and cost in reverse logistics processes. You will be a leader, a builder, and an owner, collaborating cross-functionally with technical, operations, and business teams to design scalable and automated solutions to customer problems.

Refunds Customer Experience (Refunds CX) is a charter of WW R&R that is dedicated to providing the best-in-class refunds experience to customers, by prioritizing faster refunds and ensuring 100% completeness. We strive to build a strong enforcement function to preserve CX, mitigate risk & avoid policy abuse.

We are looking for a seasoned Product Leader who has a passion for working in cross-functional environments, strong communication skills (verbal & written) in addition to proven product management experience. Join us if you want the opportunity to make a big impact in a quickly growing team that can make a big difference in the customers' journey with Amazon.

Amazon is Earth’s most customer-centric company and in WW R&R, the Earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce.

Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will
- Work with product managers, software developers, program managers and operational partners to improve the customer return experience and re-commerce programs.

- Champion global Amazon processes, identify improvement opportunities, devise strategies and guide and implement the improvement effort worldwide.

- Be a leader, required to collaborate cross-functionally with technical, operations, and business retail teams to design scalable and automated solutions to customer problems.

- Create vision, disambiguate complex problem spaces, roadmap, and execution across a suite of refund products to improve customer trust.

- Develop worldwide mechanisms with huge customer-facing and financial impact

The ideal candidate for the role demonstrates
- Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize workloads, maintain a strong attention to detail and work independently in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment

- Excellent Product Management skills with a proven ability to design scalable solutions and drive projects to successful implementation

- Strong analytical and data gathering skills, including the ability to translate large amounts of data into actionable insights

- Participate in internal business performance reviews and business reviews to understand trends, develop action plans, and share business plans and performance

A day in the life
You will work with a team of high performing Product/Program Managers, tech counter part on planning and prioritization of product roadmap. You understand the systems and technologies behind your product, their limitations, scaling factors, boundary conditions, and reasons for architectural decisions. You are capable of articulating when a new technology is needed (and when it is not) or discuss the differences between two technology offerings. You proactively mitigate risks and help reduce a product’s exposure to classic failure modes.

About the team
WW Refunds CX team under the broader WW Returns CX (WW RCX) sub-org, plays a critical role in the overall Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce (WW R&R) org by ensuring customers are provided timely and complete refunds. To address this area of paramount importance, we partner with multiple orgs outside WWRR, primarily CS, Ordering, Payments, and internally with Tech & Data Engineering to ensure faster refunds and 100% refund completion across a varying breadth of diverse use-cases and geographies. This IC role serves as a central orchestrator within this strategic workstream, responsible for designing and prioritizing optimal product investments while coordinating end-to-end execution.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience as a product manager or owner

- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL

descriptionHtml:
The Japan Perishable Supply Chain (PSC) team is looking for a talented Supply Chain Manager who excels in hypothetical thinking and data driven decision making. In this position, you will play an instrumental role in delivering optimal capacity management as our Grocery business grows and scales across Japan.
You will be part of a team dedicated to quality, customer experience, and efficiency; supporting 1P and 3P operations with stakeholders both domestically here in Japan, as well as Worldwide Grocery. Your primary deliverable will be Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP), which is a short/mid-term volume planning. S&OP is a critical business/operation elements, which forecasts upcoming shipment/arrival volume based on diving deep into multiple historical data points, and driving discussion and alignment with multiple stakeholders. You will need to execute optimal forecast planning considering business growth and capacity constraint across storage space in warehouse to labor resources.
Additionally, you will support with transportation network design, working collaboratively to deliver the right capacity and cost to enable overall profitability.
Your S&OP responsibilities will be a continuous activity, where uncertainty in new and growing business lines will require you to remain agile. Your decisions will have network wide impact, driving cost efficiency and supporting capacity across our Japan Grocery operations. Furthermore, in order to realize an optimal inventory plan that enables maximizing business growth under capacity constraints, the optimization of inbound flow from vendors/other warehouses is also an important mission in the role; and allowing you to partner within our Core and Logistics operations.
In addition, it is also expected that best practices will be found in cooperation with overseas teams for S&OP planning/methodology and inbound flow. You will contribute efficient process design as internet supermarket in worldwide. Even in an ambiguous environment, the role is expected to have the ability to think strategically and tactically, handle multiple priorities and make decisions for optimal capacity planning in view of business growth and costs.


Key job responsibilities
• Operate the volume planning for the Distribution and Fulfillment Centers with weekly cadence.
• Create a plan of the 7-21 day and 13-week horizon by managing inputs from business plans, operational constraints, and labor plans; and maintain all outputs accurate and updated.
• Support 1P and 3P business and operations team on planning and S&OP accuracy
• With giving detailed insight into variances versus planned volumes, execute countermeasures to resolve the variances, and also continuously improve forecasting accuracy.
• Realize the optimal inventory volume and arrival form and then optimize the workload in FC operations.
Reduce operation cost by analyzing data and the drivers of forecast misses/opportunities to provide optimized operation.
• Collaborate with Supply Chain and Tech teams in North America and Continental EU & United Kingdom to establish best practices, implement new tools/systems, and build end to end operation processes for the growth of the business.
• Projects ownership related to supply chain and forecasting accuracy improvement in collaboration with business and operations teams.


About the team
Perishable Grocery is an important growth area for Amazon, and our team is a critical component to deliver this growth in Japan. We support the overall supply chain, inclusive of transportation, third party external fulfillment service management, operations planning, and more - without which we could not deliver the quality and freshness of product needed to earn the trust of our customers.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of supply chain experience
- 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Business-level Japanese & English language proficiency in reading, writing, and meetings

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
- 3+ years of data visualization and reports tools experience

title: Shift Manager, AMZL, Trans Vol, EU Transportation Volume
descriptionHtml:
Shift Manager, AMZL, Trans Vol refers to a new approach in Amazon Logistics (AMZL) to define a scalable solution to run an increasingly complex and growing last mile delivery network. EU Trans Vol is a key strategic initiative with a vision to transform the way AMZL executes route planning, labor planning and last mile on-road delivery experience. This is a chance to support a rapidly evolving part of AMZL, taking the lead in developing a best-in-class operation to make effective, real-time decisions to maximize customer and driver experience through effective route planning. As a Shift Manager, you will lead a team to drive performance and ensure standard processes are followed for all the daily tasks. You will be responsible for building processes, systems, and mechanisms to schedule tens of thousands of packages across multiple Delivery Stations daily. You will drive execution and efficiency through data-driven decision-making and analytical problem-solving. You will be accountable for cost, customer experience, and delivery partner experience, both in daily execution and long-term step-function improvements. Additional responsibilities include coaching and mentoring the team, nurturing positive employee relations and building leadership bench strength within the organization.
This role will support the Rush EU test in Q4 and possible expansion in 2027.

Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities:

- Managing daily operations of the team, ensuring all the required tasks are executed on time, adhering to the standard practices.
- Monitor and report on daily and weekly performances.
- Deep dive on trends, identify the gaps in performance metrics and take corrective actions.
- Execute best practices that improve customer, cost, and delivery partner outcomes.
- Develop processes and systems to achieve metrics, often requiring scrappy solutions to temporarily overcome technical limitations. The ability to scale will be critical to all processes.
- Create and drive scalable standard work that enables remote support of a complex business area.
- Proactively identify and lead process improvement initiatives though quantitative analysis and data-driven decision making.
- Create, manage, support recognition and communication programs for the team.
- Support Rush test in Q4 2026 and expansion in 2027.

- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience in data analysis
- Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English at C1 level or above

title: Rezeptionist:in
descriptionHtml:
Diese Rolle deckt [20:00-05:00 Uhr, FC Großkneten] ab.

Als Rezeptionist:in bist du unser freundliches Aushängeschild und sorgst in einem unserer „First Mile“-Fulfillment-Center (FC) dafür, dass Besucher und Mitarbeiter einen positiven ersten Eindruck gewinnen.
In dieser wichtigen Rolle arbeitest du mit dem Assistenten des Standortleiters (GMA) zusammen, um reibungslose Abläufe und Programme zu gewährleisten und so dazu beizutragen, ein sicheres und einladendes Arbeitsumfeld für alle zu schaffen.



Key job responsibilities
- Leitung des Empfangsbereichs und proaktive Koordination von Besprechungen mit Besuchern sowie Betreuung der Gäste
- Verwaltung der Aus- und Rückgabe verschiedener Besprechungsressourcen wie Projektoren, Flipcharts und Büromaterial 
- Koordination von Taxibuchungen und des Tracking-Systems 
- Zusammenarbeit mit dem GMA des Standorts und dem Community Ambassador zur Planung, Koordination und Durchführung von Engagement-Programmen vor Ort, großen jährlichen Veranstaltungen und Amazon Community Impact-Aktivitäten
- Unterstützung bei Standort-Anerkennungsprogrammen 
- Pflege und Erstellung von Standortkommunikation, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Inhalte über alle Kommunikationskanäle hinweg korrekt und aktuell sind 
- Unterstützung des General Managers und des gesamten Führungsteams in der Funktion als Assistent des General Managers, um Jahresurlaub/Abwesenheiten in Abstimmung mit dem offiziellen Stellvertreter des GMA zu überbrücken 
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem GMA zur Unterstützung und Mitwirkung bei allen anfallenden administrativen Aufgaben entsprechend den Anforderungen des Standorts 
- Bearbeitung der Post und Beantwortung eingehender Anrufe, falls zutreffend
- Reisebuchungen für Mitarbeiter
- Beschaffung von Waren und Dienstleistungen über die Coupa-Beschaffungsplattform

A day in the life
In dieser Rolle arbeitest du täglich mit allen Kolleginnen und Kollegen am Standort zusammen. Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören die Bearbeitung des gesamten internen und externen Postverkehrs, die Unterstützung bei der Buchung von Besprechungsräumen sowie die Beantwortung sämtlicher Anfragen von Mitarbeitenden und Besuchern. Darüber hinaus wirkst du aktiv bei Maßnahmen zur Mitarbeiterbindung und bei Anerkennungsprogrammen mit.

About the team
Mit der Erfüllung unserer Kundenbestellungen (Customer Fulfillment oder CF) fing für Amazon alles an. Das Customer Fulfillment Team hat sich mittlerweile von einem Team von Buchhändler:innen hin zu einem hocherfahrenen globalen Team gewandelt, das täglich mehr als 1,5 Millionen Bestellungen bearbeitet. Das Team bildet die Grundlage unseres Geschäfts und hat uns bei der Verbreiterung in neue Regionen und Dienstleistungen geholfen. Mithilfe aufkommender Technologie sind wir stetig auf der Suche nach Möglichkeiten, eine größere und bessere Produktauswahl anzubieten – die schnell und erschwinglich geliefert wird.
Die CF-Teammitglieder sorgen als allererste dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen mit der Geschwindigkeit erhalten, für die wir bekannt sind. Wir arbeiten in Fulfillment-Centern, die das Herzstück von Amazons dynamischem Betriebsnetz bilden. Unsere Fullfilment-Center werden manchmal auch als die „erste Meile“ (First Mile) bezeichnet – hier starten die meisten Amazon-Pakete ihren Versandweg. Wir unterstützen die Verwaltung eines dynamischen Bestands und ermöglichen schnelle Zustellungen rund um die Uhr.
In unseren Fulfillment-Centern sind vielfältige Mitarbeitergruppen beschäftigt. Es gibt zahlreiche Möglichkeiten für Menschen mit den verschiedensten Fähigkeiten. Einige von uns arbeiten mit physischen Produkten. Andere analysieren Daten und helfen unternehmensweit dabei, intelligente Entscheidungen zu treffen.

title: Senior Applied Scientist, Amazon Business - External Integrations
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Business System Integrations connects Amazon Business with millions of business users and thousands of partner procurement, ERP, and finance systems. We build the APIs, protocols, and agentic experiences that let customers buy on Amazon Business directly from the systems they already use. As an Applied Scientist on this team, you will own and advance the ML and GenAI capabilities that make these integrations smarter, faster, and more reliable. You will drive model accuracy, scientific innovation, and global scale across external systems integrations.

Our work includes API-based and protocol-based shopping, such as punchout and emerging agent protocols, along with agentic interactions where buyers and AI agents search, compare, and purchase through natural language. It also covers partner onboarding and integration automation, mapping and normalizing catalog, product, and order data across many partner formats, and evaluation frameworks that measure the quality, accuracy, and latency of our agents.

Key job responsibilities
As an Applied Scientist on this team, you will work across three dimensions: Invent, Implement, and Influence.

Invent: You bring deep domain knowledge and fluency with state-of-the-art scientific approaches and emerging research. You practice customer-obsessed science, working backwards from the needs of business buyers, procurement teams, and integration partners to extend or invent new ML approaches, even when no textbook solution exists. You design novel ML and LLM-based methods for agentic shopping, product search and matching, schema and data mapping across partner systems, and automated evaluation of agent quality. You help define the research agenda for our agentic and protocol-based capabilities, and you lead the scientific strategy for accurate, low-latency responses in conversational and API-driven procurement. You author or co-author articles for internal or external peer-reviewed venues when appropriate and not precluded by business considerations.

Implement: The ML components you develop are integrated directly into production systems serving Amazon Business customers and partners worldwide. You make sound tradeoffs between accuracy and latency, innovation and stability, and short-term and long-term solutions, favoring reuse and established frameworks where appropriate. You make progress semi-autonomously with only occasional guidance, implement at the right level of complexity the first time, and evaluate emerging technologies, including LLMs and GenAI frameworks, largely on your own. You ensure your models and pipelines integrate robustly with catalog, offer, cart, order, and partner data sources and with the services that power external integrations.

Influence: You contribute to planning for the team, including goals, priorities, and roadmaps for ML and GenAI capabilities. You lead the scientific strategy for expanding agentic and integration capabilities across new partners, protocols, and countries. You collaborate with engineering, product, and program teams across Amazon Business so that data integration and ML pipelines are robust and scale with adoption. You mentor scientists and engineers, champion best practices for the AI-Driven Development Life Cycle (AIDLC), and provide peer feedback on research methods and results. You help recruit bar-raising talent through interview drives, and you are visible in the broader scientific community as a subject matter expert, including serving as a Program Committee member or reviewer for peer-reviewed venues.

Basic qualifications

- PhD, or Master's degree and 8+ years of applied research experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc.
- Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc.

title: Facility Manager, Data Center Engg Ops
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 5, 2026

Join our dynamic team and become a critical technical leader who ensures the heartbeat of our global infrastructure remains strong and resilient. In this pivotal role, you'll be the guardian of our data center operations, driving reliability and performance while optimizing operational efficiency across complex technical environments.

Data Center Facility Manger role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment such as stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems that include but not limited to switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAC units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire suppression systems, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. title: Gestionnaire des Ressources Humaines - CDD, Associate Partner, PXT
descriptionHtml:
