Dans notre quête d'être le Meilleur Employeur au Monde, nos équipes mondiales des Ressources Humaines, connues sous le nom de People eXperience and Technology (PXT), contribuent au succès de l'entreprise en favorisant une culture fondée sur la sécurité, l’inclusivité et l’innovation. Le rôle de RH Partenaire Associé(e) constitue un point d'entrée dans les équipes RH chez Amazon, axé sur les processus RH de base et le soutien direct aux employés. Le/la RH Partenaire Associé(e) offre des expériences collaborateurs de qualité en combinant expertise humaine et solutions technologiques. Il/Elle gère les demandes RH essentielles tout en établissant des liens étroits avec les employés dans un environnement de travail de plus en plus numérique. Ce rôle vient compléter les canaux de service PXT en constante évolution d'Amazon — des systèmes enrichis par l'IA aux options d'assistance en direct — en apportant une aide personnalisée et une dimension humaine là où elles sont les plus précieuses. En équilibrant efficacement les processus assistés par la technologie avec des interactions essentielles, il/elle contribue à offrir une expérience PXT fluide qui renforce l'engagement d'Amazon à être le Meilleur Employeur au Monde.



Vos principales responsabilités comprennent le traitement des demandes RH, la gestion des problèmes de temps et de présence, ainsi que l’apport d'un soutien de base aux employés, en faisant remonter les questions complexes au personnel de niveau supérieur. Les HR Partenaire Associé(e)s peuvent soutenir plusieurs sites au sein de leur région géographique et constituer le principal point de contact pour les demandes RH de base. En tant que HR Partenaire Associé(e) au sein de l'équipe One PXT, vous contribuerez à offrir une expérience collaborateur exemplaire à travers chaque interaction. Ce rôle implique de maintenir une présence accueillante tout en fournissant des informations précises et en temps opportun sur les sujets liés aux avantages sociaux, aux politiques et à la paie.

Vous devrez travailler sur site dans un établissement Amazon.

Key job responsibilities
· Fournir un soutien réactif, cordial et professionnel aux employés via différents canaux (en personne, par e-mail, par téléphone), en communiquant des informations précises et en temps opportun sur les avantages sociaux, les politiques, la paie et d'autres sujets liés aux RH.

· Garantir l'exactitude, l'intégrité et la confidentialité des données des employés en maintenant et en traitant les dossiers de manière sécurisée et dans les délais impartis.

· Contribuer à une culture de travail positive et inclusive en soutenant et en mettant en œuvre des initiatives d'engagement et de reconnaissance des employés, notamment en planifiant et en organisant des événements favorisant la cohésion et célébrant les réussites.

· Soutenir la prise de décision fondée sur les données en collectant, en examinant et en analysant les indicateurs clés de nos collaborateurs notamment l'assiduité, l'attrition et l'engagement.

Travailler en partenariat avec les managers et les équipes de support pour encourager et accompagner les collaborateurs dans l’usage des outils en libre-service, qu’ils soient pilotés par l’IA ou traditionnels, et des ressources RH, afin d’optimiser l’expérience collaborateur et la performance opérationnelle. Anticiper et résoudre les problématiques en tirant parti de l’IA comme premier levier, tout en mobilisant activement les ressources internes et les réseaux existants. Préparer et diffuser des communications internes claires et professionnelles à l'intention des employés et des responsables, en veillant à leur conformité avec les standards et le ton de l'organisation.

· Identifier et faire remonter les questions complexes ou sensibles aux responsables RH et aux responsables métiers concernés — telles que les écarts de rémunération, les conflits d'horaires, les demandes d'aménagement, les questions d'invalidité, les questions de congé, les soupçons de mauvaise conduite, les violations de politique, les préoccupations légales ou liées aux instances représentatives du personnel, et autres problématiques de relations sociales.

A day in the life
Une journée type consiste à aider les employés à naviguer dans nos outils RH numériques et plateformes en libre-service, tout en fournissant un soutien réactif et professionnel lorsque nécessaire. Vous passerez du temps sur le terrain, accompagnant les collaborateurs dans l’utilisation efficace des technologies RH, répondant à leurs questions sur les politiques et programmes, et identifiant des opportunités pour améliorer l’adoption du libre-service. Sous la supervision de membres Seniors de l'équipe, vous veillerez à l'exactitude des saisies de données et de la documentation, tout en fournissant un service irréprochable qui renforce la confiance et la sérénité de vos collaborateurs.



Tout au long de votre journée de travail, vous traiterez des demandes RH à l'aide de divers outils et systèmes, en suivant les indicateurs de service tout en développant votre compréhension des opérations RH. Lorsque des demandes complexes se présentent, vous ferez preuve de discernement pour déterminer les moyens les plus appropriées pour les remonter et collaborerez efficacement avec les membres seniors de l'équipe pour leur résolution.

La réussite dans ce rôle requiert une forte orientation service client, le souci du détail, d'excellentes compétences en communication et la capacité à préserver la confidentialité. Grâce à une expérience pratique dans ce poste de niveau débutant, vous développerez des compétences RH fondamentales tout en contribuant à des expériences collaborateurs positives.

- · Expérience dans la communication efficace avec des publics diversifiés (ex. : expliquer des processus, répondre à des préoccupations, fournir des conseils techniques)

Preferred qualifications

title: Software Development Engineer, Juneau, Next-Gen Security Automation
descriptionHtml:
Would you like to help implement novel approaches to how security engineers learn about the numerous Amazon applications. How about working with customers and peers from the entire range of Amazon's businesses on products that make a real difference in our Amazon Security goals? Whether you're passionate about building highly scalable and reliable systems in the cloud or a software developer who likes to solve interesting and complex business problems, Amazon Security has the challenges you are looking for.

Amazon Security is responsible for the protection of customer and corporate data. We are connected to all parts of Amazon's business and its massive, worldwide service-oriented architecture. We are looking for a Software Development Engineers who are excited about leading the technical vision and architecture for innovative, mission critical software security systems that affect how Amazon developers create and deploy software that is secure and protects Amazon's and our customers data.

You will work with the leadership team to drive key engineering and business decisions that will influence the Amazon developer experience. Your first mission is to build a new product that leverages application meta data from a variety of sources to synthesize in a human readable way a variety of application knowledge. This will require rapid iteration with a variety of software and security teams. Since our security systems are foundational to the Amazon ecosystem, you will also have the opportunity to learn about various Amazon business including the Amazon e-Commerce websites, Prime, Alexa, and AWS.

We're looking for a creative, customer- and details-obsessed Software Development Engineer with strong software engineering fundamentals (object-oriented design, algorithms and data structures) and a good grasp of advanced systems concepts and design. • Partner with cross-functional teams to translate intricate security requirements into elegant, high-performance software solutions

This team will work with local and international security teams to design a greenfield product that solves the complex problem of rapidly knowing critical security details about every Amazon application. We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Clearable DCEO Facility Manager, LCK InfraOps DCEO
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Data Center Engineering Operations Facility Manager to serve as a technical resource and leader within Amazon data centers. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels of data center operations. The Data Center Facility Manager is responsible for the overall operation and maintenance of all electrical, mechanical, and HVAC equipment within the data center. The Data Center Facility Manager will assist in maintaining a high reliability and performance while keeping operating costs in facilities at a minimum. This equipment supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.

This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment such as stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems that include but not limited to switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAC units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire suppression systems, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

This is a clearable position. The selected candidate must be a US citizen and will be required to successfully obtain and maintain a Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility.

Key job responsibilities
- Oversee all aspects of the data center's critical physical infrastructure. Ensure that all work performed within the space is done to high quality and without impact to internal/external customers
- Manage teams of 24x7 engineering technicians in all facets of their career
- Engage in improvement projects, often requiring reaching out to a variety of support teams, and drive them from conception to completion
- Coordinates daily with a multitude of third party vendors ensuring adherence to contracted SLAs

- Work in a noisy environment
- Work at depths, such as under raised floors

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. title: Sr. Solutions Architect, Fire TV Devices Business Development Team
descriptionHtml:
The vision of the Fire TV organization is to create devices that allow our customers to experience the streamed content, games and apps that they most enjoy from all the range of TVs, brands they like across the world. Fire TV has focused on finding and engaging with the user's content and presenting it on the 'best screen in the house'.

As our device-maker partners grow their global footprint, we are looking for a Solutions Architect who can be the technical bridge between Amazon product and engineering teams and external partners, including original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), original design manufacturers (ODMs), system-on-chip (SoC) vendors, and component suppliers.

In this role you will combine technical knowledge of device hardware/software, Cloud Services, and AI/Voice services with the business acumen to engage partner leadership at the CTO level. You will guide partners through the full product lifecycle, from reference architecture selection and hardware bring-up to software integration and global launch. If you are a curious, collaborative problem-solver who thrives where technology meets business development, we would love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Act as the trusted technical advisor to partner CTO-level executives, translating their business goals into technology strategies that accelerate time-to-launch for devices shipping globally.
- Advise partners across the full Fire TV stack — device hardware/software, cloud and streaming services, and Alexa voice integration — helping them adopt new capabilities and deliver innovative customer experiences.
- Collaborate with internal product, engineering, and UX teams to represent partner and end-customer needs, shaping product specifications and roadmap priorities.
- Lead technical reviews of Fire TV device specifications and capabilities to share best practices and resolve integration challenges.
- Build scalable self-service tooling and reusable reference artifacts that help partners onboard and integrate more efficiently.

A day in the life
Your morning might start with a video call alongside an OEM engineering team working through a hardware bring-up issue on a new SoC platform, followed by a design review with the Fire TV software team to align on an upcoming integration milestone. After lunch you could be drafting a technical best-practices guide for partner onboarding, then joining a business development call to advise on the feasibility of a new device concept. You will regularly travel to meet partners and teammates around the world, building the relationships that turn ideas into products customers love.

About the team
The Fire TV Devices Business Development and Solutions Architecture team partners with TV manufacturers and SoC vendors worldwide to bring Fire TV-powered smart TVs to customers globally. Our team is distributed across multiple regions, and we work where hardware, software, and business strategy meet. We are investing in AI-powered tooling and self-service platforms to help partners integrate faster while maintaining the high-quality customer experience Fire TV is known for. If you want to shape how millions of people interact with their television, this is the team to join.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- Experience with one or more of: embedded systems / consumer devices, cloud-based or streaming media services, or voice/AI-driven experiences — including how they integrate into an end-to-end product
- Experience working directly with external partners (OEM/ODM, content/streaming, or platform partners) in a technical advisory, integration, or solutions role
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Mandarin and English

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
- Experience spanning more than one layer of the stack — e.g., device + cloud, streaming service + client integration, or voice/AI services integrated into a consumer product
- Experience working cross-functionally with business development, product, and partner engineering teams to land technical deals
- Familiarity with the TV / smart display / streaming devices (silicon vendors, panel makers, ODMs, content/streaming providers)

title: Financial Analyst, Device Finance, Amazon Devices & Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Devices & Services (DaS) Finance is looking for a Financial Analyst to join our Brazil Device Finance team in São Paulo. This role has a Sales and Marketing Finance focus but covers a broad scope of finance activities — accounting reconciliations, logistics tracking, Brazilian tax treatment, and intercompany flows.

You will partner with the Brazil Finance Manager to keep these processes running accurately and on time, while identifying opportunities to automate and simplify them. This is not a standard reporting role — we're looking for someone who can own the transactional baseline today and systematically reduce it over time. The automation and process improvements you build for Brazil can be showcased and scaled to other international finance teams across the organization.

Key job responsibilities
Perform monthly accounting reconciliations between Amazon's records and the third-party importer, resolving discrepancies in logistics, pricing, and inventory data
Support the monthly financial close process for Brazil, including journal entries, intercompany reconciliations, and variance analysis
Track and reconcile logistics and shipment data with external partners and Amazon's internal systems
Support tax-related financial processes specific to Brazil's regulatory environment
Build and maintain reports and dashboards that give the business team visibility into financial performance, cost drivers, and margin trends
Identify repetitive, manual workflows in the Brazil finance process and develop automation solutions (e.g., using Excel macros, SQL, Python, or internal Amazon tools) to reduce cycle time and error rates
Showcase and scale successful automation and process improvements to other international finance teams
Assist with planning, forecasting, and budgeting cycles for the Brazil Devices business
Partner with the Brazil Finance Manager, worldwide accounting and finance teams, and the broader business leadership team to provide accurate, timely financial data that supports strategic decision-making

A day in the life
You will work closely with the Brazil Finance Manager in São Paulo, acting as the finance team's execution backbone for the Brazilian marketplace. You'll interact with cross-functional teams — supply chain, accounting, tax, and the local business leadership — as well as worldwide accounting and finance stakeholders, and see firsthand how finance enables a complex international operation. Over time, you'll take on more ownership of the automation roadmap, progressively reducing manual work across the Brazil finance processes.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Prime Air is seeking a Software Development Manager to lead and grow the Airspace Management and Orchestration System (AMOS) software team. This is a unique opportunity to shape the system that coordinates a fleet of autonomous delivery drones, manages shared airspace, and optimizes deliveries per hour as Prime Air expands.

As the software leader for AMOS, you will own the architecture, development, and operation of scalable services that orchestrate drone missions and coordinate activity across drone and ground systems. Your team will build the capabilities to plan and sequence missions, deconflict flight paths, and allocate airspace capacity—turning advances in planning and optimization into reliable production services. title: Software Dev Engineer, Pricing Shared Platform
descriptionHtml:
Pricing Shared Services team owns the core set of systems which decides prices of products sold by Amazon Retail. The team owns system data vending, notification and price publishing systems which are used by multiple pricing strategy teams for building their price recommendation and submission of their recommended prices. These systems scale to thousands of TPS and computes prices for billions of listing every month. We are building new services that radically scales publishing capacity of our systems while making our services multi-tenant to support Amazon's growing number of businesses. We collaborate with product, science, and business teams to figure out new ideas. We innovate by applying state-of-the-art computer science to define, design, and build our systems. And we experiment with different approaches, eager to learn from whatever the results are while having fun along the way.

To help meet these goals, we are looking for a passionate, talented Software Development Engineer. We are looking for someone who innovates, loves solving hard problems, and looks for 'yes' as the answer. As a Software Development Engineer, you will develop services using your expertise and experience with a variety of technologies. You will deep-dive into distributed systems to design and optimize for performance, maintainability, scalability, and extensibility. You will innovate and scale services, addressing problems that span new feature development to new system creation. You will design and write clean, maintainable code and integrate data from a large number of services. And you will contribute to the development of yourself and colleagues through peer code-reviews and mentoring, improving the technical knowledge and engineering practices of your team.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, test, and operate features that scale and extend the Amazon Store experience on Echo Show and Fire devices.
- Write high-quality, well-tested code and participate actively in code reviews, both giving and receiving thoughtful feedback.
- Contribute to systems that render the Amazon store in real time, keep it in sync, and support conversational, multimodal shopping flows.
- Help extend the experience to new surfaces and international marketplaces, working through ambiguity where there is no existing playbook.
- Own your components end-to-end through livesite operations — monitoring, on-call participation, and continuous improvement of reliability and performance.
- Collaborate with engineering, science, product, and design partners across Alexa Shopping, including teammates in Seattle across time zones.
- Contribute ideas to technical designs, ask good questions, and grow your scope and autonomy over time with support from senior engineers and mentors.

About the team
You'll join Pricing Error Detection (PED), part of Amazon's Pricing Shared Services. Our job is simple to say and hard to do: make sure no customer ever sees a price that's wrong, too low for Amazon to sustain or too high for customers to trust. We review hundreds of millions of price decisions every week, before and after they go live, across Amazon's marketplaces worldwide. To do that, we build LLM-based agents that check prices against live signals from across the web, and machine learning models that judge whether each price makes sense. Together they catch errors, correct them, and stop them from happening again. If you want to put the latest GenAI to work at Amazon scale, where every decision protects both customers and the business, we'd love to talk.

Basic qualifications

-3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
-2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
-Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

-3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
-Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Data Center Controls Technician, US-West, PHX
descriptionHtml:
As a member of the Global Controls Team, you will collaborate with highly motivated operators, engineers and technicians in the data center industry to maintain and optimize critical infrastructure systems. You will be responsible for troubleshooting and maintaining the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) while developing new processes and standards that drive innovation in the controls space.

AWS data centers utilize sophisticated industrial control systems to automatically operate mechanical equipment, maintaining optimal temperature and pressure conditions throughout the facilities. These systems integrate and monitor multiple critical components, including generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic and static transfer switches, air-cooled and water-cooled chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), and air economizers. Within this industrial control system infrastructure, the BMS serves as the primary control platform for all mechanical systems within the data center, while the EPMS functions as the primary monitoring platform for all electrical systems. This position offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in mission-critical environments while contributing to the reliability and efficiency of AWS's global infrastructure.

Key job responsibilities
Manage small to medium-sized projects and programs.
Perform point-to-point checkouts, first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting, and maintenance of BMS/EPMS code and hardware.
Provision servers, controllers, industrial PCs, and networks; test communication with third-party devices.
Install, replace, configure, and calibrate sensors.
Read and interpret electrical schematics and control panel drawings, applying closed-loop controls and field sensor scaling.
Supervise low-voltage contractors per AWS requirements.
Provide commissioning and systems-level testing; create red-lined drawings and documentation.
Follow change management processes for work requests and methods of procedures.
Participate in factory witness tests and perform root cause analysis during testing and commissioning.
Monitor ticketing systems, prioritize tasks, and manage service agreements (vendor scheduling, QA, invoice review).
Enforce on-site safety methodology.

Physical Requirements Lift and move up to 50 lbs; use ladders, platforms, and OSHA-standard PPE including safety harnesses.

A day in the life
As a Data Center Controls Technician, your primary customers are Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO), who rely on you to keep Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS) healthy and operational. On a given day, you are the boots on the ground solving problems that directly impact data center availability. You might diagnose a controller communication loss, calibrate instruments feeding inaccurate data to operators, or supervise vendors performing quarterly maintenance. descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

The Sr. Product Manager – Technical (PM-T) will lead the discovery, definition, and delivery of capabilities required to launch and expand Amazon Leo's eCommerce presence into new geographies. This role involves working on complex, high-impact challenges — from understanding regulatory and technical requirements unique to each market, to building scalable solutions that accelerate country readiness.

The PM-T will partner closely with engineering, legal, and business teams to define requirements, drive technical architecture decisions, and ensure the right foundations are in place for a successful launch. This is a high-visibility role at the intersection of product strategy and technical execution, with direct impact on Amazon Leo's global expansion roadmap.

Own and instrument readiness as a gating input metric for country launch sequencing. Define, track, and optimize compliance readiness scores across target geographies to accelerate launch timelines.

Identify and prioritize regulatory, technical, and customer experience requirements across the full LBGUPS (Learn, Buy, Get, Use, Pay, Serve) journey, translating country-specific needs into clear product specifications for engineering teams.

title: Data Center Controls Engineer, Data Center Capacity Delivery - Controls
descriptionHtml:
As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptable power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.

Key job responsibilities
Review quarterly maintenance results and action items for BMS/EPMS and drive resolution.
Develop project scope, schedule, budget, and level of effort (LOE) for customer requests.
Manage scope, schedule, finance, and execution of BMS/EPMS improvement projects.
Support procurement: RFQs/RFPs, RFI responses, vendor proposal reviews, and purchase orders.
Participate in the AWS global on-call schedule for immediate technical support to in-service data centers.
Attend project meetings, coordinate with project leaders, and report status to Controls management.
Support commissioning activities in data centers.
Review, troubleshoot, and iterate on the controls sequence of operation (SOO); provide design-team feedback.
Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.
Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables and navigate challenging situations.
Financially manage BMS/EPMS service contracts.
Visit assigned local in-operation data centers to troubleshoot, meet customers, and supervise vendor compliance with scope, design, SOO, and local codes.

About the team
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- Experience with Industrial Controls Systems, both hardware and software.

descriptionHtml:
As a Principal Finance Manager, you will closely work with business and finance leaders to develop financial models for both short and long term business and financial goals, evaluate new business opportunities, and drive business initiatives, including AI initiatives for Sponsored Product Advertising. This role requires a self-starter and independent individual with strong financial modeling abilities, problem solving skills, a keen attention to detail, and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment with ambiguous situations.
The successful candidate will have shown experience in past roles influencing business leaders and supporting decision-making in rapidly evolving environments. This role also has regular interaction with executives and various business units across Amazon, and therefore requires strong interpersonal and communication skills. In addition, this role requires strong business sense and the capability to independently drive business partnership. This role demands a finance leader who is equal parts strategist and operator. Someone who can deeply understand business nuances and translate that into financial impact.


Key job responsibilities
• Develop financial insights and narratives during all planning, forecasting, and reporting cycles.
• Manage and develop the financial planning and analysis processes, including long range planning, and OP1/OP2 planning processes.
• Partner with finance teams across Advertising to standardize, streamline, and prioritize improvements, remove roadblocks, and increase the reliability and efficiency of reporting.
• Partner with the business teams to drive alignment between financial forecast and business plan of record.
• Support ad-hoc requests and assist in various requests from finance and business executives.
• Assess the impact of AI initiatives on the financial plan
• Assist in the development of new advertising products by evaluating the business, understanding customer needs and value drivers, and crafting high impact growth strategies for the business
• Partner with the Sponsored Product Ads business team to anticipate business requirements, trends, and variances; develop action plans; measure and analyze results; identify and drive growth and improvement opportunities.

Basic qualifications

- 12+ years of finance, accounting, or related analytical field experience
- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or CPA
- Experience in a leadership position managing finance, accounting and operational processes

title: Sr. Security Services SA, AWS Security Services SA - North America
descriptionHtml:
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and unwavering support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

AWS is building a new team focused on driving customer adoption of AWS security services - and we're looking for a senior technical specialist to help define what great looks like from day one.

Customers are moving fast, especially into generative AI and agentic architectures, and they need help doing that securely. At the same time, they want to get more from the AWS security services they already own and adopt new ones with confidence. That gap is where this team lives.

As a Sr. Solutions Architect on the Security Services team, you will work directly with enterprise customers to design, adopt, and operationalize AWS security services at scale. You won't just advise - you'll own the technical relationship, architect the solutions, and stay engaged through adoption. You'll work alongside a paired security services seller as a technical and commercial unit, and you'll bring what you learn back to AWS product teams to shape the roadmap.

This is a founding role on a new team. The playbooks don't exist yet. You'll help write them.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end technical relationship with a portfolio of enterprise customers, guiding their adoption of AWS security services including Security Hub, GuardDuty, Amazon Inspector, and Amazon Detective
- Architect solutions to complex security problems where the technology strategy is not yet defined - helping customers move from intent to implementation with confidence
- Work as a paired technical and commercial unit with a security services seller, driving service adoption and measurable customer outcomes together
- Help customers secure their generative AI and agentic architectures, meeting them where they are and helping them move faster without sacrificing their security posture
- Serve as the voice of the customer back to AWS security product teams - surface field patterns, identify gaps, and translate that feedback into clear requirements that shape the roadmap
- Build and maintain relationships with AWS Partners to design and deliver architectures that combine AWS-native security services with best-in-class partner solutions
- Produce thought leadership that scales your impact beyond individual engagements - blogs, reference architectures, workshops, and conference sessions that help customers and the field community
- Partner with AWS Account Teams and security strategy roles to connect service adoption to broader security transformation at customers

A day in the life
No two days look the same in this role. You might start the morning reviewing a customer's detection and response architecture - mapping out how Security Hub and GuardDuty fit into their existing tooling and where the gaps are. Mid-morning, you join a call with your paired seller to align on an account plan for an enterprise customer consolidating third-party security tooling onto AWS. You draft a few notes on a pattern you've seen across three customers that the product team should know about.

In the afternoon, you run a workshop with a customer's security engineering team - walking through how to operationalize Security Hub findings at scale. You wrap the day reviewing a draft reference architecture you've been building for securing agentic workloads, something you plan to publish as a blog post next month.

Through all of it, you're doing the work directly. You're the technical expert in the room, and customers know it.

About the team
This is a new team within the AWS Customer Solutions & Scale Innovation (CSSI) organization. The team's mission is to accelerate customer adoption of AWS security services by pairing deep technical expertise with a commercial go-to-market motion alongside security services sellers.

You will work closely with AWS Account Teams, security strategy roles, and AWS Partners to help customers build confident, secure operations on AWS. The customers you serve are navigating real complexity - they're adopting generative AI, rethinking identity and access models, and trying to keep pace with a threat environment that evolves daily. This team exists to help them do all of that on AWS.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
- Experience working with end user or developer communities
- Experience in identifying security issues and risks, and developing mitigation plans
- Experience securing generative AI or agentic workloads, or a strong point of view on how security models need to evolve for AI-native architectures

title: 2027 Software Dev Engineer Intern (Machine Learning) - UK
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to solve real customer problems through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on scalable services in a collaborative team environment? Do you want to see your code directly impact millions of customers worldwide?

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. Customer obsession is part of our company DNA, which has made us one of the world's most beloved brands.

Our Software Development Engineer (SDE) interns use modern technology to solve complex problems while seeing their work's impact first-hand. The challenges SDE interns solve at Amazon are meaningful and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products globally. We seek individuals passionate about creating new products, features, and services while managing ambiguity in an environment where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.

At Amazon, we believe in ownership at every level. As an SDE intern, you'll own the entire lifecycle of your code - from design through deployment and ongoing operations. This ownership mindset, combined with our commitment to operational excellence, ensures we deliver the highest quality solutions for our customers.

We're looking for curious minds who think big and want to define tomorrow's technology. At Amazon, you'll grow into the high-impact engineer you know you can be, supported by a culture of learning and mentorship. Every day brings exciting new challenges and opportunities for personal growth.

Amazon internships across all seasons are full-time positions, and interns should expect to work in office, Monday-Friday, up to 40 hours per week typically between 8am-5pm. Specific team norms around working hours will be communicated by your manager. Interns should not have conflicts such as classes or other employment during the Amazon work-day. Applicants should have a minimum of one quarter/semester/trimester remaining in their studies after their internship concludes.

Key job responsibilities
- Collaborate and communicate effectively with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to design, build, and operate innovative products and services that delight our customers, while participating in technical discussions to drive solutions forward.

- Break down complex, ambiguous problems into well-defined, solvable components before implementation.

- Contribute to the design and development of scalable, reliable services, with distributed-systems scope varying by team.

- Participate in code reviews as a core engineering practice, providing constructive feedback and validating correctness.

- Contribute to clear and accurate technical documentation.

- Use GenAI and AI-powered tools to enhance development productivity, and critically validate, verify, and integrate AI-generated code, exercising sound judgement about when to trust AI output.

- Write clean, maintainable code following best practices and design patterns.

- Work in an agile environment practicing CI/CD principles while participating in operational responsibilities including on-call duties.

- Demonstrate operational excellence through monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues.

A day in the life
As an intern, you will be matched to a manager and a mentor and will have the opportunity to influence the evolution of Amazon technology and lead critical projects early in your career.

In addition to working on an impactful project, you will have the opportunity to engage with Amazonians for both personal and professional development, expand your network, and participate in activities with other interns throughout your internship. No matter the location of your internship, we give you the tools to own your project and learn in a real-world setting.

About the team
Intern Community:
As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a vibrant, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.

Support:
The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.

Learning Sessions:
Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's cutting-edge learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.

Opportunities:
Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.

Basic qualifications

- Are enrolled in a Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields at time of application
- Knowledge of computer science fundamentals such as object-oriented design, operating systems, algorithms, data structures, and complexity analysis
- Experience with at least one general-purpose programming language such as Java, Python, C++, C#, Go, Rust, or TypeScript

Preferred qualifications

- Experience from a technical internship
- Experience with distributed, multi-tiered systems, algorithms, and relational databases
- Experience with Cloud platforms (preferably AWS), database systems (SQL and NoSQL), AI tools for development productivity, contributing to open-source projects, and/or version control systems
- Experience using AI-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings
- Ability to effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions
- Adept at handling ambiguous or undefined problems as well as ability to think abstractly
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

title: Data Center Controls Engineer, Data Center Capacity Delivery - Controls
descriptionHtml:
As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptable power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.

Key job responsibilities
Train and assist internal customers and stakeholders with the creation, design, configuration, validation, installation, commissioning and operation of BMS and EPMS systems.

Provide technical assistance and support to operations during life cycle of the data center.  Review results and action items from the quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS and take actions to get them resolved.

Develop BMS & EPMS projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders.

Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS and EPMS improvement projects in AWS data centers.

Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.

Participate in AWS global on-call schedule to provide immediate BMS and EPMS technical support to in-service data centers.  Attend project related meetings, coordinate with project leaders and regularly report status to Controls and stakeholders management.

Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.

Review, implement, troubleshoot and iterate on the controls sequence of operation (SOO) and provide necessary feedback to the design team.

Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.

Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.

Financially manage BMS and EPMS service contracts.

Frequently visit (locally) assigned in-operation data centers to troubleshoot, meet customers, supervise vendor’s work to ensure compliance with the scope, design, SOO and applicable local codes.

About the team
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related field plus 5+ years of relevant controls experience, OR 10+ years of relevant controls experience in lieu of a degree.
- 5+ years of experience with industrial controls in critical environment (data center, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, oil & gas, petrochemical, laboratory, power, water etc.).
- 4+ years of general project or vendor management experience (request for proposals, bidding, change orders, quality control, and RFI and submittal tracking) associated with construction and project execution.

Preferred qualifications

- Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- Experience designing, configuring, programming, installing, troubleshooting or servicing HVAC Controls or Electrical SCADA systems application specific controllers, software and networks.
- Experiencing using common industrial communication protocols (MQTT, BACnet and/or MODBUS).
- Demonstrated understanding of engineering documentation, electrical and mechanical diagrams, and standard operating procedures.
- Ability to manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements, and navigate difficult situations.
- Experience designing data centers or critical MEP infrastructure
- Registered as a Professional Engineer (PE), or certified Project Management Professional (PMP).

title: Installation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Transform network infrastructure by joining our dynamic team! You'll be at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that drive network stability and scalability, using your technical expertise to create automated systems that power global technological advancement.

Infra Delivery Install Technicians will collaborate with cross-functional teams, troubleshoot complex technical scenarios, and implement strategic solutions that keep our network running seamlessly. Expect to engage in hands-on technical work that requires creativity, precision, and a passion for technological innovation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. title: Software Development Manager, Emerging Devices Software
descriptionHtml:
Join us in building the future of personal devices at Amazon!

Are you ready to shape the future of how people experience technology in their everyday lives? Join us in building the next generation of personal devices — where hardware, software, and AI converge to create experiences that feel like magic.

The Emerging Devices Software (EDS) organization is pioneering intelligent software solutions that power Amazon's Personal Devices, including Smart Eyewear and other emerging wearable categories. Our mission is to create seamless, AI-driven experiences that live at the intersection of hardware, software, and artificial intelligence — redefining how customers interact with technology in their daily lives. We're building the future of personal devices while maintaining Amazon's highest standards for quality, reliability, and customer obsession.

The personal devices challenge is a fascinating blend of real-world complexity and technological innovation. We're tackling multidimensional problems that span mobile applications, cloud services, on-device intelligence, and hardware integration — all while delivering best-in-class user experiences to customers around the world. From optimizing low-latency interactions on constrained wearable hardware to building scalable cloud backends and integrating ML/AI capabilities, every problem we solve pushes the boundaries of what's possible.

We are looking for a seasoned Software Development Manager to lead an engineering team within EDS, solving these intricate challenges. You'll work on software that span the mobile-cloud stack, own end-to-end delivery of features and experiences, and help shape the long-term technical direction of our products.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Software Development Engineers working across the mobile-cloud stack, fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement

- Own end-to-end delivery of features and platform capabilities for Amazon's Personal Devices, including Smart Eyewear and other emerging wearable categories

- Drive technical strategy and architecture decisions for mobile applications (Android, iOS, React Native) and cloud services, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance

- Partner closely with product managers, UX designers, QA, and cross-functional engineering teams to define requirements and deliver high-impact features from concept to launch

- Set a high engineering bar through rigorous design reviews, code quality standards, and best practices across the software development lifecycle

- Identify and resolve technical risks, ambiguities, and complex issues spanning the device, mobile, and cloud layers of the stack

- Recruit, hire, and develop top engineering talent, building a diverse and high-performing team aligned to Amazon's Leadership Principles

- Communicate effectively with senior leadership and stakeholders on team progress, technical direction, and strategic priorities

- Contribute to the long-term technical roadmap of EDS, helping shape the future of wearable and personal device technology at Amazon

A day in the life
- Real-World Impact: Your team's code will power experiences used by customers every day — on devices they wear, carry, and rely on to stay connected to the world around them

- Scale That Matters: You'll build systems that serve customers globally, operating reliably across diverse environments, connectivity conditions, and device form factors

- State of the Art Tech Stack: You'll leverage the latest in AI, mobile development, and cloud computing to solve real-world problems at the intersection of hardware and software

- Innovation at Scale: You'll lead a team that isn't just implementing existing solutions — you'll be creating entirely new experiences for wearable and personal device experiences

- End-to-End Ownership: You'll own complete solutions from mobile application features to cloud services, from device integration to production operations

About the team
The SDEs in your team will:

- Design, implement, and maintain features for mobile applications (Android, iOS, React Native) and cloud services that power Amazon's Personal Devices

- Write and maintain high-quality, well-tested code for critical components of the device-mobile-cloud stack

- Be responsible for building and maintaining robust testing frameworks, monitoring system performance, and ensuring software operates reliably across diverse device and connectivity scenarios

- Work in an agile environment, participating in technical design discussions and code reviews while helping to establish best practices for software development across mobile and cloud

- Investigate and resolve complex issues spanning the device, mobile, and cloud layers of the stack

- Contribute to the continuous improvement of team processes, tools, and engineering practices as the product and platform evolve

And all this happens under the strong leadership of talented SDMs like you!

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of engineering experience
- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Certificate Services, AWS Certificate Manager
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to work at the intersection of security, encryption and every internet-connected device in the world? We're looking for Software Development Engineers to build the services that help our customers secure their websites, APIs and devices with digital certificates that just work.

Our organization owns everything "certificates" for Amazon. That includes AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) for managing TLS and other X.509 certificates, AWS Private Certificate Authority (PCA) for private certificate issuance, and AWS Signer for code signing. Our services help customers create, manage, and deploy digital certificates based on strong cryptography and public-key infrastructure (PKI) best practices.

Certificate lifetimes are getting shorter and Post-Quantum cryptography is coming, while certificates now secure everything from IoT devices to AI agent workloads. Demand for content signing is growing as creators and publishers look for ways to prove their work is original. Customers need certificate management that runs without manual work at any scale. Certificates sit underneath almost every secure connection on the internet, so the systems you build here protect customer traffic across AWS.

We want engineers who question the status quo and push leadership and peers to do the right thing for the right reasons. Good ideas come from every level of the team, and we act on them.

You'll choose the right technology for the problem and learn AWS's distributed-systems and deployment-safety practices. If you don't know certificates or PKI yet, you'll learn them here.



Key job responsibilities
Design, build, and operate distributed services where security and availability can't be compromised.

Take ambiguous requirements, clarify the problem with customers and partner teams, and deliver the simplest design that solves it.

Own features end to end, from design through testing, deployment, and operations, and make trade-offs between new features and operational work.

Participate in on-call, find the root cause of production issues, and deliver permanent fixes rather than workarounds.

Improve how the team builds and operates software, including tooling, testing, and deployment safety.

Write clear design documents and system documentation, give design and code review feedback, and mentor other engineers.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 3+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 3+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 3+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Experience implementing a cloud-based technology solution, or experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS
- Knowledge of one or more of the following domains: web application development, penetration testing, mobile security, cryptography, public key infrastructure, forensic security, IP security, SSL/TLS, computer viruses and malware, network security, trusted security, trusted execution, threat intelligence, IoT security implications, or authentication

title: Senior Product Designer, Kiro
descriptionHtml:
Agentic development is redefining how software gets built, and Kiro is at the center of it. Kiro is an agentic AI from AWS that turns prompts into structured requirements, designs, and sequenced tasks, then implements them with parallel agents that verify correctness. It's available as a desktop IDE, a CLI, a web app, a mobile app, and Kiro Crew (an open-source persistent development workspace), all powered by one unified agent harness.

We're looking for a Senior UX Designer to help shape this experience. You'll initially focus on Kiro IDE, a surface with distinct design challenges and significant room to define the experience. You'll build deep understanding of the developer audience while leading hands-on design work: concept framing, interaction patterns, and shipping real improvements that inform longer-term product direction.

The design challenges here are unlike traditional developer tools: How should a developer setup their agentic workflows? How do we improve spec-driven development? How do you build trust in AI that writes and validates code on your behalf?

You excel in the early, ambiguous stages of design: concept modeling, ecosystem mapping, user story development, and framing the experience before pixels are ever pushed. You know how to set up a problem space so that the right solutions emerge. You are equally strong in execution, iterating rapidly and prototyping in whatever tool fits the moment. You adapt your approach based on the problem, the timeline, and the team. We value designers who bring their own perspective and working style. What matters is the quality of thinking and the impact of the outcome, not conformity to a single methodology.

You will collaborate with product teams, engineering teams, and executive leadership to identify and execute on opportunities, serving as the voice of the developer with senior leadership.

If you want your design work to shape how millions of developers build software with AI, we'd love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Go deep on audience understanding: conduct and synthesize research to build rich mental models of how developers think, work, and adopt agentic tools
- Lead concept design and early-stage framing: ecosystem maps, concept models, user stories, journey frameworks, and experience principles that set the foundation for product direction
- Own and drive the end-to-end design process for major features
- Shape the UX of agentic workflows including spec-driven development, autonomous mode, parallel agents, hooks, and correctness verification
- Iterate rapidly and prototype at the right fidelity, from paper sketches and concept storyboards to high-fidelity interactive prototypes, choosing the right tools and methods for each challenge
- Partner with product management and engineering to influence strategy through strong design rationale and customer advocacy
- Mentor junior designers and define scalable design patterns that raise the bar across the team

About the team
You'll join a team of designers and researchers embedded directly in the Kiro product organization. We sit alongside product and engineering as one team, which means design has a seat at the table from strategy through shipping. We have dedicated UX research support and work in close collaboration with our researchers, so design decisions are grounded in real customer insight, not assumptions.

Our team covers the full Kiro product suite: IDE, CLI, Web, Mobile, Kiro Crew, the Kiro agent, and platform capabilities. We support each other's growth, share work openly, and believe that the best design comes from people who bring diverse perspectives and their own way of working. If you thrive in an environment where you have real ownership, close partnership with research, and the autonomy to choose how you approach a problem, you'll feel at home here.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of design experience
- 3+ years of working with or evaluating AI systems experience
- Experience in a variety of design, wire-framing, and prototyping tools
- A portfolio that demonstrates deep audience understanding and early-stage design thinking: concept models, ecosystem maps, user stories, experience frameworks, and how you translate research into design strategy, not just polished final UI
- Experience designing complex, multi-step workflows across multiple platforms or surfaces, with strong information architecture and interaction design skills

Preferred qualifications

- Experience designing developer tools, IDEs, command-line products, or open-source developer experiences
- Track record of flexibly adapting design process and methods based on the problem at hand

title: System Development Engineer II, Imperium Data Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Robotics is looking for an experienced Systems Development Engineer to join the Imperium Data Services team in Austin. Data Services owns the source-of-truth data behind network automation across Amazon's fulfillment network: what devices exist, where they live, how they should be configured, which credentials they use, and what state they are actually in. Our services handle nearly a billion API calls a month and sit underneath config generation, deployment, and lifecycle workflows for hundreds of thousands of IP-enabled devices across thousands of sites. When our data is wrong, networks break; when it is right and fast, the rest of automation can run with confidence.

In this role you will partner with software, systems, and network engineers around the world to build and operate the data layer that network automation depends on. You will work on high-throughput APIs and data stores, collection of live device state, data pipelines, and the validation and staging gates that stop bad data before it reaches production devices. Network engineers and automation teams rely on the accuracy of what we serve. Your work will let them get answers in seconds and spend their time on hard problems instead of manual data cleanup. We value correctness, simplicity, and operational excellence in our designs.

Key job responsibilities
As a Systems Development Engineer on Data Services, you will design, build, and operate highly available services that model network devices, sites, and credentials, serving thousands of requests per second to automation workflows across the fulfillment network. You will build systems that collect the observed state of devices, including hardware inventory, firmware, interfaces, and neighbors, compare it against intended state, and surface drift before it causes customer impact. You will own data quality end to end, from schema design and validation at write time to staged, reviewable data changes, data health monitoring, and alarms that catch bad data before it reaches device configurations. You will lead migrations of legacy data sources onto modern APIs without disrupting the dozens of downstream teams that depend on them. You will take part in on-call, drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions, and turn recurring operational pain into automation, using AWS (CDK, Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, OpenSearch) and CI/CD pipelines to automate infrastructure and deployments.

Ideal candidates enjoy working where distributed systems meet network data. You communicate clearly, turn ambiguous requirements into simple, durable designs, and care as much about how a service runs in production as how it is built. You will work in a fast-moving, collaborative environment with partner teams who depend on your systems every day.

A day in the life
You will be a part of an agile development team following innovative best practices in software development where you will work on technical designs, architecture and coding. To build our applications, you will interact with network engineering teams to gather requirements, provide technical solutions and develop the software that are required in defining our next generation products.

About the team

We own the systems of record for network devices, sites, and credentials, plus the systems that observe what is actually running on devices in the field.
