title: Supply Chain Manager II, Technology Materials Planning
descriptionHtml:
The OpsTech Solutions - Supply Chain (OTS-SC) team plays a critical role in supporting Amazon's Worldwide (WW) Stores business by overseeing planning, purchasing, procuring, provisioning, assembling, shipping, deploying, and managing IT equipment. This team is responsible for facilitating new site launches, retrofits, expansions, relocations, colocations, decommissions, customer programs, and lifecycle programs.

Within this dynamic environment, the Supply Chain Mgr will play a crucial role for executing integrated planning activities across demand planning, supply planning, and production scheduling. The role requires hands-on ownership of planning processes to ensure equipment is available and deployed on time, in full (OTIF), and in alignment with evolving business needs.

The ideal candidate brings a strong mix of supply chain expertise, data fluency, and technical acumen. This includes leveraging AI/ML models to enhance forecast accuracy and optimize planning decisions, while driving process automation and systems integration at scale. Acting as a cross-functional bridge between business, operations, and technical teams, the Supply Chain Mgr will play a pivotal role in shaping how OTS-SC anticipates and meets demand with speed, precision, and agility.


Key job responsibilities
- Own and execute end-to-end supply chain planning across demand forecasting, supply planning, and production scheduling to ensure on-time, in-full (OTIF) delivery of IT hardware and infrastructure.
- Translate demand signals and business requirements into executable supply and production plans, collaborating closely with procurement, capital planning, and deployment teams.
- Develop and maintain data-driven forecasting models that integrate historical trends, project inputs, and operational constraints.
- Identify and mitigate planning risks including demand variability, supplier lead times, and production capacity limitations through proactive scenario planning and cross-functional alignment.
- Lead the development and enhancement of internal planning tools and applications that improve forecast accuracy, material visibility, inventory management, and automation of planning processes.
- Act as the functional owner and product lead for key supply chain systems—gathering requirements, defining roadmaps, and ensuring tools meet the evolving needs of users and stakeholders.
- Collaborate with technical teams (data engineering, software developers, BI/analytics) to build scalable solutions that integrate ERP, supply chain, and procurement systems.
- Drive the development and deployment of planning tools and dashboards using platforms such as Redshift, PowerBI, Quicksight, or Tableau to enable real-time visibility and decision-making.
- Leverage AI/ML models to enhance demand forecasting, anomaly detection, and exception-based planning to reduce manual workload and improve decision-making.
- Conduct user testing, implement feedback loops, and continuously iterate on tools and features to drive adoption and maximize impact across planning workflows.
- Partner with cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Operations, Finance, Engineering) to align tool development and planning strategies with broader business objectives.
- Monitor key planning and system adoption KPIs (forecast accuracy, fill rate, inventory turns, tool usage) and report findings in regular business reviews.

A day in the life
Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment.

The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
- Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
- Maternity and Parental Leave Options
- Paid Time Off (PTO)
- 401(k) Plan  

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you!

At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
The Tech Materials Planning team is a strategic enabler of Amazon's global operations. We manage the end-to-end lifecycle of IT infrastructure—from planning and procurement to configuration and deployment—ensuring that the right equipment gets to the right place, at the right time.

Our team supports a wide range of initiatives, including new site launches, retrofits, data center expansions, relocations, and lifecycle management programs. We operate at the intersection of supply chain, technology, and operations—delivering scalable solutions to support the rapid growth and evolving needs of the business.

OTS-SC thrives on solving complex challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. We are deeply data-driven, customer-obsessed, and constantly pushing the boundaries of what supply chain planning and execution can achieve. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do—working cross-functionally with engineering, finance, program management, and operations teams to ensure success from plan to deployment.

If you're excited by solving ambiguous problems, building high-impact planning systems, and driving operational excellence at scale, you’ll find yourself at home on this team.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 2+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- 2+ years of supply chain experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Knowledge of SQL at an intermediate level, including: compile queries, subqueries, aggregation/grouping, data modification, etc.

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of data analysis experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Account Manager, DSP Shared Services
descriptionHtml:
The Americas Deliver Service Partner (NA DSP) team partners with entrepreneurial individuals across the globe to build sustainable and scalable delivery capacity so that Amazon can continue to delight customers with fast, efficient, and bar raising fulfillment of their orders. Equal parts advisor and operating partner, Amazon’s team of Business Coaches assist our DSP business owners as they build and grow successful last mile package delivery businesses. As trusted advisors, Business Coaches work alongside DSPs to help solve their biggest challenges at a programmatic level; influence their business planning and strategy; and look around corners to identify obstacles and recommend solutions, ensuring DSP owners make effective business decisions and are setup for success.
The DSP Shared Services team (DSS) is the backbone of the Americas DSP organization and it is their workstreams that enable the scale of the program. This Account Manager, DSP Shared Services will be responsible for providing support on a day to day processes that enable DSPs to continue to grow and succeed within the last mile network. This role will use complex problem-solving skills, manage multiple high visibility priorities, and maintain a keen attention to detail and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment with ambiguous situations.
The DSS Account Manager role will be expected to support direct inquiries from DSP program teams as well as DSPs. These support request help keep the DSP day to day business operations running and can range from invoice inquires, administrative support of systems and onboarding, as well as fleet concerns. DSS was created to help DSPs and Business Coaches to scale, you must have a strong passion for accountability, setting high standards, and driving results through focus on improving existing and future state operations, systems, and processes. The ideal candidate will be able to think big to create a long-term plan and influence leaders, but have exceptional tactical skills to drive day-to-day implementation. They will be able to learn quickly and become subject-matter experts in a number of different fields.


Key job responsibilities
- Providing introductory information to new DSPs, setting up accounts and providing guidance through initial onboarding and launch.
- Conducting DSP training (in person and virtual) across several product types.
- Support DSP intake process, solving simple and complex issues from a variety of topics.
- Maintaining a positive, empathetic, and professional attitude toward customers at all times.
- Communicating with customers through various channels and responding promptly to inquiries.
- Maintain customer records by updating account information within Salesforce.
- Developing long-term solutions using field experience and data-driven assumptions


A day in the life
As an Account Manager, DSP Shared Services, you will be responsible for specific tasks or workstreams that enable the onboarding, launch, or ongoing support of a DSP owner. You will develop mechanisms to identify problems that can be solved at scale and work cross functionally to build solutions to improve efficiency and reduce manual errors of standard work. You’ll accomplish this by analyzing problems, discovering insights, delivering recommendations, and driving change through internal stakeholder teams.

About the team
At Amazon Last Mile, our goal is to provide customers with an incredible package delivery experience through the last mile of the order. To achieve this goal, we partner with a network of small independent delivery businesses (Delivery Service Providers) and the independent contractor community (Amazon Flex) to deliver customer orders. Utilizing continuous improvement initiatives and creative thinking, our Delivery Station teams ensure that millions of packages reach their final destination as efficiently as possible.

Basic qualifications

- Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers
- Experience with Excel
- Be able to travel up to 10% to assigned stations and to conduct training and lift up to 10lbs while at station

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of sales or account management experience
- Experience analyzing key open issues and resolution metrics for each of the managed accounts
- Experience in relationship management within technology, start-ups, or SaaS Platforms

title: Site Operations Leader, OMHS
descriptionHtml:
As a Site Operations Leader within the OneMHS Installation & Deployment (I&D) team, you will serve as the central engineering coordinator for large-scale material handling equipment (MHE) installation projects in greenfield and brownfield Amazon fulfillment environments. You will work directly alongside installation teams on active construction sites, owning the project schedule and coordinating all on-site project teams, sub-team leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver complex MHE systems from equipment receipt through commissioning.

You will independently manage the project schedule, procurement workflows, equipment logistics, and budget administration for MHE installation projects ranging from $50M to $100M+ in scope. Working directly with mechanical installation leads, electrical installation leads, controls engineers, commissioning teams, and external MHE vendors, you will be the single-threaded owner for site-level coordination — ensuring all teams are aligned, resources are sequenced correctly, and the project stays on track.

This is a field-based engineering role embedded within active construction sites. You will operate in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where you proactively identify schedule risks, resolve inter-team dependencies, and drive continuous improvement in how Amazon deploys MHE systems at scale.


Key job responsibilities
Project Coordination & Schedule Management
• Own and maintain the project schedule for MHE installation across assigned greenfield and brownfield sites
• Coordinate daily activities across all on-site project teams including mechanical installation, electrical installation, controls integration, and commissioning
• Serve as the central point of coordination between sub-team leaders, ensuring work sequences are properly phased and resource conflicts are resolved
• Lead daily site coordination meetings to align all installation teams on priorities, constraints, and upcoming milestones
• Track critical path items across all sub-teams and proactively identify and mitigate schedule risks
• Manage inter-team dependencies — ensuring predecessor work is complete before successor teams mobilize
• Coordinate site access timelines, aligning MHE first access dates with installation and commissioning schedules
• Create and maintain integrated project schedules coordinating engineering, supply chain, construction, and commissioning timelines
• Monitor and report KPIs for schedule adherence, budget performance, and installation progress
Site Logistics & Material Coordination
• Coordinate MHE equipment storage, sequencing, and shipment logistics between manufacturers, third-party storage facilities, and installation sites
• Manage equipment inventory tracking across active construction sites to ensure installation teams have materials staged and ready
• Engineer receiving and staging plans for MHE components including unloading coordination, inventory verification, and sequenced material placement
• Develop and maintain receiving instructions and standard operating procedures for installation crews
• Deploy and manage construction monitoring systems for progress documentation
• Coordinate asset tracking technology deployments to maintain visibility of MHE components through the installation lifecycle
• Ensure compliance with Amazon safety standards and construction site safety requirements during all installation activities
Procurement & Financial Management
• Own procurement workflows including purchase order creation, change order controls, and invoice management via Coupa
• Manage project budgets, tracking spend against approved allocations
• Develop and track financial reporting for assigned projects, providing regular budget status updates to leadership
• Coordinate with Global Procurement Organization (GPO) on vendor work allocation decisions and procurement strategies
• Create financial justification documents for equipment purchases and technology investments
• Support development of procurement and logistics strategies for large-scale multi-site deployments
Vendor Coordination & Management
• Serve as primary operational point of contact for MHE vendors on assigned sites
• Coordinate vendor equipment delivery schedules, milestone tracking, and change request alignment
• Lead vendor schedule review meetings and drive resolution of schedule conflicts between vendor and internal installation teams
• Manage vendor work allocation processes, ensuring clear scope definitions between self-perform and contracted work
• Support cross-vendor coordination for integrated installation projects involving multiple equipment suppliers
• Track and manage vendor change requests, ensuring proper documentation and financial alignment
Technical Documentation & Standards
• Develop and maintain cross-vendor work instructions for MHE installation activities
• Create and manage engineering documentation including receiving instructions, site logistics plans, and installation SOPs
• Support development of installation training materials and engineering standards documentation
• Contribute to drawing standards and layout reviews for MHE installation projects
• Participate in design reviews supporting execution between internal teams and outside vendors
• Maintain project documentation in alignment with I&D engineering team standards and best practices
Reporting & Stakeholder Communication
• Communicate project schedule status, risks, and team coordination updates to engineering leadership
• Participate in Daily Business Reviews (DBRs) providing installation progress updates on safety, job plans, and team readiness
• Support Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs) with MHE vendor partners covering risks, schedules, commercials, and capacity
• Contribute to Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs) with project-level metrics and milestones
• Provide technical input to leadership for data-driven decision-making
• Produce regular status summaries covering team progress, schedule variance, and resource utilization
• Identify and escalate inter-team conflicts, resource constraints, and schedule risks in a timely manner
• Support achievement of safety, timeline, cost, and quality metrics across assigned sites


A day in the life
A typical day for a Site Operations Leader begins with the daily site coordination meeting,
aligning mechanical, electrical, and controls teams on priorities and resolving any
sequencing conflicts. From there, you're walking the active construction site - verifying
material staging, checking that equipment deliveries match the schedule, and
troubleshooting any gaps holding up installation crews. Mid-day often involves vendor
schedule reviews, Coupa procurement actions, and updating the project schedule with
progress from each sub-team. You close out by flagging risks in the DBR, coordinating nextday
material needs, and ensuring every team has what they need to stay on track.

About the team
OneMHS (One Material Handling Systems) is Amazon's in-house program for designing,
procuring, and installing material handling equipment across its fulfillment network. Rather
than relying solely on external integrators, OneMHS brings the full lifecycle of MHE
deployment under Amazon's direct control - from final engineering and equipment
procurement through mechanical and electrical installation, controls integration, and
commissioning. The program supports both greenfield builds and brownfield retrofits,
deploying conveyor systems, sorters, induction systems, and robotic work cells at scale.
OneMHS enables Amazon to deliver faster, more cost-effective installations while
maintaining higher quality and safety standards.

Team is able to hire anywhere in the USA.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of directly managing and responsible for multiple large projects experience
- 5+ years of Reliability Program Manager experience
- 5+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- 5+ years of maintenance or engineering experience
- 2+ years of commercial CO2 refrigeration applications experience
- 5+ years of directly managing and being responsible for multiple large projects experience
- 3+ years of in material handling equipment (MHE) or automation environments experience, or experience in reliability/maintenance environments
- 3+ years of leading cross-functional teams across engineering, operations, and field execution through launch readiness and go-live phases experience
- Refrigeration Trade School certificate
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Technology, Reliability Engineering, or 2+ years of Amazon RME (BB/3P) Full Time Exempt experience
- Experience and strong technical background in relevant fields of automated or non-automated material handling equipment
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in engineering, mechanical, operations, supply chain, business administration, or equivalent STEM field
- Master's degree or above in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or Business Administration, or Master's degree or above in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics)
- Experience in Lean Management, Six Sigma and other operations engineer tools
- Experience building launch readiness frameworks, standard work, playbooks, and scalable deployment mechanisms across multiple concurrent sites
- Experience with performance metrics such as OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness), downtime, throughput, or quality
- Experience in Amazon RME (Reliability, Maintenance, and Engineering), fulfillment operations, or automation deployment environments

title: Electrical Integration Leader - Power Distribution & Infrastructure, OMHS
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking an Electrical Installation Lead – Power Distribution & Infrastructure to drive the successful installation of electrical power systems for automation and material handling equipment across multiple greenfield and brownfield fulfillment center sites. This role provides field-based electrical installation leadership focused specifically on heavy wire pulls, power distribution infrastructure, conduit and raceway systems, control panel placement, and high-voltage terminations in complex industrial environments. The Electrical Installation Lead – Power Distribution will directly manage installation crews
responsible for all electrical infrastructure that feeds power to MHE systems. This includes
conduit installation from Main Distribution Panels (MDPs) to sub-panels and equipment, cable tray routing, heavy wire pulling (480V 3-phase), control panel placement, disconnect installation, junction box and pull box placement, grounding systems, and wire terminations. You will ensure all power distribution work is executed safely, in compliance
with NEC/NFPA codes, and to Amazon's quality and schedule standards. This role reports to the Site Deployment Manager and works in close coordination with the Low Voltage Devices & Controls lead — your team must complete power infrastructure in each zone before device installation crews can mobilize. This sequencing makes schedule discipline and quality critical to overall project success.

Key job responsibilities
Power Distribution Installation Leadership:
• Lead and manage electrical installation crews focused on power distribution infrastructure for MHE systems across North American facilities
• Oversee conduit and raceway installation from Main Distribution Panels (MDPs) to sub-panels, disconnects, and equipment locations
• Manage heavy wire pulling operations through conduit including 480V 3-phase power feeders, ensuring proper cable sizing, labeling, and termination
• Direct control panel placement and mounting at designated locations per engineering drawings, ensuring proper clearance and accessibility
• Oversee installation of cable tray systems, junction boxes, pull boxes, and wireways
• Manage installation of disconnects, motor starters, overloads, and related power distribution components
• Direct grounding system installation and bonding connections per NEC requirements
• Ensure proper wire terminations with correct torque values, lugging, and labeling at all connection points
• Oversee cable management including wire bundling, cable supports, strain relief,
and routing compliance

Drawing Interpretation & Field Execution:
• Review and interpret electrical drawings including one-line diagrams, panel schedules, conduit schedules, cable schedules, and electrical installation details
• Verify field installation matches engineering drawings and identify conflicts requiring resolution
• Partner with engineering teams to clarify drawings, resolve field conflicts, and validate installation intent
• Maintain accurate field documentation including redlines, punch lists, installation status reports, and turnover documentation
• Coordinate with mechanical installation teams on shared routing paths, penetrations, and structural supports

Quality, Safety & Compliance
• Ensure all electrical power distribution work is completed in accordance with NEC/NFPA codes, project specifications, and Amazon standards
• Perform and oversee quality inspections on conduit installations, wire pulls, terminations, panel connections, and grounding systems
• Verify conduit fill ratios, bend radius compliance, and proper support spacing per code requirements
• Manage electrical punch list identification and repair for all power infrastructure scope
• Drive achievement of safety, timeline, cost, and quality metrics across assigned zones
• Ensure lockout/tagout compliance and electrical safety practices during all installation activities

Coordination & Communication
• Coordinate electrical infrastructure installation with mechanical teams, controls engineering, construction, vendors, and operations stakeholders
• Manage zone handoff sequencing with the Low Voltage Devices & Controls lead — power infrastructure must be complete before device installation begins
• Track electrical installation progress, risks, blockers, and quality issues, escalating when support is needed
• Participate in project-level technical reviews, installation readiness reviews, and punch walks
• Manage relationships with electrical contractors, OEMs, vendors, and internal project stakeholders
• Participate in daily business reviews with installation progress updates
• Support development and continuous improvement of electrical installation standards, field checklists, and scalable deployment processes

A day in the life
Your day starts at the site coordination meeting where you review which zones have completed mechanical steel installation and are ready for electrical infrastructure mobilization. You walk the floor with your conduit crew — verifying raceway runs from MDPs to sub-panels against engineering drawings, checking conduit supports and fill
ratios, and confirming proper routing around obstructions. You oversee wire pulling operations in active zones, ensuring proper cable sizing, bend radius compliance, and pull tension limits are respected. Mid-morning you inspect control panel placements, verifying mounting locations match drawings, checking clearance requirements, and confirming grounding connections. You validate junction box and disconnect installations, review wire terminations for proper torque values and labeling, and address any field conflicts that require engineering clarification. By afternoon, you're tracking installation progress against the schedule, coordinating with the device installation lead on upcoming zone handoffs, and documenting redlines for as-built updates. You close out at the daily business review with progress updates and flag any material or access risks for the next
day.

About the team
The OMHS Installation & Deployment team supports the deployment and integration of automation and material handling systems across Amazon's operations network. The team works cross-functionally with engineering, construction, operations, supply chain, vendors, and field execution partners to deliver safe, scalable, and reliable systems.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in engineering including a supervisory role managing people
- Experience in a fast-paced, automated, industrial, logistics, production or manufacturing environment
- 5+ years of experience in industrial electrical installation, electrical construction,
- power distribution, or a similar technical environment
- Experience leading or supervising electrical installation crews, contractors, or field execution teams
- Experience reading and interpreting electrical drawings including one-line diagrams, panel schedules, conduit schedules, and wiring diagrams
- Experience with industrial power distribution systems including 480V 3-phase, motor control circuits, disconnects, and related infrastructure
- Experience with conduit installation, raceway systems, cable tray, wire pulling, and termination practices
- Experience working in fast-paced industrial, logistics, manufacturing, or construction environments
- Ability to travel up to 50% domestically; travel may exceed 50% in some instances with short notice

Preferred qualifications

- Prior experience managing journeyman electricians, electrical contractors, or industrial electricians on large-scale installation projects
- Prior experience working for a material handling integrator
- Prior experience installing power distribution infrastructure for conveyor or sortation systems
- Experience with 480V 3-phase systems, motor control centers (MCCs), VFD power wiring, and transformer installations
- Journeyman electrician license, master electrician license, or state electrical license
- Knowledge of AutoCAD Electrical, Bluebeam, BIM 360, or equivalent drawing review software
- Experience with NEC/NFPA compliance in industrial or construction environments
- Experience managing third-party electrical contractors and subcontractors
- Experience with punch list management, redlines, installation quality inspections, and turnover documentation
- Lean, Six Sigma, PMP, or related project management certifications

title: Overnight Staff Pharmacist , Amazon Pharmacy
descriptionHtml:
Innovation is at the core of what we do. We believe that by removing and reducing the barriers that
prevent people from taking their medications, we can help customers conveniently get the
medications they need, when they need them and take them as prescribed. We have provided
customers with the ability to find transparent and simple pricing, receive 24/7 customer service
support, and have their meds delivered to their doorsteps while creating programs and products
that embody our mission and position ourselves in becoming the world’s safest and fastest online
pharmacy.

We are looking for a Staff Pharmacist to join us on our journey to make it drastically easier for
customers to find, choose, afford, and engage with the services, products, and professionals they
need to get and stay healthy!


#everydaybetter


Key job responsibilities
• Perform clinical data review, prescription verification, and virtual patient consultations in
compliance with state and federal regulations
• Manage end-to-end prescription fulfillment process, including dispensing medications
using automated systems (Parata Max2) and manual fill
• Package and prepare prescriptions for shipment or site injection, including handling of
specialized medications (refrigerated and bulk items)
• Maintain strict quality standards and safety protocols while meeting Critical Pull Times
(CPT) and production targets
• Split time effectively between prescription verification and fulfillment duties based on
operational needs and customer centric volume
• Perform thorough DUR (Drug Utilization Review) and ensure accurate documentation in
pharmacy systems
• Monitor, receive, and manage pharmacy inventory effectively and compliantly
• Work collaboratively with pharmacy technicians and other pharmacists to maintain
efficient workflow
• Demonstrate strong attention to detail and adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced
environment
• Support operational excellence initiatives and continuous improvement efforts
• Identify and report quality or safety concerns promptly while maintaining compliance with
all regulatory requirements
• Complete daily operational tasks including processing returns, medication rejects,
therapeutic substitutions, and canister approvals

Physical Requirements:
During Peak/high demand, shifts last up to 12 hours (standard full-time shifts are 8-10 hours)
• Standing, bending, reaching above the head, kneeling, crouching and/or stretching
• Lifting and moving products up to 49 lbs in weight
• Manual dexterity of hands and wrists
• Walking throughout the Amazon building for various reasons such as injections and inventory receive

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Science, or Doctor of Pharmacy in PharmD, or Doctor of Pharmacy
- Knowledge of pharmacy laws and federal/state regulations concerning patient care
- Can demonstrate proficiency with basic computer functions and pharmacy systems
- Can have an active and unrestricted pharmacist license in your state of employment (additional licenses may be required)

descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a mixed-methodology researcher to join our team. We need someone who can identify the why behind customer behaviors, uncover durable needs and motivational drivers, and work fluently with telemetry data — bringing both scientific depth and deep customer empathy. AWS customers are shifting from console-based building toward AI-augmented, agent-primary, and autonomous workflows. With this shift, a researcher will need to work with not only human customers but also agents as a new class of customer — understanding their needs and behaviors to inform the solutions we build.

You will bring creativity and a Learn and Be Curious mindset, working within the research vertical and partnering with the science and engineering teams to deliver solutions at greater scale. We move fast, and we need someone who can keep pace while maintaining a high bar for quality.

The problems are genuinely interesting — and many don't yet have established methodologies. You'll define how we study the intersection of human and agentic behavior, shaping both the questions we ask and the frameworks we use to answer them.

Translate large-scale telemetry and behavioral data into actionable insights, integrating quantitative signals with qualitative depth to build a compelling customer story.

Pioneer new research methodologies for emerging problem spaces — particularly at the intersection of human and AI-driven workflows — where established playbooks don't yet exist.

Partner cross-functionally with science and engineering teams to ensure research insights directly inform strategy and how we build our products.

Raise the bar for research quality and craft across the organization through mentorship, peer review, and thought leadership.

We are building a unified customer lifecycle data platform and customer intelligence system that delivers deep customer understanding at scale to everyone across AWS. Our team approaches data both qualitatively and quantitatively, fusing customer insights with telemetry to tell actionable customer stories — insight is the critical layer that makes data meaningful.

- Experience (end to end) with all aspects of research (study design, recruiting, moderation, analysis, reporting)

descriptionHtml:

当チームは、社内の様々なチームに加え、出版社・取次会社・倉庫・物流会社といった社外のステークホルダーと協働し、紙書籍の在庫・物流に関する戦略立案と実行を担っています。そのうち、今回募集する Associate Strategic Supply Chain Manager は、出版社の在庫管理を専門に支援するチームに所属し、アサインされた出版社（1人あたり3〜4社）に寄り添いながら、在庫・物流を中心としたサプライチェーン上の課題を特定し、解決策の設計から実行までを一気通貫で担うコンサルタント職です。社内の多様なチームと協業し、お客様の購買体験と出版社のビジネスの双方を改善します。なお、本ポジションは原則として電子書籍を業務スコープに含みません。

この職種の魅力:

在庫、需要予測、物流のデータを自ら分析し、改善施策を企画から実行までオーナーシップを持って進められます
欠品の削減、発売日のお届け、配送スピードなど、お客様が実感できる成果に直結します
日本の出版流通という業界構造そのものに向き合い、出版社の意思決定層と直接議論する機会があります
前例のない課題に、自分の分析と行動で最初に取り組めます
変化を脅威ではなく機会ととらえ、自ら課題を見つけて動けるリーダーをお待ちしています。

Japan's print book supply chain meets new challenges one after another: new constraints and rising costs across the existing logistics network, broadening reader preferences, and shifts in the economy and in how people buy. Even in this fast-changing environment, the Strategic Supply Chain Management team in Amazon's Books organization works with stakeholders inside and outside Amazon, every day, to deliver on one mission: readers get the book they want, when they want it.

Our team sets and executes the strategy for print book inventory and logistics. We work across Amazon and with external stakeholders including publishers, distributors, warehouses, and transportation providers. As an Associate Strategic Supply Chain Manager, you will join a team dedicated to supporting publishers' inventory management. You will work closely with an assigned group of publishers (three to four per role), identify supply chain problems centered on inventory and logistics, and own the solution end to end, from design through execution. You will collaborate with teams across Amazon to improve both the customer buying experience and our publishers' business. As a rule, this position does not include eBooks in its scope.

Why you will love this role:

You analyze inventory, forecasting, and logistics data yourself, and own improvement initiatives from idea through execution.
Your work connects directly to outcomes customers feel: fewer out-of-stock titles, delivery on release day, and faster shipping speed.
You engage with the structure of Japan's book distribution industry, and discuss decisions directly with publisher leadership.
You are first to take on problems with no precedent, where your own analysis and action move the result.
We are looking for a customer-focused, driven, and analytical leader who sees change as an opportunity rather than a threat, and who finds and acts on problems without being asked.

Key job responsibilities
Associate Strategic Supply Chain Manager は、担当する出版社（1人あたり3〜4社）の在庫戦略にオーナーシップを持ち、商品セレクションの拡充、欠品の削減、サプライチェーンの効率化を通じて、お客様にとって最良の購買体験と事業の収益性の双方を高めます。担当出版社の在庫計画と運用管理のすべての側面を担うことが、この職種の業務の基盤です。加えて、そこで得た知見や経験をもとに、チーム全体が追う欠品率などの指標の改善、重要プロジェクト、事業部全体を横断する取り組みにも携わります。

主な職務内容:

担当出版社の需要予測、発注、在庫水準の計画を立案し、欠品の削減と在庫回転率の改善を主導します
出版社のサプライチェーン上の課題を特定し、改善施策を設計から実行まで一気通貫で担います
納品リードタイム、受注対応、在庫情報の連携など、出版社側のオペレーション改善を支援します
効率的で拡張性のあるサプライチェーンを構築し、固定費・変動費の削減に貢献します
Amazon 社内の購買・発注の仕組みとシステムを理解し、活用および改善提案を行います
データ分析、自動化、継続的な改善により、業務の精度とスピードを高めます
当チームでは、担当範囲の線引きにとらわれず、チームの成果のために必要なことへ自ら手を伸ばすことを期待しています。Amazon のリーダーは「それは私の仕事ではありません」とは決して口にしません。チームおよびプログラムの状況に応じて、担当出版社の枠を越えた指標の改善、重要プロジェクト、上記以外の業務を、一時的または継続的に担当することがあります。自ら職務範囲を広げていける方にとって、成長の機会が多い環境です。

As an Associate Strategic Supply Chain Manager, you will own the inventory strategy for an assigned group of publishers (three to four per role). You will grow selection, reduce out-of-stock titles, and drive supply chain efficiency, so that customers get a best-in-class buying experience and the business grows revenue and margin. Covering all aspects of inventory planning and operational management for your publishers is the foundation of this job. Building on what you learn there, you will also help improve the metrics the whole team owns, such as out-of-stock rate, and take part in key projects and in initiatives that run across the Books organization.

Key job responsibilities:

Build demand forecasting, ordering, and inventory level plans for your publishers, and drive improvement in out-of-stock rate and inventory turns.
Identify supply chain problems at your publishers, and own improvement initiatives from design through execution.
Support your publishers in improving their operations, including delivery lead time, order confirmation, and inventory data exchange.
Build efficient and scalable supply chain operations that reduce fixed and variable costs.
Understand and apply Amazon's internal buying and ordering systems and processes, and propose improvements to them.
Raise the accuracy and speed of your work through data analysis, automation, and Kaizen.
On this team, we expect you to look past the boundaries of your assigned scope and reach for whatever the team's results require. Leaders at Amazon never say "that's not my job." Depending on team and program circumstances, you may take on metric improvements beyond your assigned publishers, key projects, or work outside the scope described above, either temporarily or on an ongoing basis. For someone who wants to widen their own remit, this is an environment with a lot of room to grow.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

A day in the life
日々の業務は担当出版社との対話と、その背後にあるデータの分析を往復しながら進みます。直接のクライアントは担当出版社ですが、最終的なお客様は本を待っている読者です。業務の中心は担当出版社ですが、週の一部は、チーム全体が追う指標の改善や、事業部を横断する取り組みに充てることもあります。

出版社側のカウンターパートは、在庫・物流・営業の担当部門です。Amazon 社内では、同じく出版社を担当するチームメンバーや、Strategic Supply Chain Management チームの各メンバーと最も密に協働します。書籍事業部内では、アカウントマネージャー、売上向上コンサルタント、商品企画担当、マーケティング部門などの各チームと連携します。さらに、フルフィルメントセンター、輸送、需要予測やシステムの関連チーム、ファイナンス、および他国の同職種のチームとも日常的に関わります。

解決する課題は、欠品の発生原因の特定と解消、新刊の発売日に向けた在庫確保、需要予測の精度改善、納品プロセスに潜む非効率の解消などです。

一日・一週間の業務の例:

担当出版社の指標（欠品率、在庫水準、納品実績）を確認し、異常値の原因を特定します
データを抽出して深く掘り下げ、課題を定量化した上で仮説を立てます
仮説に基づきアクションプランとスケジュールを設計し、出版社や社内ステークホルダー向けの資料を作成してレビューを受けます
担当出版社からの問い合わせに対応し、在庫や納品に関する判断を日次で行います
Amazon 社内システム上で、需要予測や発注、在庫に関する設定と実行を行います
出版社との定例ミーティングで改善の進捗を共有し、次に取り組むことを合意します
担当出版社の枠を越え、チーム全体が追う指標の改善に向けた分析や施策の検討に取り組みます
事業部を横断するプロジェクトや、チーム内の業務プロセスの改善・自動化に参加します

Your days move back and forth between conversations with your publishers and analysis of the data behind them. Your direct clients are the publishers you are assigned to, and your ultimate customers are the readers waiting for their books. Your publishers are the center of the work, though part of your week may also go to improving the metrics the whole team owns and to initiatives that run across the Books organization.

At your publishers, your counterparts are the teams responsible for inventory, logistics, and sales. Inside Amazon, you work most closely with the other members who cover publishers and with the members of the Strategic Supply Chain Management team. Within the Books organization, you work with account managers, sales growth consultants, merchandising and product planning, and Marketing. You also engage day to day with our fulfillment centers, Transportation, forecasting and technology teams, Finance, and your counterparts in other countries.

The problems you solve include finding and removing the causes of out-of-stock titles, securing inventory ahead of new release dates, improving forecast accuracy, and taking inefficiency out of the delivery process.

A typical day or week:

Review metrics for your publishers, including out-of-stock rate, inventory levels, and delivery performance, and identify the cause of anything that looks off.
Extract data and run a deep dive analysis to quantify the problem and form a hypothesis.
Design an action plan and schedule from that hypothesis, draft the materials for your publishers and internal stakeholders, and take them through review.
Respond to inquiries from your publishers, and make day-to-day decisions on inventory and delivery.
Configure and run demand forecasting, ordering, and inventory settings in Amazon's internal systems.
Share progress in regular meetings with your publishers, and agree on what to tackle next.
Work on analysis and initiatives that improve the metrics the whole team owns, beyond your own publishers.
Take part in projects that run across the Books organization, and in improving and automating how the team works.

About the team
書籍事業部について

読書は健全な社会にとって必須であるという信念のもと、読者がより手軽に本を読み、読書からより多くを得られるようにすることが私たちの使命です。

本ポジションが所属する Strategic Supply Chain Management チームのミッションは、お客様が読みたい書籍を、読みたいタイミングでお届けすることです。そのために、適切な商品を、適切な数量で、適切な場所に、適切なタイミングで揃えることに取り組んでいます。

日本の紙書籍のサプライチェーンは、いま転換点にあります。従来の延長線上の改善では解決できない構造的な課題が増えており、業界全体で大きな変革が必要だという認識が共有されつつあります。それは同時に、お客様のための改善に取り組む機会が豊富にあることを意味します。特に、AI モデルなどの技術を活用してサプライチェーンや在庫管理の業務を自動化し、お客様への提供価値を高める余地が大きく残されています。

当チームの働き方には3つの特徴があります。1人が担当出版社のオーナーとして意思決定を任されること、議論の土台を感覚ではなくデータに置くこと、そして担当や職種の境界を越えて互いに助け合うことです。

紙書籍という、当たり前に存在するように見えて実は大きな課題を抱えるビジネスを、持続可能なかたちで続けていくために、前向きな姿勢と強いオーナーシップ、そしてチームワークをもって取り組んでいます。

About the Books organization

We believe reading is essential for a healthy society. Our mission is to inspire readers by making it easy to read more and to get more out of reading.

The mission of the Strategic Supply Chain Management team, where this role sits, is to deliver the books our customers want, at the time they want them: the right products, in the right quantities, in the right place, at the right time.

Japan's print book supply chain is at a turning point. Structural problems are growing that incremental improvement alone will not solve, and a shared view is forming across the industry that significant change is needed. That also means there is no shortage of opportunity to improve things for customers. In particular, much room remains to use technology such as AI models to automate work across supply chain and inventory management, and to raise what we deliver to customers.

Three things define how our team works. Each of us owns the decisions for our own publishers. We put data, not instinct, at the base of our discussions. And we help each other across the boundaries of assignments and job families.

This is work that takes a business most people assume will always be there, but which in fact faces real structural challenges, and turns it into something sustainable. We are looking for someone who will take that on with a positive outlook, strong ownership, and teamwork.

Basic qualifications

・工学、ビジネス、または関連分野における学士号
・2年以上の社会人経験
・日本語が母国語、もしくは、JPLTN1 / N2 ビジネスレベルの英語
・基礎的なOffice操作 (Excelによる分析、Powerpointによるスライド作成、Wordによるドキュメント作成）
・KPIなどのメトリック作成・改善の経験、および、生データからインサイトを抽出する分析力

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business or related field
- 2+ years of professional non-internship experience.
- Native Japanese or JPLT N1/N2 and business level English required
- Basic capability for MS Office (analysis using Excel, slide creation using Powerpoint, document creation using Word)
- Experience with reporting technologies and analytics. Capable of turning raw data into information and insights

Preferred qualifications

・4年以上の社会人経験
・事業会社における経営企画/サプライチェーン関連の業務経験又はコンサルティング会社におけるアナリスト/コンサルタント経験
・出版業界における経営企画/サプライチェーン関連又は営業に関連する経験
・優れた意思決定力、書面および口頭でのコミュニケーション力、実践的で常識的なアプローチに基づく実行力
・優れた分析能力と問題解決能力。 大規模で複雑なデータを処理する能力と、統計学またはその他の分析手法に精通している
・優先順位付け、スケジュール管理、時間管理、期限の遵守などの優れた実行力
・カイゼン、リーン生産方式、シックスシグマなどのプロセス改善の経験

- 4+ years of professional non-internship experience.
- Job experience for business planning/supply chain-related field or analyst/consultant experience at a consulting firm
- Job experience for business planning/supply chain-related field or sales experience in the publishing industry
- Possess excellent business judgment, strong written and oral communication skills, and a practical, common sense approach to getting things done.
- Strong analytical abilities and problem solving skills. Ability to work with large, complex data sets and familiarity with statistics or other analytical techniques.
- Strong organizational skills including prioritizing, scheduling, time management and meeting deadlines.
- Experience with improvement techniques such as Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma.

title: Operations & Logistics Internship MXP3-Vercelli
descriptionHtml:
****This position is based in MXP3-Vercelli. Please note that this role requires on-site presence. Relocation support will be provided. Applying to the talent pool is non-binding and does not guarantee a specific start date or offer.****

Amazon Operations is the backbone of the Amazon customer experience. With over 50 fulfilment centres, hundreds of delivery stations, and tens of thousands of employees, the team works together to efficiently deliver items to customers. In the fulfilment centres, millions of items are picked and packed annually, while delivery teams work to get orders to customers on time. Safety is the top priority, and the operations culture is defined by teamwork, diversity, and a shared work ethic that keeps the business running smoothly. The team takes pride in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for globally.

Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.


Key job responsibilities
As an Amazon operations intern, you'll have the opportunity to apply your analytical skills to impactful projects that enhance the functionality and service of Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Centers, and Delivery Stations. Key aspects of the role include:
• Completing high-priority projects to the highest standard, demonstrating your ability to deliver results
• Analyzing data to identify operational challenges and opportunities for improvement
• Proposing and testing solutions, collaborating with the team to implement the most effective ones
• Developing communication and teamwork skills by working with managers, stakeholders, and frontline associates.
• Be on the move within the building to engage with various teams. This includes actively gathering knowledge by participating in activities such as pre-briefs, flow meetings, and discussions with the leadership team and associates.
• Ability to navigate the workspace and move between different areas is essential for this position.
• Displaying flexibility to work various schedules and shift patterns as required.
• Potential relocation to the designated work location.


A day in the life
Our internships are educational opportunities that allow you, our future managers, to discover how we lead and develop our teams of associates. You'll immerse yourself in the fast-paced, complex world of our Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Hubs, and Delivery Stations, witnessing how our managers engage their teams to fulfill customer expectations.

This internship will place you at the heart of our operations, enabling you to trace the journey of a customer order. You'll gain a realistic job preview of the full-time opportunities awaiting you within our organization.

You'll learn how our managers cultivate a safe, productive environment, harnessing the full potential of their teams through effective engagement and performance management strategies. This is your chance to develop skills that will propel you towards a rewarding career with Amazon.


About the team
Intern Community:
• As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.
Support:
• The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.
Learning Sessions:
• Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.
Opportunities:
• Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.
Internship Start Dates across the year:

Basic qualifications

- Currently in your penultimate (graduating in 2028) or last year, and working towards a university degree in Supply Chain, Business/Management, Engineering or another related field.
- Eligible to complete a full-time internship (40hours/week) of 3-6 months with a start date between January and July 2027.
- Highly proficient in both spoken and written English and the local language of the country you are applying for (Common European Framework of Reference C1).

Preferred qualifications

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify process improvements and innovative solutions.
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills, able to collaborate effectively with others.
- Demonstrated curiosity, proactivity, and willingness to take on challenges in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment.

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. title: Product Designer III, AWS Search, Security, Observability, Governance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon OpenSearch Service is how customers search, analyze, and make sense of their data at massive scale — powering application search, log analytics, observability, and increasingly AI-powered and agentic investigation workflows. It's a product where the data is enormous, the queries are complex, and the users range from developers running their first search cluster to SRE and security teams triaging an incident at 2 a.m. We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to own the experience for a core part of OpenSearch and make that complexity feel effortless.

Search itself is being reinvented. With Winnow, OpenSearch is moving from keyword-and-query mechanics toward agentic search — where a customer expresses intent and an AI agent plans, retrieves, reasons, and returns answers rather than ten blue links. That shift rewrites the design problem: the interface is no longer a search box and a results list, but a conversation with a system that acts on the customer's behalf, shows its reasoning, and has to earn trust with every answer. You'll help invent what that experience looks like.

This isn't a role where design hands off mockups and walks away. Our designers are end-to-end builders — embedded in OpenSearch builder pods, shaping product decisions, prototyping in real code, shipping to production, and measuring what happens. You'll own your problem space from framing through launch, ground your decisions in research that actually feeds the roadmap, and help push OpenSearch into its next chapter — agentic search and observability where the design challenge is as much about trust and verification

Key job responsibilities
1. Own the end-to-end design for a core OpenSearch experience — from problem framing and research through interaction design, visual craft, production implementation, and post-launch measurement.
2. Help define the experience for Winnow / agentic search: how a customer expresses intent, how the agent's planning and reasoning are surfaced, how results and their provenance earn trust, and how the customer stays in control.
3. Embed in a builder pod with product and engineering as a true end-to-end builder: shape what gets built and in what order, not just how it looks.
4. Design for genuine complexity — search relevance, vector and semantic search, log analytics, dashboards, observability workflows, alerting, and root-cause investigation — and make dense, high-volume data feel clear and navigable.
5. Help define the experience for agentic observability alongside agentic search, where interfaces surface agent reasoning, findings, and remediation — and where earning the customer's trust is the core design problem.
6. Run research that ships: structured research cycles, trust-calibration studies, and competitive signal capture that feed directly into the roadmap rather than sitting in a deck.
7. Contribute to and extend the OpenSearch design system (OUI) so patterns are consistent, accessible, and scale across the product.
8. Partner daily with PMs and engineers to balance customer needs, deep technical constraints, and business goals.
9. Raise the design bar across the team through critique, mentorship, and reusable patterns.

A day in the life
Your morning might start with a design review where you present a systems-level concept to product and engineering partners, walking through how a new interaction pattern scales across multiple surfaces. After lunch, you shift into hands-on craft work in Figma, refining a prototype informed by recent research findings. Later, you facilitate an alignment session with cross-functional stakeholders who have competing priorities, helping the group converge on a shared path forward. Throughout it all, you mentor fellow designers, write persuasive strategy documents, and use AI tools to rapidly explore ideas.

About the team
We're the design team behind Amazon OpenSearch Service, and we work differently: six designers embedded directly in OpenSearch builder pods, owning the experience from problem framing through production. We're designing OpenSearch's shift to agentic search and observability so the work is net-new: inventing the patterns for how customers trust a system that searches, reasons, and acts for them. We operate on three principles: end-to-end builders (we shape, build, ship, and measure), research that ships (structured research and trust-calibration work that feeds the roadmap directly), and a self-learning design system (OUI, evolving toward agentic patterns). We treat design as a competitive weapon, not a line item. We're a senior, tight-knit group that gives designers genuine ownership of their problem space, invests in craft and research, and cares deeply about raising each other's work.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of design experience

Preferred qualifications

- Have an available online portfolio

title: AWS Commercial Sales Internship
descriptionHtml:
The internship starts mid-April 2027 (24 weeks). You need to be enrolled in University, graduating from a Bachelor's or Master's degree in 2027 (desired) or 2028.

Mandatory languages: Swedish and English



We're on the lookout for the curious, those who think big and want to define the world of tomorrow. At Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will grow into the high-impact, visionary person you know you're ready to be, taking on new challenges and developing new skills every day in our AI-first cloud environment.

Would you like to be part of a team that helps customers across EMEA adopt AWS cloud solutions and accelerate their digital transformation.

If you are passionate about cloud technologies, AWS is developing the next generation of commercial leaders. Our Commercial Sales Internship Program offers a structured roadmap of in-depth learning and hands-on practice across AWS services and solution selling, preparing you for a future Sales role while you deliver long-term impact through a real business project.

AWS offers a dynamic and motivating environment where you will advance your career, support the growth of AWS customers, and help shape the future of emerging cloud and AI technologies. As you build customer-readiness, the role becomes partly external-facing, giving you real exposure to customers.

This paid internship gives you the chance to take on a real business project, developed in a team connected to Amazon Global Sales. You'll work with a range of stakeholders across AWS, making a tangible impact and building and innovating in the Amazonian way. Throughout, you'll be supported by our EMEA internship community, working in agile teams with access to mentoring, learning, and shadowing opportunities.

Key job responsibilities
What Makes You Future-Ready:
• Critical thinking and problem-solving abilities with a data-driven approach
• Digital innovation mindset with genuine curiosity about AI and emerging cloud technologies
• Showcasing resilience and adaptability in a dynamic and fast-paced environment
• Customer and stakeholder focus with strong communication skills
• Cross-functional collaboration capabilities to work across different teams and business units

The program includes comprehensive training on AWS services, cloud computing concepts, AI-first methodologies, and hands-on practical exercises to solidify your learning. You'll develop strategic thinking capabilities, GenAI proficiency, and stakeholder management skills essential for success in our rapidly evolving AI environment.
The successful candidate will be interested in a career in cloud technology, demonstrating learning agility, comfort with digital tools, and the ability to think strategically while remaining adaptable to new challenges and technologies that drive and grow AWS footprint with our customers.


A day in the life

• Learn about the AWS solution portfolio (including earning certifications like the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner and AWS Certified AI Practitioner) and the Amazon culture, with strong focus on AI services and innovative cloud solutions
• Rotation assignments across different business units and teams, collaborating with various team members to innovate
• Work within agile methodologies to deliver impactful business projects
• Build an understanding of customer challenges, requirements, and the potential value that can be delivered by AWS
• Differentiate and understand various IT roles and responsibilities in modern AI-first organizations


If you're insatiably curious and eager to learn, then you've come to the right place. Depending on your location, country, job status and other requirements, the following benefits may be available to you as an intern:

title: EU QC In-stock specialist - 1 year FTC
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Quick Commerce (QC) delivers groceries and everyday essentials to customers in minutes from a network of local stores. To keep that promise, the right products have to be on our shelves at the right time. A large part of our range is supplied from Amazon's core fulfilment network into each QC store.

We are looking for a core in-stock specialist to own that flow every day. You will make sure the core selection is transferred in the right quantity, at the right time and to the right store, so customers find what they are looking for. You will manage day-to-day operations with the fulfilment centres, transport and store teams. You will be the first person to see a gap in availability and the person who closes it.

This is an operational role in a young and fast-growing network. Processes are still being built and volumes change quickly, especially around Peak and promotional events. You will need to act fast on data, raise issues early and keep stakeholders aligned. You will also help shape the mechanisms we use as we scale.

The applicable collective agreement for this role is CBA for employees of Logistics, Delivery and Shipping Sector. The position is classified at level 2 or above, depending on the candidate's skills, competences and experience.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the in-stock of the core selection across QC stores, tracking core VBI and store availability against target and acting on gaps every day.
- Plan and execute manual transfers from the core fulfilment centres to QC stores, setting quantities from demand forecasts, safety stock and store capacity.
- Schedule and manage CPTs with fulfilment centre and transport teams so transfers leave on time and arrive in line with store receiving windows.
- Run daily operations end to end: check transfer status, find stuck or short shipments, and fix issues with fulfilment centres, middle mile and store teams.
- Find the root causes of out-of-stocks, such as upstream availability, stock reserved for other channels, missed CPTs or receiving delays, and drive corrective actions with the owning teams.
- Review safety stock levels and resize deal and promotional ASINs per store based on forecast and sell-through, especially ahead of Peak events.
- Keep store space and capacity in mind when sending stock, so transfers do not create overstock or congestion in the store.
- Report weekly on in-stock, transfer performance and key issues, and escalate risks early with clear data and a proposed action.
- Contribute to new processes and tools as the network grows, for example automating manual transfers or launching direct fulfilment-centre-to-store injections.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, import/export operations, or data entry/data administration
- Experience in an operational role, or experience working with data analytics and using these metrics to identify problems
- Experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including colleagues and leadership

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with transfer planning, replenishment or transport scheduling in a fulfilment or store network.

title: EU - China Vendor Manager, BISS
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Vendor Manager to join the EU Hardlines (HL) team within Amazon Retail, specializing in Chinese vendor on-boarding. Hardlines is one of the largest and fastest-growing product families in Amazon EU, spanning categories such as Home, DIY & Tools, Garden, Automotive, Business, Industrial & Scientific Supplies (BISS), Sports, and more. A significant share of HL selection and growth originates from Chinese brands and manufacturers, and this role owns the pipeline that brings them onto the EU platform and scales them.

We are looking for a leader who can develop deep relationships with strategic Chinese brands and manufacturers, take full P&L ownership of a cross-border vendor cohort, and drive it towards its next phase of selection-led growth. Much of the selection runway in HL sits with manufacturers who do not yet sell directly on Amazon EU; the right candidate will be hungry to close that gap through vendor acquisition, on-boarding, negotiations, and a relentless focus on customer experience.

In this role, you will examine data to identify high-potential Chinese brands and manufacturers to target, including holdout vendors, initiate long-term relationships with their senior management, resolve the operational, logistical, commercial, and cross-border barriers that slow on-boarding, conduct negotiations on Amazon's behalf, and help vendors launch, ramp, and scale on the platform.

You will also work closely with multiple partner teams and senior stakeholders across EU and China, including Category Leaders, Finance, Supply Chain, Catalogue, Compliance, and Global Selling, to deliver projects that meaningfully improve customer experience, selection breadth, and profitability.

This role has a high degree of autonomy for developing, owning and delivering the vendor on-boarding strategy in order to exceed business goals and for managing key vendors both locally and Pan-EU.



Key job responsibilities
- Identify, acquire and onboard new Chinese brands and manufacturers across HL categories
- Build and own a pipeline of high-potential vendors, including strategic holdouts
- Travel to China to attend tradeshows and meet vendors face-to-face
- Develop long-term relationships with vendors' senior management
- Conduct negotiations on Amazon's behalf to drive top- and bottom-line growth
- Own the Retail P&L for your vendor cohort and deliver revenue and margin plans
- Resolve the cross-border barriers — logistics, compliance, catalogue, and payments — that slow vendor onboarding and ramp
- Use data to identify which vendors to target and to prioritise selection addition
- Work with Category Leaders, Finance, Supply Chain, Catalogue, Compliance, and GlobalSelling to improve customer experience, selection, and profitability

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Fluency in Mandarin Chinese (written and verbal)
- Fluency in English (written and verbal)
- Experience in vendor management, account management, buying, merchandising, or a commercial/negotiation role
- Experience with business analysis and P&L management
- Experience using data and metrics to drive decisions, including proficiency in Excel
- Experience negotiating with and managing external partners or vendors

Preferred qualifications

- Experience onboarding or managing cross-border vendors, or working with Chinese brands and manufacturers
- Experience in a cross-functional role working with supply chain, catalogue, compliance, or logistics teams
- Experience managing large, complex vendor negotiations

title: Senior Network Development Manager, Networking
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's network is a key differentiator for Amazon Cloud Computing and Web Services (AWS), enabling the global operation of thousands of applications across hundreds of thousands of servers worldwide. Our AWS networking teams develop and operate the network platform for all of Amazon, including e-commerce products and cloud computing solutions. This platform is industry-leading for its efficiency, throughput, and reliability -- making it critical to the success of hundreds of thousands of AWS customers.

We are looking for a Senior Network Development Manager (NDM) to join our team, serving large customers with unique requirements. This opportunity will have you lead the design, operation, scaling, and expansion of the network, software, and systems that support AWS Regions. This infrastructure is dedicated to the enterprise and mission needs of partners across federal and civilian agencies, research and development centers, and private industry. It combines innovation in cloud computing with dedicated infrastructure that provides customers and partners with the scale and speed needed to move from data collection to decisions and action.

As a Senior NDM, you will be hiring, managing, and developing multiple teams of network and systems engineers. You will be responsible for the end-to-end operational health of the network including capacity management and forecasting, scaling and expansion, change control, and continuous improvement through new software automation, tools, and systems. You will lead the operations and evolution of a network that is software driven, highly automated, and operating at an unmatched global scale. You will also represent the networking team to our customers, ensuring we meet their needs for innovation, delivery and safe operations.

At Amazon, we ask our technical leaders to be great engineers who can dive deep and get involved in helping their engineers make good decisions and deliver quality solutions. They should maintain a good level of technical understanding and be able to ensure the right engineering expertise exists within the team. In addition, our leaders are thoughtful managers who support and mentor their team and create a friendly working environment of mutual trust and respect.

This is a high visibility and high impact role.
To be considered for this role you must be a UK national.

Key job responsibilities
The person in this role will be responsible for:

- Managing software and network issues to drive down availability risks, while ensuring they are addressed long-term through effective solutions that prevent a recurrence.
- Identifying and implementing innovation opportunities that improve the security, availability, scalability, performance, agility and cost efficiency of the network.
- Working closely with customers and internal partners to develop, communicate, and deliver technology roadmaps that invent new network and software solutions.
- Ensuring that the design, management, implementation, and deployments are sound and executed at scale, safely keeping AWS ahead of customers' demand.
- Representing networking to our customers, senior leadership, and internal service/infrastructure teams, to ensure that network dependencies and deliverables are identified and delivered as needed.
- Ensuring best practices from AWS are adopted, and that we are always compliant with security requirements.
- Building a world class team by attracting, developing, and retaining industry leading talent. This includes technical and soft skills mentoring, career and growth management, 1:1s, training, and day-to-day oversight.
- You must be a UK national and able to obtain and maintain a UK Government Security Clearance. Further details found here: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels

A day in the life
The networking lead owns the design, planning, development, and delivery of network and software infrastructure for Region Expansions that require the highest level of regulatory compliance and security.

Our vision is to deliver connectivity services that set the standard for performance, availability, security, and cost, making AWS the clear choice for customers. Our mission is to make the network completely invisible to anyone using it. We do this by delivering capacity ahead of demand, maximizing security and availability, building extensible solutions that are easy to use, and resolving faults before anyone can notice.

A day in the life includes tactical event response, project management, developing and aligning leaders on new strategies, inspecting metrics to find new ways to further automate the network, and managing a talented team of builders across network, systems, and scaling disciplines.

About the team
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon diversity conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related fields
- Experience with networking and troubleshooting (TCP/IP, DNS, routing, switching, firewalls, LAN/WAN, traceroute, iperf, dig, cURL or related) at an advanced level
- Experience establishing credibility quickly with senior level executives across organizations
- Experience coordinating between technical teams, peers and business stakeholders
- Experience writing strategy documents for executive audiences with clear recommendations in the midst of ambiguity

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in root cause analysis and error correction, identifying changes to procedures and systems to implement long-term fixes and avoid repeating issues
- Experience in software development, or experience with software development lifecycle
- Experience driving projects to improve operations and support-related processes
- Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
- Experience working within a high-growth technology company and large-scale networking environment
- Experience managing on-call support coverage, and participation in escalation and critical issue management
- 7+ years of network management experience.

descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:

In this role, you will join a team of highly talented engineers that build and support AWS Lambda and container services (ECS, EKS, ECR, Fargate) in air-gapped cloud environments, as well as services and tooling to improve how we operate and deliver these platforms. This role enables you to deliver impact at scale: the work you do unlocks the latest in serverless and container capabilities for all of our US ADC customers.

A successful Systems Development Engineer on our team is focused on building services and tooling that enhance our operational posture and eliminate toil. They think about the scalability, availability, and operational readiness of what they create. They operate at the intersection of commercial service architecture and ADC partition constraints, balancing long-term design decisions against the urgency of customer delivery. They build automation that replaces manual processes, and they drive reliability improvements through software rather than procedure.

title: Software Development Engineer, Advanced Analytics - LLD
descriptionHtml:
Build the foundational infrastructure to capture, process, store, and analyze petabyte-scale log-level advertising data — delivering unprecedented transparency into the programmatic supply chain for Amazon's most strategic advertising partners. Your work will directly empower teams to understand auction competitiveness, identify revenue opportunities, optimize floor pricing, and ensure supply chain integrity.

We own and operate the premier advanced analytics capability within Amazon Ads, delivering innovative AI, modeling, and data solutions that help Holding Companies, independent agencies, technology integrators, and large-scale advertisers make smarter, faster, and more impactful advertising decisions. Log-level data — granular, non-aggregated, event-level information from ad servers, exchanges, and SSPs — provides advertisers with visibility into individual ad impressions, bid prices, viewability scores, and supply path. This is a greenfield infrastructure challenge at massive scale, and you'll be building it from the ground up.

Key job responsibilities
- Implement and maintain scalable data pipelines to ingest, process, and store petabyte-scale log-level advertising data from multiple sources (ad servers, exchanges, SSPs)

- Build ETL workflows that transform raw event-level data into queryable, analysis-ready formats following established architectural patterns and best practices

- Create and maintain APIs that enable analytics teams and data scientists to query log-level data efficiently

- Implement data quality checks, validation logic, and monitoring for data pipelines and services

- Optimize performance and cost efficiency of data processing jobs and queries

- Write clean, well-tested code and participate in code reviews to maintain high engineering standards

- Collaborate with senior engineers to contribute to design discussions and architectural decisions

- Debug and resolve production issues, participating in on-call rotations as needed

- Document systems, processes, and runbooks to support operational excellence

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
