descriptionHtml:
Are you an innovative leader that wants to lead the cross-functional design and deployment of innovative solutions into our world-class existing fulfillment centers and logistics systems? Do you want to take ownership of solving the industry’s most complex problems? Does the challenge of designing and implementing ground breaking solutions for automated material handling equipment, packaging technologies, and systems including robotics and high-speed manufacturing appeal to you? If you’re looking to be challenged in a fast paced and often ambiguous environment, and you have strong technical problem solving and project management skills, then this job is for you!

Amazon is searching for an innovative and solutions-oriented Technical Program Manager who is able to collaborate effectively with internal and external technical teams and be responsible for the design, development and deployment of our material handling systems across multiple building types. The role primarily focuses on the Technical Program Management of integrating systems and devices and delivering turnkey deployable solutions to be delivered in the field.

In this role you will be responsible for working with internal customers to define highly ambiguous problem statements, influencing a global Amazon MHE sourcing and integration strategy, writing technical specifications and performing technical evaluations on equipment, generating multiyear budgets, driving project schedules from design to release, and managing multiple large, high visibility programs simultaneously through the project lifecycle.

This person will possess a strong engineering and program management background, will have demonstrated experience leading medium to large projects, and will have a well-rounded technical background in current MHE technologies and storage solutions. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an innovative environment, and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. This means you are not only able to develop and drive high-level strategic initiatives, but can also roll up your sleeves, dig in, and get the job done.

This role requires 50% regional travel and availability to work from a corporate office when not traveling. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Relocation assistance may be provided.


Key job responsibilities
- Own multiple large, complex programs through the full development and deployment lifecycle — you are the accountable driver from concept through field delivery
- Partner with internal customers to define ambiguous problem statements and translate them into clear technical requirements and specifications
- Contribute to Amazon's MHE sourcing and integration strategy by evaluating vendor capabilities, performing technical assessments, and generating data-driven recommendations
- Understand product integration requirements across mechanical, electrical, and controls functions at a systems level
- Critique and debate technical designs, assess viability of proposed solutions, and help engineering teams make appropriate trade-offs considering business goals, throughput, quality, maintainability, and operability
- Drive project schedules from design through release, managing dependencies and risks across internal and external stakeholders
- Generate multiyear budgets and track program financials
- Identify engineering standards and drive consistent application of changes across North America
- Synthesize complex technical and business inputs into clear documentation and specifications
- Lead weekly Team Leads Sync meetings — facilitate agenda, surface hot topics, and track open action items
- Facilitate bi-weekly Team All Call meetings, coordinating topic shares across the team
- Compile and distribute bi-weekly Lookahead/Flash reports covering highlights, lowlights, key meetings, FAT testing schedules, and vendor POCs
- Manage monthly document reviews, ensuring working papers are reviewed internally before leadership submission
- Support quarterly business reviews by compiling executive summaries, sub-pillar updates, FAQs, and appendices
- Prepare quarterly Big Rocks updates for leadership review
- Coordinate annual Charter/Strategy and Headcount Reviews, maintaining documentation in SharePoint and WorkDocs
- Support annual goal-setting processes and provide monthly goal update reminders
- Manage the Team Request Tracker — assign and track action items across team members
- Maintain and optimize operational mechanisms in Smartsheet and Slack to support team workflows

A day in the life
Global Engineering Services (GES) North America (NA) Technical Vendor Management operates at the intersection of engineering execution and vendor partnership across North America. A day in the life may involve leading a weekly business review with a general contractor, reviewing scorecard data to identify systemic performance patterns, conducting a strategic planning session with your team leads, or presenting portfolio risk assessments to GES leadership. You will engage with vendor executives, coordinate with GPO on sourcing decisions, align with TVM counterparts, and drive cross-portfolio intelligence that no single project team can see. GES NA Technical Vendor Management is highly collaborative, working daily to make vendor performance consequential, vendor relationships strategic, and Amazon’s construction supply base stronger every year.

About the team
The Technical Vendor Management (TVM) organization is an engineering and performance-focused function within NA GES, consisting of five pillars: TVM MHE Vendor Management, TVM MHE Vendor Development, TVM MHE Components, Construction Contracts, and Technical Vendor Management, Construction. We manage the full project lifecycle of Amazon’s vendor relationships for general contractors and specialty subcontractors—from qualification through active project execution, performance accountability, and continuous improvement. Technical Vendor Management exists because vendor performance directly impacts whether Amazon’s network launches on time, on budget, and at the quality level operations require. With our team, vendor performance improves year over year because we make it consequential. We build strategic relationships that unlock decisions site-level teams cannot reach, see patterns across the portfolio that no single project can see, and act on them before they repeat.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 3+ years of software development experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Bachelor's degree or above in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or other STEM field
- 5+ years of in material handling equipment (MHE) or automation environments experience, or experience with complex automated material handling equipment, packaging technologies, and systems and high-speed manufacturing
- Experience managing end-to-end project lifecycles including scope definition, scheduling, risk management, vendor coordination, and delivery
- Experience with project management tools and reporting frameworks (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent) and data-driven decision-making
- Position includes travel up to 50% (Nationwide). Travel involves air travel to regional airports and driving to site locations. A valid driver's license is required due to project assignments in areas with limited public transportation and rideshare options.

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
- Master's degree in engineering or equivalent STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) field
- Experience in vendor management, RFP and RFIs
- project management certification such as PMP, Scrum, or other Agile certification
- Experience participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results, or experience in building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making
- Knowledge of controls engineering, mechanical/electrical systems, or software integration as it relates to automation infrastructure

title: Project Engineer
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As a Data Center Project Engineer, you will be part of a creative, diverse team tasked with solving fascinating problems in constructing Amazon Data Centers. Our data centers are industry examples of energy-efficient, cost-effective designs. You will work alongside partner teams such as Operations, Networking, Controls, Security, and Commissioning to build Data Centers that directly support our customers.

As our Data Center Project Engineer, you will support the teams that build some of the most interesting electrical and mechanical systems in the world. You will be on the construction site daily, interacting with construction managers and stakeholders, and be directly responsible for supporting the fast, high-quality delivery of our data center construction. The Data Center Project Engineer will be part of the onsite Construction Management team and will own the communication coordination with our vendors, information workflow, and coordination of document management, including requests for information (RFI), change orders, reports, and schedule updates.

At Amazon, we are all Owners and leverage unique opportunities presented to us by owning everything from the design review to construction bidding to construction execution and final hand-off to our customers. We are a diverse, upbeat, creative team of engineers and managers working on a daily basis to develop innovative data centers for our customers.

Key job responsibilities
The Data Center Project Engineer will be responsible for:

• Leading cross-functional communication and coordination between regional general contractors, stakeholders, and internal teams, ensuring seamless information flow for construction protocols, documentation access, and standardized procedures

• Developing and maintaining comprehensive tracking systems for design modifications, RFIs, and change orders, creating detailed dashboards with priority levels and deadlines for regional leadership review

• Evaluating Method of Procedure (MOP) submissions for thoroughness, necessity, and risk assessment

• Managing vendor onboarding processes, including security credentialing and orientation programs

• Maintaining current project management software with critical milestone updates, correspondence records, and document control

• Coordinating and monitoring owner-furnished material deliveries to ensure timely arrival at construction sites

• Establishing and managing a centralized repository for contractor-supplied construction data

• Overseeing quality assurance programs through implementation of various checklists, including substantial completion verification, safety protocols, and quality control measures

A day in the life
**Why AWS**
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

- 5+ years of data center engineering or operations experience
- 5+ years of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel experience

- Experience with Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel

title: Electrical Engineer, Power Resiliency
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking an experienced Technical Infrastructure Program Manager (TIPM) to join our Global Engineering Services & Analytics (GESA) organization within the Power Resiliency team. In this role, you will own the end-to-end program management of power resiliency assets—including generators, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and related electrical infrastructure—across Amazon’s global portfolio of fulfillment centers, sort centers, and delivery stations.
You will drive the implementation, commissioning, and lifecycle management of technical power projects that ensure uninterrupted operations at Amazon sites worldwide. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and can balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will work cross-functionally with electrical engineering, construction, operations, safety, and procurement teams to deliver resilient power solutions at scale.


Key job responsibilities
Project Implementation & Delivery
• Scope, plan, and execute generator and BESS installation projects from concept through commissioning, ensuring on-time, on-budget delivery aligned with site operational requirements.
• Develop and maintain comprehensive project schedules, budgets, risk registers, and status reports for all assigned power resiliency capital projects.
• Coordinate commissioning, testing, and acceptance protocols for new power equipment, ensuring compliance with Amazon technical standards, NEC/NFPA codes, and local jurisdictional requirements.
• Manage design reviews and technical submittals, working closely with electrical engineers and third-party design firms to ensure constructability and operational readiness.
• Drive the procurement process for generators, BESS units, switchgear, and related balance-of-plant equipment in partnership with Strategic Sourcing.

Maintenance & Lifecycle Management
• Develop and oversee preventive and corrective maintenance programs for generators, BESS, automatic transfer switches (ATS), paralleling switchgear, and associated controls across assigned sites.
• Establish maintenance KPIs and reporting cadences; analyze equipment performance data to identify trends, predict failures, and optimize maintenance intervals.
• Manage end-of-life planning and replacement strategies for aging power resiliency assets, including capital justification and prioritization.
• Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements, manufacturer recommendations, and Amazon internal standards for power equipment maintenance.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management
• Manage vendor relationships with generator OEMs, BESS suppliers, electrical contractors, and commissioning agents; hold partners accountable to scope, schedule, quality, and safety standards.
• Serve as the primary point of contact between engineering, construction, operations, and external partners for all power resiliency project activities at assigned sites.
• Facilitate stakeholder alignment across regional operations teams, site leadership, safety, and corporate engineering to ensure seamless project delivery and transition to steady-state operations.
• Negotiate contracts, change orders, and service agreements; manage purchase orders and invoicing through the project lifecycle.

Technical Leadership & Strategy
• Support the development of Amazon’s global power resiliency strategy, including site assessment frameworks, resiliency scoring models, and technology evaluation criteria.
• Evaluate emerging technologies in energy storage, distributed generation, microgrid architecture, and renewable integration to inform the team’s technical roadmap.
• Author and maintain technical standards, design guidelines, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for generator and BESS programs.
• Conduct root-cause analysis on power system failures and outages; develop corrective action plans and drive implementation across the portfolio.
• Represent the Power Resiliency team in cross-functional reviews, leadership briefings, and incident response coordination.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Power Engineering, or a related field
- Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
- Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
- Knowledge of project management tools and software
- 3+ years of construction or project management, or 3+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 2+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- Working knowledge of NEC, NFPA 110, NFPA 111, IEEE, and other applicable codes and standards governing emergency and standby power systems.

Preferred qualifications

- Professional Engineer License
- Experience working in data centers or critical infrastructure
- Experience working in a matrixed organization
- Master’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
- Knowledge of microgrid design, distributed energy resources (DERs), renewable energy integration, and advanced energy storage technologies (lithium-ion, flow batteries, etc.).
- Familiarity with CMMS platforms (e.g., Maximo, SAP PM) and capital planning/budgeting processes.
- Experience with utility interconnection processes, power purchase agreements, and grid-tied energy systems.
- Prior experience at Amazon or within a large-scale logistics/technology infrastructure environment.

title: Senior Robotics Data Engineer, Frontier AI & Robotics (FAR)
descriptionHtml:
Are you interested in solving the most critical operations problem behind cutting-edge robotics development? Interested in fast dynamic environment? Amazon's Frontier AI & Robotics (FAR) team is building advanced robotic systems through frontier foundation models, and high-quality data collection is a core input to that research.


Key job responsibilities
Own the technical execution and continuous improvement of early-stage data collection for advanced robotics. Partner with researchers to translate research objectives into reliable collection workflows, improve data quality, and shorten policy training iteration cycles. Work independently within agreed priorities, providing hands-on technical guidance to data collectors and coordinating execution across research, engineering, and operations.

In this role, you will
- Own end-to-end collection iterations for assigned research tasks, from requirements and station readiness through pilot collection, quality review, and delivery of training-ready data. Coordinate dependencies and resolve blockers to meet agreed quality and turnaround goals.
- Partner with researchers to develop and refine SOPs, translating task objectives, failure modes, and evaluation feedback into clear collection instructions and acceptance criteria. Maintain version control and ensure collectors adopt changes consistently.
- Serve as the technical subject matter expert for assigned collection workflows, equipment, and tools. Independently diagnose complex issues involving robotics hardware, sensors, calibration, collection software, and data integrity; engage engineering partners when resolution requires deeper expertise.
- Provide critical technical direction and coaching to data collectors. Demonstrate correct execution, calibrate collectors against quality standards, and develop their troubleshooting skills and judgment.
- Assess operational and technical risks, including equipment readiness, unsafe conditions, data loss, and quality degradation. Determine when to continue, pause collection, or escalate, and coordinate recovery within established safety and technical boundaries.
- Own collection performance metrics, including usable-data yield, rework, station availability, and iteration turnaround time. Use dashboards and root-cause analysis to identify recurring issues and verify that corrective actions improve results.
- Lead operational improvement projects that reduce collection failures and iteration delays. Develop and implement reusable workflows, troubleshooting guides, readiness checks, and lightweight tooling, and drive adoption across relevant stations, shifts, and partner teams.
- Coordinate technical and nontechnical stakeholders, including researchers, engineering, operations, and annotation partners. Communicate priorities, trade-offs, risks, and decisions clearly, and escalate issues that threaten delivery commitments.

Basic qualifications

- Can work proactively and independently, meet deadlines, and deliver on projects and tasks
- Bachelor's degree or above in Operations Research, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science or related field, or experience working in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)
- Experience diagnosing hardware, software, or process issues, using evidence to identify root causes and implement corrective actions
- Strong problem-solving and systems-thinking skills, including the ability to assess risks and make sound technical decisions with incomplete information
- Working understanding of how collection quality, task coverage, and consistency affect model training and evaluation, with the ability to translate research requirements into executable procedures and quality checks
- Demonstrated ability to train and mentor others and communicate complex information clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences, including remote teams and colleagues who use English as a second language
- Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and dependencies across multiple collection tasks

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in technical operations, engineering, technical project management, or a related role involving hands-on ownership of complex systems or workflows
- Experience developing SOPs, technical documentation, performance metrics, and process improvements, and ensuring their adoption
- Experience with robotics, teleoperation, egocentric video, or multimodal sensor data
- Experience supporting ML/AI data collection, annotation, quality assurance, or model evaluation workflows
- Familiarity with sensor calibration, timestamp synchronization, pose tracking, and data integrity checks
- Experience using vibe coding agents to build and maintain lightweight operational tools
- Experience taking an experimental workflow from initial pilot through repeatable execution across multiple stations or teams

title: Principal Product Manager - Tech, News, Prime Video Global App Experience
descriptionHtml:
Prime Video is a first-stop destination for premium video in one app, available on thousands of devices worldwide. Alongside movies, series, and live sports, Prime Video is becoming a place customers come every day to stay informed, and we're investing in News to make that happen.

Our News program is early. We launched a dedicated News experience this year and are moving quickly, but much of what this product could become is still unbuilt. We're looking for a Principal Product Manager – Technical to lead Prime Video's effort to become the best place to watch video news. The work feels like a startup inside a larger business. You'll have the room to define a new category for Prime Video, along with the scale, data, and technology to reach millions of customers.

You'll own the strategy for growing customers' awareness of news on Prime Video and making it a daily habit. You'll set ambitious goals and run the programs that deliver them. A central part of the work is inventing AI-powered news features that inform and engage customers. You'll partner directly with applied scientists and engineers to build them, turning user research and data into the experience customers see on screen. You'll study the competitive landscape closely so that Prime Video sets the bar for video news streaming instead of following it.

We're looking for a hands-on leader who is highly analytical, customer obsessed, and comfortable with ambiguity. You have a track record of taking a new product area from early traction to scale. You're fluent in AI/ML and generative AI, and you can weigh in on technical trade-offs with scientists and engineers. You influence senior stakeholders through clear writing and sound judgment, and you can bring hotly debated topics to a decision. Experience in news or digital media is a strong plus.

Key job responsibilities
- Define the multi-year vision, strategy, and roadmap for news on Prime Video, and the metrics that measure customer awareness, engagement, and daily habit.
- Set ambitious, measurable goals for news growth, and drive the programs and feature launches that deliver them.
- Invent AI-powered news experiences that help customers stay informed in ways they can't get elsewhere.
- Partner directly with applied scientists and software engineers to frame problems, evaluate model and technology choices, and make trade-offs between quality, speed, and cost.
- Build a deep understanding of news customers through user research, experimentation, and data analysis, and translate those insights into product requirements and design direction.
- Continuously benchmark against best-in-class news and video experiences, track emerging industry trends, and use those insights to inform Prime Video's approach.
- Write clear product narratives and requirements that align senior leaders and cross-functional partners, and bring contentious decisions to resolution.
- Drive launches across teams inside and outside Prime Video, including design, content partnerships, marketing, legal, and operations.
- Shape how Prime Video meets the unique demands of news, including timeliness, accuracy, trust, and responsible use of AI.

About the team
Prime Video's Global App Experience (GAE) organization builds a simple, intuitive, fast, and personalized streaming experience for Prime Video customers worldwide, across web, mobile, and living room devices. Our goal is to make Prime Video a daily destination where customers want to come to watch their favorite content. The News team within GAE is central to that goal. We're building Prime Video into the place customers turn every day to stay informed. The team combines the energy of an early-stage startup with GAE's global reach and Amazon's investments in AI. We work closely with science, engineering, design, and content partners to experiment fast, learn from customers, and scale what works.

- 4+ years of end to end product delivery experience
- 8+ years of technical product or program management experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience leading engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience technical product management
- Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders
- Experience with AI/ML technologies

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in a technical field, or Master of Business Administration
- Experience with machine learning (ML) tools and methods
- Experience reviewing user research and data to build a strategic and user-friendly design
- 5+ years of planning, designing, developing and delivering consumer software experience
- Familiarity with modern GenAI or LLM tools
- Experience in journalism or other editorial media

title: Network Services Specialist Solution Architect, AGS-EMEA-Europe South
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about enterprise networking, edge computing, and content delivery? Do you enjoy helping customers design high-performance, secure network architectures that connect their workloads to the world? Come join us!

At Amazon, we've invested deeply in building a resilient, secure, and globally distributed network in the cloud. AWS is looking for an Edge/Network Specialist Solutions Architect for our Europe South team, who will be the Subject Matter Expert (SME) helping customers design complex networking and edge delivery solutions spanning connectivity, content delivery, and perimeter protection services.

As part of the team, you will work closely with Europe South customers across all industry verticals to drive adoption of AWS Network Services, including CloudFront, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, Cloud WAN, PrivateLink, VPC Lattice, Elastic Load Balancing, WAF, and Shield. You will act as a trusted advisor on hybrid connectivity, network security, application delivery, and high-throughput architectures supporting AI/ML, migration, and modernization workloads. Beyond customer engagements, you will create and deliver original content, including white papers, blogs, reference architectures, and presentations, to enable customers and field teams to fully leverage the strength of the AWS network from data center to end user.

Key job responsibilities
As the Network Services Specialist SA for Europe South, you will:
- Act as the regional SME for AWS network and edge services, advising customers on connectivity, content delivery, and perimeter protection architectures.
- Lead technical deep dives, architecture reviews, and hands-on workshops covering CloudFront, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, Cloud WAN, PrivateLink, VPC Lattice, Elastic Load Balancing, WAF, and Shield.
- Design hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity, zero-trust network segmentation, and high-availability application delivery for enterprise customers.
- Support high-throughput architectures for AI/ML, migration, and modernization workloads.
- Create reusable reference architectures, white papers, and blogs, and present at Summits, re:Invent, and customer events.
- Partner with sales, service teams, and the field community to drive adoption of AWS network services across the region.

A day in the life
You start the day on a customer architecture review, helping an enterprise redesign hybrid connectivity across Direct Connect and Transit Gateway. Midday you run a workshop on edge delivery and perimeter protection, then partner with an account team to unblock a migration networking design. In the afternoon you write a reference architecture for high-throughput AI/ML connectivity and prepare a talk for an upcoming customer event. You work across engineering teams and VP-level stakeholders.

About the team
The Europe South Specialist SA team helps customers get the most from the AWS global network, from data center to end user. We are deep technical experts who pair closely with customers and account teams on their most complex networking and edge challenges. We value hands-on building, original technical content, and customer obsession. We learn fast, share openly, and help each other grow in a collaborative, high-trust environment.

Basic qualifications

- Deep expertise in CDN and Edge Services Hands-on experience with content delivery networks (CloudFront or equivalent), edge compute (Lambda@Edge, CloudFront Functions), Global Accelerator, and perimeter protection architectures (WAF, Shield, Firewall Manager).
- Enterprise networking architecture Advanced knowledge of hybrid and multi-cloud networking: Direct Connect (including 100+ Gbps), Transit Gateway, Cloud WAN, VPN, and BGP routing.
- Network security and zero-trust design Expertise in network segmentation, PrivateLink, VPC Lattice, security groups, NACLs, and micro-segmentation patterns.
- Application delivery and load balancing Deep understanding of Elastic Load Balancing (ALB, NLB, GWLB), origin architectures, TLS termination, health checking patterns, and high-availability application delivery across regions and edge locations.
- Performance optimization and troubleshooting Ability to diagnose and resolve complex latency, throughput, and connectivity issues across distributed architectures.
- Customer-facing technical leadership Proven ability to lead architectural workshops, deliver technical presentations at events (Summits, re:Invent, customer days), write technical blogs, and create reusable reference architectures. Comfortable presenting to both engineering teams and VP/C-level audiences.

Preferred qualifications

- AI/ML and high-throughput workload connectivity Understanding of network requirements for AI/ML training, fine-tuning, and inference workloads, including high-capacity DX provisioning, placement group networking, EFA, and low-latency connectivity to GPU/Trainium clusters.
- Migration and modernization networking Experience designing network foundations for large-scale cloud migrations (VMware, Oracle, SAP), including DX + TGW bridge connectivity, DNS migration, IP address management, and hybrid routing during cutover periods.

title: Senior Agency Development Manager, Agency Development, Amazon Ads
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Ads is dedicated to driving measurable outcomes for brand advertisers and agencies. Our full funnel ad solutions—including display, video, audio and custom ads—leverage Amazon’s innovations and insights to find, attract, and engage intended audiences throughout their daily journeys. With a range of flexible pricing and buying models, including self-service, managed service, and programmatic ad buying, these solutions help businesses build brand awareness, increase product sales, and more. We start with the customer and work backwards in everything we do, including advertising. If you’re interested in joining a rapidly growing team working to build a unique, world-class advertising group with a relentless focus on the customer, you’ve come to the right place.

Agency Development Managers (ADM) are single threaded owners responsible for relationships with our largest agency customers. They own the Amazon/Agency HoldCo relationship at the most senior level. ADMs are tasked with accelerating Amazon Ads revenue, increasing Amazon Ads tool adoption and increasing penetration of the total advertiser universe in each agency. Overseeing key customer meetings, running group presentations, building commercial agreements and joint business plans, escalating blockers and driving the business forward across EMEA agency hubs based in London.

Our team build long-lasting partnerships with our agency customers through the development of commercial and servicing plans covering our entire offering. We aim to increase the number of brands using Amazon, and the diversity of products and tools they use to drive revenue growth and advocacy with our agency customers.

title: Senior Equipment Engineer, Annapurna Labs
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Equipment Engineer to join our team in South Korea. This is the team's **first hire in country**, making it a foundational role with significant ownership and visibility. This role will provide technical leadership for automated test equipment (ATE) operations at our OSAT partners, driving excellence in test cell qualification and problem resolution.

Key job responsibilities
Lead and execute new test cell qualification and bring-up activities at OSAT partners

Serve as the primary technical escalation point for complex issues at OSAT facilities

Drive resolution of sophisticated setup challenges involving thermal, electrical, and mechanical systems

Conduct comprehensive technical audits at OSAT partners to ensure compliance with quality standards

Develop and deliver technical training programs for new team members and OSAT partners

Review and approve test cell configurations for production release

Partner with cross-functional teams to optimize test cell performance and reliability

Lead continuous improvement initiatives for test cell efficiency and yield

A day in the life
As our first engineer based in South Korea, you will be the on-the-ground technical anchor for our OSAT operations in the Incheon area — a foundational role with real ownership and visibility.

A typical week blends hands-on floor time with focused remote work:

- **On-site at the OSAT (3+ days/week):** You start the day walking the test floor — reviewing overnight test cell performance, checking in on qualification or bring-up activities in progress, and acting as the first point of contact when the OSAT team hits a complex thermal, electrical, or mechanical setup challenge. You run technical audits, review configurations for production release, and partner directly with the partner's engineers to keep yield and reliability on track.

- **Remote days (work from home):** You focus on the deeper work — analyzing test data, preparing audit findings, building training materials for OSAT partners and new team members, and syncing with cross-functional teams across time zones (including colleagues in Israel).

- **Quarterly business trips:** You travel to OSATs outside South Korea (Taiwan, Malta) to support bring-up and qualification, or to Israel for training and team collaboration.


Because you'll be the first local hire, you'll also help shape how the team operates in-country — setting the standard for how we engage our Korean OSAT partners.

About the team
You will join Annapurna Labs' Equipment Engineering team, which provides the technical backbone for our semiconductor test operations across our OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test) partners. The team owns test cell qualification, bring-up, and sustaining engineering for the ATE and handler fleet that validates our custom silicon.

As a globally distributed team — with engineers in Israel and a growing presence across APAC, including Taiwan — we work hand-in-hand with our OSAT partners to ensure every test cell runs reliably, efficiently, and to spec. Establishing a dedicated engineer in South Korea is a key step in expanding our regional footprint and deepening our partnership with local OSATs. You will be the team's first presence in Korea, working closely with colleagues across these sites while building the local engineering relationship from the ground up.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering
- 5+ years of hands-on experience with automated test equipment
- **ATE testers** — proficiency in at least one of the below:
- Advantest (EVA Scale, SmartScale)
- Teradyne UFP ("UltraFLEX Plus")
- **ATC handlers** — proficiency in at least one of the below:
- HonPrec Inc. (HPI) — 1028CH / CA, 9046LS
- Chroma ATE — 3160-H
- Cohu — EclipseX
- Demonstrated expertise in complex problem solving across thermal, electrical, and mechanical domains
- Strong project management and stakeholder communication skills

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge in electrical engineering at practical engineer level is a significant advantage
- Experience with semiconductor test and handling equipment
- Track record of leading technical teams or mentoring junior engineers
- Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills
- Excellent communication skills in English; Korean proficiency highly desired
- Experience working with OSAT partners in Asia

title: Wireless Network Development Engineer , ONE-NAT, ONE Access Engineering (LAN/Wireless)
descriptionHtml:
Are you strong in network automation? then this might be a great opportunity for you.

Join Amazon's Network Access Technology team and build automation that keeps the world's largest enterprise wireless network running smoothly and healing itself. You'll design and deploy next-generation access infrastructure across thousands of global sites, solving complex problems at massive scale while your work directly enables every package Amazon delivers.

Your primary focus is building automation that makes our global wireless network self-sufficient and resilient. You'll analyze patterns across thousands of sites, develop workflows that resolve issues without human intervention, and validate new hardware before it reaches production environments.

You partner with firmware, field operations, and infrastructure engineers—pressure-testing designs and influencing decisions through data-driven insights. You'll mentor newer engineers, conduct technical reviews, and occasionally visit sites for hands-on validation and troubleshooting.

No two weeks look the same, but the constant is this: you're solving complex problems at unprecedented scale, and your work directly impacts the reliability of our fulfillment network worldwide.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and Deploy Network Solutions: Lead the design, development, and deployment of network access solutions spanning wireless (Wi-Fi 5/6/6E/7), wired (802.1X, NAC), and emerging network access technologies across Amazon's global fulfillment network.
- Own End-to-End Project Delivery: Take ownership of complex, multi-milestone network engineering projects from requirements gathering through deployment and validation, ensuring alignment with internal processes and stakeholder expectations.
- Build Automation and Tooling: Develop and enhance automation frameworks for network configuration, compliance validation, and zero-touch deployment pipelines that reduce manual effort and improve consistency.
- Enable Self-Healing Operations: Contribute to our automation platform by developing automated remediation workflows, anomaly detection models, and predictive maintenance capabilities for wireless infrastructure.
- Drive Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with engineering, field operations, network operations, and program management teams to develop solutions that balance performance, cost, and operational simplicity while validating new device types and configurations.

About the team
We own the design, planning, deployment, and support of the largest wireless and wired access network in the world. We operate at an unprecedented scale—assisting fulfillment, sortation, and delivery sites globally. Our team manages access interconnection that ensures every Amazon associate, robot, and IoT device stays reliably linked to power Amazon's fulfillment promise.

We're focused on transforming network engineering and operations through AI-driven automation, self-healing infrastructure, and next-generation access technologies. We don't just maintain reachability—we architect the network that enables Amazon to deliver for customers worldwide. You'll be part of a team that values operational excellence, continuous improvement, and collective problem-solving.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with automation or working with scripting languages like Python, Java, Perl, PHP, Ruby, Bash, Shell, or equivalent
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or other related discipline
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
- 4+ years experience developing engineering, deployment, or operations mechanisms to support IP network and/or networking systems
- 4+ years experience in a network focused hands-on technical role working with IP routing protocols/technologies and platforms in large scale enterprise wireless network environments
- 4+ years of experience in network engineering, with deep expertise in wireless (802.11ac/ax/be) and wired (802.1X, RADIUS, DHCP, DNS) access technologies

Preferred qualifications

- Thorough understanding of TCP/IP networking, IP routing, Server Load Balancing, and Network Security architecture and core technologies such as IP, TCP, OSPF/IS-IS, BGP, MPLS, Server Load Balancers, Firewalls, ACLs, DNS, DHCP, IPAM, LDAP, NFS, etc.
- Experience with one or more of the following wireless access points/controllers, switches, routers, server load balancer, and firewall vendor platforms: Cisco, Juniper, Alcatel-Lucent, Arista, Brocade, Extreme, Citrix, F5, Fortinet, Palo Alto, etc.
- Hands-on experience with enterprise wireless platforms (Cisco, Juniper MIST, or similar) including controller-based and cloud-managed architectures
- Strong understanding of RF fundamentals, site survey methodologies, and wireless capacity planning

title: SC Capacity Manager, Sort Center Capacity
locations: Sao Joao Do Meriti, RJ, Brazil
descriptionHtml:
O(a) Capacity Planning Manager é responsável por garantir que a rede de Sort Centers opere com capacidade otimizada, conectando planejamento de volumes, configuração de sistemas e execução operacional. Esta posição atua como elo entre as equipes de operações dos Sort Centers e as equipes de transporte, assegurando que a capacidade configurada reflita a demanda real e que desvios sejam corrigidos com agilidade.

O(a) candidato(a) ideal é apaixonado(a) por usar dados para oferecer um plano prático que impacte os negócios. Ele/Ela têm um forte histórico de entrega de resultados e tem experiência na execução em um ambiente multifuncional, apoiado por análises e dados. Ele/Ela gosta de um ambiente acelerado, trabalhando com grandes quantidades de dados e resolvendo problemas altamente complexos e ambíguos.

A Amazon está comprometida com um ambiente de trabalho diverso e inclusivo. A Amazon é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades e não discrimina com base em raça, origem nacional, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, status de veterano protegido, deficiência, idade ou outro status legalmente protegido.




Key job responsibilities
1- Planejar e monitorar a capacidade operacional dos Sort Centers em ciclos semanal e diário, garantindo que os planos de volume estejam alinhados à capacidade instalada.

2- Identificar e eliminar gaps de capacidade comparando volumes planejados versus capacidade, trabalhando diretamente com as equipes de execução para implementar ajustes em tempo hábil e minimizar impactos ao cliente.

3- Alinhar configurações de capacidade com as equipes de transporte em âmbito nacional, assegurando que as premissas de volume inbound/outbound, rotas e janelas operacionais estejam consistentes entre Sort Centers e a rede de middle mile.

4- Configurar e gerenciar a capacidade nos sistemas, definindo as capacidade por tipo de operação e monitorando a utilização em tempo real para identificar oportunidades de otimização.

5- Analisar os desvios em premissas críticas de planejamento — como packages per route (PPR), cube per package (CPP) e tamanho médio de pacotes — investigando root causes e produzindo análises que orientem decisões operacionais.

6- Produzir revisões analíticas e recomendações para as operações, traduzindo dados de forecast accuracy, volume profile e produtividade em insights acionáveis para melhoria contínua.

7- Otimizar a alocação de volumes entre SC, avaliando trade-offs de capacidade, custo e nível de serviço, maximizando a eficiência da rede.

A day in the life
- Trabalhar com equipes da Amazon para transformar inputs de previsão de volume em plano de execução operacional;
- Interagir com as partes interessadas em toda a malha para garantir que a execução do plano diário;
- Apoiar a liderança com análises de dados importantes para garantir uma tomada de decisão rápida e precisa.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
- Experience in program or project management
- Experience in defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics
- Experience in supply chain

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Healthcare Strategic Lead, UK Public Sector Healthcare
descriptionHtml:
AWS is seeking an experienced healthcare technology leader to drive long-term proposition development for the NHS. This is not a traditional sales role — it is a strategic, outward-facing position that combines deep NHS domain expertise with the ability to shape and architect cloud-enabled solutions that address the systemic challenges facing the health service.

You will act as the bridge between NHS clinical/operational reality and AWS's technology capabilities — translating policy intent into deliverable cloud propositions, working 12–36 months ahead of procurement cycles to shape demand, and ensuring AWS is positioned as the strategic platform of choice when buying decisions crystallise.

This role is ideal for someone with a CTO, CDIO, or senior digital leadership background in the NHS who wants to apply that expertise at national scale — shaping propositions that will transform care delivery across the system.

Key job responsibilities
1/ Develop and own long-term (2–5 year) cloud propositions aligned to NHS strategic priorities
2/ Translate NHS policy (10-Year Health Plan, NHSE mandates, ICS strategies) into actionable AWS account plans
3/ Engage at CIO, CDIO, CCIO, and Medical Director level as a credible peer — understanding clinical workflows, operational pressures, and governance constraints from first-hand experience
4/ Shape NHS procurement criteria and architecture standards ahead of formal tender processes
5/ Lead proposition development for complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives
6/ Work with AWS Solutions Architects, Partner teams, and ISVs to build reference architectures, business cases, and proof-of-concept designs
7/ Represent AWS at national policy forums, NHS boards, and industry bodies — contributing thought leadership on cloud-enabled health system transformation
8/ Advise the AWS UK Healthcare leadership team on NHS strategic direction, emerging opportunities, and competitive positioning
Build relationships across the NHS ecosystem: NHSE, DHSC, ICSs, NHS Trusts, Royal Colleges and regulators

A day in the life
No two days in this role are the same. On any given day, you might start the morning preparing a cloud business case for a Trust CFO and spend the afternoon on-site with a CDIO walking through their digital roadmap.

You'll balance strategic account planning with tactical deal execution — one moment you're working with a Trust's to shape their infrastructure strategy, the next you're navigating a procurement framework. You'll join internal working sessions with Solutions Architects to design a resilient architecture for a clinical workload, then brief your leadership on pipeline progress.

You'll attend NHS industry events and ICS board meetings and host innovation days that bring clinicians face-to-face with AI and data tools. Some weeks you'll be deep in a complex multi-stakeholder procurement; others you'll be running a proof-of-concept that demonstrates measurable productivity gains.

What stays constant: you will be at the centre of the UK's most significant healthcare transformation, working with senior leaders who are making technology decisions that will shape patient care for the next decade. The pace is high, the impact is real, and the team around you is exceptional.

Basic qualifications

- Experience solving problems with technology in the Healthcare/Life Sciences Industry
- Experience working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage
- Experience building strategic relationships with stakeholders, including communicating and collaborating across teams and functions
- Evidence a background of working in or with the NHS on digital transformation projects
- Evidence of engagement across C Suite within NHS

Preferred qualifications

- Experience implementing a cloud-based technology solution, or experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS
- Experience in C-level NHS leadership or Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting

title: Software Development Engineer, Alexa Connections
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to shape how people stay connected across calls, text, and email? Alexa Connections is building a trusted communication agent that understands intent, context, and relationships, then acts on a customer's behalf to make every interaction feel natural. As a Software Development Engineer on this team, you'll design and deliver the software systems behind a context-aware assistant that grows more helpful over time. You'll work across the full software development lifecycle — from understanding customer problems, through system design and implementation, to deployment and operations — building privacy-first solutions that serve tens of millions of daily communication events.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement software services that model each customer's personal connections graph, a privacy-first representation of relationships and communication patterns used to power context-aware assistance.

Your morning might start with a design review for a new personalization feature, working through tradeoffs in scalability and data privacy with senior engineers and applied scientists. After lunch you could be writing and testing code for a service that ranks a customer's most relevant contacts, then pairing with a teammate on a code review. You'll regularly join standups with product managers and scientists to align on priorities, and you'll rotate through on-call responsibilities to keep the systems you build running smoothly.

About the team
The Alexa Connections team is growing, so you'll join early and help shape its engineering culture from the ground up. You'll work alongside experienced engineers and scientists who are invested in your growth, with mentorship and the chance to own meaningful problems. Our mission is to make communication effortless and trustworthy for customers worldwide, and we're focused on building intelligent, privacy-first systems that redefine how people stay in touch.

As a Solutions Architect, you will help customers succeed using AWS technologies — linking technology with measurable business value for healthcare and life sciences organizations. You will bring technical depth and curiosity, with the ability to participate in architecture discussions and clearly communicate the value of the AWS platform to both technical and business audiences.

You will help design scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures, assist customers in understanding best practices around cloud-based solutions, and support workload migration efforts. Amazon Web Services is looking for a highly motivated Solutions Architect to help accelerate customer adoption. This is an excellent opportunity to join Amazon’s world class technical teams, working with some of the best and brightest engineers, architects and technical managers while also developing your skills and furthering your career within one of the most innovative and progressive technology companies anywhere.

As a Solutions Architect at AWS you will work directly with customers. We are looking for individuals who are motivated by the opportunity to work backwards from these customers' needs and help them gain competitive edge using AWS. As an experienced technologist and key member of the Account team you will help influence customers' architectural choices across broad use cases involving security, compute, storage networking as well as advanced scenarios involving serverless, analytics, and AI/ML.

As a part of the role, you will provide exceptional technical design guidance and thought leadership. You will lead efforts to capture and share best-practice knowledge with the AWS solution architect community. You will also gain the opportunity to learn from, collaborate with, and educate some of the brightest technical minds in the industry today across the breadth of enterprise architecture.

- Work closely with IT and business stakeholders at BioPharma/Biotech and diagnostics organizations to understand their unique requirements and challenges.

title: Instandhaltungstechniker:in
descriptionHtml:
Das Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist für unseren Betrieb von fundamentaler Bedeutung – es sorgt dafür, dass unsere technischen Systeme und Anlagen laufend funktionieren. Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du für die Wartung und Instandhaltung unserer förder- und haustechnischen Anlagen sowie Produktionsanlagen zuständig. Du hilfst, die höchsten Sicherheitsstandards im Arbeitsschutz zu gewährleisten und Maschinenausfallzeiten zu verhindern. Unser technisches Team stellt eine hohe Verfügbarkeit der technischen Anlagen sicher und verbessert die Qualität unserer Geräte.

The minimum basic salary for this position is 2885.8 EUR gross per month. In accordance with the applicable legal requirements, we also state that the minimum salary for this position is determined by the relevant collective bargaining agreement. Depending on experience and qualifications, there is a willingness to overpay. In addition, depending on the position, we offer sign-on payments and restricted stock unit (RSU) award as well as employee discount.

Key job responsibilities
- Ausführung präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an einer breiten Vielfalt von Geräten an unseren Standorten
- Durchführung von Reparaturen und Fehlerdiagnosen
- Verwendung neuester Tools zur Maximierung der Geräteeffektivität
- Einhaltung aller Arbeitsschutzrichtlinien und -praktiken
- Unterstützung der Entwicklung und des beruflichen Fortschritts von Auszubildenden am Standort
- Arbeit an Projekten zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Einführung von Best Practices an verschiedenen EU-Standorten
- Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit

WIR BIETEN:
• Einen unbefristeten Vertrag direkt mit Amazon.
• Spannende Aufgaben in einem expandierenden, innovativen und internationalen Umfeld.
• Gestaltungsfreiräume für Ideen und Wertschätzung von Engagement.
• Hervorragende Perspektiven aufgrund unseres Wachstums.
• Die Mitarbeit in einem kompetenten, hoch motivierten Team.
• Vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und ein attraktives Vergütungspaket mit Unternehmensbeteiligung.
• Das kollektivvertragliche Mindestgrundgehalt beträgt € 39.243€ brutto pro Jahr. Eine Überzahlung ist je nach Qualifikation und Erfahrung möglich.

A day in the life
Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren tätig, um schnell auf technische Störungen reagieren zu können. Du führst eine Reihe geplanter präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an Geräten durch, um für ihren sicheren Betrieb zu sorgen. Außerdem reagierst Du als Instandhaltungstechniker:in unverzüglich auf Störungen und Ausfälle. Du untersuchst die Ursachen, findest so schnell wie möglich Lösungen und wendest sie an. Zudem machst Du Vorschläge für langfristige Verbesserungen.
In Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Kolleg:innen nimmst Du tägliche Wartungsaufgaben wahr und kommunizierst mit Dienstleistern, falls Du externe Expertise benötigst. Du arbeitest in rotierenden Schichten, damit wir rund um die Uhr unsere Standorte unterstützen – und dafür sorgen, dass Amazon weiterhin in dem Tempo liefern kann, für das wir bekannt sind.

About the team
Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) sorgt dafür, dass unsere Geräte und Ausstattung jederzeit optimal funktionieren. Wir sind ein Team von Techniker:innen und Ingenieur:innen, das aus hervorragenden Teamplayern besteht und von erfahrenen Führungskräften geleitet wird. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, die Geräte in unserem gesamten globalen Netzwerk von Fulfillment-Centern zu warten, zu reparieren und ihre Fehler zu beheben. Einige unserer Mitarbeiter:innen sind Führungskräfte, die das Team bei der Arbeit an spannender, innovativer Technologie beaufsichtigen – die es teilweise nur bei Amazon gibt.
Von der Installation automatisierter Verpackungssysteme bis hin zur Beaufsichtigung der allgemeinen Wartungsarbeiten eines Standorts sowie der Reparatur von für den Vertrieb wesentlichen Geräten wickelt unser Team einen Großteil der technischen Aufgaben bei Amazon ab. Unter anderem sorgt es auch dafür, dass Gebäude weiterhin den rechtlichen Auflagen entsprechen, damit alle sicher bleiben und unsere Standorte mit maximaler Effizienz betrieben werden. Es gibt zahlreiche Aufstiegschancen im RME-Team selbst ebenso wie im gesamten Amazon-Unternehmen.
Alle unsere Aktivitäten sind darauf ausgerichtet, die Ausfallzeiten an Amazons wichtigsten Betriebsstandorten zu reduzieren, damit Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen rechtzeitig erhalten. Oft arbeiten wir früh morgens, spät abends oder in der Nachtschicht, um Wartungsarbeiten mit den geringstmöglichen Störungen vorzunehmen. Falls wir eine bessere Möglichkeit finden, eine bestimmte Aufgabe zu erledigen, verfügen wir über die Fertigkeiten und Gelegenheiten, vollständig neue Prozesse oder bahnbrechende Technologie wie Amazon Robotics oder unseren Complex Item Sorter einzuführen.

title: Technical Infrastructure Project Manager - Networking, Network Deployment - Fulfilment Center Technology
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Network Deployment Services owns the planning, delivery, and lifecycle management of network infrastructure supporting Amazon's global fulfillment, transportation and grocery, sites. Our infrastructure enables reliable connectivity for Amazon's operations at scale and plays a critical role in supporting business growth, operational efficiency, and customer experience. The team is responsible for delivering network infrastructure programs across the full lifecycle, including hardware deployment, upgrades, capacity expansion, technology refresh, optimization, and decommissioning. We work closely with Engineering, Finance, Supply Chain, Field Deployment, Operations, and external vendors to deliver scalable, reliable, and cost-effective infrastructure solutions across Amazon's global network.
We are seeking a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager (TIPM) to lead large-scale network hardware deployment and lifecycle programs. The successful candidate will own program planning and execution, drive financial and commercial approvals, coordinate hardware procurement and field deployments, and ensure programs are delivered on time and within budget. This role requires strong program management fundamentals, the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, and experience delivering complex infrastructure programs across cross-functional teams.


Key job responsibilities
• Program Ownership and Execution: Own end-to-end planning and delivery of network hardware lifecycle programs, including technology refresh, infrastructure upgrades, capacity expansion, and hardware replacement. Manage multiple programs in parallel, ensuring delivery against agreed schedules, budgets, and business requirements.
• Financial Planning and Approvals: Partner with Finance and business stakeholders to develop project cost estimates, prepare and secure Capital Authorization Request (CAR) approvals, track budget utilization, and manage financial risks and changes throughout the program lifecycle.
• Vendor and Commercial Management: Work with hardware vendors, suppliers, and internal procurement teams to obtain quotes, negotiate pricing, evaluate commercial proposals, and drive cost-effective procurement while meeting program timelines and technical requirements.
• Project Planning and Deployment Coordination: Develop detailed project plans, milestones, resource requirements, and deployment schedules. Coordinate with field deployment teams, engineering teams, vendors, and site stakeholders to ensure hardware deployments are executed as planned and dependencies are addressed proactively.
• Risk and Dependency Management: Identify delivery risks, technical dependencies, resource constraints, and schedule deviations early. Establish mitigation plans, drive issue resolution, and escalate blockers to the appropriate stakeholders to protect committed timelines.
• Stakeholder Management and Communication: Build strong working relationships across Engineering, Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Field Deployment, Operations, and external vendors. Provide clear and regular program updates to stakeholders and senior leadership, highlighting progress, risks, financial status, and decisions required.
• Metrics and Operational Excellence: Establish scalable mechanisms to track program milestones, deployment progress, financial performance, vendor commitments, and delivery risks. Use metrics to improve visibility, identify bottlenecks, reduce deployment cycle times, and drive continuous improvement.
• Process Improvement and Standardization: Identify opportunities to simplify program execution, standardize deployment processes, improve planning accuracy, and reduce manual effort across hardware lifecycle programs. Develop repeatable mechanisms that support increased deployment volume and operational scale.

Basic qualifications

title: Senior Manager, Product Management, Technical, Enterprise Foundational AI
descriptionHtml:
Enterprise Foundational AI is changing how every Amazonian works by building AI products and scalable foundations that make knowledge workers measurably more productive. We are looking for a Senior Manager, Product Management – Technical to own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for a portfolio that includes Amazon Quick, AI model routing and orchestration optimization services, and foundational products that accelerate Amazon's shift to an AI-native product development lifecycle. In this role, you will lead a team of product managers and technical program managers through significant ambiguity, deciding which problems to solve, how to sequence investment, and when to pivot. You will partner with engineering, AWS product teams, and functional stakeholders in Security, Legal, and People Experience and Technology (PXT) to ship products that reach every major Amazon business unit. If you want to shape the AI tools that hundreds of thousands of Amazonians rely on every day, we would love to talk.

Key job responsibilities
- Define and communicate the multi-year product vision and strategy for Enterprise Foundational AI's portfolio, translating ambiguous internal customer needs into a prioritized roadmap that balances near-term delivery with long-term platform goals.
- Lead, coach, and grow a team of product managers and technical program managers, setting the hiring bar, developing future leaders, and building an inclusive team culture where people make sound decisions and deliver independently.
- Partner with engineering and applied science teams to develop functional and non-functional requirements, evaluate system design trade-offs around scalability and performance, and determine when to integrate generative AI capabilities to improve product quality and team productivity.
- Drive cross-functional alignment with AWS product teams, Security, Legal, PXT, and major Amazon business units by writing clear strategic narratives and presenting investment cases to senior leadership.
- Establish mechanisms to inspect product quality, operational performance, and the internal customer experience, proactively identifying risks and decomposing complex problems into actionable solutions that scale across the organization.

A day in the life
Your morning might start by reviewing a product narrative from one of your direct reports, sharpening the customer problem statement before a working session with engineering on AI model orchestration trade-offs. After lunch you lead a roadmap prioritization discussion, helping the team weigh competing signals from business units against resource constraints. Later you prepare a strategic update for senior leadership, distilling progress on Amazon Quick adoption into a concise, data-informed story that frames the path forward.

About the team
Enterprise Foundational AI builds the products, layers, and services that put trusted generative AI in the hands of every Amazonian. The team's portfolio spans Amazon Quick, AI model routing and orchestration, and foundational capabilities that are accelerating Amazon's AI-native transformation. As the investment in AI-native products continues to grow, the team is expanding. You will manage product managers and technical program managers, partnering closely with AWS product teams and cross-functional stakeholders across Security, Legal, and PXT. If you are excited about building AI products at a scale few organizations can match, this is the team for you.

- 6+ years of team management experience
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience overseeing roadmap strategy and definition throughout the product life cycle from concept to end of lifecycle

title: HR Partner, Human Resource
descriptionHtml:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People eXperience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. The HR Partner role offers an exceptional opportunity to build your career in human resources, focusing on employee experience, engagement, leadership development and HR operational excellence.

As an HR Partner on the PXT team, you will support PXT operations through consistent standard work execution, relationship-building, and timely issue resolution. With a visible presence across site operations, you'll foster team culture, support engagement, and coach leaders on PXT practices. You'll create positive employee experiences while building your skills in navigating increasingly complex issues and influencing without authority. Success in this role comes from building strong partnerships, demonstrating sound judgment, and maintaining a customer-centric approach. You'll learn to use data-driven insights and HR technologies to enhance the employee experience while developing core HR capabilities that will serve as the foundation for your career growth.

You will be expected to work onsite at an Amazon facility.

Key job responsibilities
- Support a positive employee experience by executing key programs, reinforcing workplace standards, and partnering with PXT and Operations to create a culture where employees feel valued, heard, and supported.

- Execute standard work with consistent quality and timeliness, meeting established service level agreements (SLAs) and maintaining accurate documentation of HR processes and employee interactions.

- Provide frontline employee support by responding to inquiries, addressing concerns, and ensuring appropriate resolution or escalation of employee matters. Handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.

A day in the life
A typical day involves balancing standard work execution with responsive employee support. title: Senior Financial Analyst, AWS Regions Finance
descriptionHtml:
Join our team as a Senior Financial Analyst to support the fast-growing AWS Dedicated Cloud business. As part of the Regions Finance team, you'll drive strategic financial planning and analysis for AWS Infrastructure. This role offers the unique opportunity to own CAPEX planning for an entire region, with visibility across the entire P&L. You'll leverage your financial expertise to influence leadership business decisions and support long-term growth initiatives. This role works to understand the financial impact of high-level business trends (such as customer adoption, GenAI capacity planning, etc.) and synthesize insights to provide the business strategic financial analysis.

Your strong problem-solving skills and leadership communication will be essential as you partner with senior leadership to develop financial frameworks that enable data-driven decision making. You'll analyze complex data sets, identify strategic opportunities, and provide valuable insights that shape the direction of the business. This role is ideal for a finance professional looking to develop into a general finance manager with significant business impact.

Key job responsibilities
- Own financial reporting for AWS Public Sector infrastructure, developing analyses and narratives that support operational and growth business decisions with senior leadership

- Build and maintain comprehensive financial models to support CAPEX analysis to drive strategic long-term value

- Communicate frequently and effectively with business leaders, using timely and accurate financials to help make business decisions

- Independently align financial and operational analyses with business partners, challenging assumptions when necessary and providing recommendations that influence data-driven decision making.

- Identify opportunities and implement large-scale financial solutions to proactively resolve finance issues, improve scalability, and simplify finance tools and processes across teams.

- Dive deep to ensure reporting accuracy and compliance with internal and external policies while promoting strong controllership principles.


A day in the life
In this dynamic role, you'll find yourself tackling strategic financial problems that directly impact business performance. Rather than following a routine, you'll prioritize what's most important each day—whether that's developing financial models for new initiatives, collaborating with leadership on investment decisions, or analyzing P&L components to identify optimization opportunities. You'll leverage data to influence cross-functional partners and present financial insights that drive meaningful business outcomes.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field
- 4+ years of applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses experience
- 3+ years of finance, accounting, or related analytical field experience
- 4+ years of creating process improvements with automation and analysis experience
- 4+ years of identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes experience
- Experience with advanced use of SQL for data mining and business intelligence
- Can meet export control requirements by being a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum
- Due to the nature of work performed, this position requires that the selected candidate be able to obtain a Security Clearance and thus be a U.S. citizen.

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
- MBA, or CPA
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
