descriptionHtml:
The Frontier AI Assets (FAI) team is looking for a passionate, talented, and inventive Principal Applied Scientist with a strong deep learning and reinforcement learning background to build the training and evaluation assets that advance frontier Generative AI (GenAI) with Large Language Models (LLMs).

AI models become more capable largely because of the learning environments, the RL gyms, in which they are trained. FAI builds those gyms and the platform that certifies them, so that model training teams across Amazon can rely on high-quality, graded assets. As a Principal on this team, you will set the technical direction for how these gyms and the tooling around them are built, evaluated, and scaled.


Key job responsibilities
As a Principal Applied Scientist with FAI, you will:

•Set technical direction across data collection, sampling, and evaluation for RL gyms focused on agentic tool use across a range of real-world domains.
•Design and lead experiments that produce reliable, efficient signal on what drives model improvement.
•Build gym-building tooling and automated quality control that scale with demand.
•Advance the science of how gyms are evaluated and validated before they're used in model training.
•Act as a hands-on technical leader: produce exemplary, high-quality assets yourself, and audit and support more junior scientists and engineers.
•Partner closely with domain experts and cross-functional teams, turning real-world problems into challenging, high-value tasks.
•Lead scientific reviews, scrutinize experimental design and verification, probe assumptions, and align teams toward coherent strategies. Contribute to hiring, mentorship, and the development of other scientists.


About the team
The FAI team has the mission to push the envelope in GenAI with LLMs, in order to provide the best-possible experience for our customers. We build frontier training and evaluation assets, RL gyms and the certification platform behind them, that directly shape how Amazon's models are trained and improved. We value scientific depth, hands-on building, and turning research into measurable impact at scale.

Basic qualifications

- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field; or Master's degree with significant additional applied research experience.
- Strong hands-on experience building machine learning models and systems for real-world applications, with deep learning and neural methods.
- Experience with reinforcement learning and/or building RL gyms, learning environments, or agentic tool-use systems.
- Experience setting technical direction across data, modeling, and evaluation, and dealing with ambiguity and competing objectives.
- Experience leading experienced scientists/engineers and developing more junior members.

Preferred qualifications

- 10+ years of relevant work in industry or academia experience
- Experience building automated evaluation, quality-control, or verification tooling for training data or environments.
- Experience with agentic tool use and improving the capabilities of LLMs (for example multi-step, tool-using agents).
- Track record of creating novel algorithms and advancing the state of the art; peer-reviewed contributions in premier journals and conferences.
- Experience with large-scale distributed training/compute and modern ML frameworks.

title: Power Settlements Manager, AWS Energy Procurement Operations
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about energy? Do you want to be part of a growing energy team working on exciting projects across the world that will have a lasting impact on AWS?

Amazon is seeking a results-oriented individual contributor Power Settlements Manager to lead and scale our global energy settlement operations across our renewable and data center energy portfolio. In this role, you will establish, audit, and continuously improve settlement processes and controls to ensure accurate validation of transactions (e.g. renewable project invoices, utility bills etc.) in a diverse and large energy portfolio. You will be the accountable owner of settlement validation activities — interpreting and translating complex contractual and tariff language, executing validation processes, driving dispute resolution, ensuring timely payments, and managing compliance controls across a large and growing volume of transactions. The ideal candidate is a builder and a doer who brings deep experience in PPA settlement structures, utility billing frameworks across diverse regulatory environments, ISO/RTO and non-market energy settlement, and global market exposure across APAC, EMEA, and AMER.

As a senior member of the team, you will train, mentor, and exercise oversight over junior team members while owning the most complex settlements in the portfolio. You will think strategically and tactically to identify simplification opportunities, close control gaps, and build robust processes, business intelligence, and reporting capabilities. We are looking for a strong program builder; someone who is a culture carrier who can hold the team accountable; and someone that has a proven track record of standing up settlement operations from the ground up.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead power settlement for our portfolio of renewable and utility agreements, including invoice and bill validation, reconciliations, dispute resolution, payments, and compliance controls.

- Establish, audit, and continuously improve settlement processes and controls to ensure accurate, compliant, and scalable settlement validation practices.

- Interpret and translate contractual and tariff language, matching them with energy market understanding to execute settlement processes.

- Train, mentor, and exercise oversight over junior team members' work as the accountable owner of settlement validation activities

- Support end-of-month financial close and controllership reporting, including performance analysis and business impact assessments across business units and customers

- Partner with tech and product teams to advance settlement automation capabilities and drive further scale across Amazon's energy portfolio

- Plan and execute operational improvement initiatives, continuously identifying simplification opportunities and closing control gaps

title: Senior Product Manager, Serverless Compute
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Serverless Compute team. Our team owns the products that make it radically easier for builders to build scalable, reliable, and intelligent cloud applications without managing infrastructure. Our portfolio includes some of the most widely adopted services in cloud computing: AWS Lambda, AWS Step Functions, Amazon EventBridge, and AWS Elastic Beanstalk. Together, these services power millions of customer workloads, from event-driven architectures and workflow orchestration to full application deployment. Our latest innovations are defining how customers build complex, multi-step, AI-native applications on AWS, including durable execution for AI agents and next-generation compute primitives.

We're looking for a product manager who is passionate about solving customer problems and has demonstrated success in turning ambiguous customer needs into successful products. In this role, you will help evolve our serverless services by delivering new capabilities and intuitive developer experiences that make it easier to build applications without becoming an expert in distributed systems. If you're excited by cloud computing and have a deep-rooted passion for the evolution of computing and application development platforms, we want to talk to you.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will be a critical part of the PM organization that owns the business model and P&L, prioritization of the product roadmap, customer segmentation and pricing, and demand generation for impactful new products. You will work across engineering, business development, and marketing leads to set strategy, define the product, and make high-judgment trade-offs between features and time-to-market. You will partner with technical leaders to ensure the programming model, scalability and reliability promises, and developer experience delight our customers. You will also play a key role in hiring additional team members and helping set the vision and culture of this business.

The breadth of this role is what makes it unique. Depending on your interests and strengths, you could find yourself working on event-driven architectures that connect and integrate cloud-native systems at scale, workflow orchestration and durable execution for AI agents and distributed applications, or developer experiences that make building, deploying, and governing serverless applications effortless.

Key job responsibilities
- Define and prioritize the product roadmap for your service area, translating customer needs into clear requirements and making transparent trade-offs between scope, quality, and delivery timelines.
- Drive product development end-to-end across engineering, operations, business development, and marketing — from authoring business requirements and functional specifications through design, implementation, and launch.
- Engage directly with external customers and partners to understand their technical challenges, validate assumptions through usability studies and market research, and turn those insights into product decisions that improve adoption and satisfaction.
- Evaluate industry innovations, technology platforms, and generative AI capabilities to identify opportunities that strengthen our serverless portfolio and keep it ahead of customer expectations.
- Mentor and coach other product managers on best practices while actively participating in recruiting efforts to grow the team.

A day in the life
Your morning might start by reviewing service metrics and customer feedback to identify emerging patterns, then shifting into a design review with engineers where you weigh architectural trade-offs for an upcoming feature. After lunch you could be running a customer call to validate a new API design, followed by a working session with marketing to refine messaging for an upcoming launch. You'll balance focused solo time such as writing product requirements, analyzing competitive data, and refining your roadmap with collaborative sessions that keep engineering, design, and business teams aligned on what to build next.

About the team
We are a core part of the AWS Serverless Compute organization with team members in Vancouver, Seattle, and Dublin. Together, we work as one team spanning Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, and Elastic Beanstalk. Our shared mission is to make it radically easier for developers to build scalable, reliable, and intelligent cloud applications without managing infrastructure.

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we are building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, document reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and take on more complex challenges over time.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of technical product management with internet business experience
- 5+ years of working as a Technical Product Manager experience

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary.

As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis.

The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
Work in an environment where the noise level varies
Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Current valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification by an approved emergency cardiac care (ECC) provider; AND must have one of the following:
- Current valid Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) OR Paramedic Certification from the Department of Health OR the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT); OR
- Current active Athletic Trainer Certification, by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification.

Preferred qualifications

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program

title: Risk Manager II, Continuous Improvement, Relay Product Excellence
descriptionHtml:
Want to own how an organization gets better at what it does? Relay Product Excellence (RPE) protects Customers, Carriers, Drivers, and Amazon globally through fast-paced investigation and analytics, and we need an owner for the Continuous Improvement pillar within our Strategic Programs and Organizational eXcellence (SPOX) team. This is hands-on process work: you'll map how work actually flows today, standardize it into clear Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and build the documentation that makes the right way the easy way.

In this role, you'll own the Continuous Improvement pillar end to end, help shape the direction for how SPOX raises quality, consistency, and efficiency across a growing portfolio of risk and investigation initiatives. You'll build the mechanisms that find process gaps, size the opportunity, and drive improvements to closure, then institutionalize them so gains stick. You'll define what "good" looks like for execution standards and operating rhythms, and you'll measure whether the organization is actually getting better over time.

Because improvements are driven across risk operations, you'll need to be versed in risk or investigations, enough to read the work, spot where the real opportunities are, and partner credibly with the functional subject matter experts across RPE who run it. You'll partner closely with the Program Delivery, Special Programs, and Workforce Intelligence & Strategic Planning pillars to embed continuous improvement into how work gets delivered day to day. The ideal candidate brings strong communication skills, attention to detail, and a data-driven mindset, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders, earn trust across partner teams, and drive change independently in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys the craft of process mapping, standardization, and documentation.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the Continuous Improvement pillar within SPOX end to end, partnering with SPOX leader to set its roadmap, define its mechanisms, and measure its impact on quality, consistency, and efficiency across the organization.

- Identify process gaps and improvement opportunities, size them with data, and drive them to closure, then institutionalize the changes so gains are sustained.

- Map current-state processes end to end, standardize them into clear Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and build and maintain the documentation (process maps, runbooks, work instructions) that keeps execution consistent and audit-ready across the organization.

- Apply working knowledge of risk or investigations to identify where the biggest improvement opportunities sit, and partner effectively with functional subject matter experts across RPE to drive continuous improvement across risk operations.

- Define and raise execution standards for how programs are delivered, embedding continuous improvement into mechanisms within the operating rhythm (Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs) and Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs)) and OP planning cycle.

- Partner with the Program Delivery and Special Programs pillars under SPOX to translate improvement opportunities into delivered change across cross-functional initiatives with org-wide impact.

- Influence stakeholders through data-driven insights, written narratives, and clear recommendations.

- Operate with high integrity and discretion, handling sensitive data in compliance with Amazon's data classification and privacy policies.

A day in the life
In this role, you'll work through ambiguity regularly, reviewing program health metrics, spotting where the organization can get better, and prioritizing the improvements that matter most. While you own the strategy and roadmap for the pillar, the core of your week at the working level is hands-on process work: sitting with SMEs to map how a process actually works, turning that into a standardized SOP, and documenting it so it holds up over time. You'll drive alignment across RPE teams through influence, not authority, translating data into clear narratives for stakeholders to reach alignment and buy-in.

About the team
Middle Mile Transportation Technology moves millions of packages across Amazon's network daily, and Relay Product Excellence (RPE) ensures those systems stay protected. We sit at the intersection of product and operations, building programs that close gaps where automation hasn't yet reached. Our program managers, analysts, and investigators deliver rapid-cycle investigation and analytics that safeguard Customers, Carriers, Drivers, and Amazon globally.

Within RPE, the Strategic Programs and Organizational eXcellence (SPOX) team is the connective tissue, spanning Program Delivery, Escalations, Team Growth, Continuous Improvement, and Special Programs. SPOX owns the program management frameworks, milestone governance, execution methodology, and operating rhythms that give teams structure to move fast. We don't support delivery; we set the standard.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent experience
- Experience establishing successful partnerships with internal and external teams to execute tactical initiatives or equivalent
- Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis
- Experience with data analysis tools such as Excel, Pivot Tables, macros, SQL, visualization tools - Tableau, Quicksight, etc.
- Experience owning program or process improvement end to end and communicating results to stakeholders
- Experience creating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process maps, and process documentation

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment, or experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects
- Experience in data interpretation and analysis to influence stakeholders
- Experience owning or leading a continuous improvement function, program, or methodology (for example Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen)
- Experience standardizing processes at scale through SOP development, process mapping, and documentation (for example BPMN, value stream mapping, or equivalent)

title: Sr. Technical Program Mgr., Robotics & Innovation - AMZL
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Logistics (AMZL) is on a mission to build the most advanced last-mile delivery network in the world. Our Central Engineering – Robotics & Innovation team is at the forefront of this transformation, developing and deploying automation and robotic systems that power delivery stations across North America and beyond. Our objective is to fully automate our Delivery Stations, achieving zero-touch unit-to-recipient (UTR) operations end-to-end.
We are seeking an experienced, innovative, and customer-obsessed Technical Program Manager to drive the end-to-end lifecycle of robotics and automation programs — from early ideation and concept validation through large-scale field deployment and performance ramp-up. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role that combines strategic program leadership with deep technical engagement across robotics, mechatronics, controls, and software disciplines.
If you thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and want to make a measurable difference in how Amazon delivers to customers — come help us make history.


Key job responsibilities
Own end-to-end program management for robotics and automation initiatives across the AMZL delivery station network - scope, schedule, cost, risk, and performance.
Lead cross-functional teams spanning hardware engineering, software development, controls, operations, RME, process engineering, and external vendors to deliver integrated robotic solutions at scale.
Drive the full technology lifecycle: ideation to concept design to prototyping to pilot validation to GA deployment to continuous performance improvement.
Define pilot criteria, success metrics, and GO/NO-GO frameworks for new automation technologies entering the AMZL network.
Develop and maintain detailed deployment plans, including critical path scheduling, resource planning, and sequencing, validated through simulation and modeling tools.
Author business cases and strategic narratives for introducing new automation to the delivery station network; present to Director- and VP-level audiences.
Capture voice-of-the-customer directly from field operations (Ops, Maintenance, ACES, Process Engineering, Associates) and translate insights into actionable engineering and roadmap improvements.
Partner with BI and Data Engineering teams to establish KPI frameworks and performance visibility dashboards for deployed robotic systems.
Drive continuous improvement across deployment cycle time, system reliability, and operational throughput, identifying bottlenecks and delivering measurable efficiency gains.
Lead technical design reviews; propose and influence solution architectures for robotic cells, autonomous vehicles, material handling, and sortation systems.
Manage contractor and vendor relationships; ensure delivery commitments are met to quality, timeline, and cost targets.
Lead value engineering initiatives to minimize CAPEX while maintaining performance standards.
Travel 25-50% to delivery stations and partner sites across North America for field validation, deployment support, and stakeholder engagement.


A day in the life
Your day could start with a technical design review for a robotic induction system being piloted at in delivery station, shift to a vendor alignment call on a mechatronics integration timeline, and end with drafting a VP-level narrative on program status for a quarterly business review. You are the connective tissue between the engineers building the future of AMZL and the operators running it today - making sure what we invent actually works at Amazon scale, safely and reliably.
It's always Day 1.



About the team
The Robotics and Innovation team within AMZL Central Engineering develops and deploys automation solutions that drive our objective of fully automated, zero-touch unit-to-recipient (UTR) delivery-station operations, eliminating manual risk and unlocking throughput at scale. We are part of the Worldwide (WW) AMZL team, partnering closely with peer Robotics and Innovation organizations across geographies to share technology, standards, and best practices.
We are a set of diverse individuals who work coherently to solve customer problems with the most innovative solutions. We put heavy emphasis on empowering our employees to maintain work life harmony. The team works with innovative technologies in the market to bring into AMZL to solve complex technical problems. It is a fine balance between working on writing strategic business cases to understanding the deep human machine interfaces.

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- Experience managing complex, cross-functional programs involving robotics, automation, mechatronics, or industrial hardware systems
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition end-to-end
- Experience working directly with engineering teams (hardware, software, controls) through the full product development lifecycle
- Experience managing vendors, contractors, and external technology partners

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

title: SCIF Accreditation Analyst, US Amazon Dedicated Cloud Security
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Security team is looking for a SCIF Accreditation Analyst to help deliver the accredited classified space. Accreditation is on the critical path, and we need someone who can navigate ICD 705 and the accreditation authority with equal parts rigor and urgency.

In this role you develop and maintain the Fixed Facility and TEMPEST Checklists and accreditation package, coordinate with the Government accreditation authority and the certified TEMPEST technical authority on construction security and countermeasures, and track accreditation status, findings, and reaccreditation actions. You will work with physical security, construction security specialists, and our Government counterparts to take classified space from design to accredited and keep it that way. If you like owning the details that unlock everything else, this role is for you.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and maintain the ICD 705 Fixed Facility Checklist and accreditation package.
- Coordinate with the Government AO and CTTA on construction security and TEMPEST requirements.
- Track accreditation status, findings, and reaccreditation actions.
- Support construction surveillance and physical-security documentation.
- Collaborate with internal teams, general contractors, architects and engineers prior to and during facility builds to ensure government build compliance.
- Able to read and understand construction details and drawings that capture government requirements and standards.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of physical/SCIF security or accreditation experience.
- Working knowledge of ICD 705 and SCIF construction/accreditation standards.
- Experience preparing accreditation documentation.
- Current, active US Government Security Clearance of TS/SCI with Polygraph

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with Government SCIF accreditation and CTTA coordination.
- TEMPEST or technical-security background.
- ICD 705 practitioner training.

title: Risk Specialist I, EAP
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Worldwide Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP) team is responsible for ensuring that Amazon's global operation is the benchmark for environmental excellence across all similar industries. EAP transforms environmental regulatory compliance into a zero-defect process through simple, scalable, and sustainable solutions that protect the business, our communities, and the environment.

The Risk Specialist I drives regulated waste compliance across the 2-4 sites they support. This specialist executes the organization's environmental compliance plans at the site level, tracks waste compliance obligations to closure, and partners with site and operations teams to meet compliance milestones. They conduct site inspections, maintain hazardous waste accumulation and manifesting records, and surface gaps through regular program controls.

The ideal candidate brings working knowledge of regulated waste requirements, including RCRA, DOT, and applicable state hazardous waste rules. They communicate technical compliance requirements clearly to site leaders, operations partners, and legal stakeholders, and use data to find gaps, prioritize fixes, and improve conformance across their sites.

This role requires sound independent judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to run the right mechanisms and manage competing priorities to meet compliance objectives in a dynamic, high-pace operations environment. If you are motivated by solving regulatory compliance problems in the field, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the execution and delivery of regulated waste compliance projects and activities, including developing standard operating procedures, workflows, and inspection routines, to mitigate identified risks across the sites you support.
- Apply risk management methods such as waste compliance audits and site inspections to monitor compliance thresholds, test controls, and take corrective action when findings arise.
- Collaborate with site teams, compliance operations, and operations partners to understand business needs, clarify waste compliance requirements, and drive productive discussions that build consensus.
- Identify process improvement opportunities and work with process owners to improve conformance, reduce risk, and increase operational efficiency.
- Prepare clear and concise documentation, including status reports, audit results, metrics, and project communications, so the right information reaches the right audience at the right time.
- Travel expected up to 50% of the time.

A day in the life
Your morning might begin by reviewing incoming risk-related requests and prioritizing your project tasks. You will spend time conducting audits or risk assessments, updating documentation, and coordinating with compliance operations and partner teams. Throughout the day, you will track project milestones, resolve roadblocks, and communicate progress to stakeholders. You will also look for ways to streamline existing processes and ensure your risk area stays aligned with current regulations and team objectives.

About the team
Our team is dedicated to protecting Amazon's customers and business by proactively managing risk across a broad range of areas, from regulatory compliance to operational resilience. We work closely with legal, operations, and business partners to deliver practical risk solutions and build a strong culture of compliance. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and creative problem-solving, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where every team member can grow and make an impact.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) or related field
- 2+ years of experience in environmental compliance, regulated waste management, or workplace risk investigations
- Experience interpreting and applying environmental regulations (RCRA, DOT, and applicable state hazardous waste rules)
- Experience collecting and analyzing data to identify compliance gaps and drive corrective actions

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
- 4+ years of compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent experience
- Experience managing a regulated waste program across multiple sites, including hazardous waste accumulation, manifesting, and disposal
- Hazardous waste certification such as RCRA or DOT (49 CFR) training, or 40-hour HAZWOPER
- Experience conducting site audits or inspections and tracking findings to closure
- Master's degree in Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) or related field

title: シフトアシスタント
descriptionHtml:
※このポジションの勤務地は福岡県粕屋郡を予定しています。

私たちのグローバルオペレーションネットワークは、日々何百万もの荷物と笑顔をアマゾンのお客様にお届けしています。私たちは、シフトアシスタントとして私たちのチームに加わってほしいと考え、意欲的で顧客重視の人材を探しています。この役割では他業種・職種も含めこれまでの経験、スキルを活かし、改善点を模索しながら、より便利でお客様に満足いただける高い品質のサービスを提供できるビジネスをつくる事、安全・快適・楽しい職場環境の構築を行う、将来の組織のリーダーを目指していただける事を期待しています。また、お客様の注文が適切な時間に適切な場所へ確実に配送されるよう、お客様の期待に応えることにおいても重要な役割を担います。

私たちの業務の流れには3つの主要な要素があります。
商品が保管され注文に備える「ファーストマイル」、注文品をお客様のエリアまで輸送する「ミドルマイル」、そして商品をお客様の玄関先までお届けする「ラストマイル」です。各拠点で運営方法に若干の違いはありますが、一貫して変わらないものが一つあります、それは顧客を第一に考える私たちのビジョンと献身的な姿勢です。

本ポジションはアマゾンの新しいエキサイティングな配送拠点で業務を行います。可能な限り最速でお客様のご自宅に商
品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！


■業務内容■
具体的にはマネージャーのサポートのもと、以下の業務に責任をもち遂行いただきます。

① 安全・品質・作業効率の向上
安全安心な作業環境の維持・向上のため、日々の安全活動、品質チェックに加え、標準作業手順書の作成や多岐にわたる問題解決・改善活動を行います。

② 日々のオペレーション対応
商品を入荷、在庫として管理し、注文があった商品を出荷するという一連の流れを各工程間で連携をとりながら、業務を円滑に進める事が求められます。お客様とお約束した期日までに商品を迅速かつ正確にお届けするため、時間ごとの計画に沿ってオペレーションを実施することに責任を持ちます。

③ 新規プロジェクトの導入・セール時など、オペレーション拡大時の準備
新しいサービスやシステムの導入に備え、現場での手順変更・導入方法を検討し円滑な導入に向けて準備を行います。また、新規入職者でもAmazonの標準作業に則った手順がスムーズに身につくためのトレーニング構築やマニュアルを作成します。

④ イレギュラーへの対応
作業で発生する様々な課題の原因を追求し問題解決を行います。また、再発防止策案の検討、実施を行います。
※上記業務はマネージャーやチームのサポートのもと実施していただきます
※配送ステーション内での配送を通じて、物流の仕組みやマネジメントについて学ぶことができます
※社内公募により、マネージャーへのキャリアアップや他部署への異動機会もあります
※勤務は交代制（夜勤あり）です
※1日の流れ：以下ページをご参照ください。
先輩社員インタビュー

■福利厚生■
下記ページをご確認ください。
福利厚生 | アマゾンジャパンキャリアサイト

■教育制度■
入社後、約1週間はAmazonのリーダーとして必要な会社のカルチャーや、配送拠点の基本的な業務を一通り学ぶことができる座学の機会を提供します。各部署へ配属後は、トレーナーのもと、OJTで工程知識やツールの使用方法など基礎知識を学んでいきます。トレーニング資料も完備しており、相互に進捗を確認しながら独り立ちまでしっかりとサポートしますので、未経験者も安心してスタートができる環境です。
最先端の物流システムを学ぶことはもちろん、年齢・性別・国籍問わず様々な仲間と日々の業務を通して、次のステップとなるピープルマネージメントやビジネススキルを学ぶことができます。

■キャリアパス■
シフトアシスタントからキャリアをスタートし、チームマネージャー、統括マネージャー、そして配送拠点の拠点長となった実績も多数あります。また、Amazonでは社内公募制度があり、国内外問わず他部署や異なる職種への異動にチャレンジし、社内で多様なキャリアを築くチャンスもあります。Amazonではご自身で学び成長することを推奨し、キャリア開発できるようサポートを行っています。

title: Senior Solutions Architect
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about helping customers solve complex technical challenges? Do you thrive at the intersection of business strategy and technology? As a Solutions Architect at Amazon, you will partner directly with customers to design and deliver solutions that address their most pressing needs — from reducing costs and mitigating risk to launching new products and transforming legacy platforms. You will bring together technical depth, creative problem-solving, and strong communication skills to guide customers through their technology journey. This role offers the opportunity to work across a broad range of technical domains, influence long-term technology strategies, and make a measurable impact on customer outcomes.

Key job responsibilities
- Design end-to-end customer solutions that are extensible, secure, reliable, cost-optimized, and performant, shepherding those solutions through the full implementation lifecycle.
- Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, building relationships with senior leaders and ensuring their short-term technology decisions align with long-term business goals.
- Lead technical solution discussions, diving into design choices, best practices, and use cases while proactively identifying and mitigating risks or overly complex approaches.
- Develop and deliver thought leadership content such as presentations, workshops, blog posts, and sample code that educates customers on technology strategy and best practices.
- Gather and translate customer feedback into clear business and technical requirements for product and engineering teams, helping to shape new products, features, and service improvements.

A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing customer architectures and preparing for solution design sessions. Much of your time is spent collaborating with customers to understand their business context, whiteboarding solution options, and evaluating trade-offs. You will also partner with internal teams across sales, engineering, and professional services to ensure the right expertise is brought to each engagement. Between customer interactions, you may be refining a workshop you are delivering next week or contributing a reusable reference design that helps fellow architects accelerate their work.

About the team
Our team is dedicated to helping customers achieve meaningful business outcomes through well-architected technology solutions. We operate in a collaborative, inclusive environment where curiosity is encouraged and knowledge-sharing is a daily practice. Whether mentoring teammates, contributing to strategic planning, or speaking at industry events, you will find opportunities to grow your skills and broaden your impact. If you are excited about working with customers to turn complex challenges into elegant solutions, we would love to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
- Knowledge of SAP systems (like SAP Business Suite, S/4HANA, SAP Business Warehouse, SAP HANA, SAP Business Objects, etc.) and their architecture and infrastructure needs
- Experience working with end user or developer communities
- Experience managing relationships with SAP customers and partners
- Experience in SAP S/4HANA, SAP Cloud Platform, SAP Cloud ERP and Cloud ERP Private
- Experience in SAP clean core design concepts, including design and build using non-SAP technologies in domains such as Generative / Agentic AI, and data & analytics

title: Data Center Technical Support Engineering Operations Engineer, BJS - DCEO
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services Infrastructure Services team provides comprehensive technical support throughout the design, planning, delivery, and operation of Amazon Web Services infrastructure. We support data centers and the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure the customers of Amazon Web Services have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations technical support managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across Amazon and our operating partners to help Amazon Web Services deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for the customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Facility Engineer will be responsible for providing technical support to Data Center Engineering Operations within data centers including risk management and mitigation, corrective and preventative maintenance of data center infrastructure, vendor management and metric reporting.
基础设施技术支持主要负责支持数据中心的基础设施运维，包括对设施/系统存在的风险进行管理，提出缓解措施和改造方案，以及日常的基础设施的维护，供应商的管理，数据的整理归档汇报等。

Key job responsibilities
· Provide technical support for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
· Provide technical support for performance benchmarks establishment, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all aspects of the data center facility infrastructure operations and maintenance.
· Generate change management requests & incident management tickets for DCEO activities.
· Work with DCO managers (IT) and other business leaders and operating partners to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability, sustainability and efficiency.
· Establish documentation relevant to technical support of business & facility operations.
· Responsible for supporting the installation of the racks and the provision of power/cooling.
· Support the COLO management of both routine maintenance and emergency services on a variety of essential systems such as: switchgear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, etc.
· Assist in the design, implementation, commissioning and build out of new facilities.
· Drive & implement projects to increase current facility capacity, efficiency, sustainability & reliability.
· Assist in recruiting efforts.
· Support operating partners in the resolution of any infrastructure engineering issues.
· This role might involve covering 24x7 shift rotation

岗位职责：
• 为承包商、分包商和供应商的现场管理提供技术支持，确保所有工作符合既定流程、程序和当地法律。
• 支持建立执行标准，对数据中心基础设施的运维和维护各个方面进行分析并撰写报告。
• 为数据中心的日常工作创建变更管理请求和事件管理工单。
• 与DCO经理（IT）和其他部门主管以及现场IDC服务运营商合作，协调完成项目，管理站点容量，优化站点安全性，可用性，可靠性，可持续性和效率。
• 撰写，创建与业务和设施运维的技术支持相关的文件。
• 负责支持机柜的安装和机柜供电，供冷。
• 支持COLO（Co-Location，现场提供IDC服务的运营商）的日常常规维护和数据中心基本系统的紧急服务，如：开关柜，柴油发电机，UPS系统，配电设备，冷机，冷塔，精密空调，楼宇监控系统等。
• 协助新数据中心/机房的设计，实施，调试和建设。
• 推动并实施项目，以提高现有设施的产能，效率，可持续性和可靠性。
• 协助招聘工作。
• 支持运维合作伙伴解决运维中遇到技术问题。
• 可能参与轮换倒班以支持24x7的工作需求。


About the team
About Amazon Web Services
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Web Services values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why Amazon Web Services?
Amazon Web Services is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. Amazon Web Services pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust Amazon Web Services’ robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
Amazon Web Services values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or 2+ years of relevant discipline work experience
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Fundamental knowledge of network design and layout as well as low voltage (copper/ fiber) cabling.
- High/Low Voltage electrician’s license.

title: Area Manager, Amazon Logistics
descriptionHtml:
※このポジションの勤務地は東京都板橋区を予定しています。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

私たちは数億という膨大な商品を取り扱っており、多くのサプライヤーから入荷したアイテムはフルフィルメントセンターという物流拠点に集約され、各地のデリバリーステーション（DS）を経てお客様先に届けられます。
エリアマネージャーには、膨大な数の商品を効率的かつスムーズにお届けするための出荷計画や配送ルートの立案・管理などをお任せします。

現在、私たちは物流網を拡大すべくDSの全国展開に注力中。Amazonの重要拠点で物流を進化させる新規ビジネスに携わる。
そんな挑みがいのあるミッションに、あなたの経験を活かしてみませんか。

Key job responsibilities
■配送管理
入荷した商品の仕分け・出荷作業および配送ルートの計画を立案します。
“どのアイテムを、いつ、何人で仕分けするか”、“どの地域に、どのような順番で配送するか”などをプランニングします。
全体の作業・人員計画はシニアエリアマネージャーが行います。連携をしっかり取り、仕分けや配送などが滞りなく進む計画を立てます。
■シフト・勤怠・作業管理
仕分けや出荷、配送などを担うスタッフの管理業務です。
人員は数十名。
物流量に合わせてシフトを組むほか、業務がスムーズに進捗しているかなどを管理します。
シフト調整を担当するアシスタントスタッフ（3～4名）と連携し、状況把握や指示出しなどを行います。
業務管理は社内システムで行います。
■業務改善
安全・品質・生産性向上や業務効率化などを実現するための業務です。
業務フローや業務環境、作業内容などにおける問題を見つけ、改善案やその実施計画を立案します。
シニアエリアマネージャーとは定期的に業務改善のミーティングをするため、積極的に意見を出しあいます。

A day in the life
※勤務は土日祝/夜勤勤務を含むシフト勤務になります。

title: Business Analyst, Global Supply Chain & Transportation Procurement
descriptionHtml:
As a Business Analyst within the Global Supply Chain and Transportation Procurement (GSCTP) organization, you will drive data-driven insights across transportation spend analytics and procurement optimization. This role combines deep analytical capabilities with strategic sourcing expertise to optimize transportation costs, improve operational efficiency, and support procurement decisions across all transportation modes.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead strategic transportation procurement initiatives including RFP analysis, bid optimization, and rate card development while providing data-driven insights for carrier negotiations.
- Analyse complex transportation spend data and market conditions across modes to identify cost savings opportunities, spending patterns, and develop strategic sourcing recommendations.
- Design, build and maintain automated dashboards and scorecards tracking key performance metrics including carrier compliance, service levels, and contract performance.
- Partner with procurement teams to optimize carrier selection and lane assignments, translating complex analytical findings into actionable recommendations.
- Support leadership decision-making through deep-dive analysis of transportation trends, market dynamics, and operational performance metrics.

About the team
GSCTP is a global team responsible for procurement related activities which include supporting and/or leading small to large scale sourcing events and contract negotiations. Works closely with internal stakeholders to understand business requirements and to ensure that all supplier related activities meet cost, capacity and service goals.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
- Experience with SQL or ETL
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field
- Knowledge of and proficiency in Excel and SQL
- Experience demonstrating strong analytical abilities and confidence in the use of data
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using very large datasets
- Experience with AI/ML technologies
- Knowledge of data visualization tools such as Quick Sight, Tableau, Power BI or other BI packages
- Experience in data analysis and reporting
- Experience in transportation operations and industry knowledge

title: Staff Pharmacist , Amazon Pharmacy
descriptionHtml:
Innovation is at the core of what we do. We believe that by removing and reducing the barriers that
prevent people from taking their medications, we can help customers conveniently get the
medications they need, when they need them and take them as prescribed. We have provided
customers with the ability to find transparent and simple pricing, receive 24/7 customer service
support, and have their meds delivered to their doorsteps while creating programs and products
that embody our mission and position ourselves in becoming the world’s safest and fastest online
pharmacy.

We are looking for a Staff Pharmacist to join us on our journey to make it drastically easier for
customers to find, choose, afford, and engage with the services, products, and professionals they
need to get and stay healthy!


#everydaybetter


Key job responsibilities
• Perform clinical data review, prescription verification, and virtual patient consultations in
compliance with state and federal regulations
• Manage end-to-end prescription fulfillment process, including dispensing medications
using automated systems (Parata Max2) and manual fill
• Package and prepare prescriptions for shipment or site injection, including handling of
specialized medications (refrigerated and bulk items)
• Maintain strict quality standards and safety protocols while meeting Critical Pull Times
(CPT) and production targets
• Split time effectively between prescription verification and fulfillment duties based on
operational needs and customer centric volume
• Perform thorough DUR (Drug Utilization Review) and ensure accurate documentation in
pharmacy systems
• Monitor, receive, and manage pharmacy inventory effectively and compliantly
• Work collaboratively with pharmacy technicians and other pharmacists to maintain
efficient workflow
• Demonstrate strong attention to detail and adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced
environment

all regulatory requirements
• Complete daily operational tasks including processing returns, medication rejects,
therapeutic substitutions, and canister approvals

• Standing, bending, reaching above the head, kneeling, crouching and/or stretching

• Manual dexterity of hands and wrists
• Walking throughout the Amazon building for various reasons such as injections and inventory receive

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Science, or Doctor of Pharmacy in PharmD, or Doctor of Pharmacy

Preferred qualifications

- Exemplary interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills
- Demonstrated ability to work as an effective team member
- Demonstrated organization skills and attention to detail
- Experience working under pressure in a fast-paced work environment while consistently meeting standards for productivity and quality

title: Program Manager II, Supply Chain
descriptionHtml:
We are hiring Program Managers to run complex and cross functional supply chain projects. This role is a part of the centralized supply chain planning function at Amazon India. The role is very much like an internal consulting role where the incumbent will drive large high impact projects in supply chain. These projects will typically involve designing and building complex new processes, driving technology solutions, driving large cost reduction or efficiency improvement initiatives or launching exciting new supply chain models.

The incumbent will be own the following -
1) They will be responsible for working with finance, supply chain execution, transportation and other Amazon teams to identify pain points and scope out large high impact projects
2) They will be responsible for driving cost benefit analysis and go/no-go decisions on various initiatives
3) Once a go decision is made, the program manager will work to evolve a plan and timeline for execution.
4) The program manager will develop a roadmap and metrics to measure progress of the initiative they own. They will also own writing reports/documents that detail the progress to leadership on a frequent basis
5) They will liaise across functions to drive their project and help clear issues and bottlenecks.
6) They will work with technology teams to scope out and drive any tech changes that are needed

Above all, we expect program managers to be single threaded owners for their initiatives. This is a high ownership position where you directly control your destiny.

Program Managers will be measured on the impact of their project. Depending on the project, clear financial or other impact goals will be set forth. It is the program manager's responsibility to ensure they drive the program towards achieving those goals.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Content Acquisition Manager - Prime Videos, Amazon Prime Video
descriptionHtml:
Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.

Amazon.in is seeking an experienced, dynamic, data-driven content acquisition professional to lead English entertainment content acquisition for Prime Video India. The role will have responsibility for creating, managing and expanding our content provider network and relationships. The individual in this role will be responsible for deep diving into the English entertainment market segment, identifying and closing deals, slates and titles that fit into the overall service programming for the category, and planning content selection for the forward looking 12+ months. This role will also involve negotiating license agreements and securing great content selection for Amazon (Prime Video). It's a mix of strategy and execution.

Key job responsibilities
Create Amazon's English entertainment content strategy driven by data analysis, customer preferences and market dynamics.
Identify content opportunities and partnerships with studios, independent producers and content owners/aggregators.
Negotiate license agreements in line with Amazon's guardrails with content providers to secure high demand content for the service. Benchmark content and create a category level strategy / execution plan to meet service level goals. Build and manage relationships with CEOs/ heads of studios/ Licensing Teams at all key studios.
Focus on understanding customer needs, pain points, behaviors and preferences; seek feedback and invent new delightful experiences on their behalf.
Work closely with colleagues in other departments and locations to build and grow the category.
Analyze the market segment conditions, challenges and opportunities.
Dive deep and analyze customer viewership data, focus groups, online surveys, in-person interviews, external benchmarking and other forms of secondary research. Analyse metrics/results to drive improvements in acquisition strategy.
Develop and document acquisition plans, financial metrics and goals for leadership.
Work with other teams to present content to our customers; be the strongest internal voice of our customers.
Drive continuous improvement in all operational aspects of Amazon's relationship with its content suppliers.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in an account management, licensing or business development role
- 10+ years of content licensing, syndication or distribution experience.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in movies & TV distribution/licensing
- Experience in managing licensing and acquisition for English entertainment.

title: Software Development Engineer II, Digital Acceleration
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Digital Acceleration is the commerce engine for Amazon's digital businesses, built on a simple premise: build for one, available to all. With over 20 years of proven capabilities and more than 10 billion digital transactions processed in the past year, we power purchases and subscriptions across Prime, Prime Video, Audible, Kindle, Music, Alexa+, Luna, and 40+ other businesses. Now we are transforming these capabilities into a shared, AI-native commerce foundation, providing ordering, transactions, and fulfillment through a unified model, shared gateways, and common client experiences.

As a Software Development Engineer on this team, you will design and launch AI-native features that digital product lines can adopt out of the box, without custom integration work. You will write production-ready Java code on AWS, collaborate with Technical Program Managers and Product Managers, and contribute across the full software development lifecycle. If you are a curious engineer who wants to help build the standardized commerce layer behind some of Amazon's most recognized products, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, implement, test, and deploy AI-native feature standardizations in Java on AWS that digital clients across Amazon can adopt with zero custom integration.
- Integrate AI models and AI knowledge bases into commerce workflows, staying current with new technologies to improve productivity and code quality.
- Write logical, well-organized, and maintainable code using optimal data structures and algorithms, making thoughtful trade-offs between performance and readability.
- Collaborate with Technical Program Managers, Product Managers, and peer engineers on scoping, code reviews, and operational support to ship high-quality software.
- Troubleshoot production issues, identify root causes, and contribute to improving system reliability across the ordering platform.


A day in the life
Your day starts with a team standup where you align on priorities with your Manager, Technical Program Manager, and fellow engineers. From there you dive into coding, building features, writing tests, and refining your implementations based on code review feedback. You might pair with a teammate to debug a tricky ordering flow or prototype a new AI-driven capability that dozens of digital product lines will use. You also participate in operational reviews, learning how your services perform at scale and spotting opportunities to make them better.


About the team
Amazon Digital Acceleration powers ordering, subscriptions, and device management for Prime, Amazon Video, Music, Audible, Alexa, and Kindle, amongst other digital businesses. We process billions of digital purchases every year and enable our digital businesses to grow their businesses worldwide. We are on a mission to be earth's best provider of one-time and recurring digital commerce, delivering a seamless and enjoyable post-purchase customer experience.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Sr. Product Manager Tech - AWS, Global System Integration
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We keep the cloud running: the data centers and all the power, cooling, networking, and structural systems behind them.

Within that, the Global System Integration team builds the next generation of data center products. We are accountable for cost per megawatt, construction cycle time, on-time launch, design error rates, embedded carbon, and labor moved off site.

As a Sr. Product Manager - Technical, you own the business case for a data center product or platform. You define the problem worth solving: the cost target, the customer need, and the limits the design must meet. You help the team make real tradeoffs, and you stay accountable from first concept to the final megawatt delivered.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the business case for each product or platform you carry, defining the cost target, customer need, constraint set, and measure of success.
- Set and defend the constraint box Engineering solves within, drawing the cost, schedule, sustainability, and buildability limits from the business case.
- Govern design change, the largest controllable cost driver, by being the test every proposed change passes or fails on whether it earns its cost and schedule hit against the case.
- Own the full chain from design decision to delivered megawatt.
- Prioritize across the portfolio when new demand arrives, deciding what gets staffed and what slips, naming the cost of leaving a product understaffed, and tying every staffing ask to a specific product and tier so the tradeoffs stay explicit and documented.
- Author and defend the business case in the operating plans, reviews, and strategy papers that release capital, and turn repeatable product judgment into decision-support mechanisms the organization can run without you.


A day in the life
You start by checking the products you own against their cases: is cost on target, are dates holding without burning buffer, are design errors trending down. In a design review, you judge not the engineering but whether a proposed change earns its cost and schedule hit and whether anyone has signed off the departure. When new demand lands, you decide what it displaces and write that tradeoff down so it is traceable. You draft a business case for an operating-plan review, coach a PM through theirs, and close an open sign-off before it re-opens first principles.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience managing technical products or online services
- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree
- Experience bridging technical and business teams to collect and refine requirements, prioritize incoming work requests, and ensure all committed work is delivered on time
- 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience

descriptionHtml:
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team is central to Amazon's commitment to innovation. As Amazon evolves and adapts, this team makes sure that the tools and technologies we use do as well. As a Senior RME Technician, you'll help us stay one step ahead, adopting the latest technologies and identifying new and efficient ways of working. A day in the life
In every shift, you’ll be leading a team to make sure everyone has the equipment they need and that it’s running properly. That involves monitoring processes so that regulations and policies are followed and ensuring that preventative maintenance is carried out to increase equipment uptime.

With everything you observe on your shifts, you’ll suggest improvements to make our systems more efficient and productive and then implement those improvements across an EU-wide function. You’ll also be monitoring processes with tools like Scada to guarantee their performance, as well as working closely with your line manager to assist with admin tasks.

This role is located at one of our operational sites. You’ll work shift patterns, which may include some weekends and nights. As you develop your experience within this exciting part of Amazon, you’ll be well-placed to progress into more senior roles.

Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering or RME team keep our equipment performing at its best. We're a technically minded team, made up of excellent team players and guided by experienced leaders. We work together to maintain, troubleshoot and repair equipment across our global network of fulfilment centres. From installing automated packaging systems to overseeing the general maintenance of a site to repairing key distribution equipment, our team handles most aspects of Amazon’s technical side. This includes keeping buildings legally compliant, so everyone is safe, and our sites are operating at maximum efficiency. There are lots of opportunities for progression, both within the RME team and more widely across Amazon.

Everything we do focuses on reducing downtime in Amazon’s crucial operations sites, so customers get their orders on time. title: Manager, Software Development, Accounting Insights (Transportation Financial Systems)
descriptionHtml:
If you want to apply machine learning and generative AI to a problem where accuracy has a dollar value, this is the role for you. Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) builds the technology that records, reconciles and posts the accounting for Amazon's transportation invoices and payments across 16+ transportation modes. Today, month-end close depends on people tracing breaks across ten or more systems, one case at a time. The Accounting Insights team replaces that with software. We detect anomalies in financial data with machine learning, find the root cause of a break with generative AI, produce explanations and insights for controllers and accountants, and automate the standard operating procedures (SOPs) that run the close. You will lead a team of engineers, own the roadmap with product management and Accounting partners.

Key job responsibilities
What will you own?

You will manage a team of engineers and grow them through long-term technical problems their team solves.
You will own the technical roadmap for your area with TFS Product Management, Accounting and Controllership partners.
You will own operational excellence for your services: operational load, security, resiliency and compliance at Amazon scale.
You will set the bar for taking AI into a controlled financial process, with audit evidence, approval steps and separation of duties built in.

What interesting engineering problem will you solve?

You will build machine learning models that detect anomalies in reconciliation, balance and posting data before close, with precision you can measure.
You will build generative AI agents that trace a break to its owning system and team and propose a permanent fix, with human confirmation before it is submitted.
You will build a generative AI assistant that answers balance and variance questions from reconciled figures and attaches the supporting evidence.
You will automate close SOPs as versioned, auditable procedures that AI helps author and run, replacing spreadsheets and individual knowledge.

What large scale program opportunities will you have?

You will own the partner relationship with Accounting, Controllership and Audit, and influence their roadmap as well as yours.
You will work with principal product managers and business leaders to prioritize work and deliver it with quality.
You will make sure open issues and debated topics reach the right forums, so your team's roadmap stays protected.

What Think Big exists for you?

You can move month-end close from a monthly investigation to a continuous, automated certification.
You can turn each one-off root-cause investigation into a permanent fix, so the same class of break stops recurring.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of engineering experience

- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations

title: Software Development Manager, Everyday Essentials Science
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Everyday Essentials (EE) Science team is looking for a Software Development Manager to lead the engineering team that brings our science into production. Our team builds the intelligence behind how customers find, reorder, and discover everyday products - using Generative AI, large language models (LLMs), and machine learning to power recommendations, substitutions, subscriptions, personalization, and next-generation AI-powered shopping experiences across Amazon.



Key job responsibilities
• Lead and develop a team of software engineers, building individualized growth plans, coaching engineers toward their aspirations, and hiring to raise the bar.
• Own technical strategy and architecture for production ML systems, including real-time inference services, batch ML pipelines, and the data foundations underneath them.
• Build and scale production LLM systems, including model management, fine-tuning, retrieval, evaluation, and observability.
• Partner with applied scientists to take models from prototype to production, and build the experimentation, evaluation, and feedback infrastructure that shortens the path from idea to measured customer impact.
• Expose ML-powered intelligence through well-designed APIs and integrations that partner teams can adopt with minimal bespoke work.
• Drive operational excellence for production services, including availability, latency, on-call health, and cost efficiency.
• Foster an inclusive, high-performing culture where diverse perspectives thrive

·       Integrate EE Science intelligence into Amazon's central systems and agentic experiences, exposing it through APIs and agent tools that partner teams can adopt with minimal bespoke work.

·       Drive operational excellence for services that partner teams depend on, including availability, latency, on-call health, and cost efficiency.

·       Foster an inclusive, high-performing culture where diverse perspectives thrive and work/life harmony is sustainable.



A day in the life
You'll lead a team of software engineers who work closely with applied scientists. Your team owns the production systems behind our science: real-time services and APIs, large-scale ML and LLM pipelines, the evaluation and feedback infrastructure that keeps our models improving, and the integrations that deliver our intelligence into core Amazon shopping experiences.

The problems are hard and the field is moving fast:
• How do you serve ML models at scale through APIs with the latency and reliability a shopping page demands?
• How do you take LLM-powered personalization from prototype to production, with model management, fine-tuning, retrieval, and monitoring for quality and cost at Amazon scale?
• How do you build a feedback loop that captures how customers respond to every recommendation and routes that signal back, so every model improves on its own?
• How do you build AI-powered systems that enhance the shopping experience and make them trustworthy enough to act on a customer's behalf?

The Impact You'll Have
Production ML at Amazon scale: You'll own the services that deliver our science to customers - from real-time APIs serving high-throughput traffic worldwide, to low-latency retrieval over large product catalogs.
LLM and GenAI systems: You'll build and run the platform that makes LLM work production-grade - including model management, fine-tuning, quality evaluation, and robust monitoring.
AI-powered shopping experiences: You'll help shape the next generation of intelligent shopping experiences, exposing ML capabilities through APIs that teams across Amazon can integrate into customer-facing products.
Broad reach: Your team's work powers experiences across multiple Amazon surfaces and marketplaces, so a single launch can reach customers at scale.


About the team
Our team transforms everyday essentials shopping through Generative AI and advanced machine learning. We build reusable intelligence about products and customers, and deliver it into the systems that reach customers across Amazon. The Bangalore team brings applied scientists and software engineers together in one organization, and partners closely with science teams in Seattle and Vancouver. We value curiosity, scientific rigor, and developing each team member's career

- Experience partnering with product or program management teams
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
