title: Data Center Controls Tech, Data Center Communities
descriptionHtml:
As a member of the Global Controls Team, you will collaborate with highly motivated operators, engineers and technicians in the data center industry to maintain and optimize critical infrastructure systems. You will be responsible for troubleshooting and maintaining the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) while developing new processes and standards that drive innovation in the controls space.

AWS data centers utilize sophisticated industrial control systems to automatically operate mechanical equipment, maintaining optimal temperature and pressure conditions throughout the facilities. These systems integrate and monitor multiple critical components, including generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic and static transfer switches, air-cooled and water-cooled chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), and air economizers. Within this industrial control system infrastructure, the BMS serves as the primary control platform for all mechanical systems within the data center, while the EPMS functions as the primary monitoring platform for all electrical systems. This position offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in mission-critical environments while contributing to the reliability and efficiency of AWS's global infrastructure.

Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

Key job responsibilities
Primarily work in and support multiple data centers by deploying, servicing, and upgrading BMS and EPMS systems.

Mentor and train Facilities team members on the operation and control of BMS and EPMS systems.

Manage small to medium-sized projects and programs.

Perform point-to-point checkouts between field devices and controllers.

Perform first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting, and maintenance of programming code and hardware associated with BMS and EPMS in data centers.

Execute provisioning processes for servers, controllers, industrial PCs, and network configurations, including communication testing between third-party devices and controllers or servers.

Install, replace, configure, and calibrate sensors.

Read and interpret electrical schematics and control panel drawings with a basic understanding of closed-loop controls, field sensor scaling, and functions typically performed by industrial controllers.

Supervise low-voltage electrical contractors performing wiring and installation of field devices in compliance with AWS requirements.

Provide commissioning and systems-level testing support.

Create red-lined drawings and documentation of systems.

Follow change management processes to generate work requests and methods of procedures.

Participate in factory witness tests at vendor or panel builder facilities.

Perform root cause analysis during testing and commissioning.

Ensure personnel on site utilize proper safety methodology.

Perform service activities including monitoring and reviewing ticketing systems, conducting root cause analysis, and prioritizing tasks.

Actively manage service agreements including vendor labor scheduling, quality assurance, and financial invoice review.

Participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying, or moving up to 50 lbs of equipment, and utilize OSHA-standard safety equipment including limited weight-bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools, and personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety harnesses.

Perform other tasks as assigned by manager.

title: Controls Integration Engineer, One MHS | Systems Integration and Flow
descriptionHtml:
The Controls Integration Engineer defines how automated material handling systems operate and owns the site-specific setup of the controls application software that runs them, assembling and configuring standard code for each site's conveyors, sorters, and automated work cells. For an assigned project, the engineer leads technical execution end to end: authoring the functional specifications, defining test criteria, and delivering tested, reviewed code and documentation ready for field deployment. The engineer solves difficult technical problems with visible risks or roadblocks, bringing clarity to implementations where the business problem is understood but the solution is not fully designed. The engineer mentors the engineers on the project, reviews every deliverable for quality and downstream readiness, and builds close partnerships with third-party vendors and cross-functional teams. The engineer is also the primary handoff contact to the field team and carries field lessons learned back to upstream design teams. The goal is to take risk out of every project before it reaches the field and give the field team everything it needs to bring the site up.

Key job responsibilities
Application Development and Delivery
Own application deliverables for the assigned project from planning through handoff.
Assemble and configure the site's controls application software from standard code libraries, adapting it where the project requires.
Partner with design teams to resolve open functional questions and drive decisions to closure.
Contribute to design reviews with partner teams, bringing the controls and system function perspective.
Testing and Validation
Define test criteria for emulation, digital twin, and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) in partnership with simulation, equipment, and design teams.
Lead emulation and digital twin testing, verifying that system flow meets design intent.
Participate in FAT and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) as the system function expert.
Build the site's commissioning test cases from the standard test case library, in partnership with the field team.
Cross-Team Partnerships
Build strong partnerships with cross-functional teams and third-party vendors, leading site-level coordination to resolve technical issues and unblock progress.
Define functional requirements for third-party interfaces and drive gaps to resolution with third-party teams.
Communicate status, risks, and decisions clearly to project stakeholders.
Serve as the primary partner to the field team from planning through handoff.
Site Handoff and Post-Handoff Support
Deliver a complete, documented handoff package for each project.
Train the field team on each subsystem before handoff.
Partner with the field team on root cause analysis and corrective action for issues found in the field.
Continuous Improvement and Mentorship
Document issues, resolutions, and lessons learned, and feed them back to upstream design teams to improve future projects.
Improve team procedures, templates, and tools based on project experience.
Mentor engineers through hands-on guidance and deliverable review.
AutoStore-Specific Commissioning Duties:

Commission and validate AutoStore grid infrastructure, robot fleet initialization, port configurations, and charging systems
Troubleshoot robot navigation faults, bin handling errors, and port throughput issues
Analyze system logs, datasets, and diagnostic outputs to identify trends, anomalies, and root cause of system failures
Monitor and optimize system performance using diagnostic tools (PowerBI, Databricks, AutoStore controller software)
Support grid modifications, expansion projects, and firmware/software upgrades
Conduct advanced root cause analysis on system failures and performance deviations
Validate end-to-end material flow from AutoStore grid through conveyance to outbound operations
Collaborate with AutoStore distribution partners, customers, and internal teams to ensure successful deployments and minimal downtime
Interpret system telemetry, performance metrics, and monitoring dashboards to drive continuous improvement

Basic qualifications

- Experience with networking fundamentals including hands-on experience with load balancers, switches, routers, etc.
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Travel up to 50% of the time
- Willingness to travel up to 50% for on-site commissioning and deployment support.
- Hands-on experience with industrial communication protocols such as Ethernet/IP, Profinet, EtherCAT, or Modbus TCP.
- Knowledge of engineering documentation, electrical diagrams and standard operating procedures
- Experience of automated equipment including packaging machinery, sortation and conveyor systems
- Experience developing or testing application software for industrial automation systems using IEC 61131-3 platforms such as Codesys, Rockwell Logix (Studio 5000), Siemens TIA Portal, Beckhoff TwinCAT, or equivalent.
- Experience writing functional specifications or descriptions of operations for automated systems.
- 5+ years of experience in systems development engineering, controls application development, or industrial automation.

Preferred qualifications

- Familiarity with object-oriented programming concepts in an IEC 61131-3 environment (e.g., structured function blocks, reusable control architectures).
- Experience supporting large-scale commissioning projects such as automated warehouses, conveyor and sorter systems, or complex manufacturing environments.
- - Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team, or experience leading and influencing your team or organization
- - Experience working in a Linux/Unix environment
- - Demonstrated ability to independently interpret functional design documents and implement or validate corresponding controls behavior.
- - Experience with industrial communication protocols such as EtherCAT, Ethernet/IP, Profinet, or Modbus TCP.
- - Experience coordinating with third-party vendors or system integrators on interface specifications and gap resolution.

title: Sr Program Manager, Long Term Planning and Forecasting
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Program Manager to own the strategic vision and execution for how Amazon's business customers interact with LTPF forecasts and plans. As a senior leader within the LTPF, you will be responsible for defining the multi-year roadmap for customer engagement, ensuring that business stakeholders across Amazon can seamlessly access, understand, and act upon our forecasting outputs. In this role, you will manage the lifecycle of complex, cross-functional programs that transform how Operations, Stores, and Finance teams leverage LTPF insights for strategic decision-making. You will work with scientists, economists, engineers, and business customers to architect the customer interaction experience, including viewing capabilities, auditing tools, what-if analysis frameworks, and forecast intervention workflows.

This role might be for you if you have interest and experience in:
- Driving cross-functional alignment on demand insights that impact Amazon's topline growth
- Defining multi-year program vision and strategy while balancing short-term execution
- Regularly presenting to VP and SVP level leaders
- Prioritizing operational excellence work alongside feature delivery on a roadmap
- Showing strong business acumen with strategic, analytical, and critical thinking
- Managing planning calendars and strategic review mechanisms
- Driving organizational alignment across multiple teams and stakeholders



Key job responsibilities
As a Senior Program Manager in LTPF:
- You will architect the customer engagement experience, ensuring business stakeholders can seamlessly view, audit, and leverage LTPF outputs for strategic planning.
- You will lead innovation and use of customer-facing tools, what-if analysis frameworks, and forecast intervention workflows that enable the full business to incorporate strategic decisions into LTPF's forecasts and plans.
- You will serve as the strategic bridge between LTPF's technical outputs and diverse business stakeholders.
- You will own the end-to-end customer journey, from initial forecast consumption to what-if scenario exploration to submitting forecast interventions.
- You will gather insights, identify systemic gaps, and drive strategic initiatives to transform the experience.
- You will use data-driven insights to continuously improve how Operations, Finance, and Stores teams interact with LTPF.
- You will partner with cross-functional stakeholders to determine project priorities, manage the lifecycle of complex initiatives from concept to delivery, and negotiate resources.
- You will forge partnerships with Product, Tech, Science, and Operations teams to build enhanced capabilities.
- You will regularly present to Directors and VPs, publish strategic planning documents, and own quarterly and annual reviews with senior leadership.


A day in the life
Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment.

The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
- Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage

- Paid Time Off (PTO)
- 401(k) Plan

About the team
The Long-Term Planning and Forecasting (LTPF) organization is dedicated to answering some of Amazon's most important strategic questions: Where will Amazon's growth come from in the next year? What about over the next five years? Which product lines are poised to grow significantly? Are we investing appropriately in our infrastructure? How do our customers react to changes in prices, product selection, or delivery times? Are our infrastructure investments optimal for the level of demand we expect?

title: Technical Program Manager, Serviceability
descriptionHtml:
Data Center Serviceability team works with hundreds of data centers globally to deliver the highest quality and lowest cost availability, capacity, and scaling results for our customers. We standardize operations globally by delivering tools, policy, processes, and procedures to our internal teams.

Serviceability is the ability to maintain, repair, and manage infrastructure assets efficiently throughout their lifecycle, encompassing maintenance standards, spares management, training and certifications, operational readiness, and the systematic use of data and automation to prevent disruptions and drive continuous improvement.

We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to support serviceability for water systems across our data centers. Water quality management is a critical and fast-growing area of data center operations, where evaporative cooling, condenser water, and makeup water systems must be kept safe, compliant, and reliable to protect both people and infrastructure. This role will define how water systems are sampled, maintained, and kept within regulatory compliance as we scale from early programs to a global fleet, with a focus on proactively catching water quality issues before they drive equipment degradation or infrastructure downtime.

What you will do:

You will own the serviceability program for water systems across the fleet. You will write and maintain preventive maintenance (PM) guidelines for water sampling across all water bodies in our data centers, such as cooling towers, condenser and chilled water loops, evaporative systems, and storage tanks, making sure these guidelines meet regulatory and environmental compliance requirements across every region we operate in. You will build these guidelines with Operations, Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO), Industrial Hygiene, Environmental, and water treatment vendors. You will set the serviceability framework for water systems so that sampling, treatment, and remediation happen on time and water quality issues are caught proactively rather than after they affect equipment or availability. You will partner with Finance on labor analyses that turn sampling and treatment needs into staffing plans. You will work with Field Engineering to lead root cause analyses on water quality and equipment findings, and you will make sure the lessons feed back into PM standards and procedures. You will work with Operations and site teams to build operational readiness plans for new sites, then track readiness so every site is sampling and compliant from day one. You will also run field trials and stakeholder workshops to validate procedures, collect feedback and drive continuous improvement.

Key job responsibilities
Own the execution and success metrics for water systems serviceability across the global fleet
Write and maintain PM guidelines for water sampling across all water bodies, ensuring they meet regulatory and environmental compliance, working with Operations, DCEO, Industrial Hygiene, Environmental, and vendors
Set the serviceability framework for water systems that keeps sampling and treatment on schedule and prevents water quality issues from causing infrastructure downtime
Build mechanisms to proactively detect and escalate water quality risks before they affect equipment or availability
Conduct labor analyses with Finance to support annual and long-range staffing plans
Lead root cause analyses with Field Engineering on water quality and equipment findings, and drive corrective actions into standards
Build operational readiness plans with Operations and site teams, and track readiness as new sites deploy
Run field trials and stakeholder workshops to validate procedures and collect operational feedback
Keep serviceability standards current as the fleet grows and new equipment, regulations, and vendors are introduced
Use data and metrics to measure program health, prioritize effort and report progress
Write narratives (one to six pages) and present to Director-level leadership
Travel up to 10–15%

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Bachelor's degree in chemical engineering, biotech/bio-engineering, mechanical or equivalent relevant experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing serviceability/maintenance programs
- Experience maintaining regulatory or compliance-driven global programs
- Experience working with data center engineering teams

descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about last mile delivery and ready to make a real impact in one of Australia's fastest-growing logistics networks? Amazon Logistics (AMZL) Australia is looking for an **On the Road (OTR) Manager** to own on-road operations at one of our delivery stations. In this role, you'll be the critical link between station operations and our Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) and Flex DPs driving safety, delivery quality, capacity planning, compliance, and cost performance.

You'll think on your feet every day - balancing customer expectations with operational realities across a dynamic delivery network. You'll be the voice of the DSP within the station and region, building strong partnerships with operations teams, leveraging data to solve problems, and embedding a culture of continuous improvement. This field-based role offers the chance to shape the future of last mile delivery in Australia - it's fast-paced, challenging, and hugely rewarding.

The days and hours required for this role are Sunday-Wednesday 06:00 - 16:00

Key job responsibilities
- Safety leadership - Champion on-road safety standards; lead investigations, drive corrective actions, and deliver against regional safety metrics in partnership with the Senior OTR Manager and site leadership.

- DSP performance management - Support and coach a portfolio of Delivery Service Partners through daily performance reviews, training, metrics analysis, and structured feedback to maximize delivery quality and productivity on route.

- Data-driven decision making - Deliver weekly reporting on on-road performance; create actionable insights and improvement plans that influence stakeholder decisions and drive operational excellence.

- Capacity planning & execution - Manage short- and medium-term capacity plans, coordinate network changes, and execute high-volume event planning including infrastructure scaling during peak periods (e.g., Prime Day, Black Friday/Cyber Monday).

title: SDE II, EC2 Instance Networking, EC2 Nitro
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to build the networking infrastructure that powers every virtual machine in the world's largest cloud? Are you excited by the challenge of writing systems software that runs on millions custom networking cards across millions of hosts?

The Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) Instance Networking team builds and operates the software-defined networking stack at the heart of AWS. Our code is what makes Virtual Private Clouds (VPC) work, what enforces customer security policies, and what enables workloads to scale from a single instance to clusters of tens of thousands. Every packet that enters or leaves an EC2 instance flows through software we write, running on custom silicon designed in-house.

This work sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and the AI revolution. As machine learning workloads grow to unprecedented scale - training runs spanning thousands of accelerators, clusters demanding millions of network endpoints, and fabrics pushing hundreds of gigabits per second. We build the networking primitives that make these workloads possible: high-performance interfaces, low-latency data plane protocols, and scalable network virtualization that operates predictably even under heavy churn. When the world's most ambitious AI companies scale on AWS, they're relying on the software we build.

You'll write low-level systems code in C and Rust running on custom hardware in a real-time
embedded environment. You'll work on network virtualization protocols, packet processing pipelines, and availability mechanisms that must perform correctly at massive scale with sub-second latency requirements. You'll solve problems that span hardware, firmware, and
software, and see the direct impact of your work on customers running some of the largest and most demanding workloads in the cloud.

Key job responsibilities
Own the design, development, and delivery of data plane networking features for EC2 instances running on custom Nitro hardware
Drive operational excellence for network virtualization systems serving millions of AWS customers worldwide
Ensure the reliability, performance, and security of VPC connectivity and policy enforcement at scale

Contribute to the technical roadmap for EC2 Instance Networking, identifying opportunities to improve performance, scalability, and customer experience
Partner with cross-functional teams — including hardware, control plane, and ML platform teams — to define and deliver end-to-end solutions
Raise the bar on engineering quality through code reviews, design reviews, and operational best practices

Design and implement data plane networking software across the full lifecycle — from design through deployment and operations

Develop packet processing pipelines and availability mechanisms that must perform correctly at massive scale with sub-second latency requirements
Investigate and resolve complex production issues across distributed embedded systems, driving root cause analysis and permanent fixes
Collaborate with partner teams across hardware, control plane, and ML platforms to deliver end-to-end solutions

descriptionHtml:
Avez-vous une passion profonde pour l'utilisation de la technologie afin d'outiller les entreprises? Aimeriez-vous poursuivre une carrière qui aide les clients et les partenaires à atteindre leurs objectifs plus rapidement et à moindre coût grâce aux services infonuagiques?

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) gestionnaire principal(e) de l'engagement capable de diriger des équipes internes d'AWS, des partenaires externes et des équipes clients afin de livrer des produits et services infonuagiques AWS qui permettent à nos clients de réaliser leurs objectifs d'affaires. Vous devrez mettre à profit vos compétences en relation client et votre sens technique pour comprendre les exigences des clients et les accompagner dans la mise en œuvre de leurs projets de transformation numérique.

Vous collaborerez avec de nombreux groupes d'intervenants pour soutenir la collecte des exigences et la définition de la portée des projets. Vous travaillerez de façon continue à mettre en œuvre de manière proactive les pratiques exemplaires pour nos clients et à cerner et combler les lacunes des projets en collaboration avec tous les échelons des organisations. Les mandats typiques comprennent : l'élaboration de stratégies infonuagiques et d'analyses de rentabilité, les évaluations d'admissibilité et de migration vers l'infonuagique, la conception et la mise en œuvre d'architectures infonuagiques, les migrations de l'infrastructure sur site vers l'infonuagique, ainsi que l'harmonisation organisationnelle liée à l'infonuagique.
--------------------------------------------
Do you have a deep passion for utilizing technology to empower businesses? Would you like to have a career that supports customers and partners reach their outcomes faster and cheaper through Cloud Services?

We are hiring a Senior Engagement Manager capable of leading internal AWS, external partners, and customer teams to deliver AWS cloud products and services that enable our customers to realize their business outcomes. You will need to draw on your customer-facing skills and technical acumen to understand customer requirements and enable them to implement their digital transformation projects.

You will be collaborating with many stakeholder groups to support requirements gathering and scope definition. You will be working on an ongoing basis to proactively implement best practices for our customers and help identify and close project gaps working with all levels of organizations. Typical engagements include: Cloud Strategy and Business Case Development, Cloud Suitability and Migration Assessments, Cloud Architecture Design and Implementation, On-Premise to Cloud Migrations, and Cloud Organizational Alignment.

Key job responsibilities
Livraison
• Collaborer avec les équipes de vente, d'avant-vente, de formation et de soutien d'AWS sur le terrain afin de chercher à comprendre les besoins de nos clients, leur entreprise, la façon dont le succès est défini, et veiller à ce que nous dépassions les attentes en matière de développement et de livraison des résultats clients. • Planifier, organiser et gérer toutes les phases du cycle de vie des projets afin d'assurer une livraison réussie. Cela comprend l'élaboration et la gestion de plans de gouvernance de projet, de calendriers de projet, d'objectifs d'équipe, de jalons de projet, de budgets et la définition de critères de succès.
• Gérer les objectifs des mandats et diriger les équipes afin d'atteindre les résultats d'affaires des clients en gérant les enjeux, les risques, les décisions, les dépendances et les mesures à prendre.
• Travailler avec les intervenants et les équipes de vente d'AWS pour modifier la portée contractuelle, les aspects financiers et les échéanciers prévus.
• Capacité à prendre en charge les responsabilités, à travailler sous pression, à respecter les budgets et les échéances.
• Tenir les équipes internes et externes responsables, réorienter au besoin et gérer les attentes des clients tout au long des mandats.
• Travailler efficacement dans un environnement dynamique où les priorités changent et être en mesure de prendre des mesures proactives pour s'assurer que les équipes répondent aux attentes des clients ou les dépassent.
• Capacité à travailler de façon autonome et efficace de manière indépendante, tout en étant également à l'aise de contribuer au sein d'une équipe mondiale.
• Axé(e) sur les résultats, priorise les activités de travail, planifie et demeure organisé(e) afin de respecter les engagements.
• S'assurer que les équipes d'AWS et des partenaires atteignent ou dépassent les objectifs d'affaires des clients.

Solutions
• Diriger des individus, des équipes ou plusieurs groupes et jouer un rôle actif dans l'analyse des objectifs de projet, la création d'un plan pour atteindre ces objectifs, puis guider les membres de l'équipe AWS, les intervenants/experts en la matière du client et potentiellement d'autres tiers pour atteindre ces objectifs, tout en comprenant l'environnement du client et les contraintes liées à l'exécution.
• Rechercher activement des moyens d'améliorer l'efficacité et l'efficience des processus.
• Capacité à appliquer une réflexion stratégique et à démontrer une compréhension des exigences pour mener à bien l'exécution.
• Capacité à prendre des décisions guidées par les politiques, les procédures et les plans d'affaires avec un encadrement limité.
• Capacité à appliquer un sens des affaires et des finances pour obtenir des résultats d'affaires mesurables favorisant le succès des clients.
• Soutenir et influencer le cycle de vente en mobilisant les clients dans la définition des prochaines phases des projets infonuagiques, selon les besoins des clients.
• Participer au développement de la pratique en contribuant à l'élaboration de solutions et de méthodologies concrètes, ainsi qu'au développement d'outils de partage des connaissances.

Communication
• Excellentes compétences en communication écrite, verbale et en présentation avec les membres de l'équipe et les auditoires de tous les niveaux.
• Capacité à établir des relations avec divers intervenants internes d'AWS et clients, y compris les équipes de haute direction (cadres de niveau C, PVP principal/VP, directeurs) ainsi que les ressources au niveau des projets telles que les experts en la matière.
• Planifier et superviser la préparation et la distribution des communications de projet.
• Comprendre les styles de fonctionnement des autres ainsi que les relations d'équipe/client, la dynamique d'équipe, et adapter son comportement en conséquence pour réussir. Reconnaître les nuances environnementales ou culturelles et s'adapter.
• Favoriser un environnement de travail inclusif et diversifié.

Travail d'équipe
• Succès démontré dans le travail avec des équipes et la haute direction dans un environnement client complexe.
• Esprit d'équipe qui intègre efficacement, motive et établit des relations avec les membres d'équipes interfonctionnelles (locaux ou à distance), les commanditaires, les intervenants clés, les cadres et les autres personnes ou organisations touchées par le projet.
• Expérience avérée de travail dans un environnement matriciel, gérant de multiples intervenants.
• Excellentes compétences en gestion des personnes, y compris la capacité d'influencer, de négocier et d'obtenir des résultats par l'entremise d'autres personnes qui ne sont pas des subordonnés directs.

Il s'agit d'un poste en contact avec la clientèle. Vous pourriez être appelé(e) à vous déplacer chez les clients pour offrir des services professionnels au besoin, lorsque les déplacements reprendront. Nous offrons un environnement de travail flexible pour vous aider à concilier votre vie professionnelle et personnelle, tout en demeurant obsédé(e) par le client.
-----------------------------------------------------------
Delivery
• Collaborate with AWS field sales, pre-sales, training, and support teams to seek to understand our customers’ needs, their business, how success is defined, and ensure that we are exceeding expectations in developing and delivering customer outcomes.
• Plan, organize, and manage all phases of the project lifecycle to ensure successful delivery. This includes developing and managing project governance plans, project schedules, team goals, project milestones, budgets and defining success criteria.
• Manage engagement goals and lead teams to achieve customers’ business outcomes by managing issues, risks, decisions, dependencies, and action items.
• Work with stakeholders and AWS sales teams to amend the contractual scope, financials, and expected timelines
• Ability to take ownership, work under pressure, stay within budget, and meet deadlines
• Hold internal and external teams accountable, redirect when needed, and manage customer expectations throughout engagements.
• Works effectively in a dynamic environment with changing priorities and able to take proactive steps to ensure teams meet or exceed customer expectations.
• Ability to be self-directed and effective working independently, yet equally comfortable contributing in a global team environment
• Results-oriented, prioritizes work activities, plans and stays organized in order to meet commitments.
• Ensures AWS and Partner teams meet or exceed customer business objectives

Solutions
• Lead individuals, teams, or multiple groups and play an active role in analyzing project goals, creating a plan to achieve those goals, and then guiding AWS team members, customer stakeholders/SMEs and potentially other third parties to achieve those goals while understanding the client environment and any limitations to execution.
• Actively looks for ways to improve process efficiencies and effectiveness.
• Ability to apply strategic thinking and demonstrate understanding of requirements to execute.
• Ability to make decisions guided by policies, procedures and business plans with limited guidance.
• Ability to apply business and financial acumen to achieve measurable business results for customer success.
• Support and influence the sales lifecycle by engaging clients in defining next phases of cloud projects as appropriate to meet client needs.
• Participate in practice development by contributing to the development of practical solutions and methodologies, and the development of knowledge sharing artifacts.

Communication
• Excellent written, verbal communication, and presentation skills with team members and audiences of all levels.
• Ability to build relationships with various customer and internal AWS stakeholders which consists of senior leadership teams (C-level execs, SVP/VP, Directors) and project level resources such as SMEs.
• Plans and oversees the preparation and distribution of project communications.
• Understand the operating styles of others as well as team/client relationships, team dynamics, and adjusts behavior accordingly to succeed. Recognizes environmental or cultural nuances and adapts.
• Foster an inclusive and diverse work environment.

Team Work
• Proven success in working with teams and executive leadership in a complex customer environment.
• Team player who effectively integrates, motivates and builds relationships with cross-functional team members (local or remote), sponsors, key stakeholders, executives, and other individuals or organizations involved with or affected by the project.
• Proven experience working in a matrix environment, managing multiple stakeholders.
• Excellent people management skills, including the ability to influence, negotiate and achieve results through others who are not direct reports.
This is a customer-facing role. You may be required to travel to customer locations to deliver professional services when needed when travel resumes. We offer a flexible work environment to help you balance your work and personal life, while still remaining customer obsessed.

Basic qualifications

- Plus de 7 ans d'expérience dans la direction et la livraison de mandats en TI de niveau entreprise.
- Expérience dans la direction simultanée ou à grande échelle de plusieurs équipes Agile (tels que des Scrum Masters et des responsables de produit).
- Expérience avec des programmes de transformation ou de migration à grande échelle en TI, en numérique ou en affaires dans un rôle en contact avec la clientèle.
- Expérience dans la gestion de mandats utilisant à la fois les méthodologies en cascade (Waterfall) et Agile/itératives.
- La maîtrise du français et de l'anglais est requise en raison de la nature du poste qui nécessite des interactions avec d'autres entités d'Amazon à l'échelle mondiale ainsi qu'avec des employés et des intervenants d'Amazon dans d'autres provinces du Canada.
- --------------------------------------------

- Experience in leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale
- Experience with large scale IT/digital/business transformation or migration programs in a customer facing role
- Experience managing engagements using both Waterfall and Agile/Iterative methodologies
- Fluency in French and English is required due to the nature of the role that requires interaction with other Amazon entities globally and with Amazon employees and stakeholders in other provinces in Canada.

Preferred qualifications

- Expérience dans la gestion de projets techniques composés de 8 personnes ou plus totalisant un budget de plus de 1 000 000 $
- Expérience dans la direction de transformations à grande échelle en entreprise avec les services AWS/infonuagiques
- Expérience de présentation à des PVP principaux et des cadres de niveau C
- Connaissance des principes et des services technologiques, y compris l'infrastructure, les applications d'affaires, la gestion des données, la sécurité, les plateformes d'applications et les technologies destinées aux consommateurs
- Certification professionnelle en gestion de projet (PMP) ou certification équivalente

- Experience leading large enterprise transformations with AWS/cloud services
- Experience presenting to SVP and C-Level
- Knowledge of technology principles and services including infrastructure, business applications, data management, security, application platforms, and consumer-facing technology

title: Area Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly workforce and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Key job responsibilities
* Support, mentor, and motivate your hourly workforce
* Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
* Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
* Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
* Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
* Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
* Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
* Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience managing a team of 20+ employees
- Experience with process improvements (Lean process, Kaizen, and/or Six Sigma)
- Excellent customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills
- A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field.
- Industry experience in: retail, F&B, military, manufacturing, automotive, biotech, electronics, energy, instrumentation, machinery, defense/aerospace, medical, cosmetics, production or distribution environments.

title: EHS Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. As a Workplace Health & Safety Specialist (WHSS), you'll be at the forefront of transforming workplace safety culture at one of the world's most innovative companies. Your expertise and dedication will directly protect employees, ensuring they return home safely to their families every day. You'll facilitate new approaches to safety, combining technology with human-centered solutions to create an environment where safety and productivity thrive together. This isn't just about maintaining safety standards – it's about revolutionizing how we think about and implement workplace safety, making a lasting impact on our people and operations. As your building's designated safety champion, you'll have the unique opportunity to build relationships, influence positive change, and help write the next chapter in Amazon's commitment to becoming Earth's Safest Place to Work.

Core Impact Areas:
Safety Program Excellence & Implementation - Drive comprehensive safety programs through data-driven strategies. Lead daily safety audits, incident investigations, and risk assessments while implementing innovative solutions to prevent injuries. Deliver engaging safety training that resonates with associates and promotes a proactive safety culture. Champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance workplace safety while maintaining operational efficiency.

Associate Advocacy & Cultural Leadership - Serve as a trusted safety advisor and advocate for associate wellbeing, building strong partnerships across all levels of the organization. Foster a culture where safety is everyone's priority through effective communication, coaching, and positive reinforcement. Develop strong relationships with frontline associates and leadership to drive behavioral changes and ensure safety best practices become natural habits. Transform safety data into compelling narratives that influence positive change and drive engagement in safety initiatives.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site

Must be available to work flexible shifts including days, nights and/or weekends.

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent
- A minimum of 1 year in an Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) related field OR; A Bachelor’s degree in EHS-relevant background OR; 6 months experience performing in a safety-related role within Amazon
- Knowledge of OSHA regulations specifically 29 CFR 1910
- Experience using Microsoft Word and Excel in a professional capacity
- Experience maintaining confidentiality in matter involving security and/or personnel issues in the workplace

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree or higher, preferably in a safety related field
- Strong communication, teamwork, analysis, judgment, and customer focus skills
- Experience leading and managing a team, ability to analyze accident data, new processes, and machinery for potential safety concerns, and conduct job hazard and job safety analyses
- Experience in emergency response and currently holds First Aid and CPR certificates
- Experience in workers compensation case management

title: L6 Sr HRBP
descriptionHtml:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People eXperience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. The Senior HR Business Partner (Sr. HRBP) is a key strategic partner on the (Insert Line of Business) PXT team, bringing expertise in leadership development, employee experience, culture, and change management. This role balances tactical excellence with strategic insight, leveraging both technology and human judgment to align local leadership, centralized support, and systems in delivering high-quality employee experiences.

The Sr. HRBP contributes to excellence in PXT service delivery through leadership and strategic insight. They support team development and process optimization while upholding high standards and risk management practices. Leveraging data and experience, they inform business decisions and help implement scalable solutions. Their influence extends across the organization, collaborating with leaders to advance key initiatives and deliver solutions that balance immediate needs with long-term objectives.

You will be expected to work onsite at an Amazon facility.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and develop a diverse team of HR professionals, coaching them to elevate beyond tactical execution to become strategic partners who proactively identify and mitigate organizational risks while delivering exceptional service.

- Drive a culture of proactive risk identification and mitigation by establishing early warning systems, leveraging data insights, and building strong partnerships across functions. Guide your team in developing sound judgment to spot emerging people-related risks before they impact the business.

- Shape the strategic vision for employee experience and organizational health. Challenge status quo thinking and drive innovation in HR practices while ensuring sustainable execution. Enable your team to move beyond immediate problem-solving to address systemic issues and opportunities.

- Partner with business leadership to develop and execute integrated talent strategies that address both current needs and future capability requirements. Coach leaders on effective talent development while building a strong succession pipeline within your own HR organization. Anticipate future talent needs and evolving workforce dynamics to future-proof both operations and HR.

- Lead your team in effective use of analytics and AI tools to uncover hidden patterns, predict emerging risks, and drive data-informed decision making. Translate complex insights into compelling narratives that influence senior stakeholders and drive organizational change.

- Set clear goals for culture transformation with business leaders. Design and implement comprehensive strategies to systematically strengthen organizational health, talent capabilities, and leadership effectiveness. Champion initiatives that measurably enhance diversity, equity and inclusion.

- Drive strategic adoption of HR technology to enable both efficiency and excellence in service delivery. Guide your team to leverage automation while preserving high-touch support for sensitive employee matters requiring human judgment and empathy.

A day in the life
A typical day involves balancing strategic insight with tactical execution. You'll provide expertise in employee relations, coach leaders through performance and development matters, and drive HR functional excellence. Operating with autonomy, you'll partner with leaders at multiple levels to develop forward-looking strategies focused on employee experience and operational objectives.

Through data analytics and AI-enabled tools, you'll identify trends and opportunities while maintaining the human connections essential for building trust. You'll support critical HR processes such as investigations and talent management while leveraging technology to enhance service delivery and decision-making, knowing when automation creates efficiency and when personal interaction remains crucial.

Success in this role comes from effectively enabling strong people leadership, influencing at scale, and addressing root causes of systemic issues. Through a combination of data-driven insights and strategic partnerships, you'll help create and maintain a workplace culture where employees feel valued, supported, and empowered to perform at their best.

- Experience using data and high-judgement to drive business decisions

- Experience supporting and/or leading employee-focused processes such as onboarding, benefits, investigations, training and/or talent management

title: Chief of Staff & Business Operations Lead, Global Network Delivery
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Chief of Staff & Business Operations Lead to join the Global Network Delivery (GND) organization. This role is the strategic partner to the GND Director and the connective tissue between GND leadership and the mechanisms that drive decisions: operating plans, goals, business reviews, workforce plans, and the broader rhythm of business.

You will shape what GND works on, not just track it. You will act as an extension of the leader: representing them in forums, deciding what needs their attention, owning the narrative in executive documents, and telling leaders what they need to hear, not what they want to hear. You will also own the business operations engine that keeps a fast-growing global organization running with high standards.

Key job responsibilities
- Serve as a thought partner on org strategy, priorities, and tradeoffs. Provide candid feedback and surface blind spots.
- Represent the leader in leadership forums and cross-org meetings; make decisions within agreed guardrails; triage what needs the leader's time, what gets delegated, and what gets handled directly.
- Write and own executive documents as required; prepare the leader for upward reviews and key meetings.
- Lead ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives that do not belong to a single team, from problem definition through delivery, without direct authority.
- Identify gaps in how the org makes decisions and design mechanisms to close them. Maintain the decision log and serve as institutional memory for commitments and rationale.
- Build relationships across the business (Finance, HR, Talent Acquisition, and peer BizOps teams) to unblock dependencies and keep the organization's mechanisms aligned.

title: Sr. Engineering Design Manager, Global Building Design Risk and Recovery (GBDR)
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a highly skilled MEP Design Engineer/Manager to lead full-lifecycle design and engineering for industrial, commercial, and mixed-use projects across Australia. The primary focus is Electrical Engineering and Design for Industrial Buildings, with a particular emphasis on large-scale warehouse, distribution centre, fulfilment centre, and logistics hub developments. The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in warehouse electrical systems, proven competency in Australian codes and standards including current Australian Standards and the NCC/BCA, strong design leadership, cross-disciplinary coordination capability, and a track record of delivering compliant, high-quality engineering documentation from concept through construction.

Key job responsibilities
Electrical System Design — Primary Discipline
All electrical designs to be prepared in full compliance with current Australian electrical wiring standards, NCC/BCA, and applicable state electrical safety legislation.
• HV/MV Power Systems — Design high-voltage substations (11 kV/33 kV), zone reticulation networks, and transformer installations with appropriate redundancy. Carry out protection relay coordination and liaise directly with Distribution Network Service Providers (DNSPs) such as AusGrid, Energex, and SA Power Networks.
• LV Distribution & Cable Design — Size and detail main switchboards, sub-main distribution boards, and motor control centres. Undertake cable sizing and derating calculations in accordance with applicable Australian electrical standards, ensuring voltage drop and fault level compliance throughout.
• Load Analysis, MCC & Variable Speed Drives — Calculate maximum demand and design motor control centres including DOL, soft-starter, and VSD configurations. Perform load flow and harmonic analysis using industry tools such as ETAP or PowerFactory, with power factor correction to meet utility requirements.
• Emergency & Standby Power — Design diesel generator sets, online UPS systems, and automatic transfer switching arrangements to meet essential services requirements under the NCC/BCA. Provide appropriate redundancy levels for critical process and life safety loads.
• Lighting, Earthing & Hazardous Areas — Develop industrial lighting designs for warehouse, distribution centre, and fulfilment centre environments, including high-bay warehouse lighting layouts, aisle-by-aisle lux level calculations, racking interleaved luminaire placement, and emergency egress lighting. Incorporate DALI controls and NCC Section J energy compliance for large-footprint warehouse facilities. Design earthing and bonding systems and lightning protection installations. Classify hazardous areas and select explosion-protected equipment in accordance with relevant Australian standards for flammable atmospheres.
• Warehouse Power Distribution & Energy Management — Design warehouse power distribution systems including dock leveller power supplies, conveyor and ASRS power feeds, forklift charging bays, EV charging infrastructure, and GPO layouts to suit operational workflows. Develop sub-metering strategies and NCC Section J energy compliance reports. Produce complete electrical deliverables including single-line diagrams, cable and panel schedules, design basis reports, commissioning plans, and as-built documentation.

Design Standards & Specifications Writing
• Design Standards Authoring — Author and maintain electrical design standards, technical specifications, and engineering guidelines specifically for warehouse, distribution centre, fulfilment centre, and logistics hub projects, aligned with the NCC and current Australian Standards. Establish project-specific design basis documents that define system design parameters, equipment selection criteria, and installation requirements for warehouse electrical infrastructure.
• Equipment & System Specifications — Prepare detailed electrical equipment specifications for switchboards, transformers, generators, UPS systems, lighting, and cable management systems for warehouse and logistics hub projects. Develop method of measurement and payment clauses, hold point inspection and test plans (ITPs), and commissioning procedures aligned with Australian construction and design certification requirements.

Secondary Disciplines — HVAC, Fire, Plumbing & ELV
• HVAC — Design heating, ventilation, and air conditioning systems including central plant, ductwork layouts, and BMS integration, ensuring compliance with NCC energy performance requirements.
• Fire Protection — Design sprinkler systems, fire detection and alarm systems, hydrant networks, and emergency warning systems in compliance with the NCC and applicable Australian fire safety standards.
• Plumbing & Hydraulics — Design water supply, drainage, stormwater, and trade waste systems in accordance with applicable Australian plumbing and drainage standards and the NCC Plumbing Code of Australia. Include on-site detention, grease traps, oil-water separators, and rainwater harvesting where required.
• BMS, ELV & Smart Building Systems — Design BMS/IBMS architecture using open-protocol platforms, SCADA/HMI integration, and NABERS-aligned energy dashboards. Develop access control, IP CCTV, structured cabling, IoT, and cybersecurity solutions to meet building security and operational requirements.
• BIM Coordination — Lead 3D clash detection and multi-discipline MEP coordination using Revit MEP, Navisworks, and BIM 360/ACC. Prepare bills of quantities, design basis reports, and authority submissions in accordance with Australian BIM information management requirements.


About the team
This role will be a part of Amazon Building Design Team for International Region encompassing EU, APAC, India and MEATR . Our team is accountable for ensuring meeting the key business requirements, upholding safety in design and compliance. We continuously innovate to better ourselves, working with internal and external stakeholders.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of program management or technical project management experience
- Bachelor's degree or above in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Technology, or Reliability Engineering, or Master's degree or above in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering
- • Electrical analysis: ETAP, PowerFactory, SKM PowerTools — load flow, short circuit analysis, cable sizing, and protection coordination.
- • Lighting & energy modelling: DIALux evo, Relux; NCC Section J compliance (JV3/DTS pathway); NABERS and Green Star reporting.
- • CAD & BIM: AutoCAD Electrical, Revit MEP, Navisworks, BIM 360/ACC; working knowledge of Australian BIM information management frameworks.
- • HVAC & hydraulics: Carrier HAP, IES-VE, EnergyPlus; hydraulic calculation tools for fire and plumbing system design.
- • Core standards proficiency: current Australian wiring, cable selection, and lighting standards, NCC/BCA — with strong working knowledge of all related Australian design and safety standards.

Preferred qualifications

- • Certified Energy Professional (CEP) or equivalent industry credential.
- • Autodesk Professional certification in Revit MEP or BIM management.

title: Sr. Associate - Quality Analyst, Global Solutions & Risk Compliance (GSRC)
descriptionHtml:
The Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) organization is a component of Amazon's operations, dedicated to ensuring the compliance of its products and services worldwide. GSRC's core mission is to keep customers, partners, and associates safe while protecting the company from legal and regulatory risks. With a diverse global team spanning across India, China, Poland, Romania, Netherlands, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica, GSRC partners with its stakeholders to classify products and ensure regulatory and legal compliance for product listings. GSRC raises the bar on quality by implementing operational changes matching the everchanging regulatory space. The team designs global, consistent, and scalable solutions and prioritize a blend between technology-driven and human decision-making processes. GSRC believes that innovation thrives on diversity, fostering an inclusive and equitable culture that empowers employees with opportunities for learning and development.

Key job responsibilities
Your job responsibilities as a Sr. Compliance Associate-Quality Analyst may include:
• Performs quality audits on a daily basis using Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and achieves self-utilization, productivity and quality as per defined targets.
• Must be able to comprehend SOPs with minimal support and identify opportunities.
• Identifies anomalies through audits (SOP defects, Process gaps etc.).
• Uses knowledge and identifies defect/s & preliminary root causes, explains the rationale
• Proposes solutions on quality/productivity and work on milestones with managers
• Expertise in research – finding specific information (eg: products, regulations etc) in a timely manner.
• Prepares key insight trends and share reports on regular basis.
• Provide feedbacks to the associates and close loop on audit observations.
• Respond to stakeholders with guidance and flags any updates to Lead/Manager

About the team
Amazon is an E-commerce and Cloud Computing company with headquarters in Seattle, Washington. Since 1995, Amazon has focused on being “the world’s most customer centric company.” Our customers are worldwide, and include not just consumers, but also our sellers and vendors (selling partners). World-class retail brands and individual sellers increase their sales and reach new customers by leveraging the power of the Amazon e-commerce platform. To meet our selling partners’ needs, our smart, diverse, customer-obsessed employees are constantly innovating and building on new ideas.
The Operational Risk Compliance (ORC) organization exists to keep our customers and partners safe, protect associates, and ensure legal and regulatory compliance. We coordinate the aspects of product transactions that are regulated (distribution, shipping, sale, and import/export). Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) is the operational arm of the ORC organization. This involves analyzing product import documentation and flagging hazardous risks. We are also responsible for keeping Amazon customers safe and informed by coordinating actions around worldwide program teams to classify products and ensure Amazon’s product listings follow regulatory and legal compliance guidelines. These actions include removing products from the site and from our warehouses, and contacting customers with pertinent sustainability information. The ORC team partners with GSRC supports regulatory compliance requirements for Amazon’s worldwide programs such as Dangerous Goods, Chemical Safety Compliance, Global Trade Services, Transport Risk Compliance, Sustainability, Extended Producer Responsibility and Food Safety. GSRC has offices across India, China, Poland, Romania, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica and supports compliance related needs for worldwide Amazon marketplaces.

- 1+ years of logistics, transportation, supply chain, import/export operations, or data entry/data administration experience
- Knowledge of Excel at a basic level (e.g., UX navigation, math & logical functions, lookup functions, etc.)
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
- Experience performing accurate data entry and analysis

Preferred qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Bachelor's degree in logistics, transporation, supply chain, or business
- Licensed customs broker

title: Sr. Critical Infrastructure Electrical Engineer, Field Engineering
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As an Amazon Critical Infrastructure Engineer, you will provide full life-cycle support to AWS Data Centers from design inception through site improvement and maintenance. You will be the ‘go to’ engineering resource for your region when technical advice is needed, and will use your subject matter expertise and engage with diverse teams to:

* Troubleshoot, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site/equipment failures.

* Directly support operational issues with ad-hoc training, complex operating procedure reviews, including critical equipment, and event support.

* Own the conceptual design for existing data center upgrades and design-solutions, which add capacity, improve availability, increase efficiency and sustainability.

* Interface with internal data center operations team, data center design engineering team, server hardware team, environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered.

* Develop innovative solutions for AWS’s data centers.

* Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions.

* Initiate and lead engineering audits including on-site visits within Amazon’s data centers. Produce reports outlining risks with recommended mitigations and remediation.

* Act as resident engineer during new construction projects. Support construction, commissioning, and turnover

Key job responsibilities
Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. As an Amazon Critical Infrastructure Engineer, you will be leading projects to fit out our data centers to meet ever-evolving customer needs as we continue expanding our fleet to hyper-scale. As an ideal candidate you:

* Possess Strong Engineering Judgement and are able to provide recommendations despite uncertainty/ambiguity.

* Possess excellent communication and writing skills, attention to detail, maintain high quality standards Organized and have the ability to set priorities and meet deadlines and budget

* Possess leadership and problem-solving skills

* Are detail and data oriented

* Have experience solving problems with engineered solutions.

* Have experience managing engineering projects and consultants.

* Build trust and relationships with different stakeholders (e.g., Operations, Controls, Construction, Design, Commissioning, Product Managers, Technical Program Managers, ).

* Are adaptable and inclined to get into the field to see things up close.

* Excited about a mix of office and field work.

A day in the life
Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will prioritize your activities to support data center capacity availability and safety focusing on the actions that are most impactful. You will have the opportunity to work on projects locally and globally.


If you meet these qualifications, exude passion, and enjoy the challenge of innovative projects at hyper-scale, this job is for you!

About the team
Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.


Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.


Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.


Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.


Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance experience
- 6+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
- Knowledge of critical data center mechanical and electrical equipment
- Experience in data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance
- Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities
- Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities
- Must hold a valid Government Certificate of Competency (GCC) - Factories

Preferred qualifications

- Professional Engineering or Architectural License
- Knowledge of building codes and regulations for your region
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer, and we value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, sex, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion or belief. Amazon is strongly committed to diversity within its community and especially welcomes applications from South African citizens who are members of designated groups who may contribute to Employment Equity within the workplace and the further diversification of ideas. We are required by law to verify your ability to work lawfully in South Africa. title: Chip Design Engineer, Graviton Team
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs, a fabless semiconductor company, was established by semiconductor industry veterans and is developing leading-edge products manufactured on state-of-the-art technologies. We are looking for talented engineers to help us develop a semiconductor platform based on a revolutionary architecture.
Take part in the development of state-of-the-art products within a disruptive system architecture. You will have the opportunity to work on the technologies that power the world's largest cloud provider, in a dynamic, open, and fast-paced environment. AWS provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud, which powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world.

AWS Graviton is a family of innovative processors designed to deliver the best price performance for cloud workloads running in Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2), the world's largest leading Cloud vendor.
The Graviton is our own internal home grown solution that re-shaped EC2 offering to AWS customers, and the preferable solution for cloud compute by customers.

We are looking for talented engineers to join our Chip Design team, working on the Graviton product line. Our chip design team is in charge of defining the product's features and working on their architecture and development. Our team members collaborate with multiple teams from different disciplines such as product definition, pre and post silicon validation, physical design, software and others contributing to a full cycle of chip development from idea to mass production. Your design will be integrated into the Graviton products, an important part of the AWS data centers worldwide. This is an opportunity to have a large-scale impact.

Join our innovative team at Annapurna Labs and play a pivotal role in developing next-generation semiconductor platforms that power the world's largest cloud infrastructure. Your expertise will directly contribute to creating transformative chip technologies that shape the future of cloud computing.

Watch these videos to learn more about Annapurna Labs and the Graviton project:

* AWS re:Invent 2025 - Keynote with Peter DeSantis and Dave Brown: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JeUpUK0nhC0
* AWS re:Invent 2025 - AWS Graviton: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=haSHl2BLhm8

Basic qualifications

- B.Sc. in Electrical or Computer Engineering. Please include your academic transcript with your CV in a single PDF

- Experience in Chip Design
- Experience with IP integration
- Experience in a full design cycle – RTL/Verification/Synthesis and timing closure/CDC/ Lint.
- Very good communication skills
- Verilog / SystemVerilog
- Protocols: Ethernet, SATA, PCIe, DDR
- Systems with embedded processors

title: Environmental Compliance Manager, EU EAP Field
descriptionHtml:
Are you an environmental compliance professional ready to make a measurable impact on the ground at Amazon facilities? As environmental regulations evolve across Europe — including the EU Energy Efficiency Directive being transposed into national law — we are expanding our Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP) team to keep pace. In this field-based role you will be the on-site environmental compliance expert for the Middle Europe region, covering Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, Czechia, Slovakia, and Austria. You will work directly at facilities to ensure compliance across all environmental media — energy, air emissions, stormwater, waste management, and wastewater discharge — turning regulatory requirements into clear, practical guidance for site teams.

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Regional Environmental Leader for Middle Europe. You will work closely with operations leadership and the Workplace Health and Safety organization to embed environmental compliance into daily site operations. As you grow, you can expect to move from hands-on field delivery to leading compliance programs across a broader set of sites and topics, with a clear path toward owning compliance areas across Europe or stepping into a team leadership position.

Key job responsibilities
- Ensure compliance with EU directives and country-specific environmental regulations across energy, air emissions, stormwater, waste management, and wastewater discharge programs at facilities in Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, Czechia, Slovakia, and Austria.
- Conduct on-site environmental risk assessments, identify and prioritize gaps, and develop site-specific mitigation plans using ISO 14001 and ISO 50001 frameworks
- Work with operations leadership and the Workplace Health and Safety organization to integrate environmental compliance requirements into daily workflows and training at each facility
- Interpret and apply EU directives and country-specific regulations, coordinating with Legal on permit applications, regulatory inquiries, and authority submissions
- Build repeatable compliance mechanisms across facilities, track key performance indicators, and report results to internal stakeholders

A day in the life
Much of your time will be spent on-site at facilities across the Middle Europe region, with the balance dedicated to desk-based compliance work. A typical morning might involve reviewing compliance data in Microsoft Office tools and preparing guidance for an upcoming audit, while the afternoon could see you at a facility walking the local team through air emissions monitoring or new energy reporting requirements. You will regularly work with Legal to engage regulators and with site leaders to roll out environmental training. Priorities shift as new regulations take effect or urgent compliance questions come up, so the ability to adapt quickly is important.

About the team
The Environmental Assurance and Protection team is a group of environmental compliance experts and program managers responsible for regulatory compliance across a large and growing portfolio of Amazon sites in the Middle Europe Region. We work side by side with local operations teams and the Workplace Health and Safety organization to keep every facility aligned with applicable environmental regulations. Our current focus is supporting the rollout of the EU Energy Efficiency Directive into national law, and we are expanding to meet that challenge. If you are excited about joining an inclusive team where your environmental expertise directly protects communities and shapes how Amazon operates, we would like to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in German and English at C1 level or above
- Experience developing and implementing environmental compliance programs including regulated waste, water, and air regulations in accordance with applicable laws
- Experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including colleagues and leadership, or experience in an operational role
- Experience in compliance, audit or risk management
- Experience with all Microsoft Office applications
- Bachelor’s degree in the Environmental Sciences, Environmental Engineering, or related field of study, or equivalent level of qualification in line with the European Qualifications Framework (EQF)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience implementing scalable compliance solutions (technology, procedures, processes, etc.) in a regulated environment
- Master's Degree in civil, chemical or environmental engineering or related field of engineering or science study
- Experience implementing and maintaining ISO 50001 certification programs in an operations setting
- Project management certification such as PMP, Scrum, or other Agile certification

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.
